chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.0 Introduction
chapterContent: Ukuphefumula kuyinto eyenzeka ngokungazikhetheli. Ukuthi ukuphefumula kangaki nokuthi umoya uphefumulwa noma ukhishwa kangaki kulawulwa ngokuqinile yisikhungo sokuphefumula ebuchosheni. Abantu, uma bengazikhandla, baphefumula cishe izikhathi ezingu-15 ngomzuzu ngokwesilinganiso. Izinja, njengenja ekuFigure 30.1, zinesilinganiso sokuphefumula esingaba ngu-15-30 ngomzuzu. Ngaphezu kokukhipha i-carbon dioxide lapho siphefumula, ososayensi bakholelwa ukuthi abantu abanamangqamuzana amaphaphu anomdlavuza nabo bakhipha inani elincane le-volatile organic com amakhilogremu. Abacwaningi basebenzise izinja eziqeqeshwe ngokukhethekile ukuze babone ukuthi zingawubona yini umehluko phakathi kwabantu abanomdlavuza wamaphaphu nabangenawo. Izinja zathola kahle iziguli ezingu-71 kwezingu-100 zomdlavuza wamaphaphu kanye nezingu-372 kwezingu-400 ezingazange ziwubone. Bheka Umfanekiso 30.1
question1: Cishe kangaki ngomzuzu umuntu ophumulayo aphefumula ngawo?
answer1: Cishe ukuphefumula okungu-15 ngomzuzu
question2: Iyiphi ingxenye yomzimba elawula ngokuqinile izinga lokuphefumula kanye nenani lomoya ophefumulwa nokhishwayo?
answer2: Isikhungo sokuphefumula ebuchosheni
question3: Lingakanani izinga lokuphefumula elijwayelekile lenja?
answer3: Cishe ukuphefumula okungu-15–30 ngomzuzu
question4: Bheka uMfanekiso 30.1. Yini izinja eziqeqeshwe ngokukhethekile ezaziyithola ekuphefumuleni kwabanye abantu?
answer4: I-Volatile organic com amakhilogremu ehlotshaniswa nomdlavuza wamaphaphu
question5: Ngokusho kocwaningo, zingaki iziguli ezingu-100 ezinomdlavuza wamaphaphu ezihlonzwe kahle yizinja eziqeqeshwe?
question6: Ngokusho kocwaningo, bangaki kubantu abangu-400 abangenawo umdlavuza wamaphaphu abahlonzwe kahle yizinja eziqeqeshwe?
question7: Yimuphi ugesi ovame ukukhishwa njengomkhiqizo ongcolile wokuphefumula?
answer7: I-carbon dioxide

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.1 Izinhlelo Zokushintshana Ngegesi | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.1 Systems of Gas Exchange | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluningi kulesi sahluko alukho ngaphakathi kwe-AP®. Kodwa-ke, ukufunda uhlelo lokuphefumula kunikeza ithuba lokusebenzisa imiqondo esiyihlolile ngaphambilini, okuhlanganisa i-chemistry kanye ne-pH, isakhiwo se-membrane yeseli, kanye nokusabalala kwama-molecule kuwo wonke ama-membrane. Izinhlelo zokuphefumula zezilwane ezingenamgogodla kanye nezilwane ezinomgogodla—kusukela ohlelweni lwe-tracheal lwezinambuzane kanye nama-gill ezinhlanzi kuya emaphashini ezihuquzelayo, izinyoni, kanye nezilwane ezincelisayo—zibonisa iphethini ehlukile yokuziphendukela kwemvelo njengoba izilwane zishintsha kusuka ezindaweni zasemanzini kuya ezindaweni zasemhlabeni. Umsebenzi wazo zonke izinhlelo zokuphefumula ukwenza kube lula ukushintshana komoya-mpilo (O2) kanye ne-carbon dioxide (CO2) nendawo ezungezile. Ukukhiqizwa kwamandla ekuphefumuleni kwamaseli kudinga i-O2, kanti i-CO2 ikhiqizwa njengomkhiqizo onobuthi. Ezinye izilwane, njengezibungu kanye nezilwane eziphila emanzini, zisebenzisa wonke umzimba wazo ukuphefumula. Izilwane zasemhlabeni, okuhlanganisa nabantu, zazidinga uhlelo olusebenza kahle kakhulu lokushintshana ngegesi. Ngakho-ke, thatha umoya ojulile (okuhloswe ngawo!) njengoba singena emisebenzini kanye nemisebenzi yesistimu yokuphefumula.

 Ungadidanisi uhlelo lokuphefumula nokuphefumula kwamaseli nakuba kokubili kuhilela ukuhamba kwe-O2 kanye ne-CO2 (ukushintshana kwegesi) phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo nendawo ezungezile.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 kanye no-Big Idea 4 wohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.A
Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kudinga amandla amahhala nezinto.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.3 Izinto eziphilayo kumele zishintshane ngezinto nendawo ezungezile ukuze zikhule, zizale futhi zilondoloze ukuhleleka.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezehlakalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obuvezwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.7 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza ukuthi ubukhulu bamaseli kanye nesimo kuthinta kanjani izinga lokudla okunomsoco kanye nezinga lokususwa kwemfucuza.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 4
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo zinezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.A
Ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo kuholela ezimpahleni eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.6 Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo ezikuyo kuphumela ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
1.3 Umfundi angalungisa izethulo kanye namamodeli ezehlakalo zemvelo noma ezenziwe ngabantu kanye nezinhlelo endaweni.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.15 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izethulo ezibonakalayo ukuhlaziya isimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngobuningi ukuze abonise ukuthi ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo ezikuyo kuphumela kanjani ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla.

 Umsebenzi oyinhloko wesistimu yokuphefumula ukuhambisa umoya-mpilo emaseli ezicubu zomzimba nokususa i-carbon dioxide, umkhiqizo ongcolile weseli. Izakhiwo eziyinhloko zesistimu yokuphefumula yomuntu yikhala, i-trachea, namaphaphu.

 Zonke izinto eziphilayo ze-aerobic zidinga umoya-mpilo ukuze zenze imisebenzi yazo ye-metabolic. Eceleni kwesihlahla sokuziphendukela kwemvelo, izinto eziphilayo ezahlukene ziye zasungula izindlela ezahlukene zokuthola umoya-mpilo emoyeni ozungezile. Indawo lapho isilwane sihlala khona inquma kakhulu ukuthi isilwane siphefumula kanjani. Ubunzima besistimu yokuphefumula buhlobene nobukhulu bento eziphilayo. Njengoba usayizi wesilwane ukhula, amabanga okusabalala ayanda kanye nesilinganiso sendawo ebusweni kuya komthamo siyehla. Ezintweni eziphilayo ezi-unicellular, ukusabalala kulo lonke ulwelwesi lweseli kwanele ukunikeza umoya-mpilo esitokisini (Isithombe 30.2). Ukusabalala kuyinqubo yokuhamba ehamba kancane, engenzi lutho. Ukuze ukusabalala kube yindlela ephumelelayo yokuhlinzeka nge-oxygen emzimbeni wesilwane, izinga lokusabalala emzimbeni wonke kumele lifane nezinga elisetshenziswa yi-oxygen. Ngamanye amazwi, uma umzimba ubumkhulu kakhulu noma ujiyile, ukusabalala bekungeke kukwazi ukunikeza i-oxygen ngokushesha ngokwanele kumaseli omzimba. Ngakho-ke, ukuncika ekusabalaleni njengendlela yokuthola i-oxygen nokususa i-carbon dioxide kusengenzeka kuphela ezintweni ezincane noma lezo ezinemizimba eyisicaba kakhulu, njengezikelemu eziningi (ama-Platyhelminthes). Izinto eziphilayo ezinkulu kwadingeka zithuthukise izicubu ezikhethekile zokuphefumula, njengemiphunga, amaphaphu, kanye nezindlela zokuphefumula ezihambisana nezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi eziyinkimbinkimbi, ukuze zithuthe i-oxygen kuwo wonke umzimba wazo.
question1: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wohlelo lokuphefumula?
answer1: Ukushintshanisa umoya-mpilo kanye ne-carbon dioxide nendawo ezungezile
question2: Uhlelo lokuphefumula luhluke kanjani ekuphefumuleni kwamaseli?
answer2: Uhlelo lokuphefumula luhilela ukushintshana kwegesi phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo nendawo ezizungezile, kuyilapho ukuphefumula kwamaseli kusebenzisa umoya-mpilo ukukhiqiza amandla ngaphakathi kwamaseli.
distractor2a: Uhlelo lokuphefumula lukhiqiza i-ATP, kuyilapho ukuphefumula kwamaseli kususa i-carbon dioxide
distractor2b: Uhlelo lokuphefumula lwenzeka ezitshalweni kuphela, kanti ukuphefumula kwamaseli kwenzeka ezilwaneni
distractor2c: Uhlelo lokuphefumula luphula i-glucose, kuyilapho ukuphefumula kwamaseli kuthutha umoya-mpilo
question3: Kungani ukusabalala kwe-membrane yeseli kwanele ukushintshaniswa kwegesi ezintweni eziphilayo ezi-unicellular?
answer3: Ubuncane bazo buvumela umoya-mpilo kanye ne-carbon dioxide ukuthi kusabalale kahle kulo lonke ulwelwesi lweseli
distractor3b: Basebenzisa ukuthutha okusebenzayo ukuhambisa umoya-mpilo emaseli
distractor3c: Zinezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi eziyinkimbinkimbi ukuze zilethe umoya-mpilo
question4: Njengoba isilwane sikhula ngobukhulu, kungani ukusabalala kuba yindlela engasebenzi kahle yokushintshanisa igesi?
answer4: Amabanga okusabalala ayanda futhi isilinganiso sendawo ebusweni kuya kuvolumu siyancipha
distractor4a: Izilwane ezinkulu zidinga umoya-mpilo omncane ukuze zisebenzise amandla azo okugaya ukudla
distractor4b: Izilwane ezinkulu zinezindawo zomzimba ezincane ezivimbela ukusabalala
distractor4c: I-carbon dioxide ayisakwazi ukukhiqizwa yizilwane ezinkulu
question5: Bheka uMfanekiso 30.2. Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezingathembela kakhulu ekusabalaleni ukuze zithole umoya-mpilo?
answer5: Izinto eziphilayo ezincane noma izinto eziphilayo ezinemizimba eyisicaba kakhulu
distractor5c: Izilwane ezihuquzelayo ezinkulu ezinezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ezibanzi
question6: Yiziphi izakhiwo zokuphefumula ezavela ezilwaneni ezinkulu ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukushintshana kwegesi?
answer6: Ama-gill, amaphaphu, kanye nezindlela zokuphefumula
distractor6a: Ama-enzyme okugaya ukudla kanye namakamelo esiswini
question7: Kungani izilwane zasemhlabeni zazidinga izinhlelo zokuphefumula ezisebenza kahle kakhulu kunezilwane eziningi zasemanzini?
answer7: Izindawo zomhlaba zazidinga izakhiwo ezikhethekile ukuze zithole umoya-mpilo owanele emoyeni

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.1 Izinhlelo Zokushintshana Kwegesi | Ukusabalala Okuqondile
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.1 Systems of Gas Exchange | Direct Diffusion
chapterContent: Kuzinto eziphilayo ezincane ezinamaseli amaningi, ukusabalala kwe-membrane yangaphandle kwanele ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zazo ze-oxygen. Ukushintshaniswa kwegesi ngokusabalala ngqo kwe-membrane engaphezulu kusebenza kahle ezintweni eziphilayo ezingaphansi kuka-1 mm ububanzi. Ezintweni eziphilayo ezilula, njenge-cnidarians kanye ne-flatworms, wonke amaseli emzimbeni aseduze nendawo engaphandle. Amaseli azo agcinwa emanzi futhi amagesi asakazeka ngokushesha ngokusabalala ngqo. Izibungu ezisicaba ziyizibungu ezincane, empeleni ezisicaba, `eziphefumula` ngokusabalala kwe-membrane yangaphandle (Isithombe 30.3). Ukuma okusicaba kwalezi zinto eziphilayo kwandisa indawo yokusabalalisa, okuqinisekisa ukuthi iseli ngalinye emzimbeni liseduze nobuso be-membrane yangaphandle futhi linokufinyelela ku-oxygen. Uma i-flatworm yayinomzimba osilinda, khona-ke amaseli aphakathi ayengeke akwazi ukuthola i-oxygen
question1: Kuluhlobo luni lwezinto eziphilayo lapho ukusabalala okuqondile kuwo wonke ama-membrane angaphezulu kuyindlela ephumelelayo yokushintshanisa igesi?
answer1: Izinto eziphilayo ezincane ezinamaseli amaningi ezingaphansi kuka-1 mm ububanzi
distractor1c: Izilwane ezihuquzelayo ezinkulu ezinezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ezibanzi
question2: Kungani izinto eziphilayo ezilula njenge-cnidarians kanye ne-flatworms zingathembela ekusakazweni okuqondile kokushintshaniswa kwegesi?
answer2: Iseli ngalinye liseduze nendawo engaphandle, okuvumela amagesi ukuthi asakazeke ngokushesha
distractor2c: Zisebenzisa ukuthutha okusebenzayo ukuhambisa amagesi kuwo wonke ama-membrane
question3: Izibungu ezithambile ziyithola kanjani i-oxygen?
answer3: Ngokusabalala kwesikhumba sabo sangaphandle
distractor3a: Ngokusebenzisa amagill atholakala ebusweni bomzimba wabo
question4: Bheka Umfanekiso 30.3. Ukuma okuyisicaba kwezibungu ezisicaba kuthuthukisa kanjani ukushintshana kwegesi?
answer4: Yandisa indawo engaphezulu yokusabalala futhi igcina amaseli eseduze nolwelwesi lwangaphandle
distractor4b: Ivumela i-flatworm ukuthi igcine umoya-mpilo ezithweni ezikhethekile
distractor4c: Kuvimbela i-carbon dioxide ukuthi ingaphumi emzimbeni
question5: Kungani isibungu esiyisicaba esinomumo oyindilinga singaba nobunzima bokuthola umoya-mpilo?
answer5: Amaseli aphakathi nendawo abe kude kakhulu ne-membrane yangaphandle ukuze asakazeke kahle
distractor5b: Ulwelwesi lwangaphandle luzoba lukhulu kakhulu ukuba lungasebenzi
distractor5c: Inyama izolahlekelwa ikhono layo lokugaya ukudla
question6: Yisiphi isimo esidingekayo ukuze ukusabalala okuqondile kuwo wonke ama-membranes angaphezulu kusebenze kahle?
answer6: Amaseli kumele asondele ngokwanele endaweni engaphandle futhi ahlale emanzi
distractor6a: Umzimba kumele ube nohlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluthuthuke kakhulu
distractor6b: Isidalwa kumele sigcine izinga lokushisa eliphezulu langaphakathi lomzimba
distractor6c: Umzimba kumele ube nezitho zokuphefumula ezikhethekile

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.1 Izinhlelo Zokushintshana Kwegesi | Isikhumba Nama-Gill
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.1 Systems of Gas Exchange | Skin and Gills
chapterContent:
Izibungu zomhlaba kanye nezilwane eziphila emanzini angaphandle zisebenzisa isikhumba sazo (i-integument) njengesitho sokuphefumula. Inethiwekhi ebanzi yama-capillary ingaphansi kwesikhumba futhi yenza kube lula ukushintshana kwegesi phakathi kwendawo yangaphandle kanye nohlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi. Indawo yokuphefumula kumele igcinwe imanzi ukuze amagesi ancibilike futhi asakazeke kuwo wonke ama-membrane eseli.

 Izinto eziphilayo ezihlala emanzini zidinga ukuthola umoya-mpilo emanzini. Umoya-mpilo uyancibilika emanzini kodwa ngenani eliphansi kunasemkhathini. Umkhathi unomoya-mpilo ocishe ube ngamaphesenti angama-21. Emanzini, inani lomoya-mpilo lincane kakhulu kunalokho. Izinhlanzi nezinye izinto eziphilayo zasemanzini ziye zashintsha ama-gill ukuze zithathe umoya-mpilo oncibilikile emanzini (Isithombe 30.4). Ama-gill ayizicucu ezincane ezinamagatsha amaningi futhi agoqekile. Lapho amanzi edlula phezu kwama-gill, umoya-mpilo oncibilikile emanzini usakazeka ngokushesha kuwo wonke ama-gill uye egazini. Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi lungabe seluthwala igazi elinomoya-mpilo liye kwezinye izingxenye zomzimba. Ezilwaneni eziqukethe uketshezi lwe-coelomic esikhundleni segazi, umoya-mpilo uyasakazeka kuwo wonke ama-gill uye kuketshezi lwe-coelomic. Ama-gill atholakala kuma-mollusk, ama-annelid, kanye nama-crustacean.

 Izindawo ezigoqiwe zama-gill zinikeza indawo enkulu yobuso ukuqinisekisa ukuthi inhlanzi ithola umoya-mpilo owanele. Ukusabalala kuyinqubo lapho izinto ezihamba khona zisuka ezindaweni ezinomthamo ophezulu ziye ekugxilweni okuphansi kuze kube yilapho kufinyelelwa ukulingana. Kulesi simo, igazi elinomthamo ophansi wama-molecule e-oxygen lijikeleza ngama-gill. Ukuxinana kwama-molecule e-oxygen emanzini kuphakeme kunomthamo wama-molecule e-oxygen kuma-gill. Ngenxa yalokho, ama-molecule e-oxygen ayasabalala emanzini (umthamo ophezulu) aye egazini (umthamo ophansi), njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 30.5. Ngokufanayo, ama-molecule e-carbon dioxide egazini ayasabalala egazini (umthamo ophezulu) aye emanzini (umthamo ophansi)
question1: Izibungu zomhlaba kanye nezilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini zisebenzisa kanjani isikhumba sazo ukuze ziphefumule?
answer1: Isikhumba sabo sisebenza njengesitho sokuphefumula lapho amagesi esakazeka khona phakathi kwendawo ezungezile kanye nohlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi
distractor1b: Isikhumba sabo sipompa umoya-mpilo ngqo emangqamuzaneni emisipha
distractor1c: Isikhumba sabo sigcina umoya-mpilo ukuze sisetshenziswe kamuva
question2: Kungani indawo yokuphefumula yezibungu zomhlaba kanye nezilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini kufanele ihlale imanzi?
answer2: Umswakama uvumela amagesi ukuthi ancibilike futhi asakazeke kuwo wonke amaseli
distractor2a: Umswakama uvimbela umoya-mpilo ukuthi ungangeni egazini
distractor2b: Umswakama ukhulisa izinga lokushisa lomzimba wezinto eziphilayo
distractor2c: Umswakama uvumela amangqamuzana ukuthi akhiqize i-carbon dioxide eningi
question3: Kungani izinto eziphilayo zasemanzini zidinga izakhiwo ezikhethekile njengezimbobo zokushintshanisa igesi?
answer3: Ukuhlushwa kwe-oxygen emanzini kuphansi kakhulu kunasemkhathini
distractor3b: Izinto eziphilayo zasemanzini azikwazi ukusebenzisa ukusabalala
distractor3c: Amanzi avimbela i-carbon dioxide ekuphumeni kwamangqamuzana
question4: Yikuphi ukuzivumelanisa nezimo kwama-gill okuvumela izinhlanzi ukuthi zithole umoya-mpilo emanzini ngempumelelo?
answer4: Ama-gill aqukethe imicu yezicubu ezincane, ezinamagatsha amaningi, nezigoqiwe ezinikeza indawo enkulu ebusweni
distractor4a: Ama-gill aqukethe izicubu ezijiyile ezigcina ama-molecule omoya-mpilo
distractor4b: Ama-gill avimbela amanzi ukuthi angathintani nezindawo zokuphefumula
distractor4c: Ama-gill akhiqiza umoya-mpilo ngokusebenzisa ukusabela kwe-metabolic
question5: Bheka uMfanekiso 30.4. I-oxygen isuka emanzini iye egazini lezinhlanzi kanjani?
answer5: I-oxygen iyasakazeka emanzini lapho kugcwele khona umoya-mpilo omningi iye egazini lapho kugcwele khona umoya-mpilo omningi.
distractor5a: I-oksijini ithuthwa ngenkuthalo isuka egazini iye emanzini
distractor5b: I-oksijini isuka ekugxilweni okuphansi emanzini iye ekugxilweni okuphezulu egazini
question6: Ngokwenqubo eboniswe kuMfanekiso 30.5, ikhabhoni diokside ihamba kanjani ngesikhathi sokushintshana kwegesi ezinhlanzini?
answer6: I-carbon dioxide iyasabalala egazini ngokugxila okuphezulu iye emanzini ngokugxila okuphansi
distractor6a: I-carbon dioxide iyasabalala emanzini iye egazini
distractor6b: I-carbon dioxide iguqulwa ibe yi-oxygen yi-gills
distractor6c: I-carbon dioxide ihlala igcinwe ngaphakathi kwama-gill
question7: Yimaphi amaqembu ezilwane avame ukuba nama-gill?
answer7: Ama-mollusk, ama-annelid, nama-crustacean
distractor7b: Izilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini kanye nezibungu ezisicaba kuphela

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.1 Izinhlelo Zokushintshana Kwegesi | Izinhlelo Zokuthulula Umoya
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.1 Systems of Gas Exchange | Tracheal Systems
chapterContent:
Ukuphefumula kwezinambuzane akuncikile ohlelweni lwazo lokujikeleza kwegazi; ngakho-ke, igazi alidlali indima eqondile ekuthuthweni komoya-mpilo. Izinambuzane zinohlobo olukhethekile kakhulu lwesistimu yokuphefumula ebizwa ngokuthi uhlelo lwe-tracheal, oluqukethe inethiwekhi yamapayipi amancane athwala umoya-mpilo uye kuwo wonke umzimba. Uhlelo lwe-tracheal luhlelo lokuphefumula oluqondile nolusebenza kahle kakhulu ezilwaneni ezisebenzayo. Amapayipi ohlelweni lwe-tracheal enziwe ngezinto ze-polymeric ezibizwa ngokuthi i-chitin.

 Imizimba yezinambuzane inezimbobo, ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-spiracle, esifubeni nasesiswini. Lezi zimbobo zixhuma kunethiwekhi ye-tubular, zivumela umoya-mpilo ukuthi udlule emzimbeni (Isithombe 30.6) futhi zilawula ukusabalala kwe-CO2 kanye nomhwamuko wamanzi. Umoya ungena futhi uphume ohlelweni lwe-tracheal ngokusebenzisa ama-spiracle. Ezinye izinambuzane zingangenisa umoya ohlelweni lwe-tracheal ngokunyakaza komzimba.
question1: Ukuphefumula kwezinambuzane kuhluke kanjani ekuphefumuleni kwezinye izilwane eziningi?
answer1: Ukuphefumula kwezinambuzane akuxhomekile ohlelweni lokujikeleza kwegazi, ngakho igazi alithuthi umoya-mpilo
distractor1a: Izinambuzane zisebenzisa igazi ukuthwala umoya-mpilo ngqo kuwo wonke amaseli
distractor1b: Izinambuzane zithola umoya-mpilo kuphela ngohlelo lwazo lokugaya ukudla
distractor1c: Izinambuzane azishintshisani umoya-mpilo kanye ne-carbon dioxide
question2: Iyini i-tracheal system ezinambuzaneni?
answer2: Inethiwekhi yamapayipi amancane athwala umoya-mpilo ngqo ezicutshini zomzimba
question3: Kungani uhlelo lwe-tracheal lubhekwa njengohlelo lokuphefumula olusebenzayo lwezinambuzane ezisebenzayo?
answer3: Ihambisa umoya-mpilo ngqo ezicutshini ngaphandle kokuthembela ohlelweni lokujikeleza kwegazi
distractor3a: Ivumela izinambuzane ukuguqula i-carbon dioxide ibe yi-glucose
distractor3b: Kuvimbela umoya-mpilo ukuthi ungafinyeleli emisipheni yezinambuzane
question4: Yiziphi izinto ezakha amapayipi ohlelo lwe-tracheal yezinambuzane?
answer4: I-Chitin
question5: Bheka Umfanekiso 30.6. Ziyini i-spiracles ezinambuzaneni?
answer5: Izimbobo eziseduze kwesifuba nesisu ezivumela umoya ukuthi ungene futhi uphume ohlelweni lwe-trachea
question6: Yimiphi imisebenzi eyenziwa ama-spiracle ekuphefumuleni kwezinambuzane?
answer6: Zivumela umoya-mpilo ukuthi ungene futhi zilawule ukusabalala kwe-carbon dioxide kanye nomhwamuko wamanzi
distractor6a: Zikhiqiza umoya-mpilo futhi zigcine i-carbon dioxide
distractor6c: Zivimbela wonke amagesi ukuthi angaphumi emzimbeni
question7: Ezinye izinambuzane zingawuphefumulisa kanjani umoya ohlelweni lwazo lokuphefumula?
answer7: Ngokusebenzisa ukunyakaza komzimba ukuhambisa umoya ngamapayipi omgudu wokuphefumula
distractor7b: Ngokumunca umoya-mpilo ngendlela yokugaya ukudla kwabo

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.1 Izinhlelo Zokushintshana Ngegesi | Izinhlelo Zezilwane Ezincelisayo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.1 Systems of Gas Exchange | Mammalian Systems
chapterContent:
Ezincelisayo, ukuphefumula kwamaphaphu kwenzeka ngokuphefumula (ukuphefumula). Ngesikhathi sokuphefumula, umoya ungena emzimbeni ngomgodi wamakhala otholakala ngaphakathi nje kwekhala (Isithombe 30.7). Njengoba umoya udlula emgodini wamakhala, umoya ufudunyezwa ufike ezingeni lokushisa lomzimba futhi ufuthwe. Indlela yokuphefumula imbozwe nge-mucus ukuvala izicubu ekuthinteni ngqo nomoya. I-mucus igcwele amanzi. Njengoba umoya udlula kulezi zindawo zolwelwesi lwama-mucous, uthatha amanzi. Lezi zinqubo zisiza ukulinganisa umoya nezimo zomzimba, zinciphise noma yimuphi umonakalo ongabangwa umoya obandayo, owomile. Izinto ezintanta emoyeni zisuswa ezindleleni zamakhala nge-mucus kanye ne-cilia. Izinqubo zokufudumala, ukufumisa, nokususa izinhlayiya ziyizindlela ezibalulekile zokuvikela ezivimbela umonakalo ku-trachea nasemaphashini. Ngakho-ke, ukuphefumula kufeza izinjongo eziningana ngaphezu kokuletha umoya-mpilo ohlelweni lokuphefumula.

 Ukusuka emgodini wamakhala, umoya udlula emphinjeni (umphimbo) kanye ne-larynx (ibhokisi lezwi), njengoba ungena ku-trachea (Isithombe 30.7). Umsebenzi oyinhloko we-trachea ukuhambisa umoya ophefumuliwe uye emaphashini bese umoya ophumayo ubuyela emzimbeni. I-trachea yomuntu iyisilinda esingaba ngu-10 kuya ku-12 cm ubude kanye nobubanzi obungu-2 cm esiphambi komhubhe futhi sisuka elarynx siye esifubeni lapho ihlukana khona ibe yi-bronchi emibili eyinhloko e-midthorax. Yenziwe ngamasongo angaphelele e-hyaline cartilage kanye nemisipha ebushelelezi (Isithombe 30.8). I-trachea igcwele amaseli e-goblet akhiqiza i-mucus kanye ne-ciliated epithelia. I-cilia ihambisa izinhlayiya zangaphandle ezivaleleke ku-mucus ziye e-pharynx. I-cartilage inikeza amandla nokusekela i-trachea ukuze kugcinwe indlela ivulekile. Imisipha ebushelelezi ingafinyela, yehlise ububanzi be-trachea, okubangela ukuthi umoya ophelelwe yisikhathi ugijimele phezulu usuka emaphashini ngamandla amakhulu. Ukuphefumula okuphoqelelwe kusiza ukukhipha i-mucus lapho sikhwehlela. Imisipha ebushelelezi ingafinyela noma iphumule, kuye ngokuthi yini ebangela indawo yangaphandle noma uhlelo lwezinzwa zomzimba.
question1: Kwenzekani ngesikhathi sokuphefumula kwamaphaphu ezincelisayo?
answer1: Umoya ungena futhi uphume ohlelweni lokuphefumula ngokuphefumula nokukhipha umoya
question2: Bheka Umfanekiso 30.7. Umoya ophefumulayo uhamba kanjani usuka emphinjeni uye emaphashini?
answer2: I-pharynx → i-larynx → i-trachea → i-bronchi → ama-bronchioles
question3: Yimiphi imisebenzi yomgodi wamakhala ngesikhathi sokuphefumula?
answer3: Iyafudumeza, ifake umswakama, futhi isuse izinhlayiya emoyeni ophefumulwayo
distractor3a: Ikhiqiza umoya-mpilo bese iyithutha iye emangqamuzaneni
question4: Kungani i-mucus ibalulekile endleleni yokuphefumula?
answer4: Ivikela izicubu ekuthintaneni ngqo nomoya futhi ibamba izinhlayiya
question5: Iyiphi indima eyenziwa yi-cilia endleleni yokuphefumula?
answer5: Zihambisa izinhlayiya zangaphandle ezivaleleke ku-mucus ziye epharynx
question6: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-trachea?
answer6: Ukuhambisa umoya ophefumulayo emaphashini kanye nokukhipha umoya emzimbeni
question7: Yini enikeza ukwesekwa kwesakhiwo ukugcina umphimbo uvulekile?
answer7: Izindandatho ezingaphelele ze-hyaline cartilage
question8: Ukufinyela kwemisipha ebushelelezi ku-trachea kusiza kanjani ngesikhathi sokukhwehlela?
answer8: Yehlisa ububanzi be-trachea, okwenza umoya ophelelwe yisikhathi ugijimele phezulu futhi ukhiphe i-mucus

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.1 Izinhlelo Zokushintshana Kwegesi | Izinhlelo Zezilwane Ezincelisayo | Amaphaphu: I-Bronchi kanye ne-Alveoli
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.1 Systems of Gas Exchange | Mammalian Systems | Lungs: Bronchi and Alveoli
chapterContent:
Isiphetho se-trachea siyahlukana (sihlukana) namaphaphu angakwesokudla nakwesobunxele. Amaphaphu awafani. Iphaphu langakwesokudla likhulu futhi liqukethe ama-lobes amathathu, kanti iphaphu elincane langakwesokunxele liqukethe ama-lobes amabili (Isithombe 30.9). I-diaphragm yemisipha, esisiza ukuphefumula, ingaphansi (ngaphansi) kwamaphaphu futhi iphawula ukuphela komgodi wesifuba.

 Emaphashini, umoya udluliselwa emigudwini emincane nemincane, noma i-bronchi. Umoya ungena emaphashini nge-bronchi ezimbili eziyinhloko (eziyinhloko) (eyodwa: i-bronchus). I-bronchus ngayinye ihlukana ibe yi-bronchi yesibili, bese kuba yi-bronchi yesithathu, ehlukana, idale ama-bronchioles amancane nemincane njengoba ehlukana futhi esakazeka emaphashini. Njenge-trachea, i-bronchi yenziwe nge-cartilage kanye nemisipha ebushelelezi. Kuma-bronchioles, i-cartilage ithathelwa indawo yimicu enwebekayo. Ama-bronchi agcinwa yimizwa yezinhlelo zezinzwa ze-parasympathetic kanye ne-sympathetic ezilawula ukufinyela kwemisipha (parasympathetic) noma ukuphumula (sympathetic) kuma-bronchi kanye nama-bronchioles, kuye ngokuthi izinkomba zesistimu yezinzwa ziyini. Kubantu, ama-bronchioles anobubanzi obungaphansi kuka-0.5 mm angama-bronchioles okuphefumula. Awanayo i-cartilage ngakho-ke athembele emoyeni ophefumulwayo ukuze asekele ukuma kwawo. Njengoba izindlela zokungena zincipha ngobubanzi, inani elilinganiselwe lemisipha ebushelelezi liyakhula.

 Ama-bronchioles agcinayo ahlukana abe amagatsha amancane abizwa ngokuthi ama-respiratory bronchioles. Ama-respiratory bronchioles ahlukana abe yimigudu eminingana ye-alveolar. Ama-alveoli amaningi kanye nama-alveolar sacs azungeze imigudu ye-alveolar. Ama-alveolar sacs afana nezinqwaba zamagilebhisi aboshwe ekugcineni kwama-bronchioles (Isithombe 30.10). Esifundeni se-acinar, imigudu ye-alveolar inamathele ekugcineni kwe-bronchiole ngayinye. Ekupheleni komsele ngamunye kukhona cishe amasaka e-alveolar ayi-100, ngalinye liqukethe ama-alveoli angu-20 kuya kwangu-30 anobubanzi obungama-microns angu-200 kuya kwangu-300. Ukushintshana kwegesi kwenzeka kuphela kuma-alveoli. Ama-Alveoli enziwe ngamaseli e-parenchymal anodonga oluncane, ngokuvamile anobukhulu beseli elilodwa, abukeka njengamabhamuza amancane ngaphakathi kwamasaka. Ama-Alveoli axhumana ngqo nama-capillary (ubukhulu beseli elilodwa) ohlelweni lokujikeleza kwegazi. Ukuxhumana okunjalo okuseduze kuqinisekisa ukuthi umoya-mpilo uzosabalala kusuka kuma-alveoli uye egazini futhi usatshalaliswe kumaseli omzimba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-carbon dioxide eyakhiqizwa amaseli njengomkhiqizo ongcolile izosabalala egazini iye kuma-alveoli okufanele ikhishwe. Ukuhlelwa kwe-anatomical kwama-capillary nama-alveoli kugcizelela ubudlelwano besakhiwo nokusebenza kwezinhlelo zokuphefumula nezokujikeleza kwegazi. Ngenxa yokuthi kune-alveoli eningi kakhulu (~300 million ngephaphu ngalinye) ngaphakathi kwesaka ngalinye le-alveolar kanye namasaka amaningi ekugcineni komsele ngamunye we-alveolar, amaphaphu anokuqina okufana nesiponji. Le nhlangano ikhiqiza indawo enkulu kakhulu etholakalayo yokushintshana kwegesi. Indawo engaphezulu ye-alveoli emaphashini ingaba ngu-75 m2. Le ndawo enkulu ebusweni, ehlanganiswe nokwakheka okunodonga oluncane kwamaseli e-alveolar parenchymal, ivumela amagesi ukuthi asakazeke kalula kuwo wonke amaseli.
question1: Bheka Umfanekiso 30.9. Amaphaphu angakwesokudla nakwesobunxele ahluke kanjani kubantu?
answer1: Iphaphu langakwesokudla likhulu futhi linama-lobe amathathu, kanti iphaphu langakwesokunxele lincane futhi linama-lobe amabili.
distractor1a: Iphaphu langakwesokudla linama-lobe amabili kanti iphaphu langakwesokunxele linama-lobe amathathu
distractor1c: Iphaphu lesobunxele likhulu ngoba liqukethe ama-alveoli amaningi
question2: Yisiphi isakhiwo esihlukanisa umgodi wesifuba nomgodi wesisu futhi esiza ukwenza kube lula ukuphefumula?
answer2: I-diaphragm
question3: Iyiphi indlela efanele yokuhamba komoya esihlahleni se-bronchial?
answer3: I-bronchi eyinhloko → i-bronchi yesibili → i-bronchi yesithathu → ama-bronchioles
distractor3a: Ama-Bronchioles → i-three bronchi → i-secondary bronchi → i-primary bronchi
distractor3b: I-bronchi eyinhloko → i-alveoli → i-bronchioles → i-bronchi yesithathu
question4: Ama-bronchioles ahluke kanjani kuma-bronchi njengoba eba yimigudu emincane yomoya?
answer4: Ama-bronchioles alahlekelwa yi-cartilage futhi aqukethe inani elikhulayo lemisipha ebushelelezi
distractor4b: Ama-bronchioles ayayeka ukuphendula ezimpawini zesistimu yezinzwa
question5: Kwenzekani ku-alveoli yamaphaphu?
answer5: Ukushintshana kwegesi kwenzeka njengoba umoya-mpilo usakazeka egazini kanye ne-carbon dioxide isakazeka iye kuma-alveoli
question6: Kungani izakhiwo ze-alveoli zisebenza kahle ekushintsheni igesi?
answer6: Zinezindonga ezincane futhi zihlobene eduze nama-capillary, okuvumela ukusabalala okuphumelelayo
distractor6a: Ziqukethe izingqimba ezijiyile ze-cartilage ukuze zisekele
distractor6c: Zivimbela i-carbon dioxide ukuthi ingaphumi emzimbeni
question7: Cishe zingaki i-alveoli ezitholakala emaphashini omuntu ngamunye?
answer7: Cishe izigidi ezingu-300 ze-alveoli
question8: Indawo enkulu ebusweni be-alveoli ithuthukisa kanjani umsebenzi wokuphefumula?
answer8: Inikeza indawo eyengeziwe yokuthi umoya-mpilo kanye ne-carbon dioxide kusabalale phakathi komoya negazi
distractor8a: Ivimbela amagesi ukuthi angaweli emangqamuzaneni eseli
question9: Buyini ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinhlelo zokuphefumula kanye nezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ku-alveoli?
answer9: Ama-capillary azungeze amagesi okushintshana kwe-alveoli nomoya we-alveolar futhi athutha umoya-mpilo kuwo wonke umzimba
distractor9a: Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi lukhiqiza umoya-mpilo ngaphakathi kwe-alveoli
distractor9b: Uhlelo lokuphefumula luthutha izakhamzimba ngemithambo yegazi
distractor9c: Lezi zinhlelo ezimbili zisebenza ngokuzimela ngaphandle kokushintshana ngezinto

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.1 Izinhlelo Zokushintshana Ngegesi | Izindlela Zokuvikela
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.1 Systems of Gas Exchange | Protective Mechanisms
chapterContent:
Umoya ophefumulwa yizinto eziphilayo uqukethe izinto ezincane ezifana nothuli, ukungcola, izinhlayiya zamagciwane, kanye namagciwane angalimaza amaphaphu noma abangele ukusabela komzimba okungezwani nomzimba. Uhlelo lokuphefumula luqukethe izindlela eziningana zokuvikela ukugwema izinkinga noma ukulimala kwezicubu. Emgodini wamakhala, izinwele kanye ne-mucus kubamba izinhlayiya ezincane, amagciwane, amabhaktheriya, uthuli, kanye nokungcola ukuvimbela ukungena kwazo.

 Uma izinhlayiya zidlula ekhaleni, noma zingena ngomlomo, i-bronchi kanye ne-bronchioles yamaphaphu nazo ziqukethe izinto eziningana zokuvikela. Amaphaphu akhiqiza i-mucus—into enamathelayo eyenziwe nge-mucin, i-glycoprotein eyinkimbinkimbi, kanye nosawoti namanzi—ebamba izinhlayiya. I-bronchi kanye ne-bronchioles ziqukethe i-cilia, izinhlayiya ezincane ezifana nezinwele ezigobe izindonga ze-bronchi kanye ne-bronchioles (Isithombe 30.11). Lezi zi-cilia ziyashayana futhi zithutha i-mucus kanye nezinhlayiya ziphume kwi-bronchi kanye ne-bronchioles ziye emphinjeni lapho zigwinywa khona futhi zikhishwe nge-esophagus.

 Kubantu, isibonelo, i-tar nezinye izinto ezisentuthwini kagwayi zibhubhisa noma zikhubaze i-cilia, okwenza ukususwa kwezinhlayiya kube nzima kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukubhema kubangela ukuthi amaphaphu akhiqize i-mucus eningi, okuyinto i-cilia eyonakele engakwazi ukuyihambisa. Lokhu kubangela ukukhwehlela okuqhubekayo, njengoba amaphaphu ezama ukususa izinhlayiya, futhi kwenza ababhemayo babe sengozini enkulu yezifo zokuphefumula.
question1: Yiziphi izinhlobo zezinto ezitholakala emoyeni ophefumulayo ezingalimaza amaphaphu noma zibangele ukusabela komzimba?
answer1: Izinto ezisanhlamvu ezifana nothuli, ukungcola, izinhlayiya zamagciwane kanye namagciwane
distractor1b: Umhwamuko wamanzi kanye ne-carbon dioxide kuphela
question2: Uboya bekhala kanye ne-mucus kuvikela kanjani uhlelo lokuphefumula?
answer2: Zibamba izinhlayiya, amagciwane, amabhaktheriya, uthuli kanye nokungcola ngaphambi kokuba zingene shí endleleni yokuphefumula
question3: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-mucus emaphashini?
answer3: Ukubopha izinto ezincane ezingena e-bronchi nase-bronchioles
question4: Yini eyenziwe nge-mucus ohlelweni lokuphefumula?
answer4: I-mucin, usawoti, namanzi
question5: Bheka uMfanekiso 30.11. Iyiphi indima edlalwa yi-cilia ku-bronchi kanye ne-bronchioles?
answer5: Zihambisa amafinyila nezinhlayiya ezibambekile ziye emphinjeni ukuze zisuswe
distractor5b: Bashintshana ngegazi nomoya-mpilo kanye ne-carbon dioxide
distractor5c: Zivimbela zonke izinhlayiya ukuthi zingangeni ekhaleni
question6: Izinhlayiya ezivalelekile zisuswa kanjani ohlelweni lokuphefumula ngemva kokuthuthwa yi-cilia?
answer6: Ziyasuswa emphinjeni, zigwinywe, bese zikhishwa ngomqala
question7: Intuthu kagwayi iyithinta kanjani i-cilia ohlelweni lokuphefumula?
answer7: I-tar nezinye izinto ezisentuthwini zingabhubhisa noma zikhubaze i-cilia
distractor7a: Kubangela ukuthi i-cilia ikhule isikhathi eside futhi isuse izinhlayiya eziningi
distractor7b: Kwandisa ukunyakaza kwe-cilia futhi kunciphisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-mucus
question8: Kungani ababhemayo bevame ukuba nokukhwehlela okungapheli?
answer8: I-cilia eyonakele ayikwazi ukususa ulwelwesi oluningi kanye nezinhlayiya ngempumelelo, okwenza amaphaphu azame ukususa ngokukhwehlela

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.2 Ukushintshana Ngegesi Kuzo Zonke Izindawo Zokuphefumula | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.2 Gas Exchange across Respiratory Surfaces | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ulwazi olukulesi sigaba mayelana nomthamo wamaphaphu kanye namandla awo lungaphandle kobubanzi be-AP®. Kodwa-ke, okuqukethwe mayelana nokuhamba kwamagesi kuwo wonke ama-membrane e-alveoli kuyindlela ebalulekile yokusebenzisa izimiso zokusabalalisa esizihlolile esahlukweni mayelana nokuhamba okungenamsebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukushintshaniswa kwegesi kunikeza umoya-mpilo odingekayo ekuphefumuleni kwamaseli e-aerobic kanye nokususwa kwe-carbon dioxide ekhiqizwa njengomkhiqizo wemfucuza ye-metabolic.

 Ukuhamba kwegesi emaphashini noma ngaphandle kuncike ekucindezelweni kwegesi. Ngenxa yokuthi umoya esiwuphefumulayo uyinhlanganisela yamagesi amaningana, kufaka phakathi i-N, i-O2 kanye ne-CO2, inani legesi ngalinye lilinganiswa ngokucindezela kwayo okungaphelele. Njengoba ukhumbula ekuhloleni kwethu kwangaphambilini kokusabalalisa, ama-molecule asuka endaweni yokuhlushwa okuphezulu aye ekuhlushweni okuphansi, noma, esimweni samagesi, esuka ekucindezelweni okungaphelele okuphezulu (okulinganiswe ku-mm Hg) aye ekucindezelweni okungaphelele okuphansi. Ngamanye amazwi, i-O2 kanye ne-CO2 zihamba nge-gradient yazo yokuhlushwa. Ngenxa yokuthi womabili amagesi amancane, ama-molecule angewona ama-polar, ahamba ngokukhululeka ku-phospholipid bilayer ye-plasma cell membrane.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo wokwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.B
Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye ne-homeostasis enamandla kudinga ukuthi iseli lidale futhi lilondoloze izindawo zangaphakathi ezihlukile endaweni yazo yangaphandle.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.B.2 Ukukhula kanye ne-homeostasis enamandla kugcinwa ukunyakaza okuqhubekayo kwama-molecule kuwo wonke ama-membrane.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.1 Umfundi angakha izethulo namamodeli ezehlakalo nezinhlelo zemvelo noma ezenziwe ngumuntu kuleso sizinda.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
7.2 Umfundi angaxhumanisa imiqondo ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwesizinda (izindawo) ukuze ahlanganise noma achaze ukuqonda okuqhubekayo kanye/noma imibono emikhulu.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.12 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi ukuze ahlole ukuthi i-homeostasis enamandla igcinwa yini ukunyakaza kwama-molecule kuwo wonke ama-membrane.

 Isakhiwo samaphaphu senza indawo yaso yobuso ikhule ukuze kwandiswe ukusabalala kwegesi. Ngenxa yenani elikhulu lama-alveoli (cishe izigidi ezingu-300 emaphashini omuntu ngamunye), indawo yobuso yamaphaphu inkulu kakhulu (75 m2). Ukuba nendawo enkulu kangaka kwandisa inani legesi elingasakazeka lingene futhi liphume emaphashini
question1: Yisiphi isimiso esichaza ukuhamba komoya-mpilo kanye ne-carbon dioxide ezimbotsheni ze-alveolar?
answer1: Ukusabalala, lapho ama-molecule eshintsha khona esuka ekugxilweni okuphezulu noma ekucindezelweni okuyingxenye aye ekugxilweni okuphansi noma ekucindezelweni okuyingxenye
distractor1a: Ukuthutha okusebenzayo, lapho ama-molecule ahamba khona ngokumelene ne-gradient yawo yokuhlushwa
distractor1b: I-Osmosis, lapho amanzi ehamba khona phezu kwe-membrane
distractor1c: I-Endocytosis, lapho amangqamuzana egubha khona ama-molecule
question2: Amagesi anjenge-oxygen kanye ne-carbon dioxide ahamba kanjani ku-plasma membrane yamaseli?
answer2: Zisakazeka ngokukhululekile ku-bilayer ye-phospholipid ngoba zingama-molecule amancane angewona ama-polar
distractor2c: Zinkulu kakhulu ukuthi zingangena ezingxeni zamaseli
question3: Yini enquma indlela igesi elihamba ngayo emaphashini noma eliphumayo?
answer3: Ukwehla kwengcindezi engaphelele yegesi
question4: Iyini ingcindezi engaphelele uma iqhathaniswa namagesi ohlelweni lokuphefumula?
answer4: Ukucindezela okubangelwa yigesi ngayinye ngaphakathi kwengxube yamagesi
distractor4a: Inani eliphelele lomoya-mpilo ogcinwe ngaphakathi kwamaseli
distractor4b: Amandla adalwe ukufinyela kwemisipha ngesikhathi sokuphefumula
question5: Kungani indawo enkulu yamaphaphu ibalulekile ekushintsheni kwegesi?
answer5: Kwandisa inani lomoya-mpilo kanye ne-carbon dioxide elingasakazeka ezindaweni zokuphefumula
distractor5a: Kuvimbela amagesi ukuthi ahambe phezu kwe-membrane
distractor5b: Kunciphisa izinga lokusabalala phakathi kwe-alveoli negazi
question6: Cishe zingaki i-alveoli ezitholakala emaphashini omuntu ngamunye?
answer6: Cishe izigidi ezingu-300 ze-alveoli
question7: Iyiphi indawo elinganiselwayo etholakalayo yokushintshanisa igesi emaphashini omuntu?
answer7: Cishe 75 m2

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.2 Ukushintshana Ngegesi Kuzo Zonke Izindawo Zokuphefumula | Izimiso Eziyisisekelo Zokushintshana Ngegesi
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.2 Gas Exchange across Respiratory Surfaces | Basic Principles of Gas Exchange
chapterContent:
Ukushintshana kwegesi ngesikhathi sokuphefumula kwenzeka ngokuyinhloko ngokusabalala. Ukusabalalisa kuyinqubo lapho ukuthutha kuqhutshwa khona ukuthambekela kokuhlushwa. Ama-molecule egesi asuka esifundeni sokuhlushwa okuphezulu aye esifundeni sokuhlushwa okuphansi. Igazi elinomthamo ophansi we-oxygen kanye nokuhlushwa okuphezulu kwe-carbon dioxide lishintshana ngegesi nomoya emaphashini. Umoya emaphashini unesilinganiso esiphezulu se-oxygen kunegazi eliphelelwe yi-oxygen kanye nokuhlushwa okuphansi kwe-carbon dioxide. Lokhu kuthambekela kokuhlushwa kuvumela ukushintshana kwegesi ngesikhathi sokuphefumula.

 Ukucindezela okuyingxenye kuyisilinganiso sokuhlushwa kwezingxenye ngazinye engxubeni yamagesi. Ukucindezela okuphelele okukhishwa yingxube kuyisamba sezingcindezi ezingaphelele zezingxenye ezingxubeni. Izinga lokusabalala kwegesi lilingana nokucindezela kwalo okungaphelele ngaphakathi kwengxube yegesi iyonke. Lo mqondo uxoxwa kabanzi ngezansi.
question1: Iyiphi inqubo eqhuba ukushintshana kwegesi ngesikhathi sokuphefumula?
answer1: Ukusabalala
question2: Ama-molecule egesi ahamba ngakuphi lapho kusatshalaliswa?
answer2: Kusukela esifundeni esinokugxila okuphezulu kuya esifundeni esinokugxila okuphansi
distractor2a: Kusukela esifundeni esinokugxila okuphansi kuya esifundeni esinokugxila okuphezulu
distractor2c: Ukusuka egazini kuya ezindaweni zomoya kuphela
question3: Igazi lishintshana kanjani amagesi nomoya emaphashini ngesikhathi sokuphefumula?
answer3: Igazi elinomoya-mpilo ophansi kanye ne-carbon dioxide ephezulu lishintshana ngamagesi nomoya wamaphaphu ogcwele umoya-mpilo
distractor3a: Igazi elinomoya-mpilo omningi likhipha umoya-mpilo emaphashini futhi limunce i-carbon dioxide
distractor3b: Igazi lishintshanisa amagesi ngokusebenzisa ukuthuthwa okusebenzayo kusetshenziswa i-ATP
distractor3c: Igazi livimbela umoya-mpilo kanye ne-carbon dioxide ukuthi ingangeni ezindaweni zokuphefumula
question4: Kungani umoya-mpilo usuka emoyeni osemaphashini uye egazini eliphelelwe umoya-mpilo?
answer4: Umoya emaphashini unezinga eliphezulu le-oxygen kunegazi
distractor4b: Ama-molecule e-oksijini adinga amandla ukuze angene egazini
distractor4c: I-carbon dioxide iphoqa umoya-mpilo ukuba ungene egazini
question5: Kuyini ukucindezela okungaphelele?
answer5: Isilinganiso sokuhlushwa kwegesi ngayinye ngaphakathi kwengxube yamagesi
distractor5a: Ingcindezi iyonke edalwe yiwo wonke amagesi ahlanganisiwe
distractor5b: Inani lomoya-mpilo ogcinwe ngaphakathi kwamaseli abomvu egazi
question6: Ingcindezi iyonke yengxube yamagesi inqunywa kanjani?
answer6: Yisamba sezingcindezi ezingaphelele zamagesi ngamanye
question7: Izinga lokusabalala kwegesi lihambisana nasiphi isici?
answer7: Ingcindezi yayo engaphelele ngaphakathi kwengxube yegesi iyonke

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.2 Ukushintshana Ngegesi Kuzo Zonke Izindawo Zokuphefumula | Ubuningi Bamaphaphu Namandla Awo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.2 Gas Exchange across Respiratory Surfaces | Lung Volumes and Capacities
chapterContent:
Izilwane ezahlukene zinamakhono ahlukene amaphaphu ngokusekelwe emisebenzini yazo. Ama-cheetah athuthukise amandla amaphaphu aphezulu kakhulu kunabantu; kusiza ekuhlinzekeni umoya-mpilo kuzo zonke imisipha emzimbeni futhi kuzivumela ukuthi zigijime ngokushesha kakhulu. Izindlovu nazo zinamandla aphezulu amaphaphu. Kulesi simo, akusikho ukuthi zigijima ngokushesha kodwa ngoba zinomzimba omkhulu futhi kumele zikwazi ukuthatha umoya-mpilo ngokuhambisana nosayizi womzimba wazo.

 Usayizi wamaphaphu omuntu unqunywa yizakhi zofuzo, ubulili, nokuphakama. Uma umthamo uphezulu, amaphaphu amaduna amadala ajwayelekile angabamba cishe amalitha ayisithupha omoya, kodwa amaphaphu awavami ukusebenza ngomthamo omkhulu. Umoya emaphashini ulinganiswa ngomthamo wamaphaphu kanye namandla amaphaphu (Isithombe 30.12 kanye nethebula elingezansi). Umthamo ulinganisa inani lomoya lomsebenzi owodwa (njengokuphefumula noma ukukhipha umoya). Umthamo ungowomthamo omabili noma ngaphezulu (isibonelo, ukuthi kungakanani okungaphefumulwa kusukela ekugcineni kokukhipha umoya omkhulu).

 Umthamo Wamaphaphu kanye Namakhono (Isilinganiso Somuntu Omdala Owesilisa)
Umthamo/Umthamo
Incazelo_____Umthamo (amalitha)_____Izilinganiso

 Umthamo we-Tidal (TV)
Inani lomoya ophefumuliwe ngesikhathi sokuphefumula okuvamile_____0.5_____-

 Umthamo wokugcina wokuphefumula (ERV)
Inani lomoya ongaphefumulwa ngemva kokuphefumula okuvamile_____1.2_____-

 Umthamo wokugcina wokuphefumula (IRV)
Inani lomoya ongaphefumulwa ngemva kokuphefumula okuvamile_____3.1_____-

 Umthamo osele (RV)
Umoya oshiywe emaphashini ngemva kokuphefumula okuphoqelelwe_____1.2_____-

 Amandla abalulekile (VC)
Inani eliphezulu lomoya ongangena noma uphume emaphashini ngomjikelezo owodwa wokuphefumula_____4.8_____ERV+TV+IRV

 Umthamo wokuphefumula (IC)
Umthamo womoya ongaphefumulwa ngemva kokuphefumula okuvamile_____3.6_____TV+IRV

 Umthamo osele wokusebenza (FRC)
Umthamo womoya osele ngemva kokuphefumula okuvamile_____2.4_____ERV+RV

 Umthamo wamaphaphu ophelele (TLC)
Umthamo womoya ophelele emaphashini ngemva kokuphefumula okuphezulu_____6.0_____RV+ERV+TV+IRV

 Umthamo wokuphefumula ophoqelelwe (FEV1)
Ungakanani umoya ongaphoqelwa uphume emaphashini esikhathini esithile, ngokuvamile umzuzwana owodwa_____~4.1 kuya ku-5.5_____-

 Umthamo emaphashini ungahlukaniswa ngamayunithi amane: umthamo womoya ogelezayo, umthamo wokugcina umoya ophefumulayo, umthamo wokugcina umoya ophefumulayo, kanye nomthamo osele. Umthamo we-Tidal (TV) ulinganisa inani lomoya ophefumulelwe futhi ophelelwe yisikhathi ngesikhathi sokuphefumula okuvamile. Ngokwesilinganiso, lo mthamo ucishe ube yi-1/2 yelitha, okungaphansi kancane komthamo webhodlela lokuphuza elingama-ounces angu-20. Umthamo wokugcina umoya ophefumulayo (ERV) yinani elengeziwe lomoya ongakhishwa umoya ngemva kokuphefumula okuvamile. Ngokuphambene nalokho, umthamo wokugcina umoya ophefumulayo (IRV) yinani elengeziwe lomoya ongakhishwa umoya ngemva kokuphefumula okuvamile. Umthamo osele (RV) yinani lomoya osele ngemva kokukhipha umoya ogelezayo. Amaphaphu awalokothi angenalutho ngokuphelele: Kuhlala kukhona umoya osele emaphashini ngemva kokuphefumula okukhulu. Uma lo mthamo osele ubungekho futhi amaphaphu ekhishwe umoya ngokuphelele, izicubu zamaphaphu bezizonamathelana futhi amandla adingekayo okuvuselela amaphaphu angaba makhulu kakhulu ukuba anganqotshwa. Ngakho-ke, kuhlale kukhona umoya osele emaphashini. Umthamo osele ubalulekile futhi ekuvimbeleni ukuguquguquka okukhulu kwamagesi okuphefumula (O2 kanye ne-CO2). Umthamo osele yiwona kuphela umthamo wamaphaphu ongenakulinganiswa ngqo ngoba akunakwenzeka ukukhipha umoya ngokuphelele emaphashini. Lo mthamo ungabalwa kuphela kunokuba ulinganiswe.

 Amandla ayizilinganiso zamavolumu amabili noma ngaphezulu. Umthamo obalulekile (VC) ulinganisa inani eliphezulu lomoya ongaphefumulwa noma ukhishwe ngesikhathi somjikelezo wokuphefumula. Yisamba sevolumu yokugcina umoya, umthamo wokugeleza kwamanzi, kanye nomthamo wokugcina umoya ophefumulelayo. Umthamo wokuphefumula (IC) yinani lomoya ongaphefumulwa ngemva kokuphela kokuphelelwa umoya okuvamile. Ngakho-ke, yisamba sevolumu yokugeleza kwamanzi kanye nomthamo wokugcina umoya ophefumulelayo. Umthamo wokugeleza osebenzayo (FRC) yivolumu yomoya osele ngemva kokuphelelwa umoya okuvamile (isamba se-ERV kanye ne-RV), okuhlanganisa umthamo wokugcina umoya ophefumulelayo kanye nomthamo osele. I-FRC ilinganisa inani lomoya owengeziwe ongakhishwa ngemva kokukhipha umoya ojwayelekile. Okokugcina, umthamo wamaphaphu ophelele (i-TLC) uwukulinganisa inani lomoya ophelele ongabanjwa amaphaphu. Yisamba sevolumu esele, umthamo wokugcina umoya ophumayo, umthamo wolwandle, kanye nomthamo wokugcina umoya ophefumulelayo.

 Umthamo wamaphaphu ulinganiswa ngendlela ebizwa ngokuthi i-spirometry. Ukulinganisa okubalulekile okuthathwa ngesikhathi se-spirometry umthamo wokuphefumula ophoqelelwe (i-FEV), olinganisa ukuthi umoya ongakanani ongaphoqwa ukuphuma emaphashini esikhathini esithile, ngokuvamile umzuzwana owodwa (i-FEV1). Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthamo ophoqelelwe wokuphila (i-FVC), okuyinani lomoya ophelele ongakhishwa umoya ophoqelelwe, uyalinganiswa. Isilinganiso salezi zindinganiso (isilinganiso se-FEV1/FVC) sisetshenziselwa ukuxilonga izifo zamaphaphu okuhlanganisa i-asthma, i-emphysema, kanye ne-fibrosis. Uma isilinganiso se-FEV1/FVC siphezulu, amaphaphu awahambisani (okusho ukuthi aqinile futhi awakwazi ukugoba kahle), futhi isiguli cishe sine-fibrosis yamaphaphu. Iziguli zikhipha umoya omningi wamaphaphu ngokushesha okukhulu. Ngokuphambene nalokho, uma isilinganiso se-FEV1/FVC siphansi, kuba nokuphikiswa emaphashini okubonakaliswa yi-asthma. Kulesi simo, kunzima ngesiguli ukukhipha umoya emaphashini aso, futhi kuthatha isikhathi eside ukufinyelela umthamo omkhulu wokukhipha umoya. Kunoma yikuphi, ukuphefumula kunzima futhi kuvela izinkinga.
question1: Kungani izingulule zinamandla aphezulu okuphefumula kunabantu?
answer1: Umthamo wabo ophezulu wamaphaphu unikeza umoya-mpilo emisipheni yabo futhi usekela ukugijima okusheshayo
distractor1a: Amaphaphu abo agcina i-carbon dioxide eyengeziwe ukuze kukhiqizwe amandla
distractor1b: Amaphaphu abo amakhulu abavumela ukuthi bagaye ukudla ngendlela ephumelelayo
distractor1c: Amaphaphu abo avimbela umoya-mpilo ukuthi ungangeni egazini labo
question2: Yiziphi izici ezithonya ubukhulu bamaphaphu omuntu?
answer2: Izakhi zofuzo, ubulili, kanye nokuphakama
distractor2a: Ukudla, ukuvama kokuvivinya umzimba, kanye nokushisa komzimba kuphela
distractor2b: Ubudala, uhlobo lwegazi, kanye nokushaya kwenhliziyo kuphela
distractor2c: Inani le-carbon dioxide elikhiqizwa amaseli kuphela
question3: Kuyini ivolumu yolwandle (i-TV)?
answer3: Inani lomoya ophefumulwayo nophefumulwayo ngesikhathi sokuphefumula okuvamile
distractor3a: Inani lomoya osele ngemva kokukhipha umoya ngenkani
distractor3b: Inani eliphezulu lomoya ohambayo ngesikhathi somjikelezo wokuphefumula
distractor3c: Inani lomoya ophefumulwayo ngemva kokukhipha umoya omkhulu
question4: Ingakanani ivolumu evamile yokugeleza kwamanzi kwendoda endala?
answer4: Cishe amalitha angu-0.5
question5: Kuyini ivolumu eseleyo (i-RV)?
answer5: Inani lomoya osele emaphashini ngemva kokukhipha umoya ngenkani
distractor5a: Inani lomoya ophefumulwayo ngesikhathi sokuphefumula okuvamile
distractor5b: Inani eliphezulu lomoya elingakhishwa ngomzuzwana owodwa
distractor5c: Inani lomoya ophefumulwayo ngemva kokukhipha umoya ojwayelekile
question6: Kungani ivolumu eseleyo ibalulekile emaphashini?
answer6: Kuvimbela izicubu zamaphaphu ukuthi zinganamatheli ndawonye futhi kunciphisa ukuguquguquka okukhulu kwamagesi okuphefumula
distractor6a: Ivumela amaphaphu ukuthi akhiphe konke ngemva kokuphefumula ngakunye
distractor6c: Kwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-carbon dioxide ezicutshini zamaphaphu
question7: Yimuphi umthamo wamaphaphu obalwa njenge-ERV + TV + IRV?
answer7: Umthamo obalulekile (VC)
question8: Iyini i-spirometry elinganisayo?
answer8: Umthamo wamaphaphu kanye namandla awo ngokulinganisa ukunyakaza komoya ngesikhathi sokuphefumula
question9: Iyini i-forced expiratory volume (FEV1) elinganisa?
answer9: Ungakanani umoya ongaphoqeleka ukuphuma emaphashini ngomzuzwana owodwa
distractor9a: Ungakanani umoya ongena emaphashini ngesikhathi sokuphefumula okuvamile
distractor9c: Inani lomoya osele ngemva kokukhipha umoya ojwayelekile
question10: Ibonisani isilinganiso esiphansi se-FEV1/FVC?
answer10: Ukumelana emaphashini okubonakaliswa yizimo ezifana ne-asthma
distractor10a: Amaphaphu aqinile abangelwa yi-fibrosis kuphela
distractor10b: Ukungakwazi ngokuphelele ukushintshanisa umoya-mpilo kanye ne-carbon dioxide
distractor10c: Ukwanda kokuguquguquka kwamaphaphu kanye nokugeleza komoya

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.2 Ukushintshana Ngegesi Kuzo Zonke Izindawo Zokuphefumula | Ukuxhumana Nomsebenzi | Uchwepheshe Wokwelapha Ukuphefumula
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.2 Gas Exchange across Respiratory Surfaces | Career Connection | Respiratory Therapist
chapterContent: Abelaphi bokuphefumula noma ochwepheshe bokuphefumula bahlola futhi belaphe iziguli ezinezifo zamaphaphu nezenhliziyo. Basebenza njengengxenye yethimba lezokwelapha ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokwelapha iziguli. Abelaphi bokuphefumula bangase baphathe izingane ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi ezinamaphaphu angakakhuli kahle, iziguli ezinezimo ezingamahlalakhona njenge-asthma, noma iziguli ezindala ezinesifo samaphaphu njenge-emphysema kanye nesifo samaphaphu esingamahlalakhona (i-COPD). Bangase basebenzise imishini ethuthukisiwe njengezinhlelo zokulethwa kwegesi ecindezelwe, ama-ventilator, ama-blood gas analyzer, kanye nama-resuscitator. Ama-pro grams akhethekile ukuze abe uchwepheshe wokuphefumula ngokuvamile aholela ezidingeni ze-bachelor nge-respiratory therapist ekhethekile. Ngenxa yokukhula kwabantu asebekhulile, amathuba emisebenzi njengochwepheshe wokuphefumula kulindeleke ukuthi ahlale eqinile.
question1: Iyini indima eyinhloko yabelaphi bezokwelapha ukuphefumula?
answer1: Ukuhlola nokwelapha iziguli ezinezifo zamaphaphu nezenhliziyo
distractor1b: Ukuxilonga nokwelapha izinkinga zesistimu yokugaya ukudla
question2: Obani abelaphi bezokwelapha izifo zokuphefumula abasebenza nabo lapho bethuthukisa izinhlelo zokwelapha?
answer2: Ithimba lezokwelapha
question3: Yiziphi iziguli ezingelashwa ngabelaphi bokuphefumula?
answer3: Izingane ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, iziguli ezine-asthma, kanye neziguli ezinezifo zamaphaphu ezifana ne-emphysema kanye ne-COPD
distractor3a: Iziguli eziphukile amathambo kanye nokulimala kwemisipha kuphela
distractor3b: Abadlali abanempilo kuphela abafuna ukuthuthukiswa kokusebenza
distractor3c: Iziguli ezinezinkinga zokugaya ukudla kanye nezinso kuphela
question4: Kungani abelaphi bokuphefumula bengase baphathe izingane ezisanda kuzalwa?
answer4: Izingane ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi zingase zibe namaphaphu angakakhuli kahle
distractor4a: Izingane ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi azikwazi ukushintshanisa izakhamzimba ngokugaya ukudla
distractor4b: Izingane ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi zinamaphaphu akhule ngokugcwele kodwa imisipha ebuthakathaka
distractor4c: Izingane ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi azikwazi ukukhiqiza amangqamuzana abomvu egazi
question5: Yisiphi isimo sokuphefumula esingamahlalakhona esingadinga ukwelashwa ngudokotela wezifo zokuphefumula?
answer5: Isifuba somoya
question6: Yimiphi imishini engasetshenziswa ngabelaphi bokuphefumula?
answer6: Izinhlelo zokulethwa kwegesi ezicindezelwe, ama-ventilator, ama-blood gas analyzer, kanye nama-resuscitator
distractor6b: Amarobhothi okuhlinzwa kanye namadivayisi okuthwebula izithombe kuphela
question7: Uhlobo luni lwemfundo oludingekayo ukuze ube ngumelaphi wokuphefumula?
answer7: Iziqu ze-bachelors kanye nochwepheshe wezokwelapha ophefumulayo
distractor7a: Idiploma yesikole samabanga aphezulu engenalo ukuqeqeshwa okwengeziwe
question8: Kungani amathuba emisebenzi abelaphi bokuphefumula kulindeleke ukuthi ahlale eqinile?
answer8: Ngenxa yokukhula kwabantu abadala
distractor8b: Ngoba yonke imishini yokuphefumula ithathelwa indawo amarobhothi

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.2 Ukushintshana Ngegesi Kuzo Zonke Izindawo Zokuphefumula | Ukucindezela Kwegesi Nokuphefumula
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.2 Gas Exchange across Respiratory Surfaces | Gas Pressure and Respiration
chapterContent:
Inqubo yokuphefumula ingaqondwa kangcono ngokuhlola izakhiwo zamagesi. Amagesi ahamba ngokukhululeka, kodwa izinhlayiya zegesi zihlala zishaya izindonga zomkhumbi wazo, ngaleyo ndlela zikhiqize umfutho wegesi.

 Umoya uyinhlanganisela yamagesi, ikakhulukazi i-nitrogen (N2; amaphesenti angu-78.6), umoya-mpilo (O2; amaphesenti angu-20.9), umhwamuko wamanzi (H2O; amaphesenti angu-0.5), kanye ne-carbon dioxide (CO2; amaphesenti angu-0.04). Ingxenye ngayinye yegesi yaleyo ngxube inengcindezi. Umfutho wegesi ngayinye engxubeni uwumfutho ongaphelele waleyo gesi. Cishe amaphesenti angu-21 egesi yomoya-mpilo uwumoya-mpilo. Nokho, i-carbon dioxide itholakala ngamanani amancane, amaphesenti angu-0.04. Umfutho ongaphelele we-oxygen mkhulu kakhulu kunowe-carbon dioxide. Umfutho ongaphelele wanoma iyiphi igesi ungabalwa ngokuthi:

 P=(Patm)×(iphesenti lokuqukethwe ekuxubeni).
I-Patm, ingcindezi yomoya, iyisamba sazo zonke izingcindezi ezingaphelele zamagesi omoya ahlanganiswe ndawonye,

 I-Patm⁢=PN2⁢+PO2⁢+PH2O⁢+PCO2=760mmHg.
Ingcindezi yomoya olwandle ingu-760 mm Hg. Ngakho-ke, ingcindezi engaphelele yomoya-mpilo ingu:

 PO2=(760mmHg)(0.21)=160mmHg
kanye ne-carbon dioxide:

 PCO2=(760mmHg)(0.0004)=0.3mmHg.
Ezindaweni eziphakeme, i-Patm iyancipha kodwa ukuhlushwa akushintshi; ukwehla kwengcindezi engaphelele kungenxa yokwehla kwe-Patm.

 Lapho ingxube yomoya ifika emaphashini, isuke imanzisiwe. Ukucindezela komhwamuko wamanzi emaphashini akushintshi ukucindezela komoya, kodwa kumele kufakwe ku-equation yokucindezela okungaphelele. Kulokhu kubalwa, ukucindezela kwamanzi (47 mm Hg) kususiwe ekucindezelweni komoya:

 760mmHg−47mmHg=713mmHg
kanti ukucindezela okungaphelele komoya-mpilo kungu:

 (760mmHg−47mmHg)×0⁢.21=150mmHg.
Lezi zingcindezi zinquma ukushintshaniswa kwegesi, noma ukugeleza kwegesi, ohlelweni. I-oxygen ne-carbon dioxide kuzogeleza ngokwe-gradient yazo yokucindezela kusukela phezulu kuya phansi. Ngakho-ke, ukuqonda ukucindezela okungaphelele kwegesi ngayinye kuzosiza ekuqondeni ukuthi amagesi ahamba kanjani ohlelweni lokuphefumula. Bheka Umfanekiso 30.11.1

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.2 Ukushintshana Ngegesi Kuzo Zonke Izindawo Zokuphefumula | Ukushintshana Ngegesi Kuzo Zonke Izindawo Zokuphefumula
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.2 Gas Exchange across Respiratory Surfaces | Gas Exchange across the Alveoli
chapterContent:
Emzimbeni, umoya-mpilo usetshenziswa amaseli ezicubu zomzimba kanti i-carbon dioxide ikhiqizwa njengomkhiqizo ongcolile. Isilinganiso sokukhiqizwa kwe-carbon dioxide nokusetshenziswa kwe-oxygen yi-respiratory quotient (RQ). I-RQ iyahlukahluka phakathi kuka-0.7 no-1.0. Uma i-glucose kuphela isetshenziswa ukugcwalisa umzimba, i-RQ ibingalingana neyodwa. I-mole eyodwa ye-carbon dioxide ibingakhiqizwa kuyo yonke i-mole ye-oxygen esetshenziswayo. Nokho, i-glucose akuyona yodwa uphethiloli womzimba. Amaprotheni namafutha nawo asetshenziswa njengamafutha omzimba. Ngenxa yalokhu, kukhiqizwa i-carbon dioxide encane kune-oxygen esetshenziswayo kanti i-RQ, ngokwesilinganiso, cishe ingu-0.7 yamafutha kanye no-0.8 wamaprotheni.

 I-RQ isetshenziselwa ukubala ingcindezi engaphelele ye-oxygen ezindaweni ze-alveolar ngaphakathi kwamaphaphu, i-alveolar PO2
Ngaphezulu, ingcindezi engaphelele ye-oxygen emaphashini ibalwe ukuthi ingu-150 mm Hg. Kodwa-ke, amaphaphu awalokothi anciphe ngokuphelele ngokukhipha umoya; Ngakho-ke, umoya ophefumulelwe uhlangana nalo moya osele futhi wehlisa ingcindezi engaphelele yomoya-mpilo ngaphakathi kwe-alveoli. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kukhona ukuhlushwa okuphansi komoya-mpilo emaphashini kunalokho okutholakala emoyeni ongaphandle komzimba. Ukwazi i-RQ, ingcindezi engaphelele yomoya-mpilo ku-alveoli ingabalwa (bheka Umfanekiso 30.11.2):

 alveolarPO2⁢=inspiredPO2⁢(
alveolarPCO2

 )
Nge-RQ engu-0.8 kanye ne-PCO2
ku-alveoli engu-40 mm Hg, i-alveolar PO2
ilingana no:

 i-alveolarPO2=150mmHg−(

 )=mmHg.
Qaphela ukuthi le ngcindezi ingaphansi komoya wangaphandle. Kodwa-ke, isenkulu kunomfutho ongaphelele womoya-mpilo egazini njengoba ingena ku-alveoli, ngakho-ke, umoya-mpilo uzogeleza usuka emoyeni ophefumulelwe emaphashini (PO2
= 100 mm Hg) ungene egazini (PO2
= 40 mm Hg) (Isithombe 30.13).

 Emaphashini, umoya-mpilo uyasakazeka usuka ku-alveoli uye ku-capillaries ezungeze i-alveoli. I-oxygen (cishe amaphesenti angu-98) ibopha ngokubuyela emuva ku-hemoglobin yombala wokuphefumula etholakala kumaseli abomvu egazi (ama-RBC). Ama-RBC athwala umoya-mpilo uye ezicutshini lapho umoya-mpilo uhlukana khona ne-hemoglobin bese usakazeka ungene emaseli ezicubu. Ngokuqondile, i-alveolar PO2
iphakeme ku-alveoli (i-PALVO2
= 100 mm Hg) kune-blood PO2
(40 mm Hg) kuma-capillary. Ngenxa yokuthi lo mfutho ukhona, umoya-mpilo uyasakazeka phansi kwe-gradient yawo yokucindezela, usuke ku-alveoli bese ungena egazini lama-capillary lapho i-O2 ibopha khona i-hemoglobin. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, i-alveolar PCO2
iphansi ku-PALVCO2
= 40 mm Hg kune-blood PCO2
= (45 mm Hg). I-CO2 iyasakazeka phansi kwe-gradient yayo yokucindezela, isuke ku-capillary bese ingena ku-alveoli.

 I-oxygen ne-carbon dioxide ziyahamba ngokuzimela; ziyasakazeka phansi kwe-gradient yazo yokucindezela. Njengoba igazi liphuma emaphashini ngemithambo yamaphaphu, i-venous PO2
= 100 mm Hg, kuyilapho i-venous PCO2
= 40 mm Hg. Njengoba igazi lingena kuma-capillary ajwayelekile, igazi lizolahlekelwa umoya-mpilo futhi lithole i-carbon dioxide ngenxa yokwehluka kwengcindezi kwezicubu negazi. Kuma-capillary ajwayelekile, i-PO2
= 100 mm Hg, kodwa kumaseli ezicubu, i-PO2
= 40 mm Hg. Lokhu kuthambekela kokucindezela kuqhuba ukusabalala komoya-mpilo kuma-capillary kanye namaseli ezicubu. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, i-PCO2 yegazi
= 40 mm Hg kanye ne-PCO2 yezicubu ezijwayelekile
= 45 mm Hg. Ukuthambekela kokucindezela kuqhuba i-CO2 kumaseli ezicubu kanye nama-capillary. Igazi elibuyela emaphashini ngemithambo ye-pulmonary line-venous PO2
= 40 mm Hg kanye ne-PCO2
= 45 mm Hg. Igazi lingena kuma-capillary amaphaphu lapho inqubo yokushintshanisa amagesi phakathi kwama-capillary kanye ne-alveoli iqala khona futhi (Isithombe 30.13).

 Ngamafuphi, ushintsho ekucindezelweni okungaphelele okuvela ku-alveoli kuya kuma-capillary luqhuba umoya-mpilo ungene ezicutshini kanye ne-carbon dioxide ingene egazini elivela ezicutshini. Igazi libe selithuthelwa emaphashini lapho umehluko ekucindezelweni ku-alveoli uholela ekuthuthweni kwe-carbon dioxide egazini iye emaphashini, kanye nomoya-mpilo ungene egazini.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.3 Ukuphefumula | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®

chapterContent:
Ulwazi olukulesi sigaba alukho ngaphakathi kwe-AP® futhi aluhambisani noHlaka Lwezifundo. Kodwa-ke, ukuqonda ukuthi ukuphefumula kwenzeka kanjani kuthuthukisa ukuqonda komuntu ngesakhiwo kanye nomsebenzi wohlelo lokuphefumula.

 Amaphaphu ezilwane ezincelisayo atholakala emgodini wesifuba lapho ezungezwe futhi evikelwe yi-rib cage, imisipha ye-intercostal, futhi eboshwe udonga lwesifuba. Iphansi lamaphaphu liqukethwe yi-diaphragm, imisipha yamathambo eyenza kube lula ukuphefumula. Ukuphefumula kudinga ukuhlanganiswa kwamaphaphu, udonga lwesifuba, futhi okubaluleke kakhulu, i-diaphragm.
question1: Akuphi amaphaphu ezilwane ezincelisayo?

distractor2c: Inhliziyo, izinso, kanye nomgudu wokugaya ukudla
question3: Iyini i-diaphragm?
answer3: Umsipha wamathambo osiza ukuphefumula
question4: Yini etholakala phansi kwamaphaphu futhi esiza ekulawuleni lawo maphaphu?
answer4: I-diaphragm
question5: Yiziphi izakhiwo okumele zihambisane ukuze ukuphefumula kwenzeke?
answer5: Amaphaphu, udonga lwesifuba, kanye ne-diaphragm
distractor5c: Ubuchopho, umgogodla, kanye nohlelo lokugaya ukudla

answer6: I-diaphragm
question7: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-rib cage ekuphefumuleni?
answer7: Ukuzungeza nokuvikela amaphaphu

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.3 Ukuphefumula | Izinhlobo Zokuphefumula
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.3 Breathing | Types of Breathing
chapterContent:
Izilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini ziye zavela ngezindlela eziningi zokuphefumula. Izilwane ezincane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini, njengezimpukane, zisebenzisa izimpukane ukuphefumula, futhi azishiyi amanzi. Ezinye izilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini zigcina izimpukane impilo yazo yonke. Njengoba impukane ikhula, izimpukane ziyanyamalala futhi amaphaphu ayakhula. Lawa maphaphu asendulo futhi awashintshi njengamaphaphu ezilwane ezincelisayo. Izilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini ezindala azinawo noma zine-diaphragm enciphile, ngakho-ke ukuphefumula ngamaphaphu kuyaphoqeleka. Enye indlela yokuphefumula yama-amphibians ukusabalala esikhumbeni. Ukuze kusizwe lokhu kusabalala, isikhumba sama-amphibian kumele sihlale simanzi.

 Izinyoni zibhekene nenselele eyingqayizivele maqondana nokuphefumula: Ziyandiza. Ukundiza kudla amandla amaningi; ngakho-ke, izinyoni zidinga umoya-mpilo omningi ukusiza izinqubo zazo ze-metabolic. Izinyoni ziye zasungula uhlelo lokuphefumula oluzinikeza umoya-mpilo odingekayo ukuze zikwazi ukundiza. Njengezilwane ezincelisayo, izinyoni zinamaphaphu, okuyizitho ezikhethekile zokushintshana ngegesi. Umoya one-oxygen, othathwa ngesikhathi sokuphefumula, uyasakazeka ebusweni bamaphaphu uye egazini, futhi i-carbon dioxide iyasakazeka egazini iye emaphashini bese ikhishwa ngesikhathi sokuphefumula. Imininingwane yokuphefumula phakathi kwezinyoni nezilwane ezincelisayo ihluke kakhulu.

 Ngaphezu kwamaphaphu, izinyoni zinezikhwama zomoya ngaphakathi emizimbeni yazo. Umoya ugeleza ohlangothini olulodwa usuka ezikhwameni zomoya ezingemuva uye emaphashini futhi uphume ezikhwameni zomoya ezingaphambili. Ukugeleza komoya kuphambene nokugeleza kwegazi, futhi ukushintshana kwegesi kwenzeka kahle kakhulu. Lolu hlobo lokuphefumula lwenza izinyoni zikwazi ukuthola umoya-mpilo odingekayo, ngisho nasezindaweni eziphakeme lapho ukugcwala komoya-mpilo kuphansi. Lokhu kuqondiswa kokugeleza komoya kudinga imijikelezo emibili yokungenisa umoya kanye nokukhipha umoya ukuze kukhishwe umoya ngokuphelele emaphashini.

 Zonke izilwane ezincelisayo zinamaphaphu ayizitho eziyinhloko zokuphefumula. Amandla amaphaphu athuthukile ukusekela imisebenzi yesilwane. Ngesikhathi sokuphefumula, amaphaphu ayanda ngomoya, futhi umoya-mpilo uyasakazeka ebusweni bamaphaphu bese ungena egazini. Ngesikhathi sokuphefumula, amaphaphu akhipha umoya futhi ivolumu yamaphaphu iyancipha. Ezigabeni ezimbalwa ezilandelayo, inqubo yokuphefumula komuntu izochazwa
