answer9: Uhlelo lwabo lokuhamba komoya olusebenzayo luvumela ukushintshaniswa kwegesi okuphumelelayo ngisho nalapho ukugcwala komoya-mpilo kuphansi
question10: Kwenzekani emaphashini ezincelisayo ngesikhathi sokuphefumula nokukhipha umoya?
answer10: Ngesikhathi sokuphefumula amaphaphu akhula ngomoya, futhi ngesikhathi sokuphefumula akhipha umoya futhi anciphise ivolumu.
distractor10a: Ngesikhathi sokuphefumula, amaphaphu ancipha ngobukhulu, futhi ngesikhathi sokuphefumula ayanda.
distractor10b: Amaphaphu ahlala enobukhulu obufanayo ngesikhathi sokuphefumula
distractor10c: Amaphaphu akhiqiza umoya-mpilo ngesikhathi sokuphefumula kanye ne-carbon dioxide ngesikhathi sokuphefumula

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.3 Ukuphefumula | Ukuphefumula Kwezinyoni
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.3 Breathing | Avian Respiration
chapterContent:
Izinyoni zithuthukise uhlelo lokuphefumula oluzivumela ukuthi zindize. Ukundiza kuyinqubo enamandla amakhulu futhi kudinga umoya-mpilo omningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinyoni eziningi zindiza ezindaweni eziphakeme lapho ukugcwala komoya-mpilo kuphansi. Izinyoni zashintsha kanjani uhlelo lokuphefumula oluhlukile kangaka?

 Ucwaningo lweminyaka eminingi olwenziwe ososayensi be-paleontologists lukhombisile ukuthi izinyoni zavela kuma-therapods, ama-dinosaur adla inyama (Isithombe 30.14). Eqinisweni, ubufakazi bezinsalela bubonisa ukuthi ama-dinosaur adla inyama aphila eminyakeni engaphezu kwezigidi eziyi-100 edlule ayenesistimu yokuphefumula efanayo egeleza ngamaphaphu kanye nama-air sacs. I-Archeopteryx kanye ne-Xiaotingia, isibonelo, kwakuyizi-dinosaur ezindizayo futhi kukholakala ukuthi zingabanduleli bokuqala bezinyoni
question1: Kungani izinyoni zidinga uhlelo lokuphefumula olusebenza kahle kakhulu?
answer1: Ukundiza kudinga amandla amaningi kanye nomoya-mpilo
distractor1c: Ukundiza kudinga umoya-mpilo omncane kunokuhamba ngezinyawo
question2: Kungani ukuphefumula kuyinselele ikakhulukazi ezinyonini ezindiza ezindaweni eziphakeme?
answer2: Ukuhlushwa komoya-mpilo kuphansi ezindaweni eziphakeme
distractor2c: Umfutho womoya uyanda ezindaweni eziphakeme futhi umisa ukusabalala
question3: Izinyoni zavela kuliphi iqembu lama-dinosaur?
answer3: Ama-Therapod, ama-dinosaur adla inyama
question4: Yibuphi ubufakazi obusikisela ukuthi amanye ama-dinosaur ayenezinhlelo zokuphefumula ezifana nezezinyoni zanamuhla?
answer4: Ubufakazi bezinsalela bubonisa ukuthi amanye ama-dinosaur adla inyama ayenezinhlayiya zokuphefumula ezinamaphaphu kanye nezikhwama zomoya
distractor4a: Izinsalela zikhombisa ukuthi ama-dinosaur ayenamaphaphu ezilwane ezincelisayo anama-diaphragm
distractor4b: Izinsalela zikhombisa ukuthi ama-dinosaur ashintshana ngamagesi ngesikhumba sawo kuphela
distractor4c: Izinsalela zikhombisa ukuthi ama-dinosaur ayengadingi umoya-mpilo
question5: Yiziphi izibankwakazi ezindizayo zasendulo ezibhekwa njengezibikezelo zokuqala zezinyoni?
answer5: I-Archeopteryx ne-Xiaotingia
question6: Kusho ukuthini uhlelo lokuphefumula olugeleza ezinyonini?
answer6: Umoya uhamba ohlelweni lokuphefumula ngendlela ecishe ibe yinye
distractor6a: Umoya uhamba uye emuva naphambili ngendlela efanayo naleyo ezilwaneni ezincelisayo
question7: Bheka Umfanekiso 30.14. Uhlelo lokuphefumula olugeleza luzisiza kanjani izinyoni ngesikhathi zindiza?
answer7: Ivumela ukuphefumula okuphumelelayo ngokugcina ukuhamba komoya okuqhubekayo emasakeni omoya nasezinhlakeni zokuphefumula
distractor7a: Ivumela izinyoni ukuthi ziphefumule ngaphandle kokusebenzisa umoya-mpilo
distractor7b: Ithatha indawo yamaphaphu ngamathambo angenalutho ashintshanisa amagesi
distractor7c: Kunciphisa ukuhamba komoya-mpilo ngokunciphisa ukuhamba komoya
question8: Kungani amasaka omoya ebalulekile ohlelweni lokuphefumula lwezinyoni?
answer8: Zisiza ukugcina ukuhamba komoya okuqhubekayo futhi zithuthukise ukusebenza kahle kokushintshana komoya-mpilo
distractor8b: Zithatha indawo yemithambo yegazi ohlelweni lokuphefumula
distractor8c: Zivimbela i-carbon dioxide ukuthi ingaphumi emaphashini
question9: Uhlelo lokuphefumula lwezinyoni luhluke kanjani ohlelweni lokuphefumula lwezilwane ezincelisayo?
answer9: Izinyoni zisebenzisa amasaka omoya kanye nokugeleza komoya okuya ohlangothini olulodwa, kuyilapho izilwane ezincelisayo zisebenzisa ukugeleza komoya okuya ohlangothini olulodwa emaphashini
distractor9a: Izinyoni azinawo amaphaphu, kuyilapho izilwane ezincelisayo zinawo
distractor9b: Izinyoni zishintshana ngamagesi ngesikhumba esikhundleni sezitho zokuphefumula
distractor9c: Izinyoni zisebenzisa ama-gill esikhundleni sezikhwama zomoya
question10: Bheka uMfanekiso 30.14. Iningi lethu licabanga ukuthi ama-dinosaur asephelile. Kodwa-ke, izinyoni zanamuhla ziyinzalo yama-dinosaur ezinyoni. Khumbula futhi ubuyekeze indlela yokuphefumula yezinyoni, njengoba kuboniswe. Thola ukuthi kusho ukuthini ngalesi sitatimende, lezi zilwane `zinohlelo lokuphefumula olugeleza,`” bese uchaza ukuthi lokhu kusiza kanjani izinyoni ezindizayo
answer10: Uhlelo lokuphefumula olugeleza luvumela umoya ukuthi uhambe ngendlela ecishe ibe yinye emaphashini, kanye namasaka omoya agcina ukuhamba komoya okuqhubekayo ukuze kube nokushintshana kwegesi okuphumelelayo ngesikhathi sokundiza.
distractor10a: Uhlelo lokuphefumula olugeleza luvumela umoya ukuthi uhambe ngokuphelele ohlangothini olulodwa, ngaphandle kokulandela umkhondo wawo nhlobo, okuvumela isilwane ukuthi siphefumule ngokushesha ngenkathi sindiza.
distractor10b: Uhlelo lokuphefumula olugeleza luqukethe izikhwama zomoya eziningana ezenza isilwane sibe lula uma siqhathaniswa nezilwane ezinobukhulu obufanayo ezingenazo izikhwama zomoya.
distractor10c: Uhlelo lokuphefumula olugeleza luqukethe amaphaphu amaningi, avumela izilwane ukuthi zithole umoya-mpilo omningi odingekayo ukuze zindiza.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.3 Ukuphefumula | Izindlela Zokuphefumula Zomuntu
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.3 Breathing | The Mechanics of Human Breathing
chapterContent:
Umthetho kaBoyle umthetho wegesi othi endaweni evaliwe, ingcindezi kanye nomthamo kuhlobene ngendlela ephambene. Njengoba ivolumu yehla, ingcindezi iyanda kanye nokwehlukile (Isithombe 30.15). Ubudlelwano phakathi kwengcindezi yegesi kanye nomthamo kusiza ukuchaza indlela yokuphefumula.

 Kuhlala kukhona ingcindezi encane engemihle ngaphakathi komgodi wesifuba, okusiza ekugcineni imigudu yomoya yamaphaphu ivulekile. Ngesikhathi sokuphefumula, ivolumu iyanda ngenxa yokufinyela kwe-diaphragm, kanye nengcindezi iyancipha (ngokusho koMthetho kaBoyle). Lokhu kwehla kwengcindezi emgodini wesifuba uma kuqhathaniswa nendawo ezungezile kwenza umgodi ube ngaphansi komkhathi (Isithombe 30.16a). Ngenxa yalokhu kwehla kwengcindezi, umoya ugijimela emigudwini yokuphefumula. Ukuze kwandiswe ivolumu yamaphaphu, udonga lwesifuba luyanda. Lokhu kubangelwa ukufinyela kwemisipha ye-intercostal, imisipha exhunywe ekhejini lezimbambo. Ivolumu yamaphaphu iyanda ngoba i-diaphragm iyafinyela kanye nemisipha ye-intercostal iyafinyela, ngaleyo ndlela yandisa umgodi wesifuba. Lokhu kwanda komthamo womgodi wesifuba kunciphisa ukucindezeleka uma kuqhathaniswa nomoya, ngakho umoya ugijimela emaphashini, ngaleyo ndlela ukhulisa umthamo wawo. Ukwanda komthamo okubangelwa yilokhu kubangelwa ukwanda kwesikhala se-alveolar, ngoba ama-bronchioles kanye ne-bronchi kuyizakhiwo eziqinile ezingashintshi ngobukhulu.

 Udonga lwesifuba luyanwebeka luphuma futhi lusuke emaphashini. Amaphaphu ayanwebeka; ngakho-ke, lapho umoya ugcwalisa amaphaphu, ukugoba okunwebekayo ngaphakathi kwezicubu zamaphaphu kubuyisela ingcindezi emuva ngaphakathi kwamaphaphu. Lawa mandla angaphandle nangaphakathi ancintisana ukufutha nokuthulula amaphaphu ngokuphefumula ngakunye. Lapho ephefumula, amaphaphu ayagoba ukuze aphoqe umoya uphume emaphashini, futhi imisipha ye-intercostal iyaphumula, ibuyisele udonga lwesifuba endaweni yalo yokuqala (Isithombe 30.16b). I-diaphragm nayo iyaphumula futhi ihambe iye phezulu emgodini wesifuba. Lokhu kwandisa ingcindezi ngaphakathi komgodi wesifuba uma kuqhathaniswa nendawo ezungezile, futhi umoya uphuma emaphashini. Ukuhamba komoya uphuma emaphashini kuyisenzakalo esingenzi lutho. Akukho misipha efinyela ukuze ikhiphe umoya.

 Iphaphu ngalinye lizungezwe yisikhwama esifakwe ngaphakathi. Ungqimba lwezicubu olumboza iphaphu bese lungena ezikhaleni lubizwa ngokuthi i-visceral pleura. Ungqimba lwesibili lwe-parietal pleura luhlanganisa ingaphakathi lesifuba (Isithombe 30.17). Isikhala esiphakathi kwalezi zingqimba, isikhala sangaphakathi kwesifuba, siqukethe inani elincane loketshezi oluvikela izicubu futhi lunciphise ukungqubuzana okubangelwa ukuxubha izingqimba zezicubu njengoba amaphaphu efinyela futhi ephumula. I-Pleurisy iphumela lapho lezi zingqimba zezicubu zivuvukala; kuba buhlungu ngoba ukuvuvukala kwandisa ingcindezi ngaphakathi kwesifuba futhi kunciphisa umthamo wamaphaphu
question1: UMthetho kaBoyle uthini ngobudlelwano phakathi komfutho wegesi kanye nomthamo endaweni evaliwe?
answer1: Ukucindezela kanye nomthamo kuhlobene ngokuphambene
distractor1a: Ukucindezela kanye nevolumu kuhlale kukhuphuka ndawonye
distractor1c: Ukucindezela kuhlala kungashintshi kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ivolumu ingakanani
question2: Ngokusho koMthetho kaBoyle, kwenzekani ngengcindezi lapho umthamo wegesi wehla?
answer2: Ukucindezela kuyakhuphuka
question3: Kwenzekani ngesikhathi sokuphefumula okubangela ukuba umoya ungene emaphashini?
answer3: Imisipha ye-diaphragm kanye ne-intercostal iyafinyela, ikhulisa umthamo womgodi wesifuba futhi yehlise ingcindezi
distractor3a: I-diaphragm iyaphumula, inyuse ingcindezi futhi isunduze umoya emaphashini
distractor3b: Amaphaphu adonsa umoya ngenkuthalo esebenzisa ukufinyela kwemisipha
distractor3c: Ama-bronchioles ayanda kuyilapho umgodi wesifuba uncipha ngomthamo
question4: Iyini indima ye-diaphragm ngesikhathi sokuphefumula?
answer4: Iyafinyela futhi inyuse umthamo womgodi wesifuba
question5: Imisipha ye-intercostal isiza kanjani ngesikhathi sokuphefumula?
answer5: Ziyafinyela ukuze zandise udonga lwesifuba futhi zandise umthamo womgodi wesifuba
distractor5a: Bashintshana nge-oxygen kanye ne-carbon dioxide ku-alveoli
distractor5c: Zikhipha umoya ngamandla kuzo zonke izenzakalo zokuphefumula
question6: Kungani umoya ungena emaphashini ngesikhathi sokuphefumula?
answer6: Ingcindezi ngaphakathi kwesifuba iba ngaphansi kunengcindezi yomoya
distractor6a: Ingcindezi ngaphakathi kwesifuba iba phezulu kunengcindezi yomoya
distractor6c: Amaphaphu adala umoya-mpilo odonsa umoya ngaphakathi
question7: Kwenzekani ngesikhathi sokuphefumula okuvamile?
answer7: Imisipha ye-diaphragm kanye ne-intercostal iyakhululeka, okubangela ukwanda kwengcindezi yesifuba kanye nomoya ophuma emaphashini
distractor7b: Amaphaphu akhipha umoya ngamandla esebenzisa amandla
distractor7c: Udonga lwesifuba luyakhula ukuze luphoqelele umoya ukungena ngaphakathi
question8: Kungani ukuphefumula okuvamile kubhekwa njengenqubo engenzi lutho?
answer8: Akukho misipha efinyela ukuze kuphoqwe umoya emaphashini
distractor8a: Amaphaphu ayayeka ukushintshanisa amagesi ngesikhathi sokuphefumula
question9: Uyini umsebenzi we-pleural membranes ezungeze amaphaphu?
answer9: Zivikela izicubu zamaphaphu futhi zinciphisa ukungqubuzana ngesikhathi sokunyakaza kwamaphaphu
distractor9a: Zikhiqiza umoya-mpilo ukuze igazi ligeleze kahle
question10: Kuyini i-pleurisy?
answer10: Ukuvuvukala kwezingqimba ze-pleural okwandisa ubuhlungu futhi kunciphisa umthamo wamaphaphu
distractor10a: Isimo lapho i-alveoli ikhula khona unomphela ngobukhulu
distractor10c: Isimo lapho i-diaphragm iyeka ukufinyela ngokuphelele

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.3 Ukuphefumula | Umsebenzi Wokuphefumula
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.3 Breathing | The Work of Breathing
chapterContent:
Inani lokuphefumula ngomzuzu liyisilinganiso sokuphefumula. Ngokwesilinganiso, ngaphansi kwezimo zokungazivocavoci, izinga lokuphefumula lomuntu lingukuphefumula okungu-12-15 ngomzuzu. Izinga lokuphefumula lifaka isandla ekungeneni komoya ngaphakathi kwe-alveoli, noma ukuthi umoya ongakanani ongena futhi uphuma e-alveoli. Ukuphefumula ngaphakathi kwe-alveoli kuvimbela ukwakheka kwe-carbon dioxide e-alveoli. Kunezindlela ezimbili zokugcina ukuphefumula ngaphakathi kwe-alveoli kungaguquguquki: ukwandisa izinga lokuphefumula ngenkathi unciphisa umthamo womoya ngokuphefumula (ukuphefumula okungajulile), noma ukunciphisa izinga lokuphefumula ngenkathi ukhulisa umthamo womoya ngokuphefumula. Kunoma yikuphi, ukuphefumula kuhlala kufana, kodwa umsebenzi owenziwe kanye nohlobo lomsebenzi odingekayo kuhlukile kakhulu. Kokubili umthamo womoya kanye nesilinganiso sokuphefumula kulawulwa eduze lapho isidingo se-oxygen sanda.

 Kunezinhlobo ezimbili zomsebenzi owenziwa ngesikhathi sokuphefumula, umsebenzi ovimbela ukugeleza kanye nomsebenzi ovimbela ukugeleza. Ukumelana nokugeleza kubhekisela emsebenzini we-alveoli nezicubu emaphashini, kanti umsebenzi ovimbela ukugeleza ubhekisela emsebenzini wemisipha ye-intercostal, udonga lwesifuba, kanye ne-diaphragm. Ukwandisa izinga lokuphefumula kwandisa umsebenzi wokumelana nokugeleza kwemigudu yomoya futhi kunciphisa umsebenzi wokunwebeka kwemisipha. Ukunciphisa izinga lokuphefumula kuguqula uhlobo lomsebenzi odingekayo.
question1: Kuyini izinga lokuphefumula?
answer1: Inani lokuphefumula okuthathwa ngomzuzu
question2: Ingakanani isilinganiso sokuphefumula esijwayelekile kubantu abaphumule ngaphansi kwezimo zokungazivocavoci?
answer2: Ukuphefumula okungu-12–15 ngomzuzu
question3: Kuyini ukungenisa umoya e-alveolar?
answer3: Inani lomoya ongena futhi ophumayo ku-alveoli
question4: Kungani kubalulekile ukungenisa umoya e-alveolar?
answer4: Ivimbela ukunqwabelana kwe-carbon dioxide kuma-alveoli
question5: Umoya wokungenisa umoya ophuma e-alveolar ungahlala kanjani ungaguquguquki ngenkathi uphefumula kancane?
answer5: Izinga lokuphefumula liyakhuphuka ngenkathi ivolumu yolwandle incipha
distractor5a: Izinga lokuphefumula liyancipha ngenkathi ivolumu yolwandle incipha
distractor5b: Izinga lokuphefumula liyakhula ngenkathi ivolumu yolwandle ikhuphuka
distractor5c: Kokubili izinga lokuphefumula kanye nomthamo womoya kuyayeka ukushintsha
question6: Kwenzekani ngomthamo womoya-mpilo kanye nesivinini sokuphefumula lapho isidingo somoya-mpilo sanda?
answer6: Zombili zilawulwa eduze ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo ezengeziwe zomoya-mpilo
distractor6b: Umthamo womoya kuphela oshintshayo ngenkathi izinga lokuphefumula lihlala lizinzile
question7: Yiziphi izinhlobo ezimbili zomsebenzi ezenziwa ngesikhathi sokuphefumula?
answer7: Umsebenzi wokumelana nokugeleza kanye nomsebenzi wokunwebeka
distractor7a: Umsebenzi we-Metabolic kanye nomsebenzi wokugaya ukudla
distractor7c: Umsebenzi osebenzayo kanye nomsebenzi wokuthutha ongenzi lutho
question8: Umsebenzi wokumelana nokugeleza ubhekisela kuphi?
answer8: Umsebenzi odingwa yi-alveoli nezicubu zamaphaphu
distractor8c: Umsebenzi wokuthutha izakhamzimba ohlelweni lokugaya ukudla
question9: Umsebenzi we-elastic ubhekisela kuphi?
answer9: Umsebenzi owenziwa yimisipha ye-intercostal, udonga lwesifuba, kanye ne-diaphragm
distractor9b: Ukushintshana kwamagesi kuwo wonke ama-membrane e-alveolar
question10: Ukwanda kwesilinganiso sokuphefumula kuthinta kanjani izinhlobo zomsebenzi odingekayo ukuze kuphefumule?
answer10: Kwandisa umsebenzi wokumelana nokugeleza kwamanzi futhi kunciphisa umsebenzi wokunwebeka
distractor10a: Kunciphisa umsebenzi wokumelana nokugeleza kwamanzi futhi kwandisa umsebenzi wokunwebeka
distractor10b: Kunciphisa kokubili umsebenzi wokumelana nokugeleza kanye nomsebenzi wokunwebeka
distractor10c: Kwandisa kokubili umsebenzi wokumelana nokugeleza kanye nomsebenzi wokunwebeka

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.3 Ukuphefumula | Umsebenzi Wokuphefumula | I-Surfactant
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.3 Breathing | The Work of Breathing | Surfactant
chapterContent:
I-interface yomoya nezicubu/amanzi ye-alveoli inokucindezeleka okuphezulu kobuso. Lokhu kuxineka kobuso kufana nokuxineka kobuso bamanzi endaweni yokuxhumana koketshezi nomoya weconsi lamanzi okuholela ekuhlanganisweni kwama-molecule amanzi ndawonye. I-Surfactant iyinhlanganisela eyinkimbinkimbi yama-phospholipid nama-lipoprotein esebenza ukunciphisa ukuxineka kobuso okukhona phakathi kwezicubu ze-alveoli nomoya otholakala ngaphakathi kwe-alveoli. Ngokunciphisa ukuxineka kobuso koketshezi lwe-alveolar, kunciphisa ukuthambekela kwe-alveoli kokuwa.

 I-Surfactant isebenza njengesihlanzi ukunciphisa ukuxineka kobuso futhi ivumela ukukhuphuka okulula kwemigudu yomoya. Lapho ibhaluni liqala ukukhukhumala, kuthatha umzamo omkhulu ukwelula ipulasitiki bese uqala ukukhukhumala ibhaluni. Uma insipho encane ifakwa ngaphakathi kwebhaluni, khona-ke inani lomzamo noma umsebenzi odingekayo ukuqala ukukhukhumala ibhaluni lizoncipha, futhi kuzoba lula kakhulu ukuqala ukuqhumisa ibhaluni. Lesi simiso esifanayo sisebenza emigudwini yomoya. Inani elincane le-surfactant ezicutshini zomoya linciphisa umzamo noma umsebenzi odingekayo ukuze kufuthwe lezo zindlela zomoya. Izingane ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi ngezinye izikhathi azikhiqizi i-surfactant eyanele. Ngenxa yalokho, zihlushwa yi-respiratory distress syndrome, ngoba kudinga umzamo owengeziwe ukuze kufuthwe amaphaphu azo. I-surfactant ibalulekile futhi ekuvimbeleni ukuwohloka kwe-alveoli encane uma kuqhathaniswa ne-alveoli enkulu.
question1: Yini ebangela ukucindezeleka okuphezulu kobuso endaweni yokuxhumana komoya-izicubu/namanzi kwe-alveoli?
answer1: Ukuhlanganiswa kwama-molecule amanzi endaweni yokuxhumana yoketshezi nomoya
question2: Kuyini i-surfactant?
answer2: Ingxube eyinkimbinkimbi yama-phospholipid nama-lipoprotein ehlisa ukucindezeleka kobuso be-alveolar
distractor2a: Iphrotheni ethwala umoya-mpilo emangqamuzaneni abomvu egazi
question3: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-surfactant emaphashini?
answer3: Ukunciphisa ukucindezeleka kobuso nokuvimbela i-alveoli ukuthi ingawi
question4: I-surfactant yenza kanjani ukuphefumula kube lula?
answer4: Yehlisa ukucindezeleka kobuso, inciphise umzamo odingekayo wokufaka umoya ongcolile
distractor4b: Kuvimbela i-alveoli ukuthi ikhule ngesikhathi sokuphefumula
distractor4c: Kukhulisa ingcindezi edingekayo ukuvula imigudu yokuphefumula
question5: I-surfactant isebenza kanjani ngendlela efanayo nensipho ebhaluni?
answer5: Kokubili kunciphisa ukucindezeleka kobuso futhi kunciphisa umzamo odingekayo wokufaka umoya esakhiweni
distractor5a: Kokubili kwandisa ukucindezeleka kobuso ukuze kube lula ukukhuphuka kwamanani
distractor5b: Kokubili kuvimbela amagesi ukuthi angahambi phezu kwe-membrane
question6: Kungani izingane ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi zingaba nesifo sokucindezeleka kokuphefumula?
answer6: Zingase zingakhiqizi i-surfactant eyanele, okwenza kube nzima kakhulu ukwehla kwamaphaphu
distractor6a: Zikhiqiza i-surfactant eningi kakhulu, zivimbela ukushintshaniswa kwegesi
distractor6b: Ama-alveoli abo awakwazi ukuthwala umoya ngemva kokuzalwa
question7: Kwenzekani uma kungekho i-surfactant eyanele ku-alveoli?
answer7: Kudingeka umzamo owengeziwe ukuze kufakwe umoya emaphashini futhi i-alveoli ingase iwele phansi
question8: Kungani i-surfactant ibalulekile ekuvimbeleni ukuwohloka kwe-alveoli encane?
answer8: Kunciphisa ukucindezeleka kobuso futhi kusiza ukugcina ukuzinza kwe-alveolar
distractor8a: Kwandisa umehluko wokucindezela obhidliza ama-alveoli amancane

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.3 Ukuphefumula | Umsebenzi Wokuphefumula | Ukumelana Nokuhambisana Nemithetho Yamaphaphu
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.3 Breathing | The Work of Breathing | Lung Resistance and Compliance
chapterContent:
Izifo zamaphaphu zinciphisa izinga lokushintshana kwegesi ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwamaphaphu. Izimbangela ezimbili eziyinhloko zokuncipha kokushintshana kwegesi ukuhambisana (ukuthi iphaphu lithambile kangakanani) kanye nokumelana (ukuthi kungakanani ukuvinjelwa okukhona emigudwini yomoya). Ushintsho kunoma yikuphi kungashintsha kakhulu ukuphefumula kanye nekhono lokungenisa umoya-mpilo nokukhipha i-carbon dioxide.

 Izibonelo zezifo ezivimbelayo yi-respiratory distress syndrome kanye ne-pulmonary fibrosis. Kuzo zombili lezi zifo, imigudu yomoya ayihambisani kahle futhi iqinile noma i-fibrotic. Kukhona ukwehla kokuhambisana ngoba izicubu zamaphaphu azikwazi ukugoba nokunyakaza. Kulezi zinhlobo zezifo ezivimbelayo, ingcindezi yangaphakathi kwe-pleural ingcono kakhulu futhi imigudu yomoya iyawa lapho uphefumula, okubamba umoya emaphashini. Amandla aphoqelelwe noma asebenzayo (i-FVC), okuyinani lomoya elingakhishwa ngenkani ngemva kokuthatha umoya ojulile ngangokunokwenzeka, liphansi kakhulu kuneziguli ezivamile, futhi isikhathi esithathwayo ukukhupha umoya omningi sithatha isikhathi eside kakhulu (Isithombe 30.18). Isiguli esihlushwa yilezi zifo asikwazi ukukhipha umoya ojwayelekile.

 Izifo nezimo ezivimbelayo zifaka phakathi i-emphysema, i-asthma, kanye ne-pulmonary edema. Ku-emphysema, evame ukuvela ekubhemeni ugwayi, izindonga ze-alveoli ziyabhujiswa, kunciphisa indawo yokushintshana kwegesi. Ukuhambisana okuphelele kwamaphaphu kuyanda, ngoba njengoba izindonga ze-alveolar zonakele, ukubuyela emuva kwe-elastic yamaphaphu kuncipha ngenxa yokulahlekelwa imicu ye-elastic, futhi umoya omningi ubhajwa emaphashini ekugcineni kokuphefumula. I-asthma yisifo lapho ukuvuvukala kubangelwa yizici zemvelo. Ukuvuvukala kuvimbela imigudu yomoya. Ukuvaleka kungase kube ngenxa ye-edema (ukuqongelela koketshezi), ukuqaqamba kwemisipha ebushelelezi ezindongeni ze-bronchioles, ukwanda kokukhishwa kwe-mucus, ukulimala kwe-epithelia yemigudu yomoya, noma inhlanganisela yalezi zenzakalo. Labo abane-asthma noma i-edema bahlangabezana nokuvaleka okukhulu ngenxa yokuvuvukala okukhulu kwemigudu yomoya. Lokhu kuvame ukuvimba imigudu yomoya, kuvimbele ukunyakaza okufanele kwamagesi (Isithombe 30.18). Labo abanezifo ezivimbelayo banomoya omningi obhajwe ngemva kokuphefumula futhi baphefumula ngomthamo ophezulu wamaphaphu ukuze bakhokhele ukuntuleka kokuqashwa kwemigudu yomoya.
question1: Yiziphi izici ezimbili ezinganciphisa ukushintshaniswa kwegesi emaphashini nakumaphaphu?
answer1: Ukuthobela imithetho kanye nokumelana
distractor1c: Ukukhiqizwa kwe-oksijini kanye nokugcinwa kwe-carbon dioxide
question2: Kuchaza ukuthini ukuhambisana nomthetho wamaphaphu?

distractor2c: Indlela igazi eligeleza ngayo ngokushesha ngama-capillaries amaphaphu
question3: Kuchaza ukuthini ukumelana nokuphefumula?
answer3: Kungakanani ukuvinjelwa okukhona emigudwini yomoya
distractor3b: Ukuthi i-diaphragm ifinyela kangakanani ngesikhathi sokuphefumula
question4: Yiziphi kulezi ezilandelayo eziyizibonelo zezifo zamaphaphu ezivimbelayo?
answer4: I-Respiratory distress syndrome kanye ne-pulmonary fibrosis
question5: Kungani izifo ezivimbelayo zinciphisa ukuhambisana kwamaphaphu?
answer5: Izicubu zamaphaphu ziyaqina futhi azikwazi ukugoba nokukhula ngendlela evamile
distractor5b: Imigudu yomoya iba mikhulu futhi iguquguquke kakhudlwana
distractor5c: Amaphaphu alahlekelwa yiwo wonke amandla okumelana nokugeleza komoya
question6: Kwenzekani kumandla aphoqelelwe okuphila (i-FVC) ezigulini ezinezifo ezivimbelayo?
answer6: Kuphansi kakhulu kunokujwayelekile ngoba iziguli azikwazi ukukhipha umoya ojwayelekile
distractor6c: Kuyancipha kuphela ngoba umoya-mpilo awukwazi ukungena egazini
question7: I-emphysema ithinta kanjani ukusebenza kwamaphaphu?
answer7: Ibhubhisa izindonga ze-alveolar, inciphisa indawo yokushintshana kwegesi futhi inciphise ukubuyela emuva kwe-elastic
distractor7a: Kukhulisa izindonga ze-alveolar futhi kuthuthukisa ukushintshaniswa kwegesi
distractor7b: Kwenza amaphaphu abe lukhuni ngokwandisa i-fibrosis
question8: Kungani ukuhambisana kwamaphaphu kukhula ku-emphysema?
answer8: Ukulahlekelwa imicu enwebekayo kunciphisa ukubuyela emuva kwe-elastic yamaphaphu
question9: Yini ebangela ukuvaleka komoya ku-asthma?
answer9: Ukuvuvukala okungase kuhilele ukuvuvukala, ukuqaqamba kwemisipha ebushelelezi, ukwanda kwe-mucus, noma umonakalo we-epithelial
question10: Bheka Umfanekiso 30.18. Izifo ezivimbayo zithinta kanjani ukuphefumula?
answer10: Zibangela umoya omningi ovalelekile ngemva kokukhipha umoya futhi zivimbela ukuhamba kahle kwegesi
distractor10a: Zandisa ukuhamba komoya ngokwandisa yonke imigudu yomoya
distractor10b: Zivumela iziguli ukuthi zikhiphe amaphaphu azo ngokuphelele ngemva kokuphefumula ngakunye
distractor10c: Zinciphisa umthamo wamaphaphu ngoba amaphaphu aqina ngokuphelele

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.3 Ukuphefumula | Isikhala Esifile: Ukungafani kwe-V/Q
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.3 Breathing | Dead Space: V/Q Mismatch
chapterContent:
Umfutho wokujikeleza kwegazi emaphashini uphansi kakhulu uma uqhathaniswa nowe-systemic circulation. Futhi awuncikile ekuphumeni kwenhliziyo. Lokhu kungenxa yento ebizwa ngokuthi ukuqashwa, okuyinqubo yokuvula imigudu yomoya evame ukuhlala ivaliwe lapho ukuphuma kwenhliziyo kukhuphuka. Njengoba ukuphuma kwenhliziyo kukhuphuka, inani lama-capillary nemithambo yegazi egeleza (egcwele igazi) liyakhula. La ma-capillary nemithambo yegazi asetshenziswa njalo kodwa akulungele uma kudingeka. Nokho, ngezinye izikhathi, kukhona ukungafani phakathi kwenani lomoya (umoya, V) kanye nenani legazi (umoya, Q) emaphashini. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukungahambisani komoya/umoya (V/Q).

 Kunezinhlobo ezimbili zokungafani kwe-V/Q. Zombili zikhiqiza isikhala esifile, izifunda zezicubu zamaphaphu eziphukile noma ezivinjiwe. Izikhala ezifile zingathinta kakhulu ukuphefumula, ngoba zinciphisa indawo engaphezulu etholakalayo yokusabalala kwegesi. Ngenxa yalokho, inani lomoya-mpilo egazini liyancipha, kanti izinga le-carbon dioxide liyakhuphuka. Isikhala esifile siyadalwa lapho kungekho umoya-mpilo kanye/noma ukungcola okwenzekayo. Isikhala esifile somzimba noma i-shunt ye-anatomical, sivela ekuhlulekeni komzimba, kuyilapho isikhala esifile ngokomzimba noma i-shunt ye-physiological, sivela ekuphazamisekeni kokusebenza kwamaphaphu noma imithambo yegazi.

 Isibonelo se-shunt ye-anatomical umphumela wamandla adonsela phansi emaphashini. Amaphaphu asengozini enkulu yokushintsha ubukhulu kanye nesiqondiso samandla adonsela phansi. Uma umuntu emi noma ehleli eqondile, i-gradient yengcindezi ye-pleural iholela ekungeneni komoya ongaphezulu phansi emaphashini. Ngenxa yalokho, ingcindezi yangaphakathi kwe-pleural ayibi kakhulu esisekelweni samaphaphu kunaphezulu, futhi umoya omningi ugcwalisa phansi kwephaphu kunaphezulu. Ngokufanayo, kuthatha amandla amancane ukupompa igazi phansi kwephaphu kunaphezulu uma usesimweni sokuthambekela. Ukugeleza kwegazi emaphashini akuhambisani ngenkathi umi noma uhleli. Lokhu kungumphumela wamandla e-hydrostatic ahlanganiswe nomthelela wengcindezi yomoya. I-shunt ye-anatomical iyavela ngoba ukugeleza komoya okuphefumulayo akuhambisani nokugeleza kwegazi emithambo yegazi ezungeze leyo migudu yomoya. Ngenxa yalokho, izinga lokushintshana kwegesi liyancishiswa. Qaphela ukuthi lokhu akwenzeki uma ulele phansi, ngoba kulesi simo, amandla adonsela phansi awadonseli phansi iphaphu.

 I-shunt yomzimba ingavela uma kukhona ukutheleleka noma ukuvuvukala emaphashini okuvimbela indawo. Lokhu kuzonciphisa ukuphefumula kodwa kungaphazamisi ukujikeleza kwegazi; ngakho-ke, isilinganiso se-V/Q siyashintsha futhi ukushintshana kwegesi kuyathinteka.

 Amaphaphu angakhokhela lokhu kungalingani kokungena komoya kanye nokujikeleza kwegazi. Uma ukuphefumula kukhulu kunokujikeleza kwegazi, ama-arterioles (imithambo yegazi emincane yemithambo yegazi) ayavuleka futhi ama-bronchioles ayancipha. Lokhu kwandisa ukujikeleza kwegazi futhi kunciphisa ukujikeleza kwegazi. Ngokufanayo, uma ukuphefumula kungaphansi kokujikeleza kwegazi, ama-arterioles ayancipha kanye nama-bronchioles ayancipha ukuze kulungiswe ukungalingani.
question1: Kungani ingcindezi yokujikeleza kwegazi emaphashini iphansi kunengcindezi yokujikeleza kwegazi emzimbeni?
answer1: Ukujikeleza kwegazi emaphashini kusebenzisa inqubo yokuqoqa evula imithambo yegazi eyengeziwe uma kudingeka
distractor1a: Amaphaphu awadingi ukugeleza kwegazi ukuze kushintshwe igesi
question2: Kuyini ukuqashwa kwegazi emgudwini womoya emaphashini?
answer2: Inqubo yokuvula imigudu yomoya kanye nemithambo yegazi evame ukuvalwa lapho ukuphuma kwenhliziyo kukhuphuka
distractor2c: Inqubo yokunciphisa ukugeleza kwegazi ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca
question3: Kuchaza ukuthini ukungalingani komoya/umoya ophumayo (V/Q)?
answer3: Ukungafani phakathi komoya ofinyelela emaphashini kanye nenani legazi eligeleza emaphashini
distractor3a: Ukungafani phakathi kokukhiqizwa kwe-oxygen ne-carbon dioxide emaseli
distractor3b: Ukungafani phakathi kwesilinganiso senhliziyo nesilinganiso sokuphefumula
distractor3c: Ukungafani phakathi kosayizi wamaphaphu nosayizi womzimba
question4: Ziyini izikhala ezifile emaphashini?
answer4: Izindawo zezicubu zamaphaphu ezonakele noma ezivinjiwe lapho ukushintshana kwegesi kuncipha khona
distractor4a: Izindawo lapho kwenzeka khona ukukhiqizwa komoya-mpilo
distractor4b: Izindawo lapho ukugeleza kwegazi kukhula khona unomphela
distractor4c: Izindawo lapho i-alveoli ikhiqiza khona i-surfactant eyengeziwe
question5: Isikhala esifile sithinta kanjani amazinga egesi egazini?
answer5: Yehlisa amazinga omoya-mpilo egazini futhi yandisa amazinga e-carbon dioxide
distractor5a: Yandisa amazinga e-oxygen futhi yehlisa amazinga e-carbon dioxide
distractor5b: Kuvimbela noma yiziphi izinguquko kumagesi egazini
question6: Uyini umehluko phakathi kwesikhala esifile sokwakheka komzimba kanye nesikhala esifile sokwakheka komzimba?
answer6: Isikhala esifile somzimba sibangelwa ukwehluleka komzimba, kanti isikhala esifile ngokomzimba sibangelwa ukukhubazeka kokusebenza.
distractor6a: Isikhala esifile se-anatomical senzeka enhliziyweni kuphela, kanti isikhala esifile se-physiological senzeka ebuchosheni kuphela.
distractor6b: Isikhala esifile somzimba sithinta ukukhiqizwa komoya-mpilo, kanti isikhala esifile ngokomzimba sithinta ukukhiqizwa kwe-carbon dioxide
question7: Kungani amandla adonsela phansi angadala i-shunt yokwakheka kwamaphaphu?
answer7: Umoya kanye nokugeleza kwegazi akufani ngokulinganayo kulo lonke iphaphu lapho umi noma uhleli
distractor7a: Amandla adonsela phansi avimba konke ukugeleza kwegazi emaphashini
distractor7b: Amandla adonsela phansi abangela ukuthi umoya-mpilo uphume egazini ngokushesha
distractor7c: Amandla adonsela phansi avimbela umoya ukuthi ungene emaphashini
question8: Yini ebangela i-shunt yomzimba?
answer8: Ukutheleleka noma ukuvuvuka okuvimbela ukuphefumula ngenkathi uketshezi luqhubeka
question9: Iphaphu lisabela kanjani uma umoya ungena kakhulu kunomoya ophumayo?
answer9: Ama-arterioles ayavuleka futhi ama-bronchioles ancipha ukuze kwandiswe uketshezi oluphumayo futhi kuncishiswe umoya
distractor9a: Ama-arterioles anciphile futhi ama-bronchioles ayanda ukuze kwandiswe umoya
question10: Iphaphu lisabela kanjani uma umoya ungaphansi komoya ophumayo?
answer10: Ukuminyana kwe-arterioles kanye ne-bronchioles kuyavuleka ukuze kulungiswe ukungalingani
distractor10a: Ama-arterioles ayavuleka futhi ama-bronchioles ancipha
distractor10b: Zombili izakhiwo zandisa ukumelana nokugeleza komoya

Ukushintshana kwegesi ezingeni lezicubu nakho kwenzeka ngokusabalala. Iningi lomoya-mpilo othuthwa usuka emaphashini uye ezicutshini zomzimba liboshelwe kuphrotheni ebizwa ngokuthi i-hemoglobin. I-hemoglobin iyiphrotheni ye-quaternary equkethe amaqembu amane e-heme aqukethe insimbi; insimbi inobuhlobo obukhulu nomoya-mpilo. (Siyakwazi lokhu ngoba insimbi iyagqwala uma ivezwa emoyeni.)

 Uma i-oxygen isakazeka kuyo yonke i-alveoli, ingena egazini bese ithuthwa iye ezicutshini lapho ithululwa khona, bese i-carbon dioxide isakazeka iphuma egazini iye kwi-alveoli ukuze ikhishwe emzimbeni. chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.4 Ukuthuthwa Kwamagesi Kuketshezi Lomzimba Womuntu | Ukuthuthwa Kwe-Oxygen Egazini | I-Hemoglobin
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.4 Transport of Gases in Human Bodily Fluids | Transport of Oxygen in the Blood | Hemoglobin
chapterContent:
Nakuba umoya-mpilo uncibilika egazini, inani elincane kuphela lomoya-mpilo lithuthwa ngale ndlela. Amaphesenti angu-1.5 kuphela omoya-mpilo egazini ancibilika ngqo egazini ngokwalo. Iningi lomoya-mpilo—amaphesenti angu-98.5—liboshelwe kuphrotheni ebizwa ngokuthi i-hemoglobin bese liyiswa ezicutshini.

 I-Hemoglobin
I-Hemoglobin, noma i-Hb, iyi-molecule yephrotheni etholakala kumaseli abomvu egazi (ama-erythrocyte) enziwe ngama-subunit amane: ama-subunit amabili e-alpha kanye nama-subunit amabili e-beta (Isithombe 30.19). I-subunit ngayinye izungeza iqembu eliphakathi le-heme eliqukethe insimbi futhi libopha i-molecule eyodwa yomoya-mpilo, okuvumela i-molecule ngayinye ye-hemoglobin ukuthi ibophe ama-molecule amane omoya-mpilo. Ama-molecule anomoya-mpilo omningi aboshwe emaqenjini e-heme abomvu ngokugqamile. Ngenxa yalokho, igazi le-arterial eline-oxygen lapho i-Hb ithwele ama-molecule amane omoya-mpilo libomvu ngokugqamile, kanti igazi le-venous elikhishwe umoya-mpilo libomvu ngokugqamile.

 Kulula ukubopha i-molecule yesibili neyesithathu yomoya-mpilo ku-Hb kune-molecule yokuqala. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi i-molecule ye-hemoglobin ishintsha isimo sayo, noma ukwakheka kwayo, njengoba i-oxygen ibopha. I-oxygen yesine iba nzima kakhulu ukuyibopha. Ukubopha kwe-oxygen ku-hemoglobin kungadwetshwa njengomsebenzi wokucindezela okuyingxenye kwe-oxygen egazini (x-axis) uma kuqhathaniswa nokugcwala kwe-Hb-oxygen (y-axis). Igrafu ephumayo—ijika lokuhlukanisa i-oxygen—liyi-sigmoidal, noma eliyi-S-shape (Isithombe 30.20). Njengoba ukucindezela okuyingxenye kwe-oxygen kwanda, i-hemoglobin igcwala kakhulu i-oxygen.

answer2: Iboshelwe ku-hemoglobin kumaseli abomvu egazi

answer3: I-molecule yeprotheni emangqamuzaneni abomvu egazi ebopha futhi ithuthe umoya-mpilo
question4: Mangaki amayunithi amancane akha i-molecule eyodwa ye-hemoglobin?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.4 Ukuthuthwa Kwamagesi Kuketshezi Lomzimba Womuntu | Ukuthuthwa Kwe-Oksijini Egazini | Izici Ezithinta Ukubopha Kwe-Oksijini
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.4 Transport of Gases in Human Bodily Fluids | Transport of Oxygen in the Blood | Factors That Affect Oxygen Binding
chapterContent:
Umthamo we-hemoglobin othwala umoya-mpilo unquma ukuthi ingakanani i-oxygen ethwalwa egazini. Ngaphezu kwe-PO2
, ezinye izici zemvelo nezifo zingathinta umthamo kanye nokulethwa kwe-oxygen.

 Amazinga e-carbon dioxide, i-pH yegazi, kanye nokushisa komzimba kuthinta umthamo we-oxygen (Isithombe 30.20). Lapho i-carbon dioxide isegazini, isabela namanzi ukuze yakhe i-bicarbonate (HCO−
3)
kanye nama-ion e-hydrogen (H+). Njengoba izinga le-carbon dioxide egazini landa, kukhiqizwa i-H+ eningi futhi i-pH iyancipha. Lokhu kwanda kwe-carbon dioxide kanye nokwehla okulandelayo kwe-pH kunciphisa ukuhambisana kwe-hemoglobin ye-oxygen. I-oxygen iyahlukana ne-molecule ye-Hb, ishintshe i-curve yokuhlukanisa umoya-mpilo iye kwesokudla. Ngakho-ke, kudingeka i-oxygen eningi ukuze kufinyelelwe ezingeni elifanayo lokugcwala kwe-hemoglobin njengalapho i-pH yayiphezulu. Ukushintsha okufanayo kwi-curve nakho kubangelwa ukwanda kokushisa komzimba. Ukushisa okwandisiwe, njengokwanda komsebenzi wemisipha yamathambo, kubangela ukuthi ukuhambisana kwe-hemoglobin ye-oxygen kunciphe.

 Izifo ezifana ne-sickle cell anemia kanye ne-thalassemia zinciphisa ikhono legazi lokuletha umoya-mpilo ezicutshini kanye namandla alo okuthwala umoya-mpilo. Ku-sickle cell anemia, ukuma kweseli elibomvu legazi kufana nokwenyanga, bude, futhi kuqinile, kunciphisa ikhono lalo lokuletha umoya-mpilo (Isithombe 30.21). Ngale ndlela, amangqamuzana abomvu egazi awakwazi ukudlula kuma-capillary. Lokhu kubuhlungu uma kwenzeka. I-Thalassemia yisifo esingavamile sofuzo esibangelwa ukukhubazeka ku-alpha noma i-beta subunit ye-Hb. Iziguli ezine-thalassemia zikhiqiza inani elikhulu lamangqamuzana abomvu egazi, kodwa lawa maseli anamazinga aphansi kunejwayelekile e-hemoglobin. Ngakho-ke, amandla okuthwala umoya-mpilo ayancipha
question1: Yini enquma amandla okuthwala umoya-mpilo we-hemoglobin?
answer1: Ingakanani i-oxygen ethwalwa egazini
question2: Yiziphi izinto ezingathinta amandla okuthwala umoya-mpilo kanye nokulethwa kwawo?
answer2: Amazinga e-carbon dioxide, i-pH yegazi, kanye nokushisa komzimba
distractor2a: I-glucose egazini, i-cholesterol, kanye namazinga ama-hormone
distractor2b: Isisindo somzimba, ukuphakama, kanye nosayizi wemisipha
distractor2c: Amazinga e-nitrogen, umsebenzi wokugaya ukudla, kanye nokuqina kwamathambo
question3: Kwenzekani uma amazinga e-carbon dioxide ekhuphuka egazini?
answer3: Kukhiqizwa ama-ion e-hydrogen engeziwe, okwenza i-pH yegazi yehle
distractor3a: Kukhiqizwa i-hydrogen encane, okwenza i-pH yegazi ikhuphuke
distractor3b: Ukukhiqizwa komoya-mpilo kuyanda ngaphakathi kwamaseli abomvu egazi
question4: Ukwehla kwe-pH egazini kukuthinta kanjani ukusondelana kwe-hemoglobin ne-oxygen?
answer4: Inciphisa ukusondelana kwe-hemoglobin ne-oxygen
question5: Ukwehla kokusondelana kwe-hemoglobin komoya-mpilo kuyithinta kanjani ijika lokuhlukaniswa komoya-mpilo?
answer5: Ijika lishintshela kwesokudla
question6: Ukwanda kwezinga lokushisa lomzimba kuthinta kanjani ukubopha kwe-oxygen yi-hemoglobin?
answer6: Inciphisa ukusondelana kwe-hemoglobin ne-oxygen
distractor6b: Ivimbela i-carbon dioxide ukuthi ingangeni egazini
question7: Kungani ukwanda komsebenzi wemisipha yamathambo kunciphisa ukusondelana kwe-hemoglobin komoya-mpilo?
answer7: Ukwanda komsebenzi kuphakamisa izinga lokushisa komzimba, okwenza i-hemoglobin ikhiphe umoya-mpilo kalula
distractor7a: Umsebenzi owandisiwe ususa yonke i-carbon dioxide egazini
distractor7b: Ukwanda komsebenzi kuvimbela umoya-mpilo ukuthi ungafinyeleli ezicutshini
distractor7c: Ukwanda komsebenzi kubangela amazinga e-hemoglobin akhuphuke ngokushesha
question8: I-sickle cell anemia ikuthinta kanjani ukulethwa komoya-mpilo?
answer8: Amangqamuzana abomvu egazi aba sesimweni sobunye futhi aqine, okunciphisa ikhono lawo lokuletha umoya-mpilo
distractor8a: Amangqamuzana abomvu egazi aba makhulu futhi athwale umoya-mpilo ongenamkhawulo
distractor8b: Amangqamuzana abomvu egazi akhiqiza i-hemoglobin eningi
distractor8c: Amaseli abomvu egazi alahlekelwa yiwo wonke amandla okuthutha i-carbon dioxide kuphela

answer9: Azikwazi ukudlula kalula ema-capillaries

distractor10b: Ukuguquka kwesimo okuvimbela umoya-mpilo ukuthi ungangeni emaphashini

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.4 Ukuthuthwa Kwamagesi Kuketshezi Lomzimba Womuntu | Ukuthuthwa Kwe-Carbon Dioxide Egazini
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.4 Transport of Gases in Human Bodily Fluids | Transport of Carbon Dioxide in the Blood
chapterContent:
Ama-molecule e-carbon dioxide athuthwa egazini esuka ezicutshini zomzimba aye emaphashini ngenye yezindlela ezintathu: ukuncibilika ngqo egazini, ukubopha ku-hemoglobin, noma ukuthwalwa njenge-ion ye-bicarbonate. Izakhiwo eziningana ze-carbon dioxide egazini zithinta ukuthuthwa kwayo. Okokuqala, i-carbon dioxide incibilika kakhulu egazini kune-oxygen. Cishe amaphesenti ama-5 kuya kwangu-7 ayo yonke i-carbon dioxide ayancibilika ku-plasma. Okwesibili, i-carbon dioxide ingabopha amaprotheni e-plasma noma ingangena emaseli abomvu egazi futhi ibophe ku-hemoglobin. Leli fomu lithutha cishe amaphesenti ayi-10 e-carbon dioxide. Lapho i-carbon dioxide ibopha ku-hemoglobin, kwakheka i-molecule ebizwa ngokuthi i-carbaminohemoglobin. Ukubopha kwe-carbon dioxide ku-hemoglobin kuyaguqulwa. Ngakho-ke, lapho ifika emaphashini, i-carbon dioxide ingahlukana ngokukhululekile ne-hemoglobin futhi ikhishwe emzimbeni.

 Okwesithathu, iningi lama-molecule e-carbon dioxide (amaphesenti angu-85) athwalwa njengengxenye yesistimu ye-bicarbonate buffer. Kulesi simiso, i-carbon dioxide iyasakazeka emaseli abomvu egazi. I-Carbonic anhydrase (CA) ngaphakathi kwamaseli abomvu egazi iguqula ngokushesha i-carbon dioxide ibe yi-carbonic acid (H2CO3). I-Carbonic acid iyi-molecule ephakathi engazinzile ehlukana ngokushesha ibe yi-bicarbonate ions (HCO−
3)
kanye nama-ion e-hydrogen (H+). Njengoba i-carbon dioxide iguqulwa ngokushesha ibe yi-bicarbonate ions, lokhu kusabela kuvumela ukuqhubeka kokumuncwa kwe-carbon dioxide egazini phansi kwe-gradient yayo yokuhlushwa. Kuphinde kubangele ukukhiqizwa kwama-ion e-H+. Uma kukhiqizwa i-H+ eningi kakhulu, ingashintsha i-pH yegazi. Kodwa-ke, i-hemoglobin ibopha kuma-ion e-H+ amahhala futhi ngaleyo ndlela ikhawulela ukushintsha kwe-pH. I-ion ye-bicarbonate esanda kuhlanganiswa ithuthwa isuka kuseli elibomvu legazi iye engxenyeni ewuketshezi yegazi ngokushintshana nge-ion ye-chloride (Cl-); lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukushintsha kwe-chloride. Lapho igazi lifika emaphashini, i-ion ye-bicarbonate ithuthwa ibuyiselwe kuseli elibomvu legazi ngokushintshana nge-ion ye-chloride. I-ion ye-H+ iyahlukana ne-hemoglobin bese ibopha kwi-ion ye-bicarbonate. Lokhu kukhiqiza i-carbonic acid ephakathi, eguqulwa ibe yi-carbon dioxide ngesenzo se-enzyme se-CA. I-carbon dioxide ekhiqizwayo ikhishwa ngamaphaphu ngesikhathi sokuphefumula (Bheka Isithombe 30.18.1).

 Inzuzo yesistimu ye-bicarbonate buffer ukuthi i-carbon dioxide imuncwa “egazini ngokushintsha okuncane ku-pH yesistimu. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kuthatha ushintsho oluncane kuphela ku-pH iyonke yomzimba ukuze kuvele ukulimala okukhulu noma ukufa. Ukuba khona kwalesi simiso se-bicarbonate buffer kuvumela nabantu ukuthi bahambe futhi bahlale ezindaweni eziphakeme: Lapho ingcindezi engaphelele ye-oxygen ne-carbon dioxide ishintsha ezindaweni eziphakeme, uhlelo lwe-bicarbonate buffer luyazivumelanisa nokulawula i-carbon dioxide ngenkathi lugcina i-pH efanele emzimbeni.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.4 Ukuthuthwa Kwamagesi Kuketshezi Lomzimba Womuntu | Ukuthuthwa Kwe-Carbon Dioxide Egazini | Ubuthi Be-Carbon Monoxide
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.4 Transport of Gases in Human Bodily Fluids | Transport of Carbon Dioxide in the Blood | Carbon Monoxide Poisoning
chapterContent:
Nakuba i-carbon dioxide ingahlangana kalula futhi ihlukane ne-hemoglobin, amanye ama-molecule afana ne-carbon monoxide (CO) awakwazi. I-carbon monoxide inobuhlobo obukhulu ne-hemoglobin kune-oxygen. Ngakho-ke, uma i-carbon monoxide ikhona, ibopha i-hemoglobin ngaphezu kwe-oxygen. Ngenxa yalokho, i-oxygen ayikwazi ukubopha i-hemoglobin, ngakho-ke i-oxygen encane kakhulu ehanjiswa emzimbeni (Isithombe 30.22). I-carbon monoxide iyigesi engenambala, engenaphunga futhi ngenxa yalokho kunzima ukuyibona. Ikhiqizwa yizimoto namathuluzi asebenzisa igesi. I-carbon monoxide ingabangela ikhanda elibuhlungu, ukudideka, kanye nesicanucanu; ukuchayeka isikhathi eside kungabangela ukulimala kobuchopho noma ukufa. Ukunikeza i-oxygen engu-100% (emsulwa) kuyindlela evamile yokwelapha ubuthi be-carbon monoxide. Ukunikeza i-oxygen emsulwa kusheshisa ukuhlukaniswa kwe-carbon monoxide ne-hemoglobin.

 Izinto ezishisa uphethiloli ekhaya zingavuza igesi ye-carbon monoxide. Ngenxa yokuthi ayinambitheki futhi ayinaphunga, abantu bangase bangazi ngokuvuza, okubabeka engozini enkulu yobuthi be-carbon monoxide. Imishini yokuhlola i-carbon monoxide, njengale eboniswe lapha, isindise izimpilo eziningi ngokuxwayisa abantu ngokunqwabelana okuyingozi kwe-carbon monoxide
question1: Kungani i-carbon monoxide iyingozi kubantu?
answer1: Ibopha i-hemoglobin kakhulu kune-oxygen, ivimbela ukuthuthwa kwe-oxygen
distractor1a: Kuvimbela i-carbon dioxide ukuthi ingaphumi emaphashini

distractor2c: I-carbon monoxide nomoya-mpilo kufana kakhulu ne-hemoglobin

distractor3a: Umoya-mpilo omningi ubopha i-hemoglobin futhi ufinyelela izicubu ngokushesha

answer6: Ubuhlungu bekhanda, ukudideka, kanye nesicanucanu
distractor6b: Ukukhula kwemisipha kuphela kanye nokwanda kwe-metabolism

answer7: Ukuphathwa kwe-oxygen emsulwa engu-100%

answer8: Kusheshisa ukuhlukaniswa kwe-carbon monoxide ne-hemoglobin
question9: Kungani izinto zokuthola i-carbon monoxide zibalulekile emakhaya?
answer9: I-carbon monoxide ayinaphunga futhi ayinambitheki, ngakho abantu bangase bangaboni ukuvuza okuyingozi
distractor9a: I-carbon monoxide inephunga elinamandla elithusa abantu kusenesikhathi kakhulu
distractor9b: I-carbon monoxide ayinangozi ngaphandle kokuthi inombala
question10: Bheka uMfanekiso 30.23. Kungani kubaluleke kakhulu ukuba nesitholi se-carbon monoxide kunezinye igesi zasekhaya, njenge-ammonia noma igesi yemvelo?
answer10: Ngoba i-carbon monoxide ayinaphunga futhi ayinambitheki, ngokungafani ne-ammonia kanye negesi yemvelo yasekhaya enamaphunga ahlukile
distractor10a: Ngoba i-carbon monoxide ayinambitheki futhi inephunga elincane, elitholakala sekwephuzile kakhulu lapho livezwa
distractor10b: Ngoba i-carbon monoxide inephunga elinamandla, okwenza kube kubi futhi kube yingozi kakhulu

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 30. Uhlelo Lokuphefumula | 30.6 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 30. The Respiratory System | 30.6 Chapter Summary
chapterContent:
30.1 Izinhlelo Zokushintshana Ngegesi
Izinhlelo zokuphefumula zezilwane zenzelwe ukwenza kube lula ukushintshana ngegesi. Ezincelisayo, umoya uyafudunyezwa futhi umanziswe emgodini wamakhala. Umoya ube usuhamba phansi kwe-pharynx, nge-trachea, bese ungena emaphashini. Emaphashini, umoya udlula nge-bronchi ehlanganisa amagatsha, ufinyelele kuma-bronchioles okuphefumula, anendawo yokuqala yokushintshana ngegesi. Ama-bronchioles okuphefumula avulekela emigudwini ye-alveolar, emasakeni e-alveolar, kanye nase-alveoli. Ngenxa yokuthi kunezinqwaba ze-alveoli kanye ne-alveolar emaphashini, indawo engaphezulu yokushintshana ngegesi inkulu kakhulu. Kunezindlela eziningana zokuvikela ezikhona ukuvimbela umonakalo noma ukutheleleka. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinwele kanye ne-mucus emgodini wamakhala okubamba uthuli, ukungcola, nezinye izinto ezincane ngaphambi kokuba zingene ohlelweni. Emaphashini, izinhlayiya zibhajwa ungqimba lwe-mucus futhi zithuthwe nge-cilia ziye emngxunyeni womqala phezulu kwe-trachea ukuze zigwinywe.

 30.2 Ukushintshana Kwegesi Kuzo Zonke Izindawo Zokuphefumula
Amaphaphu angabamba umthamo omkhulu womoya, kodwa avame ukugcwaliswa ngomthamo omkhulu. Ukulinganiswa komthamo wamaphaphu kufaka phakathi umthamo wolwandle, umthamo wokugcina wokuphefumula, umthamo wokugcina wokuphefumula, kanye nomthamo osele. Isamba salokhu silingana nomthamo wamaphaphu ophelele. Ukuhamba kwegesi ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle kwamaphaphu kuncike ekucindezelweni kwegesi. Umoya uyinhlanganisela yamagesi; ngakho-ke, ukucindezela okuyingxenye kwegesi ngayinye kungabalwa ukuze kunqunywe ukuthi igesi izogeleza kanjani emaphashini. Umehluko phakathi kokucindezela okuyingxenye kwegesi emoyeni ushayela umoya-mpilo ezicutshini kanye ne-carbon dioxide ngaphandle komzimba.

 30.3 Ukuphefumula
Isakhiwo samaphaphu kanye nomgodi wesifuba kulawula indlela yokuphefumula. Lapho uphefumulelwa, i-diaphragm iyafinyela futhi yehle. Imisipha ye-intercostal iyafinyela futhi yandise udonga lwesifuba ngaphandle. Ukucindezela kwe-intrapleural kuyehla, amaphaphu ayakhula, futhi umoya udonswa ungene emigwaqweni yomoya. Uma ukhipha umoya, imisipha ye-intercostal kanye ne-diaphragm kuyaphumula, kubuyisela ingcindezi yangaphakathi kwe-pleural esimweni sokuphumula. Amaphaphu ayabuyela emuva futhi imigudu yomoya iyavaleka. Umoya uphuma kancane emaphashini. Kukhona ukucindezeleka okuphezulu kobuso endaweni yomoya-emaphashini. I-Surfactant, ingxube yama-phospholipid nama-lipoprotein, isebenza njengesihlanzi emigudwini yomoya ukunciphisa ukucindezeleka kobuso nokuvumela ukuvulwa kwe-alveoli.

 Ukuphefumula kanye nokushintshana kwegesi kokubili kuguqulwa izinguquko ekuhambisaneni nasekumelaneni kwamaphaphu. Uma ukuhambisana kwamaphaphu kuncipha, njengoba kwenzeka ezifweni ezivimbelayo njenge-fibrosis, imigudu yomoya iyaqina futhi iwele lapho ukhipha umoya. Umoya ubhajwa emaphashini, okwenza ukuphefumula kube nzima kakhulu. Uma ukumelana kukhuphuka, njengoba kwenzeka nge-asthma noma i-emphysema, imigudu yomoya iyavaleka, ibambe umoya emaphashini futhi ibangele ukuphefumula kube nzima. Ukushintsha komoya emigudwini yomoya noma ukugeleza kwegazi emithanjeni kungathinta ukushintshana kwegesi. Lezi zinguquko ekungeneni komoya kanye nokugeleza kwegazi, okubizwa ngokuthi i-V/Q mismatch, zingavela ezinguqukweni zomzimba noma zomzimba.

 30.4 Ukuthuthwa Kwamagesi Kuketshezi Lomzimba Womuntu
I-Hemoglobin iyiprotheni etholakala kumaseli abomvu egazi enziwe ngama-subunit amabili e-alpha kanye nama-beta amabili azungeze iqembu le-heme eliqukethe insimbi. I-oksijini ibopha kalula leli qembu le-heme. Amandla e-oksijini okubopha ayanda njengoba ama-molecule e-oksijini engeziwe ebopha i-heme. Izimo zesifo kanye nezimo ezishintshile emzimbeni kungathinta ikhono lokubopha le-oksijini, futhi kwandise noma kunciphise ikhono layo lokuhlukana ne-hemoglobin.

 I-carbon dioxide ingathuthwa ngegazi ngezindlela ezintathu. Incibilikiswa ngqo egazini, ibophane namaprotheni e-plasma noma i-hemoglobin, noma iguqulwe ibe yi-bicarbonate. Iningi le-carbon dioxide lithuthwa njengengxenye yesistimu ye-bicarbonate. I-carbon dioxide isakazeka ibe amaseli abomvu egazi. Ngaphakathi, i-carbonic anhydrase iguqula i-carbon dioxide ibe yi-carbonic acid (H2CO3), kamuva e-hydrolyzed ibe yi-bicarbonate (HCO−
3)
kanye ne-H+. I-H+ ion ibopha i-hemoglobin emaseli abomvu egazi, bese i-bicarbonate ithuthwa iphume emaseli abomvu egazi ukuze ithole i-chloride ion. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-chloride shift. I-Bicarbonate iphuma emaseli abomvu egazi bese ingena ku-plasma yegazi. Emaphashini, i-bicarbonate ithuthwa ibuyele emaseli abomvu egazi ukuze ithole i-chloride. I-H+ iyahlukana ne-hemoglobin bese ihlangana ne-bicarbonate ukuze yakhe i-carbonic acid ngosizo lwe-carbonic anhydrase, eqhubeka nokuvuselela ukusabela kokuguqula i-carbonic acid ibe yi-carbon dioxide namanzi. I-carbon dioxide bese ikhishwa emaphashini.
question1: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wohlelo lokuphefumula?
answer1: Inikeza izicubu zomzimba umoya-mpilo
distractor1a: Inikeza izicubu zomzimba umoya-mpilo kanye ne-carbon dioxide
distractor1b: Kunquma ukuthi kuthathwa umoya omningi kangakanani ngomzuzu
question2: Umoya uhamba kanjani ngesikhathi sokuphefumula?
answer2: Umgodi wempumulo, i-larynx, i-trachea, i-bronchi, ama-bronchioles, i-alveoli
distractor2a: Umgodi wempumulo, i-larynx, i-trachea, ama-bronchioles, i-bronchi, i-alveoli
distractor2b: Umgodi wempumulo, umphimbo, i-larynx, i-bronchi, ama-bronchioles, i-alveoli
distractor2c: Umgodi wempumulo, umphimbo, i-larynx, ama-bronchioles, i-bronchi, i-alveoli
question3: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezinikezwa umoya ofudumezayo ngaphakathi kwemigudu yamakhala?
answer3: Kuvimbela ukulimala kwamangqamuzana okubangelwa umoya obandayo
distractor3b: Kuvimbela izinto zakwamanye amazwe ukuthi zingangeni emaphashini
distractor3c: Kunciphisa ukunqwabelana koketshezi emoyeni obandayo nomanzi
question4: I-Emphysema yisifo esibonakala ngokuncipha okukhulu kwenani lama-alveoli asebenzayo emaphashini. I-emphysema ingaba namuphi umphumela ohlelweni lokuphefumula?
answer4: Ukushintshana kwegesi okuncane kuzokwenzeka ngegazi
distractor4c: Umoya wawungasakwazi ukudlidliza izintambo zezwi ze-larynx
question5: Umthamo wokugcina ophefumulelayo ulinganisa i-____
answer5: Inani lomoya ongaphefumulwa ngokwengeziwe ngemva kokuphefumula okuvamile
distractor5a: Inani lomoya osele emaphashini ngemva kokukhipha umoya omkhulu
distractor5c: Inani lomoya ongakhishwa kakhulu ngemva kokuphefumula okuvamile
question6: Umthamo wamaphaphu uphelele ubalwa kusetshenziswa yiphi ifomula?
answer6: Ivolumu eseleyo + ivolumu yokugcina umoya + ivolumu yokugeleza kwamanzi + ivolumu yokugcina ukuphefumula
distractor6a: Ivolumu eseleyo + ivolumu yolwandle + ivolumu yokugcina ephefumulelayo
distractor6b: Ivolumu eseleyo + ivolumu yokugcina umoya + ivolumu yokugcina ephefumulelayo
distractor6c: Umthamo wokugcina wokuphefumula + umthamo wolwandle + umthamo wokugcina ophefumulelayo
question7: Kungani ingcindezi engaphelele yomoya-mpilo iphansi emaphashini kunasemoyeni wangaphandle?
answer7: Izinguquko ekucindezelweni komhwamuko wamanzi zibangela ukuthi umoya-mpilo omncane ungene emoyeni emaphashini
distractor7a: Umoya-mpilo ususwa njalo ngumoya emaphashini ngegazi
distractor7c: Amaphaphu acindezela umoya ukuze anciphise ingcindezi yomoya-mpilo
question8: Ukwehla kwephesenti lomoya-mpilo emoyeni kungathinta kanjani ukuhamba komoya-mpilo emzimbeni?
answer8: Kunganciphisa izinga lokusabalala kwegazi ngoba kunciphisa umehluko phakathi kokucindezela okungaphelele komoya negazi.
distractor8a: Ngeke kuthinte izinga lokusabalala kwegazi ngoba bekungeke kube nomehluko phakathi kokucindezela okungaphelele komoya negazi.
distractor8b: Kunganciphisa izinga lokusabalala kwegazi ngoba kwandisa umehluko phakathi kokucindezela okungaphelele komoya negazi.
distractor8c: Kungandisa izinga lokusabalala kwegazi ngoba kunciphisa umehluko phakathi kokucindezeleka okungaphelele komoya negazi.
question9: Iyiphi indima edlalwa yimisipha ye-intercostal ekuphefumuleni nasekuphelelweni yithemba?
answer9: Ziyafinyela, zibangele ugqozi, futhi ziphumule, zibangele ukuphelelwa yisikhathi
distractor9a: Ziya phansi, zibangele ugqozi, futhi ziya phezulu, zibangele ukuphelelwa yisikhathi
distractor9b: Ziya phezulu, zibangele ugqozi, futhi ziye phansi, zibangele ukuphelelwa yisikhathi
distractor9c: Ziyaphumula, zibangele ugqozi, futhi zinciphe, zibangele ukuphelelwa yisikhathi
question10: Bheka uMfanekiso 30.16. Hlola umfanekiso onikeziwe. Yenza isimangalo esichaza ukuthi ukukhubazeka kwe-diaphragm kungawushintsha kanjani ugqozi
answer10: Kungavimbela ukuhogela ngoba ukucindezeleka kwangaphakathi kwe-pleural ngeke kushintshe
distractor10a: Kungavimbela ukufinyela kwemisipha ye-intercostal
distractor10b: Kunganciphisa ingcindezi yangaphakathi kwe-pleural futhi kuvumele umoya omningi ukuthi ungene emaphashini
distractor10c: Kunganciphisa ukuphelelwa yisikhathi ngoba amaphaphu awaphumuli
question11: Izifo zomoya ezivimbelayo
answer11: Nciphisa ukuhambisana kwamaphaphu
question12: Isiguli sihlushwa ukusabela kokungezwani komzimba okubangela ukuvuvukala kwemigudu yomoya. Chaza ukuthi lesi simo singathinta kanjani futhi kungani singathinta ukumelana kwesistimu yaso yokuphefumula
answer12: Ukumelana kuyanda ngoba kuzoba nzima ukuthi umoya ugeleze emigwaqweni yomoya
distractor12a: Ukumelana kunciphisa ngoba kuzoba nzima ukuthi umoya ugeleze emigwaqweni yomoya
distractor12b: Ukumelana kunciphisa ngoba imigudu yomoya ihambisana kakhulu
distractor12c: Ukumelana kuyanda ngoba imigudu yomoya ihambisana kakhulu
question13: Iyini indawo efile ngokwezinto eziphilayo futhi ingaba yini imbangela yayo?
answer13: Indawo efile ngokomzimba yindawo yezicubu zamaphaphu engahilelekile ekushintshisaneni kwegesi ngoba izicubu azisebenzi kahle. Kungabangelwa ukuthi ama-capillary e-alveoli awatholi ukugeleza kwegazi
distractor13a: Indawo efile ngokomzimba yindawo yezicubu zamaphaphu ezivuza umoya. Kungabangelwa inxeba lokubhoboza
distractor13b: Isikhala esifile ngokomzimba yisifunda sezicubu zamaphaphu esingatholi ukukhuthazwa ngogesi okuvela ohlelweni lwezinzwa. Kungabangelwa ukwehla kwama-neurotransmitters
distractor13c: Indawo efile ngokomzimba yindawo yezicubu zamaphaphu engahilelekile ekushintshisaneni kwegesi ngoba izicubu zinesici esakhiweni sazo. Kungabangelwa yisimo sofuzo.
question14: Faka isimangalo sokuthi izinga lokuphefumula kanye nomthamo womoya ngokuphefumula kuzoshintsha kanjani uma umoya ophumayo e-alveolar uphakeme kakhulu noma uphansi kakhulu
answer14: Uma umoya uphansi, izinga lokuphefumula lizokhula kuyilapho ivolumu yomoya ngokuphefumula ikhuphuka. Uma umoya uphezulu, izinga lokuphefumula lizokwehla kuyilapho ivolumu yomoya ngokuphefumula incipha.
distractor14a: Uma umoya uphansi, izinga lokuphefumula lizoncipha kuyilapho ivolumu yomoya ngokuphefumula incipha. Uma umoya uphakeme, izinga lokuphefumula lizokhula kuyilapho ivolumu yomoya ngokuphefumula incipha.
distractor14b: Uma umoya uphansi, izinga lokuphefumula lizoncipha kuyilapho ivolumu yomoya ngokuphefumula ikhuphuka. Uma umoya uphakeme, izinga lokuphefumula lizokhula kuyilapho ivolumu yomoya ngokuphefumula ikhuphuka.
distractor14c: Uma umoya uphansi, izinga lokuphefumula lizokhula kuyilapho ivolumu yomoya ngokuphefumula incipha. Uma umoya uphakeme, izinga lokuphefumula lizokhula kuyilapho ivolumu yomoya ngokuphefumula incipha.
question15: Kusho ukuthini ukugoba okunwebekayo emaphashini futhi ingabe kusiza ekuphefumuleni noma ekuphelelweni yithemba?
answer15: Amandla ezicubu zamaphaphu okubuyisela ingcindezi ngaphakathi kwamaphaphu, ukuphelelwa yisikhathi
distractor15a: Ikhono le-diaphragm lokufinyela nokuphumula ukushintsha ivolumu yamaphaphu, ugqozi
distractor15b: Umoya ogciniwe emaphashini okhona ngisho nangemva kokukhipha umoya kakhulu, ukuphelelwa yisikhathi
distractor15c: Amandla e-bronchioles okukhula nokuhoxa njengoba umoya ungena futhi uphuma, ugqozi
question16: I-pH ephansi egazini izokwenza _____ ukusondelana kwe-hemoglobin ku-_____
question17: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungeke kube lula ukudluliselwa komoya-mpilo ezicutshini?
question18: Yenza isimangalo esichaza ukuthi iningi le-carbon dioxide lithuthwa kanjani egazini
question19: Ngokusekelwe ekuqondeni kwakho ukuthi ikhabhoni dioksijini ithuthwa kanjani isuka ezicutshini zomzimba iye emaphashini, chaza ubudlelwano phakathi kokushintsha kwe-chloride kanye nokuthuthwa kwekhabhoni dioksijini egazini.
answer19: Ukushintsha kwe-chloride kuvumela i-carbon dioxide, ngesimo sama-ion e-bicarbonate, ukuthi ingene ku-plasma yegazi.
distractor19a: Ukushintsha kwe-chloride kudala i-carbaminohemoglobin ngaphakathi kwamaseli abomvu egazi
distractor19b: Ukushintsha kwe-chloride kuvumela ukuguqulwa kwe-carbon dioxide ibe yi-carbonic acid ngaphakathi kwamaseli abomvu egazi
distractor19c: Ukushintsha kwe-chloride kuvimbela ukwakheka kwama-ion e-bicarbonate egazini
question20: Isakhiwo se-alveoli sikwandisa kanjani ukushintshaniswa kwegesi?
answer20: Isakhiwo sazo esifana nesikhwama sandisa indawo yazo engaphezulu
distractor20a: Ukuxhumana kwazo ngqo ne-bronchi kwandisa ukufinyelela kwazo emoyeni
distractor20b: Zithutha ngenkuthalo amagesi phakathi komoya negazi
distractor20c: Ziyizimbulunga ezigcwala igazi ngokugcwele, ezizothintana nomoya
question21: Yiziphi izakhiwo zesistimu yokuphefumula ezifudumeza futhi zisuse ukungcola emoyeni ophefumulayo?
answer21: Izinwele kanye ne-mucus ekhaleni kanye ne-trachea kubamba ukungcola, kuyilapho ikhala lifudumeza umoya
distractor21a: I-epiglottis ikhipha ukungcola ku-trachea iye emhubheni, kuyilapho umgodi wempumulo ufudumeza umoya
distractor21b: Amathe emlonyeni nasezinweleni ku-trachea abamba ukungcola, kuyilapho i-pharynx ifudumeza umoya
distractor21c: Izingxenye ezivaliwe ze-larynx zibamba ukungcola emoyeni futhi zifudumale umoya
question22: Uma ubuhamba ngomkhumbi omncane odlula ohlelweni lokuphefumula, kusukela epharynx kuya e-alveolus, yiziphi izakhiwo obungazidlula endleleni, futhi ngokulandelana okunjani?
question23: Ilinganisani i-FEV1/FVC futhi kungani isilinganiso sizokhula nge-lung fibrosis?
answer23: Umthamo wokuphefumula ophoqelelwe ngomzuzwana owodwa uma kuqhathaniswa nomthamo ophelele wokuphila okuphoqelelwe; i-lung fibrosis ibangela ukuthi amaphaphu angaguquguquki kalula
distractor23a: Umthamo wokuphefumula ophoqelelwe ngomzuzwana owodwa uma kuqhathaniswa nomthamo ophelele wokuphila okuphoqelelwe; i-lung fibrosis ibangela ukuthi amaphaphu anciphe ngobukhulu
distractor23b: Umthamo wokuphefumula osebenzayo ngomzuzwana owodwa uma kuqhathaniswa nomthamo ophelele wokusebenza; i-lung fibrosis ibangela ukuthi amaphaphu anciphe ngobukhulu
distractor23c: Umthamo wokuphefumula osebenzayo ngomzuzwana owodwa uma kuqhathaniswa nomthamo ophelele wokusebenza; i-lung fibrosis ibangela ukuthi amaphaphu angaguquguquki kalula
question24: Bheka uMfanekiso 30.13. Buyekeza umfanekiso onikeziwe, bese uqhathanisa kahle ingcindezi engaphelele yomoya-mpilo phakathi kwegazi elisemithanjeni e-alveolus nasemoyeni, naphakathi kwegazi elisemithanjeni kanye nezicubu zomzimba.
answer24: Igazi liphansi kunasemoyeni futhi liphakeme egazini kunasezicutshini zomzimba
distractor24a: Igazi liphakeme kunasemoyeni futhi liphakeme egazini kunasezicutshini zomzimba
distractor24b: Iphakeme egazini kunasemoyeni futhi iphansi egazini kunasezicutshini zomzimba
distractor24c: Igazi liphansi kunasemoyeni futhi liphansi egazini kunasezicutshini zomzimba
question25: Izilinganiso zokusebenza kwamaphaphu zifaka phakathi i-forced air volume (FEV) kanye ne-functional vital capacity (FVC). Yenza isimangalo esikhomba ukuthi yiziphi izimo zamaphaphu ezingadala ukwanda kwe-FEV1/FVC, nokuthi yini engadala ukwehla kwe-FEV1/FVC.
answer25: Isifo samaphaphu esivimbelayo singakhulisa lesi silinganiso njengoba amaphaphu eba lukhuni futhi engaguquguquki. Ukwelashwa kwamaphaphu alimele kunciphisa lesi silinganiso, njengoba kukhona ukumelana okukhulu emaphashini
distractor25a: Lesi silinganiso siyanda uma kukhona ukumelana okunciphile emaphashini, njengalapho ikhwalithi yamaphaphu ithuthukiswa ngokwelashwa. Isifo samaphaphu esivimbayo singanciphisa isilinganiso njengoba amaphaphu eba lukhuni futhi engaguquguquki.
distractor25b: Isifo samaphaphu esivimbayo singakhulisa lesi silinganiso njengoba amaphaphu eba lukhuni futhi engaguquguquki. Isifo samaphaphu esivimbayo singanciphisa lesi silinganiso, njengoba kukhona ukumelana okukhulu emaphashini.
distractor25c: Lesi silinganiso siyanda njengoba amaphaphu eqina futhi engaguquguquki, njengasesifweni samaphaphu esivimbayo. Ukuthuthuka esimweni sesifo samaphaphu esivimbayo kunciphisa isilinganiso, lapho kukhona ukumelana okukhulu emaphashini.
question26: Izilwane eziphila emanzini nasemhlabeni, njengezixoxo, ziphefumula ngokuqoqa umoya esikhwameni esingaphansi komphimbo wazo. Imisipha ibe isifinyeza isikhwama bese iphoqa umoya emaphashini azo. Yenza isimangalo esichaza ukuthi le nqubo ihluke kanjani ekuphefumuleni kwabantu nakwezinye izilwane ezincelisayo.
answer26: Ukuphefumula kubantu nakwezinye izilwane ezincelisayo kuhilela ukwandisa umgodi wesifuba ngokudala ingcindezi engemihle emaphashini, okubangela ukuba umoya usabalale emaphashini.
distractor26a: Ukuphefumula kubantu nakwezinye izilwane ezincelisayo kuhilela izimbobo ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-spiracle, ezixhuma kunethiwekhi yeshubhu ukuze kuvunyelwe umoya-mpilo ukuthi udlulele emzimbeni.
distractor26b: Ukuphefumula kubantu nakwezinye izilwane ezincelisayo kuhilela ukusabalala okuqondile ngaphesheya kwe-membrane yangaphandle ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomoya-mpilo. Amagesi angasabalala ngokushesha ngokusabalala okuqondile
distractor26c: Ukuphefumula kubantu nakwezinye izilwane ezincelisayo kuhilela ukufinyela komgodi wesifuba ngokudala ingcindezi engemihle emaphashini, okubangela ukuba umoya usabalale ungene emaphashini.
question27: Bheka uMfanekiso 30.24. Amagrafu abonisa ushintsho lwengcindezi kanye nomthamo konogwaja abavamile, kanye nonogwaja abasuswe i-surfactant yamaphaphu. Uyini umphumela wokususa i-surfactant emaphashini?
answer27: Uma evuvukele, amaphaphu aba nomfutho ofanayo, kodwa umthamo wawo uphansi
distractor27a: Amaphaphu avuvukala aze abe nomthamo ofanayo, kodwa umfutho wawo ophezulu uphansi
distractor27b: Uma evuvukele, amaphaphu aba nomfutho ophansi kanye nomthamo ophansi
distractor27c: Amaphaphu angakhukhumala abe yivolumu efanayo kanye nengcindezi njengakuqala
question28: Bheka uMfanekiso 30.25. Isithombe sibonisa ukucindezeleka ezindaweni ezahlukene zamaphaphu kumuntu omi eqonde phezulu. Iyiphi ingxenye yamaphaphu enesilinganiso esiphezulu somoya (V) kanye nokugeleza kwegazi (Q) (V/Q)?
question29: Yenza isimangalo sokuchaza ukuthi ukuphathwa komoya-mpilo ongu-100% kungasindisa kanjani isiguli ebubini be-carbon monoxide. Chaza ukuthi kungani ukunikeza i-carbon dioxide kungeke kusebenze
answer29: Kulelo qophelo, umoya-mpilo uzosusa i-carbon monoxide ku-hemoglobin. Umoya-mpilo unamandla kakhulu ku-hemoglobin kune-carbon dioxide.
distractor29a: Kulelo qophelo, umoya-mpilo uzothuthwa emzimbeni ngesivinini esikhulu ngokuncibilika egazini. Umoya-mpilo unamandla kakhulu e-hemoglobin kune-carbon dioxide.
distractor29b: Kulelo qophelo, umoya-mpilo uzosusa i-carbon monoxide ku-hemoglobin. I-Carbon dioxide inamandla kakhulu ku-hemoglobin kune-oxygen.
distractor29c: Kulelo qophelo, umoya-mpilo uzothuthwa emzimbeni ngesivinini esikhulu ngokuncibilika egazini. I-carbon dioxide inamandla kakhulu e-hemoglobin kune-oxygen.
question30: Ngokusekelwe ekuqondeni kwakho ukuthi amagesi athuthwa kanjani esuka ezicutshini zomzimba aye emaphashini, chaza ukuthi bekuzokwenzekani uma kungekho i-carbonic anhydrase emangqamuzaneni abomvu egazi.
answer30: I-carbon dioxide ngeke i-hydrolyzed ibe yi-carbonic acid noma i-bicarbonate. Amaphesenti angu-15 kuphela e-carbon dioxide angathuthwa egazini asuke ezicutshini.
distractor30a: I-carbon dioxide izofakwa i-hydrolyzed ibe yi-carbonic acid noma i-bicarbonate. Inani eliphezulu le-carbon dioxide lizothuthwa egazini lisuke ezicutshini.
distractor30b: I-carbon dioxide ngeke i-hydrolyzed ibe yi-carbonic acid noma i-bicarbonate. Inani eliphezulu le-carbon dioxide lingathuthwa egazini lisuke ezicutshini.
distractor30c: I-oksijini ngeke i-hydrolyzed ibe yi-carbonic acid noma i-bicarbonate. Amaphesenti angu-50 kuphela e-carbon dioxide angathuthwa egazini asuke ezicutshini.
question31: Kuyini i-sickle cell anemia futhi ikuthinta kanjani ukugeleza komoya-mpilo egazini?
answer31: Kuyisifo esibangelwa izakhi zofuzo lapho amangqamuzana abomvu egazi emise okwesikela, okunciphisa ukugeleza komoya-mpilo egazini
distractor31a: Kuyisifo esibangelwa izakhi zofuzo lapho amangqamuzana abomvu egazi emise okwesikela, okwandisa ukugeleza komoya-mpilo egazini.
distractor31b: Kuyisifo sokuntuleka kwegazi lapho amangqamuzana abomvu egazi emise okwesikela, okunciphisa ukugeleza komoya-mpilo egazini.
distractor31c: Kuyisifo sokuntuleka kwegazi lapho amangqamuzana abomvu egazi emise okwesikela, okwandisa ukugeleza komoya-mpilo egazini.
question32: Bheka uMfanekiso 30.26. Iseli le-algae ye-unicellular i-Ventricaria ventricosa ingenye yezinhlobo ezinkulu kakhulu ezaziwayo, ezifinyelela ububanzi obuyi-1 kuya ku-5 amasentimitha ububanzi. Njengazo zonke izinto eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa, i-V. ventricosa ishintshana ngamagesi kulo lonke ulwelwesi lweseli. Yiziphi izinguquko okungenzeka ukuthi i-V. ventricosa izenzeke ngokuphathelene nobukhulu bayo obukhulu kanye nekhono lokushintshana ngezinto nendawo engaphandle?

distractor32a: Ukuguquguquka okuzonciphisa imetabolism yamaseli ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zamaseli amakhulu
distractor32b: Ukuguquguquka okungenza iseli libe likhulu, ukunciphisa ukulahleka kwezakhamzimba
distractor32c: Ukuguquguquka okuvumela iseli ukuthi lithathe izinto ezinkulu zokudla lisebenzisa izingxenye ze-membrane yalo yeseli
question33: Bheka uMfanekiso 30.27. Igrafu ikhombisa indawo yonke yokuphefumula uma iqhathaniswa nobunzima bomzimba wezilwane ezahlukene. Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kule grafu

question34: Isithombe 30.10 sibonisa i-alveolus yomuntu, eyingxenye yesimiso sokuphefumula. Imelelani imicibisholo u-A no-B kumdwebo?
answer34: A: umoya ophefumulayo; B: igazi eliya enhliziyweni

distractor34b: A: umoya ophumayo; B: igazi elihamba lisuka enhliziyweni

question35: Bheka uMfanekiso 30.28. Isiguli sifakwe ipayipi ngokuhlinzwa endaweni eboniswe kumdwebo. Ngokusekelwe kulolu lwazi, yenza isimangalo esikhomba lapho ukulimala okungenzeka kwenzeke khona ohlelweni lokuphefumula lwesiguli. Xoxa ngesimangalo sakho ngokucabanga.
answer35: Ukulimala kwenzeke emlonyeni, ngoba kungaphezu kwendawo yokufaka ipayipi

distractor35c: Ukulimala kwenzeke elarynx, ngoba kungaphansi kwendawo yokufaka ipayipi
question36: Bheka uMfanekiso 30.29. Umzimba cishe ubungasabela kanjani uma amanye amangqamuzana awo ebhekene nokuqongelela kwe-carbon dioxide noma isidingo somoya-mpilo owengeziwe?
answer36: Ukukhiqiza izimpawu ze-neural ezikhuthaza inhliziyo ukuba ishaye ngesivinini esikhulu
distractor36a: Ukukhulula ama-hormone akhuthaza amangqamuzana omzimba ukuthi adlule ekuthuthweni okusebenzayo kakhulu
distractor36b: Ukukhulula amangqamuzana abomvu egazi angamukela umoya-mpilo ngokusebenzisa ukusabalala esikhundleni sokuthutha okulula
distractor36c: Ukulungisa i-pH yegazi ukuze kwehliswe ingcindezi engaphelele ye-CO2 emaseli omzimba
question37: Bheka uMfanekiso 30.30. Umdwebo ukhombisa iseli elibomvu legazi ku-alveolus bese kuba sesicutshini somzimba. Imicibisholo kufanele ikhombe ngakuphi ukusabalala komoya-mpilo kanye ne-CO2? Yenza isimangalo sokuthi ingcindezi ngayinye engaphelele kufanele ibhalwe kanjani
answer37: O2← CO2→; Iseli lomzimba PO2= eliphansi; i-RBC PO2= eliphezulu; Iseli lomzimba PCO2= eliphezulu, i-RBC PCO2= eliphansi
distractor37a: O2→ CO2←; Iseli lomzimba PO2= eliphansi; i-RBC PO2= eliphezulu; Iseli lomzimba PCO2= eliphezulu, i-RBC PCO2= eliphansi
distractor37b: O2→ CO2←; Iseli lomzimba PO2= eliphezulu; i-RBC PO2= eliphansi; Iseli lomzimba PCO2= eliphansi, i-RBC PCO2= eliphezulu
distractor37c: O2← CO2→; Iseli lomzimba PO2= eliphezulu; i-RBC PO2= eliphansi; Iseli lomzimba PCO2= eliphansi, i-RBC PCO2= eliphezulu
question38: Bheka uMfanekiso 30.31. Igrafu esithombeni ibonisa iphesenti lokugcwala komoya-mpilo we-hemoglobin njengomsebenzi wokucindezela okungaphelele komoya-mpilo ku-alveoli. Yiziphi izinguquko ezenzeka ku-hemoglobin njengoba ijika likhuphuka lizungeze ukucindezela okungaphelele okungu-60 mmHg?
answer38: Njengoba iphesenti lokugcwala kwe-hemoglobin likhuphuka lize lifike ezingeni eliphezulu, ukusondelana kwe-hemoglobin nomoya-mpilo kuyanda njengoba ukutholakala komoya-mpilo kukhuphuka.
distractor38a: Njengoba iphesenti lokugcwala kwe-hemoglobin lincipha (ngaphandle kokuthi wonke umoya-mpilo uhlukane), ukusondelana kwe-hemoglobin nomoya-mpilo kuyancipha njengoba ukutholakala komoya-mpilo kuncipha.
distractor38b: Njengoba iphesenti lokugcwala kwe-hemoglobin likhuphuka liye emazingeni aphezulu kakhulu, ukusondelana kwe-hemoglobin nomoya-mpilo kuyancipha ngenxa yokuncipha kwamandla ayo okubopha umoya-mpilo.
distractor38c: Njengoba iphesenti lokugcwala kwe-hemoglobin lincipha, ukusondelana kwe-hemoglobin nomoya-mpilo kuyanda njengoba ukutholakala komoya-mpilo kuncipha
question39: Bheka uMfanekiso 30.32. Ngokusekelwe ku-oxygen dissociation curve ye-hemoglobin, yini engase ibangele ukuthi i-curve ishintshele kwesobunxele?
answer39: Ukwehla kwe-carbon dioxide, ukwanda kwe-pH, noma ukwehla kwezinga lokushisa

question40: Bheka uMfanekiso 30.33. Uma ukuhlushwa kwe-carbon dioxide endaweni ezungezile kukhuphukile, lokhu kuzothinta kanjani ijika lokuhlukaniswa komoya-mpilo?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.0 Introduction
chapterContent:
Izilwane eziningi ziyizinto eziphilayo eziyinkimbinkimbi ezinamaseli amaningi ezidinga indlela yokuthutha izakhamzimba emizimbeni yazo kanye nokususa imfucuza. Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi luye lwavela ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kusukela ekusakazekeni okulula ngamaseli ekuqaleni kokuvela kwezilwane kuya kunethiwekhi eyinkimbinkimbi yemithambo yegazi efinyelela kuzo zonke izingxenye zomzimba womuntu. Le nethiwekhi ebanzi inikeza amangqamuzana, izicubu, kanye nezitho umoya-mpilo kanye nezakhamzimba, futhi isusa i-carbon dioxide kanye nemfucuza, okuyimikhiqizo yokuphefumula.

 Enhliziyweni yesistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi yomuntu yinhliziyo. Ubukhulu besandla esivalwe, inhliziyo yomuntu ivikelwe ngaphansi kwekheji lezimbambo. Yenziwe ngemisipha yenhliziyo ekhethekile neyingqayizivele, ipompa igazi emzimbeni wonke nasenhliziyweni uqobo. Ukufinyela kwenhliziyo kuqhutshwa yizinzwa zikagesi ezingaphakathi ezisiza ubuchopho nama-hormone e-endocrine.

 Ukuqonda ukwakheka kanye nokusebenza kwenhliziyo okuyisisekelo kubalulekile ekuqondeni izinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi kanye nokuphefumula zomzimba. Ngenxa yokuthi ukufa okukodwa kwabane e-United States kubangelwa yisifo senhliziyo, kuchithwa izigidigidi zamaRandi minyaka yonke kucwaninga izindlela zokuvimbela nokwelapha. Isibonelo, abacwaningi bebezama ukuthola indlela yokuthola imisipha yenhliziyo eyonakele ukuze izilungise. Ithimba labacwaningi e-Weizmann Institute of Science lisanda kuthola ukuthi ukusebenzisa iphrotheni ebizwa ngokuthi i-ERBB2 kubangela ukuthi amangqamuzana enhliziyo emagundwini amadala aphinde avuseleleke. Ithimba labacwaningi liyaqhubeka nocwaningo lwabo ukuze lithole ukuthi lolu lwazi lungasetshenziswa kanjani emithini yabantu. Bheka Umfanekiso 31.1
question1: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wesimiso sokujikeleza kwegazi ezilwaneni eziyinkimbinkimbi ezinamaseli amaningi?
answer1: Ukuthutha izakhamzimba nomoya-mpilo emzimbeni wonke nokususa i-carbon dioxide kanye nemikhiqizo engcolile
distractor1a: Ukugaya ukudla nokumunca izakhamzimba ngqo endaweni ezungezile
distractor1b: Ukukhiqiza ama-hormone nokulawula izinga lokushisa lomzimba kuphela
distractor1c: Ukushintshanisa ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwamaseli
question2: Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi luye lwathuthuka kanjani ngokuhamba kwesikhathi?
answer2: Yashintsha kusukela ekusakazekeni okulula ngamaseli yaba inethiwekhi eyinkimbinkimbi yemithambo yegazi
distractor2a: Yashintsha kusukela ezithweni zokugaya ukudla yaya ezithweni zokuphefumula
distractor2b: Yashintsha kusukela emathanjeni yaba imisipha nezicubu
distractor2c: Yashintsha kusukela ezinhlelweni zezinzwa yaya ezinhlelweni ze-endocrine
question3: Yiziphi izinto ezilethwa uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi lomuntu kumaseli, ezicutshini nasezithweni zomzimba?
answer3: I-oksijini kanye nezakhamzimba
distractor3a: I-carbon dioxide kanye nemfucuza ye-metabolic kuphela
question4: Iyini isitho esiyinhloko esiyinhloko sesimiso sokujikeleza kwegazi somuntu?
answer4: Inhliziyo
question5: Hlobo luni lomsipha olwakha inhliziyo yomuntu?
answer5: Imisipha yenhliziyo ekhethekile
question6: Ukufinyela kwenhliziyo kuqala kanjani?
answer6: Ngezinzwa zikagesi zangaphakathi ezilawulwa ubuchopho nama-hormone e-endocrine
question7: Kungani ukuqonda ukwakheka kwenhliziyo kanye nokusebenza kwayo kubalulekile ku-biology kanye nezokwelapha?
answer7: Ngenxa yokuthi inhliziyo ibalulekile ekusebenzeni kokujikeleza kwegazi kanye nokuphefumula, kanti isifo senhliziyo siyimbangela enkulu yokufa.
distractor7a: Ngoba inhliziyo ilawula zonke izinguquko zofuzo emangqamuzaneni
distractor7b: Ngoba inhliziyo ikhiqiza zonke izakhamzimba ezidingwa ngumzimba
distractor7c: Ngoba inhliziyo ithatha indawo yomsebenzi wohlelo lokuphefumula
question8: Yiliphi iphrotheni elatholakala ukusiza ekuvuseleleni kabusha kwamangqamuzana enhliziyo egundane elidala?
answer8: I-ERBB2

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.1 Ukubuka Konke Kohlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.1 Overview of the Circulatory System | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluningi kulesi sahluko alukho emkhakheni we-AP®. Kodwa-ke, lesi sahluko sigcwele izibonelo ezisebenza emiqondweni esike sayihlola ngaphambilini. Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi luxhumanisa nazo zonke ezinye izinhlelo zezitho zomzimba. Isibonelo, izakhamzimba zidlula ohlelweni lokugaya ukudla ziye egazini, futhi uhlelo lokukhipha ukungcola lukhipha igazi elingcolile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngenxa yokuthi isifo senhliziyo siyimbangela ehamba phambili yokufa kubantu, ulwazi lubalulekile.

 Izinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ezilwaneni zibonisa iphethini ehlukile yokuziphendukela kwemvelo—kusukela kokungekho eziponji nasejellyfish kuya ezinhlelweni zokujikeleza kwegazi ezivulekile ezibonakala ezinambuzaneni kuya ezinhlelweni zokujikeleza kwegazi ezivaliwe ezinezinhliziyo, ama-valve, nemithambo yegazi ezilwaneni ezinomgogodla. Izinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi zinikeza amangqamuzana omzimba umoya-mpilo nezakhamzimba, zisusa ukungcola, zithutha ama-hormone, zivikele kubahlaseli, futhi zisiza ekulawuleni izinga lokushisa. Nakuba ezinye izilwane ezifana nesiponji zingazange zibe nesidingo sokuzivumelanisa nezimo sokuthuthukisa uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluyinkimbinkimbi (zishintshana izakhamzimba nokungcola ngqo nendawo ezungezile), njengoba izidingo zomoya-mpilo zanda ngokuphila kwasemhlabeni, ukukhethwa kwemvelo kwathanda uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvaliwe lapho igazi lithuthwa khona ngemithambo yegazi. Ukuze kwandiswe ukusebenza kahle, ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo ezivaliwe inhliziyo yavela emakamelweni amabili ezinhlanzini (i-atrium eyodwa kanye ne-ventricle eyodwa) yaya enhliziyweni enamakamelo amane (ama-atria amabili kanye nama-ventricle amabili) abonakala ezingwenya, ezinyonini, nasezincelisayo.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 1 yoHlaka Lwekharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi olusekelwe ebholeni lokucwaninga, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 1

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 1.A
Ushintsho ekwakhekeni kwezakhi zofuzo zabantu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ukuvela kwemvelo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
1.A.1 Ukuzivumelanisa nezimo, njengenani lamakamelo enhliziyo, ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo okukhethwa ukukhethwa kwemvelo futhi kunikeza inzuzo kumuntu ophilayo endaweni ethile.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
2.2 Umfundi angasebenzisa izindlela zezibalo emananini achaza izenzakalo zemvelo.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 1.B

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
1.B.2 Izihlahla ze-phylogenetic kanye ne-cladogram zingamela izici, njengenani lamakamelo enhliziyo ezilwaneni, atholakala noma alahlekile ngenxa yokuziphendukela kwemvelo.
