question1: Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi luxhumana kanjani nezinye izinhlelo zezitho ezilwaneni?
answer1: Ithutha izinto phakathi kwezinhlelo zezitho zomzimba, njengezakhamzimba ezivela ohlelweni lokugaya ukudla kanye nokungcola ziye ohlelweni lokukhipha ukudla.
distractor1a: Ithatha indawo yemisebenzi yazo zonke ezinye izinhlelo zezitho zomzimba
distractor1b: Ikhiqiza zonke izakhamzimba futhi isuse umoya-mpilo emzimbeni
distractor1c: Ilawula ukunyakaza kwemisipha kanye nokuziphatha kuphela
question2: Izinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi zihluke kanjani phakathi kwamaqembu ezilwane ngesikhathi sokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer2: Zashintsha kusukela ekungangeni kokujikeleza kwegazi kwezinye izilwane zaya ezindleleni ezivulekile ezinambuzaneni kanye nasezindleleni ezivaliwe ezilwaneni ezinomgogodla.
distractor2a: Zashintsha kusukela ezimisweni ezivaliwe ezincelisayo zaya ezimisweni ezingenazo ezipanjini
distractor2b: Zonke izilwane zakha izinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ezifanayo
distractor2c: Zavela kuphela ngokusekelwe kusayizi womzimba hhayi ezidingweni zemvelo
question3: Hlobo luni lwesimiso sokujikeleza kwegazi olutholakala ezinambuzaneni?
answer3: Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvulekile
distractor3a: Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvaliwe olunamakamelo amane enhliziyo
distractor3c: Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi olusebenzisa ukuphefumula kuphela
question4: Yimiphi imisebenzi emikhulu yezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ezilwaneni?
answer4: Ukuhlinzeka nge-oxygen nezakhamzimba, ukususa imfucuza, ukuthutha ama-hormone, ukuvikela abahlaseli, nokulawula izinga lokushisa
distractor4a: Ukukhiqiza amandla nge-photosynthesis nokugcina ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo
question5: Kungani ukukhetha kwemvelo kwasiza izinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ezivaliwe kwezinye izilwane?
answer5: Ukwanda kwezidingo zomoya-mpilo ezivela ezintweni eziphilayo zasemhlabeni kwakudinga ukuthuthwa kwegazi ngendlela ephumelelayo ngemithambo yegazi
distractor5a: Izinhlelo ezivaliwe zivimbela izilwane ekushintsheni amagesi
distractor5c: Izinhlelo ezivaliwe zivumela amaseli ukuthi aphile ngaphandle kwezakhamzimba
question6: Inhliziyo yesilwane esinomgogodla yashintsha kanjani kusukela ezinhlanzini kuya ezincelisayo?
answer6: Yashintsha kusukela enhliziyweni enamakamelo amabili ezinhlanzini yaya enhliziyweni enamakamelo amane ezinyonini nasezincelisayo.
distractor6a: Yashintsha kusukela enhliziyweni enamakamelo amane yaba inhliziyo enamakamelo amabili
distractor6b: Akuzange kushintshe phakathi nokuvela kwezilwane ezinomgogodla
distractor6c: Yashintsha kusukela kuseli elilodwa yaba inethiwekhi yemithambo yegazi
question7: Amakamelo enhliziyo angabhekwa kanjani njengokuguquguquka okuhlobene nokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer7: Ukwehluka kwenombolo yegumbi lenhliziyo kunganikeza izinzuzo ezithandwa ukukhethwa kwemvelo ezindaweni ezithile
distractor7a: Amakamelo enhliziyo atholakala kuphela ngesikhathi sokuphila komuntu ngamunye
distractor7b: Amakamelo enhliziyo awathinti ukusinda noma ukuzala
distractor7c: Amakamelo enhliziyo awahlobene nokuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo
question8: Izihlahla ze-phylogenetic noma i-clado amagremu zingasetshenziswa kanjani ukutadisha ukuvela kwesistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi?
answer8: Zingamelela ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo kanye nezinguquko ezicini ezifana nenani lamakamelo enhliziyo
distractor8a: Zibonisa kuphela imisebenzi yansuku zonke yezitho ngazinye
distractor8c: Zithatha indawo yokuhlolwa okubandakanya i-physiology yezilwane
question9: Yimuphi umbono omkhulu we-AP® Biology osekelwa yilesi sigaba?
answer9: Umqondo Omkhulu 1: Inqubo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo iqhuba ukuhlukahluka kanye nobunye bokuphila
distractor9a: Umqondo Omkhulu 2: Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule
distractor9b: Umqondo Omkhulu 3: Izinhlelo eziphilayo zigcina, zibuyise, zidlulise, futhi ziphendule ulwazi
distractor9c: Umqondo Omkhulu 4: Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana futhi zinezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.1 Ukubuka Konke Kohlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | Ukwakhiwa Kwesistimu Yokujikeleza Kwegazi
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.1 Overview of the Circulatory System | Circulatory System Architecture
chapterContent: Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi luyinethiwekhi yemithambo yegazi esilinda: imithambo yegazi, imithambo yegazi, kanye nama-capillary aphuma empompini, inhliziyo. Kuzo zonke izilwane ezinethambo lomgogodla, kanye nezinye izilwane ezingenamgogodla, lolu uhlelo oluvaliwe, lapho igazi lingakhululekile emgodini. Esistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi evaliwe, igazi liqukethwe ngaphakathi kwemithambo yegazi futhi lijikeleza ngokungaqondile lisuka enhliziyweni lizungeze umzila wokujikeleza kwegazi, bese libuyela enhliziyweni futhi, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 31.2a. Ngokungafani nohlelo oluvaliwe, ama-arthropod—kufaka phakathi izinambuzane, ama-crustacean, kanye nezinhlobo eziningi ze-mollusk—anesistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi evulekile, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 31.2b. Esistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi evulekile, igazi alivalelwanga emithanjeni yegazi kodwa liphonswa emgodini obizwa ngokuthi i-hemocoel futhi libizwa ngokuthi i-hemolymph ngoba igazi lixubana noketshezi oluphakathi komzimba. Njengoba inhliziyo ishaya futhi isilwane sihamba, i-hemolymph ijikeleza izitho ezingaphakathi emgodini womzimba bese ingena ezinhliziyweni ngezikhala ezibizwa ngokuthi i-ostia. Lokhu kuhamba kuvumela ukushintshana kwegesi kanye nezakhamzimba. Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvulekile alusebenzisi amandla amaningi njengohlelo oluvaliwe ukuze lusebenze noma lulondoloze; nokho, kukhona ukuhwebelana ngenani legazi elingathuthelwa ezithweni nasezicutshini ezisebenzayo zomzimba ezidinga amazinga aphezulu omoya-mpilo. Eqinisweni, esinye sezizathu ezenza izinambuzane ezinamaphiko afinyelela ku-2 foot ububanzi (70 cm) zingabi khona namuhla mhlawumbe kungenxa yokuthi zahlulwa ukufika kwezinyoni eminyakeni eyizigidi ezingu-150 edlule. Izinyoni, ezinesimiso sokujikeleza kwegazi esivaliwe, kucatshangwa ukuthi zihambe ngokushesha, okuvumela ukuthi zithole ukudla ngokushesha futhi mhlawumbe zidle izinambuzane.
question1: Yiziphi izingxenye eziyinhloko zokwakheka kwesistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi?
answer1: Imithambo yegazi, imithambo yegazi, ama-capillary, kanye nenhliziyo
distractor1c: Imisipha ye-Alveoli, i-bronchi, kanye nemisipha yokuphefumula
question2: Yini echaza uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvaliwe?
answer2: Igazi liqukethwe ngaphakathi kwemithambo yegazi futhi lijikeleza ngokujikeleza lisuka enhliziyweni lidlule emzimbeni bese libuyela enhliziyweni.
distractor2a: Igazi likhishwa lingene emigodini yomzimba bese lihlangana ngqo nezitho zomzimba
distractor2b: Igazi lihlala limile ngenkathi izakhamzimba zisakazeka ezicutshini
distractor2c: Igazi ligeleza kuphela phakathi kwezitho zokuphefumula nendawo ezungezile
question3: Esimisweni sokujikeleza kwegazi esivaliwe, igazi lihamba kanjani emzimbeni?
answer3: Ihamba ngendlela engaqondile isuka enhliziyweni idlule ekujikelezeni kwegazi bese ibuyela enhliziyweni
distractor3b: Kugeleza kude nenhliziyo kuphela futhi akubuyi
distractor3c: Ihamba ngqo phakathi kwamaseli angenazo izitsha
question4: Yiziphi izilwane ezivame ukuba nezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ezivulekile?
answer4: Ama-arthropod afana nezinambuzane nama-crustacean, kanye nezinhlobo eziningi ze-mollusk
distractor4a: Zonke izilwane ezinomgogodla okuhlanganisa izilwane ezincelisayo nezinyoni
distractor4b: Izinhlanzi nezilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini kuphela
question5: Iyini i-hemolymph ohlelweni lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvulekile?
answer5: Uketshezi oluvela lapho igazi lihlangana noketshezi olungaphakathi kwe-interstitial
distractor5a: Igazi elihlanzekile litholakala ngaphakathi kwemithambo yegazi kuphela
question6: Uyini umsebenzi we-ostia ezilwaneni ezinezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ezivulekile?
answer6: Ziyizikhala ezivumela i-hemolymph ukuthi ingene futhi enhliziyweni
distractor6b: Bakhiqiza amangqamuzana egazi ngaphakathi komgodi womzimba
question7: Iyiphi inzuzo eyodwa yesistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi evulekile uma iqhathaniswa nesistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi evaliwe?
answer7: Kudinga amandla amancane ukuze kusetshenziswe futhi kunakekelwe
distractor7a: Iletha umoya-mpilo owengeziwe ezicutshini ezisebenza kakhulu
distractor7b: Ivumela ukuhamba kwegazi ngokushesha emithanjeni yegazi
distractor7c: Isekela ubukhulu bomzimba obukhulu ngokwandisa umfutho wegazi
question8: Iyini inzuzo enkulu yokuba nohlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvulekile?
answer8: Ayikwazi ukuthutha igazi eliningi liye ezicutshini ezisebenzayo zomzimba ezidinga amazinga aphezulu omoya-mpilo
question9: Kungani izinyoni kungenzeka ukuthi zibe negalelo ekunciphiseni izinambuzane ezinkulu kakhulu ezinamaphiko abanzi?
answer9: Izinyoni zazinezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ezisebenza kahle ezazingase zivumele ukushesha okukhulu nokufinyelela ukudla okungcono
distractor9b: Izinyoni zabangela ukuba izinambuzane zilahlekelwe yikhono lazo lokuzala
distractor9c: Izinyoni zazinezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ezivulekile ezazisebenzisa amandla amancane

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.1 Ukubuka Konke Kohlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | Ukwehluka Kohlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi Ezilwaneni
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.1 Overview of the Circulatory System | Circulatory System Variation in Animals
chapterContent:
Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi luyahlukahluka kusukela ezinhlelweni ezilula ezilwaneni ezingenamgogodla kuya ezinhlelweni eziyinkimbinkimbi ezilwaneni ezinomgogodla. Izilwane ezilula kakhulu, njengeziponji (i-Porifera) kanye ne-rotifers (i-Rotifera), azidingi uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi ngoba ukusabalalisa kuvumela ukushintshaniswa okwanele kwamanzi, izakhamzimba, kanye nemfucuza, kanye namagesi ancibilikisiwe, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 31.3a. Izinto eziphilayo eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kodwa ezisenezingqimba ezimbili zamaseli ohlelweni lwazo lomzimba, njengejeli (i-Cnidaria) kanye nejeli ze-comb (i-Ctenophora) nazo zisebenzisa ukusabalalisa nge-epidermis yazo nangaphakathi nge-gastrovascular compartment. Zombili izicubu zazo zangaphakathi nezangaphandle zigezwa endaweni enamanzi futhi zishintshana ngamanzi ngokusabalalisa kuzo zombili izinhlangothi, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 31.3b. Ukushintshana koketshezi kusizwa ukushaya komzimba we-jellyfish.

 Kwezinto eziphilayo eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu, ukusabalalisa akusebenzanga kahle ekujikelezeni amagesi, izakhamzimba, kanye nemfucuza ngempumelelo emzimbeni; ngakho-ke, izinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu zavela. Iningi lama-arthropod kanye nama-mollusk amaningi anezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ezivulekile. Esimisweni esivulekile, inhliziyo eshayayo ende isunduza i-hemolymph emzimbeni futhi ukufinyela kwemisipha kusiza ukuhambisa uketshezi. Ama-crustacean amakhulu ayinkimbinkimbi, kufaka phakathi ama-lobster, athuthukise imithambo efana nemithambo yegazi ukuze asunduze igazi emizimbeni yawo, kanti ama-mollusk asebenza kakhulu, njenge-squid, athuthukise uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvaliwe futhi ayakwazi ukuhamba ngokushesha ukuze abambe inyamazane. Izinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ezivaliwe ziyisici sezilwane ezinomgogodla; nokho, kunomehluko omkhulu esakhiweni senhliziyo kanye nokujikeleza kwegazi phakathi kwamaqembu ahlukene anomgogodla ngenxa yokuzivumelanisa nezimo ngesikhathi sokuvela kanye nomehluko ohlobene nokwakheka komzimba. Isithombe 31.4 sibonisa izinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi eziyisisekelo zezinye izilwane ezinomgogodla: izinhlanzi, izilwane ezihlala emanzini, izilwane ezihuquzelayo, nezilwane ezincelisayo.

 Njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 31.4a Izinhlanzi zinesekethe eyodwa yokugeleza kwegazi kanye nenhliziyo enamakamelo amabili ene-atrium eyodwa kanye ne-ventricle eyodwa. I-atrium iqoqa igazi elibuyile emzimbeni bese i-ventricle ipompa igazi liye kuma-gill lapho kwenzeka khona ukushintshana kwegesi bese igazi liphinde lifakwe umoya-mpilo; lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukujikeleza kwe-gill. Igazi bese liqhubeka kulo lonke umzimba ngaphambi kokubuyela e-atrium; lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukujikeleza kwe-systemic. Lokhu kugeleza kwegazi okungahambisani nesiqondiso kukhiqiza i-gradient ye-oxygenated egazini elingenawo umoya-mpilo elizungeze isifunda se-systemic senhlanzi. Umphumela uba umkhawulo enanini le-oxygen elingafinyelela kwezinye zezitho nezicubu zomzimba, kunciphisa amandla okusebenza kwezinhlanzi.

 Ezilwaneni ezihlala emanzini, ezihuquzelayo, ezinyonini, nasezincelisayo, ukugeleza kwegazi kuqondiswa ngezifunda ezimbili: eyodwa ngamaphaphu bese ibuyela enhliziyweni, okubizwa ngokuthi ukujikeleza kwe-pulmonary, kanti enye kulo lonke umzimba kanye nezitho zayo okuhlanganisa nobuchopho (ukujikeleza kwe-systemic). Ezilwaneni ezihlala emanzini, ukushintshana kwegesi kwenzeka nasesikhumbeni ngesikhathi sokujikeleza kwe-pulmonary futhi kubizwa ngokuthi ukujikeleza kwe-pulmocutaneous.

 Njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 31.4b, ama-amphibian anenhliziyo enamakamelo amathathu ene-atria ezimbili kanye ne-ventricle eyodwa kunenhliziyo yezinhlanzi enamakamelo amabili. Ama-atria amabili (amakamelo enhliziyo aphezulu) athola igazi elivela kumasekethe amabili ahlukene (amaphaphu kanye nezinhlelo), bese kuba nokuxubana kwegazi kwi-ventricle yenhliziyo (igumbi lenhliziyo elingaphansi), okunciphisa ukusebenza kahle kokungenisa umoya-mpilo. Inzuzo yalolu hlelo ukuthi ukucindezela okuphezulu emithanjeni yegazi kusunduza igazi liye emaphashini nasemzimbeni. Ukuxubana kuncishiswa yi-ridge ngaphakathi kwe-ventricle ehambisa igazi elicebile ngomoya-mpilo ngokusebenzisa uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluhlelekile kanye negazi elingenawo umoya-mpilo liye kwisekethe yamaphaphu. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, ama-amphibian avame ukuchazwa ngokuthi anokujikeleza kabili.

 Iningi lezilwane ezihuquzelayo linenhliziyo enamakamelo amathathu efana nenhliziyo yama-amphibian eqondisa igazi kumasekethe amaphaphu kanye ne-systemic, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 31.4c. I-ventricle ihlukaniswa ngempumelelo kakhulu yi-septum engaphelele, okuholela ekuxubeni okuncane kwegazi eline-oxygen kanye nelingenawo umoya-mpilo. Ezinye izilwane ezihuquzelayo (ama-alligator nama-crocodile) yizilwane zakudala kakhulu ezibonisa inhliziyo enamakamelo amane. Ama-crocodilian anendlela ehlukile yokujikeleza kwegazi lapho inhliziyo isusa igazi emaphashini liye esiswini nakwezinye izitho ngesikhathi eside sokucwila, isibonelo, kuyilapho isilwane silinde inyamazane noma sihlala ngaphansi kwamanzi silinde inyamazane ukuba ibole. Okunye ukuzivumelanisa nezimo kuhlanganisa imithambo emibili eyinhloko eshiya ingxenye efanayo yenhliziyo: enye ithatha igazi iye emaphashini kanti enye inikeza indlela ehlukile eya esiswini nakwezinye izingxenye zomzimba. Ezinye izindlela ezimbili zokuzivumelanisa nezimo zifaka phakathi imbobo enhliziyweni phakathi kwama-ventricle amabili, okuthiwa i-foramen of Panizza, evumela igazi ukuthi lisuke kolunye uhlangothi lwenhliziyo liye kolunye, kanye nezicubu ezikhethekile ezixhumanisayo ezinciphisa ukugeleza kwegazi emaphashini. Lokhu kuzivumelanisa nezimo kwenze izingwenya nama-alligator zibe ngelinye lamaqembu ezilwane aphumelele kakhulu emhlabeni.

 Ezincelisayo nasezinyonini, inhliziyo ihlukaniswe futhi yaba amakamelo amane: ama-atria amabili nama-ventricle amabili, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 31.4d. Igazi elinomoya-mpilo lihlukaniswe negazi elingenawo umoya-mpilo, okuthuthukisa ukusebenza kahle kokujikeleza kwegazi kabili futhi cishe kuyadingeka empilweni yokuphila enegazi elifudumele yezilwane ezincelisayo nezinyoni. Inhliziyo yezinyoni nezilwane ezincelisayo enamakamelo amane yavela ngokuzimela enhliziyweni enamakamelo amathathu. Ukuvela okuzimele kwesici esifanayo noma esifanayo sebhayoloji kubizwa ngokuthi ukuguquka okuhlangene
question1: Kungani izilwane ezilula njengeziponji nama-rotifer zingadingi uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi?
answer1: Ukusabalala kwanele ukushintshanisa amanzi, izakhamzimba, imfucuza kanye namagesi ancibilikisiwe
distractor1b: Bathembele kuphela ekuthuthweni okusebenzayo ngemithambo yegazi
question2: Ama-cnidarians nama-ctenophores ashintshana kanjani ngezinto ngaphandle kohlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluyinkimbinkimbi?
answer2: Basebenzisa ukusabalala ngokusebenzisa i-epidermis yabo kanye nengxenye yesisu
distractor2b: Basebenzisa amaphaphu ukushintshanisa umoya-mpilo kanye ne-carbon dioxide
distractor2c: Basebenzisa amaseli abomvu egazi akhethekile ukuze bathuthe
question3: Kungani izinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi eziyinkimbinkimbi zavela ezintweni eziphilayo ezinkulu?
answer3: Ukusabalala akusebenzi kahle ngokwanele ukuthutha amagesi, izakhamzimba, kanye nemfucuza kuyo yonke imizimba emikhulu
distractor3b: Ukusabalala kuba ngokushesha njengoba usayizi womzimba ukhula
distractor3c: Izinto eziphilayo eziyinkimbinkimbi azikwazi ukushintshanisa izinto nendawo ezizungezile
question4: Hlobo luni lwesimiso sokujikeleza kwegazi olutholakala kuma-arthropod amaningi kanye nama-mollusk amaningi?
answer4: Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvulekile
distractor4a: Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvaliwe olunamakamelo amane
question5: Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi lwezinhlanzi luhluke kanjani kolwezilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini, izilwane ezihuquzelayo, izinyoni nezilwane ezincelisayo?
answer5: Izinhlanzi zinomjikelezo owodwa wokujikeleza kwegazi kanye nenhliziyo enamakamelo amabili, kanti ezinye zinomjikelezo wokujikeleza kabili.
distractor5a: Izinhlanzi zinamakamelo amane kanti izilwane ezincelisayo zinamakamelo amabili
distractor5b: Izinhlanzi azinawo inhliziyo kanti ezinye izilwane ezinomgogodla zinayo
distractor5c: Izinhlanzi zisebenzisa ukujikeleza kwegazi emaphashini kuphela kanti izilwane ezincelisayo zisebenzisa ukujikeleza kwegazi okuhlelekile kuphela
question6: Mangaki amakamelo atholakala enhliziyweni yenhlanzi?
answer6: Amakamelo amabili: i-atrium eyodwa kanye ne-ventricle eyodwa
distractor6a: Amakamelo amathathu: i-atria amabili kanye ne-ventricle eyodwa
distractor6b: Amakamelo amane: i-atria emibili kanye nama-ventricle amabili
distractor6c: Amakamelo amahlanu: i-atria emithathu kanye nama-ventricle amabili
question7: Kungani uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi olulodwa lwezinhlanzi lunciphisa amandla azo okusebenza kwe-metabolic?
answer7: Ukwehla komoya-mpilo ozungeze isekethe yesistimu kunciphisa inani lomoya-mpilo ofinyelela kwezinye izicubu
distractor7a: Izinhlanzi azikwazi ukuthutha izakhamzimba emizimbeni yazo
distractor7b: Izinhlanzi azikwazi ukushintshanisa igesi ema-gill azo
distractor7c: Izinhlanzi zinamakamelo amaningi kakhulu enhliziyo ukuze zingakwazi ukujikeleza kahle kwegazi
question8: Iyini inzuzo enkulu yokujikeleza kabili kwezilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini, ezihuquzelayo, ezinyonini nasezincelisayo?
answer8: Ihlukanisa ukujikeleza kwegazi kwamaphaphu kanye nokwesistimu, ithuthukisa ukusebenza kahle kokulethwa komoya-mpilo
distractor8b: Kuvimbela konke ukuhamba kwegazi emithanjeni yegazi
distractor8c: Ivumela igazi ukuthi lidlule amaphaphu ngokuphelele
question9: Inhliziyo yezilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini enamakamelo amathathu ikuthinta kanjani ukujikeleza kwegazi?
answer9: Igazi elivela kuma-atria amabili lihlangana kancane e-ventricle, okunciphisa ukusebenza kahle kokungenisa umoya-mpilo
distractor9a: Ihlukanisa ngokuphelele igazi elinomoya-mpilo kanye negazi elingenawo umoya-mpilo
distractor9c: Isebenza kahle njengenhliziyo yesilwane esincelisayo esinegumbi ezine
question10: Kuyini ukuziphendukela kwemvelo okuguquguqukayo?
answer10: Ukuvela okuzimele kwezimpawu ezifanayo noma ezifanayo zebhayoloji emaqenjini ahlukene
distractor10a: Ukulahlekelwa yizo zonke izimo ngaphakathi kwesizwe
distractor10b: Ifa lezimpawu ezifanayo ezivela kukhokho ovamile wakamuva kuphela
distractor10c: Inqubo lapho izinto eziphilayo ziyeka khona ukuguquka

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.2 Izingxenye Zegazi | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.2 Components of the Blood | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Iningi lethu liye lasikwa noma lakhuhla idolo futhi labona igazi lethu. Igazi lakhiwa izinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli ahlanjwe oketshezini olusekelwe emanzini olubizwa ngokuthi i-plasma. Amaseli abomvu egazi akhethekile ukuthwala i-hemoglobin (Hgb), iphrotheni ye-quaternary ethwala umoya-mpilo kanye ne-carbon dioxide ethile emzimbeni, iye futhi isuka enhliziyweni nasemaphashini. I-hemoglobin futhi inamandla e-carbon monoxide, igesi enobuthi nebulalayo. Izinhlobo ze-hemoglobin zisiza izilwane ukuba zivumelane nezimo ezahlukene. Isibonelo, i-Hgb-S ibangela i-sickle-cell anemia; yize lolu hlobo lwe-hemoglobin lungasebenzi kahle ekuthwaleni i-O2, lunikeza isivikelo esithile ngokumelene nomalaleveva, ngaleyo ndlela lunikeza inzuzo kubantu abane-heterozygous. Olunye uhlobo yi-Hgb-F noma i-hemoglobin yengane, ethwala i-O2 kahle ezimweni eziphansi ze-oxygen. Amaseli abomvu egazi akhula futhi avuthwe emnkantsheni wamathambo futhi lapho ekhishwa egazini awanazo i-nuclei kanye ne-mitochondria. Izinhlobo zegazi ezifana ne-A, B, AB, kanye ne-O zihlobene namaprotheni ebusweni bamaseli abomvu egazi. Isibonelo, abantu abanegazi lohlobo A bane-glycoproteins A ebusweni bamaseli abo abomvu egazi. Sizohlola ngokujulile uhlobo lwegazi, ama-antigen, kanye nama-antibodies lapho sihlola isimiso somzimba sokuzivikela komzimba esahlukweni esilandelayo, futhi sizofunda nokuthi izinhlobo ezinhlanu zamaseli amhlophe egazi zidlala indima ebalulekile ekulweni nomzimba. Ama-platelet namaprotheni e-plasma asebenza ekulweni kwegazi okuvamile; izinguquko endleleni (izindlela) yokuphendula ezibangela ukuminyana kwegazi okuvamile zingaba nemiphumela emibi, okuhlanganisa i-hemophilia kanye nesifo sohlangothi.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 kanye no-Big Idea 4 wohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nenye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zigcine i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.C
Izinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa izindlela zokuphendula ukuze zilawule ukukhula nokuzala, kanye nokugcina i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.C.1 Ushintsho ezindleleni zezindlela zokuphendula ezingezinhle nezinhle kungaba nemiphumela emibi emzimbeni.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo nezibikezelo mayelana nezehlakalo zemvelo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi namamodeli.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.19 Umfundi uyakwazi ukwenza izibikezelo mayelana nokuthi izindlela zokuphendula ezinhle zithuthukisa kanjani imisebenzi nezinqubo ezintweni eziphilayo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi namamodeli.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 4
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo zinezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.A
Ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo kuholela ezimpahleni eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.4 Izinto eziphilayo zibonisa izakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi ngenxa yokusebenzisana phakathi kwezitho nezinhlelo zezitho.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.3 Umfundi angalungisa izethulo namamodeli ezethulo nezinhlelo zemvelo noma ezenziwe ngumuntu endaweni

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.10 Umfundi uyakwazi ukulungisa izethulo namamodeli ukuze abonise ubunkimbinkimbi bezinto eziphilayo ngenxa yokusebenzisana kwezingxenye eziyingxenye.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.C
Ukwehlukahlukana okwenzeka ngokwemvelo phakathi kwezingxenye ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo kuthinta ukusebenzisana nendawo ezungezile.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.C.1 Ukwehluka okukhiqiza izinhlobo ezahlukene zama-molecule kusiza izinto eziphilayo ukuzivumelanisa nezimo ezahlukene zemvelo.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezethulo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obuvezwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.
Inhloso Yokufunda
4.22 Umfundi uyakwazi ukwakha izincazelo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini bokuthi ukuhlukahluka kwamayunithi ama-molecule kunikeza amangqamuzana imisebenzi ehlukahlukene.

 I-Hemoglobin inesibopho sokusabalalisa umoya-mpilo, futhi ngezinga elincane, i-carbon dioxide, kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi zabantu, izilwane ezinomgogodla, kanye nezilwane eziningi ezingenamgogodla. Igazi lingaphezu kwamaprotheni, nokho. Empeleni igazi liyigama elisetshenziselwa ukuchaza uketshezi oluhamba ngemithambo yegazi futhi luhlanganisa i-plasma (ingxenye yoketshezi, equkethe amanzi, amaprotheni, usawoti, amafutha, kanye ne-glucose) kanye namaseli (amangqamuzana abomvu namhlophe) kanye nezingcezu zamaseli ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-platelet. I-plasma yegazi empeleni iyisakhi esiyinhloko segazi futhi iqukethe amanzi, amaprotheni, ama-electrolyte, amafutha, kanye ne-glucose. Amaseli anesibopho sokuthwala amagesi (amangqamuzana abomvu) futhi avikele impendulo (emhlophe). Ama-platelet anesibopho sokujiya kwegazi. Uketshezi oluphakathi oluzungeze amangqamuzana luhlukile egazini, kodwa ku-hemolymph, luyahlanganiswa. Kubantu, izingxenye zamaseli zakha cishe amaphesenti angu-45 egazi kanye ne-plasma yoketshezi engu-55%. Igazi lingamaphesenti angama-20 oketshezi lomuntu olungaphandle kwesikhumba kanye namaphesenti ayisishiyagalombili esisindo

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.2 Izingxenye Zegazi | Indima Yegazi Emzimbeni
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.2 Components of the Blood | The Role of Blood in the Body
chapterContent: Igazi, njengegazi lomuntu eliboniswe kuMfanekiso 31.5 libalulekile ekulawuleni izinhlelo zomzimba kanye ne-homeostasis. Igazi lisiza ekugcineni i-homeostasis ngokuzinzisa i-pH, izinga lokushisa, ingcindezi ye-osmotic, kanye nokususa ukushisa okweqile. Igazi lisekela ukukhula ngokusabalalisa izakhamzimba nama-hormone, nangokususa ukungcola. Igazi lidlala indima yokuvikela ngokuthutha izinto ezivala igazi kanye nama-platelet ukuvimbela ukulahleka kwegazi kanye nokuthutha izinto ezilwa nezifo noma amaseli egazi amhlophe ezindaweni zokutheleleka.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.2 Izingxenye Zegazi | Amaseli Egazi Abomvu
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.2 Components of the Blood | Red Blood Cells
chapterContent:
Amaseli egazi abomvu, noma ama-erythrocyte (ama-erythro- = abomvu”; -cyte = iseli”), angamaseli akhethekile ajikeleza emzimbeni ehambisa umoya-mpilo emaselini; akhiwa ngamaseli okuqala emnkantsheni wamathambo. Ezincelisayo, amaseli egazi abomvu angamaseli amancane e-biconcave lapho esekhulile angenawo i-nucleus noma i-mitochondria futhi anobukhulu obungu-7–8 μm kuphela. Ezinyonini nasezihuquzelayo ezingezona izinyoni, i-nucleus isagcinwa kumaseli egazi abomvu.

 Umbala obomvu wegazi uvela ku-hemoglobin equkethe insimbi, eboniswe kuMfanekiso 31.6a. Umsebenzi oyinhloko wale phrotheni ukuthwala umoya-mpilo, kodwa futhi ithutha ne-carbon dioxide. I-hemoglobin ifakwa kumaseli egazi abomvu ngesilinganiso sama-molecule e-hemoglobin angaba yizigidi ezingu-250 ngeseli ngalinye. I-molecule ngayinye ye-hemoglobin ibopha ama-molecule amane e-oxygen ukuze iseli ngalinye elibomvu legazi lithwale ama-molecule e-oxygen ayizigidi eziyinkulungwane. Kunamaseli abomvu egazi angaba yizigidigidi ezingama-25 emalitheni amahlanu egazi emzimbeni womuntu, angathwala ama-molecule e-oxygen afinyelela ku-25 sextillion (25 × 1021) emzimbeni nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Ezincelisayo, ukuntuleka kwama-organelle kuma-erythrocyte kushiya isikhala esengeziwe sama-molecule e-hemoglobin, futhi ukuntuleka kwe-mitochondria kuvimbela nokusetshenziswa komoya-mpilo ekuphefumuleni komzimba. Izilwane ezincelisayo kuphela ezinamaseli abomvu egazi ane-anucleated, kanti ezinye izilwane ezincelisayo (amakamela, isibonelo) zinamaseli abomvu egazi ane-nucleated. Inzuzo yamaseli abomvu egazi ane-nucleated ukuthi la maseli angadlula ku-mitosis. Amaseli abomvu egazi ane-anucleated aguqula i-anaerobically (ngaphandle komoya-mpilo), esebenzisa indlela yokuqala yokuguqula i-metabolic ukukhiqiza i-ATP nokwandisa ukusebenza kahle kokuthuthwa komoya-mpilo.

 Akuzona zonke izinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisa i-hemoglobin njengendlela yokuthutha umoya-mpilo. Izilwane ezingenamgogodla ezisebenzisa i-hemolymph kunegazi zisebenzisa imibala ehlukene ukubopha umoya-mpilo. Lezi mibala zisebenzisa ithusi noma insimbi ukubopha umoya-mpilo. Izilwane ezingenamgogodla zinezinhlobonhlobo zezinye imibala yokuphefumula. I-Hemocyanin, iphrotheni eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, equkethe ithusi, eboniswe kuMfanekiso 31.6b itholakala kuma-mollusk, ama-crustacean, nakwamanye ama-arthropod. I-Chlorocruorin, umbala oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, oqukethe insimbi, itholakala emindenini emine yama-polychaete tubeworms. I-Hemerythrin, iphrotheni ebomvu, equkethe insimbi, itholakala kwezinye izibungu ze-polychaete kanye nama-annelids futhi iboniswe kuMfanekiso 31.6c. Naphezu kwegama layo, i-hemerythrin ayinayo iqembu le-heme futhi amandla ayo okuthwala umoya-mpilo aphansi uma kuqhathaniswa ne-hemoglobin.

 Ubukhulu obuncane nendawo enkulu yamangqamuzana egazi abomvu ivumela ukusabalala okusheshayo komoya-mpilo kanye ne-carbon dioxide kulo lonke ulwelwesi lwe-plasma. Emaphashini, i-carbon dioxide iyakhishwa futhi umoya-mpilo uthathwa yigazi. Ezicutshini, umoya-mpilo uyakhishwa egazini futhi i-carbon dioxide iboshelwa ekuthuthweni ibuyiselwe emaphashini. Izifundo zithole ukuthi i-hemoglobin ibopha ne-nitrous oxide (NO). I-NO iyi-vasodilator ekhulula imithambo yegazi nama-capillary futhi ingasiza ngokushintshana kwegesi kanye nokudlula kwamaseli abomvu egazi ngemithambo emincane. I-Nitroglycerin, umuthi wenhliziyo we-angina nokuhlaselwa yinhliziyo, iguqulwa ibe yi-NO ukusiza ukukhulula imithambo yegazi nokwandisa ukugeleza komoya-mpilo emzimbeni.

 Isici samaseli abomvu egazi ukugqoka kwawo kwe-glycolipid ne-glycoprotein; lawa ama-lipid namaprotheni anama-molecule e-carbohydrate anamathele. Kubantu, ama-glycoprotein angaphezulu nama-glycolipid kumaseli abomvu egazi ayahlukahluka phakathi kwabantu, akhiqiza izinhlobo ezahlukene zegazi, njenge-A, B, kanye ne-O. Amaseli abomvu egazi anesilinganiso sokuphila sezinsuku ezingu-120, lapho ephulwa khona futhi aphinde asetshenziswe esibindini nasesinqeni yi-phagocytic macrophages, uhlobo lweseli elimhlophe legazi

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.2 Izingxenye Zegazi | Amaseli Egazi Amhlophe
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.2 Components of the Blood | White Blood Cells
chapterContent:
Amaseli amhlophe egazi, abizwa nangokuthi ama-leukocyte (leuko = amhlophe), akha cishe iphesenti elilodwa ngobuningi bamaseli egazini. Indima yamaseli amhlophe egazi ihluke kakhulu kuneyamaseli abomvu egazi: ahileleke kakhulu ekuphenduleni komzimba ukuze abone futhi ahlasele amagciwane, njengamabhaktheriya ahlaselayo, amagciwane, nezinye izinto eziphilayo zakwamanye amazwe. Amaseli amhlophe egazi akhiwa njalo; amanye aphila amahora noma izinsuku kuphela, kodwa amanye aphila iminyaka.

 Ukwakheka kwamaseli amhlophe egazi kuhluke kakhulu kumaseli abomvu egazi. Anama-nuclei futhi awaqukethe i-hemoglobin. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli amhlophe egazi zibonakala ngokubonakala kwawo okuncane kakhulu ngemva kokudaya kwe-histologic, futhi ngalinye linomsebenzi ohlukile okhethekile. Amaqembu amabili amakhulu, womabili aboniswe kuMfanekiso 31.7 ama-granulocyte, afaka ama-neutrophils, ama-eosinophils, nama-basophils, kanye nama-agranulocyte, afaka ama-monocyte nama-lymphocyte.

 Ama-granulocyte aqukethe ama-granules ku-cytoplasm yawo; Ama-agranulocyte aqanjwe kanjalo ngenxa yokuntuleka kwama-granule ku-cytoplasm yawo. Amanye ama-leukocyte aba ama-macrophage ahlala endaweni efanayo noma ahamba emgudwini wegazi futhi aqoqene ezindaweni zokutheleleka noma ukuvuvukala lapho edonswa khona izimpawu zamakhemikhali ezivela ezinhlayiyeni zakwamanye amazwe namaseli alimele. Ama-lymphocyte angamaseli ayinhloko esistimu yomzimba futhi afaka amaseli e-B, amaseli e-T, namaseli okubulala emvelo. Amaseli e-B abhubhisa amabhaktheriya futhi aqede ubuthi bawo. Aphinde akhiqize ama-antibodies. Amaseli e-T ahlasela amagciwane, isikhunta, amanye amabhaktheriya, amaseli atshalwe kabusha, namaseli omdlavuza. Amaseli e-T ahlasela amagciwane ngokukhulula ubuthi obubulala amagciwane. Amaseli okubulala emvelo ahlasela izinhlobo ezahlukene zamagciwane athelelekayo namaseli athile esimila.

 Esinye sezizathu ezenza i-HIV ibe nezinselele ezinkulu zokuphatha ukuthi igciwane lihlasela ngqo amaseli e-T ngokuthola ukungena nge-receptor. Uma selingaphakathi kweseli, i-HIV yanda isebenzisa imishini yezakhi zofuzo yeseli le-T. Ngemva kokuba igciwane le-HIV liphindaphindeka, lidluliselwa ngqo kusuka kuseli le-T elithelelekile liye kuma-macrophage. Ukuba khona kwe-HIV kungahlala kungaziwa isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuba kuvele izimpawu zesifo ezigcwele.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.2 Izingxenye Zegazi | Ama-Platelet kanye Nezinto Ezibangela Ukujiya Kwegazi
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.2 Components of the Blood | Platelets and Coagulation Factors
chapterContent: Igazi kumele lijike ukuze lipholise amanxeba futhi livimbele ukulahleka kwegazi okweqile. Izingcezu ezincane zamaseli ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-platelet (ama-thrombocyte) zidonswa endaweni yamanxeba lapho zinamathela khona ngokwandisa ukubonwa okuningi nokukhulula okuqukethwe kwazo. Lokhu okuqukethwe kushukumisa amanye ama-platelet futhi kuhlangana nezinye izinto ezijike, eziguqula i-fibrinogen, iphrotheni encibilika emanzini ekhona ku-serum yegazi ibe yi-fibrin (iphrotheni engancibiliki emanzini), okubangela ukuba igazi lijike. Izinto eziningi ezijikekayo zidinga i-vitamin K ukuze isebenze, futhi ukuntuleka kwe-vitamin K kungaholela ezinkingeni zokujikeka kwegazi. Ama-platelet amaningi ayahlangana futhi anamathele ndawonye endaweni yamanxeba akha i-platelet plug (ebizwa nangokuthi i-fibrin clot), njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 31.8b. I-plug noma i-clot ihlala izinsuku eziningana futhi imisa ukulahleka kwegazi. Ama-platelet akhiwa ngokuqhekeka kwamaseli amakhulu abizwa ngokuthi ama-megakaryocytes, njengalokho okuboniswe kuMfanekiso 31.8a. Ku-megakaryocyte ngayinye, kwakheka ama-platelet angu-2000–3000 anama-platelet angu-150,000 kuya ku-400,000 akhona ku-cubic millimeter ngayinye yegazi. I-platelet ngayinye inomumo we-disc futhi ububanzi bayo bungu-2–4 μm. Aqukethe ama-vesicle amaningi amancane kodwa awaqukethe i-nucleus

question4: Yiliphi iphrotheni eliguqulwa libe yi-fibrin ngesikhathi sokujiya kwegazi?

question6: Yiliphi ivithamini elidingwa yizinto eziningi ezibangela ukujiya kwegazi ukuze lisebenze kahle?

question7: Yini engenzeka uma umuntu entula i-vitamin K?

question8: Iyini i-platelet plug?
answer8: Iqoqo lama-platelet anamathelana ndawonye endaweni yenxeba ukuze kumiswe ukulahleka kwegazi
distractor8a: Iqembu lamaseli abomvu egazi athwala umoya-mpilo
question9: Ama-platelet akhiwa ngamaphi amaseli?
answer9: Ama-Megakaryocytes
question10: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza ama-platelet?
