chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.2 Izingxenye Zegazi | I-Plasma Ne-Serum
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.2 Components of the Blood | Plasma and Serum
chapterContent:
Ingxenye ewuketshezi yegazi ibizwa ngokuthi i-plasma, futhi ihlukaniswa ngokujika noma ngokuyijika igazi nge-centrifugal ngokujikeleza okuphezulu (3000 rpm noma ngaphezulu). Amaseli egazi nama-platelet ahlukaniswa ngamandla e-centrifugal phansi kwepayipi lesampula. Ingqimba engenhla yoketshezi, i-plasma, inamanzi angamaphesenti angama-90 kanye nezinto ezahlukahlukene ezidingekayo ukuze kulondolozwe i-pH yomzimba, umthwalo we-osmotic, kanye nokuvikela umzimba. I-plasma iqukethe nezinto ezihlanganisa ukujiya kanye nama-antibodies.

 Ingxenye ye-plasma yegazi engenazo izinto ezihlanganisa ukujiya ibizwa ngokuthi i-serum. I-serum ifana noketshezi oluphakathi lapho ukwakheka okufanele kwama-ion ayisihluthulelo asebenza njengama-electrolyte kubalulekile ekusebenzeni okuvamile kwemisipha kanye nemizwa. Ezinye izingxenye ezise-serum zifaka amaprotheni asiza ekugcineni i-pH kanye nebhalansi ye-osmotic ngenkathi enikeza i-viscosity egazini. I-serum iqukethe nama-antibodies, amaprotheni akhethekile abalulekile ekuvikeleni amagciwane namagciwane. Ama-lipid, okuhlanganisa ne-cholesterol, nawo athuthwa nge-serum, kanye nezinye izinto ezahlukahlukene okuhlanganisa izakhamzimba, ama-hormone, imfucuza ye-metabolic, kanye nezinto zangaphandle, njengezidakamizwa, amagciwane, namabhaktheriya.

 I-albumin ye-serum yomuntu iyiprotheni eningi kakhulu eplasma yegazi lomuntu futhi yenziwa esibindini. I-Albumin, eyakha cishe ingxenye yeprotheni ye-serum yegazi, ithutha ama-hormone nama-fatty acid, igcina i-pH, futhi igcina ingcindezi ye-osmotic. I-Immunoglobin iyi-antibody yeprotheni ekhiqizwa elangeni le-mucosal futhi idlala indima ebalulekile ekuvikelekeni okubangelwa yi-antibody.
question1: Ibizwa ngokuthini ingxenye yegazi ewuketshezi?
answer1: I-Plasma
question2: I-plasma ingahlukaniswa kanjani kumaseli egazi nama-platelet?
answer2: Ngokufaka igazi nge-centrifuging ngokujikeleza okuphezulu, okubangela ukuthi amaseli nama-platelet athuthele phansi kwepayipi
distractor2a: Ngokufudumeza igazi kuze kube yilapho amaseli encibilika
question3: Ingakanani iphesenti le-plasma elingaba ngamanzi?
answer3: Cishe amaphesenti angama-90
question4: Yiziphi izinto ezibalulekile ezitholakala ku-plasma?
answer4: Izinto ezibangela ukuminyana kwegazi, ama-antibodies, nezinto ezisiza ukugcina ibhalansi ye-pH ne-osmotic
distractor4a: Amaseli abomvu egazi kanye ne-hemoglobin kuphela
question5: I-serum ihluke kanjani ku-plasma?
answer5: I-Serum iyi-plasma engenazo izinto ezibangela ukujiya kwegazi
distractor5b: I-serum iqukethe amaseli abomvu egazi kuphela
question6: Kungani ama-electrolyte ku-serum ebalulekile?
answer6: Zibalulekile ekusebenzeni okujwayelekile kwemisipha nezinzwa
distractor6a: Zikhiqiza umoya-mpilo ngaphakathi kwamangqamuzana abomvu egazi
question7: Iyini indima eyinhloko yama-antibodies atholakala ku-serum?
answer7: Ukuvikela umzimba kuma-virus namagciwane
question8: Iyiphi iphrotheni eningi kakhulu ku-plasma yegazi lomuntu?
answer8: I-albumin ye-serum yomuntu
question9: Yimiphi imisebenzi ye-albumin egazini?
answer9: Ithutha ama-hormone nama-fatty acid, igcina i-pH, futhi igcina ingcindezi ye-osmotic
question10: Iyini indima ye-immunoglobin emzimbeni?
answer10: Isebenza njenge-antibody ehilelekile ekulweni nomzimba okubangelwa yi-antibody
distractor10a: Ilawula umfutho wegazi ngokwenza amahlule
distractor10b: Ithutha i-carbon dioxide ngamaseli abomvu egazi

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.2 Izingxenye Zegazi | Izinhlobo Zegazi Ezihlobene Namaprotheni Asebusweni Bamaseli Egazi Abomvu
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.2 Components of the Blood | Blood Types Related to Proteins on the Surface of the Red Blood Cells
chapterContent:
Amaseli egazi abomvu ambozwe ngama-antigen enziwe ngama-glycolipid nama-glycoprotein. Ukwakheka kwala ma-molecule kunqunywa izakhi zofuzo, eziye zavela ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Kubantu, ama-antigen ahlukene angaphezulu ahlukaniswe ngamaqembu egazi angu-24 ahlukene anama-antigen angaphezu kwe-100 ahlukene kuseli ngalinye elibomvu legazi. Amaqembu egazi amabili aziwa kakhulu yi-ABO, aboniswe kuMfanekiso 31.9, kanye nezinhlelo ze-Rh. Ama-antigen angaphezulu eqenjini legazi le-ABO ama-glycolipid, abizwa ngokuthi i-antigen A kanye ne-antigen B. Abantu abanohlobo lwegazi A bane-antigen A, labo abanohlobo lwegazi B bane-antigen B, labo abanohlobo lwegazi AB banawo womabili ama-antigen, kanti abantu abanohlobo lwegazi O abanawo ama-antigen. Ama-antibodies abizwa ngokuthi ama-agglutinougens atholakala ku-plasma yegazi futhi asabela nama-antigen A noma B, uma womabili exutshwe. Lapho igazi lohlobo A kanye negazi lohlobo B lihlanganiswa, ukuhlanganiswa kwegazi kwenzeka ngenxa yama-antibodies ku-plasma abophana ne-antigen ephikisanayo; lokhu kubangela amahlule ahlangana ezinso okubangela ukwehluleka kwezinso. Igazi lohlobo O alinawo ama-antigen ka-A noma B, ngakho-ke, igazi lohlobo O linganikezwa zonke izinhlobo zegazi. Igazi lohlobo O elingelutho lingumhlinzeki wendawo yonke. Igazi lohlobo AB elinokwamukela indawo yonke ngoba line-antigen ka-A no-B. Amaqembu egazi e-ABO atholakala ngo-1900 nango-1901 nguKarl Landsteiner eNyuvesi yaseVienna.

 Iqembu legazi le-Rh latholakala okokuqala ezinkawini ze-Rhesus. Iningi labantu line-antigen ka-Rh (Rh+) futhi alinawo ama-antibody ka-Rh egazini labo. Abantu abambalwa abangenayo i-antigen ka-Rh futhi abane-Rh– bangakha ama-antibody ka-anti-Rh uma bevezwa egazini lika-Rh+. Lokhu kungenzeka ngemva kokumpontshelwa igazi noma ngemva kokuba owesifazane we-Rh– ethole umntwana we-Rh+. Ukuvezwa kokuqala akuvamile ukubangela ukusabela; nokho, ekuvezweni kwesibili, ama-antibodies anele akheke egazini ukuze akhiqize ukusabela okubangela ukuhlangana nokuwohloka kwamaseli abomvu egazi. Umjovo ungavimbela lokhu kusabela
question1: Yimaphi ama-molecule amboza ubuso bamaseli abomvu egazi futhi anqume uhlobo lwegazi?
answer1: Ama-antigen enziwe ngama-glycolipid nama-glycoprotein
question2: Yini enquma ukwakheka kwama-antigen ebusweni bamaseli abomvu egazi?
answer2: Izakhi zofuzo
question3: Yimaphi ama-antigen ahilelekile ohlelweni lweqembu legazi le-ABO?
answer3: I-Antigen A kanye ne-antigen B
question4: Yimaphi ama-antigen akhona kumaseli abomvu egazi lomuntu onegazi lohlobo lwe-AB?
answer4: Kokubili i-antigen A kanye ne-antigen B
question5: Kungani i-agglutination iyenzeka uma izinhlobo zegazi ezingahambisani zixubene?
answer5: Ama-antibodies ku-plasma abopha ama-antigen aphikisanayo, okubangela ukuba amaseli egazi ahlangane
distractor5a: Amangqamuzana abomvu egazi alahlekelwa yi-hemoglobin yawo futhi ancibilike ngokushesha
distractor5b: Ama-platelet ayayeka ukukhiqiza izinto ezibangela ukujiya kwegazi
distractor5c: Amanzi e-plasma abangela ukwanda kwamangqamuzana egazi abomvu
question6: Kungani igazi lohlobo O elibi libhekwa njengomnikeli ojwayelekile?
answer6: Ayinawo ama-antigen e-A, B, kanye ne-Rh angabangela ukusabela komzimba kulabo abatholayo
distractor6a: Iqukethe wonke ama-antigen egazi angaba khona
distractor6c: Iqukethe umoya-mpilo omningi kunezinye izinhlobo zegazi
question7: Kungani igazi lohlobo lwe-AB libhekwa njengelamukelekayo jikelele?
answer7: Inama-antigens amabili u-A no-B futhi ayikhiqizi ama-antibodies ngokumelene nalawo ma-antigen.
distractor7a: Ayinawo wonke ama-antigen amangqamuzana abomvu egazi
question8: Kwenzekani uma umuntu one-Rh-negative evezwa egazini le-Rh-positive?
answer8: Umuntu angakha ama-anti-Rh antibodies
distractor8a: Umuntu ulahlekelwa ngokushesha wonke amaseli abomvu egazi
question9: Kungani ukuchayeka okwesibili egazini eline-Rh kungabangela ukusabela okunamandla kumuntu one-Rh-negative?
answer9: Kukhiqizwe ama-antibodies anele e-anti-Rh ukuze kubangele ukuhlangana kwamangqamuzana egazi abomvu kanye nokuwohloka kwawo
distractor9a: Umzimba uyayeka ukubona amangqamuzana abomvu egazi ngemva kokuchayeka kokuqala
distractor9b: Igazi lilahlekelwa yiwo wonke ama-antigen ngemva kokuchayeka kokuqala
question10: Bheka uMfanekiso 31.9 kanye noMfanekiso 31.9.1. Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo, okudalwe ngokusekelwe ezicini zesimiso sokujikeleza kwegazi sezilwane ezinezinhlungu, okunembe kakhulu?
answer10: I-phylogeny ekhombisa izinhlanzi ziqala ngamagatsha ngenhliziyo enamakamelo amabili, kulandele izilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini ezinenhliziyo enamakamelo amathathu, bese kuba izilwane ezihuquzelayo, izinyoni, nezilwane ezincelisayo ezinokujikeleza kwegazi okuhlukene kakhulu
distractor10a: I-phylogeny ekhombisa izilwane ezincelisayo zishintsha ngqo ezinhlanzini ngaphandle kwamaqembu ezilwane ezinomgogodla eziphakathi nendawo
distractor10b: I-phylogeny ebeka izinyoni ngaphambi kwezinhlanzi ngoba izinyoni zinenhliziyo eyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu
distractor10c: I-phylogeny ekhombisa zonke izilwane ezinezinhlungu zomgogodla ezinesakhiwo senhliziyo esifanayo

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.3 Inhliziyo Nemithambo Yegazi Yezilwane Ezincelisayo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.3 Mammalian Heart and Blood Vessels | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluningi kulesi sigaba alukho ngaphakathi kwe-AP®. Cishe uke wafunda indlela yegazi elidlula ngayo enhliziyweni esifundweni sangaphambilini, futhi njengomfundi webhayoloji, kufanele ube nolwazi oluthile ngale ndlela. (Cha, awudingi ukukhumbula amagama ayo yonke imithambo yegazi nemithambo yegazi noma amagama ama-valve athile enhliziyo.)

 Inhliziyo iyisibonelo esiphelele sobudlelwano phakathi kwesakhiwo nomsebenzi. Inhliziyo yezilwane ezincelisayo enamakamelo amane enemisipha yayo yenhliziyo ehlukile, ama-valve ahamba ngendlela eyodwa, nemithambo yegazi yenzelwe ukuthutha umoya-mpilo obalulekile (O2) emaseli omzimba nokususa i-carbon dioxide (CO2) ezicutshini. Umklamo oyinkimbinkimbi wenhliziyo uhlukanisa igazi eliphansi ku-O2 egazini eliphakeme ku-O2. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi igazi elicebile ngomoya-mpilo lihanjiswa kuzo zonke izicubu namaseli omzimba lapho lizosetshenziselwa ukuphefumula kwamaseli. Igazi elibuya ezicutshini liphezulu ku-CO2 futhi eliphansi ku-O2 lizobuyela enhliziyweni bese liphonswa emaphashini, lapho amagesi eshintshwa khona ngokusabalala emibhedeni yama-capillary.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 4 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 4
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo zinezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.A
Ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo kuholela ezimpahleni eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.4 Ukusebenzisana kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlelo zezitho zomzimba kuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi ebalulekile yezinto eziphilayo kuyo yonke into.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo kanye nezibikezelo mayelana nezenzakalo zemvelo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi namamodeli.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.9 Umfundi uyakwazi ukubikezela imiphumela yoshintsho engxenyeni (izingxenye) yesistimu yezinto eziphilayo ekusebenzeni kwezinto eziphilayo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.4 Ukusebenzisana nokuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlelo zezitho zomzimba kuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi ebalulekile yezinto eziphilayo kuyo yonke into.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.3 Umfundi angalungisa izethulo namamodeli ezehlakalo nezinhlelo zemvelo noma ezenziwe ngabantu kule ndawo.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.10 Umfundi uyakwazi ukulungisa izethulo namamodeli ukuze abonise ubunkimbinkimbi bezinto eziphilayo ngenxa yokusebenzisana kwezingxenye eziyingxenye.
Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.B
Ukuncintisana nokubambisana kuyizinto ezibalulekile zezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.B.2 Ukukhethekile kwenhliziyo nemithambo yegazi kunegalelo ekusebenzeni komzimba wonke.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.18 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya ukuthi ukusebenzisana ngokubambisana phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo kukhuthaza kanjani ukusebenza kahle ekusetshenzisweni kwamandla nezinto.

 Inhliziyo iyimisipha eyinkimbinkimbi epompa igazi ngezigaba ezintathu zesistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi: i-coronary (imikhumbi ekhonza inhliziyo), i-pulmonary (inhliziyo namaphaphu), kanye ne-systemic (izinhlelo zomzimba), njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 31.10. Ukujikeleza kwe-coronary okungaphakathi kwenhliziyo kuthatha igazi ngqo kusuka emthanjeni oyinhloko (i-aorta) ovela enhliziyweni. Ukuze kujikeleze amaphaphu kanye ne-systemic, inhliziyo kufanele ipompe igazi liye emaphashini noma kuwo wonke umzimba, ngokulandelana. Ezilwaneni ezinomgogodla, amaphaphu aseduze kakhulu nenhliziyo emgodini wesifuba. Ibanga elifushane lokupompa lisho ukuthi udonga lwemisipha ohlangothini lwesokudla lwenhliziyo alukhulu njengohlangothi lwesobunxele okumele lube nomfutho owanele wokupompa igazi kuze kufike ozwaneni lwakho olukhulu.
question1: Kungani inhliziyo yezilwane ezincelisayo ibhekwa njengesibonelo sobudlelwano phakathi kwesakhiwo nomsebenzi?
answer1: Amakamelo ayo amane, imisipha yenhliziyo, ama-valve, kanye nemithambo yegazi kukhethekile ukuthutha umoya-mpilo ngempumelelo nokususa i-carbon dioxide
distractor1a: Isakhiwo sayo siyivumela ukuthi ikhiqize izakhamzimba zawo wonke amaseli omzimba
distractor1b: Amakamelo ayo ayivumela ukuthi yenze ngqo ukuphefumula kwamaseli
distractor1c: Ama-valve ayo ayivumela ukuthi ithathe indawo yokusebenza kwamaphaphu
question2: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wenhliziyo yesilwane esincelisayo esinezindawo ezine?
answer2: Ukuhlukanisa igazi elinomoya-mpilo omningi kanye negazi elingenawo umoya-mpilo futhi lihambise umoya-mpilo kahle emzimbeni wonke
distractor2a: Ukuvimbela yonke i-carbon dioxide ukuthi ingangeni egazini
question3: Kungani ukuhlukanisa igazi elinomoya-mpilo kanye negazi elingenawo umoya-mpilo kubalulekile ezincelisayo?
answer3: Kuqinisekisa ukuthi izicubu zithola igazi elinamazinga aphezulu omoya-mpilo ukuze kuphefumulelwe amaseli
distractor3c: Ivumela amangqamuzana ukukhiqiza umoya-mpilo ngaphandle kokuphefumula
question4: Kwenzekani egazini elibuya ezicutshini zomzimba liye enhliziyweni?
answer4: Ine-carbon dioxide ephezulu futhi ine-oxygen ephansi futhi ipompelwa emaphashini ukuze kushintshwe igesi
distractor4a: Ine-oxygen eningi futhi ithunyelwa ngqo ezicutshini zomzimba
distractor4c: Iyadlula emaphashini bese ingena ohlelweni lokugaya ukudla
question5: Yiziphi izingxenye ezintathu zokujikeleza kwegazi ezikhonzwa yinhliziyo yezilwane ezincelisayo?
answer5: Ukujikeleza kwegazi kwe-coronary, pulmonary, kanye ne-systemic
distractor5a: Ukujikeleza kwegazi kokuphefumula, kokugaya ukudla, kanye nokwemizwa
distractor5b: Ukujikeleza kwegazi kwemithambo yegazi, kwemithambo yegazi kanye ne-lymphatic
distractor5c: Ukujikeleza kwegazi kweseli, izicubu, kanye nezitho zomzimba
question6: Iyini injongo yokujikeleza kwegazi kwenhliziyo?
answer6: Ukunikeza igazi ngqo emisipheni yenhliziyo uqobo
distractor6a: Ukuthutha umoya-mpilo usuka emaphashini uye kuzo zonke izicubu zomzimba
distractor6c: Ukushintshanisa amagesi phakathi kwegazi nendawo ezungezile
question7: Kungani uhlangothi lwesobunxele lwenhliziyo yezilwane ezincelisayo lunemisipha eminingi kunohlangothi lwesokudla?
answer7: Uhlangothi lwesobunxele kumele lukhiqize ingcindezi eyanele yokupompa igazi kuwo wonke umzimba
distractor7a: Uhlangothi lwesobunxele lupompa igazi emaphashini aseduze kuphela
distractor7b: Uhlangothi lwesobunxele luqukethe amaseli amaningi akhiqiza umoya-mpilo
question8: Kungani uhlangothi lwesokudla lwenhliziyo lungenamisipha eminingi kunohlangothi lwesobunxele?
answer8: Kudingeka kuphela ukupompa igazi ibanga elifushane ukuya emaphashini
distractor8c: Ikhiqiza amangqamuzana abomvu egazi esikhundleni sokupompa igazi
question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 31.10. Qhathanisa imisebenzi nezakhiwo zamaseli egazi abomvu namhlophe
answer9: Amangqamuzana abomvu egazi awanazo izinhlayiya zegazi lapho esevuthiwe futhi aqukethe i-hemoglobin, esabalalisa umoya-mpilo kuwo wonke umzimba. Amangqamuzana amhlophe egazi ahileleke kakhulu ekusabeleni kwamasosha omzimba ukuze abone futhi ahlasele amagciwane. Anazo izinhlayiya zegazi futhi awanazo izinhlayiya zegazi zegazi.
distractor9a: Amangqamuzana abomvu egazi awanazo izinhlayiya zegazi lapho esevuthiwe futhi aqukethe i-hemoglobin, esabalalisa umoya-mpilo kuwo wonke umzimba. Amangqamuzana amhlophe egazi ahileleke kakhulu ekusabeleni kwamasosha omzimba ukuze abone futhi ahlasele amagciwane. Awanayo inhlayiya yegazi kanye ne-hemoglobin.
distractor9b: Amangqamuzana egazi abomvu aqukethe i-nuclei ne-hemoglobin, ehambisa umoya-mpilo kuwo wonke umzimba. Amangqamuzana egazi amhlophe ahileleke kakhulu ekusabeleni kwamasosha omzimba ukuze abone futhi ahlasele amagciwane. Awanayo i-nuclei ne-hemoglobin.
distractor9c: Amangqamuzana abomvu egazi awanazo izinhlayiya zegazi lapho esevuthiwe futhi aqukethe i-hemoglobin, ebandakanyeka ekusabeleni komzimba, esiza ekuboneni nasekuhlaseleni amagciwane. Amangqamuzana amhlophe egazi asakaza umoya-mpilo kuwo wonke umzimba. Anazo izinhlayiya zegazi futhi awanazo i-hemoglobin.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.3 Inhliziyo Yezilwane Ezincelisayo Nemithambo Yegazi | Isakhiwo Senhliziyo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.3 Mammalian Heart and Blood Vessels | Structure of the Heart
chapterContent:
Imisipha yenhliziyo ayilingani ngenxa yebanga igazi okumele lihambe ngalo kuma-pulmonary circuits kanye nama-systemic. Njengoba uhlangothi lwesokudla lwenhliziyo luthumela igazi kuma-pulmonary circuit, luncane kunohlangothi lwesobunxele okumele luthumele igazi kuwo wonke umzimba kuma-systemic circuit, njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 31.11. Kubantu, inhliziyo icishe ibe yingalo ecijile; ihlukaniswe ngamakamelo amane: i-atria ezimbili nama-ventricle amabili. Kukhona i-atrium eyodwa ne-ventricle eyodwa ohlangothini lwesokudla kanye ne-atrium eyodwa ne-ventricle eyodwa ohlangothini lwesobunxele. Ama-atria ngamakamelo athola igazi, kanti ama-ventricle angamakamelo ampompa igazi. I-atrium yesokudla ithola igazi elingenawo umoya-mpilo kusuka ku-vena cava ephezulu, ekhipha igazi kusuka emthanjeni we-jugular ovela ebuchosheni nasemithanjeni evela ezingalweni, kanye naku-vena cava engaphansi ekhipha igazi emithanjeni evela ezithweni ezingezansi nasemilenzeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-atrium yesokudla ithola igazi kusuka ku-coronary sinus ekhipha igazi elingenawo umoya-mpilo enhliziyweni uqobo. Leli gazi elingenawo umoya-mpilo lidlulela e-ventricle yesokudla nge-valve ye-atrioventricular noma i-valve ye-tricuspid, i-flap yezicubu ezixhumanisayo evuleka ohlangothini olulodwa kuphela ukuvimbela ukugeleza kwegazi emuva. I-valve ehlukanisa amakamelo ohlangothini lwesobunxele lwe-valve yenhliziyo ibizwa ngokuthi i-valve ye-biscuspid noma ye-mitral. Ngemva kokuthi igcwalisiwe, i-ventricle yesokudla ipompa igazi nge-valve ye-semilunar (noma i-valve ye-pulmonary noma i-pulmonary) iye emithanjeni yamaphaphu bese iye emaphashini ukuze iphinde ifake umoya-mpilo. Ngemva kokuba igazi lidlule emithanjeni yamaphaphu, ama-valve e-semilunar yesokudla ayavaleka avimbele igazi ukuthi ligeleze emuva liye e-ventricle yesokudla. I-atrium yesobunxele bese ithola igazi elicebile ngomoya-mpilo emaphashini ngemithambo yamaphaphu. Leli gazi lidlula nge-valve ye-bicuspid noma i-valve ye-mitral (i-valve ye-atrioventricular ohlangothini lwesobunxele lwenhliziyo) liye e-ventricle yesokudla lapho igazi likhishwa khona nge-aorta, umthambo omkhulu womzimba, uthatha igazi elinomoya-mpilo liye ezithweni nasemisipheni yomzimba. Uma igazi seliphumile liphuma kwi-ventricle yesobunxele liye kwi-aorta, i-aortic semilunar valve (noma i-aortic valve) iyavala ivimbele igazi ukuthi ligeleze libuyele emuva liye kwi-ventricle yesobunxele. Le ndlela yokupompa ibizwa ngokuthi ukujikeleza kabili futhi itholakala kuzo zonke izilwane ezincelisayo.

 Inhliziyo yakhiwe ngezingqimba ezintathu; i-epicardium, i-myocardium, kanye ne-endocardium, okuboniswe kuMfanekiso 31.11. Udonga lwangaphakathi lwenhliziyo lunolwelwesi olubizwa ngokuthi i-endocardium. I-myocardium yakhiwa amaseli emisipha yenhliziyo akha ulwelwesi oluphakathi kanye nenqwaba yodonga lwenhliziyo. Ulwelwesi lwangaphandle lwamaseli lubizwa ngokuthi i-epicardium, lapho ulwelwesi lwesibili luyisakhiwo esinezingqimba ezibizwa ngokuthi i-pericardium esizungezile futhi sivikele inhliziyo; sivumela indawo eyanele yokupompa ngamandla kodwa futhi sigcina inhliziyo isendaweni yayo ukuze kuncishiswe ukungqubuzana phakathi kwenhliziyo nezinye izakhiwo.

 Inhliziyo inemithambo yayo yegazi ehlinzeka ngegazi emsipheni wenhliziyo. Imithambo yenhliziyo isuka ku-aorta futhi izungeze ubuso benhliziyo njengomqhele. Ihlukana ibe ama-capillary lapho imisipha yenhliziyo inikezwa khona umoya-mpilo ngaphambi kokuba iphinde ihlangane emithanjeni yenhliziyo ukuze ithathe igazi elingenawo umoya-mpilo libuyele e-atrium kwesokudla lapho igazi lizophinde lifakwe umoya-mpilo ngesekethe yamaphaphu. Imisipha yenhliziyo izofa ngaphandle kokunikezwa kwegazi njalo. I-atherosclerosis ukuvaleka komthambo ngokuqongelela kwama-fatty plaque. Ngenxa yobukhulu (obuncane) bemithambo yenhliziyo kanye nomsebenzi wayo ekukhonzeni inhliziyo uqobo, i-atherosclerosis ingaba yingozi kule mithambo. Ukwehla kokugeleza kwegazi kanye nokuntuleka komoya-mpilo okulandelayo okubangelwa yi-atherosclerosis kubangela ubuhlungu obukhulu, okwaziwa ngokuthi i-angina, futhi ukuvaleka okuphelele kwemithambo kuzobangela i-myocardial infarction: ukufa kwezicubu zemisipha yenhliziyo, okwaziwa ngokuthi ukuhlaselwa yinhliziyo.
question1: Kungani uhlangothi lwesobunxele lwenhliziyo lukhulu futhi lunemisipha eminingi kunohlangothi lwesokudla?
answer1: Uhlangothi lwesobunxele lupompa igazi kuwo wonke umzimba ohlelweni lwesistimu, okudinga ingcindezi enkulu
distractor1a: Uhlangothi lwesobunxele lupompa igazi emaphashini aseduze kuphela
distractor1b: Uhlangothi lwesobunxele lukhiqiza amaseli abomvu egazi ukuze ajikeleze igazi
distractor1c: Uhlangothi lwesobunxele luthola igazi ngqo ezicutshini zomzimba
question2: Mangaki amakamelo atholakala enhliziyweni yomuntu?
answer2: Amakamelo amane: i-atria emibili kanye nama-ventricle amabili
distractor2a: Amakamelo amabili: i-atrium eyodwa kanye ne-ventricle eyodwa
distractor2b: Amakamelo amathathu: i-atria amabili kanye ne-ventricle eyodwa
distractor2c: Amakamelo amahlanu: i-atria emithathu kanye nama-ventricle amabili
question3: Uyini umsebenzi we-atria nama-ventricle enhliziyweni?
answer3: I-Atria ithola igazi, kuyilapho ama-ventricle epompa igazi
distractor3a: Igazi le-atria pump kanye nama-ventricle athola igazi
distractor3b: Kokubili i-atria nama-ventricle ashintshana ngamagesi kuphela
distractor3c: Kokubili i-atria kanye ne-ventricles kukhiqiza amaseli egazi
question4: Hlobo luni lwegazi olutholwa yi-atrium efanele?
answer4: Igazi elingenawo umoya-mpilo elibuya emzimbeni
distractor4b: Igazi elivela ngqo ohlelweni lokugaya ukudla kuphela
question5: Uyini umsebenzi wevalvu ye-tricuspid?
answer5: Ivumela igazi ukuthi lisuke ku-atrium efanele liye ku-ventricle efanele futhi ivimbele ukugeleza kwegazi emuva
distractor5a: Ipompa igazi lisuka ku-ventricle yesobunxele liye ku-aorta
distractor5b: Ivumela igazi ukuthi ligeleze libuyele emuva liye e-atrium
question6: Igazi elivela kwi-ventricle yesokudla lihamba kuphi ngemva kokudlula kwivalvu yamaphaphu?
answer6: Kuye emithanjeni yamaphaphu bese kuba emaphashini ukuze kubuyiselwe umoya-mpilo
question7: Iyini indlela yegazi elinomoya-mpilo omningi ngemva kokuba libuyile emaphashini?
answer7: Imithambo yamaphaphu → i-atrium yesobunxele → i-valve ye-mitral → i-ventricle yesobunxele → i-aorta
distractor7a: Imithambo yegazi yamaphaphu → i-atrium yangakwesokudla → ivalvu ye-tricuspid → i-aorta
distractor7b: I-Vena cava → i-ventricle yesobunxele → imithambo yamaphaphu → amaphaphu
distractor7c: I-Aorta → i-ventricle yesokudla → imithambo yamaphaphu → amaphaphu
question8: Yiziphi izingqimba ezintathu zodonga lwenhliziyo?
answer8: I-Epicardium, i-myocardium, kanye ne-endocardium
question9: Uyini umsebenzi we-pericardium ezungeze inhliziyo?
answer9: Ivikela inhliziyo, iyigcine isendaweni yayo, futhi inciphisa ukungqubuzana ngenkathi ivumela ukunyakaza ngesikhathi sokupompa
question10: Bheka uMfanekiso 31.11. I-Plasma ne-serum amagama avamile. Womabili ayizingxenye ezibalulekile zegazi. Uyini umehluko phakathi kwe-plasma yegazi ne-serum yegazi?
answer10: I-plasma yegazi yenziwe nge-serum yegazi nezinye izingxenye. I-serum yingxenye ye-plasma engenazo izinto ezibangela ukujiya kwegazi
distractor10a: I-plasma yegazi yakhiwe yi-serum yegazi nezinye izingxenye. I-serum yingxenye ye-plasma equkethe izinto ezibangela ukujiya kwegazi
distractor10b: I-serum yegazi yakhiwe yi-plasma yegazi nezinye izingxenye. I-plasma yingxenye ye-serum equkethe izinto ezibangela ukujiya kwegazi
distractor10c: I-plasma yegazi yakhiwe yi-serum yegazi nezinye izingxenye. I-serum yingxenye ye-plasma engenawo ama-antibodies nama-hormone.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.3 Inhliziyo Nemithambo Yegazi Yezilwane Ezincelisayo | Umjikelezo Wenhliziyo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.3 Mammalian Heart and Blood Vessels | The Cardiac Cycle
chapterContent:
Inhloso eyinhloko yenhliziyo ukupompa igazi emzimbeni; lokhu kwenza ngokulandelana okuphindaphindiwe okubizwa ngokuthi umjikelezo wenhliziyo. Umjikelezo wenhliziyo ukuhlanganisa ukugcwaliswa nokuthululwa kwegazi enhliziyweni ngezibonakaliso zikagesi ezibangela ukuba imisipha yenhliziyo ifinyele futhi iphumule. Inhliziyo yomuntu ishaya izikhathi ezingaphezu kuka-100,000 ngosuku. Kuwo wonke umjikelezo wenhliziyo, inhliziyo iyafinyela (i-systole), ikhiphe igazi bese ilipompa emzimbeni; lokhu kulandelwa isigaba sokuphumula (i-diastole), lapho inhliziyo igcwalisa khona igazi, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 31.12. I-atria iyafinyela ngesikhathi esifanayo, iphoqa igazi ngamavalvu e-atrioventricular liye kuma-ventricles. Ukuvalwa kwamavalvu e-atrioventricular kukhiqiza umsindo we-monosyllabic lup”. Ngemva kokulibaziseka isikhashana, ama-ventricles ayafinyela ngesikhathi esifanayo ephoqa igazi ngamavalvu e-semilunar liye ku-aorta kanye nomthambo othutha igazi liye emaphashini (ngomthambo wamaphaphu). Ukuvalwa kwamavalvu e-semilunar kukhiqiza umsindo we-monosyllabic dup”. Ukupompa kwenhliziyo kungumsebenzi wamaseli emisipha yenhliziyo, noma ama-cardiomyocyte, akha imisipha yenhliziyo. Ama-cardiomyocyte, aboniswe kuMfanekiso 31.13, angamaseli emisipha ahlukile ahlelwe njengemisipha yamathambo kodwa ampompa ngesigqi nangokungazithandeli njengemisipha ebushelelezi; axhunywe ngama-disk ahlanganisiwe akhethekile emisipha yenhliziyo. Azivuselela isikhathi esithile futhi ama-cardiomyocyte ahlukanisiwe azoshaya uma enikezwe ibhalansi efanele yezakhamzimba nama-electrolyte.

 Ukushaya okuzenzakalelayo kwamaseli emisipha yenhliziyo kulawulwa yi-pacemaker yangaphakathi yenhliziyo esebenzisa izimpawu zikagesi ukuze ibeke isikhathi sokushaya kwenhliziyo. Izimpawu zikagesi kanye nezenzo zomshini, eziboniswe kuMfanekiso 31.14, zixhumene kakhulu. I-pacemaker yangaphakathi iqala ku-node ye-sinoatrial (SA), etholakala eduze kodonga lwe-atrium yangakwesokudla. Amacala kagesi ashaya ngokuzenzakalelayo kusuka ku-node ye-SA okwenza ama-atria amabili anciphe kanyekanye. I-pulse ifinyelela i-node yesibili, ebizwa ngokuthi i-atrioventricular (AV), phakathi kwe-atrium yangakwesokudla kanye ne-ventricle yangakwesokudla lapho ima khona cishe umzuzwana ongu-0.1 ngaphambi kokusabalala ezindongeni zama-ventricle. Kusukela ku-node ye-AV, i-electrical impulse ingena eqoqweni le-His, bese iya emagatsheni e-bundle yesobunxele neyakwesokudla adlula nge-septum ye-interventricular. Ekugcineni, imicu ye-Purkinje iqhuba i-impulse isuka esiqongweni senhliziyo iye phezulu ku-myocardium ye-ventricular, bese ama-ventricle eqina. Lokhu kuphumula kuvumela i-atria ukuthi ithulule ngokuphelele kuma-ventricle ngaphambi kokuba ama-ventricle akhiphe igazi. I-electrical impulses enhliziyweni ikhiqiza imisinga kagesi egeleza emzimbeni futhi ingalinganiswa esikhumbeni kusetshenziswa ama-electrode. Lolu lwazi lungabonakala njenge-electrocardiogram (ECG)—ukuqoshwa kwe-electrical impulses yemisipha yenhliziyo.

 Bheka Umfanekiso 31.15. I-echocardiogram (ECG) iyi-ultrasound yenhliziyo esetshenziselwa ukunquma ukuthi ama-valve enhliziyo nemisipha isebenza kahle yini. Kulesi sithombe, wonke amakamelo amane enhliziyo angabonakala
question1: Iyini injongo eyinhloko yomjikelezo wenhliziyo?
answer1: Ukuhlanganisa ukugcwaliswa nokuthululwa kwenhliziyo njengoba ipompa igazi emzimbeni
question2: Kwenzekani ngesikhathi se-systole?
answer2: Inhliziyo iyafinyela futhi ikhiphe igazi emzimbeni
question3: Kwenzekani ngesikhathi se-diastole?
answer3: Inhliziyo iyaphumula futhi igcwale igazi
question4: Yini ebangela umsindo wokuqala wenhliziyo, ovame ukuchazwa ngokuthi i-lup”?
answer4: Ukuvalwa kwamavalvu e-atrioventricular
question5: Yini ebangela umsindo wesibili wenhliziyo, ovame ukuchazwa ngokuthi i-dup”?
answer5: Ukuvalwa kwamavalvu e-semilunar
question6: Ayini ama-cardiomyocytes?
answer6: Amaseli emisipha yenhliziyo akhethekile afinyela ngesigqi nangokungazithandeli
question7: Ama-cardiomyocyte ahluke kanjani kumaseli emisipha abushelelezi namathambo?
answer7: Zinemisipha efana nemisipha yamathambo kodwa zifinyela ngesigqi nangokungazithandi njengemisipha ebushelelezi
distractor7a: Azinawo wonke umsebenzi kagesi futhi azikwazi ukufinyela
distractor7b: Azinazo izintambo futhi zilawulwa ngokuzithandela kuphela
question8: Iyini indima ye-sinoatrial node (SA) enhliziyweni?
answer8: Isebenza njenge-pacemaker yangaphakathi eqala ama-pulse kagesi abangela ukufinyela kwe-atrial
question9: Kungani isignali kagesi ima kancane ku-node ye-atrioventricular (AV)?
answer9: Ukuvumela i-atria ukuthi ithulule ngokuphelele kuma-ventricles ngaphambi kokufinyela kwe-ventricle
question10: Yiluphi ulwazi olulinganiswa nge-electrocardiogram (ECG)?
answer10: Imizwa kagesi ebangelwa umsebenzi wemisipha yenhliziyo
distractor10a: Inani lomoya-mpilo othwalwa amangqamuzana egazi abomvu

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.3 Inhliziyo Nemithambo Yegazi Yezilwane Ezincelisayo | Imithambo Yegazi, Imithambo Yegazi, Nama-Capillaries
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.3 Mammalian Heart and Blood Vessels | Arteries, Veins, and Capillaries
chapterContent:
Igazi elivela enhliziyweni lithwalwa emzimbeni ngenethiwekhi eyinkimbinkimbi yemithambo yegazi (Isithombe 31.16). Imithambo yegazi isusa igazi enhliziyweni. Umthambo oyinhloko yi-aorta ehlukana ibe yimithambo emikhulu ehambisa igazi iye ezithweni nasezithweni ezahlukene. Le mithambo emikhulu ihlanganisa umthambo we-carotid ohambisa igazi ebuchosheni, imithambo ye-brachial ehambisa igazi ezingalweni, kanye nomthambo we-thoracic ohambisa igazi esifubeni bese ungena emithanjeni yesibindi, yezinso, neyesisu yesibindi, izinso, kanye nesisu, ngokulandelana. Umthambo we-iliac uthatha igazi liye ezithweni ezingezansi. Imithambo emikhulu ihlukana ibe yimithambo emincane, bese kuba yimithambo emincane ebizwa ngokuthi ama-arterioles, ukuze ifinyelele ngokujulile emisipheni nasezithweni zomzimba.

 Ama-arterioles ahlukana abe yimibhede ye-capillary. Imibhede ye-capillary iqukethe inani elikhulu (10 kuya ku-100) lama-capillary ahlangana phakathi kwamaseli nezicubu zomzimba. Ama-capillary angamapayipi amancane angangena amangqamuzana abomvu egazi ngendlela eyodwa futhi ayizindawo zokushintshana kwezakhamzimba, imfucuza, kanye nomoya-mpilo nezicubu ezingeni lamaseli. Uketshezi luphinde luwele esikhaleni esiphakathi kwama-capillary. Ama-capillary aphinde ahlangane abe ama-venule axhuma emithanjeni emincane ekugcineni exhuma emithanjeni emikhulu ethatha igazi elinomoya-mpilo omningi libuyele enhliziyweni. Imithambo yegazi iyimithambo yegazi ebuyisela igazi enhliziyweni. Imithambo emikhulu ikhipha igazi ezithweni nasemalungeni afanayo anikezwa yimithambo emikhulu. Uketshezi luphinde lubuyiselwe enhliziyweni ngohlelo lwe-lymphatic.

 Isakhiwo sezinhlobo ezahlukene zemithambo yegazi sibonisa umsebenzi wazo noma izendlalelo. Kunezendlalelo ezintathu ezihlukile, noma ama-tunic, akha izindonga zemithambo yegazi (Isithombe 31.17). I-tunic yokuqala iyindwangu ebushelelezi, engaphakathi yamaseli e-endothelial axhumana namaseli abomvu egazi. I-tunic ye-endothelial iqhubeka ne-endocardium yenhliziyo. Kuma-capillary, lolu ngqimba olulodwa lwamaseli luyindawo lapho kusabalala khona umoya-mpilo kanye ne-carbon dioxide phakathi kwamaseli e-endothelial kanye namaseli abomvu egazi, kanye nendawo yokushintshana nge-endocytosis kanye ne-exocytosis. Ukuhamba kwezinto endaweni yama-capillary kulawulwa yi-vasoconstriction, ukuncipha kwemithambo yegazi, kanye ne-vasodilation, ukwanda kwemithambo yegazi; lokhu kubalulekile ekulawulweni okuphelele komfutho wegazi.

 Imithambo yegazi kanye nemithambo yegazi zombili zineminye imicu emibili ezungeze i-endothelium: i-tunic ephakathi yakhiwe yimisipha ebushelelezi kanti ungqimba olungaphandle luyizicubu ezixhumanisayo (i-collagen kanye nemicu ethambile). Izicubu ezixhumanisayo ezinwebekayo ziyanwebeka futhi zisekele imithambo yegazi, kanti ungqimba lwemisipha olubushelelezi lusiza ukulawula ukugeleza kwegazi ngokushintsha ukumelana kwemithambo yegazi ngokusebenzisa i-vasoconstriction kanye ne-vasodilation. Imithambo yegazi inemisipha ebushelelezi ejiyile kanye nezicubu ezixhumanisayo kunemithambo yegazi ukuze ivumelane nokucindezela okuphezulu kanye nesivinini segazi elisanda kupompa. Imithambo yegazi iboshwe ngodonga oluncane njengoba ukucindezela kanye nesivinini sokugeleza kuphansi kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imithambo yegazi ihlukile ngokwesakhiwo kunemithambo yegazi ngoba imithambo yegazi inama-valve okuvimbela ukugeleza kwegazi emuva. Ngenxa yokuthi imithambo yegazi kufanele isebenze ngokumelene namandla adonsela phansi ukuze igazi libuyele enhliziyweni, ukufinyela kwemisipha yamathambo kusiza ekugelezeni kwegazi libuyele enhliziyweni.
question1: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wemithambo yegazi?
answer1: Ukuthwala igazi lisuke enhliziyweni
question2: Yimuphi umthambo omkhulu kunayo yonke emzimbeni womuntu?
answer2: I-aorta
question3: Uyini umsebenzi wama-capillary?
answer3: Zivumela ukushintshaniswa komoya-mpilo, izakhamzimba, kanye nokungcola phakathi kwegazi nezicubu
distractor3c: Zithwala i-carbon dioxide kuphela ziyise emaphashini
question4: Kungani amangqamuzana abomvu egazi engadlula kuma-capillaries ngefayela elilodwa kuphela?
answer4: Ama-capillary anobubanzi obuncane kakhulu amamitha
distractor4a: Amaseli abomvu egazi aba makhulu ngaphakathi kwama-capillary
distractor4b: Ama-capillary aqukethe ama-valve avimbela ukuhamba kwegazi
question5: Iyiphi indlela efanele yokugeleza kwegazi kusuka emithanjeni kuya emithanjeni?
answer5: Imithambo → ama-arterioles → imibhede yama-capillary → ama-venule → imithambo
distractor5c: Ama-capillaries → imithambo yegazi → imithambo yegazi → ama-arterioles
question6: Kuyini ukuvaleka kwemithambo yegazi?
answer6: Ukuncipha kwemithambo yegazi okusiza ukulawula ukugeleza kwegazi kanye nomfutho wegazi
question7: Kuyini ukuvaleka kwemithambo yegazi?
answer7: Ukwanda kwemithambo yegazi okusiza ukulawula ukugeleza kwegazi kanye nomfutho wegazi
question8: Yiziphi izendlalelo ezintathu, noma ama-tunic, odonga lwemithambo yegazi?
answer8: I-endothelial tunic, i-smooth muscle middle tunic, kanye nesendlalelo sangaphandle sezicubu ezixhumeneyo
distractor8b: Ingqimba ye-plasma, ungqimba lwe-platelet, kanye nengqimba yamaseli abomvu egazi
distractor8c: Ingqimba yemithambo yegazi, ungqimba lwemithambo yegazi, kanye nongqimba lwe-lymphatic
question9: Kungani imithambo yegazi inezindonga ezijiyile kunemithambo yegazi?
answer9: Imithambo yegazi ithwala igazi ngomfutho ophezulu nangesivinini esikhulu lisuka enhliziyweni
distractor9a: Imithambo yegazi iqukethe igazi elincane kunemithambo yegazi
distractor9b: Imithambo yegazi kumele ivimbele umoya-mpilo ukuthi ungangeni ezicutshini
question10: Kungani imithambo iqukethe ama-valve?
answer10: Ukuvimbela ukugeleza kwegazi emuva njengoba libuyela enhliziyweni
distractor10a: Ukwandisa umfutho wegazi ophuma enhliziyweni

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.4 Ukugeleza Kwegazi Nokulawulwa Komfutho Wegazi | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.4 Blood Flow and Blood Pressure Regulation | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ulwazi olukulesi sigaba alukho ngaphakathi kwesilinganiso se-AP®. Kodwa-ke, ukushintshaniswa komoya-mpilo kanye ne-carbon dioxide emibhedeni yama-capillary kuyindlela yokusabalalisa, into esiyihlolile ngokuningiliziwe esahlukweni esidlule. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngenxa yokuthi abantu abaningi bahlushwa umfutho wegazi ophakeme, ovame ukubizwa ngokuthi umbulali othule,” ungase ukuthole kuwusizo ukwazi ukuthi umfutho wegazi ulawulwa kanjani nokuthi kungani ukuntuleka komthethonqubo ofanele kuyingozi.

 Umfutho wegazi (BP) umfutho wegazi okhishwa yizindonga zomthambo wegazi osiza ukusunduza igazi emzimbeni. Umfutho wegazi we-Systolic ulinganisa inani lomfutho wegazi eliwenzayo emithanjeni yegazi ngenkathi inhliziyo ishaya. Umfutho wegazi we-systolic ofanele kakhulu ngu-120 mm Hg. Umfutho wegazi we-Diastolic ulinganisa umfutho emithanjeni yegazi phakathi kokushaya kwenhliziyo. Umfutho wegazi we-diastolic ofanele kakhulu ngu-80 mm Hg. Izinto eziningi zingathinta umfutho wegazi, njenge-hormone, ukucindezeleka, ukuvivinya umzimba, ukudla, ukuhlala phansi, nokuma. Ukugeleza kwegazi emzimbeni kulawulwa ubukhulu bemithambo yegazi, ngesenzo semisipha ebushelelezi, ngama-valve aqondene ne-one-way, kanye nomfutho wegazi uqobo.
question1: Kuyini umfutho wegazi?
answer1: Ingcindezi ekhishwa yigazi ezindongeni zemithambo yegazi
distractor1a: Ingcindezi ebangelwa ukufinyela kwemisipha yenhliziyo kuphela
question2: Iyini isilinganiso somfutho wegazi we-systolic?
answer2: Ingcindezi yegazi iyasebenza emithanjeni yegazi ngenkathi inhliziyo ishaya
distractor2a: Ingcindezi emithanjeni yegazi phakathi kokushaya kwenhliziyo
distractor2b: Inani lomoya-mpilo ogcinwe emangqamuzaneni abomvu egazi
question3: Iyini i-diastolic blood pressure elinganiswayo?
answer3: Ingcindezi emithanjeni yegazi phakathi kokushaya kwenhliziyo
question4: Yiziphi izindinganiso zomfutho wegazi we-systolic kanye ne-diastolic ezibhekwa njengezingcono kakhulu?
answer4: I-systolic engu-120 mm Hg kanye ne-diastolic engu-80 mm Hg
distractor4a: I-systolic engu-80 mm Hg kanye ne-diastolic engu-120 mm Hg
distractor4b: I-systolic engu-150 mm Hg kanye ne-diastolic engu-100 mm Hg
distractor4c: I-systolic engu-60 mm Hg kanye ne-diastolic engu-40 mm Hg
question5: Kungani umfutho wegazi ophakeme uvame ukubizwa ngokuthi umbulali othule?
answer5: Kungalimaza umzimba ngaphandle kwezimpawu ezisobala futhi kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu zempilo
distractor5a: Kuvimbela igazi ukuthi lingangeni enhliziyweni ngokushesha
distractor5b: Kubangela ukuba yonke imithambo yegazi inyamalale
distractor5c: Kumisa ngokuphelele ukuthuthwa komoya-mpilo emangqamuzaneni abomvu egazi
question6: Yiziphi izinto ezingathinta umfutho wegazi?
answer6: Ama-hormone, ukucindezeleka, ukuvivinya umzimba, ukudla, ukuhlala, nokuma
distractor6a: Ukushisa komzimba kanye nohlobo lwegazi kuphela
question7: Ukugeleza kwegazi emzimbeni kulawulwa kanjani?
answer7: Ngosayizi wemithambo yegazi, ukusebenza kwemisipha ebushelelezi, ama-valve ahamba ngakwesokudla, kanye nomfutho wegazi ophakeme
distractor7c: Kuphela ngohlelo lokugaya ukudla olumunca izakhamzimba
question8: Imisipha ebushelelezi emithanjeni yegazi isiza kanjani ekulawuleni ukugeleza kwegazi?
answer8: Zishintsha ububanzi bemithambo yegazi ngokusebenzisa ukuvaleka kwemithambo yegazi kanye nokwanda kwemithambo yegazi yegazi
distractor8a: Bakhiqiza amaseli egazi ngaphakathi kwemithambo yegazi
distractor8c: Zivimbela konke ukuhamba kwegazi emithanjeni yegazi

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.4 Ukugeleza Kwegazi Nokulawulwa Komfutho Wegazi | Indlela Igazi Eligeleza Ngayo Emzimbeni
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.4 Blood Flow and Blood Pressure Regulation | How Blood Flows Through the Body
chapterContent:
Igazi liphushwa emzimbeni ngesenzo senhliziyo epompayo. Ngephampu ngayinye enesigqi, igazi liphushwa ngaphansi kokucindezela okuphezulu kanye nesivinini kude nenhliziyo, ekuqaleni lihambisana nomthambo omkhulu, i-aorta. Ku-aorta, igazi lihamba ngama-30 cm /sec. Njengoba igazi lingena emithanjeni, kuma-arterioles, futhi ekugcineni liye emibhedeni yama-capillary, izinga lokunyakaza liyehla kakhulu lifinyelele cishe ku-0.026 cm /sec, okuphindwe kayinkulungwane kunezinga lokunyakaza ku-aorta. Ngenkathi ububanzi be-arteriole ngayinye kanye ne-capillary buncane kakhulu kunobubanzi be-aorta, futhi ngokomthetho wokuqhubeka, uketshezi kufanele luhambe ngokushesha ngepayipi elincane lobubanzi, izinga empeleni lihamba kancane ngenxa yokuthi ububanzi bonke bama-capillary ahlanganisiwe bukhulu kakhulu kunobubanzi be-aorta ngayinye.

 Izinga lokuhamba kancane emibhedeni yama-capillary, efinyelela cishe kuwo wonke amaseli emzimbeni, lisiza ngokushintshana kwegesi nezakhamzimba futhi likhuthaza ukusabalala koketshezi esikhaleni esiphakathi. Ngemva kokuba igazi selidlule emibhedeni yama-capillary liye kuma-venule, emithanjeni, futhi ekugcineni liye kwi-venae cavae eyinhloko, izinga lokuhamba liyanda futhi kodwa lisephansi kakhulu kunezinga lokuqala ku-aorta. Igazi lihamba kakhulu emithanjeni ngokuhamba okunesisindo kwemisipha ebushelelezi odongeni lwemithambo yegazi kanye nokusebenza kwemisipha yamathambo njengoba umzimba uhamba. Ngenxa yokuthi imithambo eminingi kumele ihambise igazi ngokumelene nokudonswa kwamandla adonsela phansi, igazi livinjelwa ukuthi ligeleze emuva emithanjeni ngama-valve ahamba ngendlela eyodwa. Ngenxa yokuthi ukufinyela kwemisipha yamathambo kusiza ekugelezeni kwegazi emithanjeni, kubalulekile ukuvuka nokunyakaza njalo ngemva kwesikhathi eside sokuhlala ukuze igazi lingahlangani emaphethelweni.

 Ukugeleza kwegazi emibhedeni yama-capillary kulawulwa kuye ngezidingo zomzimba futhi kuqondiswa izimpawu zemizwa nama-hormone. Isibonelo, ngemva kokudla okukhulu, iningi legazi lidluliselwa esiswini ngokuvasa imithambo yegazi yesistimu yokugaya ukudla kanye nokuvasa imithambo yegazi yeminye imithambo yegazi. Ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca, igazi lidluliselwa emisipheni yamathambo ngokuvasa imithambo yegazi ngenkathi igazi liye ohlelweni lokugaya ukudla lizoncishiswa ngokuvasa imithambo yegazi. Igazi elingena emibhedeni ethile ye-capillary lilawulwa yimisipha emincane, ebizwa ngokuthi ama-precapillary sphincters, okuboniswe kuMfanekiso 31.18. Uma ama-sphincters evulekile, igazi lizogeleza emagatsheni ahlobene egazi le-capillary. Uma wonke ama-sphincters evaliwe, khona-ke igazi lizogeleza ngqo lisuka ku-arteriole liye ku-venule ngomzila we-thoroughfare (bheka uMfanekiso 31.18). Le misipha ivumela umzimba ukuthi ulawule ngokunembile ukuthi imibhede ye-capillary ithola nini ukugeleza kwegazi. Nganoma yisiphi isikhathi cishe ama-5-10% emibhedeni yethu ye-capillary empeleni anegazi eligeleza kuyo.

 Amaprotheni nezinye izinto ezinkulu ezincibilikayo azikwazi ukuphuma kuma-capillary. Ukulahleka kwe-plasma enamanzi kudala isixazululo se-hyperosmotic ngaphakathi kwama-capillary, ikakhulukazi eduze kwama-venule. Lokhu kubangela cishe u-85% we-plasma eshiya ama-capillary ukuze ekugcineni asakazeke abuyele kuma-capillary eduze kwama-venule. U-15% osele we-plasma yegazi uphuma oketshezini lwe-interstitial uye emithanjeni ye-lymphatic eseduze (Isithombe 31.19). Uketshezi oluku-lymph lufana ngokwakheka noketshezi lwe-interstitial. Uketshezi lwe-lymph ludlula kuma-lymph node ngaphambi kokuba lubuyele enhliziyweni nge-vena cava ephezulu. Ama-lymph node yizitho ezikhethekile ezihlunga i-lymph ngokubhoboza nge-maze yezicubu ezixhumene ezigcwele amangqamuzana egazi amhlophe. Amangqamuzana amhlophe egazi asusa izinto ezithathelwanayo, njengebhaktheriya namagciwane, ukuze ahlanze i-lymph ngaphambi kokuba ibuyele egazini. Ngemva kokuba ihlanziwe, i-lymph ibuyela enhliziyweni ngesenzo sokupompa kwemisipha ebushelelezi, ukusebenza kwemisipha yamathambo, kanye nama-valve ahamba ngendlela eyodwa ajoyina igazi elibuyayo eduze kokuhlangana kwe-venae cavae engena ku-atrium efanele yenhliziyo.
question1: Inhliziyo ihambisa kanjani igazi emzimbeni?
answer1: Inhliziyo ipompa igazi ngaphansi kokucindezeleka okuphezulu kanye nesivinini emithanjeni yegazi
distractor1a: Inhliziyo ivumela igazi ukuthi lihambe kuphela ngokusabalala
distractor1c: Imisipha yamathambo ikhiqiza konke ukunyakaza kwegazi
question2: Igazi lihamba ngokushesha kangakanani nge-aorta?
answer2: Cishe 30 cm /sec
question3: Kungani igazi lihamba kancane kakhulu emibhedeni ye-capillary kunase-aorta?
answer3: Indawo ehlanganisiwe ye-cross-section yawo wonke ama-capillary inkulu kakhulu kune-aorta, okunciphisa ukugeleza kwegazi jikelele.
distractor3a: Ama-capillary anezindonga ezijiyile ezivimba ukuhamba kwegazi
distractor3c: Amaseli abomvu egazi awakwazi ukungena kuma-capillaries
question4: Kungani ukuhamba kwegazi kancane kancane emibhedeni yama-capillary kuzuzisa?
answer4: Ivumela isikhathi sokushintshana kwegesi, izakhamzimba, kanye noketshezi phakathi kwegazi nezicubu
distractor4a: Kuvimbela umoya-mpilo ukuthi ungafiki emangqamuzaneni omzimba
distractor4c: Kwenyusa umfutho wegazi kuzo zonke izicubu
question5: Igazi lihamba kanjani ngokuyinhloko emithanjeni?
answer5: Ngokufinyela kwemisipha ebushelelezi ezindongeni zemithambo yegazi kanye nokunyakaza kwemisipha yamathambo
distractor5b: Ngokusebenzisa amangqamuzana abomvu egazi asunduza izindonga zemithambo yegazi
question6: Kungani imithambo inezivikelo eziya ohlangothini olulodwa?
answer6: Ukuvimbela ukugeleza kwegazi emuva njengoba libuyela enhliziyweni ngokumelene namandla adonsela phansi
question7: Umzimba ulawula kanjani ukugeleza kwegazi emibhedeni ehlukene yama-capillary?
answer7: Ngezimpawu zemizwa nama-hormone ezilawula ukuvuvukala kwemithambo yegazi kanye nokuvaleka kwemithambo yegazi
question8: Kwenzekani ekugelezeni kwegazi ngemva kokudla okukhulu?
answer8: Igazi liqondiswa ohlelweni lokugaya ukudla ngokuvula imithambo yegazi yokugaya ukudla
distractor8a: Igazi liqondiswa kude nohlelo lokugaya ukudla ngokusebenzisa i-vasoconstriction
distractor8b: Ukugeleza kwegazi kuyama kuze kube yilapho ukugaya sekuqediwe
question9: Uyini umsebenzi wama-sphincters angaphambi kwe-capillary?
answer9: Balawula ukuthi igazi liyangena yini emibhedeni ethile yama-capillary
distractor9b: Zivimbela lonke igazi ukuthi lingangeni emithanjeni
question10: Bheka Umfanekiso 31.18. Imithambo yegazi ihluke kanjani emithanjeni yegazi?
answer10: Imithambo inezingqimba zemisipha ezibushelelezi ezijiyile ukuze zivumelane nezinguquko ekucindezelweni okuvela enhliziyweni
distractor10a: Imithambo yegazi ithwala i-plasma
distractor10b: Imithambo inezingqimba zemisipha ezibushelelezi ezincane kanye nama-valve futhi ihambisa igazi ngesenzo semisipha yamathambo.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.4 Ukugeleza Kwegazi Nokulawulwa Komfutho Wegazi | Ukuhlukahluka Kwamathambo Ekujikelezeni Kwegazi
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.4 Blood Flow and Blood Pressure Regulation | Vertebrate Diversity in Blood Circulation
chapterContent:
Ukujikeleza kwegazi kuye kwashintsha ngendlela ehlukile ezilwaneni ezinomgogodla futhi kungabonisa ukwehluka ezilwaneni ezahlukene ngenani elidingekayo lokucindezela, indawo yezitho kanye nemithambo yegazi, kanye nosayizi wezitho. Izilwane ezinezintamo ezinde kanye nalezo ezihlala ezindaweni ezibandayo zinezindlela ezihlukile zokushintsha umfutho wegazi.

 Izilwane ezinentamo ende, njengezindlulamithi, zidinga ukupompa igazi phezulu lisuka enhliziyweni ngokumelene namandla adonsela phansi. Umfutho wegazi odingekayo kusukela ekupompeni kwe-ventricle yesobunxele ungalingana no-250 mm Hg (mm Hg = milli amamitha we-mercury, iyunithi yokucindezela) ukuze kufinyelelwe ukuphakama kwekhanda lendlulamithi, okuphakeme ngama-2.5 amamitha kunenhliziyo. Kodwa-ke, uma ukuhlolwa nokulinganisela bekungekho endaweni, lo mfutho wegazi ubungalimaza ubuchopho bendlulamithi, ikakhulukazi uma igoba ukuze iphuze. Lokhu kuhlolwa nokulinganisela kufaka phakathi ama-valve kanye nezindlela zokuphendula ezinciphisa izinga lokukhishwa kwenhliziyo. Ama-dinosaur anentamo ende njengama-sauropods kwakudingeka aphompe igazi phezulu nakakhulu, kuze kufike ku-10 amamitha ngaphezu kwenhliziyo. Lokhu bekuzodinga umfutho wegazi ongaphezu kuka-600 mm Hg, okwakungafezwa yinhliziyo enkulu kuphela. Abukho ubufakazi benhliziyo enkulu kangaka futhi izindlela zokunciphisa umfutho wegazi ezidingekayo zifaka phakathi ukwehla kokusetshenziswa kwezakhi zofuzo njengoba lezi zilwane zikhula zikhula. Kungenzeka ukuthi azizange zidle njalo eziqongweni zezihlahla kodwa zazidla phansi.

 Njengoba zihlala emanzini abandayo, imikhomo idinga ukugcina izinga lokushisa egazini layo. Lokhu kufezwa yimithambo yegazi nemithambo yegazi esondelene ukuze kwenzeke ukushintshana kokushisa. Le ndlela ibizwa ngokuthi i-countercurrent heat exchanger. Imithambo yegazi nomzimba wonke nakho kuvikelwa yizingqimba ezinkulu zama-bulber ukuvimbela ukulahleka kokushisa. Ezilwaneni zasezweni ezihlala ezindaweni ezibandayo, uboya obukhulu kanye nokulala ebusuku kusetshenziswa ukugcina ukushisa kanye nokunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwezakhi zofuzo.
question1: Kungani izinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi zezilwane ezinomgogodla zihluka phakathi kwezilwane ezahlukene?
answer1: Bathuthukise izindlela ezahlukene zokuzivumelanisa nezimo ukuze bahlangabezane nezidingo zokucindezela, indawo yezitho zomzimba, kanye nosayizi womzimba.
distractor1a: Zonke izilwane ezinethambo lomgogodla zinezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ezifanayo kungakhathaliseki indawo ezikuyo
distractor1b: Izinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ziyahlukahluka kuphela ngenxa yokwehluka kombala wegazi
question2: Kungani izindlulamithi zidinga umfutho wegazi ophakeme?
answer2: Kudingeka bapompe igazi phezulu lisuka enhliziyweni liye ebuchosheni ngokumelene namandla adonsela phansi
distractor2a: Kudingeka bathuthe igazi lisuka ebuchosheni liye emaphashini kuphela
distractor2b: Kudingeka bavimbele umoya-mpilo ukuthi ungangeni ebuchosheni
distractor2c: Kudingeka banciphise ukugeleza kwegazi entanyeni yabo ende
question3: Yimuphi umfutho wegazi odingekayo ukuze inhliziyo yendlulamithi ikwazi ukupompa igazi ekhanda layo?
answer3: Cishe 250 mm Hg
question4: Kungani umfutho wegazi ophakeme kakhulu ungaba yingozi endlini yendlulamithi?
answer4: Kungalimaza ubuchopho, ikakhulukazi uma indlulamithi igoba ukuze iphuze
question5: Yiziphi izindlela zokuzivumelanisa nezimo ezisiza izindlulamithi ukulawula umfutho wegazi?
answer5: Ama-valve kanye nezindlela zokuphendula ezinciphisa ukuphuma kwenhliziyo
distractor5a: Ukususa yonke imithambo yegazi eduze kobuchopho
distractor5c: Ukuvimba ukujikeleza kwegazi lapho isilwane sigoba
question6: Kungani ama-dinosaur anentamo ende njengama-sauropod ayedinga umfutho wegazi ophakeme kakhulu?
answer6: Kwakudingeka bapompe igazi lifike ezindaweni eziphakeme ezingafika kumamitha ayishumi ngaphezu kwenhliziyo
distractor6a: Kwakudingeka bathuthe igazi liye emaphashini kuphela
question7: Imikhomo iwagcina kanjani amazinga okushisa egazi ezindaweni ezibandayo zamanzi?
answer7: Ngokusebenzisa i-heat exchanger ephikisanayo lapho imithambo yegazi nemithambo yegazi eseduze kushintshana khona ukushisa
distractor7a: Ngokwandisa umfutho wegazi kuze kufike emazingeni aphezulu
question8: Iyiphi indima edlalwa ama-blubber emikhomeni?
answer8: Ihlinzeka ngokuvikela futhi inciphisa ukulahleka kokushisa
question9: Izilwane zasemhlabeni ezindaweni ezibandayo zilondoloza kanjani ukushisa?
answer9: Zisebenzisa ukuzivumelanisa nezimo njengoboya obukhulu kanye nokulala isikhathi eside ukuze zigcine ukushisa futhi zinciphise ukusetshenziswa kwe-metabolism
distractor9a: Zandisa ukulahleka kwegazi ukuze kwehliswe izinga lokushisa
distractor9c: Bayayeka ukusebenzisa umoya-mpilo ngesikhathi sokusetshenziswa kwe-metabolism
question10: Inhliziyo yohlobo lwesilwane esincelisayo esisanda kutholakala ayilingani. Uhlangothi lwesokudla lwenhliziyo luncane kunohlangothi lwesobunxele. Yini okungenzeka ibe yiqiniso ngalolu hlobo?
answer10: Uhlangothi lwesokudla lwenhliziyo luthumela igazi emaphashini
distractor10a: Uhlangothi lwesokudla lwenhliziyo luthumela igazi emzimbeni
distractor10b: Uhlangothi lwesokudla lwenhliziyo luthumela igazi ezindaweni ezingaphezu kwenhliziyo
distractor10c: Uhlangothi lwesokudla lwenhliziyo luthumela igazi ebuchosheni kuphela

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.4 Ukugeleza Kwegazi Nokulawulwa Komfutho Wegazi | Umfutho Wegazi
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.4 Blood Flow and Blood Pressure Regulation | Blood Pressure
chapterContent: Umfutho wegazi emzimbeni ukhiqizwa umfutho wegazi oqinile (igazi) ohambisana nezindonga zemithambo yegazi. Uketshezi luzohamba lusuka ezindaweni ezinengcindezi ephezulu ye-hydrostatic kuya kwephansi. Emithanjeni yegazi, umfutho wegazi oqinile eduze kwenhliziyo uphakeme kakhulu futhi igazi ligeleza liye kuma-arterioles lapho izinga lokugeleza lincishiswa khona yizimbobo ezincane zama-arterioles. Ngesikhathi se-systole, lapho igazi elisha lingena emithanjeni yegazi, izindonga zemithambo yegazi ziyanwebeka ukuze zivumelane nokwanda komfutho wegazi elengeziwe; ngesikhathi se-diastole, izindonga zibuyela esimweni sazo esijwayelekile ngenxa yezakhiwo zazo zokunwebeka. Umfutho wegazi wesigaba se-systole kanye nesigaba se-diastole, esidwetshwe kuMfanekiso 31.20, unikeza ukufundwa kwengcindezi okubili komfutho wegazi. Isibonelo, i-120/80 ibonisa ukufundwa okungu-120 mm Hg ngesikhathi se-systole kanye no-80 mm Hg ngesikhathi se-diastole. Kuwo wonke umjikelezo wenhliziyo, igazi liyaqhubeka nokuthululela kuma-arterioles ngesilinganiso esilinganayo. Lokhu kumelana nokugeleza kwegazi kubizwa ngokuthi ukumelana kwe-peripheral
question1: Yini ekhiqiza ingcindezi ehambisa igazi emzimbeni?
answer1: Umfutho wegazi oqinile ohambisana nezindonga zemithambo yegazi
question2: Uketshezi luhamba kanjani ngokwengcindezi ye-hydrostatic?
answer2: Uketshezi luhamba lusuka ezindaweni ezinengcindezi ephezulu ye-hydrostatic luye ezindaweni ezinengcindezi ephansi ye-hydrostatic
distractor2a: Uketshezi luhamba kuphela kusukela ekucindezelekeni okuphansi kuya ekucindezelekeni okuphezulu
distractor2c: Uketshezi luhlala luhamba luye enhliziyweni kungakhathaliseki ukuthi lucindezelekile
question3: Kukuphi lapho umfutho wegazi uphezulu khona ohlelweni lokujikeleza kwegazi?
answer3: Emithanjeni eseduze nenhliziyo
question4: Kwenzekani ekugelezeni kwegazi lapho igazi lifika kuma-arterioles?
answer4: Izinga lokugeleza liyehla ngoba ama-arterioles anezimbobo ezincane ezidala ukumelana
distractor4a: Izinga lokugeleza liyakhula ngoba imithambo iba mincane
distractor4b: Igazi liyayeka ukuhamba kuze kube yilapho ukushaya kwenhliziyo okulandelayo
distractor4c: Igazi liphuma ngokushesha ohlelweni lokujikeleza kwegazi
question5: Kwenzekani ezindongeni zemithambo yegazi ngesikhathi se-systole?
answer5: Ziyanwebeka ukuze zikwazi ukumelana nokucindezeleka okukhulu okuvela egazini elingenayo
distractor5c: Zivimbela igazi ukuthi lingangeni emithanjeni yegazi
question6: Kungani izindonga zemithambo yegazi zibuyela esimweni sazo esijwayelekile ngesikhathi se-diastole?
answer6: Ngenxa yezakhiwo zabo zokunwebeka
distractor6b: Ngoba ama-valve aphoqa izindonga ukuba zinciphe
question7: Zimelelani izinombolo ezimbili eziku-120/80 ezifundweni zomfutho wegazi?
answer7: Umfutho we-systolic kanye nomfutho we-diastolic
distractor7a: Inani lomoya-mpilo kanye ne-carbon dioxide egazini
question8: Uma kuqhathaniswa nomfutho wegazi ongu-120/80, inombolo engu-120 imelelani?
answer8: Ingcindezi ngesikhathi se-systole lapho inhliziyo incipha
distractor8a: Ingcindezi ngesikhathi se-diastole lapho inhliziyo iphumula
question9: Kuyini ukumelana okungaphandle?
answer9: Ukumelana nokugeleza kwegazi njengoba igazi liqhubeka nokuhamba nge-arterioles

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.4 Ukugeleza Kwegazi Nokulawulwa Komfutho Wegazi | Ukulawulwa Komfutho Wegazi
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.4 Blood Flow and Blood Pressure Regulation | Blood Pressure Regulation
chapterContent: Ukuphuma kwenhliziyo yivolumu yegazi elimpontshelwa yinhliziyo ngomzuzu owodwa. Kubalwa ngokuphindaphinda inani lokufinyela kwenhliziyo okwenzeka ngomzuzu (isilinganiso senhliziyo) ngokuphindwe kaningi kunomthamo we-stroke (ivolumu yegazi elimpontshelwa kwi-aorta ngokufinyela kwe-ventricle yesobunxele). Ngakho-ke, ukuphuma kwenhliziyo kungandiswa ngokwandisa izinga lokushaya kwenhliziyo, njengalapho uzivocavoca. Kodwa-ke, ukuphuma kwenhliziyo kungandiswa nangokwandisa ivolumu ye-stroke, njengokuthi inhliziyo ifinyela ngamandla amakhulu. Umthamo we-stroke ungandiswa nangokusheshisa ukujikeleza kwegazi emzimbeni ukuze igazi eliningi lingene enhliziyweni phakathi kokufinyela. Ngesikhathi sokuzikhandla okukhulu, imithambo yegazi iyaphumula futhi ikhule ngobubanzi, inciphise izinga lokushaya kwenhliziyo elikhuphukile futhi iqinisekise ukuthi igazi elanele elinomoya-mpilo lifika emisipheni. Ukucindezeleka kubangela ukwehla kobubanzi bemithambo yegazi, ngaleyo ndlela kwandise umfutho wegazi. Lezi zinguquko zingabangelwa nayizimpawu zemizwa noma ama-hormone, futhi ngisho nokuma noma ukulala phansi kungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekucindezelweni kwegazi.
question1: Kuyini ukuphuma kwenhliziyo?
answer1: Umthamo wegazi ophampulwa yinhliziyo ngomzuzu owodwa
distractor1a: Inani lomoya-mpilo ogcinwe emangqamuzaneni abomvu egazi
question2: Ukukhishwa kwenhliziyo kubalwa kanjani?
answer2: Ngokuphindaphinda izinga lokushaya kwenhliziyo ngevolumu yokushaya kwenhliziyo
distractor2a: Ngokufaka izinga lokushaya kwenhliziyo kanye nomfutho wegazi
distractor2b: Ngokuphindaphinda umfutho wegazi ngobubanzi bemithambo yegazi
distractor2c: Ngokuhlukanisa ivolumu yesifo sohlangothi ngesilinganiso senhliziyo
question3: Kuyini ukushaya kwenhliziyo?
answer3: Inani lokufinyela kwenhliziyo okwenzeka ngomzuzu
distractor3a: Inani legazi elimpontshelwa ngesikhathi sokusikwa ngakunye
question4: Kuyini ivolumu yokushaya?
answer4: Umthamo wegazi ophonswa ku-aorta ngokufinyela kwe-ventricle yesobunxele
question5: Ukuzivocavoca kungakwandisa kanjani ukuphuma kwenhliziyo?
answer5: Ngokwandisa izinga lokushaya kwenhliziyo kanye nokwandisa umthamo wokushaya kwenhliziyo okungenzeka
question6: Ingakhuphuka kanjani ivolumu yokushaya kwenhliziyo?
answer6: Uma inhliziyo ifinyela ngamandla amakhulu noma igazi eliningi lingena enhliziyweni phakathi kokufinyela
distractor6a: Uma inhliziyo ishaya kancane futhi iyeka ukupompa
distractor6c: Lapho ukuthuthwa komoya-mpilo ngamaseli abomvu egazi kuncipha
question7: Kungani imithambo yegazi iphumula futhi ikhula ngobubanzi ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca okunzima?
answer7: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi igazi elanele elinomoya-mpilo lifinyelela emisipheni esebenzayo
question8: Ukucindezeleka kuyithinta kanjani ingcindezi yegazi?
answer8: Ukucindezeleka kunganciphisa ububanzi bemithambo yegazi, kwandise umfutho wegazi
distractor8a: Ukucindezeleka kuhlala kwandisa ububanzi bemithambo yegazi futhi kwehlisa umfutho wegazi
question9: Yini engalawula izinguquko ekucindezelekeni kwegazi ngaphandle kokuvivinya umzimba nokucindezeleka?
answer9: Izimpawu zemizwa, ama-hormone, kanye nezinguquko esimweni somzimba njengokuma noma ukulala phansi
question10: Yibuphi ubuhlobo obukhona phakathi kokukhishwa kwenhliziyo nokulethwa komoya-mpilo ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca?
answer10: Ukwandisa ukuphuma kwenhliziyo kusiza ukuletha igazi elinomoya-mpilo eningi ezicutshini ezisebenzayo
distractor10a: Ukwanda kokuphuma kwenhliziyo kuvimbela igazi ekufinyeleleni emisipheni
distractor10b: Ukwanda kokukhishwa kwenhliziyo kunciphisa ukutholakala komoya-mpilo
distractor10c: Ukwanda kokuphuma kwenhliziyo kuthinta kuphela ukugaya ukudla

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.5 Amagama Ayisihluthulelo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.5 Key Terms
chapterContent:
angina
ubuhlungu obubangelwa ukuvaleka kwemithambo yenhliziyo ngenxa yokwakheka kwe-plaque kanye nokuntuleka komoya-mpilo emisipheni yenhliziyo

 i-aorta
umthambo omkhulu womzimba osusa igazi enhliziyweni

 i-arteriole
umthambo omncane oxhumanisa umthambo nombhede we-capillary

 umthambo wegazi osusa igazi enhliziyweni

 i-atherosclerosis
ukuqongelela kwama-fatty plaque emithanjeni yenhliziyo enhliziyweni

 i-valve ye-atrioventricular
i-flap ye-membrane yendlela eyodwa yezicubu ezixhumanisayo phakathi kwe-atrium ne-ventricle ohlangothini lwesokudla lwenhliziyo; eyaziwa nangokuthi i-valve ye-tricuspid

 i-atrium
(ubuningi: i-atria) igumbi lenhliziyo elithola igazi elivela emithanjeni bese lithumela igazi kuma-ventricles

 i-valve ye-bicuspid
(futhi, i-valve ye-mitral; i-valve ye-atrioventricular yesobunxele) i-flap ye-membranous enendlela eyodwa phakathi kwe-atrium ne-ventricle ohlangothini lwesobunxele lwenhliziyo

 umfutho wegazi (BP)
umfutho wegazi emithanjeni esiza ukusunduza igazi emzimbeni

 i-capillary
umthambo wegazi omncane kakhulu ovumela ukudlula kwamaseli egazi ngamanye kanye nendawo yokusabalala komoya-mpilo kanye nokushintshana kwezakhamzimba

 umbhede we-capillary
inani elikhulu lama-capillary ahlanganayo ukuze athathe igazi aye esithweni esithile noma esicutshini

 umjikelezo wenhliziyo
ukugcwalisa nokuthulula inhliziyo yegazi ngezibonakaliso zikagesi ezibangela ukuba imisipha yenhliziyo ifinyele futhi iphumule

 ukuphuma kwenhliziyo
umthamo wegazi elimpontshelwa yinhliziyo ngomzuzu owodwa njengomkhiqizo wokushaya kwenhliziyo okuphindaphindwe ngomthamo we-stroke

i-cardiomyocyte
 iseli lemisipha yenhliziyo elikhethekile eligobile kodwa elifinyela ngokungazikhetheli njengemisipha ebushelelezi

uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvaliwe
 uhlelo lapho igazi lihlukaniswa khona noketshezi lomzimba futhi litholakala emithanjeni yegazi

umthambo we-coronary
 isitsha esinikeza izicubu zenhliziyo ngegazi

umthambo we-coronary
 isitsha esisusa igazi ezicutshini zenhliziyo libuyele emakamelweni enhliziyweni

i-diastole
 isigaba sokuphumula somjikelezo wenhliziyo lapho inhliziyo ikhululekile futhi ama-ventricle egcwala igazi

ukujikeleza kabili
 ukugeleza kwegazi ezifundeni ezimbili: isifunda samaphaphu emaphashini kanye nesifunda sohlelo ngokusebenzisa izitho zomzimba nomzimba

i-electrocardiogram (ECG)
ukuqoshwa kwemizwa kagesi yemisipha yenhliziyo

 i-endocardium
ungqimba olungaphakathi lwezicubu enhliziyweni

 i-epicardium
ungqimba lwezicubu zangaphandle zenhliziyo
ukujikeleza kwe-gill
uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluqondene nezilwane ezine-gill zokushintshanisa igesi; igazi ligeleza nge-gill ukuze lifake umoya-mpilo

 i-hemocoel
umgodi lapho igazi lifakwa khona ohlelweni lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvulekile

 i-hemolymph
ingxube yegazi kanye noketshezi oluphakathi olutholakala ezinambuzaneni nakwezinye izidalwa kanye nezinhlobo eziningi ze-mollusk
i-vena cava engaphansi
ikhipha igazi emithanjeni evela ezithweni ezingezansi nasemilenzeni

 uketshezi oluphakathi
uketshezi phakathi kwamaseli

 i-lymph node
isitho esikhethekile esiqukethe inani elikhulu lama-macrophage ahlanza i-lymph ngaphambi kokuba uketshezi lubuyiselwe enhliziyweni

 i-myocardial infarction
(futhi, ukuhlaselwa yinhliziyo) ukuvaleka okuphelele kwemithambo yenhliziyo nokufa kwezicubu zemisipha yenhliziyo

 i-myocardium
amaseli emisipha yenhliziyo akha ungqimba oluphakathi kanye nenqwaba yodonga lwenhliziyo

 uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvulekile
uhlelo lapho igazi lixutshwa khona noketshezi oluphakathi futhi limboza ngqo izitho

 i-ostium
(ubuningi: i-ostia) izimbobo phakathi kwemithambo yegazi evumela ukuhamba kwe-hemolymph emzimbeni wezinambuzane, ama-arthropod, nama-mollusk anezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ezivulekile

 i-pericardium
ungqimba lwe-membrane oluvikela inhliziyo; futhi luyingxenye ye-epicardium

 ukumelana kwe-peripheral
ukumelana kwemithambo yegazi kanye nezindonga zemithambo yegazi ekucindezelweni okubekwe kuzo ngamandla enhliziyo epompa

 i-plasma
ingxenye ewuketshezi yegazi esala ngemva kokususwa kwamaseli

 i-platelet
(futhi, i-thrombocyte) ingxenye encane yamangqamuzana eqoqana emanxebeni, isabela ngezinto ezihlanganisa ama-clotting, bese yakha i-plug ukuvimbela ukulahleka kwegazi

 i-precapillary sphincter
umsipha omncane olawula ukujikeleza kwegazi emibhedeni yama-capillary

 ukujikeleza kwama-pulmocutaneous
uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi kuma-amphibians; ukugeleza kwegazi emaphashini kanye nesikhumba esimanzi sokushintshana kwegesi

 ukujikeleza kwamaphaphu
ukugeleza kwegazi kude nenhliziyo ngamaphaphu lapho kwenzeka khona umoya-mpilo bese kubuyela enhliziyweni futhi

 iseli elibomvu legazi
iseli elincane (7–8 μm) le-biconcave elingenayo i-mitochondria (kanye nasezincelisayo ezingenayo i-nuclei) eligcwele i-hemoglobin, elinika iseli umbala walo obomvu; lithutha umoya-mpilo emzimbeni

 i-valve ye-semilunar
i-membrane flap yezicubu ezixhumanisayo phakathi kwe-aorta kanye ne-ventricle yenhliziyo (ama-valve e-aortic noma ama-pulmonary semilunar)

 i-serum
i-plasma ngaphandle kwezinto ezibangela ukujiya

 i-node ye-sinoatrial (SA)
i-pacemaker yangaphakathi yenhliziyo; etholakala eduze kodonga lwe-atrium yangakwesokudla

 ivolumu yokushaya
ivolumu yegazi ephonswa ku-aorta ngokujiya kwe-ventricle yesobunxele

 i-vena cava ephezulu
ikhipha igazi emthanjeni we-jugular ovela ebuchosheni kanye nasemithanjeni evela ezingalweni

 ukujikeleza kwegazi okujwayelekile
ukugeleza kwegazi kusuka enhliziyweni kuya ebuchosheni, esibindini, ezinso, esiswini, nakwezinye izitho zomzimba, izitho zomzimba, bese kubuyela kwaleli gazi enhliziyweni

 i-systole
isigaba sokufinyela komjikelezo wenhliziyo lapho ama-ventricle epompa igazi emithanjeni

 i-valve ye-tricuspid
i-flap ye-membrane yendlela eyodwa yezicubu ezixhumanisayo phakathi kwe-atrium ne-ventricle ohlangothini lwesokudla lwenhliziyo; eyaziwa nangokuthi i-valve ye-atrioventricular

 ukujikeleza kwegazi okuqondisayo
ukugeleza kwegazi ngesekethe elilodwa; kwenzeka enhlanzini lapho igazi ligeleza khona ngama-gill, bese lidlula izitho kanye nomzimba wonke, ngaphambi kokubuyela enhliziyweni

 ukuqina kwegazi
ukuncipha komthambo wegazi

 ukujikeleza kwegazi
ukwandiswa komthambo wegazi

 umthambo
umthambo wegazi obuyisela igazi enhliziyweni

 i-vena cava
umthambo omkhulu womzimba obuyisela igazi ezingxenyeni eziphezulu nezingezansi zomzimba; bheka i-vena cava ephezulu kanye ne-vena cava ephansi

 i-ventricle
(inhliziyo) igumbi elikhulu eliphansi lenhliziyo elipompa igazi emithanjeni

 i-venule
umthambo wegazi oxhumanisa umbhede we-capillary nomthambo

 iseli legazi elimhlophe
iseli elikhulu (30 μm) elinama-nuclei okukhona izinhlobo eziningi ezinezindima ezahlukene okuhlanganisa ukuvikelwa komzimba kumagciwane namagciwane, kanye nokuhlanza amangqamuzana afile kanye neminye imfucuza

answer39: Ukugeleza kwegazi kusuka enhliziyweni kuya emaphashini ukuze kufakwe umoya-mpilo bese kubuyela enhliziyweni

answer40: Iseli elincane le-biconcave eliqukethe i-hemoglobin elithutha umoya-mpilo emzimbeni

answer44: Umthamo wegazi ophonswa ku-aorta ngesikhathi sokufinyela okukodwa kwe-ventricle yesobunxele

answer46: Ukugeleza kwegazi kusuka enhliziyweni kuya ezithweni zomzimba nasezicutshini bese kubuyela enhliziyweni

distractor48b: Ivumela igazi ukuthi ligeleze libuyele emuva liye e-atrium

answer49: Ukugeleza kwegazi ngesekethe eyodwa, njengasenhlanzini lapho igazi lihamba khona ngamagill bese kuba umzimba ngaphambi kokubuyela enhliziyweni

answer53: Umthambo omkhulu obuyisela igazi enhliziyweni lisuka ezingxenyeni eziphezulu nezingezansi zomzimba

answer56: Ukuvikela umzimba kumagciwane namagciwane nokususa amangqamuzana afile kanye nemfucuza

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 31. Uhlelo Lokujikeleza Kwegazi | 31.6 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 31. The Circulatory System | 31.6 Chapter Summary
chapterContent:
31.1 Ukubuka Konke Ngesistimu Yokujikeleza Kwegazi
Ezilwaneni eziningi, uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi lusetshenziselwa ukuthutha igazi emzimbeni. Ezinye izilwane zakudala zisebenzisa ukusabalala kokushintshana kwamanzi, izakhamzimba, namagesi. Kodwa-ke, izinto eziphilayo eziyinkimbinkimbi zisebenzisa uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi ukuthwala amagesi, izakhamzimba, kanye nemfucuza emzimbeni. Izinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi zingase zivuleke (zixutshwe noketshezi oluphakathi) noma zivaliwe (zihlukaniswe noketshezi oluphakathi). Izinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ezivaliwe ziyisici sezilwane ezinomgogodla; noma kunjalo, kunomehluko omkhulu esakhiweni senhliziyo kanye nokujikeleza kwegazi phakathi kwamaqembu ahlukene anomgogodla ngenxa yokuzivumelanisa nezimo ngesikhathi sokuvela kwemvelo kanye nomehluko ohambisanayo ku-anatomy. Izinhlanzi zinenhliziyo enamakamelo amabili enokujikeleza kwegazi okuqondile. Izilwane ezihlala emanzini nasemhlabeni zinenhliziyo enamakamelo amathathu, enokuxubana kwegazi, futhi zinokujikeleza kabili. Izilwane ezihuquzelayo eziningi ezingezona izinyoni zinenhliziyo enamakamelo amathathu, kodwa zinokuxubana okuncane kwegazi; zinokujikeleza kabili. Izilwane ezincelisayo nezinyoni zinenhliziyo enamakamelo amane engenakuxubana kwegazi kanye nokujikeleza kabili.

 31.2 Izingxenye Zegazi
Izingxenye ezithile zegazi zifaka phakathi amangqamuzana abomvu egazi, amangqamuzana amhlophe egazi, ama-platelet, kanye ne-plasma, equkethe izinto ezibangela ukujiya kanye ne-serum. Igazi libalulekile ekulawuleni i-pH yomzimba, izinga lokushisa, ingcindezi ye-osmotic, ukujikeleza kwezakhamzimba kanye nokususwa kwemfucuza, ukusatshalaliswa kwama-hormone avela kuma-endocrine glands, kanye nokususwa kokushisa okweqile; liphinde liqukethe izingxenye zokujiya kwegazi. Amangqamuzana abomvu egazi angamaseli akhethekile aqukethe i-hemoglobin futhi ajikeleza emzimbeni ehambisa umoya-mpilo kumaseli. Amangqamuzana amhlophe egazi ahilelekile ekuphenduleni komzimba ukuze abone futhi aqondise amagciwane ahlaselayo, amagciwane, kanye nezinye izinto eziphilayo zakwamanye amazwe; aphinde asebenzise izingxenye ezibangela ukujiya kwegazi, njengamaseli abomvu egazi amadala. Ama-platelet nezinto ezibangela ukujiya kwegazi zibangela ushintsho lwe-fibrinogen yephrotheni encibilikayo ibe yi-fibrin yephrotheni engancibiliki endaweni yesilonda eyakha i-plug. I-plasma iqukethe amanzi angu-90% kanye nezinto ezahlukahlukene, njengezici ezibangela ukujiya kanye nama-antibodies. I-serum yingxenye ye-plasma yegazi ngaphandle kwezici ezibangela ukujiya kwegazi.

 31.3 Inhliziyo Yezilwane Ezincelisayo Nemithambo Yegazi
Imisipha yenhliziyo ipompa igazi ngezigaba ezintathu zesistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi: i-coronary, i-pulmonary, kanye ne-systemic. Kukhona i-atrium eyodwa kanye ne-ventricle eyodwa ohlangothini lwesokudla kanye ne-atrium eyodwa kanye ne-ventricle eyodwa ohlangothini lwesobunxele. Ukupompa kwenhliziyo kungumsebenzi wama-cardiomyocytes, amaseli emisipha ahlukile ahlelwe njengemisipha yamathambo kodwa apompa ngokuhambisana nemisipha ebushelelezi. I-pacemaker yangaphakathi iqala ku-node ye-sinoatrial, etholakala eduze kodonga lwe-atrium yangakwesokudla. Amacala kagesi ashaya esuka ku-node ye-SA okwenza ama-atria amabili anciphe kanyekanye; bese ukushaya kwenhliziyo kufinyelela ku-node ye-atrioventricular phakathi kwe-atrium yangakwesokudla kanye ne-ventricle yangakwesokudla. Ukumiswa kwesignali kagesi kuvumela i-atria ukuthi ithulule ngokuphelele kuma-ventricle ngaphambi kokuba ama-ventricle akhiphe igazi. Igazi elivela enhliziyweni lithwalwa emzimbeni ngenethiwekhi eyinkimbinkimbi yemithambo yegazi; imithambo yegazi isusa igazi enhliziyweni, futhi imithambo yegazi ibuyisela igazi enhliziyweni.

 31.4 Ukugeleza Kwegazi Nokulawulwa Komfutho Wegazi
Igazi lihamba kakhulu emzimbeni ngokuhamba okunezigqi kwemisipha ebushelelezi odongeni lwemithambo yegazi kanye nokusebenza kwemisipha yamathambo njengoba umzimba uhamba. Igazi livinjelwa ukugeleza emuva emithanjeni ngama-valve ahamba ngendlela eyodwa. Ukugeleza kwegazi emibhedeni yama-capillary kulawulwa yi-precapillary sphincters ukuze kwandiswe futhi kuncishiswe ukugeleza kuye ngezidingo zomzimba futhi kuqondiswa izimpawu zemizwa nama-hormone. Imithambo ye-lymph ithatha uketshezi oluphume egazini luye kuma-lymph node lapho luhlanzwa khona ngaphambi kokubuyela enhliziyweni. Ngesikhathi se-systole, igazi lingena emithanjeni, futhi izindonga zemithambo yegazi ziyanwebeka ukuze zithwale igazi elengeziwe. Ngesikhathi se-diastole, izindonga zemithambo yegazi zibuyela esimweni esijwayelekile. Umfutho wegazi wesigaba se-systole kanye nesigaba se-diastole unikeza ukufundwa kwengcindezi okubili komfutho wegazi.
question1: Yiluphi uhlobo lohlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluhlukaniswe noketshezi oluphakathi futhi oluqukethwe emithanjeni yegazi?

question3: Inhliziyo yezilwane ezincelisayo neyezinyoni ihluke kanjani enhliziyweni yezilwane ezihlala emanzini?

distractor3c: Izilwane ezincelisayo nezinyoni zisebenzisa ukujikeleza kwamagill kuphela
question4: Yiziphi izingxenye zegazi ezihilelekile ekuvikeleni amasosha omzimba?

question5: Uyini umsebenzi wamaseli abomvu egazi?
answer5: Ziqukethe i-hemoglobin futhi zithutha umoya-mpilo ziye emangqamuzaneni
question6: Kwenzekani ngesikhathi sokwakheka kwamahlule egazi?
answer6: Ama-platelet nezinto ezibangela ukujiya kwegazi ziguqula i-fibrinogen ibe yi-fibrin, zakha ipulaki endaweni yenxeba
distractor6a: I-hemoglobin ishintsha ibe yi-fibrin ukuze ithuthe umoya-mpilo

distractor6c: I-plasma ilahlekelwa amanzi wonke bese iba yi-clot
question7: Yiziphi izingxenye ezintathu zokujikeleza kwegazi ezinikezwa yinhliziyo yezilwane ezincelisayo?
answer7: Ukujikeleza kwegazi kwe-coronary, pulmonary, kanye ne-systemic
distractor7a: Ukujikeleza kwegazi kwemithambo yegazi, kwemithambo yegazi kanye ne-lymphatic
distractor7b: Ukugaya ukudla, ukuphefumula, kanye nokujikeleza kwegazi kwezinzwa
distractor7c: Ukujikeleza kwegazi emzimbeni, isikhumba kanye nomzimba
question8: Uyini umsebenzi we-node ye-sinoatrial (SA)?
answer8: Isebenza njenge-pacemaker yangaphakathi yenhliziyo futhi iqala izimpawu zikagesi zokufinyela
question9: Iyini indima yemithambo yegazi nemithambo yegazi?
answer9: Imithambo yegazi ithwala igazi lisuke enhliziyweni, kuyilapho imithambo yegazi ibuyisela igazi enhliziyweni
distractor9a: Imithambo yegazi ibuyisela igazi enhliziyweni, kuyilapho imithambo yegazi ithwala igazi
distractor9b: Kokubili imithambo yegazi kanye nemithambo yegazi kushintshana amagesi kuphela
distractor9c: Kokubili imithambo yegazi nemithambo yegazi kukhiqiza amaseli egazi
question10: Yisiphi isilwane esilandelayo esinesistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi evulekile?
answer10: Inyosi
distractor10a: Ikati
question11: Iyini inzuzo yesistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi evulekile?
answer11: Isebenzisa amandla amancane okusebenza kwe-metabolic
distractor11b: Kuyindlela ephumelela kakhulu yokuhambisa amagesi, izakhamzimba, kanye nokungcola emzimbeni womuntu ophilayo

question12: Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo mayelana nezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi esingamanga?
answer12: Ama-lobster ayizinto eziphilayo ezinezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ezivaliwe
distractor12a: Ezinhlelweni zokujikeleza kwegazi ezivaliwe, igazi ligeleza ngemithambo yegazi ehlukene noketshezi oluphakathi komzimba
distractor12c: Esimisweni sokujikeleza kwegazi esivulekile, i-hemolymph ithululela emgodini womzimba
question13: Yisiphi kulezi zitatimende ezilandelayo esichaza kangcono uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvulekile?
answer13: Esimisweni sokujikeleza kwegazi esivulekile, igazi lixubana noketshezi oluphakathi kwe-hemocoel
distractor13a: Esimisweni sokujikeleza kwegazi esivulekile, igazi lihlukaniswa noketshezi olungaphakathi komzimba futhi litholakala emithanjeni yegazi.
distractor13b: Igazi lijikeleza ngokungaqondile lisuka enhliziyweni lizungeze umzila wokujikeleza kwegazi ojwayelekile
distractor13c: Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvulekile lusebenzisa amandla amaningi kunesistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi evaliwe
