question16: Bheka uMfanekiso 31.21. Umfundi uzama ukuhlela kabusha ezinye izilwane ezigciniwe elabhorethri yebhayoloji ezilahlekelwe amalebula azo. Umfundi uqaphela ukuthi kukhona amanothi athile ebhodweni ngalinye, anikeza ulwazi ngesigaba sesilwane ngasinye. Umfundi ubhala amalebula ezilwaneni ezingaziwa u-A-F bese efaka izici zesistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi yesilwane ngasinye etafuleni. Uma umfundi efisa ukudala i-phylogeny yezinto eziphilayo u-A kuya ku-F, yisiphi isidalwa esingaba ngakwesokudla kakhulu kwesihlahla se-phylogenetic?
question17: Bheka uMfanekiso 31.21. Umfundi uzama ukuhlela kabusha ezinye izilwane ezigciniwe elabhorethri yebhayoloji ezilahlekelwe amalebula azo. Umfundi uqaphela ukuthi kukhona amanothi athile ebhodweni ngalinye, enikeza ulwazi ngesigaba sesilwane ngasinye. Umfundi ubhala amalebula ezilwaneni ezingaziwa u-A-F bese efaka izici zesistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi yesilwane ngasinye etafuleni. Uma umfundi efisa ukudala i-phylogeny yezinto eziphilayo u-A kuya ku-F, izinto eziphilayo zingavela kanjani esihlahleni, kusukela kwesobunxele kuya kwesokudla, futhi ngani?
answer17: Ukuhleleka kungaba ngu-F, E, C, A, B, D njengoba ukuthambekela okujwayelekile kokuvela kwesistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi kuqondene nezinhlelo ezivalekile kakhulu
distractor17a: Uhlelo luzoba yi-B, D, A, C, E, F njengoba ukuthambekela okujwayelekile kokuvela kwesistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi kubheke ezinhlelweni ezivulekile ngokwengeziwe
distractor17b: Ukuhleleka kungaba ngu-F, E, C, A, D, B njengoba ukuthambekela okujwayelekile kokuvela kwesistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi kuqondene nezinhlelo ezivalekile kakhulu
distractor17c: Ukuhleleka kungaba ngu-F, E, C, D, B, A njengoba ukuthambekela okujwayelekile kokuvela kwesistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi kubheke ezinhlelweni ezivulekile ngokwengeziwe
question18: Umehluko ezinhlotsheni zegazi zabantu ubonisa ukuthi umehluko wezakhi zofuzo uguquke kanjani ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, okuthinta isakhiwo samaseli abomvu egazi. Iyini isisekelo sokuhlukaniswa kwezinhlobo zegazi?
answer18: Isekelwe kuma-antigen enziwe ngamaprotheni, ikakhulukazi ama-glycolipid nama-glycoprotein, atholakala ebusweni bamaseli abomvu egazi.
distractor18a: Isekelwe kuma-antigen enziwe ngama-carbohydrate, ikakhulukazi i-glycoside kanye ne-N-acetylglucosamine, atholakala ebusweni bamaseli abomvu egazi.
distractor18b: Isekelwe kuma-antigen enziwe ngamaprotheni, ikakhulukazi amaprotheni angaphandle kanye namaprotheni aphelele, atholakala ebusweni beseli elibomvu legazi.
distractor18c: Isekelwe kuma-antigen enziwe ngama-lipid, ikakhulukazi ama-glycerophospholipid, atholakala ebusweni bamaseli abomvu egazi.
question19: Uma umuntu enohlobo lwegazi i-AB/Rh-, yimaphi ama-antibodies azotholakala egazini?
question20: Izakhi ezitholakala egazini lomuntu zifaka phakathi amangqamuzana amhlophe egazi, amangqamuzana abomvu egazi, kanye ne-_______
question21: Kungatholakala izingxenye ezine egazini elinikelwe. Enye yalezo zingxenye yi-plasma. Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungeyona ingxenye eyisisekelo ye-plasma?
question22: Ama-platelet amaningi ayahlangana futhi anamathele ndawonye endaweni yenxeba, ekugcineni akha i-platelet plug, ebizwa nangokuthi i-fibrin clot. Ama-platelet ayaqhubeka efika endaweni yenxeba kuze kube yilapho i-plug yakheke ngokuphelele. Chaza izindlela zokuphendula ezenzekayo bese ubikezela ukuthi kungenzekani uma ingxenye ye-platelet plug iphuka ngaphambi kokuba inxeba liphiliswe.
answer22: I-loop yempendulo enhle, ezoqala kabusha uma ingxenye ye-platelet plug iphuka, ibize ama-platelet amaningi endaweni ukuze alungise i-plug ephukile.
distractor22a: I-negative feedback loop, ezoqala kabusha uma ingxenye ye-platelet plug iphuka, ibize ama-platelet amaningi endaweni ukuze alungise i-plug ephukile.
distractor22b: I-loop yempendulo enhle, engeke iqale kabusha uma ingxenye ye-platelet plug iphuka
distractor22c: I-negative feedback loop, engeke iqale kabusha uma ingxenye ye-platelet plug iphuka
question23: Bheka uMfanekiso 31.22. Umdwebo ubonisa ihlule le-fibrin elakheka ngaphakathi kwemithambo yegazi. Yiziphi izakhi zegazi ezisebenzisanayo ukuze zakhe ihlule?
answer23: Ama-platelet, i-fibrinogen, kanye nezinto ezibangela ukujiya kwegazi
distractor23a: Amaseli egazi abomvu, i-serum, kanye ne-vitamin K
question24: Bheka uMfanekiso 31.9. Umdwebo ubonisa izinhlobo ezine ezahlukene zamaseli abomvu egazi kubantu. Chaza ukuthi yini emelelwa yizimo ezinemibala ebusweni bamaseli bese uchaza umsebenzi wazo.
answer24: Ama-glycoprotein akhomba amangqamuzana abomvu egazi njengengxenye yomzimba, ngokungafani namangqamuzana abomvu egazi angaphandle, angase ahlaselwe ama-antibodies egazini
distractor24a: Ama-Receptors, akhomba amangqamuzana abomvu egazi njengengxenye yomzimba, ngokungafani namangqamuzana abomvu egazi angaphandle, angase ahlaselwe ama-antibodies egazini
distractor24b: Ama-glycoprotein, akhomba amangqamuzana abomvu egazi njengengxenye yomzimba, ngokungafani namangqamuzana abomvu egazi angaphandle, angase ahlaselwe ama-antigen egazini.
distractor24c: Ama-antibodies akhomba amaseli abomvu egazi njengengxenye yomzimba, okubangela ukuwohloka kwamaseli angaphandle
question25: Bheka uMfanekiso 31.10. Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo mayelana nohlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi esingamanga?
distractor25a: Igazi elise-vena cava engaphansi liyasuswa umoya-mpilo
question26: Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo mayelana nenhliziyo esingamanga?
answer26: Igazi lihamba nge-valve ye-bicuspid liye ku-atrium yesobunxele
distractor26a: I-valve ye-mitral ihlukanisa i-ventricle yesobunxele ne-atrium yesobunxele
distractor26b: Ama-valve e-aorta kanye nama-valve e-pulmonary angama-valve e-semilunar
question27: Enhliziyweni enempilo, ukushaya kwenhliziyo kuqala ngaphakathi kwesignali kagesi evela kuyiphi ingxenye yenhliziyo?
question28: Chaza umjikelezo wenhliziyo bese uchaza ukuthi yini ewuqhubayo
answer28: Inhliziyo iyafinyela ukuze ipompe igazi emzimbeni ngesikhathi se-systole futhi igcwale igazi ngesikhathi se-diastole. Ishaja kagesi ishaya ngokuzenzakalelayo isuka ku-SA node ibangele ukuthi ama-atria amabili afinyele. I-pulse ifika ku-AV node lapho ima khona ngaphambi kokusakazeka ezindongeni zama-ventricle. Ingena ku-bundle ye-His, bese ingena emagatsheni e-bundle yesobunxele nesokudla adlula nge-septum ephakathi kwe-ventricular. Imicu ye-Purkinje iqhuba i-pulse kusukela phezulu phezulu ku-myocardium ye-ventricular, okwenza ama-ventricle afinyele. Lokhu kuphumula kuvumela i-atria ukuthi ithulule okuqukethwe kwayo kuma-ventricle ngaphambi kokuba ama-ventricle akhiphe igazi.
distractor28a: Inhliziyo iyafinyela ukuze ipompe igazi emzimbeni ngesikhathi se-diastole futhi igcwale igazi ngesikhathi se-systole. Ishaja kagesi ishaya ngokuzenzakalelayo isuka ku-SA node ibangele ukuthi ama-atria amabili afinyele. I-pulse ifika ku-AV node lapho ima khona ngaphambi kokusakazeka ezindongeni zama-ventricle. Ingena ku-bundle ye-His, bese ingena emagatsheni e-bundle yesobunxele nesokudla adlula nge-septum ephakathi kwe-ventricular. Imicu ye-Purkinje iqhuba i-pulse isuka phezulu iye phezulu ku-myocardium ye-ventricular, okwenza ama-ventricle afinyele. Lokhu kuphumula kuvumela i-atria ukuthi ithulule okuqukethwe kwayo kuma-ventricle ngaphambi kokuba ama-ventricle akhiphe igazi.
distractor28b: Inhliziyo iyafinyela ukuze ipompe igazi emzimbeni ngesikhathi se-systole futhi igcwale igazi ngesikhathi se-diastole. Ishaja kagesi ishaya ngokuzenzakalelayo kusuka ku-AV node okubangela ukuthi ama-atria amabili afinyele. I-pulse ifika ku-SA node lapho ima khona ngaphambi kokusakazeka ezindongeni zama-ventricle
distractor28c: Inhliziyo iyafinyela ukuze ipompe igazi emzimbeni ngesikhathi se-systole futhi igcwale igazi ngesikhathi se-diastole. Ishaja kagesi ishaya ngokuzenzakalelayo isuka ku-SA node ibangele ukuthi ama-atria amabili afinyele. I-pulse ifika ku-AV node lapho ima khona ngaphambi kokusakazeka ezindongeni zama-ventricle. Ingena kuma-fibre e-Purkinje, bese ingena emagatsheni e-bundle kwesobunxele nakwesokudla adlula ku-septum ephakathi kwe-ventricular.
question29: Qhathanisa futhi uqhathanise imithambo nemithambo yegazi
answer29: Imithambo yegazi nemithambo yegazi yomibili inezingqimba ezintathu ezihlukile. Imithambo yegazi isusa igazi enhliziyweni kanti imithambo yegazi ibuyisela igazi enhliziyweni.
distractor29a: Imithambo yegazi nemithambo yegazi yomibili inezingqimba ezintathu ezihlukene. Imithambo yegazi isusa igazi enhliziyweni kanti imithambo yegazi ibuyisela igazi enhliziyweni.
distractor29b: Imithambo yegazi nemithambo yegazi yomibili inezivilovu zokuvimbela ukugeleza kwegazi emuva. Imithambo yegazi isusa igazi enhliziyweni kanti imithambo yegazi ibuyisela igazi enhliziyweni.
distractor29c: Imithambo yegazi nemithambo yegazi yomibili inezivikelo zokuvimbela ukugeleza kwegazi emuva. Imithambo yegazi isusa igazi enhliziyweni futhi imithambo yegazi ibuyisela igazi enhliziyweni.
question30: Bheka uMfanekiso 31.23. Umdwebo ongezansi ukhombisa izakhiwo zemizwa ezilawula futhi ziqondise ukushaya kwenhliziyo. Umjikelezo wenhliziyo ubungathinteka kanjani uma izimpawu zemizwa zivinjiwe ngaphakathi kwe-Purkinje fiber?
question31: Bheka uMfanekiso 31.23. Umdwebo ukhombisa izakhiwo zemizwa ezilawula futhi ziqondise ukushaya kwenhliziyo. Chaza ngokugcwele ukuthi umjikelezo wenhliziyo ubungathinteka kanjani uma isignali ivinjiwe ku-node ye-atrioventricular nokuthi kungani
answer31: I-atria yayizoncipha, kodwa ama-ventricle ayengeke, ngoba i-atrioventricular node idlulisela izimpawu kuma-fiber e-Purkinje, avumela ama-ventricle ukuthi anciphe.
distractor31a: Ama-ventricle ayezofinyela, kodwa i-atria yayingeke, ngoba i-atrioventricular node idlulisela isignali kuma-fibre e-Purkinje, avumela ama-ventricle ukuba afinyele.
distractor31b: I-atria yayizoncipha, kodwa ama-ventricle ayengeke, ngoba i-atrioventricular node idlulisela isignali kuma-fiber e-Purkinje, avumela i-atria ukuthi inciphe.
distractor31c: Ama-ventricle ayezofinyela, kodwa i-atria ayengeke, ngoba i-atrioventricular node idlulisela isignali kuma-fiber e-Purkinje, okubangela ukuthi i-atria ifinyele.
question32: Chaza uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvaliwe bese uqhathanisa umehluko esakhiweni senhliziyo yezilwane ezinezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ezivaliwe
answer32: Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvaliwe luhlelo lapho igazi lihlukile khona oketshezini oluphakathi. Izinhlanzi zinenhliziyo enamakamelo amabili. Izilwane ezihlala emanzini nasemanzini nezilwane ezihuquzelayo zinenhliziyo enamakamelo amathathu, kodwa inhliziyo yokugcina ayinawo umxube wegazi ophelele. Izilwane ezincelisayo nezinyoni zinenhliziyo enamakamelo amane futhi zijikeleza kabili.
distractor32a: Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvaliwe luhlelo lapho igazi lihlangana khona noketshezi oluphakathi. Izinhlanzi zinenhliziyo enamakamelo amabili. Izilwane ezihlala emanzini nasemanzini nezilwane ezihuquzelayo zinenhliziyo enamakamelo amathathu, kodwa le yokugcina ayinawo umxube wegazi omningi. Izilwane ezincelisayo nezinyoni zinenhliziyo enamakamelo amane kanye nokujikeleza kwegazi okuphindwe kabili.
distractor32b: Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvaliwe luhlelo lapho igazi lihlukile oketshezini olungaphakathi. Izilwane ezihlala emanzini nasemhlabeni zinenhliziyo enamakamelo amabili. Izinhlanzi nezilwane ezihuquzelayo zinenhliziyo enamakamelo amathathu, kodwa lena yokugcina ayinayo ingxube yegazi eningi. Izilwane ezincelisayo nezinyoni zinenhliziyo enamakamelo amane futhi zijikeleza kabili.
distractor32c: Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvaliwe luhlelo lapho igazi lihlangana khona noketshezi oluphakathi. Izilwane ezihlala emanzini nasemhlabeni zinenhliziyo enamakamelo amabili. Izinhlanzi nezilwane ezihuquzelayo zinenhliziyo enamakamelo amathathu, kodwa inhliziyo yokugcina ayinawo umxube wegazi omningi. Izilwane ezincelisayo nezinyoni zinenhliziyo enamakamelo amane kanye nokujikeleza kwegazi okuphindwe kabili.
question33: Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi luyindlela eyinhloko yokuthutha amagesi nezakhamzimba emzimbeni wonke. Chaza ukuthi kwenzekani ohlelweni lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvaliwe bese uqhathanisa uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvaliwe nohlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvulekile
answer33: Igazi ohlelweni lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvaliwe likhona ngaphakathi kwemithambo yegazi, lijikeleza ohlangothini olulodwa lisuka enhliziyweni lizungeze umzila wokujikeleza kwegazi, bese libuyela enhliziyweni. Lihlelekile, lilawulwa, futhi izakhamzimba kanye nemikhiqizo engcolile ithuthwa kahle kakhulu kunasesimisweni sokujikeleza kwegazi esivulekile.
distractor33a: Igazi ohlelweni lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvaliwe likhona ngaphakathi kwemithambo yegazi futhi lijikeleza ohlangothini olulodwa lisuka enhliziyweni, lizungeze umzila wokujikeleza kwegazi, bese libuyela enhliziyweni. Alilawulwa futhi alihlelekile kangako kunesistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi evulekile, kodwa izakhamzimba kanye nemikhiqizo engcolile ithuthwa kahle kakhulu.
distractor33b: Igazi elisesimisweni sokujikeleza kwegazi esivaliwe alivalelwa emithanjeni yegazi, kodwa liphonswa ku-hemocoel, ejikeleza izitho zomzimba, bese liphinde lingene enhliziyweni nge-ostia. Lihlelekile, lilawulwa, futhi izakhamzimba kanye nemikhiqizo engcolile ithuthwa kahle kakhulu.
distractor33c: Igazi elisesimisweni sokujikeleza kwegazi esivaliwe alivalelwa emithanjeni yegazi, kodwa liphonswa ku-hemocoel, ejikeleza izitho zomzimba, bese liphinde lingene enhliziyweni nge-ostia. Alilawulwa futhi alihlelekile kahle kunesistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi evulekile, kodwa izakhamzimba kanye nemikhiqizo engcolile ithuthwa kahle kakhulu.
question34: Iyini inzuzo eyodwa yenhliziyo enamakamelo amane kunenhliziyo enamakamelo amathathu?
answer34: Igazi elinomoya-mpilo kanye nelingenawo umoya-mpilo ligcinwa lahlukene enhliziyweni enamakamelo amane, okusiza ekunyakazeni kahle komoya-mpilo emzimbeni futhi okusiza umzimba ukuthi unyakaze ngokushesha uma kudingeka.
distractor34a: Igazi elinomoya-mpilo elithwalwa ohlangothini lwesokudla lwenhliziyo lihlukaniswe ngokuphelele nohlangothi lwesobunxele elithwala igazi elingenawo umoya-mpilo, okusiza ekunyakazeni kahle komoya-mpilo emzimbeni futhi okusiza umzimba ukuthi unyakaze ngokushesha uma kudingeka.
distractor34b: Inhliziyo enamakamelo amane igcina igazi elinomoya-mpilo kanye nelingenawo umoya-mpilo lihlukene futhi lijikeleza kabili kanti inhliziyo enamakamelo amathathu inokujikeleza okukodwa. Lokhu kusiza ekunyakazeni kahle komoya-mpilo emzimbeni.
distractor34c: Igazi elinomoya-mpilo kanye nelingenawo umoya-mpilo ligcinwa lahlukene enhliziyweni enamakamelo amane, okusiza ekunyakazeni kwe-carbon dioxide ngendlela ephumelela kakhulu emzimbeni.
question36: Ukwakheka kwamaseli abomvu egazi kuwavumela kanjani ukuthi alethe umoya-mpilo emaseli omzimba?
answer36: Ubukhulu nesimo sazo kuvumela ukuthi zithwale futhi zidlulise umoya-mpilo
distractor36a: Isimo sediski yabo siqukethe ama-vesicle amaningi amancane avumela ukuthi athwale futhi adlulise umoya-mpilo
distractor36c: Ziqukethe izinto ezibangela ukujiya kanye nama-antibodies
question37: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuchaza kahle i-plasma?
answer38: Kuyi-electric impulse eqala kumaseli emisipha yenhliziyo ku-sinoatrial node
distractor38a: I-implant yangaphakathi ithumela umfutho kagesi enhliziyweni
distractor38b: Kungukuvusa kwamaseli emisipha yenhliziyo ku-node ye-atrioventricular kulandelwe yi-node ye-sinoatrial
question40: Bheka uMfanekiso 31.24. Umdwebo ukhombisa ukwakheka kwangaphakathi kwenhliziyo. Ukujikeleza kwegazi ngale kwenhliziyo kungathinteka kanjani uma ivalvu yamaphaphu ingavuleki?
question41: Bheka uMfanekiso 31.24. Umdwebo ongezansi ukhombisa ukwakheka kwangaphakathi kwenhliziyo. Ukujikeleza kwegazi ngale kwenhliziyo kungathinteka kanjani uma ivalvu ye-tricuspid ingavuleki?
answer41: Igazi alikwazanga ukungena emthanjeni wamaphaphu; ngakho-ke, alikwazanga ukufinyelela emaphashini
distractor41a: Igazi alikwazanga ukungena emithanjeni yamaphaphu; ngakho-ke, alikwazanga ukufinyelela emaphashini
distractor41b: Igazi alikwazanga ukungena emthanjeni wamaphaphu; ngakho-ke, alikwazanga ukufinyelela enhliziyweni
distractor41c: Igazi alikwazanga ukungena emithanjeni yamaphaphu; ngakho-ke, alikwazanga ukufinyelela enhliziyweni
question42: Kungani kuwusizo ukuthi igazi lihambe kancane emibhedeni yama-capillary?
answer42: Ukusiza ngokushintshana kwegesi nezakhamzimba kanye nokukhuthaza ukusabalala koketshezi esikhaleni esingaphakathi kwesakhiwo
distractor42a: Ukuvumela ama-antibodies ukuthi angene emaseli athelelekile nokukhuthaza ukusabalala koketshezi esikhaleni esingaphakathi kweseli
distractor42b: Ukusiza ngokushintshana kwegesi nezakhamzimba nokuvimbela ukusabalala koketshezi esikhaleni esingaphakathi
distractor42c: Ukuvumela ama-antibodies ukuthi angene emaseli athelelekile nokuvimbela ukusabalala koketshezi esikhaleni esingaphakathi kweseli
question43: Izinambuzane zinezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ezivulekile lapho igazi, noma i-hemolymph, lijikeleza khona ngomgodi womzimba kunokuba lidlule emithanjeni yegazi evaliwe. Izinyoni, njengezinye izilwane ezinomgogodla, zinezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ezivaliwe lapho igazi lihlala ngaphakathi kwemithambo yegazi, imithambo yegazi, kanye nama-capillary njengoba lijikeleza. Ngokusekelwe ekwehlukeni kwazo ohlelweni lokujikeleza kwegazi, yisiphi kulezi zinkulumo ezilandelayo esichaza kangcono isidalwa esingathandwa ngokukhethwa ngesikhathi sokuntuleka kokudla?
answer43: Izinambuzane zingathandwa ngoba uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvulekile ludinga amandla amancane
distractor43a: Izinambuzane zingathandwa ngoba uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvulekile lugcina amandla
distractor43b: Izinyoni zingathandwa ngoba uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvaliwe lulahlekelwa amandla amancane okushisa
distractor43c: Izinyoni zingathandwa ngoba uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvaliwe lusebenza kahle kakhulu ekuletheni izakhamzimba
question44: Bheka uMfanekiso 31.25. Lo mdwebo ubonisa ukuthi izinambuzane zinenhliziyo ende kakhulu emzimbeni wazo wonke. Lokhu kuphambene nenhliziyo yezilwane ezinomgogodla, njengabantu, engasabalali kuwo wonke umzimba. Kungani kwakungaba yinzuzo ukuthi izinambuzane ziguqule inhliziyo ende kakhulu kunenhliziyo yezilwane ezinomgogodla esendaweni ephakathi?
answer44: Ngoba inhliziyo ende ivumela igazi ukuthi libuyele kalula enhliziyweni lisuka ezindaweni eziningi ngaphakathi komzimba
distractor44a: Ngoba inhliziyo ende ivumela igazi ukuthi lifinyelele kalula kuzo zonke izingxenye zomzimba lisuka enhliziyweni
distractor44b: Ngenxa yokuthi inhliziyo ende ivumela igazi eliningi ukuthi lifinyelele kuzo zonke izingxenye zomzimba, ivumela ukushintshaniswa kwezakhamzimba okwengeziwe
distractor44c: Ngoba inhliziyo ende ivumela igazi ukuthi libuyele kalula enhliziyweni lisuka emaphuzwini ambalwa ngaphakathi komzimba.
question45: Izinambuzane zinezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ezivulekile lapho igazi, noma i-hemolymph, lijikeleza khona ngomgodi womzimba kunokuba lidlule emithanjeni yegazi evaliwe. Izinyoni, njengezinye izilwane ezinomgogodla, zinezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ezivaliwe lapho igazi lihlala khona ngaphakathi kwemithambo yegazi, imithambo yegazi, kanye nama-capillaries njengoba lijikeleza. Izinambuzane ziyizidalwa ezindizayo zokuqala. Izinambuzane ezinkulu zaphuma zincintisana nezinyoni zaphela. Ngokusekelwe kulolu lwazi, iyiphi impikiswano engenziwa ngobukhulu bezinambuzane nezinyoni, ngokusekelwe ohlelweni lwazo lokujikeleza kwegazi?
answer45: Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvaliwe lusebenza kahle kakhulu ngobukhulu obukhulu, okwenze izinyoni zaba zinkulu kunezinambuzane
distractor45a: Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvaliwe lusebenza kahle kakhulu kunoma yisiphi isayizi, okwenze izinyoni zaba zinkulu kunezinambuzane
distractor45b: Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvulekile alukwazi ukusebenza ngemva kosayizi othile. Ngakho-ke, kwakungekho zinambuzane ezinkulu
distractor45c: Uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi oluvulekile lusebenza kahle kakhulu uma luncane ngobukhulu. Lokhu kwenza izinambuzane ezincane zinqobe izinyoni
question46: I-serum isetshenziselwa ukuxilonga nokuqapha izifo, futhi isetshenziselwa ukuhlukanisa izinhlobo zegazi. Yisiphi kulezi zinkulumo ezilandelayo esichaza kangcono i-serum?
answer46: Kuyi-plasma engenazo izinto ezibangela ukujiya kwegazi
distractor46a: Luwuketshezi oluqukethe amanzi angu-90% futhi lunezici zokubopha
distractor46c: I-serum iyinto efanayo noketshezi oluphakathi nendawo
question47: Chaza ukuthi izinhlobo zegazi zihlukaniswa kanjani komunye nomunye
answer47: Izinhlobo zegazi zihlukaniswa ngokususelwa ekubeni khona noma ukungabikho kwama-antigen ahlukene atholakala ebusweni bamaseli abomvu egazi
distractor47a: Izinhlobo zegazi zihlukaniswa ngokususelwa ekubeni khona noma ukungabikho kwama-carbohydrate ahlukene atholakala ebusweni bamaseli abomvu egazi
distractor47b: Izinhlobo zegazi zihlukaniswa ngokususelwa ekubeni khona noma ukungabikho kwamaprotheni ahlukene atholakala ngaphakathi kwamaseli abomvu egazi
distractor47c: Izinhlobo zegazi zihlukaniswa ngokususelwa ekubeni khona noma ukungabikho kwama-lipid ahlukene atholakala ebusweni bamaseli abomvu egazi.
question48: Impendulo yokuvuvukala ihilela ukwandisa ukugeleza kwegazi ezindaweni zomzimba eziqukethe amangqamuzana omzimba alwa negciwane noma into yangaphandle. Impendulo yokuvuvukala iyisibonelo se-feedback loop enhle. Ngokusekelwe kulokhu, yini engabangela ukuba impendulo yokuvuvukala ime endaweni ethile yomzimba?
answer48: Amaseli amhlophe egazi abhubhisa zonke izifo/izinto zakwamanye amazwe
distractor48a: Amaseli amhlophe egazi ayahlakazeka kude nendawo
distractor48b: Amangqamuzana egazi amhlophe engeziwe ayafika ukuze alwe namagciwane/izinto zakwamanye amazwe
distractor48c: Kudingeka amangqamuzana amhlophe egazi ambalwa ukuze kuqedwe ukulwa nesifo

question51: Bheka uMfanekiso 31.26. Lesi sithombe sibonisa inani legazi elimhlophe lomuntu olaliswe esibhedlela ngenxa yokutheleleka okukhulu. Yisiphi isimangalo esingashiwo ngokusekelwe esithombeni?
answer51: Inani lamaseli amhlophe egazi lafinyelela phezulu ngosuku lwesithathu futhi lancipha kancane kancane ngemva kwalokho
distractor51a: Inani lamaseli amhlophe egazi lahlala liphezulu njalo ngesikhathi sokulaliswa esibhedlela
distractor51b: Iseli elimhlophe legazi lomuntu ophilile alishintshi kakhulu
distractor51c: Inani lamaseli amhlophe egazi lafinyelela phezulu ngosuku lwesithupha futhi lahlala kulelo zinga kuze kube yilapho lonke isikhathi sokuhlala esibhedlela.
question52: Bheka uMfanekiso 31.27. Umdwebo ukhombisa ingxenye evundlile yomthambo nomthambo. Uyini umsebenzi we-tunica externa futhi kungani ijiyile emthambo kunasemthambo?
answer52: Ingaphandle le-tunica livikela umthambo ekugugeni nasekudabukeni futhi liphinde lisekele umthambo. Lijiyile emthanjeni ukuze livikeleke ekucindezelekeni kwegazi okuphezulu okutholakala emithanjeni.
distractor52a: Ingaphandle le-tunica livimbela ukunamathela kwamaseli egazi odongeni lomthambo. Lijiyile emthanjeni ukuze livikele umfutho wegazi ophezulu otholakala emithanjeni.
distractor52b: Ingaphandle le-tunica livikela umthambo ekugugeni nasekudabukeni futhi linikeza ukusekelwa komthambo. Lijiyile emthambo ukuze livikele umfutho wegazi ophansi otholakala emithanjeni.
distractor52c: Ingaphandle le-tunica livimbela ukunamathela kwamaseli egazi odongeni lomthambo. Lijiyile emthanjeni ukuze livikele umfutho wegazi ophansi otholakala emithanjeni.

chapterContent:
Isiphakamiso sokusetshenziswa kwamanzi nsuku zonke kubantu yizingilazi zamanzi eziyisishiyagalombili kuya kweziyishumi. Ukuze kufezwe ibhalansi enempilo, umzimba womuntu kufanele ukhiphe izingilazi zamanzi eziyisishiyagalombili kuya kweziyishumi nsuku zonke. Lokhu kwenzeka ngezinqubo zokuchama, ukuphuma endle, ukujuluka, kanye nokuphefumula kancane. Izitho zomzimba womuntu zicwiliswa oketshezini olugcinwa ekushiseni okulinganayo, i-pH, kanye nokuhlushwa kwe-solute, konke okubalulekile kwe-homeostasis. Izinhlayiya eziketshezini zomzimba ikakhulukazi usawoti wamaminerali noshukela, futhi ukulawulwa kwe-osmotic inqubo lapho usawoti wamaminerali namanzi kugcinwa khona ngokulinganayo. I-homeostasis ye-Osmotic igcinwa naphezu kwethonya lezinto zangaphandle njengokushisa, ukudla, kanye nezimo zezulu.

 Ibhalansi ye-Osmotic ibaluleke kakhulu ebuchosheni. Ubuchopho bungu-80% wamanzi, futhi ibhalansi ye-osmotic phakathi kwamanzi noketshezi lomgogodla ibalulekile ekusebenzeni kahle kobuchopho. Amanzi amaningi noma amancane kakhulu angabangela izimo zezokwelapha ezinzima. Abacwaningi basanda kuthola indlela elawula ukugeleza kwamanzi phakathi kwamangqamuzana obuchopho. Ijubane lokugeleza kwamanzi lilawulwa yiziteshi zamanzi ezibizwa ngokuthi iziteshi ze-aquaporin, ezilawulwa yi-neurotransmitter ebizwa ngokuthi i-gamma-aminobutyric acid. Bheka Umfanekiso 32.1
question1: Iyini injongo eyinhloko yokulawulwa kwe-osmotic emzimbeni womuntu?
answer1: Ukugcina ibhalansi yamanzi nosawoti wamaminerali oketshezini lomzimba
distractor1a: Ukwandisa inani likashukela eligcinwe ezicutshini zomzimba
distractor1c: Ukugcina izinga lokushisa lomzimba kuphela ngaphandle kokulawula izixazululo
question2: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okusiza umzimba womuntu ukuthi ulondoloze ibhalansi yamanzi?
answer2: Ukuchama, ukuthulula, ukujuluka, nokuphefumula
distractor2a: Ukugaya ukudla, ukujikeleza kwegazi, kanye nokufinyela kwemisipha kuphela
question3: Kungani ibhalansi ye-osmotic ibalulekile ebuchosheni?
answer3: Ubuchopho buqukethe inani elikhulu lamanzi, futhi kudingeka ibhalansi efanele yamanzi ukuze ubuchopho busebenze kahle.
distractor3a: Ubuchopho abunamanzi futhi buthembele kuphela kusawoti wamaminerali
distractor3b: Ubuchopho budinga ukungalingani kwe-osmotic ukuze kugcinwe izimpawu zikagesi
distractor3c: Ubuchopho bulawula izinga lokushisa lomzimba ngokushintshana komoya-mpilo
question4: Yiziphi izinto eziyinhloko ezibangela ukungalingani kwe-osmotic emzimbeni?
answer4: Usawoti wamaminerali noshukela
question5: Yini elawula ukuhamba kwamanzi phakathi kwamangqamuzana obuchopho?
answer5: Iziteshi ze-Aquaporin ezilawulwa yi-neurotransmitter gamma-aminobutyric acid
distractor5c: Imithambo yegazi ilawulwa kuphela ukushisa komzimba
question6: Yiziphi izici zangaphandle ezingathonya i-osmotic homeostasis?
answer6: Izinga lokushisa, ukudla, kanye nezimo zezulu

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.1 Ukulawulwa Nokulinganiswa Kwe-Osmotic | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.1 Osmoregulation and Osmotic Balance | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluningi kulesi sahluko alukho ngaphakathi kwe-AP®. Kodwa-ke, lesi sahluko sigcwele izibonelo ezibonisayo ezisebenza emiqondweni esiyihlolile ngaphambilini, okuhlanganisa i-chemistry, isakhiwo se-plasma cell membrane, kanye nokuhamba kwama-molecule kuwo wonke ama-membrane. Unalokhu engqondweni, kuyasiza ukuqonda ukuthi umzimba womuntu, ikakhulukazi uhlelo lokukhipha, lugcina kanjani i-osmotic homeostasis naphezu kwethonya lezinto zangaphandle njengokushisa, ukudla, kanye nezimo zemvelo ezahlukahlukene. Isibonelo, uma siphuza izingilazi zamanzi eziyisishiyagalombili kuya kweziyishumi ngosuku, umzimba womuntu ukhipha lawo manzi ngokuchama, ukuthulula, ukujuluka, kanye, ngezinga elincane, ukuphefumula.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yoHlaka Lwezifundo Zebhayoloji lwe-AP®. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.B
Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye ne-homeostasis enamandla kudinga ukuthi iseli lidale futhi lilondoloze izindawo zangaphakathi ezihlukile endaweni yazo yangaphandle.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.B.1 Ama-membrane eseli angena kalula ngenxa yesakhiwo sawo.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.1 Umfundi angakha izethulo namamodeli ezehlakalo nezinhlelo zemvelo noma ezenziwe ngabantu kulesi sizinda.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
7.1 Umfundi angaxhumanisa izehlakalo namamodeli kuzo zonke izikali zendawo nezesikhathi.
Umkhuba Wesayensi
7.2 Umfundi angaxhumanisa imiqondo ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwesizinda (ama-domain) ukuze ahlanganise noma achaze ukuqonda okuhlala njalo kanye/noma imibono emikhulu.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.11 Umfundi uyakwazi ukwakha amamodeli axhumanisa ukunyakaza kwama-molecule phezu kwe-membrane nesakhiwo se-membrane kanye nomsebenzi.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.B.2 Ukukhula kanye ne-homeostasis enamandla kugcinwa ukunyakaza okuqhubekayo kwama-molecule phezu kwe-membrane.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.12 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi ukuze ahlole ukuthi i-homeostasis enamandla igcinwa ukunyakaza okusebenzayo kwama-molecule phezu kwe-membrane.

 I-Osmosis ukusabalala kwamanzi kulwelwesi ngenxa yokucindezeleka kwe-osmotic okubangelwa ukungalingani kwama-molecule kuzo zombili izinhlangothi zelwelwesi. I-Osmoregulation inqubo yokugcinwa kwebhalansi kasawoti namanzi (ibhalansi ye-osmotic) kulwelwesi ngaphakathi koketshezi lomzimba, olwakhiwe ngamanzi, kanye nama-electrolyte nama-non-electrolyte. I-electrolyte iyi-solute ehlukana ibe ama-ion uma incibilika emanzini. I-non-electrolyte, ngokuphambene, ayihlukani ibe ama-ion ngesikhathi sokuncibilika kwamanzi. Womabili ama-electrolyte nama-non-electrolyte anegalelo ebhalansini ye-osmotic. Uketshezi lomzimba luhlanganisa i-plasma yegazi, i-cytosol ngaphakathi kwamaseli, kanye noketshezi oluphakathi, uketshezi olukhona ezikhaleni eziphakathi kwamaseli nezicubu zomzimba. Ulwelwesi lomzimba (njenge-pleural, serous, kanye nolwelwesi lweseli) lulwelwesi olungena kancane. Ulwelwesi olungena kancane lungena kancane (noma luvumela) ezinhlotsheni ezithile zolwelwesi namanzi. Izixazululo ezinhlangothini ezimbili ze-membrane engena kancane zivame ukulingana ekugxilweni kwe-solute ngokuhamba kwezingxube kanye/noma amanzi kulo lonke ulwelwesi. Njengoba kubonwe kuMfanekiso 32.2, iseli elifakwe emanzini livame ukuvuvukala ngenxa yokutholakala kwamanzi endaweni engaphansi kosawoti noma enosawoti ophansi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, iseli elifakwe esixazululweni esinosawoti ophakeme livame ukwenza ulwelwesi lubune ngenxa yokulahlekelwa amanzi endaweni engaphansi kosawoti noma enosawoti ophakeme. Amaseli e-Isotonic anokugxilwa okulinganayo kwezingxube ngaphakathi nangaphandle kweseli; lokhu kulinganisa ingcindezi ye-osmotic kuzo zombili izinhlangothi ze-membrane yeseli okuyi-membrane engena kancane.

 Umzimba awukho wodwa. Kukhona ukungena okuqhubekayo kwamanzi nama-electrolyte ohlelweni. Ngenkathi i-osmoregulation itholakala kuwo wonke ama-membrane emzimbeni, ama-electrolyte amaningi kanye nokungcola kuyathuthwa kuya ezinso futhi kukhishwe, okusiza ukugcina ibhalansi ye-osmotic
question1: Kuyini i-osmosis?
answer1: Ukusabalala kwamanzi kulwelwesi ngenxa yokucindezela kwe-osmotic okubangelwa ukungalingani kwama-molecule kuzo zombili izinhlangothi zelwelwesi
distractor1b: Ukuqhekeka kwe-solutes kube ama-molecule amancane ngaphakathi kwamaseli
question2: Iyini inhloso ye-osmoregulation?
answer2: Ukugcina usawoti namanzi ebhalansi phakathi kwama-membrane emzimbeni oketshezi
distractor2a: Ukwandisa ukuhlushwa kwazo zonke izinyibilikisi ngaphakathi kwamaseli
distractor2b: Ukuvimbela noma yikuphi ukunyakaza kwama-molecule kuwo wonke ama-membrane
question3: Iyini i-electrolyte?
answer3: I-solute ehlukana ibe ama-ion uma incibilikiswa emanzini
question4: Uyini umehluko phakathi kwama-electrolyte nama-non-electrolyte?
answer4: Ama-electrolyte ayahlukana abe ama-ion uma encibilikiswa emanzini, kuyilapho ama-non-electrolyte engahlukani
distractor4b: Ama-electrolyte ahamba nge-membrane, kuyilapho ama-non-electrolyte engakwazi ukuncibilika emanzini
distractor4c: Ama-electrolyte atholakala egazini kuphela, kanti ama-non-electrolyte atholakala emaseli kuphela.
question5: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuchaza ulwelwesi olungena kancane emanzini?
answer5: I-membrane evumela ukuthi ezinye izinto ezincibilikayo namanzi zidlule ngenkathi ivimbela ezinye
distractor5a: I-membrane evumela zonke izinto ukuthi zidlule ngokukhululeka
distractor5b: I-membrane evimbela konke ukuhamba kwamanzi kanye nezincibilikisi
question6: Kwenzekani ngeseli elibekwe kusisombululo se-hypotonic?
answer6: Iseli lithola amanzi futhi likhukhumale ngoba ikhambi elizungezile linokuqukethwe okuncishisiwe okuphansi
distractor6a: Iseli lilahlekelwa amanzi futhi libune ngoba ikhambi elizungezile linokuqukethwe okuphezulu kwe-solute
distractor6b: Iseli alishintshi ngoba amanzi awakwazi ukuwela ulwelwesi
distractor6c: Iseli lilahlekelwa yiwo wonke ama-electrolyte futhi liyeke ukusebenza
question7: Kwenzekani ngeseli elifakwe kwisisombululo se-hypertonic?
answer7: Iseli lilahlekelwa amanzi futhi libune ngoba ikhambi elizungezile linokuqukethwe okuphezulu kwe-solute
distractor7a: Iseli lithola amanzi futhi likhukhumale ngoba ikhambi elizungezile linokuqukethwe okuncishisiwe okuphansi
distractor7b: Iseli alishintshi ngoba i-solutes ayikwazi ukuthinta ukunyakaza kwamanzi
distractor7c: Iseli lihlukana ngokushesha ukuze libuyisele ibhalansi
question8: Yini echaza ikhambi le-isotonic?
answer8: Isixazululo lapho amazinga e-solute alingana ngaphakathi nangaphandle kweseli, okudala ingcindezi efanayo ye-osmotic
distractor8a: Isixazululo esinokuqukethwe okuphezulu kwe-solute ngaphandle kweseli okubangela ukulahleka kwamanzi
distractor8b: Isixazululo esinokuqukethwe okuphansi kwe-solute ngaphandle kweseli okubangela ukwanda kwamanzi
distractor8c: Isixazululo lapho amanzi engakwazi ukuwela khona ulwelwesi lweseli
question9: Umzimba womuntu ulondoloza kanjani ibhalansi ye-osmotic naphezu kwezinguquko emvelweni?
answer9: Ngokusebenzisa i-osmoregulation kuwo wonke ama-membrane kanye nokukhishwa kwama-electrolyte amaningi kanye nokungcola yizinso
distractor9a: Ngokuvimbela konke ukuhamba kwamanzi kanye ne-electrolyte phakathi kwamaseli
distractor9b: Ngokugcina wonke amanzi asele unomphela ngaphakathi kwamaseli
question10: Yimaphi amanzi adingekayo emzimbeni adingekayo ebhalansini ye-osmotic?
answer10: I-plasma yegazi, i-cytosol ngaphakathi kwamaseli, kanye noketshezi oluphakathi
distractor10a: I-plasma yegazi kanye noketshezi lokugaya ukudla kuphela
distractor10b: Uketshezi lwangaphakathi kweseli kuphela olungaphakathi kwe-nucleus

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.1 Ukulawulwa Nokulinganiswa Kwe-Osmotic | Isidingo Sokulawulwa Kwe-Osmotic
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.1 Osmoregulation and Osmotic Balance | Need for Osmoregulation
chapterContent:
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zihlala zisebenzisana futhi zishintshana ngamanzi nezakhamzimba nendawo ezungezile ngokusebenzisa ukudla namanzi nangokukhipha umjuluko, umchamo, kanye nendle. Ngaphandle kwendlela yokulawula ingcindezi ye-osmotic, noma lapho isifo silimaza le ndlela, kukhona ukuthambekela kokuqongelela imfucuza enobuthi namanzi, okungaba nemiphumela emibi kakhulu.

 Izinhlelo zezilwane ezincelisayo zishintshe ukuze zilawule hhayi kuphela ingcindezi ye-osmotic iyonke kuwo wonke ama-membrane, kodwa futhi nokuhlushwa okuqondile kwama-electrolyte abalulekile ezindaweni ezintathu ezinkulu zoketshezi: i-plasma yegazi, uketshezi olungaphandle kwe-extracellular, kanye noketshezi olungaphakathi kweseli. Njengoba ingcindezi ye-osmotic ilawulwa ukunyakaza kwamanzi kuwo wonke ama-membrane, umthamo wezindawo zoketshezi ungashintsha okwesikhashana. Ngenxa yokuthi i-plasma yegazi ingenye yezingxenye zoketshezi, ingcindezi ye-osmotic inomthelela oqondile ekucindezelweni kwegazi.
question1: Kungani i-osmoregulation iyadingeka ezinhlelweni zezinto eziphilayo?
answer1: Igcina ingcindezi efanele ye-osmotic futhi ivimbela ukuqongelela kwemfucuza enobuthi kanye namanzi amaningi
distractor1a: Kuvimbela ukushintshana kwamanzi nezakhamzimba endaweni ezungezile
question2: Yini engenzeka uma indlela elawula ingcindezi ye-osmotic yonakaliswa yisifo?
answer2: Imfucuza enobuthi namanzi kunganqwabelana, okubangela imiphumela eyingozi emzimbeni
distractor2a: Amaseli ayayeka ukushintshana ngezakhamzimba nendawo ezungezile ngokuphelele
distractor2b: Umfutho wegazi uhlala wehla uye ku-zero
question3: Yiziphi izingxenye ezintathu ezinkulu zoketshezi ezilawulwa yi-osmoregulation yezilwane ezincelisayo?
answer3: I-plasma yegazi, uketshezi olungaphandle kweseli, kanye noketshezi olungaphakathi kweseli
distractor3a: I-plasma yegazi, uketshezi lokugaya ukudla, kanye noketshezi lwe-lymph
distractor3b: Uketshezi lwenuzi, uketshezi lwamathambo, kanye noketshezi lwemisipha
distractor3c: I-plasma yegazi kanye noketshezi lwangaphakathi kweseli kuphela
question4: Ukulawulwa kwengcindezi ye-osmotic kuthinta kanjani amavolumu egumbi loketshezi?
answer4: Ukuhamba kwamanzi ezingxenyeni zolwelo kungashintsha okwesikhashana inani lezingxenye zolwelo
distractor4a: Ubuningi bezingxenye zoketshezi abushintshi ngoba ulwelwesi luvimba ukunyakaza kwamanzi
distractor4b: Ukunyakaza kwe-electrolyte kuphela okushintsha amavolumu egumbi loketshezi
distractor4c: Umthetho we-osmotic ususa amanzi unomphela kuzo zonke izingxenye
question5: Kungani ingcindezi ye-osmotic inomthelela oqondile ekucindezelweni kwegazi?
answer5: I-plasma yegazi iyisakhi esiyinhloko soketshezi, futhi izinguquko ekulinganisweni kwamanzi zingathinta ivolumu yegazi kanye nomfutho wegazi
distractor5a: Umfutho wegazi ulawulwa kuphela ngokukhiqizwa kwamangqamuzana egazi abomvu
distractor5b: Ingcindezi ye-osmotic ithinta kuphela uketshezi olungaphakathi kweseli hhayi i-plasma yegazi
distractor5c: Umfutho wegazi awuhlobene nokuhamba kwamanzi kuwo wonke ama-membrane
question6: Izilwane zishintshana kanjani ngamanzi nezakhamzimba nendawo ezikuyo?
answer6: Ngokudla ukudla namanzi kanye nokukhipha umjuluko, umchamo kanye nendle
distractor6b: Kuphela ngokuhamba kwegazi ngaphakathi kwemithambo yegazi
question7: Yiziphi izinto ezibalulekile ezilawulwa yizinhlelo zezilwane ezincelisayo ngaphezu kwengcindezi ye-osmotic iyonke?
answer7: Ukugxila okuqondile kwama-electrolyte abalulekile ezingxenyeni zoketshezi lomzimba
distractor7a: Ukugxila komoya-mpilo kuphela kumaseli abomvu egazi
distractor7c: Amazinga kashukela kuphela ohlelweni lokugaya ukudla

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.1 Ukulawulwa Nokulinganiswa Kwe-Osmotic | Ukuthuthwa Kwama-Electrolyte Kuwo Wonke Amaseli Eseli
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.1 Osmoregulation and Osmotic Balance | Transport of Electrolytes across Cell Membranes
chapterContent:
Ama-electrolyte, njenge-sodium chloride, ayayina emanzini, okusho ukuthi ayahlukana abe yizingxenye zawo zama-ion. Emanzini, i-sodium chloride (NaCl), iyahlukana ibe yi-sodium ion (Na+) kanye ne-chloride ion (Cl–). Ama-ion abaluleke kakhulu, okugxilwa kwawo kulawulwa kakhulu oketshezini lomzimba, yi-cations sodium (Na+), i-potassium (K+), i-calcium (Ca+2), i-magnesium (Mg+2), kanye ne-anion chloride (Cl–), i-carbonate (CO3–2), i-bicarbonate (HCO3–), kanye ne-phosphate (PO3–). Ama-electrolyte ayalahleka emzimbeni ngesikhathi sokuchama nokujuluka. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, abasubathi bakhuthazwa ukuthi bathathe indawo yama-electrolyte noketshezi ngezikhathi zomsebenzi owandayo nokujuluka.

 Ukucindezela kwe-osmotic kuthonywa ukugcwala kwama-solute esixazululweni. Kuhambisana ngqo nenani lama-athomu noma ama-molecule axubile futhi akuxhomekile kusayizi wama-molecule axubile. Ngenxa yokuthi ama-electrolyte ayahlukana abe yizingxenye zawo zama-ion, empeleni, afaka izinhlayiya eziningi ezincibilikayo esixazululweni futhi abe nomthelela omkhulu ekucindezelweni kwe-osmotic, ngesisindo ngasinye kune-com amakhilogremu engahlukani emanzini, njenge-glucose.

 Amanzi angadlula kuma-membrane ngokusabalala okungenamsebenzi. Uma ama-ion e-electrolyte engasabalala okungenamsebenzi kuwo wonke ama-membrane, bekungeke kwenzeke ukugcina ukugcwala okuthile kwama-ion endaweni ngayinye yoketshezi; ngakho-ke adinga izindlela ezikhethekile zokuwela ama-membrane angangena kalula emzimbeni. Lokhu kuhamba kungenziwa ngokusabalala okungenamsebenzi kanye nokuthuthwa okusebenzayo. Ukusabalala okwenziwa lula kudinga iziteshi ezisekelwe kumaprotheni zokuhambisa i-solute. Ukuthuthwa okusebenzayo kudinga amandla ngesimo sokuguqulwa kwe-ATP, amaprotheni okuthwala, noma amaphampu ukuze kuthuthwe ama-ion ngokumelene ne-gradient yokuhlushwa
question1: Kwenzekani uma i-sodium chloride (NaCl) incibilika emanzini?
answer1: Ihlukana ibe ama-ion e-sodium (Na+) kanye nama-ion e-chloride (Cl−)
question2: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okulawulwa ama-cation abalulekile oketshezini lomzimba?
answer2: Ama-ion e-sodium, potassium, calcium, kanye ne-magnesium
question3: Kungani abasubathi bekhuthazwa ukuthi bathathe indawo yama-electrolyte ngezikhathi zomsebenzi owandisiwe?
answer3: Ama-electrolyte alahleka emzimbeni ngokuchama nokujuluka
distractor3c: Ama-electrolyte aguqulwa abe amaprotheni ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca
question4: Yini enquma umphumela we-solute ekucindezelweni kwe-osmotic?
answer4: Inani lezinhlayiya ezincibilikayo esixazululweni
question5: Kungani ama-electrolyte enomthelela omkhulu ekucindezelweni kwe-osmotic kune-non-electrolytes njenge-glucose?
answer5: Ama-electrolyte ahlukana abe ama-ion amaningi, okwandisa inani lezinhlayiya ezincibilikayo esixazululweni
distractor5b: Ama-electrolyte avimbela amanzi ukuthi ahambe phezu kwe-membrane
question6: Kungani ama-electrolyte engakwazi ukusabalala ngokukhululeka kuwo wonke ama-membrane eseli?
answer6: Ukusabalala kwamahhala kuzovimbela amaseli ukuthi angagcini amazinga athile e-ion ezindaweni ezahlukene zoketshezi.
distractor6a: Ama-electrolyte makhulu kakhulu ukuthi angancibilika emanzini
distractor6c: Ukusabalala kwamahhala kuzomisa konke ukuhamba kwamanzi
question7: Yimuphi umshini wokuthutha osebenzisa iziteshi zamaprotheni kodwa ongadingi ukufakwa kwamandla ngqo?
answer7: Ukusabalala okulungiselelwe
question8: Yini edingekayo ukuze kuthuthwe ama-electrolyte asebenzayo kuwo wonke ama-membrane eseli?
answer8: Amandla avela ku-ATP, amaprotheni okuthwala, noma amaphampu ukuhambisa ama-ion ngokumelene ne-gradient yawo yokuhlushwa
distractor8b: Ukuhamba kusuka ekugxilweni okuphezulu kuya ekugxilweni okuphansi ngaphandle kwamaprotheni
question9: I-active transport ihambisa kanjani ama-ion uma kuqhathaniswa ne-concentration gradient yawo?
answer9: Ihambisa ama-ion ngokumelene ne-gradient yokuhlushwa
distractor9a: Ihambisa ama-ion kuphela kusuka ekugxilweni okuphezulu kuya ekugxilweni okuphansi
distractor9c: Ihambisa ama-molecule amanzi kuphela phezu kwe-membrane
question10: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo se-electrolyte?
answer10: I-sodium chloride (NaCl)
distractor10a: I-glucose

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.1 Ukulawulwa Nokulinganiswa Kwe-Osmotic | Umqondo We-Osmolality Nokulingana Okulinganayo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.1 Osmoregulation and Osmotic Balance | Concept of Osmolality and Milliequivalent
chapterContent:
Ukuze kubalwe ingcindezi ye-osmotic, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amazinga e-solute alinganiswa kanjani. Iyunithi yokulinganisa ama-solute yi-mole. I-mole eyodwa ichazwa njengesisindo sama-molecule egremu se-solute. Isibonelo, isisindo sama-molecule se-sodium chloride singama-58.44. Ngakho-ke, i-mole eyodwa ye-sodium chloride inesisindo esingu-58.44 amagremu . I-molarity yesisombululo yinani lama-moles e-solute ngelitha lesisombululo. I-molality yesisombululo yinani lama-moles e-solute ngekhilogramu ye-solvent. Uma i-solvent ingamanzi, ikhilogramu elilodwa lamanzi lilingana nelitha elilodwa lamanzi. Ngenkathi i-molarity kanye ne-molality kusetshenziswa ukuveza ukuhlushwa kwezixazululo, amazinga e-electrolyte avame ukuvezwa ngokwe-milliequivalents ngelitha (mEq/L): i-mEq/L ilingana nokuhlushwa kwama-ion (kuma-millimoles) okuphindaphindwe ngenani lamashaji kagesi ku-ion. Iyunithi ye-milliequivalent icabangela ama-ion akhona esixazululweni (njengoba ama-electrolyte akha ama-ion ezixazululweni zamanzi) kanye nokushaja kuma-ion.

 Ngakho-ke, kuma-ion aneshaja elilodwa, i-milliequivalent eyodwa ilingana ne-millimole eyodwa. Kuma-ion aneshaja amabili (njenge-calcium), i-milliequivalent eyodwa ilingana nama-millimole angu-0.5. Enye iyunithi yokubonakaliswa kokuhlushwa kwe-electrolyte yi-milliosmole (mOsm), okuyinani lama-milliequivalent e-solute ngekhilogramu ngayinye ye-solvent. Uketshezi lomzimba luvame ukugcinwa ngaphakathi kwebanga eliphakathi kuka-280 kuya ku-300 mOsm.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.1 Ukulawulwa Nokulinganiswa Kwe-Osmotic | Ama-Osmoregulators nama-Osmoconformers
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.1 Osmoregulation and Osmotic Balance | Osmoregulators and Osmoconformers
chapterContent:
Abantu abalahleka olwandle ngaphandle kwamanzi ahlanzekile okuphuza basengozini yokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni ngoba umzimba womuntu awukwazi ukuzivumelanisa nokuphuza amanzi olwandle, okuyinto enamandla kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa noketshezi lomzimba. Izinto eziphilayo ezifana ne-goldfish ezingabekezelela usawoti omncane kuphela zibizwa ngokuthi i-stenohaline. Cishe amaphesenti angama-90 azo zonke izinhlanzi ezinamathambo zikhawulelwe emanzini ahlanzekile noma emanzini olwandle. Azikwazi ukulawula i-osmotic endaweni ephambene. Nokho, kungenzeka ukuthi izinhlanzi ezimbalwa ezifana ne-salmon zichithe ingxenye yokuphila kwazo emanzini ahlanzekile futhi ingxenye yazo emanzini olwandle. Izinto eziphilayo ezifana ne-salmon ne-molly ezingabekezelela usawoti obanzi kakhulu zibizwa ngokuthi izinto eziphilayo ze-euryhaline. Lokhu kungenzeka ngoba ezinye izinhlanzi ziye zashintsha izindlela ze-osmoregulatory ukuze ziphile kuzo zonke izinhlobo zezindawo zasemanzini. Uma zihlala emanzini ahlanzekile, imizimba yazo ivame ukuthatha amanzi ngoba indawo inamandla kakhulu, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 32.3a. Ezindaweni ezinjalo ezinamandla kakhulu, lezi zinhlanzi aziphuzi amanzi amaningi. Esikhundleni salokho, zidlula umchamo omningi oncibilikisiwe kakhulu, futhi zithola ibhalansi ye-electrolyte ngokuthuthwa okusebenzayo kosawoti ngokusebenzisa ama-gill. Uma zithuthela endaweni yolwandle ene-hypertonic, lezi zinhlanzi ziqala ukuphuza amanzi olwandle; zikhipha usawoti owengeziwe ngokusebenzisa ama-gill azo kanye nomchamo wazo, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 32.3b. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izilwane eziningi zasolwandle ezingenamgogodla zingase zibe ne-isotonic namanzi olwandle (ama-osmoconformers). Ukuhlushwa koketshezi lomzimba wazo kuhambisana noshintsho ekuhlushweni kwamanzi olwandle. Ukwakheka kosawoti wegazi lezinhlanzi ezine-cartilaginous kufana nezinhlanzi ezinamathambo; noma kunjalo, igazi loshaka liqukethe i-organic com amakhilogremu urea kanye ne-trimethylamine oxide (TMAO). Lokhu akusho ukuthi ukwakheka kwazo kwe-electrolyte kufana nokwamanzi olwandle. Zifinyelela i-isotonic nolwandle ngokugcina amazinga amakhulu e-urea. Lezi zilwane ezikhipha i-urea zibizwa ngokuthi izilwane ze-ureotelic. I-TMAO izinzisa amaprotheni lapho kukhona amazinga aphezulu e-urea, ivimbela ukuphazamiseka kwezibopho ze-peptide okungenzeka kwezinye izilwane ezivezwe emazingeni afanayo e-urea. Oshaka bayizinhlanzi ezidla inyama ezine-rectal gland ukuze zikhiphe usawoti futhi zisize ekulawuleni i-osmoregulation.

 Iziguli ezisebenzisa i-dialysis zisebenzisa imishini ye-dialysis efana nale eboniswe lapha. Igazi labo lidlula ngepayipi elicwiliswa esixazululweni, kanti izindonga zepayipi empeleni ziyizinhlayiya ezingangeni manzi. Isixazululo senzelwe ukuthi i-urea, umkhiqizo oyinhloko wemfucuza okhiqizwa abantu, ikhishwe egazini ngokusabalala. Udonga lwepayipi olungangeni manzi luvumela i-urea ukuthi ingene, kodwa igcina izingxenye ezinkulu zegazi, njengeprotheni namaseli egazi, ngaphakathi kwepayipi. Igazi elihlanziwe ekugcineni libuyiselwa emzimbeni

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.1 Ukulawulwa Nokulinganiswa Kwe-Osmotic | Ukuxhumeka Komsebenzi | Uchwepheshe We-Dialysis
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.1 Osmoregulation and Osmotic Balance | Career Connection | Dialysis Technician
chapterContent:
I-Dialysis inqubo yezokwelapha yokususa ukungcola namanzi angaphezulu egazini ngokusabalala kanye nokuhluzwa kwe-ultrafiltration. Uma ukusebenza kwezinso kwehluleka, i-dialysis kumele yenziwe ukuze kukhishwe ukungcola emzimbeni ngokwenziwa. Lena inqubo ebalulekile yokugcina iziguli ziphila. Kwezinye izimo, iziguli zithola i-dialysis yokwenziwa kuze kube yilapho zifanelekela ukufakelwa izinso. Kwabanye abangebona abantu abazofakelwa izinso, i-dialysis iyinto edingekayo impilo yonke.

 Ochwepheshe be-Dialysis bavame ukusebenza ezibhedlela nasemakliniki. Ngenkathi ezinye izindima kulo mkhakha zifaka phakathi ukuthuthukiswa nokugcinwa kwemishini, ochwepheshe abaningi be-dialysis basebenza ekunakekelweni kweziguli ngqo. Imisebenzi yabo yomsebenzi, evame ukwenzeka ngaphansi kokuqondisa ngqo komhlengikazi obhalisiwe, igxile ekuhlinzekeni ukwelashwa kwe-dialysis. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukubuyekeza umlando wesiguli kanye nesimo samanje, ukuhlola nokuphendula izidingo zesiguli ngaphambi nangesikhathi sokwelashwa, kanye nokuqapha inqubo ye-dialysis. Ukwelashwa kungafaka phakathi ukuthatha nokubika izimpawu ezibalulekile zesiguli nokulungiselela izixazululo nemishini ukuqinisekisa izinqubo ezinembile nezingenasici.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.2 Izinso Nezitho Ezilawula I-Osmoregulatory | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.2 The Kidneys and Osmoregulatory Organs | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluningi kulesi sigaba alukho ngaphansi kwe-AP®. Nakuba uhlelo lwezifundo lungadingi ukuthi ube nolwazi oluningiliziwe mayelana nesakhiwo kanye nokusebenza kwezinso, ukufunda ukuthi sihlunga kanjani igazi ukuze sisuse ukungcola—ngesikhathi sigcina amanzi abalulekile nezinye izinto—kunikeza ithuba lokusebenzisa imiqondo esiyihlolile ngaphambilini. Ukuntuleka kokusebenza kwezinso kungaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yethu.

 Ngokusebenzisana nezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi kanye nezinhlelo ze-endocrine, uhlelo lokukhipha indle lomuntu lusebenza imisebenzi eminingana: ukukhipha ukungcola kwe-metabolic, ukugcinwa kwebhalansi yamanzi nosawoti (i-osmoregulation), ukugcinwa kwebhalansi ye-pH, kanye nokukhiqizwa kwama-hormone. Izitho zohlelo yizinso, ama-ureter, isinyi somchamo, kanye ne-urethra. Amaseli akhethekile ezinso abizwa ngokuthi ama-nephron (akufanele adidaniswe nama-neurons ohlelo lwezinzwa) ahlotshaniswa eduze nama-capillary. Ukwakheka komchamo ngama-nephron kuhilela izinyathelo ezintathu: ukuhlunga, lapho amanzi, izakhamzimba, kanye nokungcola kudlula egazini kuye ku-nephron; ukumuncwa kabusha, lapho izakhamzimba ezifana ne-glucose kanye namanzi amaningi zibuyiswa khona egazini; kanye nokukhiqizwa, lapho imfucuza eyengeziwe kanye ne-H+ kufakwa khona emchameni ukuze kugcinwe i-pH ye-homeostatic. Izinqubo zokusabalala, i-osmosis, kanye nokuthuthwa okusebenzayo kuqinisekisa ukuthi umchamo okhishwa emzimbeni une-hypertonic, ngaleyo ndlela kuvimbele ukuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni. Isibonelo, amanzi aphinde amuncwa kuwo wonke ama-nephron tubules abuyele kuma-capillaries nge-osmosis, kanti kwenye ingxenye ye-tubule (i-ascending loop ye-Henle), i-Na+ kanye ne-Cl– zithuthwa ngenkuthalo ziye ku-interstitial fluid.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 4 yoHlaka Lwezifundo lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 4
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo zinezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.A
Ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo kuholela ezimpahleni eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.4 Izinto eziphilayo zibonisa izakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi ngenxa yokusebenzisana phakathi kwezingxenye zazo eziyinhloko.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo nezibikezelo mayelana nezehlakalo zemvelo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi namamodeli.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.9 Umfundi uyakwazi ukubikezela imiphumela yoshintsho ezingxenyeni zesistimu yezinto eziphilayo ekusebenzeni kwezinto eziphilayo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.4 Izinto eziphilayo zibonisa izakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi ngenxa yokusebenzisana phakathi kwezingxenye zazo eziyinhloko.
Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.3 Umfundi angalungisa izethulo namamodeli ezehlakalo zemvelo noma ezenziwe ngabantu kanye nezinhlelo endaweni.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.10 Umfundi uyakwazi ukucwenga izethulo namamodeli ukuze abonise ubunkimbinkimbi bezinto eziphilayo ngenxa yokusebenzisana kwezingxenye eziyinhloko.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.B
Ukuncintisana nokubambisana kuyizinto ezibalulekile zezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.B.2 Ukusebenzisana ngokubambisana phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo kukhuthaza ukusebenza kahle ekusetshenzisweni kwamandla nezinto.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.18 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya ukuthi ukusebenzisana ngokubambisana phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo kukhuthaza ukusebenza kahle kanjani ekusetshenzisweni kwamandla nezinto.

 Nakuba izinso ziyilungu eliyinhloko le-osmoregulatory, isikhumba namaphaphu nakho kudlala indima kule nqubo. Amanzi nama-electrolyte alahleka ngezindlala zokujuluka esikhumbeni, okusiza ukumanzisa nokupholisa ubuso besikhumba, kuyilapho amaphaphu ekhipha amanzi amancane ngendlela yokukhishwa kwamafinyila nangokuhwamuka komhwamuko wamanzi.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.2 Izinso Nezitho Ezisebenzisa I-Osmoregulatory | Izinso: Isitho Esiyinhloko Se-Osmoregulatory
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.2 The Kidneys and Osmoregulatory Organs | Kidneys: The Main Osmoregulatory Organ
chapterContent: Izinso, eziboniswe kuMfanekiso 32.5, ziyizitho ezimbili ezimise okwebhontshisi ezitholakala ngezansi nangemuva kwesibindi emgodini we-peritoneal. Izindlala ze-adrenal zihlala phezu kwezinso ngayinye futhi zibizwa nangokuthi izindlala ze-suprarenal. Izinso zihlunga igazi futhi zilihlanze. Lonke igazi emzimbeni womuntu lihlungwa kaningi ngosuku yizinso; lezi zitho zisebenzisa cishe amaphesenti angama-25 omoya-mpilo odonswa ngamaphaphu ukuze zenze lo msebenzi. Umoya-mpilo uvumela amangqamuzana ezinso ukuthi akhiqize amandla amakhemikhali ngendlela ye-ATP ngokuphefumula kwe-aerobic. I-filtrate ephuma ezinso ibizwa ngokuthi umchamo

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.2 Izinso Nezitho Ezilawula I-Osmoregulatory | Isakhiwo Sezinso
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.2 The Kidneys and Osmoregulatory Organs | Kidney Structure
chapterContent:
Ngaphandle, izinso zizungezwe izendlalelo ezintathu, eziboniswe kuMfanekiso 32.6. Isendlalelo sangaphandle yisendlalelo sezicubu eziqinile ezixhumanisayo esibizwa ngokuthi i-renal fascia. Isendlalelo sesibili sibizwa ngokuthi i-perirenal fat capsule, esiza ekuqiniseni izinso endaweni yazo. Isendlalelo sesithathu nesingaphakathi yi-renal capsule. Ngaphakathi, izinso zinezindawo ezintathu—i-cortex yangaphandle, i-medulla ephakathi, kanye ne-renal pelvis esifundeni esibizwa ngokuthi i-hilum yezinso. I-hilum yingxenye egobile yesimo sebhontshisi lapho imithambo yegazi nemizwa kungena futhi kuphume khona ezinso; futhi yindawo yokuphuma yama-ureters. I-renal cortex iyi-granular ngenxa yokuba khona kwama-nephron—iyunithi esebenzayo yezinso. I-medulla yakhiwe yizinqwaba zezicubu ze-pyramidal, ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-renal pyramid. Phakathi kwama-pyramid kunezikhala ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-renal columns lapho imithambo yegazi idlula khona. Amaphuzu ama-pyramid, abizwa ngokuthi ama-renal papillae, akhomba ngase-renal pelvis. Ngokwesilinganiso, kunezipiramidi zezinso eziyisishiyagalombili ezinso ngayinye. Amaphiramidi ezinso kanye nesifunda se-cortical esiseduze abizwa ngokuthi ama-lobes ezinso. I-renal pelvis iholela ku-ureter ngaphandle kwezinso. Ngaphakathi kwezinso, i-renal pelvis ihlukana ibe izandiso ezimbili noma ezintathu ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-calyces amakhulu, aqhubeka nokuhlukana abe ama-calyces amancane. Ama-ureter angamapayipi aphethe umchamo aphuma ezinso futhi athululele esinyeni somchamo.

 Ngenxa yokuthi izinso zihlunga igazi, inethiwekhi yazo yemithambo yegazi iyisici esibalulekile sesakhiwo sayo nomsebenzi wayo. Imithambo, imithambo, kanye nemizwa ehlinzeka ngezinso ingena futhi iphume ku-hilum yezinso. Ukunikezwa kwegazi kwezinso kuqala ngokuhlukaniswa kwe-aorta emithanjeni yezinso (eqanjwe ngayinye ngokusekelwe esifundeni sezinso edlula kuso) futhi iphetha ngokuphuma kwemithambo yezinso ukuze ijoyine i-vena cava engaphansi. Imithambo yezinso ihlukana ibe imithambo eminingana ehlukene lapho ingena ezinso. Imithambo ngayinye ehlukene ihlukana ibe imithambo eminingana ehlukene e-interlobar bese ingena kumakholomu ezinso, ehlinzeka ngama-lobes ezinso. Imithambo ye-interlobar iyahlukana lapho kuhlangana khona i-renal cortex kanye ne-medulla ukuze kwakheke imithambo ye-arcuate. Imithambo emise okwe-arcuate bow” yakha ama-arcs phansi kwamaphiramidi e-medullary. Imithambo emise okwe-cortical radiate, njengoba negama lisho, iphuma emithanjeni emise okwe-arcuate. Imithambo emise okwe-cortical radiate ihlangana ibe ama-arterioles amaningi afferent, bese ingena kuma-capillary ahlinzeka ngama-nephron. Imithambo ilandelela indlela yemithambo futhi inamagama afanayo, ngaphandle kokuthi ayikho imithambo emise okwe-segmental.

 Njengoba kushiwo ngaphambili, iyunithi yokusebenza kwezinso yi-nephron, eboniswe kuMfanekiso 32.7. Inso ngayinye yakhiwe ngama-nephron angaphezu kwesigidi agqagqene ne-cortex yezinso, okwenza ibonakale i-granular uma ihlukaniswa nge-sagittally. Kunezinhlobo ezimbili zama-nephron—ama-cortical nephron (amaphesenti angu-85), ajule kakhulu kwi-cortex yezinso, kanye nama-juxtamedullary nephrons (amaphesenti angu-15), alele kwi-cortex yezinso eduze ne-medulla yezinso. I-nephron inezingxenye ezintathu—i-corpuscle yezinso, i-tubule yezinso, kanye nenethiwekhi yama-capillary ehlobene, evela emithanjeni emise okwe-cortical radiate.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.2 Izinso Nezitho Ze-Osmoregulatory | Isakhiwo Sezinso | I-Renal Corpuscle | I-Renal Tubule | Inethiwekhi Ye-Capillary ngaphakathi kwe-Nephron
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.2 The Kidneys and Osmoregulatory Organs | Kidney Structure | Renal Corpuscle | Renal Tubule | Capillary Network within the Nephron
chapterContent:
I-Renal Corpuscle
I-renal corpuscle, etholakala ku-renal cortex, yakhiwe inethiwekhi yama-capillary eyaziwa ngokuthi i-glomerulus kanye ne-capsule, igumbi eliyindilinga eliyizungezile, elibizwa ngokuthi i-glomerular noma i-Bowmans capsule.

 I-Renal Tubule
I-renal tubule iyisakhiwo eside nesihlanganisiwe esivela ku-glomerulus futhi singahlukaniswa sibe izingxenye ezintathu ngokusekelwe ekusebenzeni. Ingxenye yokuqala ibizwa ngokuthi i-proximal convoluted tubule (PCT) ngenxa yokusondela kwayo ku-glomerulus; ihlala ku-renal cortex. Ingxenye yesibili ibizwa ngokuthi i-loop ye-Henle, noma i-nephritic loop, ngoba yakha i-loop (enemilenze eyehlayo nekhuphukayo) edlula ku-renal medulla. Ingxenye yesithathu ye-renal tubule ibizwa ngokuthi i-distal convoluted tubule (DCT) futhi le ngxenye ikhawulelwe ku-renal cortex. I-DCT, okuyingxenye yokugcina ye-nephron, ixhuma futhi ithulule okuqukethwe kwayo emigudwini eqoqayo ehambisana namaphiramidi e-medullary. Imigudwi eqoqayo iqoqa okuqukethwe okuvela kuma-nephron amaningi bese ihlangana njengoba ingena kuma-papillae e-renal medulla.

 Inethiwekhi ye-Capillary ngaphakathi kwe-Nephron
Inethiwekhi ye-capillary evela emithanjeni yezinso inikeza i-nephron igazi elidinga ukuhlungwa. Igatsha elingena kwi-glomerulus libizwa ngokuthi i-afferent arteriole. Igatsha eliphuma kwi-glomerulus libizwa ngokuthi i-efferent arteriole. Ngaphakathi kwe-glomerulus, inethiwekhi yama-capillary ibizwa ngokuthi i-glomerular capillary bed. Uma i-efferent arteriole iphuma kwi-glomerulus, yakha inethiwekhi ye-peritubular capillary, ezungeza futhi ixhumane nezingxenye ze-renal tubule. Kuma-cortical nephrons, inethiwekhi ye-peritubular capillary izungeza i-PCT ne-DCT. Kuma-nephron e-juxtamedullary, inethiwekhi yama-capillary e-peritubular yakha inethiwekhi ezungeze umjikelezo we-Henle futhi ibizwa ngokuthi i-vasa recta

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.2 Izinso Nezitho Ze-Osmoregulatory | Umsebenzi Wezinso Ne-Physiology
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.2 The Kidneys and Osmoregulatory Organs | Kidney Function and Physiology
chapterContent: Izinso zihlunga igazi ngenqubo yezinyathelo ezintathu. Okokuqala, ama-nephron ahlunga igazi elihamba ngenethiwekhi yama-capillary ku-glomerulus. Cishe zonke izinto ezincibilikayo, ngaphandle kwamaprotheni, zihlungwa ziye ku-glomerulus ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-glomerular filtration. Okwesibili, i-filtrate iqoqwa kuma-renal tubules. Iningi lalezi zinto ezincibilikayo liphinde limuncwe ku-PCT ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-tubular reabsorption. Ku-loop ye-Henle, i-filtrate iyaqhubeka nokushintshanisa izinto ezincibilikayo namanzi ne-renal medulla kanye nenethiwekhi yama-capillary e-peritubular. Amanzi nawo aphinde amuncwe phakathi nalesi sinyathelo. Ngemuva kwalokho, ezinye izinto ezincibilikayo kanye nokungcola kukhishwa kuma-renal tubules ngesikhathi sokukhishwa kwama-tubular, okuyinqubo ephambene nokubuyiselwa kwama-tubular. Ama-collecting ducts aqoqa i-filtrate evela kuma-nephron bese ehlangana nama-papillae e-medullary. Kusukela lapha, ama-papillae aletha i-filtrate, manje ebizwa ngokuthi umchamo, kuma-calyces amancane agcina exhumene nama-ureter nge-pelvis yezinso. Le nqubo yonke iboniswe kuMfanekiso 32.8.

answer10: Ukuhlunga kwe-glomerular, ukumuncwa kabusha kwe-tubular, kanye nokukhiqizwa kwe-tubular
distractor10a: Ukukhiqizwa kwe-tubular, ukuhlunga kwe-glomerular, kanye nokumuncwa kabusha kwe-tubular

distractor10c: Ukuhlunga kwe-glomerular, ukugcinwa komchamo, kanye nokukhiqizwa kwe-tubular

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.2 Izinso Nezitho Ze-Osmoregulatory | Umsebenzi Wezinso Ne-Physiology | Ukuhlunga Kwe-Glomerular
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.2 The Kidneys and Osmoregulatory Organs | Kidney Function and Physiology | Glomerular Filtration
chapterContent: Ukuhlunga kwe-Glomerular kuhlunga iningi lezinto ezincibilikayo ngenxa yomfutho wegazi ophezulu kanye nolwelwesi olukhethekile ku-arteriole e-afferent. Umfutho wegazi ku-glomerulus ugcinwa uzimele ezintweni ezithinta umfutho wegazi wesistimu. Ukuxhumana okuvuzayo phakathi kwamaseli e-endothelial enethiwekhi ye-glomerular capillary kuvumela izinto ezincibilikayo ukuthi zidlule kalula. Zonke izinto ezincibilikayo kuma-capillary e-glomerular, ngaphandle kwama-macromolecule afana namaprotheni, zidlula ngokusabalala okungenamsebenzi. Akukho sidingo samandla kulesi sigaba senqubo yokuhlunga. Izinga lokuhlunga le-Glomerular (GFR) yivolumu ye-glomerular filtrate eyakhiwe ngomzuzu yizinso. I-GFR ilawulwa izindlela eziningi futhi iyisibonakaliso esibalulekile somsebenzi wezinso.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.2 Izinso Nezitho Ze-Osmoregulatory | Umsebenzi Wezinso Ne-Physiology | Ukumuncwa Kabusha Kwe-Tubular Nokukhishwa Kwe-Secretion
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.2 The Kidneys and Osmoregulatory Organs | Kidney Function and Physiology | Tubular Reabsorption and Secretion
chapterContent:
Ukumuncwa kabusha kwe-tubular kwenzeka engxenyeni ye-PCT ye-renal tubule. Cishe zonke izakhamzimba ziyamuncwa kabusha, futhi lokhu kwenzeka ngokuthutha okungasebenzi noma okusebenzayo. Ukumuncwa kabusha kwamanzi kanye namanye ama-electrolyte abalulekile kulawulwa futhi kungathonywa ama-hormone. I-Sodium (Na+) iyi-ion eningi kakhulu futhi iningi layo limuncwa kabusha ngokuthutha okusebenzayo bese lithuthwa liye kuma-capillary ase-peritubular. Ngenxa yokuthi i-Na+ ithuthwa ngenkuthalo iphuma kwi-tubule, amanzi ayilandela ukuze alinganise ingcindezi ye-osmotic. Amanzi aphinde amuncwe ngokuzimela kuma-capillary ase-peritubular ngenxa yokuba khona kwama-aquaporin, noma iziteshi zamanzi, ku-PCT. Lokhu kwenzeka ngenxa yomfutho wegazi ophansi kanye nengcindezi ephezulu ye-osmotic kuma-capillary ase-peritubular. Kodwa-ke, yonke i-solute inomthamo omkhulu wokuthutha futhi okungaphezulu akumuncwa kabusha.

 Ku-loop ye-Henle, ukuvuleka kwe-membrane kuyashintsha. Ilungu elihlayo lingena emanzini, hhayi ama-solutes; okuphambene nalokho kuyiqiniso ngelungu elikhuphukayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iluphu yeHenle ihlasela i-renal medulla, equkethe usawoti omningi ngokwemvelo futhi ivame ukumunca amanzi avela ku-renal tubule bese igxila ku-filtrate. Ukwehla kwe-osmotic gradient kuyanda njengoba ingena ngokujulile ku-medulla. Ngenxa yokuthi izinhlangothi ezimbili zeluphu yeHenle zenza imisebenzi ephikisanayo, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 32.9, isebenza njenge-countercurrent multiplier. I-vasa recta eyizungezile isebenza njenge-countercurrent exchanger.

 Ngesikhathi i-filtrate ifika ku-DCT, iningi lomchamo kanye nezinhlayiya seziphinde zamuncwa. Uma umzimba udinga amanzi engeziwe, wonke angaphinde amuncwa kuleli qophelo. Ukumuncwa okwengeziwe kulawulwa ama-hormone, okuzoxoxwa ngawo esigabeni esilandelayo. Ukukhishwa kwemfucuza kwenzeka ngenxa yokuntuleka kokumuncwa kabusha kuhlanganiswe nokukhiqizwa kwe-tubular. Imikhiqizo engafuneki njengemfucuza ye-metabolic, i-urea, i-uric acid, kanye nemithi ethile, ikhishwa ngokukhiqizwa kwe-tubular. Iningi lokukhishwa kweshubhu kwenzeka ku-DCT, kodwa okunye kwenzeka engxenyeni yokuqala yomsele wokuqoqa. Izinso zigcina ibhalansi ye-acid-base ngokukhipha ama-ion e-H+ amaningi.

 Nakuba izingxenye zamashubhu ezinso zibizwa ngokuthi i-proximal kanye ne-distal, engxenyeni enqamulayo yezinso, amashubhu abekwa eduze futhi athintane kanye ne-glomerulus. Lokhu kuvumela ukushintshaniswa kwezithunywa zamakhemikhali phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli. Isibonelo, i-DCT ekhuphukayo yeluphu ye-Henle inenqwaba yamaseli abizwa ngokuthi i-macula densa, athintana namaseli e-arterioles afferent abizwa ngokuthi amaseli e-juxtaglomerular. Ndawonye, amaseli e-macula densa kanye namaseli e-juxtaglomerular akha i-juxtaglomerular complex (JGC). I-JGC iyisakhiwo se-endocrine esikhipha i-enzyme renin kanye ne-hormone erythropoietin. Uma ama-hormone eqala amaseli e-macula densa ku-DCT ngenxa yokwehluka komthamo wegazi, umfutho wegazi, noma ibhalansi ye-electrolyte, la maseli angadlulisela inkinga ngokushesha kuma-capillary kuma-arterioles afferent kanye nama-efferent, angancipha noma aphumule ukushintsha izinga lokuhlunga kwe-glomerular kwezinso.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.2 Izinso Nezitho Ze-Osmoregulatory | Ukuxhumana Komsebenzi | Udokotela Wezinzwa
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.2 The Kidneys and Osmoregulatory Organs | Career Connection | Nephrologist
chapterContent:
Udokotela wezinso uyahlola futhi abhekane nezifo zezinso—zombili lezo ezibangela ukwehluleka kwezinso (njengesifo sikashukela) kanye nezimo ezibangelwa yisifo sezinso (njenge-hypertension). Umfutho wegazi, umthamo wegazi, kanye nezinguquko ekulinganisweni kwama-electrolyte kulawulwa yi-nephrologist.

 Odokotela bezinso bavame ukusebenza nabanye odokotela abathumela iziguli kubo noma babonisane nabo mayelana nokuxilongwa okuthile kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha. Iziguli zivame ukudluliselwa kudokotela wezinso ngezimpawu ezifana negazi noma iphrotheni emchameni, umfutho wegazi ophakeme kakhulu, amatshe ezinso, noma ukwehluleka kwezinso.

 I-Nephrology iyingxenye ekhethekile yezokwelapha zangaphakathi. Ukuze ube yi-nephrologist, isikole sezokwelapha silandelwa ukuqeqeshwa okwengeziwe ukuze uthole isitifiketi kwezokwelapha zangaphakathi. Iminyaka emibili noma ngaphezulu eyengeziwe ichithwa ngokukhethekile kufundwa ngezinkinga zezinso kanye nemiphumela yazo ehambisana nazo emzimbeni.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Kwe-Osmotic Nokukhipha Indle | 32.3 Izinhlelo Zokukhipha Indle | Ama-Vacuoles Agoqekayo Ezilwanyaneni Ezincane
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.3 Excretion Systems | Contractile Vacuoles in Microorganisms
chapterContent: Isici esiyisisekelo sokuphila ukuba khona kweseli. Ngamanye amazwi, iseli liyunithi elula yokusebenza yokuphila. Amabhaktheriya ayizinto eziphilayo ze-prokaryotic ezinamangqamuzana ahlukene, ezinezinqubo zokuphila eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu; noma kunjalo, ama-prokaryotes afana namabhaktheriya awaqukethe ama-vacuole aboshwe yi-membrane. Amaseli ezinto eziphilayo ezincane njengebhaktheriya, i-protozoa, kanye ne-fungi aboshwe yi-membrane membrane futhi awasebenzisela ukusebenzisana nendawo ezungezile. Amanye amaseli, kufaka phakathi amanye ama-leucocyte kubantu, ayakwazi ukugwinya ukudla nge-endocytosis—ukwakheka kwama-vesicles ngokushintsha kwe-membrane yeseli ngaphakathi kwamaseli. Ama-vesicles afanayo ayakwazi ukusebenzisana nokushintshanisa ama-metabolites nendawo engaphakathi kweseli. Kwezinye izinto eziphilayo ze-eukaryotic ezinamangqamuzana afana ne-amoeba, eziboniswe kuMfanekiso 32.10, imfucuza yeselula namanzi angaphezulu kukhishwa yi-exocytosis, lapho ama-vacuole ahlanganisiwe ehlangana ne-membrane yeseli futhi ekhipha imfucuza endaweni ezungezile. Ama-vacuole ahlanganisiwe (CV) akufanele adidaniswe nama-vacuole, agcina ukudla noma amanzi.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.3 Izinhlelo Zokukhipha | Amaseli Omlilo e-Planaria kanye ne-Nephridia Yezibungu
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.3 Excretion Systems | Flame Cells of Planaria and Nephridia of Worms
chapterContent:
Njengoba izinhlelo zamaseli amaningi zashintsha zaba nezinhlelo zezitho ezahlukanisa izidingo zomzimba, izitho ngazinye zashintsha ukuze zenze umsebenzi wokukhipha indle. I-Planaria yizibungu ezisicaba ezihlala emanzini ahlanzekile. Uhlelo lwazo lokukhipha indle luqukethe ama-tubule amabili axhunywe ohlelweni lwe-duct olunegatsha kakhulu. Amaseli akuma-tubule abizwa ngokuthi ama-flame cell (noma i-protonephridia) ngoba aneqoqo le-cilia elibukeka njengelangabi elikhanyayo uma libukwa ngaphansi kwe-microscope, njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 32.11a. I-cilia ihambisa udoti phansi kuma-tubule futhi iphume emzimbeni nge-excretory pores evuleka ebusweni bomzimba; i-cilia iphinda idonse amanzi oketshezini oluphakathi, okuvumela ukuhluzwa. Noma yiziphi izinto eziwusizo ezitholakala ngokuphinda zimuncwe. Amaseli e-flame atholakala kuma-flame worm, kufaka phakathi ama-tapeworm adla izinambuzane kanye ne-free-living planaria. Aphinde agcine ibhalansi ye-osmotic yomzimba.

 Izimpethu zomhlaba (ama-annelid) zinezakhiwo zokukhipha ukungcola ezithuthuke kancane ezibizwa nge-nephridia, eziboniswe kuMfanekiso 32.11b. I-nephridia ebili ikhona engxenyeni ngayinye yesimpethu. Zifana namaseli elangabi ngoba zine-tubule ene-cilia. Ukukhishwa kwenzeka ngembobo ebizwa nge-nephridiopore. Zithuthuke kakhulu kunamaseli elangabi ngoba zinesistimu yokuphinda zimuncwe yi-capillary network ngaphambi kokukhipha.

answer1: Amaseli elangabi (i-protonephridia)

answer5: Bagcina ibhalansi ye-osmotic
question6: Yiziphi izilwane ezine-nephridia njengezakhiwo zazo zokukhipha ukungcola?
answer6: Izibungu zomhlaba (ama-annelids)
question7: Zingaki i-nephridia ezivame ukuba khona engxenyeni ngayinye yesibungu somhlaba?
answer7: Ipheya elilodwa
question8: Iziphi izakhiwo lapho imibungu yomhlaba ikhipha khona imfucuza?
answer8: I-nephriopore
question9: I-nephridia ithuthuke kanjani kunezinhlayiya zomlilo?
answer9: Zihlanganisa ukumuncwa kabusha kweshubhu yinethiwekhi yama-capillary ngaphambi kokukhipha
distractor9b: Basebenzisa amashubhu e-Malpighian ukuze baphinde bamunce
question10: Yisiphi isitatimende esiqhathanisa kahle amaseli omlilo kanye ne-nephridia?
answer10: Zombili zisebenzisa ama-tubules acwebezelayo ukuze zikhishwe, kodwa i-nephridia iphinde ikwazi ukumunca ama-tubules ngenethiwekhi yama-capillary.
distractor10a: Zombili ziyafana ngesakhiwo kanye nomsebenzi

distractor10c: I-Nephridia itholakala ezibunjini ezisicaba, kanti amaseli omlilo atholakala ezibunjini zomhlaba.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Kwe-Osmotic Nokukhipha Indle | 32.3 Izinhlelo Zokukhipha Indle | Ama-Malpighian Tubules Ezinambuzane
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.3 Excretion Systems | Malpighian Tubules of Insects
chapterContent: Ama-tubule e-Malpighian atholakala emathunjini ezinhlobo ezithile zama-arthropod, njengenyosi eboniswe ku-Figure 32.12. Avame ukutholakala ngamabili futhi inani lama-tubule liyahlukahluka kuye ngezinhlobo zezinambuzane. Ama-tubule e-Malpighian ahlanganisiwe, okwandisa indawo yawo ebusweni, futhi ambozwe nge-microvilli ukuze aphinde amuncwe futhi agcinwe ibhalansi ye-osmotic. Ama-tubule e-Malpighian asebenza ngokubambisana nezindlala ezikhethekile odongeni lwe-rectum. Uketshezi lomzimba aluhlungwa njengasendabeni ye-nephridia; umchamo ukhiqizwa izindlela zokukhipha ama-tubule ngamaseli ambozwe ama-tubule e-Malpighian agezwa yi-hemolymph (ingxube yegazi noketshezi oluphakathi olutholakala ezinambuzaneni nakwezinye ama-arthropod kanye nezinhlobo eziningi ze-mollusk). Imfucuza ye-metabolic efana ne-uric acid isakazeka ngokukhululeka kuma-tubule. Kukhona amaphampu okushintshana ambozwe ama-tubule, athutha ngenkuthalo ama-ion e-H+ aye esitokisini kanye nama-ion e-K+ noma e-Na+ aphume; amanzi alandela kancane ukuze akhe umchamo. Ukukhiqizwa kwama-ion kushintsha ingcindezi ye-osmotic edonsela amanzi, ama-electrolyte, kanye nemfucuza ye-nitrogen (i-uric acid) kuma-tubules. Amanzi nama-electrolyte aphinde amuncwe lapho lezi zinto eziphilayo zibhekene nezimo zamanzi aphansi, futhi i-uric acid ikhishwa njenge-paste noma i-powder ejiyile. Ukungancibilikisi imfucuza emanzini kusiza lezi zinto eziphilayo ukuthi zilondoloze amanzi; lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu empilweni ezindaweni ezomile.
question1: Atholakala kuphi ama-tubules aseMalpighian?
answer1: Ukuvala amathumbu ezinye izilokazane, njengezinambuzane
question2: Yisiphi isici esisodwa sesakhiwo sama-tubules aseMalpighian esikhuphula ukusebenza kwawo kahle?
answer2: Ziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu futhi zimbozwe nge-microvilli
