answer3: I-Hemolymph
question4: Umchamo ukhiqizwa kanjani ngokuyinhloko kuma-tubules aseMalpighian?
answer4: Ngokukhishwa kwe-tubular
question5: Yimuphi udoti one-nitrogen okhishwa kakhulu yizinambuzane ngama-tubules aseMalpighian?
answer5: I-asidi ye-uric
question6: Kungani izinambuzane zikhipha i-uric acid njenge-paste noma i-powder ejiyile?
answer6: Ukonga amanzi ezindaweni ezomile
question7: Amanzi angena kanjani kuma-tubule aseMalpighian?
answer7: Ilandela ukuthuthwa kwe-ion ngokunganaki ngenxa yengcindezi ye-osmotic
distractor7a: Iphampulwa ngamandla ngamaphampu amanzi aqhutshwa yi-ATP
question8: Uyini umsebenzi wezindlala ezikhethekile odongeni lwe-rectal?
answer8: Zimunca amanzi nama-electrolyte ukuze zilondoloze ibhalansi ye-osmotic
distractor8a: Bakhiqiza ama-enzyme okugaya ukudla ukuze kugaywe amaprotheni
question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 32.12. Ayini ama-tubules aseMalpighian futhi yisiphi isidalwa esinawo?
answer9: Ama-tubules e-Malpighian yizitho zomzimba ezihlunga imfucuza evela kuma-hemolymph kuma-cockroaches
distractor9a: Ama-tubules aseMalpighian angama-tubules angaphakathi kwe-nephron kubantu
distractor9b: Ama-tubules aseMalpighian ayisikhala sesikhwama sokugaya ukudla ebhokisini le-jellyfish
distractor9c: Ama-tubules aseMalpighian ayizitho ezincane, ezimise okwebhalbhu ezivulekela embotsheni yokukhipha ukungcola ezimpungeni
question10: Kungani ama-tubules aseMalpighian ewusizo kakhulu ezinambuzaneni ezihlala ezindaweni ezomile?
answer10: Zinciphisa ukulahleka kwamanzi ngokumunca amanzi futhi zikhiphe i-uric acid njenge-paste ehlanganisiwe
distractor10a: Zivumela izinambuzane ukuthi zikhiphe umchamo omningi oncibilikisiwe

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.4 Imfucuza Ye-nitrogen | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo Ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.4 Nitrogenous Wastes | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluningi kulesi sigaba lungaphandle komkhawulo we-AP®. Kodwa-ke, le mibono inikeza ithuba lokusebenzisa imiqondo ehlolwe ezahlukweni ezedlule, kufaka phakathi i-chemistry. Kuma-macromolecule amane ezinhlelweni zezinto eziphilayo, amaprotheni nama-nucleic acid aqukethe i-nitrogen. Ngesikhathi sokuqhekeka (i-catabolism) kwama-macromolecule aqukethe i-nitrogen, ikhabhoni, i-hydrogen, kanye nomoya-mpilo kukhishwa futhi kugcinwe ngesimo sama-carbohydrate namafutha. Kodwa-ke, i-nitrogen eningi kumele ikhishwe emzimbeni ngoba imfucuza ye-nitrogen ivame ukwakha i-ammonia enobuthi, ephakamisa i-pH yoketshezi lomzimba futhi iphazamise i-homeostasis. Ukwakheka kwe-ammonia enobuthi kudinga amandla ngesimo se-ATP kanye namanzi amaningi ukuze kuyinciphise ohlelweni lwezinto eziphilayo. Izilwane zasemanzini, njengezinhlanzi, zingakhipha i-ammonia ngqo endaweni ezungezile. Izilwane ezikhipha i-ammonia kuthiwa ziyi-ammonotelic. Izilwane zasemhlabeni, kufaka phakathi izilwane ezincelisayo, kumele zisuse i-ammonia ngokuyiguqula ibe yizinhlobo ezingezona ezinobuthi njenge-uric acid noma i-urea. Izilwane ezikhipha i-urea njengemfucuza eyinhloko ye-nitrogen zibizwa ngokuthi izilwane ze-ureotelic. Izinyoni nezilwane ezihuquzelayo zikhipha i-uric acid, uhlobo lwemfucuza ye-nitrogen engancibiliki emanzini, ngaleyo ndlela kunciphisa ukulahleka kwamanzi. Ngokombono wokuziphendukela kwemvelo, cishe impilo yaqala endaweni yasemanzini, ngakho-ke akumangazi ukuthi izindlela zamakhemikhali ezifana nokuguqulwa kwe-ammonia ibe yi-urea evamile ezincelisayo zashintsha ukuze zivumelane nezimo zomhlaba; izimo ezomile kakhulu cishe zaholela ekuguqukeni kwendlela ye-uric acid njengendlela yokonga amanzi.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yoHlaka Lwekharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nenye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zigcine i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.D
Ukukhula kanye ne-homeostasis enamandla yesistimu yezinto eziphilayo kuthonywa izinguquko endaweni yesistimu.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Kwe-Osmotic Nokukhipha Indle | 32.4 Imfucuza Ye-Nitrogen | Imfucuza Ye-Nitrogen Ezilwaneni Zasemhlabeni: Umjikelezo We-Urea | Ukukhishwa Kwemfucuza Ye-Nitrogen
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.4 Nitrogenous Wastes | Nitrogenous Waste in Terrestrial Animals: The Urea Cycle | Excretion of Nitrogenous Waste
chapterContent:
Umjikelezo we-urea yindlela eyinhloko lapho izilwane ezincelisayo ziguqula khona i-ammonia ibe yi-urea. I-Urea yenziwa esibindini bese ikhishwa emchameni. Ukusabela kwamakhemikhali okuvamile lapho i-ammonia iguqulwa khona ibe yi-urea yi-2 NH3 (ammonia) + CO2 + 3 ATP + H2O → H2N-CO-NH2 (urea) + 2 ADP + 4 Pi + AMP.

 Umjikelezo we-urea usebenzisa izinyathelo ezinhlanu eziphakathi, eziqhutshwa ama-enzyme amahlanu ahlukene, ukuguqula i-ammonia ibe yi-urea, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 32.13. I-amino acid i-L-ornithine iguqulwa ibe yizihlanganisi ezahlukene ngaphambi kokuba ivuselelwe ekupheleni komjikelezo we-urea. Ngakho-ke, umjikelezo we-urea ubizwa nangokuthi umjikelezo we-ornithine. I-enzyme i-ornithine transcarbamylase ivuselela isinyathelo esibalulekile kumjikelezo we-urea futhi ukuntuleka kwayo kungaholela ekuqongeleleni amazinga anobuthi e-ammonia emzimbeni. Ukusabela okubili kokuqala kwenzeka ku-mitochondria kanti ukusabela okuthathu kokugcina kwenzeka ku-cytosol. Ukuhlushwa kwe-urea egazini, okubizwa ngokuthi i-urea nitrogen egazini noma i-BUN, kusetshenziswa njengesibonakaliso sokusebenza kwezinso.

 Ukukhishwa Kwemfucuza Ye-nitrogen
Inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo iphakamisa ukuthi impilo yaqala endaweni yasemanzini. Akumangazi ukubona ukuthi izindlela zamakhemikhali ezifana nomjikelezo we-urea zashintsha ukuze zivumelane nendawo eshintshayo lapho kuvela khona izinto eziphilayo zasemhlabeni. Izimo ezomile cishe zaholela ekuguqukeni kwendlela ye-uric acid njengendlela yokonga amanzi.

answer5: I-Ornithine transcarbamylase

answer8: Ukuhlushwa kwe-urea egazini njengesibonakaliso sokusebenza kwezinso

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.4 Imfucuza Ye-Nitrogen | Imfucuza Ye-Nitrogen Ezinyonini Nasezilwaneni Ezihuquzelayo: I-Uric Acid
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.4 Nitrogenous Wastes | Nitrogenous Waste in Birds and Reptiles: Uric Acid
chapterContent: Izinyoni, izilwane ezihuquzelayo, kanye nezinhlobo eziningi ze-arthropod zomhlaba ziguqula i-ammonia enobuthi ibe yi-uric acid noma i-guanine (i-guano) ehlobene eduze esikhundleni se-urea. Izilwane ezincelisayo nazo zakha i-uric acid ethile ngesikhathi sokuqhekeka kwama-nucleic acid. I-uric acid iyi-compound efana nama-purines atholakala kuma-nucleic acid. Ayincibiliki emanzini futhi ivame ukwakha ungqimba olumhlophe noma impuphu; ikhishwa yizinyoni, izinambuzane, kanye nezilwane ezihuquzelayo. Ukuguqulwa kwe-ammonia ibe yi-uric acid kudinga amandla amaningi futhi kuyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kunokuguqulwa kwe-ammonia ibe yi-urea Isithombe 32.14

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Kwe-Osmotic Nokukhishwa Kwazo | 32.4 Imfucuza Ye-nitrogen | I-Gout
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.4 Nitrogenous Wastes | Gout
chapterContent: Izilwane ezincelisayo zisebenzisa amakristalu e-uric acid njenge-antioxidant emaseli azo. Kodwa-ke, i-uric acid eningi kakhulu ivame ukwakha amatshe ezinso futhi ingabangela nesimo esibuhlungu esibizwa ngokuthi i-gout, lapho amakristalu e-uric acid eqoqana khona emalungeni, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 32.15. Ukudla okukhethwa kukho okunciphisa inani lezisekelo ze-nitrogen ekudleni kusiza ukunciphisa ingozi ye-gout. Isibonelo, itiye, ikhofi, kanye noshokoledi kune-purine-like com pounds, ebizwa ngokuthi ama-xanthine, futhi kufanele kugwenywe ngabantu abane-gout kanye namatshe ezinso.
question1: Iyiphi indima ewusizo edlalwa amakristalu e-uric acid ezincelisayo?
answer1: Zisebenza njengama-antioxidants emaseli
question2: Yini engabangela ukwanda kwe-uric acid egazini?
answer2: Amatshe ezinso kanye ne-gout
distractor2b: Umfutho wegazi ophakeme kanye nesifo sohlangothi
question3: Yini ebangela isimo esibuhlungu esaziwa ngokuthi i-gout?
answer3: Ukuqongelela kwamakristalu e-uric acid emalungeni
question4: Ingancishiswa kanjani ingozi ye-gout?
answer4: Ngokunciphisa ukudla okune-nitrogen ekudleni

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.5 Hormonal Control of Osmoregulatory Functions | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Njengoba sifundile esigabeni esidlule, uhlelo lokukhipha isisu lusebenza nezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi kanye nezinhlelo ze-endocrine ukuze kulondolozwe ibhalansi ye-osmotic, kususwe ukungcola, futhi kugcinwe umfutho wegazi. Ku-AP®, awudingi ukukhumbula uhlu lwama-hormone alawula imisebenzi ye-osmoregulatory noma imisebenzi yawo ethile. Kodwa-ke, ulwazi olukulesi sigaba lusebenza emiqondweni ehlolwe ngaphambilini.

 Izinso ziyavumelana nezimpawu zama-hormone. Njengoba ukhumbula ocwaningweni lwethu lwesistimu ye-endocrine, ama-hormone angama-molecule amancane esithunywa ahamba egazini ukuze athinte iseli eliqondiwe. Izifunda ezahlukene ze-nephron zinamaseli akhethekile anama-receptor ukuze aphendule kuzithunywa zamakhemikhali nama-hormone. Ama-Hormone Ethebula Athinta i-Osmoregulation ngezansi afingqa ama-hormone alawula imisebenzi ye-osmoregulatory. Isibonelo, ama-hormone okundiza/ukundiza i-epinephrine ne-norepinephrine, akhishwa yi-adrenal medulla kanye nesistimu yezinzwa, ngokulandelana, amisa ukusebenza kwezinso okwesikhashana lapho umzimba ungaphansi kokucindezeleka okukhulu futhi amandla amaningi omzimba asetshenziselwa ukulwa nengozi eseduze. Esinye isibonelo uhlelo lwe-rennin-angiotensin-aldosterone olukhulisa umfutho wegazi kanye nomthamo ngokuyinhloko ngokunciphisa imithambo yegazi. Enye i-hormone, i-antidiuretic hormone (ADH) ikhulisa ukungena kwe-membrane emanzini emigudwini yokuqoqa ye-nephron ngokufaka ama-aquaporin, okubangela ukuthi amanzi amaningi amuncwe kabusha. Uke wabhekana nemiphumela ye-ADH uma kushisa ngaphandle futhi ugijima enkundleni yezemidlalo; njengoba ulahlekelwa amanzi ngokujuluka nokuphefumula kanzima, i-ADH ikuvimbela ekulahlekelweni amanzi amaningi emchameni futhi ube sengozini yokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka Lwezifundo Zebhayoloji lwe-AP®. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.5 Ukulawulwa Kwama-Hormonal Kwemisebenzi Ye-Osmoregulatory | I-Epinephrine Ne-Norepinephrine
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.5 Hormonal Control of Osmoregulatory Functions | Epinephrine and Norepinephrine
chapterContent: I-Epinephrine kanye ne-norepinephrine kwakheka yi-adrenal medulla. Ziyi-hormone yokundiza/yokulwa ekhishwa lapho umzimba ungaphansi kokucindezeleka okukhulu. Ngesikhathi sokucindezeleka, amandla amaningi omzimba asetshenziswa ukulwa nengozi eseduze. Umsebenzi wezinso umiswa okwesikhashana yi-epinephrine kanye ne-norepinephrine. Lawa ma-hormone asebenza ngokusebenza ngqo emisipheni ebushelelezi yemithambo yegazi ukuze ayinciphise. Uma ama-arterioles ahlangene encishisiwe, ukugeleza kwegazi kuma-nephron kuyayeka. Lawa ma-hormone ahamba isinyathelo esisodwa futhi abangele uhlelo lwe-renin-angiotensin-aldosterone

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.5 Ukulawulwa Kwama-Hormonal Kwemisebenzi Ye-Osmoregulatory | I-Renin-Angiotensin-Aldosterone
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.5 Hormonal Control of Osmoregulatory Functions | Renin-Angiotensin-Aldosterone
chapterContent: Uhlelo lwe-renin-angiotensin-aldosterone, oluboniswe kuMfanekiso 32.16 luqhubeka ngezinyathelo eziningana ukukhiqiza i-angiotensin II, esebenza ukuqinisa umfutho wegazi kanye nomthamo. I-Renin (ekhishwa yingxenye ye-juxtaglomerular complex) ikhiqizwa amaseli e-granular e-arterioles e-afferent kanye ne-efferent. Ngakho-ke, izinso zilawula umfutho wegazi kanye nomthamo ngqo. I-Renin isebenza ku-angiotensinogen, eyenziwa esibindini bese iyiguqula ibe yi-angiotensin I. I-enzyme eguqula i-angiotensin I (ACE) iguqula i-angiotensin I ibe yi-angiotensin II. I-Angiotensin II iphakamisa umfutho wegazi ngokucindezela imithambo yegazi. Iphinde ibangele ukukhululwa kwe-mineralocorticoid aldosterone kusuka ku-adrenal cortex, okubangela ukuthi ama-renal tubules aphinde amunce i-sodium eningi. I-Angiotensin II iphinde ibangele ukukhululwa kwe-anti-diuretic hormone (ADH) kusuka ku-hypothalamus, okuholela ekugcinweni kwamanzi ezinso. Isebenza ngqo kuma-nephrons futhi yehlisa izinga lokuhlunga kwe-glomerular. Ngokwezokwelapha, umfutho wegazi ungalawulwa ngemithi evimbela i-ACE (ebizwa ngokuthi i-ACE inhibitors)

answer1: Ukuqinisa umfutho wegazi kanye nomthamo wegazi

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.5 Ukulawulwa Kwama-Hormonal Kwemisebenzi Ye-Osmoregulatory | Ama-Mineralocorticoids
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.5 Hormonal Control of Osmoregulatory Functions | Mineralocorticoids
chapterContent: Ama-Mineralocorticoids ama-hormone akhiqizwa yi-adrenal cortex athinta ibhalansi ye-osmotic. I-Aldosterone iyi-mineralocorticoid elawula amazinga e-sodium egazini. Cishe yonke i-sodium egazini ibuyiselwa yi-renal tubules ngaphansi kwethonya le-aldosterone. Ngenxa yokuthi i-sodium ihlala imuncwa yi-transport esebenzayo futhi amanzi alandela i-sodium ukuze kugcinwe ibhalansi ye-osmotic, i-aldosterone ayigcini nje ngokuphatha amazinga e-sodium kodwa futhi namazinga amanzi oketshezini lomzimba. Ngokuphambene nalokho, i-aldosterone iphinde ivuselele ukukhishwa kwe-potassium ngesikhathi esifanayo ne-sodium remuncwation. Ngokuphambene nalokho, ukungabikho kwe-aldosterone kusho ukuthi akukho sodium emuncwa kabusha kuma-renal tubules futhi yonke ikhishwa emchameni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthwalo we-potassium wokudla wansuku zonke awukhiqizi futhi ukugcinwa kwe-K+ kungabangela ukwanda okuyingozi kokuhlushwa kwe-plasma K+. Iziguli ezinesifo se-Addisons zine-adrenal cortex ehlulekayo futhi azikwazi ukukhiqiza i-aldosterone. Zilahlekelwa i-sodium emchameni wazo njalo, futhi uma ukuphakelwa kungagcwaliswa, imiphumela ingaba yingozi.

distractor1c: Ama-hormone akhiqizwa yi-thyroid gland alawula imetabolism

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.5 Ukulawulwa Kwama-Hormonal Kwemisebenzi Ye-Osmoregulatory | I-Antidiurectic Hormone
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.5 Hormonal Control of Osmoregulatory Functions | Antidiurectic Hormone
chapterContent: Njengoba kuxoxwe ngaphambilini, i-antidiuretic hormone noma i-ADH (ebizwa nangokuthi i-vasopressin), njengoba igama lisho, isiza umzimba ukuthi wonge amanzi lapho umthamo woketshezi lomzimba, ikakhulukazi ololwegazi, uphansi. Lwakhiwa yi-hypothalamus futhi lugcinwa futhi lukhishwe ku-posterior pituitary. Lusebenza ngokufaka ama-aquaporin emigudwini yokuqoqa futhi lukhuthaza ukumuncwa kabusha kwamanzi. I-ADH isebenza futhi njenge-vasoconstrictor futhi ikhulisa umfutho wegazi ngesikhathi sokopha.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Nokukhishwa Kwe-Osmotic | 32.5 Ukulawulwa Kwama-Hormonal Kwemisebenzi Ye-Osmoregulatory | I-Atrial Natriuretic Peptide Hormone
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.5 Hormonal Control of Osmoregulatory Functions | Atrial Natriuretic Peptide Hormone
chapterContent: I-peptide ye-atrial natriuretic (ANP) yehlisa umfutho wegazi ngokusebenza njenge-vasodilator. Ikhishwa ngamaseli ase-atrium yenhliziyo ngenxa yomfutho wegazi ophezulu kanye nasezigulini ezine-sleep apnea. I-ANP ithinta ukukhishwa kukasawoti, futhi ngenxa yokuthi amanzi alandela usawoti kancane ukuze alondoloze ibhalansi ye-osmotic, futhi inomphumela wokukhipha isisu. I-ANP iphinde ivimbele ukumuncwa kabusha kwe-sodium yi-renal tubules, inciphise ukumuncwa kabusha kwamanzi (ngaleyo ndlela isebenza njenge-diuretic) futhi yehlise umfutho wegazi. Izenzo zayo zicindezela izenzo ze-aldosterone, i-ADH, kanye ne-renin

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 32. Ukulawulwa Kwe-Osmotic Nokukhishwa Kwazo | 32.7 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 32. Osmotic Regulation and Excretion | 32.7 Chapter Summary
chapterContent:
32.1 Ukulawulwa kwe-Osmore kanye ne-Osmotic Balance
Ukugxila kwe-solute ku-membrane engenela kancane kuthonya ukunyakaza kwamanzi kanye ne-solute ku-membrane. Inani lama-molecule angenela kancane hhayi usayizi wama-molecule obalulekile ku-osmosis. Ukulawulwa kwe-Osmore kanye ne-osmotic balance kuyimisebenzi ebalulekile yomzimba, okuholela ekulinganisweni kwamanzi nosawoti. Akuzona zonke i-solute ezingadlula ku-membrane engenela kancane. I-Osmosis ukunyakaza kwamanzi ku-membrane. I-Osmosis yenzeka ukuze ilinganise inani lama-molecule angenela kancane ku-membrane engenela kancane ngokuhamba kwamanzi eceleni kokugxila okuphezulu kwe-solute. Ukusabalalisa okulula kusebenzisa iziteshi zamaprotheni ukuhambisa ama-molecule angenela kancane kusuka ezindaweni eziphakeme kuya ekugxilweni okuphansi kuyilapho izindlela zokuthutha ezisebenzayo zidingeka ukuhambisa i-solutes ngokumelene ne-gradients yokugxilisa. I-Osmolarity ilinganiswa ngamayunithi ama-milliequivalents noma ama-milliosmoles, womabili acabangela inani lezinhlayiya ze-solute kanye nokushaja okukuzo. Izinhlanzi ezihlala emanzini ahlanzekile noma emanzini anosawoti ziyazivumelanisa nezimo ngokuba ama-osmoregulators noma ama-osmoconformers.

 32.2 Izinso kanye nezitho ze-Osmoregulatory
Izinso ziyizitho eziyinhloko ze-osmoregulatory ezinhlelweni zezilwane ezincelisayo; zisebenza ukuhlunga igazi nokugcina i-osmolarity yoketshezi lomzimba ku-300 mOsm. Zizungezwe yizingqimba ezintathu futhi zakhiwe ngaphakathi kwezifunda ezintathu ezihlukene—i-cortex, i-medulla, kanye ne-pelvis.

 Imithambo yegazi ethwala igazi ingene futhi iphume ezinso ivela futhi ihlangane ne-aorta kanye ne-vena cava engaphansi, ngokulandelana. Imithambo yezinso iphuma ku-aorta bese ingena ezinso lapho ihlukana khona ibe yimithambo ye-segmental, interlobar, arcuate, kanye ne-cortical radiate.

 I-nephron iyunithi esebenzayo yezinso, ehlunga igazi futhi ikhiqize umchamo. I-nephron yakhiwe yi-corpuscle yezinso kanye ne-renal tubule. Ama-nephron e-cortical atholakala ku-cortex yezinso, kanti ama-nephron e-juxtamedullary atholakala ku-cortex yezinso eduze ne-renal medulla. Ama-nephron ahlunga futhi ashintshanise amanzi kanye nezinhlayiya ngamasethi amabili emithambo yegazi kanye noketshezi lwezicubu ezinso.

 Kunezinyathelo ezintathu ekwakhekeni komchamo: ukuhlunga kwe-glomerular, okwenzeka ku-glomerulus; ukuphinda kufakwe ishubhu, okwenzeka kuma-tubules ezinso; kanye nokukhiqizwa kweshubhu, okwenzeka futhi kuma-tubules ezinso.

 32.3 Izinhlelo Zokukhipha Isisu
Izinhlelo eziningi ziye zavela zokukhipha imfucuza elula kunezinhlelo zezinso kanye nomchamo zezilwane ezinezinhlungu. Uhlelo olulula kakhulu yilolo lwama-vacuole ahambisanayo akhona kuma-microorganisms. Amaseli elangabi kanye ne-nephridia ezibunguni enza imisebenzi yokukhipha isisu futhi agcina ibhalansi ye-osmotic. Ezinye izinambuzane ziye zashintsha ama-tubules e-Malpighian ukuze akhiphe imfucuza futhi agcine ibhalansi ye-osmotic.

 32.4 Imfucuza Ye-nitrogen
I-Amonia imfucuza ekhiqizwa yi-metabolism yamaprotheni aqukethe i-nitrogen amakhilogremu kanye nama-nucleic acid. Ngenkathi izilwane zasemanzini zingakhipha kalula i-ammonia ezindaweni zazo zamanzi, izilwane zasemhlabeni ziye zasungula izindlela ezikhethekile zokususa i-ammonia enobuthi ezinhlelweni zazo. I-Urea iwumkhiqizo oyinhloko we-metabolism ye-ammonia ezilwaneni ezinezinhlungu. I-Uric acid iwumkhiqizo oyinhloko we-metabolism ye-ammonia ezinyonini, ezinhlotsheni zasemhlabeni, nasezihuquzelayo.

 32.5 Ukulawulwa Kwama-Hormonal Kwemisebenzi Ye-Osmoregulatory
Izimpawu zama-hormone zisiza izinso ukuvumelanisa izidingo ze-osmotic zomzimba. Ama-hormone afana ne-epinephrine, i-norepinephrine, i-renin-angiotensin, i-aldosterone, i-anti-diuretic hormone, kanye ne-atrial natriuretic peptide kusiza ukulawula izidingo zomzimba kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlelo ezahlukene zezitho.

answer42: I-Renin, ekhishwa yingxenye ye-juxtaglomerular complex, isebenza ku-angiotensin ukwakha i-angiotensin I, bese iguqulwa ibe yi-angiotensin II yi-ACE. I-Angiotensin II ibe isikhuthaza ukukhishwa kwe-aldosterone ne-ADH. I-Angiotensin II isebenza ukuzinzisa umfutho wegazi kanye nomthamo.
distractor42a: I-Renin, ekhishwa yingxenye ye-juxtaglomerular complex, isebenza ku-angiotensin ukwakha i-angiotensin I, bese iguqulwa ibe yi-angiotensin II yi-ACE. I-Angiotensin II ibe isikhuthaza ukukhishwa kwe-aldosterone ne-ADH. I-Angiotensin II isebenza ukuphazamisa umfutho wegazi kanye nomthamo.
distractor42b: I-Renin, ekhishwa yingxenye ye-juxtaglomerular complex, isebenza ku-angiotensin ukwakha i-angiotensin II, bese iguqulwa ibe yi-angiotensin I yi-ACE. I-Angiotensin II ibe isikhuthaza ukukhishwa kwe-aldosterone ne-ADH. I-Angiotensin II isebenza ekuqiniseni umfutho wegazi kanye nomthamo.
distractor42c: I-Renin, ekhishwa yingxenye ye-juxtaglomerular complex, isebenza ku-angiotensin ukwakha i-angiotensin I, eguqulwa ibe yi-angiotensin II kanye ne-ADH yi-ACE. I-ADH bese ivuselela ukukhishwa kwe-aldosterone. I-Angiotensin II isebenza ukuzinzisa umfutho wegazi kanye nomthamo.
question43:
Bheka uMfanekiso 32.18. Le grafu ikhombisa imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwabanye onogwaja. Onogwaja bajovwa ngenani elikhulayo le-epinephrine, eliboniswe ku-x-axis. I-y-axis ikhombisa izinga lokushaya kwenhliziyo konogwaja.

 Yisiphi isimangalo esingenziwa kusukela kule grafu?
answer43: I-Epinephrine ayinawo umphumela omkhulu kuze kube yilapho ukuhlushwa kwayo kufinyelela umkhawulo
distractor43a: Ngisho nenani elincane kakhulu le-epinephrine libangela impendulo enkulu
distractor43c: Ukwandisa i-epinephrine kunciphisa izinga lokushaya kwenhliziyo
question44: Bheka Umfanekiso 32.19. Iziguli ezinezifo zezinso zisebenzisa imishini yokuhlanza igazi ukuze zisuse i-urea eyingozi egazini lazo. Igazi lihlukaniswe nesisombululo, esibizwa ngokuthi i-dialysate, esenzelwe ukususa imfucuza ngokusabalala nge-membrane engangeni. Ukuhlushwa kwe-solutes cishe kuhluke kanjani phakathi kwengxenye ephezulu ye-dialyzer kanye nengxenye engezansi, equkethe i-dialysate entsha, ukuze i-dialysis isuse ngempumelelo imfucuza egazini?
answer44: Engxenyeni engenhla, i-dialysate inezinga eliphansi le-solute kunegazi, okuvumela i-urea ukuthi isakazeke iye ku-dialysate engezansi phansi kwe-gradient yayo yezinga.
distractor44a: Engxenyeni engenhla, i-dialysate inezinga eliphakeme le-solute kunegazi, okuvumela i-urea ukuthi isakazeke iye ku-dialysate engezansi phansi kwe-gradient yayo yezinga.
distractor44b: Engxenyeni engenhla, i-dialysate inezinga eliphansi le-solute kunegazi, okuvumela i-urea ukuthi ihlukaniswe ngokuthutha okusebenzayo phansi kwe-gradient yezinga.
distractor44c: Engxenyeni engenhla, i-dialysate inezinga eliphakeme le-solute kunegazi, okuvumela i-urea ukuthi isebenzise ukusabalala okulula ukuze isakazeke iye kwi-dialysate engezansi.
question45: Bheka uMfanekiso 32.20. Umdwebo ukhombisa amangqamuzana abomvu egazi ezixazululweni ezimbili ezahlukene ze-NaCl. Yini okungenzeka ukuthi ibangela ukuthi amangqamuzana ahluke ngesimo kulezi zixazululo ezimbili?
answer45: Isixazululo A sine-osmolarity ephansi. Isixazululo B sine-osmolarity ephezulu
distractor45a: Isixazululo A sine-osmolarity ephezulu. Isixazululo B sine-osmolarity ephansi
distractor45b: Amaseli asesixazululweni A angama-osmoregulators. Amaseli asesixazululweni B angama-osmoconformers
distractor45c: Amaseli asesixazululweni A angama-osmoconformers. Amaseli asesixazululweni B angama-osmoregulators
question46: Bheka uMfanekiso 32.21. Lo mdwebo ubonisa ukucindezeleka kwe-osmotic okubonwa yinhlanzi. Ngokusekelwe ekuqondeni kwamanzi kanye nokunyakaza kwe-solute okuboniswe kumdwebo, ingabe le nhlanzi kungenzeka ukuthi iyinhlanzi enamanzi anosawoti noma yamanzi ahlanzekile? Wazi kanjani?
answer46: Amanzi ahlanzekile, ngoba inhlanzi iyalawula ngenxa yesisombululo se-hypotonic
distractor46a: Amanzi ahlanzekile, ngoba inhlanzi i-osmoregulating ngenxa yesisombululo se-hypertonic
distractor46b: Amanzi anosawoti, ngoba inhlanzi i-osmoregulating ngenxa yesisombululo se-hypertonic
distractor46c: Amanzi anosawoti, ngoba inhlanzi i-osmoregulating ngenxa yesisombululo se-hypotonic
question47:
Bheka uMfanekiso 32.21. Umdwebo ubonisa ukucindezeleka kwe-osmotic okubonwa yinhlanzi.

 Yisiphi inketho esiyisicelo esingabhalwa ngokusekelwe kulo mdwebo?
answer47: Inhlanzi ihlala emanzini ahlanzekile ane-osmolarity ephansi. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi amanzi aqhubeke nokusabalala emzimbeni wenhlanzi.
distractor47a: Inhlanzi ihlala emanzini anosawoti ane-osmolarity ephezulu. Lokhu kubangela ukunqwabelana kosawoti emzimbeni wenhlanzi.
distractor47b: Inhlanzi ihlala emanzini anosawoti ane-osmolarity ephezulu. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi amanzi aqhubeke esakazeka emzimbeni wenhlanzi.
distractor47c: Inhlanzi ihlala emanzini ahlanzekile ane-osmolarity ephansi. Lokhu kubangela ukunqwabelana kosawoti emzimbeni wenhlanzi.
question48:
Bheka Umfanekiso 32.19. Iziguli ezinezifo zezinso zisebenzisa imishini yokuhlanza igazi ukuze zisuse i-urea eyingozi egazini lazo. Igazi lihlukaniswe nesisombululo, esibizwa ngokuthi i-dialysate, esenzelwe ukususa imfucuza ngokusabalala nge-membrane engangeniswa igazi. I-membrane engangeniswa igazi cishe ingangeniswa igazi
 futhi ingangeniswa igazi.
question49: Bheka uMfanekiso 32.9. Umdwebo ubonisa indlela yokushintshana kwe-countercurrent ngaphakathi kwe-loop ye-Henle. Izinombolo ezingaphakathi kwe-loop zibonisa i-osmolarity ye-filtrate, kuyilapho izinombolo eziphakathi kwe-loop ezimbili zibonisa i-osmolarity ye-interstitial fluid ngaphakathi kwezicubu zezinso. Yini engase yenzeke ku-osmolarity ye-filtrate esithweni esikhuphukayo uma ukuthuthwa okusebenzayo kwe-NaCl kuyeka?
question50: Bheka uMfanekiso 32.9. Umdwebo ubonisa indlela yokushintshana kwe-countercurrent ngaphakathi kwe-loop ye-Henle. Izinombolo ezingaphakathi kwe-loop zibonisa i-osmolarity ye-filtrate, kuyilapho izinombolo eziphakathi kwe-loop ezimbili zibonisa i-osmolarity ye-interstitial fluid ngaphakathi kwezicubu zezinso. Bekuzokwenzekani nge-osmolarity ye-interstitial fluid uma amanzi engakwazi ukuphuma esitho esehlayo?
distractor50c: I-Osmolarity inganda noma yehle kuye ngokuthi inani lamanzi lingakanani
question51: Bheka uMfanekiso 32.6. Umdwebo ukhombisa ingxenye evundlile yezinso. Yini engase yenzeke uma bekungaba nehlule legazi emthanjeni wezinso?
distractor51b: Igazi alizange liphume liye epayipini elihlanganisiwe
question52: Bheka Umfanekiso 32.6. Umdwebo ukhombisa izinso zesobunxele. Kungani ama-capillary athwala igazi elivela emthanjeni wezinso egijima ngaphezu kwamaphiramidi ezinso?
answer52: Ama-capillary ahambisa igazi ku-glomerulus futhi agijime ngokuqondile ku-proximal convoluted tubule. Womabili atholakala ku-cortex
distractor52a: Ama-capillary ahambisa igazi ku-glomerulus futhi agijime ngokulingana ne-proximal convoluted tubule. Womabili atholakala ku-medulla
distractor52b: Ama-capillary ahambisa igazi ku-glomerulus futhi agijime ngokuqondile ku-distal convoluted tubule. Womabili atholakala ku-cortex
distractor52c: Ama-capillary ahambisa igazi ku-glomerulus futhi agijime ngokulingana ne-distal convoluted tubule. Womabili atholakala ku-cortex
question53: Bheka uMfanekiso 32.22. Lesi sibalo sibonisa izingxenye ze-nephron ezitholakala ngaphakathi kwezinso. Yini engase yenzeke emgudwini wokuqoqa igazi uma kunokugeleza kwegazi okwengeziwe ku-glomerulus?
answer53: Amanzi amaningi angangena emgudwini wokuqoqa amanzi
question54: Bheka uMfanekiso 32.22. Lesi sibalo sibonisa izingxenye ze-nephron ezitholakala ngaphakathi kwezinso. Utshwala bulimaza i-pituitary gland, elawula ukuthi ama-nephron aphinde amuncwe amanzi kangakanani. I-hormone ekhiqizwa yi-pituitary gland, i-anti-diuretic hormone, yandisa ukumuncwa kwamanzi yizinso. Ukuphazamiseka kwale hormone cishe kuzothinta kanjani izingxenye ezahlukene ze-nephron eboniswe lapha?
answer54: Ukumuncwa kwamanzi kusuka ku-filtrate kuzoncipha, okuboniswa ukwehla kokulahlekelwa kwamanzi ku-downward loop ye-Henle, ukwanda kokukhishwa kwe-solute ku-distal tubule, kanye nokwehla kokufakwa kwamanzi emgudwini wokuqoqa.
distractor54a: Ukumuncwa kwamanzi kusuka ku-filtrate kuzoncipha, okuboniswa ukwehla kokulahlekelwa amanzi ku-upscaping loop ye-Henle, ukwanda kokukhishwa kwe-solute ku-distal tubule, kanye nokwanda kokufakwa kwamanzi emgudwini wokuqoqa.
distractor54b: Ukumuncwa kwamanzi kusuka ku-filtrate kuzoncipha, okuboniswa ukwehla kokulahlekelwa kwamanzi ku-upscaping loop ye-Henle, ukwanda kokukhishwa kwe-solute ku-distal tubule, kanye nokwehla kokufakwa kwamanzi emgudwini wokuqoqa amanzi.
distractor54c: Ukumuncwa kwamanzi kusuka ku-filtrate kuzoncipha, okuboniswa ukwehla kokulahlekelwa amanzi ku-downward loop ye-Henle, ukwanda kokukhishwa kwe-solute ku-distal tubule, kanye nokwanda kokufakwa kwamanzi emgudwini wokuqoqa.
question55: Bheka uMfanekiso 32.9. Umdwebo ubonisa indlela yokushintshana kwe-countercurrent ngaphakathi kwe-loop ye-Henle. Izinombolo ezingaphakathi kwe-loop zibonisa i-osmolarity ye-filtrate, kuyilapho izinombolo eziphakathi kwe-loop ezimbili zibonisa i-osmolarity ye-interstitial fluid ngaphakathi kwezicubu zezinso. Yini engase yenzeke ku-osmolarity ye-filtrate esithweni esikhuphukayo uma umzimba ukhipha i-urea ku-interstitial fluid?
answer55: I-osmolarity izokwanda, okuvumela uketshezi oluphakathi nendawo ukuthi luphinde lumunce amanzi.
distractor55a: I-osmolarity izoncipha, okuvumela uketshezi oluphakathi nendawo ukuthi luphinde lumunce izixazululo
distractor55b: I-osmolarity izoncipha, okuvumela uketshezi oluphakathi nendawo ukuthi luphinde lumunce amanzi.
distractor55c: I-osmolarity izokhula, okuvumela uketshezi oluphakathi nendawo ukuthi luphinde lumunce izixazululo
question56:
Bheka uMfanekiso 32.23. I-Planaria yizibungu ezihlala emanzini ahlanzekile. Uhlelo lwazo lokukhipha amanzi luqukethe amashubhu amabili axhunywe ohlelweni lweshubhu olunegatsha kakhulu. Ingxenye yokugcina yamashubhu iqukethe i-cilia ehambisa udoti phansi kwamashubhu bese iphuma emzimbeni ngemigodi yokukhipha amanzi evuleka ebusweni bomzimba. I-Cilia iphinda idonse amanzi oketshezini oluphakathi, okuvumela ukuhluzwa. Noma yimaphi ama-metabolite abalulekile atholakala ngokumuncwa kabusha.

 Uma sakha imodeli eqhathanisa izinhlelo zokukhipha amanzi ze-planarian kanye nezinhlelo zokukhipha amanzi zabantu, yini engaba ngokusebenza okufanayo ne-cilia echazwe lapha?
answer56: I-glomerulus, ngoba yenza kube lula ukuhluzwa kwegazi
distractor56a: Umthambo wezinso, ngoba wenza kube lula ukushintshana kwezakhamzimba negazi
distractor56b: I-convoluted tube, ngoba yenza kube lula ukushintshana kwezakhamzimba negazi
distractor56c: I-ureter, ngoba yenza kube lula ukuhlunga igazi
question57:
Bheka uMfanekiso 32.23. I-Planaria yizibungu ezihlala emanzini ahlanzekile. Uhlelo lwazo lokukhipha amanzi luqukethe amashubhu amabili axhunywe ohlelweni lweshubhu olunamagatsha amaningi. Ingxenye yokungena yamashubhu iqukethe i-cilia ehambisa udoti phansi kwamashubhu futhi iphume emzimbeni ngemigodi yokukhipha amanzi evuleka ebusweni bomzimba. I-Cilia iphinda idonse amanzi oketshezini oluphakathi, okuvumela ukuhluzwa. Noma yimaphi ama-metabolite abalulekile atholakala ngokumuncwa kabusha.

 Uma sakha imodeli eqhathanisa izinhlelo zokukhipha amanzi ze-planarian kanye nezomuntu, yini engaba ngokusebenza okufana nohlelo lweshubhu olunamagatsha amaningi oluchazwe lapha?
answer57: I-convoluted tube, ngoba yenza kube lula ukushintshana kwezakhamzimba negazi
distractor57a: Umthambo wezinso, ngoba wenza kube lula ukushintshana kwezakhamzimba negazi
distractor57b: I-glomerulus, ngoba yenza kube lula ukuhluzwa kwegazi
distractor57c: I-ureter, ngoba yenza kube lula ukuhlunga igazi
question58: I-Planaria yizibungu ezisicaba ezihlala emanzini ahlanzekile. Uhlelo lwazo lokukhipha ukungcola, noma i-protonephridia, luqukethe amashubhu amabili axhunywe ohlelweni lweshubhu olunamagatsha amaningi. Ingxenye yokugcina yamashubhu iqukethe i-cilia ehambisa udoti phansi kwamashubhu bese iphuma emzimbeni ngemihubhe yokukhipha ukungcola evuleka ebusweni bomzimba. I-Cilia iphinda idonse amanzi oketshezini oluphakathi, okuvumela ukuhluzwa. Noma yimaphi ama-metabolites abalulekile atholakala ngokumuncwa kabusha. Yisiphi isakhiwo ezinso zomuntu esifana kakhulu nemigodi yokukhipha ukungcola ye-protonephridia, futhi ngani?
answer58: Umgodi womchamo, ngoba yilapho imfucuza ishiya khona umzimba
distractor58a: I-convoluted tube, ngoba yilapho ukumuncwa kabusha kanye nokukhishwa kwenzeka khona
distractor58b: I-glomerulus, ngoba yilapho ukumuncwa kabusha kanye nokukhishwa kwenzeka khona
distractor58c: I-ureter, ngoba yilapho imfucuza ishiya khona umzimba
question59: Ama-tubule aseMalpighian ahlunga izinto ezilahliwe egazini, noma i-hemolymph, yezinambuzane. Kunamaseli amboze ama-tubule ampompa ama-solute (ikakhulukazi ama-ion) endaweni ezungeze ama-tubule aseMalpighian. Uma ubona ukwanda kancane kancane kokuhlushwa kwe-solute ngaphandle kwama-tubule aseMalpighian, yini obungayilindela?
question60: Amaseli elangabi e-protonephridia ahlunga izinto ezilahla igazi, noma i-hemolymph, yezilwane ezingenamgogodla. Lokhu kungafana nani kakhulu, ekusebenzeni, ohlelweni lokukhipha indle lomuntu?
question61: Ama-arthropod asemhlabathini, izinyoni, nezilwane ezihuquzelayo ziguqula i-ammonia enobuthi ibe yi-uric acid noma i-guanine (i-guano) ehlobene eduze. Kodwa-ke, ukuguqulwa kwe-ammonia ibe yi-uric acid kudinga amandla amaningi futhi kuyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kunokuguqulwa kwe-ammonia ibe yi-urea, noma ukukhishwa kwe-ammonia njengoba kwenziwa yizinhlanzi. Ngokusekelwe kulokhu okutholakele, uhlelo lokukhipha olunye lwezinto eziphilayo zasemhlabeni ezibalwe ngenhla lungashintsha kanjani uma luguqukela ekubeni luchithe isikhathi salo esiningi emanzini?
answer61: Zingathuthukisa ikhono lokushintsha phakathi kwe-uric acid kanye nokukhishwa kwe-ammonia ngqo
distractor61b: Zingathuthukisa ikhono lokukhipha i-uric acid ngaphandle kokuyincibilikisa emanzini.
question62:
Izinyoni nezilwane ezihuquzelayo ziguqula i-ammonia enobuthi ibe yi-uric acid noma i-com efanayo amakhilogremu. Izinambuzane, ezihlala emhlabeni, nazo ziguqula i-ammonia ibe yi-uric acid. Lokhu kuphambene nezinhlanzi, ezikhipha i-ammonia ngqo, ngaphandle kokuyiguqula ibe enye into.

 Ukuguqulwa kwe-ammonia ibe yi-uric acid kudinga amandla futhi kuyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kunokukhipha i-ammonia ngqo.

 Ngokusekelwe kulolu lwazi, yenza isimangalo esinengqondo sokuthi kungani lezi zinto eziphilayo zazingashintsha ukuguqulwa kwe-ammonia kube yi-uric acid?
answer62: Ukonga amanzi lapho amanzi engekho khona
distractor62a: Ukuze ukwazi ukushintsha phakathi kokukhishwa kwe-uric acid kanye ne-ammonia
distractor62b: Ukunciphisa umthelela endaweni yabo ngoba i-ammonia iyingozi kune-uric acid
distractor62c: Ngokuphila ngokubambisana nezitshalo, okubalulekile kuzo i-uric acid
question63:
Bheka uMfanekiso 32.24. Le grafu ikhombisa amazinga e-renin kanye ne-angiotensin II egazini.

 Yisiphi isimangalo esingenziwa kusukela kule datha? (Icebiso: Hlola ulwazi oluboniswe kumagrafu kuphela.)
question64:
Bheka uMfanekiso 32.25. I-atrial natriuretic peptide (ANP) ivula imithambo yegazi. I-ANP iphinde ivimbele ukumuncwa kabusha kwe-sodium ngama-renal tubules, okunciphisa ukumuncwa kabusha kwamanzi. Ucwaningo luhlole ukuthi i-ANP inciphise yini ukuvuvukala kobuchopho (ukuqoqwa kwamanzi ngokweqile) ebuchosheni kumagundane. Igrafu ifingqa okutholakele kwawo. Ikholomu ngayinye iyindawo ehlukile ebuchosheni begundane.

 Yenza isimangalo mayelana ne-ANP ngokusekelwe kule grafu
distractor64b: I-ANP ayinawo umthelela ekuvuvukeni kobuchopho emagundwini
distractor64c: I-ANP yandisa ukuvuvukala kobuchopho kwezinye izindawo zobuchopho, futhi iyakunciphisa kwezinye izindawo, kumagundane
question65: Bheka uMfanekiso 32.26. Lo mdwebo wenziwe ngumfundi ukuze abonise uhlelo lwe-angiotensin-aldosterone. Iyiphi ingxenye yalo mdwebo equkethe iphutha?
question66: Bheka uMfanekiso 32.27. Lo mdwebo wenziwe ngumfundi ukuze abonise uhlelo lwe-angiotensin-aldosterone. Ungawuqedela kanjani lo mdwebo ukuze ube yimodeli enembile yohlelo lwe-renin-angiotensin?
answer66: I-Angiotensin I yakhiwa nge-angiotensin, eguqulwa ibe yi-angiotensin II yi-ACE. I-Aldosterone ne-ADH bese zikhuthazwa ukuba zikhishwe nge-angiotensin II.
distractor66a: URenin usebenza ku-angiotensin ukuze akhuthaze ngqo ukukhishwa kwe-aldosterone ne-ADH
distractor66b: URenin usebenza ku-angiotensin ukwakha i-ACE ne-angiotensin II, okube sekukhuthaza ukukhishwa kwe-aldosterone ne-ADH
distractor66c: I-Angiotensin II yakhiwa nge-angiotensin, eguqulwa ibe yi-angiotensin I yi-ACE. I-Aldosterone ne-ADH bese zikhuthazwa ukuba zikhishwe nge-angiotensin I.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.0 Introduction
chapterContent:
Indawo ezungezile inamagciwane amaningi, angama-agent, ngokuvamile ama-microorganism, abangela izifo kubantu abazohlala kuyo. Umnikazi yisilwane esihlaselwa futhi esivame ukulimala yi-pathogen. Amagciwane ahlanganisa amabhaktheriya, ama-protist, isikhunta nezinye izinto eziphilayo ezithelelanayo. Sihlala sichayeka kumagciwane ekudleni nasemanzini, ebusweni, nasemoyeni. Izinhlelo zokuzivikela zomzimba zezilwane ezincelisayo zavela ukuze zivikeleke kulawo magciwane; zakhiwe uhlu oluhlukahlukene kakhulu lwamaseli akhethekile nama-molecule ancibilikayo ahlanganisa uhlelo lokuzivikela olusheshayo noluguquguqukayo olukwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokuvikelwa kubantu abaningi balezi zifo.

 Imijovo yasungulwa ukuze kuncishiswe amathuba okutheleleka kwesifo esithile, njenge-measles, mumps, polio, noma chicken pox, ngokusiza umzimba ukuthi wakhe amasosha omzimba. Kodwa-ke, izifo eziningi azinawo umuthi wokugomela, njengesifo esibulalayo esibangelwa yigciwane le-Ebola. Idatha evela kwi-World Health Organisation ikhombisa ukuthi abantu abangaphezu kuka-11,000 bafa ezimweni ezingaphezu kuka-27,000 ezibikiwe ngesikhathi sokuqubuka kuka-2014-2015. Nakuba iningi lamacala lalise-Afrika, i-Ebola yasakazekela kwamanye amazwe futhi yashukumisela abacwaningi ukuba bazame ukuthola ukwelashwa. Bheka Umfanekiso 33.1
question1: Iyini i-pathogen?
answer1: I-ejenti, ngokuvamile i-microorganism, ebangela izifo kumuntu ophethe
question2: Uyini umbungazi?
answer2: Isidalwa esihlaselwa futhi esivame ukulimala yigciwane
question3: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungasebenza njengezifo ezibangela izifo?
answer3: Amabhaktheriya, ama-protist, isikhunta, nezinye izinto eziphilayo ezithathelwanayo
question4: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wesimiso sokuzivikela somzimba sezilwane ezincelisayo?
answer4: Ukuvikela umzimba ezifweni ezibangelwa amagciwane kusetshenziswa amaseli akhethekile nama-molecule ancibilikayo
question5: Imithi yokugoma isiza kanjani ekuvikeleni ezifweni?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.1 Impendulo Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni Engokwemvelo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.1 Innate Immune Response | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluningi mayelana nezinhlelo ezahlukene zezitho zezilwane ezinezinhlungu alukho ngaphakathi kwe-AP®. Nokho, uhlelo lokuzivikela komzimba lukhethwe ukuze luhlolwe ngokujulile ngoba zonke izinto eziphilayo, okuhlanganisa nabantu, kumele zigcine i-homeostasis enamandla ukuze ziphile ngaphakathi kwezimo ezishintshayo. Ngisho nama-eukaryotes alula kakhulu anjengeziponji nama-cnidarians athuthukise amangqamuzana akhethekile ekuvikeleni amasosha omzimba ukuvikela ukuphazamiseka kwe-homeostasis. Izihloko zezindaba zisixwayisa ngokuqubuka kwezifo, okuhlanganisa i-Ebola, isimungumungwane, umkhuhlane, namagciwane athwalwa yizinambuzane njengeWest Nile kanye ne-chikungunya, asakazeka ngokushesha phakathi kwabantu, ngokuvamile enemiphumela emibi kakhulu. Sizwa nangokuvela kwezifo ezintsha, ikakhulukazi ezibangelwa amagciwane aguqukele ekumelaneni nama-antibiotic.

 Izinhlelo zokuzivikela komzimba ezilwaneni zisukela eqenjini elikhulu lamaseli e-phagocytic eziponji kuya ekusebenzelaneni okuyinkimbinkimbi kwama-molecule, amangqamuzana, izicubu, nezitho ezinikeza amasosha omzimba ezincelisayo. Izingxenye zesistimu yokuzivikela komzimba zihlala zifuna izimpawu zamagciwane abangela izifo abizwa ngokuthi ama-pathogens. Izici zomzimba ziyahlangana, zibone uhlobo lwegciwane, ziqinise amaseli nama-molecule afanele ukulwa nokutheleleka, bese zimisa impendulo yomzimba ngemva kokuba ukutheleleka sekususiwe ukuze kugwenywe umonakalo ongadingekile wamaseli omuntu. Ngenxa yesistimu yayo yokukhumbula ehlelekile, uhlelo lomzimba lungakhumbula amagciwane futhi luqale impendulo esheshayo lapho luphinde luvezwe. Impendulo yomzimba ingaba ngeyangaphakathi noma eguquguqukayo. Impendulo yomzimba eguquguqukayo igcina ulwazi mayelana nokutheleleka kwangaphambilini futhi ikhulisa ukuzivikela okuqondene negciwane. Impendulo yomzimba engokwemvelo ihlala ikhona futhi ivikela kuzo zonke izifo.

 Naphezu kwezithiyo zesikhumba, izinyembezi, kanye ne-mucus, amagciwane angase angene emzimbeni. Uhlelo lomzimba olungokwemvelo luphendula ngokuvuvukala, ukuminyana kwezifo, kanye nokukhiqizwa kwezinto zomzimba namaprotheni. Izinhlobo eziningana zamaseli zihilelekile ohlelweni lomzimba olungokwemvelo, kufaka phakathi amaseli e-mast akhipha ama-histamine (abangela lezo zimpawu ezicasulayo ezihambisana nokungezwani komzimba kanye nomkhuhlane), ama-macrophage adla amagciwane namaseli omdlavuza, amaseli e-natural killer (NK) abhubhisa amaseli esimila namaseli atheleleke ngegciwane, izinhlobo eziningana zamaseli amhlophe egazi, ngisho namaprotheni avikelayo afana ne-complement kanye ne-interferon. Nokho, siyazi ngokuhlangenwe nakho ukuthi lezi zithiyo zingahluleka. Ngenhlanhla, izimpendulo zomzimba eziguquguqukayo zinikeza olunye ulayini wokuzivikela oqondile.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo wokwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zigcine i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.D
Ukukhula kanye ne-homeostasis enamandla yesistimu yezinto eziphilayo kuthonywa izinguquko endaweni yesistimu.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.D.4 Izitshalo nezilwane zinezindlela ezahlukahlukene zokuzivikela zamakhemikhali ngokumelene nokutheleleka okuthinta i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.1 Umfundi angakha izethulo namamodeli ezethulo nezinhlelo zemvelo noma ezenziwe ngabantu kulesi sizinda.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.2 Umfundi angachaza izethulo namamodeli ezethulo nezinhlelo zemvelo noma ezenziwe ngabantu kulesi sizinda.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.30 Umfundi angakha izethulo noma amamodeli ukuchaza ukuzivikela komzimba okungewona oqondile ezilwaneni.

 Uhlelo lokuzivikela komzimba luhlanganisa kokubili izimpendulo zokuzivikela komzimba ezingokwemvelo neziguquguqukayo. Ukuzivikela komzimba okungokwemvelo kwenzeka ngokwemvelo ngenxa yezici zofuzo noma i-physiology; akubangelwa ukutheleleka noma ukugonywa kodwa kusebenza ukunciphisa umthwalo womsebenzi wempendulo yokuzivikela komzimba eguquguqukayo. Amazinga angaphakathi nangaphakathi kanye nangaphakathi empendulo yokuzivikela komzimba ahilela amaprotheni akhishwe, ukusayinwa okuqondiswa yi-receptor, kanye nokuxhumana okuyinkimbinkimbi phakathi kweseli neseli. Uhlelo lokuzivikela komzimba olungokwemvelo lwakhula ekuqaleni kokuvela kwezilwane, cishe eminyakeni eyizigidigidi edlule, njengempendulo ebalulekile ekuthelelekeni. Ukuzivikela komzimba okungokwemvelo kunenani elilinganiselwe lezinhloso ezithile: noma yiluphi usongo lwezifo lubangela ukulandelana okuqhubekayo kwezehlakalo ezingakhomba uhlobo lwegciwane futhi zisuse ukutheleleka ngokuzimela noma zihlanganise impendulo yokuzivikela yomzimba eguquguqukayo ekhethekile kakhulu. Isibonelo, izinyembezi kanye nokuphuma kwe-mucus kuqukethe izinto ezibulala amagciwane.

answer9: Uhlelo lokuzivikela olungokwemvelo lusabela ngokuvuvukala, ukuminyana kwamagciwane, kanye nokukhiqizwa kwezinto zokuzivikela zomzimba kanye namaprotheni

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.1 Impendulo Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni Engokwemvelo | Izithiyo Zomzimba Nezamakhemikhali
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.1 Innate Immune Response | Physical and Chemical Barriers
chapterContent:
Ngaphambi kokuba kuqalwe noma yiziphi izici zokuzivikela komzimba, isikhumba sisebenza njengesithiyo esiqhubekayo, esingadluleki ezifweni ezingaba yingozi. Amagciwane ayabulawa noma angasebenzi esikhumbeni ngokumisa (ukomisa) kanye ne-asidi yesikhumba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amagciwane awusizo ahlala esikhumbeni ancintisana namagciwane ahlaselayo, avimbele ukutheleleka. Izifunda zomzimba ezingavikelwe yisikhumba (njengamehlo kanye nolwelwesi lwamafinyila) zinezindlela zokuzivikela ezihlukile, njengokudabuka kanye nokuphuma kwamafinyila okubamba futhi kuhlanze amagciwane, kanye ne-cilia emigudwini yamakhala kanye nendlela yokuphefumula esunduza amafinyila namagciwane aphume emzimbeni. Kuwo wonke umzimba kunezinye izindlela zokuzivikela, njenge-pH ephansi yesisu (evimbela ukukhula kwamagciwane), amaprotheni egazi abopha futhi aphazamise ulwelwesi lwamaseli ebhaktheriya, kanye nenqubo yokuchama (ekhipha amagciwane emgudwini womchamo).

 Naphezu kwalezi zithiyo, amagciwane angangena emzimbeni ngokuklwebheka kwesikhumba noma ukubhoboza, noma ngokuqoqwa ezindaweni zamafinyila ngamanani amakhulu anqoba amafinyila noma amafinyila. Amanye amagciwane athuthukise izindlela ezithile eziwavumela ukuthi anqobe izithiyo zomzimba nezamakhemikhali. Uma amagciwane engena emzimbeni, isimiso somzimba sokuzivikela esingokwemvelo sisabela ngokuvuvukala, ukuminyana kwamagciwane, kanye nokukhiqizwa kwezinto zokuzivikela zomzimba namaprotheni.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.1 Impendulo Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni Engokwemvelo | Ukuqashelwa Kwezifo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.1 Innate Immune Response | Pathogen Recognition
chapterContent:
Ukutheleleka kungaba ngaphakathi kweseli noma ngaphandle kweseli, kuye ngokuthi igciwane liyini. Wonke amagciwane athelela amaseli futhi azalane ngaphakathi kwalawo maseli (ngaphakathi kweseli), kanti amabhaktheriya nezinye izilokazane zingazalana ngaphakathi kweseli noma ngaphandle kweseli, kuye ngohlobo. Uhlelo lokuzivikela komzimba oluzalwa nalo kumele luphendule ngokufanele: ngokuhlonza igciwane elingaphandle kweseli kanye/noma ngokuhlonza amaseli asekhaya asevele ethelelekile. Lapho igciwane lingena emzimbeni, amaseli egazini kanye ne-lymph athola amaphethini athile ahlobene negciwane (ama-PAMP) ebusweni begciwane. Ama-PAMP ayizimpawu ze-carbohydrate, i-polypeptide, kanye ne-nucleic acid” ezivezwa ngamagciwane, amabhaktheriya, kanye nama-parasite kodwa ahlukile kuma-molecule kumaseli aphethe. Uhlelo lokuzivikela komzimba lunamaseli athile, achazwe kuMfanekiso 33.2 futhi aboniswe kuMfanekiso 33.3, anama-receptor aqaphela la ma-PAMP. I-macrophage iyiseli elikhulu le-phagocytic eligwinya izinhlayiya zangaphandle kanye namagciwane. Ama-Macrophage aqaphela ama-PAMP ngama-receptor ahambisanayo okuqaphela amaphethini (ama-PRR). Ama-PRR angama-molecule kuma-macrophage namaseli e-dendritic axhumana nendawo engaphandle. I-monocyte uhlobo lweseli elimhlophe legazi elijikeleza egazini nase-lymph futhi lihlukane libe ama-macrophage ngemva kokuba lingene ezicutshini ezinegciwane. Amaseli e-dendritic abopha izimpawu zama-molecule zamagciwane futhi akhuthaze ukuminyana nokubhujiswa kwe-pathogen. Ama-receptor afana nama-toll (ama-TLR) uhlobo lwe-PRR oluqaphela ama-molecule ahlanganyelwa yi-pathogen kodwa ahlukaniswa nama-molecule aphethe). Ama-TLR akhona ezilwaneni ezingenamgogodla kanye nezilwane ezinomgogodla, futhi abonakala engenye yezingxenye ezindala kakhulu zesistimu yokuzivikela komzimba. Ama-TLR Kuye kwatholakala futhi ohlelweni lwezinzwa lwezilwane ezincelisayo.

 Bheka uMfanekiso 33.2. Imifanekiso emele izinhlobo eziyisishiyagalombili zamaseli omzimba.

 (a) Iseli le-mast—Likhulisa imithambo yegazi futhi libangele ukuvuvukala ngokukhishwa kwama-histamine ne-heparin. Liqoqa ama-macrophage nama-neutrophils. Lihilelekile ekwelapheni amanxeba nasekuvikeleni izifo kodwa futhi lingaba nesibopho sokusabela kokungezwani komzimba. Litholakala ezicutshini ezixhumeneyo kanye nolwelwesi lwama-mucous. (b) Iseli le-Macrophage—Iseli le-Phagocytic elidla izifo zangaphandle kanye namaseli omdlavuza. Livuselela impendulo yamanye amaseli omzimba. Lisuka emithanjeni yegazi liye ezicutshini. (c) Iseli elibulalayo lemvelo—Libulala amaseli esimila kanye namaseli atheleleke ngegciwane. Lijikeleza egazini futhi lithuthela ezicutshini. (d) Iseli le-Dendritic—Liveza ama-antigen ebusweni balo, ngaleyo ndlela libangele ukuzivikela okuguqukayo. Likhona ezicutshini ze-epithelial, kufaka phakathi isikhumba, amaphaphu kanye nezicubu zendlela yokugaya ukudla. Lithuthela kuma-lymph node lapho lisebenza. (e) I-Monocyte—Lihluka liye Ama-macrophage namaseli e-dendritic asabela ekuvuvukeni. Agcinwe esinqeni, ahamba ngemithambo yegazi aye ezicutshini ezinegciwane. (f) I-Neutrophil—Isabela kuqala endaweni yokutheleleka noma ukulimala, leli seli eliningi le-phagocytic limelela amaphesenti angu-50-60 awo wonke ama-leukocyte. Ikhipha ubuthi obubulala noma obuvimbela amabhaktheriya nesikhunta futhi iqoqe amanye amaseli omzimba endaweni yokutheleleka. Isuka emithanjeni yegazi iye ezicutshini. (g) I-Basophil—Inesibopho sokuzivikela ezicutshini. Ikhipha ama-histamine abangela ukuvuvukala futhi angaba nesibopho sokusabela kokungezwani komzimba. Ijikeleza egazini futhi ithuthela ezicutshini. (h) I-Eosinophil—Ikhipha ubuthi obubulala amabhaktheriya nezinambuzane kodwa futhi ibangela ukulimala kwezicubu. Ijikeleza egazini futhi ithuthela ezicutshini

answer7: I-Neutrophil

answer8: Iseli le-dendritic

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.1 Impendulo Yomzimba Engokwemvelo | Ukuqashelwa Kwezifo | Imiphumela Yokukhululwa Kwe-Cytokine
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.1 Innate Immune Response | Pathogen Recognition | Effects of Cytokine Release
chapterContent:
Ukubopha ama-PRR ngama-PAMP kubangela ukukhishwa kwama-cytokine, okubonisa ukuthi kukhona i-pathogen futhi idinga ukubhujiswa kanye nanoma yimaphi amaseli athelelekile. I-cytokine iyisithunywa samakhemikhali esilawula ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli (ifomu nomsebenzi), ukwanda (ukukhiqizwa), kanye nokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ukuze kuthinte izimpendulo zomzimba. Okungenani izinhlobo ezingama-40 zama-cytokine zikhona kubantu ezihlukile ngohlobo lweseli oluwakhiqizayo, uhlobo lweseli olusabela kuwo, kanye nezinguquko ezizikhiqizayo. Uhlobo olulodwa lwe-cytokine, i-interferon, luboniswe kuMfanekiso 33.4.

 Isigaba esincane sama-cytokine yi-interleukin (IL), eqanjwe kanjalo ngoba ixhumanisa ukusebenzisana phakathi kwama-leukocyte (amangqamuzana amhlophe egazi). Ama-Interleukin ahilelekile ekuhlanganiseni izimpendulo zomzimba ezingokwemvelo neziguquguqukayo. Ngaphezu kokukhishwa kumaseli ngemva kokuqashelwa kwe-PAMP, ama-cytokine akhishwa amaseli athelelekile abophezela kumaseli aseduze angathelelekile futhi abangele lawo maseli ukuba akhulule ama-cytokine, okuholela ekuqhumeni kwe-cytokine.

 Uhlobo lwesibili lwama-cytokine asebenza ngokushesha ama-interferon, akhishwa amaseli athelelekile njengesixwayiso kumaseli aseduze angathelelekile. Omunye wemisebenzi ye-interferon ukuvimbela ukuphindaphindana kwegciwane. Aneminye imisebenzi ebalulekile, njengokuqapha isimila. Ama-Interferon asebenza ngokubonisa amaseli aseduze angathelelekile ukuthi abhubhise i-RNA futhi anciphise ukwakheka kwamaprotheni, abonise amaseli aseduze angathelelekile ukuthi adlule ku-apoptosis (ukufa kwamangqamuzana okuhleliwe), kanye nokwenza amaseli omzimba asebenze.

 Ephendula ama-interferon, amaseli angathelelekile ashintsha ukubonakaliswa kwawo kwezakhi zofuzo, okwandisa ukumelana kwamaseli ekuthelelekeni. Omunye umphumela wokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okubangelwa yi-interferon ukwehla okukhulu kokwakheka kwamaprotheni eseli. Amaseli athelelekile ngegciwane akhiqiza ama-virus amaningi ngokukhiqiza inani elikhulu lamaprotheni egciwane. Ngakho-ke, ngokunciphisa ukwakheka kwamaprotheni, iseli liba nokumelana nokutheleleka ngegciwane.
question1: Yini ebangela ukukhululwa kwama-cytokine ngesikhathi sokusabela komzimba okungokwemvelo?
answer1: Ukubopha kwama-receptor okuqaphela amaphethini (ama-PRR) kumaphethini wamangqamuzana ahlobene ne-pathogen (ama-PAMP)
question2: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wama-cytokine?
answer2: Zisebenza njengezithunywa zamakhemikhali ezilawula izimpendulo zomzimba ngokushintsha ukuhlukahluka kwamaseli, ukwanda kwawo, kanye nokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo.
question3: Ayini ama-interleukin (ama-IL)?
answer3: Isigaba esincane sama-cytokine alawula ukusebenzisana phakathi kwama-leukocyte futhi asiza ukuhlanganisa ukuzivikela komzimba okungokwemvelo nokuvumelana nezimo
question4: Kuyini ukuqhuma kwe-cytokine?
answer4: Ukwanda okusheshayo kokukhululwa kwe-cytokine lapho amangqamuzana athelelekile ethumela isibonakaliso kumaseli aseduze angathelelekile ukuthi akhiqize ama-cytokine
distractor4a: Ukubhujiswa kwawo wonke ama-cytokine ngemva kokutheleleka
question5: Uyini umsebenzi omkhulu wama-interferons?
answer5: Ukuvimbela ukuzala kwegciwane
question6: Ama-interferons asiza kanjani ekuvikeleni amangqamuzana angomakhelwane angathelelekile?
answer6: Zinika amaseli uphawu lokushintsha ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo, zibhubhise i-RNA, futhi zinciphise ukwakheka kwamaprotheni
distractor6a: Zivuselela amangqamuzana angomakhelwane ukuthi akhiqize ama-antibodies ngokushesha
question7: Ama-interferons awathinta kanjani amaseli athelelekile?
answer7: Zitshela amangqamuzana athelelekile ukuthi adlule ku-apoptosis futhi avuselele amangqamuzana omzimba
distractor7a: Zivuselela amangqamuzana athelelekile ukuthi ahlukane ngokushesha
distractor7b: Zivimbela amangqamuzana athelelekile ukuthi axhumane namangqamuzana omzimba
distractor7c: Ziguqula amangqamuzana athelelekile abe amangqamuzana abomvu egazi
question8: Kungani ukunciphisa ukwakheka kwamaprotheni eseli kwenza iseli limelane kakhulu nokutheleleka ngegciwane?
answer8: Ama-virus athembele emishinini yokwenziwa kwamaprotheni amaseli aphethe ukuze akhiqize amaprotheni amagciwane
distractor8a: Ivumela amaseli ukuthi akhiqize ama-antibodies amaningi

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.1 Impendulo Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni Engokwemvelo | Ukuqashelwa Kwezifo | I-Phagocytosis Nokuvuvukala
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.1 Innate Immune Response | Pathogen Recognition | Phagocytosis and Inflammation
chapterContent:
Ama-cytokine okuqala akhiqizwayo akhuthaza ukuvuvukala; okungukuthi, akhuthaza ukuvuvukala, ukubomvu kwendawo, ukuvuvukala, ukushisa, kanye nobuhlungu obubangelwa ukuhamba kwama-leukocyte kanye noketshezi oludlula kuma-capillary angena ngokuya endaweni yokutheleleka. Inani lama-leukocyte afika endaweni yokutheleleka lincike kuhlobo lwe-pathogen ethelelayo. Ama-macrophage namaseli e-dendritic agwinya amagciwane kanye nokungcola kwamaseli nge-phagocytosis. I-neutrophil nayo iyi-phagocytic leukocyte egwinya futhi igaye amagciwane. Ama-neutrophil, aboniswe kuMfanekiso 33.3, angama-leukocyte amaningi kakhulu ohlelweni lokuzivikela komzimba. Ama-neutrophil ane-nucleus enama-lobe amabili kuya kwayisihlanu, futhi aqukethe ama-organelles, abizwa ngokuthi ama-lysosomes, agaya amagciwane agwinyekile. I-eosinophil iyi-leukocyte esebenza namanye ama-eosinophil ukuzungeza i-parasite; ihilelekile empendulweni ye-allergy kanye nasekuvikeleni ama-helminthes (izibungu ezidla izikelemu).

 Ama-neutrophils nama-eosinophils angama-leukocyte abaluleke kakhulu agubha amagciwane amakhulu, njengebhaktheriya nesikhunta. Iseli le-mast liyi-leukocyte ekhiqiza ama-molecule okuvuvukala, njenge-histamine, ekuphenduleni amagciwane amakhulu. I-basophil iyi-leukocyte, njenge-neutrophil, ekhipha amakhemikhali ukuze ivuselele impendulo yokuvuvukala njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 33.5. Ama-Basophil nawo ahilelekile ekuphenduleni kokungezwani komzimba kanye nokuzwela futhi abangele izinhlobo ezithile zezimpendulo zokuvuvukala. Ama-Eosinophils nama-basophil akhiqiza abaxhumanisi abengeziwe bokuvuvukala ukuze athole ama-leukocyte amaningi. Impendulo yokuzivikela yomzimba ezwela kakhulu kuma-antigen angenangozi, njengasempova, ivame ukuhilela ukukhishwa kwe-histamine ngama-basophils nama-mast cell.

 Ama-Cytokines athumela impendulo kumaseli esimiso sezinzwa ukuze alethe izimpawu eziphelele zokuzizwa ugula, okuhlanganisa ukudinwa, ubuhlungu bemisipha, kanye nesicanucanu. Le miphumela kungenzeka ukuthi ivele ngoba izimpawu zikhuthaza umuntu ukuthi aphumule futhi zimvimbele ekusakazeni ukutheleleka kwabanye. Ama-Cytokine akhulisa izinga lokushisa lomzimba elingaphakathi, okubangela umkhuhlane, obangela ukuthi isibindi sigodle i-iron egazini. Ngaphandle kwe-iron, amagciwane athile, njengamanye amagciwane, awakwazi ukuzala; lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukuzivikela komzimba okunempilo
question1: Yimaphi ama-cytokine okuqala akhiqizwa ngesikhathi sokusabela komzimba okungokwemvelo?
answer1: Ama-cytokine abangela ukuvuvukala
question2: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonakaliso esiphawulekayo sokuvuvukala?
answer2: Ubomvu, ukuvuvukala, ukushisa, kanye nobuhlungu
distractor2a: Ukwehla kwezinga lokushisa komzimba kanye nokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni
distractor2b: Ukuncipha kokugeleza kwegazi kanye nesikhumba esikhanyayo
distractor2c: Ukukhula kwemisipha kanye nokwanda kwesifiso sokudla
question3: Yimaphi amangqamuzana omzimba agwinya amagciwane kanye nemfucumfucu yamaseli nge-phagocytosis?
answer3: Ama-Macrophage namaseli e-dendritic
question4: Yimaphi ama-leukocyte amaningi kakhulu ohlelweni lokuzivikela komzimba futhi abhubhisa amagciwane nge-phagocytosis?
answer4: I-Neutrophil
question5: Iyini indima eyinhloko yama-eosinophil?
answer5: Ukusiza ukuzivikela ezifweni ezibangelwa amagciwane nokuhlanganyela ezimpendulweni zokungezwani komzimba
question6: Yimaphi amangqamuzana akhipha i-histamine ngenxa yezifo ezinkulu futhi avame ukuhileleka ekuphenduleni kwe-allergy?
answer6: Amaseli e-mast kanye nama-basophil
question7: Kungani ama-cytokine ebanga izimpawu ezifana nokudinwa, ubuhlungu bemisipha, kanye nesicanucanu ngesikhathi sokutheleleka?
answer7: Lezi zimpawu zikhuthaza ukuphumula futhi zinganciphisa ukusabalala kokutheleleka
distractor7c: Zikhuthaza ukukhiqizwa kwama-antibody ngamaseli abomvu egazi
question8: Umkhuhlane ungasiza kanjani ekunciphiseni ukukhula kwezifo ezibangelwa amagciwane?
answer8: Kubangela ukuthi isibindi sigodle insimbi egazini, okunciphisa ukuphindaphindeka kwezifo
distractor8b: Ibhubhisa zonke izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane ngokuzishisa ngokweqile
distractor8c: Ivimbela ama-leukocyte ukuthi angafinyeleli ezicutshini ezinegciwane
question9: Kuyini ukuzivikela komzimba okunempilo?
answer9: Inqubo lapho isibindi sigodla khona insimbi egazini ukuze kuncishiswe ukuphindaphindeka kwezifo
distractor9a: Ukukhiqizwa kwama-antibodies ngemva kokudla ukudla okunomsoco

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.1 Impendulo Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni Engokwemvelo | Amaseli Okubulala Emvelo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.1 Innate Immune Response | Natural Killer Cells
chapterContent:
Ama-lymphocyte angama-leukocyte abonakala ngokwesayensi ngama-nuclei awo amakhulu, anombala omnyama; angamaseli amancane ane-cytoplasm encane kakhulu, njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 33.6. Amaseli athelelekile atholakala futhi abhujiswe ngamaseli e-natural killer (NK), ama-lymphocyte angabulala amaseli athelelekile ngama-virus noma amaseli esimila (amaseli angajwayelekile ahlukana ngokungalawuleki futhi ahlasele ezinye izicubu). Amaseli e-T namaseli e-B esistimu yokuzivikela yomzimba eguquguqukayo nawo ahlukaniswa njengama-lymphocyte. Amaseli e-T angama-lymphocyte avuthwa e-thymus gland, kanti amaseli e-B angama-lymphocyte avuthwa emongweni wethambo. Amaseli e-NK athola ukutheleleka kwangaphakathi kweseli, ikakhulukazi okuvela kumagciwane, ngokubonakaliswa okushintshiwe kwama-molecule amakhulu e-histocompatibility class (MHC) I ebusweni bamaseli athelelekile. Ama-molecule e-MHC I angamaphrotheni ebusweni bawo wonke amaseli ane-nucleated, ngakho-ke awatholakali kumaseli abomvu egazi nama-platelet angewona ama-nucleated. Umsebenzi wama-molecule e-MHC I ukukhombisa izingcezu zamaprotheni ezivela kuma-agent athelelekile ngaphakathi kweseli kuya kuma-T-cell; Amaseli aphilile azoshaywa indiva, kuyilapho amaprotheni angewona awemvelo noma angaphandle ezohlaselwa yisimiso somzimba sokuzivikela. Ama-molecule e-MHC II atholakala kakhulu kumaseli aqukethe ama-antigen (amaprotheni angewona awemvelo) kanye nama-lymphocyte. Ama-molecule e-MHC II asebenzisana namaseli e-T awusizo ukuze aqalise impendulo efanele yokuzivikela komzimba, engafaka impendulo yokuvuvukala.

 Iseli elithelelekile (noma iseli lesimila) ngokuvamile alikwazi ukuhlanganisa nokubonisa ama-molecule e-MHC I ngendlela efanele. Imithombo ye-metabolic yamaseli athelelekile ngamanye amagciwane ikhiqiza amaprotheni aphazamisa ukucutshungulwa kwe-MHC I kanye/noma ukuthuthwa kwayo endaweni yeseli. I-MHC I encishisiwe kumaseli amukelayo iyahlukahluka kusuka kumagciwane kuya kumagciwane futhi iphumela ekuvinjelweni okusebenzayo okukhiqizwa amagciwane. Le nqubo ingaqeda ama-molecule e-MHC I amukelayo ebusweni beseli, amaseli e-NK athola ukuthi awaphilile noma awajwayelekile ngenkathi efuna ama-molecule e-MHC I eseli. Ngokufanayo, ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okushintshiwe kakhulu kwamaseli esimila kuholela ekubonakalisweni kwama-molecule e-MHC I aguqukile kakhulu noma angekho futhi abonisa ukuthi awaphilile noma awajwayelekile.

 Amaseli e-NK ahlala esebenza; Ukusebenzisana nama-molecule e-MHC I ajwayelekile, aphelele esitokisini esinempilo kuvimbela ukulandelana kokubulala, bese iseli le-NK liqhubeka. Ngemva kokuba iseli le-NK lithole iseli elithelelekile noma elinomdlavuza, i-cytoplasm yalo ikhipha ama-granule akhiwe yi-perforin, iphrotheni ebhubhisayo edala imbobo esitokisini esiqondiwe. Ama-Granzyme akhishwa kanye ne-perforin ku-immunological synapse. I-granzyme iyi-protease egaya amaprotheni eseli futhi ibangele iseli eliqondiwe ukuba life ngokuhleliwe, noma i-apoptosis. Amaseli e-Phagocytic abe esegaya izinsalela zeseli ezisele. Amaseli e-NK ahlala eqapha umzimba futhi ayindlela ephumelelayo yokulawula izifo ezingaba khona nokuvimbela ukuqhubeka komdlavuza.
question1: Ayini amaseli okubulala emvelo (NK)?
answer1: Ama-lymphocyte abhubhisa amaseli anegciwane kanye namaseli esimila
question2: Akhula kuphi amaseli e-T namaseli e-B?
answer2: Amaseli e-T avuthwa ku-thymus, kanti amaseli e-B avuthwa ku-bone mongow
distractor2b: Amaseli e-T avuthwa emnkantsheni wamathambo, kanti amaseli e-B avuthwa emnkantsheni wamathambo
question3: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wama-molecule e-MHC I?
answer3: Ukubonisa izingcezu zamaprotheni kusukela ngaphakathi kweseli kuya kumaseli e-T
question4: Yimaphi amaseli avame ukuveza ama-molecule e-MHC I?
answer4: Cishe wonke amaseli ane-nucleic
question5: Amaseli e-natural killer (NK) awabona kanjani amaseli athelelekile noma anesimila?
answer5: Ngokubona ama-molecule e-MHC I anciphile, angekho, noma angajwayelekile ebusweni bawo
distractor5a: Ngokuqaphela ama-antibodies anamathele kumaseli abomvu egazi
distractor5b: Ngokuthola amazinga aphezulu e-oxygen kumaseli athelelekile
distractor5c: Ngokubona amazinga aphezulu ama-molecule e-MHC II kumaseli anempilo
question6: Iyini indima eyinhloko yama-molecule e-MHC II?
answer6: Ukuxhumana namaseli e-T asizayo nokuqala izimpendulo ezifanele zomzimba
question7: Yiliphi iphrotheni elikhishwa amaseli e-NK akha ama-pores kumaseli aqondiwe?
answer7: I-Perforin
question8: Uyini umsebenzi wama-granule akhishwa amaseli e-NK?
answer8: Zigaya amaprotheni eseli futhi zibangele i-apoptosis esitokisini esiqondiwe
question9: Kwenzekani ngemva kokuba iseli le-NK libhubhise iseli elithelelekile noma elinomdlavuza?
answer9: Amaseli e-Phagocytic agaya ama-debris asele eseli

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.1 Impendulo Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni Engokwemvelo | Ukwengeza
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.1 Innate Immune Response | Complement
chapterContent:
Uhlu lwezinhlobo ezingaba ngu-20 zamaprotheni ancibilikayo, olubizwa ngokuthi uhlelo lokugcwalisa, lusebenza ukubhubhisa amagciwane angaphandle kweseli. Amaseli esibindi nama-macrophage akhiqiza amaprotheni agcwalisayo njalo; lawa maprotheni atholakala eningi egazini legazi futhi ayakwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha kuma-microorganism athelelekile. Uhlelo lokugcwalisa lubizwa kanjalo ngoba luhambisana nempendulo yama-antibody yesistimu yokuzivikela eguquguqukayo. Amaprotheni agcwalisayo abopha ezindaweni zama-microorganism futhi akhangwa kakhulu yi-pathogens esevele iboshwe ngama-antibodies. Ukubopha amaprotheni agcwalisayo kwenzeka ngokulandelana okuthile nokulawulwa kakhulu, lapho iphrotheni ngayinye elandelanayo isebenza ngokuqhekeka kanye/noma izinguquko zesakhiwo ezibangelwa ukubopha amaprotheni angaphambilini. Ngemva kwamaprotheni ambalwa okuqala agcwalisayo abopha, kulandela uchungechunge lwezehlakalo zokubopha ezilandelanayo lapho i-pathogen igqokwa ngokushesha ngamaprotheni agcwalisayo.

 Amaprotheni agcwalisayo enza imisebenzi eminingana. Amaprotheni asebenza njengophawu lokukhombisa ukuba khona kwe-pathogen kumaseli e-phagocytic, njenge-macrophages namaseli e-B, futhi athuthukise ukuminyana; le nqubo ibizwa ngokuthi i-opsonization. Amanye amaprotheni agcwalisayo angahlangana ukuze akhe ama-complexes okuhlasela avula ama-pores kuma-membrane eseli lamagciwane. Lezi zakhiwo zibhubhisa amagciwane ngokubangela ukuthi okuqukethwe kwazo kuvuze, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 33.7.
question1: Iyini uhlelo lokugcwalisa?
answer1: Iqembu lamaprotheni ancibilikayo angaba ngu-20 asiza ekubhubhiseni amagciwane angaphandle kwesikhumba
distractor1a: Iqoqo lama-antibodies akhiqizwa kuphela ngemva kokutheleleka
distractor1b: Iqembu lamaprotheni amangqamuzana abomvu egazi athwala umoya-mpilo
question2: Yimaphi amangqamuzana aqhubeka nokukhiqiza amaprotheni ahambisanayo?
answer2: Amaseli esibindi nama-macrophage
question3: Kungani uhlelo lokugcwalisa lubizwa ngokuthi i-complement?
answer3: Ngoba igcwalisa impendulo ye-antibody yesistimu yokuzivikela yomzimba eguquguqukayo
distractor3a: Ngoba ithatha indawo yama-antibodies ngesikhathi sokutheleleka
question4: Amaprotheni ahambisanayo asebenza kanjani?
answer4: Ngokusebenzisa i-cascade elawulwayo lapho iphrotheni ngayinye isebenza khona okulandelayo
distractor4a: Wonke amaprotheni ahambisanayo asebenza ngasikhathi sinye
distractor4b: Ama-antibodies kuphela angavuselela amaprotheni ahambisanayo ngqo
distractor4c: Zenziwa zisebenze kuphela ngamaseli abomvu egazi
question5: Kuyini ukuphikisana?
answer5: Ukumbozwa kwamagciwane ngamaprotheni ahambisanayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukugwinywa kwawo ngamaseli e-phagocytic
question6: Amaprotheni ahambisanayo abhubhisa kanjani ngqo ezinye izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane?
answer6: Ngokwakha ama-complex okuhlasela adala ama-pores emangqamuzaneni eseli lamagciwane
question7: Kwenzekani uma ama-complement attack complexes akha ama-pores kulwelwesi lwe-pathogen?
answer7: Okuqukethwe yizifo kuyavuza, okuholela ekubhujisweni kwawo
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 33.7. Yimuphi umsebenzi obalulekile wamaprotheni ahambisanayo ngaphambi kokuba abhubhise amagciwane?
answer8: Ziphawula amagciwane ukuze amaseli e-phagocytic akwazi ukuwabona futhi awagwinye kahle kakhulu
distractor8c: Zivimbela ama-leukocyte ukuthi angafiki endaweni yokutheleleka

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.2 Impendulo Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni Evumelana Nezimo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.2 Adaptive Immune Response | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Impendulo yokuzivikela komzimba eguquguqukayo ithatha izinsuku noma ngisho amasonto ukuze isungulwe—isikhathi eside kakhulu kunempendulo yemvelo—futhi iqondene kakhulu namagciwane futhi ihilela inkumbulo yama-molecule. Lolu hlobo lokuzivikela komzimba lwenzeka ngemva kokuba sesivezwe ku-antigen kungaba yi-pathogen noma ngokugoma futhi luvuselelwa lapho impendulo yokuzivikela yomzimba engokwemvelo inganele ukulawula ukutheleleka. Kunezinhlobo ezimbili zezimpendulo eziguquguqukayo: impendulo yokuzivikela yomzimba eqondiswa amaseli, eyenziwa amaseli e-T, kanye nempendulo yokuzivikela yomzimba ehlasimulisayo, elawulwa amaseli e-B asebenzayo kanye nokukhiqizwa kwawo kwama-antibodies. Ukuzivikela komzimba okuguquguqukayo kuhilela inkumbulo ukuze ukuvezwa kabusha ku-pathogen efanayo kuzoveza impendulo ephumelelayo nesheshayo. Lokhu kunikeza isivikelo sesikhathi eside ekuthelelekeni kabusha.

 Ulwazi olukulesi sigaba luzobonakala luyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu ngengxoxo yalo ngama-antigen, amaseli aveza ama-antigen, ama-molecule amakhulu e-histocompatibility (MHC), izinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli e-T, amaseli e-B akhipha ama-antibody, kanye nokuhlela amaseli enkumbulo. chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.2 Impendulo Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni Evumelana Nezimo | Amaseli Aveza I-Antigen
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.2 Adaptive Immune Response | Antigen-presenting Cells
chapterContent:
Ngokungafani namaseli e-NK ohlelo lokuzivikela oluzalwa nalo, amaseli e-B (ama-lymphocyte e-B) awuhlobo lwamaseli amhlophe egazi akhiqiza ama-antibodies, kanti amaseli e-T (ama-lymphocyte e-T) awuhlobo lwamaseli amhlophe egazi adlala indima ebalulekile empendulweni yokuzivikela komzimba. Amaseli e-T ayisici esibalulekile empendulweni eqondiswa amaseli—impendulo ethile yokuzivikela komzimba esebenzisa amaseli e-T ukuqeda amangqamuzana atheleleke ngamagciwane namagciwane athile. Kunezinhlobo ezintathu zamaseli e-T: amaseli e-cytotoxic, amsizi, kanye namaseli e-suppressor T. Amaseli e-cytotoxic T abhubhisa amaseli atheleleke ngegciwane empendulweni yokuzivikela yomzimba eqondiswa amaseli, kanti amaseli e-helper T adlala indima ekuvuseleleni kokubili i-antibody kanye nezimpendulo zokuzivikela zomzimba eziqondiswa amaseli. Amaseli e-Suppressor T avala amangqamuzana e-T kanye namaseli e-B uma kudingeka, ngaleyo ndlela avimbele impendulo yokuzivikela komzimba ekubeni lukhuni kakhulu.

 I-antigen iyi-macromolecule yangaphandle noma engeyona eyakho ephendula namaseli esimiso sokuzivikela komzimba. Akuwona wonke ama-antigen azovusa impendulo. Isibonelo, abantu bakhiqiza ama-antigen amaningi futhi bahlala bevezwa kuma-antigen angaphandle angenangozi, njengeprotheni yokudla, impova, noma izingxenye zothuli. Ukucindezelwa kwezimpendulo zamasosha omzimba kuma-macromolecule angenangozi kulawulwa kakhulu futhi kuvame ukuvimbela izinqubo ezingalimaza umninikhaya, ezaziwa ngokuthi ukubekezelelana.

 Uhlelo lokuzivikela komzimba oluzalwa nalo luqukethe amaseli athola ama-antigen angaba yingozi, bese etshela impendulo yokuzivikela komzimba eguquguqukayo ngokuba khona kwala ma-antigen. Iseli eliveza i-antigen (i-APC) liseli lokuzivikela komzimba elithola, ligwinye, futhi litshele impendulo yokuzivikela komzimba eguquguqukayo mayelana nokutheleleka. Lapho kutholakala i-pathogen, lawa ma-APC azokhipha i-pathogen bese eyigaya ukuze yakhe izingcezu eziningi ezahlukene ze-antigen. Izingcezu ze-antigen zizobe sezithuthwa ziye ebusweni be-APC, lapho zizosebenza khona njengesibonakaliso kwamanye amaseli okuzivikela komzimba. Amaseli e-Dendritic angamaseli okuzivikela omzimba acubungula izinto ze-antigen; Zikhona esikhumbeni (amaseli e-Langerhans) kanye nolwelwesi lwekhala, amaphaphu, isisu, kanye namathumbu. Ngezinye izikhathi iseli le-dendritic livela ebusweni bamanye amaseli ukuze libangele impendulo yomzimba, ngaleyo ndlela lisebenze njengeseli eliveza i-antigen. Ama-Macrophage nawo asebenza njengama-APC. Ngaphambi kokuvuselelwa nokwahlukaniswa, amaseli e-B angasebenza futhi njengama-APC.

 Ngemva kwe-phagocytosis ngama-APC, i-phagocytic vesicle ihlangana ne-lysosome yangaphakathi kweseli eyakha i-phagolysosome. Ngaphakathi kwe-phagolysosome, izingxenye zihlukaniswa zibe yizicucu; izicucu zibe sezilayishwa kuma-molecule e-MHC class I noma e-MHC class II bese zithuthwa ziye ebusweni beseli ukuze kuvezwe i-antigen, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 33.8. Qaphela ukuthi ama-T lymphocyte awakwazi ukuphendula kahle ku-antigen ngaphandle kokuthi icutshungulwe futhi ifakwe ku-molecule ye-MHC II. Ama-APC aveza i-MHC ezindaweni zawo, futhi uma ehlanganiswa ne-antigen yangaphandle, lawa ma-complex abonisa uhlaseli ongeyena uqobo. Uma ingxenye ye-antigen isifakwe ku-molecule ye-MHC II, iseli lokuzivikela komzimba lingasabela. Amaseli e-Helper T angenye yama-lymphocyte ayinhloko asabela kumaseli aveza i-antigen. Khumbula ukuthi wonke amanye amaseli e-nucleated emzimbeni aveza ama-molecule e-MHC I, abonisa ukuthi aphilile noma ajwayelekile.
