chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.2 Impendulo Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni Evumelana Nezimo | Ama-lymphocyte e-T kanye ne-B
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.2 Adaptive Immune Response | T and B Lymphocytes
chapterContent:
Ama-lymphocyte egazini elijikeleza abantu angaba ngu-80 kuya ku-90% wamaseli e-T, aboniswe kuMfanekiso 33.9, kanye namaseli e-B angu-10 kuya ku-20%. Khumbula ukuthi amaseli e-T ahilelekile empendulweni yokuzivikela komzimba eqhutshwa amaseli, kanti amaseli e-B ayingxenye yempendulo yokuzivikela komzimba e-humoral.

 Amaseli e-T ahlanganisa inani elikhulu lamaseli anemisebenzi eyahlukahlukene kakhulu. Amanye amaseli e-T asabela kuma-APC esimiso sokuzivikela somzimba esingokwemvelo, futhi abangela ngokungaqondile izimpendulo zokuzivikela komzimba ngokukhulula ama-cytokine. Amanye amaseli e-T avuselela amaseli e-B ukuba alungiselele impendulo yawo. Elinye inani lamaseli e-T lithola izimpawu ze-APC futhi libulale ngqo amaseli athelelekile. Amanye amaseli e-T ahilelekile ekucindezeleni ukusabela okungafanele kwamasosha omzimba kuma-antigen angenangozi noma azimele.

 Amaseli e-T kanye ne-B abonisa isihloko esifanayo sokuqaphela/ukubopha ama-antigen athile nge-receptor ehambisanayo, kulandelwa ukusebenza kanye nokuzikhulisa/ukuvuthwa ukuze kuboshwe ngqo kwi-antigen ethile yegciwane elithelelanayo. Ama-lymphocyte e-T kanye ne-B nawo afana ngokuthi iseli ngalinye liveza uhlobo olulodwa kuphela lwe-receptor ye-antigen. Noma yimuphi umuntu angaba nenani lamaseli e-T kanye ne-B aveza ndawonye izinhlobo eziningi zama-receptor e-antigen angakwazi ukubona cishe noma yiliphi igciwane elithelelanayo. Amaseli e-T kanye ne-B asebenza lapho ebona izingxenye ezincane zama-antigen, ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-epitopes, ezethulwe yi-APCs, eziboniswe kuMfanekiso 33.10. Qaphela ukuthi ukuqashelwa kwenzeka ku-epitope ethile kunaku-antigen yonke; ngenxa yalesi sizathu, ama-epitopes aziwa ngokuthi yizici ze-antigenic.” Uma kungekho lwazi oluvela kuma-APC, amaseli e-T kanye ne-B ahlala engasebenzi, noma engazi lutho, futhi awakwazi ukulungiselela impendulo yamasosha omzimba. Isidingo solwazi oluvela kuma-APC mayelana nokuzivikela komzimba okubangelwa ukuvuselelwa kwamaseli e-B noma amaseli e-T sibonisa uhlobo olubalulekile lwempendulo yomzimba engokwemvelo ekusebenzeni kwesistimu yonke yomzimba.

 Amaseli e-T angenalwazi angaveza enye yama-molecule amabili ahlukene, i-CD4 noma i-CD8, ebusweni bawo, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 33.11, futhi ahlukaniswa njengamaseli e-CD4+ noma e-CD8+. Lawa ma-molecule abalulekile ngoba alawula indlela iseli le-T elizosebenzisana ngayo futhi liphendule ngayo ku-APC. Amaseli e-CD4+ angenalwazi abopha ama-APC ngama-molecule awo e-MHC II ahlanganiswe yi-antigen futhi ashukunyiswa ukuba abe ama-lymphocyte e-T (TH) awusizo, amaseli aqhubeka nokuvuselela amaseli e-B (noma amaseli e-T anobungozi) ngokuqondile noma akhiphe ama-cytokine ukuze azise amaseli amaningi ahlosiwe mayelana nosongo lwe-pathogenic. Ngokuphambene nalokho, amaseli e-CD8+ ahlanganisa ama-molecule e-MHC I ahlanganiswe yi-antigen kuma-APC futhi ashukunyiswa ukuba abe ama-lymphocyte e-T anobungozi (ama-CTL), abulala ngqo amaseli athelelekile nge-apoptosis futhi akhiphe ama-cytokine ukuze andise impendulo yomzimba. Izinhlobo ezimbili zamaseli e-T zinezindlela ezahlukene zokuvikela amasosha omzimba, kodwa zombili zibopha ama-molecule e-MHC ngama-receptor awo e-antigen abizwa ngokuthi ama-T cell receptors (ama-TCR). Ama-molecule angaphezulu e-CD4 noma e-CD8 ahlukanisa ukuthi i-TCR izosebenzisana yini ne-MHC II noma i-MHC I molecule. Ngenxa yokuthi asiza ekuqondeni ukubopha, ama-molecule e-CD4 ne-CD8 achazwa njengama-coreceptors.

 Cabanga ngama-antigen angenakubalwa umuntu azovezwa kuwo ngesikhathi sokuphila kwakhe. Uhlelo lokuzivikela oluguquguqukayo lwezilwane ezincelisayo lunekhono lokuphendula ngendlela efanele ku-antigen ngayinye. Izilwane ezincelisayo zinezinhlobonhlobo ezinkulu zezinhlobo zamaseli e-T, ezivela ekuhlukeni kwama-TCR. I-TCR ngayinye inamaketanga amabili e-polypeptide ahlanganisa ulwelwesi lwamaseli e-T, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 33.12; amaketanga axhunywe yibhuloho le-disulfide. Iketanga ngalinye le-polypeptide lakhiwe yi-domain engaguquki kanye ne-domain eguquguqukayo: i-domain, ngalomqondo, iyisifunda esithile seprotheyini esingaba yi-control noma yesakhiwo. I-domain yangaphakathi kweseli ihilelekile ekusayineni kwangaphakathi kweseli. Iseli elilodwa le-T lizoveza izinkulungwane zamakhophi afanayo ohlobo olulodwa oluthile lwe-TCR ebusweni balo beseli. Ukucaciswa kwesistimu yokuzivikela eguquguqukayo kwenzeka ngoba ihlanganisa izigidi zamaqembu ahlukene e-T cell, ngalinye liveza i-TCR ehlukile endaweni yalo eguquguqukayo. Lokhu kuhlukahluka kwe-TCR kufezwa ngokuguqulwa kanye nokuhlanganiswa kabusha kwezakhi zofuzo ezifaka la ma-receptor kuma-precursor eseli le-stem cell amaseli e-T. Ukubopha phakathi kwe-molecule ye-MHC ebonisa i-antigen kanye nomdlalo we-TCR ohambisanayo” kubonisa ukuthi uhlelo lokuzivikela oluguquguqukayo ludinga ukusebenzisa futhi lukhiqize lelo seli elithile le-T ngoba isakhiwo salo sifanelekile ukuqaphela nokubhubhisa i-pathogen ehlaselayo.

answer1: Cishe 80–90%

answer4: Zidinga ukuvezwa kwe-antigen ngamaseli aveza i-antigen (ama-APC) ukuze kusebenze

question6: Uhlobo luni lweseli le-T oluvela kuseli le-T le-CD8+ elingazi lutho?

answer7: Zibulala amangqamuzana athelelekile ngokubangela i-apoptosis

answer8: Ngokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokuhlanganiswa kabusha kwezakhi zofuzo ze-receptor ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kwamaseli e-T

answer9: Zisebenza njengama-coreceptors anquma ukuthi iseli le-T liyasebenzisana yini nama-molecule e-MHC II noma e-MHC I.
question10: Bheka uMfanekiso 33.11. Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo mayelana namaseli e-T esingamanga?
answer10: I-MHC II iyi-receptor etholakala kumaseli amaningi omzimba, kanti i-MHC I iyi-receptor etholakala kumaseli omzimba kuphela.
distractor10a: I-receptor yamaseli e-T itholakala kumaseli e-CD4+ kanye ne-CD8+ T
distractor10b: Amaseli e-T awusizo angama-CD4+, kanti amaseli e-T anobuthi angama-CD8+
distractor10c: Amaseli e-T asizayo akhipha ama-cytokine, kuyilapho amaseli e-T anobuthi ebulala iseli elithelelekile

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.2 Impendulo Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni Evumelana Nezimo | Ama-lymphocyte e-T kanye ne-B | Ama-lymphocyte e-Helper T
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.2 Adaptive Immune Response | T and B Lymphocytes | Helper T Lymphocytes
chapterContent:
Ama-lymphocyte e-TH asebenza ngokungaqondile ukuhlonza amagciwane angaba khona kwamanye amaseli esistimu sokuzivikela komzimba. Lawa maseli abalulekile ekuthelelekeni okungaphandle kweseli, njengalawo abangelwa amabhaktheriya athile, ama-helminth, kanye nama-protozoa. Ama-lymphocyte e-TH aqaphela ama-antigen athile aboniswa kuma-complex e-MHC II ama-APC. Kunezinhlobo ezimbili ezinkulu zamaseli e-TH: i-TH1 kanye ne-TH2. Amaseli e-TH1 akhipha ama-cytokine ukuze athuthukise imisebenzi yama-macrophage namanye amaseli e-T. Amaseli e-TH1 avuselela isenzo samaseli e-T anobuthi, kanye nama-macrophage. Amaseli e-TH2 avuselela amaseli e-B angenalwazi ukuthi abhubhise abahlaseli bangaphandle ngokukhishwa kwama-antibody. Ukuthi impendulo yomzimba ye-TH1 noma ye-TH2 iyavela kuncike ezinhlotsheni ezithile zama-cytokine akhishwa amaseli esistimu yokuzivikela yomzimba engokwemvelo, okuncike kuhlobo lwe-pathogen ehlaselayo.

 Impendulo eqondiswa yi-TH1 ihilela ama-macrophage futhi ihlotshaniswa nokuvuvukala. Khumbula ukuzivikela okuqondile kwama-macrophage ahilelekile empendulweni yomzimba engokwemvelo. Amanye amabhaktheriya angaphakathi kwamangqamuzana, njenge-Mycobacterium tuberculosis, avele anda kuma-macrophage ngemva kokuba esegubungelwe. Lawa ma-pathogen agwema imizamo yama-macrophage yokubhubhisa nokugaya i-pathogen. Lapho kuvela ukutheleleka kwe-M. tuberculosis, ama-macrophage angavuselela amaseli e-T angenalwazi ukuba abe amaseli e-TH1. Lawa maseli e-T avuselelwe akhipha ama-cytokine athile athumela impendulo kuma-macrophage ukuze avuselele amakhono ayo okugaya ukudla futhi ayivumele ukuthi ibhubhise i-M. tuberculosis ehlala ekoloni. Ngendlela efanayo, ama-macrophage asebenza nge-TH1 nawo afaneleka kangcono ukugwinya nokubulala amaseli esimila. Ngamafuphi; Izimpendulo ze-TH1 ziqondiswe kubahlaseli bangaphakathi kwamangqamuzana kuyilapho izimpendulo ze-TH2 ziqondiswe kulabo abangaphandle kweseli.
question1: Iyini indima eyinhloko yama-lymphocyte omsizi we-T (TH)?
answer1: Ukuthola izifo ezingaba khona nokuhlanganisa impendulo yomzimba ngokusebenzisa amanye amaseli omzimba

answer3: Zikhipha ama-cytokine avuselela ama-macrophage namaseli e-T anobuthi

question4: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wamaseli e-TH2?
answer4: Zivuselela amaseli e-B angenalwazi ukuze akhiqize ama-antibodies
distractor4a: Zivuselela amangqamuzana okubulala emvelo ukuze zibhubhise izimila
question5: Yini enquma ukuthi impendulo yomzimba ye-TH1 noma ye-TH2 iyavela yini?
answer5: Ama-cytokine athile akhishwa amaseli esimiso somzimba sokuzivikela esingokwemvelo ngenxa yegciwane
question6: Amaseli e-TH1 asiza kanjani ukuqeda ukutheleleka kwesifo sofuba se-Mycobacterium?
answer6: Zikhipha ama-cytokine athuthukisa amakhono okugaya ukudla kwama-macrophage
distractor6b: Zikhipha i-perforin ukuze zibhubhise ama-macrophage athelelekile

answer7: Amagciwane angaphakathi kwamangqamuzana
question8: Yiluphi uhlobo lwezifo ezibangelwa yi-TH2 eziqondiswe kakhulu kuzo?
answer8: Amagciwane angaphandle kwamangqamuzana

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.2 Impendulo Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni Evumelana Nezimo | Ama-lymphocyte e-T kanye ne-B | Ama-lymphocyte e-B
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.2 Adaptive Immune Response | T and B Lymphocytes | B Lymphocytes
chapterContent:
Uma ivuselelwa yindlela ye-TH2, amangqamuzana e-B angenalwazi ahlukana abe amangqamuzana e-plasma akhipha ama-antibody. Iseli le-plasma liyiseli lokuzivikela elifihla ama-antibodies; lawa maseli avela kumaseli e-B avuselelwa ama-antigen. Njengamaseli e-T, amangqamuzana e-B angenalwazi ekuqaleni ambozwe ngezinkulungwane zama-receptor e-B cell (ama-BCR), okuyizinhlobo ze-Ig (immunoglobulin, noma i-antibody). I-receptor yeseli le-B inamaketanga amabili asindayo namaketanga amabili alula axhunywe yizixhumanisi ze-disulfide. Iketanga ngalinye linesifunda esingaguquki nesiguquguqukayo; lesi sakamuva sihilelekile ekubopheni i-antigen. Amanye amaprotheni amabili e-membrane, i-Ig alpha ne-Ig beta, ahilelekile ekudluliseni izimpawu. Ama-receptor anoma yiliphi iseli le-B elithile, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 33.13 ayafana, kodwa amakhulu ezigidi zamaseli e-B ahlukene kumuntu ngamunye anezindawo zokuqaphela ezihlukile ezifaka isandla ekwahlukeni okukhulu ezinhlotsheni zezakhiwo zama-molecule angabopha kuzo. Kulesi simo, amangqamuzana e-B asebenza njenge-APC. Abopha futhi agwinye ama-antigen angaphandle ngama-BCR awo bese ekhombisa ama-antigen acutshunguliwe kumongo wama-molecule e-MHC II kumaseli e-TH2. Uma iseli le-TH2 lithola ukuthi iseli le-B liboshelwe ku-antigen efanele, likhipha ama-cytokine athile abangela iseli le-B ukuba lande ngokushesha, okwenza izinkulungwane zamakhophi alo afanayo (ama-clonal), bese lihlanganisa futhi likhiphe ama-antibodies anephethini efanayo yokubona i-antigen njenge-BCRs. Ukusebenza kwamaseli e-B okuhambisana nohlobo olulodwa oluthile lwe-BCR kanye nokwanda okukhulu kwalolo hlobo kwaziwa ngokuthi ukukhetha kwe-clonal. Lesi simo sishintsha kakhulu, kodwa kafushane, isilinganiso sezinhlobo ze-BCR ezivezwa uhlelo lokuzivikela komzimba, futhi sishintsha ibhalansi iye kuma-BCR athile ku-pathogen ethelelanayo.

 Amaseli e-T kanye ne-B ahlukile ngendlela eyodwa eyisisekelo: kuyilapho amaseli e-T ebopha ama-antigen agayiwe futhi afakwe kuma-molecule e-MHC ngama-APCs, amaseli e-B asebenza njengama-APC abopha ama-antigen aphelele angakacutshungulwa. Nakuba amaseli e-T kanye ne-B womabili esabela nama-molecule abizwa ngokuthi ama-antigen,” la ma-lymphocyte empeleni asabela ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene kakhulu zama-molecule. Amaseli e-B kumele akwazi ukubopha ama-antigen aphelele ngoba akhipha ama-antibodies okumele aqaphele i-pathogen ngqo, kunokuba akhiphe izinsalela ezigayiwe ze-pathogen. Ama-molecule e-carbohydrate kanye ne-lipid e-bacterial angasebenza amaseli e-B ngokuzimela kumaseli e-T
question1: Yini amaseli e-B angenalwazi ahlukanisa ngayo ngemva kokukhuthazwa yindlela ye-TH2?
answer1: Amaseli e-plasma akhipha ama-antibody
question2: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko weseli le-plasma?
answer2: Ukukhipha ama-antibodies
question3: Iyini i-B cell receptor (BCR)?
answer3: I-immunoglobulin eboshwe nge-membrane eqaphela ama-antigen athile
distractor3b: Iphrotheni eyakha ama-pores ezifweni ezibangelwa amagciwane
question4: Amaseli e-B asebenza kanjani njengamaseli aveza ama-antigen (ama-APC)?
answer4: Zibopha futhi zigwinye ama-antigen aphelele, ziwacubungule, bese ziveza izingcezu ze-antigen kuma-molecule e-MHC II
distractor4a: Ziveza ama-antigen kuphela kuma-molecule e-MHC I
distractor4c: Zivuselela amaseli e-T ane-cytotoxic ngaphandle kokwethulwa kwe-antigen
question5: Kuyini ukukhetha kwe-clonal?
answer5: Ukwanda okusheshayo kwamaseli e-B nge-receptor ethile yamaseli e-B ngemva kokusebenza yi-antigen efanayo
distractor5a: Ukubhujiswa kwamaseli e-B afanayo ngemva kokutheleleka
distractor5c: Ukukhiqizwa kwezinhlobo eziningi zama-receptor eseli B yiseli elilodwa le-B
question6: Amaseli e-T namaseli e-B ahluke kanjani ekuqaphelweni kwe-antigen?
answer6: Amaseli e-T aqaphela ama-antigen acutshunguliwe atholakala kuma-molecule e-MHC, kanti amaseli e-B aqaphela ama-antigen aphelele
distractor6a: Zombili zibona kuphela ama-antigen acutshunguliwe alethwa kuma-molecule e-MHC II
distractor6c: Amaseli e-T aqaphela ama-antigen aphelele, kuyilapho amaseli e-B eqaphela ama-antigen acutshunguliwe kuphela
question7: Kungani amaseli e-B kufanele aqaphele ama-antigen aphelele?
answer7: Ngoba akhiqiza ama-antibodies okumele abophe ngqo ezifweni ezibangelwa amagciwane
question8: Yiziphi izinhlobo zama-molecule ezingasebenzisa amaseli e-B ngaphandle kwamaseli e-T?
answer8: Ama-carbohydrate nama-molecule e-lipid ebhaktheriya
distractor8b: Amaprotheni kuphela atholakala kuma-molecule e-MHC I
question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 33.13. Yisiphi isici sokwakheka esinikeza ama-receptor e-B cell ukwehlukahluka kwawo okukhulu?
answer9: Umehluko ezindaweni zawo eziguquguqukayo eziqaphela ama-antigen athile
distractor9a: Umehluko ezindaweni zawo ezihlala njalo kuphela

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.2 Impendulo Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni Evumelana Nezimo | Ama-lymphocyte e-T kanye ne-B | Ama-lymphocyte e-T ayingozi
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.2 Adaptive Immune Response | T and B Lymphocytes | Cytotoxic T Lymphocytes
chapterContent:
Ama-CTL, iqembu elincane lamaseli e-T, asebenza ukususa izifo ngqo. Ingxenye elawulwa yiseli yesistimu yokuzivikela yomzimba eguquguqukayo iqukethe ama-CTL ahlasela futhi abhubhise amaseli athelelekile. Ama-CTL abaluleke kakhulu ekuvikeleni izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane; lokhu kungenxa yokuthi amagciwane ayaphindaphindeka ngaphakathi kwamaseli lapho evikelwe khona ekuthintaneni okungaphandle kwamaseli nama-antibodies ajikelezayo. Lapho ama-APC eqeda amagciwane futhi eveza ama-antigen e-MHC I kumaseli e-CD8+ T angenalwazi aveza ama-TCR ahambisanayo, amaseli e-CD8+ T asebenza ukuze ande ngokwendlela yokukhetha ama-clonal. Lawa ma-CTL aphumayo abe esebona ama-non-APC abonisa ama-antigen afanayo e-MHC I (isibonelo, amaprotheni egciwane)—isibonelo, ama-CTL akhomba amaseli aphethwe yigciwane.

 Ngaphakathi kweseli, amaseli athelelekile avame ukufa ngemva kokuba i-pathogen ethelelekile iphindaphindeka ibe yizinga elanele futhi ibulale iseli, njengoba kwenza amagciwane amaningi. Ama-CTL azama ukuthola nokubhubhisa amaseli athelelekile ngaphambi kokuba i-pathogen iphindaphindeke futhi ibaleke, ngaleyo ndlela imise ukuqhubeka kokutheleleka kwangaphakathi kweseli. Ama-CTL asekela nama-lymphocyte e-NK ukuze abhubhise umdlavuza wasekuqaleni. Ama-Cytokine akhishwa yimpendulo ye-TH1 evuselela ama-macrophage nawo avuselela ama-CTL futhi athuthukise ikhono lawo lokubona nokubhubhisa amangqamuzana athelelekile kanye nezimila.

 Ama-CTL azwa ama-antigen afakwe yi-MHC I ngokusebenzisana ngqo namaseli athelelekile ngama-TCR awo. Ukubopha ama-TCR ngama-antigen kusebenzisa ama-CTL ukuze akhiphe i-perforin kanye ne-granzyme, ama-enzyme abhubhisayo azobangela i-apoptosis yeseli elithelelekile. Khumbula ukuthi lokhu kuyindlela yokubhubhisa efanayo naleyo esetshenziswa amaseli e-NK. Kule nqubo, i-CTL ayitheleleki futhi ayilinyazwa ukukhiqizwa kwe-perforin kanye nama-granzymes. Eqinisweni, imisebenzi yamaseli e-NK nama-CTL iyahambisana futhi ikhulisa ukususwa kwamaseli athelelekile, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 33.14. Uma iseli le-NK lingakwazi ukuhlonza iphethini yokuzimela elahlekile yama-molecule e-MHC I alawulwa phansi, khona-ke i-CTL ingayihlonza ngenhlanganisela ye-MHC I enama-antigen angaphandle, okubonisa ukuthi i-self ishintshiwe. Ngokufanayo, uma i-CTL ingakwazi ukubona i-MHC I efakwe i-antigen ngoba ama-receptor anciphile ebusweni beseli, amaseli e-NK azobhubhisa iseli esikhundleni salokho. Ama-CTL aphinde akhiphe ama-cytokine, njenge-interferons, ashintsha ukubonakaliswa kweprotheni engaphezulu kwamanye amaseli athelelekile, ukuze amaseli athelelekile akwazi ukubonwa futhi abhujiswe kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, la ma-interferons angavimbela namaseli athelelekile ngegciwane ekukhipheni izinhlayiya zegciwane.
question1: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wama-cytotoxic T lymphocytes (ama-CTL)?
answer1: Ukubhubhisa ngqo amaseli athelelekile njengengxenye yempendulo yomzimba eqondiswa amaseli
question2: Kungani ama-CTL ebaluleke kakhulu ekuthelelekeni ngegciwane?
answer2: Amagciwane aphindaphindeka ngaphakathi kwamaseli omninikhaya lapho ama-antibodies ajikelezayo engakwazi ukufinyelela kuwo
distractor2a: Amagciwane ahlasela amaseli abomvu egazi kuphela
distractor2b: Ama-virus amakhulu kakhulu ukuba angagwinywa ama-macrophage
question3: Amaseli e-CD8+ T angasebenzi kanjani?
answer3: Ngokubona izingcezu ze-antigen ezethulwa kuma-molecule e-MHC I ngamaseli aveza i-antigen
question4: Ama-T lymphocyte ane-cytotoxic awabhubhisa kanjani amaseli athelelekile?
answer4: Zikhipha i-perforin kanye ne-granules ezibangela i-apoptosis
distractor4c: Zikhipha i-histamine ukuze ziqhekeze amaseli athelelekile
question5: Amaseli e-TH1 athuthukisa kanjani umsebenzi we-CTL?
answer5: Zikhipha ama-cytokine avuselela ama-CTL futhi athuthukise ikhono lawo lokubhubhisa amangqamuzana athelelekile kanye nezimila.
distractor5c: Zithatha indawo ye-CTL ngesikhathi sokutheleleka ngegciwane
question6: Ama-CTL namaseli e-natural killer (NK) ahambisana kanjani?
answer6: Ama-CTL ayaqaphela ama-antigen angaphandle alethwa ku-MHC I, kuyilapho amaseli e-NK ebhubhisa amaseli anama-molecule e-MHC I angekho noma angajwayelekile.
distractor6a: Zombili ziqaphela kuphela ama-molecule e-MHC II
distractor6b: Zombili zibhubhisa amagciwane kuphela ngokukhiqiza ama-antibodies
distractor6c: Amaseli e-NK avuselela ama-CTL ngokuletha ama-antigen ku-MHC II
question7: Iyiphi indima eyengeziwe edlalwa yi-CTL ngaphandle kokubhubhisa amaseli athelelekile?
answer7: Zikhipha ama-cytokine afana nama-interferons asiza ekuboneni amaseli athelelekile futhi avimbele ukukhishwa kwegciwane
distractor7b: Zikhipha i-histamine ukuze zibangele ukusabela kwe-allergy
question8: Ayini amaseli e-effector?
answer8: Amaseli e-plasma ahlukene kanye nama-cytotoxic T lymphocytes avikela ngenkuthalo ezifweni ezibangelwa amagciwane kanye namaseli athelelekile
distractor8a: Amaseli e-B angenalwazi kanye namaseli e-T angenalwazi
question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 33.14. Ngokusekelwe kulokho okwaziyo ngama-receptor e-MHC, kungani ucabanga ukuthi isitho esifakwe kusuka kumnikeli ongahambisani siya kumamukeli sizokwenqatshwa?
answer9: Amasosha omzimba omuntu othola lesi sidakamizwa azobona amaprotheni akwisitho esingahambisani naso njengangaphandle futhi azohlasela la maprotheni angaphandle. Lokhu kuhlasela kuzokwenza ukuthi isitho senqatshwe.
distractor9a: Amaseli abulalayo emvelo omuntu othola lesi sifo azobona amaprotheni e-MHC II akhona ebusweni beseli lesitho esingahambisani njengangaphandle futhi asebenze ama-macrophage, azokhipha amaseli angaphandle. Ukuhlasela kuzokwenza ukuthi isitho senqatshwe.
distractor9b: Ama-neutrophil azobona amaprotheni asesithweni esingahambisani njengangaphandle futhi azokhipha i-phagocytosis kumaseli angaphandle esitho esingahambisani.
distractor9c: Amaseli abulalayo emvelo omuntu otholayo azobona amaprotheni e-MHC II akhona ebusweni beseli lesitho esingahambisani njengangaphandle futhi azohlasela la maprotheni angaphandle. Ukuhlasela kuzokwenza ukuthi isitho senqatshwe.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.2 Impendulo Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni Evumelana Nezimo | Ama-lymphocyte e-T kanye ne-B | Izindawo Zomzimba Nokubekezelelana Kwazo Emzimbeni
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.2 Adaptive Immune Response | T and B Lymphocytes | Mucosal Surfaces and Immune Tolerance
chapterContent:
Izimpendulo zokuzivikela komzimba ezingokwemvelo neziguquguqukayo okuxoxwe ngazo kuze kube manje zakha uhlelo lokuzivikela komzimba olujwayelekile (oluthinta umzimba wonke), oluhlukile ohlelweni lokuzivikela komzimba olungaphakathi. Ukuzivikela komzimba olungaphakathi kwamangqamuzana kwakhiwa izicubu ze-lymphoid ezihambisana ne-mucosa, ezisebenza ngokuzimela ohlelweni lokuzivikela komzimba olungaphakathi, futhi ezinezakhi zalo zokuzalwa nezihambisanayo. Izicubu ze-lymphoid ezihambisana ne-Mucosa (i-MALT), eziboniswe kuMfanekiso 33.15, iqoqo lezicubu ze-lymphatic ezihlangana nezicubu ze-epithelial ezimboze i-mucosa kuwo wonke umzimba. Lesi zicubu sisebenza njengesivimbelo sokuzivikela komzimba kanye nokusabela ezindaweni zomzimba ngokuxhumana ngqo nendawo yangaphandle. Izinhlelo zokuzivikela zomzimba ezingaphakathi kwamangqamuzana nezingaphakathi kwamangqamuzana zisebenzisa izinhlobo eziningi zamaseli afanayo. Izinhlayiya zangaphandle ezifika e-MALT zithathwa amaseli e-epithelial adonswayo abizwa ngokuthi amaseli e-M futhi zilethwe kuma-APC atholakala ngqo ngaphansi kwezicubu ze-mucosal. Amaseli e-M asebenza ekuthuthweni okuchazwe, futhi atholakala e-Peyer`s patch, i-lymphoid nodule. Ama-APC esistimu yokuzivikela komzimba engaphakathi kwamangqamuzana ngokuyinhloko amaseli e-dendritic, namaseli e-B nama-macrophage anezindima ezincane. Ama-antigen acutshunguliwe aboniswa kuma-APC atholakala ngamaseli e-T ku-MALT nasezindaweni ezahlukahlukene zokungeniswa kwe-mucosal, njenge-tonsils, i-adenoids, i-appendix, noma ama-lymph node e-mesenteric emathunjini. Amaseli e-T asebenzayo abese ehamba ngohlelo lwe-lymphatic futhi angene ohlelweni lokujikeleza kwegazi aye ezindaweni ze-mucosal zokutheleleka.

 I-MALT iyisici esibalulekile sohlelo lokuzivikela olusebenzayo ngoba izindawo ze-mucosal, njengezindawo zamakhala, ziyizicubu zokuqala lapho kufakwa khona amagciwane aphefumulayo noma agwinyiwe. Izicubu ze-mucosal zifaka umlomo, i-pharynx, kanye ne-esophagus, kanye nezindlela zamathumbu, zokuphefumula, kanye neze-urogenital.

 Uhlelo lokuzivikela kumele lulawulwe ukuze kuvinjelwe izimpendulo ezichithayo, ezingadingekile ezintweni ezingenangozi, futhi okubaluleke kakhulu ukuze lungazihlaseli. Ikhono elitholakalayo lokuvimbela impendulo engadingekile noma eyingozi yomzimba entweni yangaphandle etholakele eyaziwa ukuthi ayibangeli izifo lichazwa njengokubekezelelana komzimba. Ukubekezelelana komzimba kubalulekile ekugcineni i-homeostasis ye-mucosal ngenxa yenani elikhulu lezinto zangaphandle (njengamaprotheni okudla) ezihlangana nama-APC omlomo, i-pharynx, kanye ne-mucosa yamathumbu. Ukubekezelelana komzimba kulethwa ama-APC akhethekile esibindini, kuma-lymph node, emathunjini amancane, nasemaphashini aletha ama-antigen angenangozi kubantu abahlukahlukene kakhulu bamaseli e-T (Treg) alawulayo, ama-lymphocyte akhethekile acindezela ukuvuvukala kwendawo futhi avimbele ukukhiqizwa kwezici zokuzivikela zomzimba ezivuselelayo. Umphumela ohlangene wamaseli e-Treg ukuvimbela ukusebenza kwe-immunologic kanye nokuvuvukala ezindaweni zezicubu ezingafuneki nokuvumela isimiso somzimba sokuzivikela komzimba ukuthi sigxile kuma-pathogen esikhundleni salokho. Ngaphezu kokukhuthaza ukubekezelelana komzimba kwama-antigen angenangozi, amanye ama-subset amaseli e-Treg ahilelekile ekuvimbeleni impendulo ye-autoimmune, okuyimpendulo engafanele yomzimba kumaseli e-host noma ama-self-antigen. Elinye ikilasi le-Treg licindezela izimpendulo zomzimba kuma-pathogen ayingozi ngemva kokuba ukutheleleka sekuphelile ukuze kuncishiswe umonakalo weseli le-host obangelwa ukuvuvukala kanye ne-cell lysis.
question1: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wesimiso sokuzivikela somzimba se-mucosal?
answer1: Ukuvikela izindawo ze-mucosal ezithintana ngqo nendawo engaphandle
question2: I-MALT imele ukuthini?
answer2: Izicubu ze-lymphoid ezihlobene ne-mucosa
question3: Iyini indima yamaseli e-M ekuvikeleni amasosha omzimba e-mucosal?
answer3: Zithutha izinhlayiya zakwamanye amazwe ziye kumaseli aveza ama-antigen ngaphansi kobuso be-mucosal
question4: Yimaphi amangqamuzana omzimba angamaseli ayinhloko aveza i-antigen ku-MALT?
answer4: Amaseli e-dendritic
question5: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sendawo yokungenisa i-mucosal?
answer5: Ama-Tonsils
question6: Kungani i-MALT iyingxenye ebalulekile yesimiso somzimba sokuzivikela?
answer6: Ngoba amagciwane amaningi aqala ukuthintana nomzimba ezindaweni ezingaphandle kwe-mucosal
distractor6c: Ngoba ibhubhisa zonke izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane ngaphambi kokuba zingene egazini
question7: Kuyini ukubekezelelana kwamasosha omzimba?
answer7: Ikhono elitholakalayo lokugwema izimpendulo zomzimba ezingadingekile noma eziyingozi ezintweni zangaphandle ezingenangozi
distractor7a: Ukungakwazi kwesimiso somzimba sokuzivikela ekuzivikeleni ekutholeni izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane
distractor7b: Ukubhujiswa kwawo wonke ama-molecule angaphandle angena emzimbeni
distractor7c: Ukucindezelwa okungapheli kwazo zonke izimpendulo zomzimba
question8: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wamaseli e-T (Treg) alawulayo?
answer8: Ukucindezela izimpendulo ezingafanele zomzimba nokugcina ukubekezelelana komzimba
question9: Amaseli e-Treg asiza kanjani ukuvimbela izifo ezizimele?
answer9: Zivimbela izimpendulo zomzimba ngokumelene namaseli omzimba kanye nama-self-antigens
distractor9b: Zivuselela ama-macrophage ukuze agaye amaseli anempilo

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.2 Impendulo Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni Evumelana Nezimo | Inkumbulo Yezifo Ezingalawuleki
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.2 Adaptive Immune Response | Immunological Memory
chapterContent:
Uhlelo lokuzivikela oluguquguqukayo lunengxenye yenkumbulo evumela impendulo ephumelelayo nemangalisayo lapho kuphinda kuhlaselwe i-pathogen efanayo. Inkumbulo iphathwa uhlelo lokuzivikela oluguquguqukayo ngaphandle kokuthembela kakhulu ezindleleni ezivela empendulweni yangaphakathi. Ngesikhathi sempendulo yokuzivikela eguquguqukayo ku-pathogen engakaze ihlangane ngaphambili, ebizwa ngokuthi impendulo eyinhloko, amaseli e-plasma akhipha ama-antibodies namaseli e-T ahlukene ayanda, bese ephela ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Njengoba amaseli e-B ne-T evuthwa abe amaseli e-effector, i-subset yabantu abangenalwazi ihluka ibe amaseli enkumbulo e-B ne-T ane-antigen specifics efanayo, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 33.16.

 Iseli lememori liyi-B noma i-T lymphocyte ethile ye-antigen engahlukani ngamaseli e-effector ngesikhathi sempendulo yokuzivikela eyinhloko, kodwa engaba amaseli e-effector ngokushesha lapho ephinde abhekane ne-pathogen efanayo. Ngesikhathi sempendulo yokuzivikela eyinhloko, amaseli enkumbulo awaphenduli kuma-antigen futhi awafaki isandla ekuzivikeleni komsingathi. Njengoba ukutheleleka kusuliwe futhi izinto ezibangela izifo ziphela, ama-effector awasadingeki, futhi adlula ku-apoptosis. Ngokuphambene nalokho, amaseli enkumbulo ayaqhubeka nokujikeleza kwegazi.

 Uma i-pathogen ingaphinde ihlangane ngesikhathi sokuphila komuntu, amaseli enkumbulo e-B ne-T azojikeleza iminyaka embalwa noma ngisho namashumi eminyaka ambalwa futhi azofa kancane kancane, engakaze asebenze njengamaseli asebenzayo. Kodwa-ke, uma umninimzi ephinde wavezwa ohlotsheni olufanayo lwe-pathogen, amaseli enkumbulo ajikelezayo azohlukana ngokushesha abe amaseli e-plasma nama-CTL ngaphandle kokufaka okuvela kuma-APC noma amaseli e-TH. Esinye sezizathu zokuthi impendulo yokuzivikela komzimba eguquguqukayo ibambezeleke ngoba kuthatha isikhathi ukuthi amaseli e-B ne-T angenalwazi ane-antigen specifics efanele atholakale futhi asebenze. Lapho ephinde atheleleke, lesi sinyathelo siyeqiwa, futhi umphumela uba ukukhiqizwa okusheshayo kokuzivikela komzimba. Amaseli e-Memory B ahluka ngamaseli e-plasma akhipha amanani e-antibody amakhulu ngokuphindwe kayishumi kunalawo akhishwe ngesikhathi sempendulo yokuqala, njengoba igrafu kuMfanekiso 33.17 ibonisa. Le mpendulo ye-antibody esheshayo neyinkimbinkimbi ingamisa ukutheleleka ngaphambi kokuba kusungulwe, futhi umuntu angase angaqapheli ukuthi wayevezwe.

 Ukugoma kusekelwe olwazini lokuthi ukuchayeka kuma-antigen angewona amagciwane, atholakala kumagciwane aziwayo, kudala impendulo encane yokuzivikela komzimba. Impendulo yokuzivikela komzimba ekugonyweni ingase ingabhekwa njengokugula ngumnikazi kodwa isanikeza inkumbulo yokuzivikela komzimba. Uma kuvezwa kugciwane elihambisanayo umuntu ajovwe kulo, ukusabela kufana nokuchayeka kwesibili. Ngenxa yokuthi ukutheleleka ngakunye kukhiqiza amangqamuzana enkumbulo amaningi kanye nokumelana okukhulu negciwane, futhi ngenxa yokuthi amanye amangqamuzana enkumbulo ayafa, izifundo ezithile zokugoma zihilela ukugoma okukodwa noma ngaphezulu ukuze kulingise ukuchayeka okuphindaphindiwe: isibonelo, ama-tetanus booster ayadingeka njalo eminyakeni eyishumi ngoba amangqamuzana enkumbulo aphila isikhathi eside kangako.
question1: Iyini inzuzo eyinhloko yenkumbulo ye-immunological?
answer1: Ivumela impendulo esheshayo neqinile yomzimba lapho iphinda itholakale ku-pathogen efanayo
distractor1b: Kuvimbela zonke izifo zesikhathi esizayo nganoma iyiphi i-pathogen
distractor1c: Iqhubeka nokukhiqiza ama-antibodies kuyo yonke impilo
question2: Iyini iseli yememori?
answer2: I-lymphocyte ye-B noma i-T ethize ye-antigen eba yiseli elisebenzayo ngokushesha lapho iphinde ivele ku-pathogen efanayo
question3: Kwenzekani kumaseli amaningi asebenzayo ngemva kokuba ukutheleleka sekususiwe?
answer3: Badlula ku-apoptosis
question4: Kungani impendulo yesibili yokuzivikela komzimba ishesha kakhulu kunempendulo yokuqala?
answer4: Amaseli enkumbulo asevele ekhona futhi angaba amaseli asebenzayo ngokushesha ngaphandle kokudinga ukusebenza kwama-lymphocyte angenalwazi
distractor4a: Isimiso somzimba sokuzivikela esingokwemvelo sisebenza unomphela
distractor4b: Amagciwane aba buthakathaka ngemva kokutheleleka kokuqala
distractor4c: Amaseli aveza i-antigen awasadingeki kunoma yikuphi ukuphendula komzimba
question5: Amaseli e-memory B asabela kanjani lapho igciwane elifanayo liphinde lahlangana?
answer5: Zihlukana ngokushesha zibe amaseli e-plasma akhiqiza inani elikhulu kakhulu lama-antibodies
question6: Iyini injongo yokugoma?
answer6: Ukwakha inkumbulo yokuzivikela ngokuveza umzimba kuma-antigen angewona athelelwanayo
distractor6a: Ukubhubhisa unomphela zonke izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane emvelweni
distractor6b: Ukuze kusebenze kuphela isimiso somzimba sokuzivikela esingokwemvelo
question7: Kungani ngezinye izikhathi kudingeka imijovo yokuqinisa?
answer7: Ngoba amangqamuzana enkumbulo ancipha kancane kancane ngokuhamba kwesikhathi futhi izikhuthazi zivuselela inkumbulo yomzimba
distractor7a: Ngoba ama-antibodies ayayeka ukusebenza unomphela ngemva konyaka owodwa
distractor7c: Ngoba imijovo yokuqinisa ithatha indawo yesimiso somzimba sokuzivikela esingokwemvelo
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 33.16 kanye noMfanekiso 33.16.1. Le grafu ikhombisa ukuhlushwa kwe-antibody ethile ngemva kokujova. Umugqa ovundlile ngosuku ngalunye ukhombisa inani elimaphakathi elilinganiswa ngalolo suku. Unganaki inani elingu-5m ekuqaleni. Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kule grafu.
answer8: Ukukhiqizwa kwama-antibody kwaqala ngokushesha ngemva kokuthola umuthi wokugoma futhi kwanda ezinsukwini ezingamashumi amathathu ngemva kwawo.
distractor8a: Ukukhiqizwa kwama-antibody kwakuphezulu kakhulu ngosuku lokudutshulwa futhi kwehla kancane kancane ezinsukwini ezingamashumi amathathu ezalandela.
distractor8b: Ukukhiqizwa kwama-antibody bekungaguquki izinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu ngemva kokujova.
distractor8c: Ukukhiqizwa kwama-antibody kwafinyelela esicongweni ezinsukwini eziyisishiyagalombili ngemva kokujova kwabe sekwehla kancane kancane

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.2 Impendulo Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni Evumelana Nezimo | Inkumbulo Ye-Immunological | Inkumbulo Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni Ye-Mucosal
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.2 Adaptive Immune Response | Immunological Memory | Mucosal Immune Memory
chapterContent: Iqembu elincane lamaseli e-T kanye ne-B ohlelweni lokuzivikela komzimba lwe-mucosal lihluka ngamaseli enkumbulo njengasesimisweni sokuzivikela somzimba esijwayelekile. Lapho kuphinda kungene uhlobo olufanayo lwe-pathogen, impendulo yokuzivikela yomzimba evelele iyenzeka endaweni ye-mucosal lapho i-pathogen yokuqala ibekwe khona, kodwa ukuzivikela okuhlangene nakho kuhlelwe ngaphakathi kwezicubu ze-mucosal ezixhumene noma eziseduze. Isibonelo, inkumbulo yokuzivikela yomzimba yokutheleleka emlonyeni ingaveza impendulo emphinjeni uma umlomo ubhekene ne-pathogen efanayo.
question1: Hlobo luni lwamaseli ohlelweni lokuzivikela komzimba oluhlukanisa ngamaseli enkumbulo?
answer1: Iqembu elincane lamaseli e-T namaseli e-B
question2: Kwenzekani lapho igciwane elifanayo liphinde lingene endaweni engcolile?
answer2: Impendulo esheshayo neqinile yokuzivikela komzimba yenzeka endaweni yokuqala ye-mucosal kanye nezicubu ze-mucosal eziseduze.
distractor2a: Isistimu yomzimba yokuzivikela yomzimba kuphela esabelayo
distractor2c: I-pathogen ayinakwa ngoba amaseli enkumbulo ayasebenza
question3: Inkumbulo yomzimba yokuzivikela komzimba iqhathaniswa kanjani nenkumbulo yomzimba yokuzivikela yomzimba ehlelekile?
answer3: Zombili zikhiqiza amaseli e-T kanye ne-B aphendula ngokushesha lapho ephinde abhekane negciwane elifanayo.
distractor3a: Amasosha omzimba asebenza kahle kuphela akha amaseli enkumbulo
distractor3b: Isistimu yokuzivikela yomzimba ye-mucosal kuphela eyakha amaseli enkumbulo
question4: Iyini inzuzo eyodwa yenkumbulo yomzimba yokuzivikela komzimba ye-mucosal?
answer4: Ihlinzeka ngokuvikelwa okusheshayo lapho amagciwane aqala ukungena emzimbeni
distractor4a: Isusa unomphela zonke izinto eziphilayo ezitholakala ebusweni be-mucosal
distractor4b: Kuvimbela impendulo yomzimba engokwemvelo ukuthi ingenzeki
question5: Uma umlomo uphinda uvezwa yi-pathogen eke yabonwa ngaphambili, kuphi lapho impendulo yomzimba ingavela khona?
answer5: Ezicutshini ze-mucosal ezixhumene njenge-pharynx
question6: Yimaphi amangqamuzana omzimba abangela inkumbulo yomzimba yokuzivikela komzimba?
answer6: Amaseli e-Memory T namaseli e-memory B

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.2 Impendulo Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni Evumelana Nezimo | Ukuxhumana Nomsebenzi | Udokotela Wokugoma
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.2 Adaptive Immune Response | Career Connection | Vaccinologist
chapterContent:
Ukugoma (noma ukugoma) kuhilela ukulethwa, ngokuvamile ngomjovo njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 33.18, kwama-antigen(ama-antigen) angewona amagciwane atholakala kuma-pathogen aziwayo. Ezinye izingxenye, ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-adjuvants, zilethwa ngesikhathi esifanayo ukusiza ukuvuselela impendulo yokuzivikela komzimba. Inkumbulo ye-immunological iyona imbangela yokusebenza kwemijovo. Okufanelekile, umphumela wokugoma uwukuvusa inkumbulo ye-immunological, ngaleyo ndlela ukumelana nama-pathogen athile ngaphandle kokuba umuntu abhekane nokutheleleka.

 Odokotela bemijovo bahilelekile enkambisweni yokuthuthukiswa komjovo kusukela emcabangweni wokuqala kuya ekutholakaleni komjovo oqediwe. Le nqubo ingathatha amashumi eminyaka, ingabiza izigidi zamaRandi, futhi ingabandakanya izithiyo eziningi endleleni. Isibonelo, imijovo ejoviwe ivuselela uhlelo lokuzivikela komzimba oluhlelekile, ivuse ukuzivikela komzimba okubangelwa yi-humoral kanye neseli, kodwa ayinawo umthelela omkhulu empendulweni ye-mucosal, okuletha inselele ngoba ama-pathogen amaningi afakwa futhi aphindaphindeka ezindaweni ze-mucosal, futhi umjovo awunikezi inkumbulo ye-immune esebenza kahle kakhulu kula ma-agent esifo. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, odokotela bemijovo bahileleke kakhulu ekwakheni imijovo emisha esetshenziswa ngezindlela zokulethwa ngaphakathi kwempumulo, i-aerosol, yomlomo, noma nge-transcutaneous (emuncwa ngesikhumba). Okubalulekile, imijovo enikezwa yi-mucosal iveza kokubili ukuzivikela komzimba kanye nomzimba futhi ikhiqize izinga elifanayo lokumelana nezifo njengemijovo ejoviwe.

 Njengamanje, kukhona uhlobo lomjovo womkhuhlane wangaphakathi kwempumulo, futhi imijovo ye-polio kanye ne-typhoid inganikezwa ngomlomo, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 33.19. Ngokufanayo, imijovo ye-measles kanye ne-rubella iguqulwa ukuze ithunyelwe nge-aerosol kusetshenziswa amadivayisi okuphefumula. Ekugcineni, izitshalo eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo zingase zenziwe ngendlela yokukhiqiza ama-antigen okugoma angadliwa ukuze anikeze ukumelana nezifo. Eminye imijovo ingashintshwa ukuze isetshenziswe ngaphakathi kwempumulo noma ngesitho sangasese sowesifazane ukuze iveze izimpendulo zomzimba ku-mucosa ye-rectal, genitourinary, noma yokuzala. Okokugcina, ama-antigen okugoma angashintshwa ukuze asetshenziswe ngaphakathi kwesikhumba lapho isikhumba siklwejwa khona kancane futhi kusetshenziswe ama-microneedles ukubhoboza ungqimba lwangaphandle. Ngaphezu kokukhuthaza impendulo yomzimba yokuzivikela komzimba, lesi sizukulwane esisha semithi yokugoma singaqeda ukukhathazeka okuhlobene nemijovo, futhi sithuthukise ukuhlanganyela kweziguli.
question1: Iyini inhloso yokugoma (ukugoma)?
answer1: Ukuveza amasosha omzimba kuma-antigen angewona athelelanayo nokukhiqiza inkumbulo ye-immunological ngaphandle kokubangela izifo
distractor1b: Ukufaka esikhundleni sesimiso somzimba sokuzivikela esingokwemvelo
question2: Yiziphi izithasiselo ezisetshenziswa emithini yokugoma?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.2 Impendulo Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni Evumelana Nezimo | Izikhungo Eziyinhloko Zohlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.2 Adaptive Immune Response | Primary Centers of the Immune System
chapterContent:
Nakuba uhlelo lokuzivikela komzimba lubonakala ngamaseli ajikeleza umzimba wonke, ukulawulwa, ukuvuthwa, kanye nokuxhumana kwezinto zokuzivikela komzimba kwenzeka ezindaweni ezithile. Igazi lijikeleza amangqamuzana okuzivikela omzimba, amaprotheni, nezinye izinto emzimbeni wonke. Cishe amaphesenti angu-0.1 awo wonke amaseli egazini angama-leukocyte, ahlanganisa ama-monocyte (okwandulela ama-macrophage) nama-lymphocyte. Iningi lamaseli egazini ama-erythrocyte (amangqamuzana abomvu egazi). I-lymph uketshezi olunamanzi olugeza izicubu nezitho ngamangqamuzana amhlophe egazi avikelayo futhi alunawo ama-erythrocyte. Amaseli ohlelo lokuzivikela komzimba angahamba phakathi kwezinhlelo ezihlukile ze-lymphatic kanye negazi, ezihlukaniswe isikhala esiphakathi, ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-extravasation (edlula iye ezicutshini ezizungezile).

 Amaseli ohlelo lokuzivikela komzimba avela kumaseli e-hematopoietic stem kumongo wethambo. Ama-Cytokine akhuthaza la maseli e-stem ukuthi ahluke abe amaseli okuzivikela komzimba. Ukuvuthwa kwamaseli e-B kwenzeka kumongo wethambo, kuyilapho amaseli e-T angenalwazi edlula kusuka kumongo wethambo aye ku-thymus ukuze avuthwe. Ku-thymus, amaseli e-T angavuthiwe aveza ama-TCR ahambisana nama-self-antigen ayabhujiswa. Le nqubo isiza ukuvimbela izimpendulo zokuzivikela komzimba.

 Lapho kuvuthwa, ama-lymphocyte e-T ne-B ajikeleza ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ama-lymph node asakazeke kuwo wonke umzimba, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 33.20, agcina inqwaba yamaseli e-T ne-B, amaseli e-dendritic, nama-macrophage. I-lymph iqoqa ama-antigen njengoba iphuma ezicutshini. Lawa ma-antigen abe esehlungwa ngama-lymph node ngaphambi kokuba i-lymph ibuyiselwe ekujikelezeni kwegazi. Ama-APC kuma-lymph node abamba futhi acubungule ama-antigen futhi atshele ama-lymphocyte aseduze ngama-pathogen angaba khona.

 I-spleen igcina amaseli e-B ne-T, ama-macrophage, amaseli e-dendritic, namaseli e-NK. I-spleen, eboniswe kuMfanekiso 33.21, yindawo lapho ama-APC abambe khona izinhlayiya zangaphandle egazini angaxhumana nama-lymphocyte. Ama-antibodies akhiqizwa futhi akhishwe ngamaseli e-plasma asebenzayo ku-spleen, futhi i-spleen ihlunga izinto zangaphandle kanye nama-antibody-complexed pathogens egazini. Ngokusebenza kahle, udende lusegazini njengoba nje ama-lymph node ese-lymph

chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluningi kulesi sigaba alukho ngaphakathi kwe-AP®. Ama-antibodies, aziwa nangokuthi ama-immunoglobulins, amaprotheni akhiqizwa futhi akhiqizwe ngamaseli e-plasma (ama-lymphocyte e-B ahlukanisiwe) aqondisa impendulo yomzimba e-humoral. Ama-antibodies amaprotheni anomumo we-Y aqukethe ama-polypeptide amane anezindawo okungenani ezimbili zokubopha i-antigen ethile. Izindawo lapho i-antigen iqashelwa khona ku-antibody ziyizizinda eziguquguqukayo. Ku-AP®, awudingi ukwazi izinhlobo ezahlukene zama-antibodies noma isakhiwo sama-molecule se-antibody ethile. Okubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ama-antibodies aqondene ne-antigen. Lapho ama-antibodies ebopha ama-antigen, anganciphisa izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane, awaphawule nge-phagocytosis, noma asebenze i-complement cascade. Ngenxa yokuthi ama-antibodies akhishwe angahlala ekujikelezeni kwegazi iminyaka eminingi, ukuvezwa kwesibili ku-pathogen kuphumela ekuphenduleni okusheshayo kwamasosha omzimba. Ama-antibodies ayenzeka egazini, ekukhishweni kwesisu kanye ne-mucus, kanye nobisi lwebele, ngaleyo ndlela anikeze ukuzivikela okungapheli enganeni.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 kanye ne-Big Idea 4 yoHlaka lwe-AP® Biology Curriculum. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlelo Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.3 Ama-Antibody | Isakhiwo Sama-Antibody
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.3 Antibodies | Antibody Structure
chapterContent:
I-molecule ye-antibody yakhiwe ngama-polypeptide amane: amaketanga amabili asindayo afanayo (amayunithi amakhulu e-peptide) ahlanganiswe kancane komunye nomunye ekwakhiweni kwe-Y”, azungezwe amaketanga amabili okukhanya afanayo (amayunithi amancane e-peptide), njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 33.22. Izibopho phakathi kwama-amino acid e-cysteine ku-molecule ye-antibody zinamathisela ama-polypeptide komunye nomunye. Izindawo lapho i-antigen iqashelwa khona ku-antibody yizindawo eziguquguqukayo futhi isisekelo se-antibody sakhiwe yizindawo ezihlala njalo.

 Kumaseli e-B asemgqeni wegciwane, isifunda esiguquguqukayo se-gene yeketanga lokukhanya sinezingxenye ezingu-40 eziguquguqukayo (V) nezinhlanu ezijoyina (J). I-enzyme ebizwa ngokuthi i-DNA recombinase ikhipha ngokungahleliwe iningi lalezi zingxenye ku-gene, futhi ihlanganisa ingxenye eyodwa ye-V ibe ingxenye eyodwa ye-J. Ngesikhathi sokucubungula i-RNA, zonke izingxenye ze-V ne-J ngaphandle kweyodwa ziyahlukaniswa. Ukuhlanganiswa kabusha kanye nokuhlanganiswa kungaholela ekuhlanganisweni kwe-VJ okungaphezu kwe-106 okungenzeka. Ngenxa yalokho, iseli ngalinye le-B elihlukanisiwe emzimbeni womuntu livame ukuba nochungechunge oluguquguqukayo oluhlukile. Isizinda esihlala njalo, esingabophi i-antibody, iyafana kuwo wonke ama-antibodies.

 Ngokufanayo nama-TCR nama-BCR, ukuhlukahluka kwama-antibody kukhiqizwa ukuguqulwa kanye nokuhlanganiswa kabusha kwezingxenye zezakhi zofuzo ezingaba ngu-300 ezihlanganisa izizinda eziguquguqukayo ze-light and heavy chain kumaseli angaphambili ahloselwe ukuba amaseli e-B. Izizinda eziguquguqukayo ezivela kumaketanga anzima nalula ziyasebenzisana ukwakha indawo yokubopha lapho i-antibody ingabopha khona i-epitope ethile ku-antigen. Izinombolo zezizinda eziphindaphindwayo ezihlala njalo emakilasini e-Ig ziyafana kuwo wonke ama-antibodies ahambisana nekilasi elithile. Ama-antibodies afana ngokwesakhiwo nengxenye engaphandle kwama-BCR, futhi ukuvuthwa kwamaseli e-B kumaseli e-plasma kungabonakala ngamagama alula njengoba iseli lithola ikhono lokukhipha ingxenye engaphandle kwe-BCR yalo ngobuningi obukhulu.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.3 Ama-Antibodies | Isakhiwo Sama-Antibodies | Amakilasi Ama-Antibodies
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.3 Antibodies | Antibody Structure | Antibody Classes
chapterContent:
Ama-antibodies angahlukaniswa ngezigaba ezinhlanu—i-IgM, i-IgG, i-IgA, i-IgD, i-IgE—ngokusekelwe ezicini zawo zomzimba, zesakhiwo, kanye nezokulwa namagciwane. Ama-IgG, akha cishe amaphesenti angama-80 awo wonke ama-antibodies ku-serum, anezintambo ezisindayo eziqukethe isizinda esisodwa esiguquguqukayo kanye nezindawo ezintathu ezifanayo ezihlala njalo. I-IgA kanye ne-IgD nazo zinezindawo ezintathu ezihlala njalo ngeketanga elisindayo, kanti i-IgM kanye ne-IgE ngayinye inezindawo ezine ezihlala njalo ngeketanga elisindayo. Isizinda esiguquguqukayo sinquma ukucaciswa kokubopha kanye nesizinda esihlala njalo seketanga elisindayo sinquma indlela yokusebenza kwe-immunological yesigaba se-antibody esihambisanayo. Kungenzeka ukuthi ama-antibodies amabili abe nokucaciswa okufanayo kokubopha kodwa abe sezigaba ezahlukene futhi, ngakho-ke, ahileleke emisebenzini ehlukene.

 Ngemva kokuba ukuzivikela okuguquguqukayo kukhiqizwe ngokumelene ne-pathogen, ngokuvamile amaseli e-plasma aqala ngokukhipha i-IgM egazini. Ama-BCR kumaseli e-B angenalwazi angowesigaba se-IgM futhi ngezinye izikhathi isigaba se-IgD. Ama-molecule e-IgM akha cishe amaphesenti ayishumi awo wonke ama-antibodies. Ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwama-antibody, amaseli e-plasma ahlanganisa ama-molecule e-IgM abe ama-pentamers (ama-antibodies amahlanu ngamanye) axhunywe ngochungechunge lokujoyina (J), njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 33.23. Ukuhlelwa kwama-pentamer kusho ukuthi la ma-macromolecule angabopha ama-antigen ayishumi afanayo. Kodwa-ke, ama-molecule e-IgM akhishwa ekuqaleni kwempendulo yokuzivikela komzimba aguquguquka awabophi kuma-antigen ngendlela eqinile njenge-IgGs, okungenye yezinhlobo ezingaba khona zama-antibodies akhishwa ngobuningi obukhulu lapho ephinde abhekane ne-pathogen efanayo. IMfanekiso 33.23 ifingqa izakhiwo zama-immunoglobulins futhi ikhombisa izakhiwo zawo eziyisisekelo.

 Ama-IgA agcwalisa amathe, izinyembezi, ubisi lwebele, kanye nokuphuma kwama-mucus emizimbeni yesisu, yokuphefumula, kanye neye-genitourinary. Ngokubambisana, lawa ma-fluid omzimba amboza futhi avikele i-mucosa ebanzi (4000 square izinyawo kubantu). Inani eliphelele lama-molecule e-IgA kula ma-molecule e-IgG egazini legazi likhulu kunenani lama-molecule e-IgG egazini. Inani elincane le-IgA nalo likhishwa ku-serum ngesimo se-monomeric. Ngokuphambene nalokho, amanye ama-IgM akhishwa oketshezini lomzimba lwe-mucosa. Ngokufanayo ne-IgM, ama-molecule e-IgA akhishwa njengezakhiwo ze-polymeric ezixhunywe ne-J chain. Kodwa-ke, ama-IgA akhishwa kakhulu njengama-molecule e-dimeric, hhayi ama-pentamers.

 IgE ikhona ku-serum ngamanani amancane futhi ibonakala kahle endimeni yayo njengomlamuleli wokungezwani komzimba. IgD nayo ikhona ngamanani amancane. Ngokufanayo ne-IgM, ama-BCR ekilasi le-IgD atholakala ebusweni bamaseli e-B angenalwazi. Leli klasi lisekela ukuqashelwa kwe-antigen kanye nokuvuthwa kwamaseli e-B kumaseli e-plasma.
question1: Zingaki izinhlobo ezinkulu zama-antibodies ezihlukaniswe ngamaqembu?
answer1: Amakilasi amahlanu: IgM, IgG, IgA, IgD, kanye ne-IgE
distractor1a: Amakilasi amathathu: IgA, IgG, kanye ne-IgM
distractor1b: Amakilasi amane: IgM, IgG, IgA, kanye ne-IgE
distractor1c: Amakilasi ayisithupha: IgA, IgB, IgD, IgE, IgG, kanye ne-IgM

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.3 Ama-Antibody | Imisebenzi Yama-Antibody
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.3 Antibodies | Antibody Functions
chapterContent:
Amaseli e-plasma ahlukene ayizidlali ezibalulekile empendulweni ye-humoral, kanti ama-antibodies awakhiphayo abaluleke kakhulu ngokumelene namagciwane angaphandle kanye nobuthi. Ama-antibodies ajikeleza ngokukhululeka futhi asebenza ngokuzimela kumaseli e-plasma. Ama-antibodies angadluliselwa kusuka komunye umuntu aye komunye ukuze avikele okwesikhashana ezifweni ezithelelanayo. Isibonelo, umuntu osanda kukhiqiza impendulo ephumelelayo yamasosha omzimba ngokumelene ne-ejenti ethile yesifo anganikela ngegazi kumuntu ongenayo i-immune futhi anikeze i-immune yesikhashana ngama-antibodies ku-serum yegazi lomnikeli. Lesi simo sibizwa ngokuthi i-passive immunity; siphinde senzeke ngokwemvelo ngesikhathi sokuncelisa, okwenza izinsana ezinceliswayo zimelane kakhulu nezifo phakathi nezinyanga ezimbalwa zokuqala zokuphila.

 Ama-antibodies amboza ama-pathogen angaphandle kweseli futhi awaqede amandla, njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 33.24, ngokuvimbela izindawo ezibalulekile ku-pathogen ezithuthukisa ukutheleleka kwawo (njenge-receptors ezifaka ama-pathogen kumaseli amukelayo). Ukungapheleli kwama-antibody kungavimbela ama-pathogen ukuthi angene futhi athelele amaseli amukelayo, ngokungafani nendlela ye-CTL yokubulala amaseli asevele ethelelekile ukuvimbela ukuqhubeka kokutheleleka okusunguliwe. Ama-pathogen angenayo i-antibody angase ahlungwe yi-spleen futhi asuswe emchameni noma endle.

 Ama-antibodies aphinde aphawule ama-pathogen ukuthi abhujiswe amaseli e-phagocytic, njenge-macrophages noma ama-neutrophils, ngoba amaseli e-phagocytic akhangwa kakhulu ama-macromolecule ahlanganiswe nama-antibodies. Ukuthuthukiswa kwe-phagocytic ngama-antibodies kubizwa ngokuthi i-opsonization. Enqubweni ebizwa ngokuthi i-complement fixation, i-IgM ne-IgG ku-serum zibopha kuma-antigen futhi zinikeze izindawo zokufaka lapho amaprotheni ahambisanayo angabopha khona. Ukuhlanganiswa kwama-antibodies kanye ne-complement kuthuthukisa i-opsonization nakakhulu futhi kukhuthaza ukusulwa okusheshayo kwama-pathogens

distractor2c: Ukungavikeleki komzimba okutholakale ngemuva kokululama ekuthelelekeni

answer3: Ukuncelisa

answer4: Ngokubopha amagciwane nokuvimba izindawo ezidingekayo ukuze kutheleleke amangqamuzana abambe iqhaza
distractor4b: Ngokubangela amangqamuzana athelelekile ukuthi adlule ku-apoptosis
distractor4c: Ngokubhubhisa amangqamuzana abomvu egazi athwala izifo

answer5: Zihlungwa yi-spleen bese zikhishwa emchameni noma endle
distractor5b: Ziyanda kancane kancane ngaphakathi kwamaseli abomvu egazi

answer6: Inqubo lapho ama-antibodies emboza khona ama-pathogen futhi athuthukise ukugwinywa kwawo ngamaseli e-phagocytic

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.3 Ama-Antibody | Imisebenzi Yama-Antibody | Ukusondelana, Ukuqina, kanye Nokusabela Okuphambeneyo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.3 Antibodies | Antibody Functions | Affinity, Avidity, and Cross Reactivity
chapterContent:
Akuwona wonke ama-antibodies abopha ngamandla afanayo, ukucaca, kanye nokuzinza. Eqinisweni, ama-antibodies abonisa ukufana okuhlukile (ukukhanga) kuye ngokuthi kuhambisana kanjani kwama-molecule phakathi kwama-molecule e-antigen nama-antibody, njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 33.25. I-antibody enokuhambisana okuphezulu kwe-antigen ethile izobopha ngokuqinile nangokuzinzile, futhi ngaleyo ndlela kulindeleke ukuthi iveze ukuzivikela okunzima kakhulu ngokumelene ne-pathogen ehambisana ne-antigen ethile.

 Igama elithi avidity lichaza ukubopha ngamakilasi e-antibody akhishwa njengezakhiwo ezihlanganisiwe, eziningi (njenge-IgM kanye ne-IgA). Nakuba ukunamathela kulinganisa amandla okubopha, njengoba nje kwenza ukunamathela, ukunamathela akulona nje inani lokunamathela kwama-antibodies esakhiweni se-multimeric. Ukunamathela kuncike enanini lezindawo ezifanayo zokubopha ku-antigen ezitholakalayo, kanye nezinye izici zomzimba nezamakhemikhali. Ngokuvamile, ama-antibodies e-multimeric, njenge-pentameric IgM, ahlukaniswa njengane-affinity ephansi kune-antibody ye-monomeric, kodwa ukunamathela okuphezulu. Empeleni, iqiniso lokuthi ama-antibody amaningi angabopha ama-antigen amaningi ngesikhathi esisodwa lilinganisa amandla awo okubopha aphansi kancane ekusebenzisaneni ngakunye kwama-antibody/ama-antigen.

 Ama-antibodies akhishwa ngemuva kokubopha kwi-epitope eyodwa ku-antigen angabonisa ukusabela okuphambene kwama-epitope afanayo noma afanayo kuma-antigen ahlukene. Ngenxa yokuthi i-epitope ifana nesifunda esincane kangaka (indawo engaphezulu yama-amino acid amane kuya kwayisithupha), kungenzeka ukuthi ama-macromolecule ahlukene abonise ubunikazi obufanayo bama-molecule kanye nokuqondiswa kwawo ezindaweni ezimfushane. Ukusabela okuphambene kuchaza lapho i-antibody ibopha hhayi kwi-antigen ebangele ukwakheka kwayo kanye nokukhishwa kwayo, kodwa kwi-antigen ehlukile.

 Ukusabela okuphambene kungaba wusizo uma umuntu eba nokuzivikela kuma-pathogen amaningana ahlobene naphezu kokuba evezwe noma egonywe kwelinye lawo kuphela. Isibonelo, ukusabela okuphambene kwama-antibody kungase kwenzeke ngokumelene nezakhiwo ezifanayo zamabhaktheriya ahlukahlukene e-Gram-negative. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ama-antibodies akhuliswe ngokumelene nezingxenye zama-molecule ezibangela izifo ezifana nama-molecule azimele angamaka ngokungalungile amaseli ombungazi ukuthi abhujiswe futhi abangele umonakalo wokuzivikela komzimba. Iziguli ezakha i-systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) zivame ukubonisa ama-antibodies asabela ne-DNA yazo. Lawa ma-antibodies kungenzeka ukuthi aqale aphakanyiswa ngokumelene ne-nucleic acid yama-microorganisms kodwa kamuva ahlangana nama-self-antigens. Lesi simo sibizwa nangokuthi i-molecular mimicry

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.3 Ama-Antibodies | Ama-Antibodies Ohlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni Lwe-Mucosal
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.3 Antibodies | Antibodies of the Mucosal Immune System
chapterContent: Ama-antibodies akhiqizwa uhlelo lokuzivikela komzimba lwe-mucosal afaka phakathi i-IgA ne-IgM. Amaseli e-B asebenzayo ahluka ngamaseli e-plasma e-mucosal akhiqiza futhi akhiphe i-IgA ye-dimeric, kanye ne-IgM ye-pentameric. I-IgA ekhishwayo itholakala kakhulu ezinyembezini, ematheni, obisini lwebele, kanye nasekukhishweni kwemigudu yokugaya ukudla kanye nokuphefumula. Ukukhiqizwa kwama-antibody kuphumela empendulweni yendawo ye-humoral ezindaweni ze-epithelial futhi kuvimbela ukutheleleka kwe-mucosa ngokubopha nokuqeda amagciwane.

answer7: Impendulo yokuzivikela komzimba yendawo ye-humoral
distractor7b: Impendulo yokuzivikela yomzimba eqhutshwa yiseli kuphela

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.4 Ukuphazamiseka Esistimu Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.4 Disruptions in the Immune System | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluningi kulesi sigaba alukho ngaphakathi kwe-AP®. Izinhlelo zokuzivikela komzimba zinganqotshwa ngezinye izikhathi yizifo ezibangelwa amagciwane. Isibonelo, amanye amabhaktheriya, okuhlanganisa ne-Streptococcus pneumoniae, azizungeza nge-capsule evimbela ama-phagocyte ukuthi awagubungele futhi abonise ama-antigen ohlelweni lokuzivikela komzimba oluguquguqukayo. Igciwane le-human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), igciwane elibangela ingculaza, lithelela amaseli e-T awusizo ngama-molecule awo e-CD4 surface, kancane kancane linciphisa inani lamaseli e-TH emzimbeni; lokhu kuvimbela ikhono lohlelo lokuzivikela komzimba oluguquguqukayo lokusabela ngokwanele ekuthelelekeni noma ezimilayo abantu abanezinhlelo zokuzivikela zomzimba ezinempilo abangazivikela kuzo. Ukungezwani komzimba nempova noma i-dander yezilwane ezifuywayo kwenzeka lapho uhlelo lokuzivikela komzimba luhlasela amaseli noma izicubu zomzimba. Ezinye izibonelo zezifo ezizimele zifaka phakathi isifo sikashukela sohlobo I kanye ne-ALS. Ekwenqatshweni kwezitho ezitshalwe kabusha, isimiso somzimba sokuzivikela sisabela kumaprotheni e-MHC angenakuqhathaniswa kumaseli esitho esinikelwe (esingesona uqobo). Kodwa-ke, isimiso somzimba sokuzivikela sivame ukuphendula njengoba kufanele, sikuvikele ekuthelelekeni futhi sikubuyisele ekilasini lakho le-AP® Biology ngokushesha okukhulu.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yoHlaka Lwekharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zigcine i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.D
Ukukhula kanye ne-homeostasis enamandla yesistimu yezinto eziphilayo kuthonywa izinguquko endaweni yesistimu.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.D.3 Izinhlelo zebhayoloji zithintwa ukuphazamiseka kwe-homeostasis yazo enamandla.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.28 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izethulo noma amamodeli ukuhlaziya ngokwekhwalithi nemiphumela yokuphazamiseka kwe-homeostasis enamandla ezinhlelweni zebhayoloji
