chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.4 Ukuphazamiseka Esistimu Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni | Ukuntuleka Kwamasosha omzimba
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.4 Disruptions in the Immune System | Immunodeficiency
chapterContent:
Ukwehluleka, ukwehluleka, noma ukubambezeleka kunoma yiliphi izinga lokusabela komzimba kungavumela amagciwane noma amaseli esimila ukuba abambe indawo futhi aphindaphindeke noma ande aze afike emazingeni aphezulu kangangokuba isimiso somzimba sokuzivikela sinqotshwe. Ukuntuleka kwamasosha omzimba ukwehluleka, ukuntuleka, noma ukubambezeleka empendulweni yesimiso somzimba sokuzivikela, okungatholakala noma kuzuzwe njengefa. Ukuntuleka kwamasosha omzimba kungatholakala ngenxa yokutheleleka ngamagciwane athile (njenge-HIV), ukuchayeka kumakhemikhali (kufaka phakathi ukwelashwa okuthile), ukungondleki kahle, noma mhlawumbe ngokucindezeleka okukhulu. Isibonelo, ukuchayeka emisebeni kungabhubhisa inani lama-lymphocyte futhi kuphakamise ukuthambekela komuntu ekuthelelekeni nasekuthelelekeni ngomdlavuza. Izifo eziningi zofuzo zibangela ukuntuleka kwamasosha omzimba, kufaka phakathi i-Severe Combined Immunodeficiency (SCID), i-Bare lymphocyte syndrome, kanye nokuntuleka kwe-MHC II. Akuvamile, ukuntuleka kwamasosha omzimba okuqala okukhona kusukela ekuzalweni kungenzeka. I-Neutropenia uhlobo olulodwa lapho isimiso somzimba sokuzivikela sikhiqiza khona inani elingaphansi kwesilinganiso lama-neutrophil, ama-phagocyte amaningi emzimbeni. Ngenxa yalokho, ukutheleleka ngamagciwane kungase kuvinjelwe egazini, kubangele izinkinga ezinkulu.

 Bheka uMfanekiso 33.26. Leli yigundane elimhlophe elinokukhubazeka okukhulu okuhlangene (i-SCID). Amagundane e-SCID asetshenziselwa ukutadisha isimiso somzimba sokuzivikela
question1: Kuyini ukuntuleka kwamasosha omzimba?
answer1: Ukwehluleka, ukungasebenzi kahle, noma ukubambezeleka kwempendulo yesistimu yomzimba
distractor1a: Impendulo yomzimba esebenza ngokweqile ngokumelene nezinto ezingenabungozi
distractor1c: Isimo lapho zonke izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane zisuswa khona
question2: Yiziphi izinhlobo ezimbili ezinkulu zokuntuleka kwamasosha omzimba?
answer2: Kutholwe futhi kwazuzwa njengefa
question3: Yimuphi umuthi wegciwane okukhulunywe ngawo endimeni ongabangela ukuntuleka kwamasosha omzimba?
answer3: Igciwane le-HIV (i-HIV)
question4: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungaba nomthelela ekutholakaleni kwe-immunodeficiency?
answer4: Ukuchayeka kumakhemikhali, ukungondleki kahle, kanye nokucindezeleka okukhulu
distractor4a: Ukuvivinya umzimba njalo kanye nokudla okunempilo
question5: Ukuchayeka emisebeni kungawenza kanjani buthaka amasosha omzimba?
answer5: Ngokubhubhisa ama-lymphocyte nokwandisa ukuthambekela ekuthelelekeni kanye nomdlavuza
question6: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisifo sokuntuleka kwamasosha omzimba esizuzwe njengefa okukhulunywe ngaso endimeni?
answer6: Ukuntuleka Kwamasosha Omzimba Okuhlanganisiwe Okukhulu (i-SCID)
question7: Kuyini i-neutropenia?
answer7: Isimo lapho umzimba ukhiqiza khona ama-neutrophil ambalwa kakhulu
distractor7a: Isimo lapho kukhiqizwa khona ama-antibodies amaningi kakhulu
distractor7b: Isifo esibangelwa amaseli e-T asizayo ngokweqile
question8: Kungani abantu abane-neutropenia besengozini enkulu yokutheleleka ngamagciwane?
answer8: Ngoba ama-neutrophils angama-phagocyte amaningi emzimbeni futhi abalulekile ekulawuleni ukutheleleka kwamagciwane
distractor8b: Ngoba ama-neutrophils avuselela amaseli e-memory B
distractor8c: Ngoba ama-neutrophils athutha umoya-mpilo kuwo wonke umzimba

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.4 Ukuphazamiseka Esistimu Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni | Ukuzwela Okuphezulu | Ukungezwani Nomzimba
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.4 Disruptions in the Immune System | Hypersensitivities | Allergies
chapterContent:
Izimpendulo zokuzivikela komzimba ezingalungile ezintweni zangaphandle ezingenangozi noma ama-antigen azimele ezenzeka ngemva kokuzwela kwezicubu zibizwa ngokuthi i-hypersensitivities. Izinhlobo ze-hypersensitivities zifaka phakathi ngokushesha, ukubambezeleka, kanye nokuzivikela komzimba. Ingxenye enkulu yabantu ithintwa uhlobo olulodwa noma ngaphezulu lwe-hypersensitivity.

 Ukungezwani komzimba
Ukusabela kokuzivikela komzimba okubangelwa ukuzwela okukhulu okusheshayo lapho impendulo yokuzivikela komzimba eqhutshwa yi-antibody yenzeka khona ngemizuzu embalwa yokuchayeka ku-antigen engenangozi kubizwa ngokuthi i-allergy. E-United States, amaphesenti angama-20 abantu abonisa izimpawu zokungezwani komzimba noma i-asthma, kanti amaphesenti angama-55 abantu bahlolwa ukuthi bane-allergen eyodwa noma ngaphezulu. Lapho bechayeka okokuqala ku-allergen engaba khona, umuntu ongezwani komzimba uhlanganisa ama-antibodies ekilasini le-IgE ngenqubo evamile yama-APC aletha i-antigen ecutshunguliwe kumaseli e-TH ashukumisa amangqamuzana e-B ukuthi akhiqize i-IgE. Leli klasi lama-antibodies liphinde lixhumanise impendulo yokuzivikela komzimba kuma-parasitic worms. Indawo eqhubekayo yama-molecule e-IgE isebenzisana namaseli e-mast afakwe ezicutshini ezixhumeneyo. Le nqubo ikhuthaza, noma ivuselela, izicubu. Lapho kuvela i-allergen efanayo, ama-molecule e-IgE kumaseli e-mast abopha i-antigen ngezizinda zawo eziguquguqukayo futhi avuselele iseli le-mast ukuthi likhulule ama-amino acid aguquliwe i-histamine ne-serotonin; laba baxhumanisi bamakhemikhali babe sebeqoqa ama-eosinophil alawula izimpendulo ze-allergy. Isithombe 33.27 sibonisa isibonelo sempendulo ye-allergy ku-ragweed pollen. Imiphumela yempendulo ye-allergy isukela ezimpawini ezincane njengokuthimula kanye namehlo alumayo, anamanzi kuya ekuphenduleni okukhulu noma okusongela impilo okubandakanya ukuqubuka okukhulu noma ama-hives, ukufinyela komoya okuphefumulayo kanye nokucindezeleka okukhulu kokuphefumula, kanye nokwehla komfutho wegazi. Lokhu kusabela okukhulu kwaziwa ngokuthi ukushaqeka kwe-anaphylactic. Uma kungelashwa nge-epinephrine ukulwa nomfutho wegazi kanye nemiphumela yokuphefumula, lesi simo singaba yingozi.

 Ukuzwela okulibazisekile kuyimpendulo yokuzivikela yomzimba eqhutshwa yiseli ethatha cishe usuku olulodwa kuya kwezimbili ngemuva kokuvezwa kwesibili ukuze kubonakale impendulo ephezulu. Lolu hlobo lokuzwela luhilela impendulo yokuvuvukala eqhutshwa yi-TH1 cytokine futhi lungase lubonakale njengezilonda zezicubu zendawo noma i-contact dermatitis (ukuqubuka noma ukucasuka kwesikhumba). Ukuzwela okubambezelekile kwenzeka kwabanye abantu lapho besabela ekuthinteni izinhlobo ezithile zobucwebe noma izimonyo. Ukuzwela okubambezelekile kwenza kube lula ukusabela komzimba ku-poison ivy futhi kuyisizathu esenza ukuhlolwa kwesikhumba kwesifo sofuba kuholele endaweni encane yokuvuvukala kubantu ababevezwe ngaphambilini ku-Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Yingakho futhi i-cortisone isetshenziswa ukwelapha izimpendulo ezinjalo: izovimbela ukukhiqizwa kwe-cytokine
question1: Kuyini ukucindezeleka?
answer1: Impendulo yokuzivikela komzimba engaguquki kahle ezintweni zangaphandle ezingenangozi noma ama-self-antigens ngemva kokuzwela kwezicubu
question2: Kuyini ukungezwani komzimba?
answer2: Ukusabela okusheshayo komzimba lapho impendulo yomzimba eqondiswa yi-antibody ivele khona kungakapheli imizuzu embalwa yokuchayeka ku-antigen engenangozi
distractor2a: Ukusabela okubambezelekile kwamasosha omzimba okwenzeka emavikini ambalwa ngemva kokutheleleka
question3: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-antibody olubangela kakhulu ukusabela kokungezwani komzimba?
answer3: I-IgE
question4: Kwenzekani uma umuntu evezwa yi-allergen efanayo okwesibili?
answer4: I-IgE kumaseli e-mast ibopha i-allergen futhi ibangele ukukhishwa kwe-histamine ne-serotonin
question5: Yimaphi amangqamuzana omzimba asebenza yi-histamine ne-serotonin ngesikhathi sokungezwani komzimba?
answer5: Ama-Eosinophil
question6: Kuyini ukushaqeka kwe-anaphylactic?
answer6: Ukusabela okubi kakhulu, okungase kusongela impilo okuhilela ukuminyana komoya kanye nomfutho wegazi ophansi ngendlela eyingozi
distractor6a: Ukuqhuma kwesikhumba okuncane okubangelwa yi-contact dermatitis
distractor6c: Ukusabela okulibazisekile kokuzivikela komzimba ku-poison ivy
question7: Yimuphi umuthi osetshenziswa ukwelapha ukushaqeka kwe-anaphylactic?
answer7: I-Epinephrine
question8: Kuyini ukucindezeleka okubambezelekile?
answer8: Impendulo yokuzivikela yomzimba eqhutshwa yiseli efinyelela esiphezulu sayo ngosuku olulodwa kuya kwezimbili ngemva kokuchayeka kwesibili
distractor8a: Impendulo eqondiswa yi-antibody eyenzeka ngemizuzu embalwa
distractor8b: Impendulo yokuzivikela komzimba eyenzeka kuphela ngesikhathi sokutheleleka kokuqala
question9: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sokuzwela okubambezelekile?
answer9: Ukusabela kwesikhumba ku-ivy enobuthi noma ukuhlolwa kwesikhumba okune-TB okuhle
distractor9c: Ukuzivikela komzimba okungenamsebenzi otholakala ngobisi lwebele
question10: Bheka uMfanekiso 33.27. Yiliphi iseli lomzimba elikhipha i-histamine ngemva kokuba i-IgE ibophe i-allergen?
answer10: Iseli le-Mast
distractor10a: I-Neutrophil

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.4 Ukuphazamiseka Esistimu Yokuzivikela Emzimbeni | Ukuzwela Okuphezulu | Ukuzivikela Emzimbeni
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.4 Disruptions in the Immune System | Hypersensitivities | Autoimmunity
chapterContent:
Izimpendulo zokuzivikela komzimba ezingalungile ezintweni zangaphandle ezingenangozi noma ama-self-antigen ezenzeka ngemva kokuzwela kwezicubu zibizwa ngokuthi ama-hypersensitivities. Izinhlobo zokuzwela okukhulu zifaka phakathi okusheshayo, okulibazisekile, kanye nokuzivikela komzimba. Ingxenye enkulu yabantu ithintwa uhlobo olulodwa noma ngaphezulu lokuzwela okukhulu.

 Ukuzivikela komzimba
Ukuzivikela komzimba uhlobo lokuzwela okukhulu kuma-self-antigens oluthinta cishe amaphesenti amahlanu abantu. Izinhlobo eziningi zokuzivikela komzimba zihilela impendulo yokuzivikela komzimba e-humoral. Ama-antibodies aphawula ngokungafanele izingxenye zawo njengezingaphandle abizwa ngokuthi ama-autoantibodies. Ezigulini ezinesifo sokuzivikela komzimba i-myasthenia gravis, ama-receptor eseli lemisipha abangela ukufinyela ngenxa ye-acetylcholine aqondiswe ama-antibodies. Umphumela uba ubuthakathaka bemisipha obungafaka phakathi okuphawulwe kanzima ngemisebenzi emihle kanye/noma ye-gross motor. Ku-systemic lupus erythematosus, impendulo ye-autoantibody esakazekile ku-DNA namaprotheni omuntu siqu ibangela izifo ezahlukahlukene zesistimu. Njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 33.28, i-systemic lupus erythematosus ingathinta inhliziyo, amalunga, amaphaphu, isikhumba, izinso, isimiso sezinzwa esiphakathi, noma ezinye izicubu, okubangela ukulimala kwezicubu ngokubopha ama-antibody, okuhambisana nokuqashwa, ukususwa kwezicubu, kanye nokuvuvukala.

 Ukuzivikela komzimba kungakhula ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, futhi izimbangela zako zingase zisekelwe ekulingiseni kwama-molecule. Ama-antibodies nama-TCR angabopha ama-self antigen afana nesakhiwo sama-antigen e-pathogen, akhuliswa ama-immune receptors okokuqala. Isibonelo, ukutheleleka nge-Streptococcus pyogenes (ibhaktheriya ebangela umphimbo we-strep) kungakhiqiza ama-antibodies noma amaseli e-T asabela ngemisipha yenhliziyo, enesakhiwo esifanayo nesobuso be-S. pyogenes. Lawa ma-antibodies angalimaza imisipha yenhliziyo ngokuhlasela komzimba, okuholela kumkhuhlane wamathambo. Isifo sikashukela esincike ku-insulin (Uhlobo 1) sivela empendulweni ye-TH1 ebhubhisayo yokuvuvukala ngokumelene namaseli akhiqiza i-insulin e-pancreas. Iziguli ezinalokhu kuzivikela komzimba kumele zijovwe nge-insulin evela kweminye imithombo
question1: Kuyini ukuzivikela komzimba (autoimmune)?
answer1: Ukusabela okukhulu komzimba lapho amasosha omzimba ehlasela khona ama-self-antigens omzimba
distractor1a: Impendulo yomzimba yokulwa ne-allergens engeyona ingozi endaweni ezungezile
question2: Ayini ama-autoantibodies?
answer2: Ama-antibodies aqaphela ngephutha izingxenye zawo njengezingaphandle
distractor2c: Ama-antibodies avuselela i-complement ngaphandle kokubopha ama-antigen
question3: Yisiphi isifo sokuzivikela komzimba esibangelwa ama-antibodies ahlasela ama-receptor e-acetylcholine kumaseli emisipha?
answer3: I-Myasthenia gravis
question4: Iyini imiphumela evamile ye-myasthenia gravis?
answer4: Ubuthakathaka bemisipha obungathinta imisebenzi emihle neyomzimba wonke
question5: Ku-systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), ama-autoantibodies ahlose ini ngokuyinhloko?
answer5: Abantu bane-DNA namaprotheni
question6: Kuyini ukulingisa kwama-molecule?
answer6: Isenzakalo lapho izimpendulo zomzimba ezilwa namagciwane zihlangana khona nama-self-antigen afana nesakhiwo
distractor6a: Ukuphindaphindwa kwezakhi zofuzo zama-antibody ngesikhathi se-mitosis
distractor6b: Ukukhiqizwa kwama-antibodies afanayo ngamaseli e-plasma ahlukene
distractor6c: Ukungakwazi kwama-antibodies ukubona izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane
question7: Yikuphi ukutheleleka kwamagciwane okungadala umkhuhlane wamathambo ngokulingisa ama-molecule?
answer7: I-Streptococcus pyogenes
question8: Yini ebangela isifo sikashukela sohlobo 1 ngokwendlela okukhulunywa ngayo?
answer8: Impendulo yokuzivikela yomzimba ebhubhisayo ebangelwa yi-TH1 ngokumelene namaseli akhiqiza i-insulin epancreas
distractor8a: Ukulahlekelwa amaseli e-T awusizo okubangelwa yi-HIV
question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 33.28. Yiziphi izitho noma izinhlelo ezingase zithinteke yi-systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE)?
answer9: Inhliziyo, amalunga, amaphaphu, isikhumba, izinso, isimiso sezinzwa esiyinhloko, kanye nezinye izicubu

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.5 Amagama Ayinhloko
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.5 Key Terms
chapterContent:
ukuzivikela okuguquguqukayo
ukuzivikela okunenkumbulo futhi okwenzeka ngemva kokuchayeka ku-antigen kungaba kusuka ku-pathogen noma ekugonyweni

 ukusondelana
ukukhangana kokuhambisana kwama-molecule phakathi kwama-molecule e-antigen nama-antibody

 ukungezwani komzimba
ukusabela kwamasosha omzimba okubangelwa ukuzwela okukhulu ngokushesha lapho impendulo yamasosha omzimba eqondiswa yi-antibody iyenzeka phakathi nemizuzu yokuchayeka ku-antigen engenangozi

 i-antibody
iphrotheni ekhiqizwa amaseli e-plasma ngemva kokukhuthazwa yi-antigen; eyaziwa nangokuthi i-immunoglobulin

 i-antigen
iphrotheni yangaphandle noma engeyona eyakho ebangela impendulo yomzimba

 iseli eliveza i-antigen (i-APC)
iseli lomzimba elithola, ligwinye, futhi lazise impendulo yomzimba eguquguqukayo mayelana nokutheleleka ngokuletha i-antigen ecutshunguliwe ebusweni beseli

 i-autoantibody
i-antibody ephawula ngokungalungile izingxenye zayo njengezingaphandle futhi ivuselele impendulo yomzimba

 impendulo yomzimba
impendulo yomzimba engafanele kumaseli abambe iqhaza noma ama-self-antigen

 ukuzivikela komzimba
uhlobo lokuzwela kuma-self antigen

 ukushesha
amandla okubopha aphelele e-antibody eningi ene-antigen

 Iseli le-B
i-lymphocyte ekhula emnkantsheni wethambo futhi ihlukane ibe amaseli e-plasma akhipha ama-antibody

 i-basophil
i-leukocyte ekhipha amakhemikhali avame ukuhileleka empendulweni yokuvuvukala

 impendulo yokuzivikela eqondiswa amaseli
impendulo yokuzivikela eguquguqukayo eyenziwa amaseli e-T

 ukukhetha kwe-clonal
ukusebenza kwamaseli e-B ahambisana nohlobo olulodwa oluthile lwe-BCR kanye nokwanda okukhulu kwalolo hlobo

 uhlelo lokugcwalisa
uhlu lwamaprotheni ancibilikayo angaba ngu-20 esistimu yokuzivikela engokwemvelo athuthukisa i-phagocytosis, abhoboze izimbobo kuma-pathogen, futhi aqoqe ama-lymphocyte; athuthukisa impendulo eguquguqukayo lapho kukhiqizwa ama-antibodies

 ukusabela okuphambene
ukubopha i-antibody ku-epitope ehambelana ne-antigen ehlukile kuleyo i-antibody ephakanyiswe ngokumelene nayo

 i-cytokine
isithunywa samakhemikhali esilawula ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli, ukwanda, ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo, kanye nokushushumbiswa kwamaseli ukuze kusebenze izimpendulo zokuzivikela

 i-cytotoxic T lymphocyte (CTL)
iseli lomzimba elizivumelanisa nezimo elibulala ngqo amangqamuzana athelelekile nge-perforin nama-granzymes, futhi likhiphe ama-cytokine ukuze lithuthukise impendulo yomzimba

iseli le-dendritic
 iseli lomzimba elicubungula izinto ze-antigen bese lizibeka phezu kwamanye amangqamuzana ukuze libangele impendulo yomzimba

iseli le-effector
 i-lymphocyte ehlukanisiwe, njengeseli le-B, iseli le-plasma, noma i-cytotoxic T lymphocyte

i-eosinophil
 i-leukocyte ephendula kuma-parasites futhi ehilelekile empendulweni yokungezwani komzimba

i-epitope
 ingxenye encane ye-antigen eqashelwa ngqo ngama-antibodies, amangqamuzana e-B, namaseli e-T; i-antigenic determinant

i-granzyme
 i-protease engena kumaseli okuqondiwe nge-perforin futhi ibangele i-apoptosis kumaseli okuqondiwe; esetshenziswa amangqamuzana e-NK namaseli e-killer T

i-lymphocyte yomsizi i-T (TH)
iseli lesistimu yokuzivikela yomzimba eguquguqukayo ebopha ama-APC ngama-molecule e-MHC II futhi ivuselele amaseli e-B noma ikhiphe ama-cytokine ukuze iqalise impendulo yomzimba

 ibamba
isidalwa esihlaselwe yi-pathogen noma i-parasite

 impendulo yomzimba ehlekisayo
impendulo yomzimba eguquguqukayo elawulwa amaseli e-B asebenzayo nama-antibodies

 ukuzwela okukhulu
ububanzi bezimpendulo zomzimba ezingalungile ezinhlayiyeni zangaphandle ezingenangozi noma ama-self antigen; kwenzeka ngemva kokuzwela kwezicubu futhi kufaka phakathi uhlobo olusheshayo (ukungezwani komzimba), uhlobo olubambezelekile, kanye nokuzivikela komzimba

 ukubekezelelana komzimba
ikhono elitholwe lokuvimbela impendulo yomzimba engadingekile noma eyingozi emzimbeni wangaphandle otholakele owaziwa ukuthi awubangeli izifo noma ama-self-antigen

 ukuntuleka kwamasosha omzimba
ukwehluleka, ukungasebenzi kahle, noma ukubambezeleka kunoma yiliphi izinga lesimiso somzimba sokuzivikela, okungase kutholakale noma kuzuzwe njengefa

 ukuvuvukala
ukubomvu kwendawo, ukuvuvukala, ukushisa, kanye nobuhlungu obuvela ekuhambeni kwama-leukocyte kanye noketshezi oludlula kuma-capillaries avuliwe luye endaweni yokutheleleka

 ukuzivikela kwemvelo
ukuzivikela kwemvelo okwenzeka ngokwemvelo ngenxa yezici zofuzo noma i-physiology, futhi okungabangelwa ukutheleleka noma ukugonywa

 i-interferon
i-cytokine evimbela ukuphindaphindana kwamagciwane futhi ilawula impendulo yomzimba

 i-lymph
uketshezi olunamanzi olugeza izicubu nezitho ngamangqamuzana egazi amhlophe avikelayo futhi olungenawo ama-erythrocyte
i-lymphocyte
i-leukocyte ebonakala ngokwesayensi nge-nucleus yayo enkulu; iyiseli elincane eline-cytoplasm encane kakhulu

 i-macrophage
iseli elikhulu le-phagocytic eligwinya izinhlayiya zakwamanye amazwe kanye namagciwane

 i-molecule enkulu ye-histocompatibility class (MHC) I/II
iphrotheni etholakala ebusweni bawo wonke amaseli ane-nucleated (I) noma ikakhulukazi kumaseli aveza i-antigen (II) etshela amaseli omzimba ukuthi iseli liphilile/lijwayelekile noma linegciwane/linomdlavuza; inikeza ithempulethi efanele lapho ama-antigen angafakwa khona ukuze aqashelwe ama-lymphocyte

 iseli le-mast
i-leukocyte ekhiqiza ama-molecule okuvuvukala, njenge-histamine, ekuphenduleni ama-pathogen amakhulu kanye nama-allergen

 iseli lememori
i-lymphocyte ye-B noma i-T ethize ye-antigen engahlukanisi kumaseli e-effector ngesikhathi sempendulo yokuqala yokuzivikela komzimba kodwa engaba yiseli le-effector ngokushesha lapho iphinde ivele ku-pathogen efanayo

 i-monocyte
uhlobo lweseli elimhlophe legazi elijikeleza egazini kanye ne-lymph bese lihlukana libe ama-macrophage ngemva kokuba lingene ezicutshini ezinegciwane

izicubu ze-lymphoid ezihlotshaniswa ne-mucosa (i-MALT)
ukuqoqwa kwezicubu ze-lymphatic ezihlangana nezicubu ze-epithelial ezimboze i-mucosa kuwo wonke umzimba

 iseli lokubulala lemvelo (NK)
i-lymphocyte engabulala amangqamuzana atheleleke ngamagciwane noma amangqamuzana esimila

 i-neutrophil
i-phagocytic leukocyte egwinya futhi igaye amagciwane

 i-opsonization
inqubo ethuthukisa i-phagocytosis isebenzisa amaprotheni ukukhombisa ukuba khona kwe-pathogen kumaseli e-phagocytic

 ukuzivikela okungasebenzi
ukudluliselwa kwama-antibodies kusuka komunye umuntu kuya komunye ukuhlinzeka ngokuvikelwa kwesikhashana kuma-pathogen

 i-pathogen
i-ejenti, ngokuvamile i-microorganism, ebangela izifo ezintweni eziphilayo ezizihlaselayo

 iphethini yama-molecule ahlobene ne-pathogen (i-PAMP)
 i-carbohydrate, i-polypeptide, kanye ne-nucleic acid signature” evezwa ngamagciwane, amabhaktheriya, kanye nama-parasite kodwa ihlukile kuma-molecule kumaseli aphethe

 i-receptor yokuqashelwa kwephethini (i-PRR)
i-molecule kuma-macrophage namaseli e-dendritic ebopha izimpawu zama-molecule zama-pathogen futhi ikhuthaze ukuminyana nokubhujiswa kwe-pathogen

 i-perforin
iphrotheni ebhubhisayo edala imbobo esiseleni esiqondiwe; esetshenziswa amaseli e-NK namaseli e-T abulalayo

 iseli le-plasma
iseli lokuzivikela elifihla ama-antibodies; lawa maseli avela kumaseli e-B avuselelwe ama-antigen

 iseli le-T (Treg) elilawulayo
i-lymphocyte ekhethekile ecindezela ukuvuvukala kwendawo futhi ivimbele ukukhiqizwa kwama-cytokine, ama-antibodies, kanye nezinye izici zokuzivikela ezivuselelayo; ehilelekile ekubekezeleleni amasosha omzimba

 iseli le-T
i-lymphocyte ekhula e-thymus gland; elinye lamaseli ayinhloko ahilelekile ohlelweni lokuzivikela oluguquguqukayo
question1: Kuyini ukuzivikela komzimba okuzivumelanisa nezimo?
answer1: Ukungavikeleki okunenkumbulo futhi okwenzeka ngemva kokuchayeka ku-antigen kungaba yi-pathogen noma ukugonywa
distractor1a: Ukungavikeleki komzimba okukhona lapho kuzalwa futhi okungenankumbulo
question2: Kuyini ukusondelana?
answer2: Ukukhanga kokuhambisana kwama-molecule phakathi kwama-molecule e-antigen kanye nama-antibody
question3: Kuyini ukungezwani komzimba?
answer3: Ukusabela komzimba okubangelwa ukuzwela okukhulu ngokushesha lapho impendulo yomzimba eqondiswa yi-antibody ivele khona ngemizuzu embalwa yokuchayeka ku-antigen engenangozi
question4: Iyini i-antibody?
answer4: Iphrotheni ekhiqizwa amaseli e-plasma ngemva kokukhuthazwa yi-antigen; eyaziwa nangokuthi i-immunoglobulin
distractor4c: I-molecule enikeza izimpawu ekhiqizwa amaseli e-T kuphela
question5: Iyini i-antigen?
answer5: Iphrotheni yangaphandle noma engeyona eyakho ebangela impendulo yomzimba
question6: Iyini iseli eliveza i-antigen (i-APC)?
answer6: Iseli lokuzivikela elithola, ligwinye, futhi linikeze ulwazi ngempendulo yokuzivikela eguquguqukayo mayelana nokutheleleka ngokuletha i-antigen ecutshunguliwe ebusweni beseli
distractor6b: Iseli elibhubhisa amangqamuzana athelelekile kusetshenziswa i-perforin
question7: Kuyini i-autoantibody?
answer7: I-antibody ephawula ngokungalungile izingxenye zayo njengezingaphandle futhi ivuselela impendulo yomzimba
distractor7c: I-antibody esebenza nge-complement ngaphandle kokubopha i-antigen
question8: Iyini impendulo ye-autoimmune?
answer8: Impendulo engafanele yokuzivikela komzimba kumaseli abambe iqhaza noma ama-self-antigen
question9: Kuyini ukuzivikela komzimba (autoimmune)?
answer9: Uhlobo lokuzwela kakhulu kuma-antigen azimele
question10: Kuyini ukushisekela?
answer10: Amandla okubopha aphelele e-antibody e-multivalent ene-antigen
distractor10a: Ukukhanga phakathi kwe-antibody eyodwa nendawo eyodwa yokubopha i-antigen
question11: Iyini iseli B?
answer11: I-lymphocyte ekhula emnkantsheni wethambo futhi ihlukane ibe amaseli e-plasma akhipha ama-antibody
question12: Iyini i-basophil?
answer12: I-leukocyte ekhipha amakhemikhali avame ukuba yingxenye yempendulo yokuvuvukala
answer13: Impendulo yokuzivikela komzimba eguquguqukayo eyenziwa amaseli e-T
distractor13a: Impendulo yokuzivikela yomzimba ezalwa nayo eyenziwa yi-neutrophils
answer14: Ukusebenza kwamaseli e-B ahambisana nohlobo olulodwa oluthile lwe-BCR kanye nokwanda okukhulu kwalolo hlobo
distractor14a: Ukubhujiswa kwawo wonke amaseli e-B ngemva kokutheleleka
distractor14b: Ukukhiqizwa kwama-antibodies ahlukene yiseli elilodwa le-plasma
answer15: Uhlu lwamaprotheni ancibilikayo angaba ngu-20 esimiso somzimba sokuzivikela esingokwemvelo athuthukisa i-phagocytosis, abhoboze izimbobo ezifweni, futhi athole ama-lymphocyte; athuthukisa impendulo eguquguqukayo lapho kukhiqizwa ama-antibodies.
answer16: Ukubopha kwe-antibody ku-epitope ehambisana ne-antigen ehlukile kuleyo i-antibody ephakanyiswe ngokumelene nayo
answer17: Isithunywa samakhemikhali esilawula ukwahlukahlukana kwamaseli, ukwanda kwawo, ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo, kanye nokushushumbiswa kwamaseli ukuze kuthinte izimpendulo zomzimba
answer18: Iseli lokuzivikela elizivumelanisa nezimo elibulala ngqo amangqamuzana athelelekile nge-perforin nama-granuleme, futhi likhiphe ama-cytokine ukuze lithuthukise impendulo yokuzivikela komzimba
answer19: Iseli lomzimba elicubungula izinto ze-antigen bese lizibeka phezu kwamanye amaseli ukuze libangele impendulo yokuzivikela komzimba
answer20: I-lymphocyte ehlukanisiwe, njenge-B cell, i-plasma cell, noma i-cytotoxic T lymphocyte
answer21: I-leukocyte esabela ezifweni ezibangelwa amagciwane futhi ehilelekile empendulweni yokungezwani komzimba
answer22: Ingxenye encane ye-antigen eqashelwa ngqo ngama-antibodies, amaseli e-B, namaseli e-T; isichaza-zinhlungu se-antigen
answer23: I-protease engena kumaseli aqondiwe nge-perforin futhi ibangele i-apoptosis kumaseli aqondiwe; isetshenziswa amaseli e-NK namaseli e-T abulalayo
answer24: Iseli lesistimu yokuzivikela yomzimba eguquguqukayo ebopha ama-APC ngama-molecule e-MHC II futhi ivuselele amaseli e-B noma ikhiphe ama-cytokine ukuze aqalise impendulo yokuzivikela komzimba
question26: Iyini impendulo yomzimba yokuzivikela komzimba e-humoral?
answer26: Impendulo yokuzivikela komzimba eguquguqukayo elawulwa amaseli e-B asebenzayo kanye nama-antibodies
distractor26a: Impendulo yokuzivikela komzimba eguquguqukayo eyenziwa amaseli e-T anobuthi
answer27: Uhla lwezimpendulo ezingaguquki kahle zomzimba ezinhlayiyeni zangaphandle ezingenangozi noma ama-self antigen; kwenzeka ngemva kokuzwela kwezicubu futhi kufaka phakathi uhlobo olusheshayo (ukungezwani komzimba), uhlobo olubambezelekile, kanye nokuzivikela komzimba
answer28: Ikhono elitholakalayo lokuvimbela impendulo yomzimba engadingekile noma eyingozi emzimbeni wangaphandle otholakele owaziwa ukuthi awubangeli izifo noma ama-self-antigens
distractor28a: Ukungakwazi kwesimiso somzimba sokuzivikela ekuzivikeleni ekutholeni izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane
distractor28b: Ukucindezela okungapheli kwazo zonke izimpendulo zomzimba
distractor28c: Ukubhujiswa kwawo wonke ama-molecule angaphandle angena emzimbeni
answer29: Ukwehluleka, ukungasebenzi kahle, noma ukubambezeleka kunoma yiliphi izinga lesimiso somzimba sokuzivikela, esingase sitholakale noma sizuzwe njengefa
answer30: Ukubomvu kwendawo, ukuvuvukala, ukushisa, kanye nobuhlungu obuvela ekuhambeni kwama-leukocyte kanye noketshezi oludlula ema-capillaries avulekile luye endaweni yokutheleleka
answer31: Ukungavikeleki okwenzeka ngokwemvelo ngenxa yezici zofuzo noma i-physiology, futhi okungabangelwa ukutheleleka noma ukugonywa
distractor31a: Ukungavikeleki komzimba okutholakala kuphela ngemva kokugonywa
distractor31c: Ukungavikeleki komzimba okuvela kuphela ngemva kokutheleleka okuphindaphindiwe
answer32: I-cytokine evimbela ukuphindaphindana kwegciwane futhi iguqule impendulo yomzimba
answer33: Uketshezi olumanzi olugeza izicubu nezitho ngamangqamuzana amhlophe egazi avikelayo futhi olungenawo ama-erythrocyte
distractor33a: Ingxenye ewuketshezi yegazi equkethe amangqamuzana egazi abomvu
answer34: I-leukocyte ebonakala ngokwesayensi nge-nucleus yayo enkulu futhi ene-cytoplasm encane kakhulu
answer35: Iseli elikhulu le-phagocytic eligwinya izinhlayiya zangaphandle kanye namagciwane
question36: Uyini umsebenzi wama-molecule e-major histocompatibility class (MHC) I/II?
answer36: Zibonisa ama-antigen futhi zitshele amangqamuzana omzimba ukuthi ngabe iseli liphilile noma lithelelekile ngenkathi zinikeza ithempulethi yokuqashelwa kwe-antigen ngama-lymphocyte
answer37: I-leukocyte ekhiqiza ama-molecule okuvuvukala, njenge-histamine, ngenxa yezifo ezinkulu kanye ne-allergens
answer38: I-lymphocyte ye-B noma i-T ethize ye-antigen engahlukani ngamaseli asebenzayo ngesikhathi sokusabela okuyinhloko komzimba kodwa ingaba yiseli elisebenzayo ngokushesha uma iphinde ivele ku-pathogen efanayo.
answer39: Uhlobo lweseli elimhlophe legazi elijikeleza egazini kanye ne-lymph bese lihlukana libe ama-macrophage ngemva kokungena ezicutshini ezinegciwane
answer40: Iqoqo lezicubu ze-lymphatic ezihlangana nezicubu ze-epithelial ezimboze i-mucosa kuwo wonke umzimba
distractor40a: Iqembu lama-lymph node litholakala entanyeni kuphela
answer41: I-lymphocyte engabulala amangqamuzana atheleleke ngamagciwane noma amangqamuzana esimila
distractor41b: Iseli T elisizayo elisebenzisa amaseli B
answer42: I-phagocytic leukocyte egwinya futhi igaye amagciwane
answer43: Inqubo ethuthukisa i-phagocytosis isebenzisa amaprotheni ukukhombisa ukuba khona kwe-pathogen kumaseli e-phagocytic
answer44: Ukudluliselwa kwama-antibodies kusuka komunye umuntu kuya komunye ukuze kuhlinzekwe isivikelo sesikhashana ngokumelene namagciwane
distractor44b: Ukungavikeleki komzimba okukhiqizwa kuphela ngamaseli enkumbulo
distractor44c: Ukungavikeleki komzimba okuvela ngemva kokutheleleka kwemvelo kuphela
answer45: I-ejenti, ngokuvamile i-microorganism, ebangela izifo ezintweni eziphilayo ezizihlaselayo
answer46: Isiginesha se-carbohydrate, i-polypeptide, kanye ne-nucleic acid esivezwa ngamagciwane, amabhaktheriya, kanye nezinambuzane ezihlukile kuma-molecule kumaseli aphethe
answer47: I-molecule kuma-macrophage namaseli e-dendritic ebopha izimpawu zama-molecule e-pathogen futhi ikhuthaze ukuminyana nokubhujiswa kwe-pathogen
answer48: Iphrotheni ebhubhisayo edala imbobo esiseleni esiqondiwe; esetshenziswa amaseli e-NK namaseli e-T abulalayo
answer49: Iseli lokuzivikela elikhipha ama-antibodies; lawa maseli avela kumaseli e-B avuselelwa ama-antigen
answer50: I-lymphocyte ekhethekile evimbela ukuvuvukala kwendawo futhi ivimbele ukukhishwa kwama-cytokine, ama-antibodies, nezinye izici zokuzivikela ezivuselelayo; ihilelekile ekubekezeleleni amasosha omzimba
answer51: I-lymphocyte ekhula endlaleni ye-thymus; elinye lamaseli ayinhloko ahilelekile ohlelweni lokuzivikela oluguquguqukayo
distractor51a: I-lymphocyte ekhula emnkantsheni wethambo futhi ikhipha ama-antibodies
question36KeyTerm: Ikilasi elikhulu lokuhambisana kwe-histocompatibility (MHC) ama-molecule e-I/II

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 33. Uhlelo Lokuzivikela Emzimbeni | 33.6 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 33. The Immune System | 33.6 Chapter Summary
chapterContent:
33.1 Impendulo Yomzimba Engokwemvelo
Uhlelo lomzimba olungokwemvelo lusebenza njengomphenduli wokuqala ezinsongweni zezifo ezidlula izithiyo zemvelo zomzimba nezamakhemikhali zomzimba. Sisebenzisa inhlanganisela yokuhlaselwa kwamaseli nama-molecule, uhlelo lomzimba olungokwemvelo luhlonza uhlobo lwe-pathogen futhi lusabela ngokuvuvukala, i-phagocytosis, ukukhululwa kwe-cytokine, ukubhujiswa ngamaseli e-NK, kanye/noma uhlelo lokugcwalisa. Uma izindlela zokuzalwa zinganele ukususa ukutheleleka, impendulo yokuzivikela eguquguqukayo iyaziswa futhi ishukunyiswe.

 33.2 Impendulo Yomzimba Eguquguqukayo
Impendulo yokuzivikela eguquguqukayo iyimpendulo esebenza kancane, ehlala isikhathi eside, futhi eqondile kunempendulo yomvelo. Kodwa-ke, impendulo eguquguqukayo idinga ulwazi oluvela ohlelweni lomzimba olungokwemvelo ukuze lusebenze. Ama-APC abonisa ama-antigen ngama-molecule e-MHC kumaseli e-T ahambisanayo angenalwazi. Ekuphenduleni, amaseli e-T ayahluka futhi ayanda, abe amaseli e-TH noma ama-CTL. Amaseli e-TH avuselela amaseli e-B agubungele futhi aveze ama-antigen asuselwa ku-pathogen. Amaseli e-B ahlukana abe amaseli e-plasma akhipha ama-antibodies, kanti ama-CTL abangela i-apoptosis kumaseli athelelekile ngaphakathi kweseli noma anomdlavuza. Amaseli ememori ayaqhubeka ngemva kokuchayeka kokuqala ku-pathogen. Uma kuvela ukuvezwa kabusha, amaseli ememori ahlukana abe amaseli asebenzayo ngaphandle kokufaka okuvela ohlelweni lokuzivikela olungokwemvelo. Uhlelo lokuzivikela lwe-mucosal luzimele kakhulu ohlelweni lokuzivikela oluhlelekile kodwa lusebenza ngendlela efanayo ukuvikela ubuso obukhulu be-mucosal yomzimba.

 33.3 Ama-antibodies
Ama-antibodies (ama-immunoglobulins) ama-molecule akhishwe kumaseli e-plasma aqondisa impendulo yokuzivikela ye-humoral. Kunezigaba ezinhlanu zama-antibody; isigaba sama-antibody sinquma indlela yaso yokusebenza kanye nendawo yokukhiqiza kodwa asilawuli ukucaciswa kwaso kokubopha. Ama-antibodies abopha ama-antigen ngezizinda eziguquguqukayo futhi anganciphisa ama-pathogen noma awabeke uphawu lwe-phagocytosis noma asebenze i-complement cascade.

 33.4 Ukuphazamiseka Kuhlelo Lokuzivikela Lomzimba
Ukuphazamiseka komzimba kungabandakanya ukusabela okunganele komzimba noma imigomo yokuzivikela engafanele. Ukuntuleka kwamasosha omzimba kwandisa ukuthambekela komuntu ekuthelelekeni ngezifo kanye nomdlavuza. Ukuzwela ngokweqile kuyimpendulo eqondiswe kabi ezinhlayiyeni zangaphandle ezingenangozi, njengasendabeni yokungezwani komzimba, noma ezintweni ezibangela ukungezwani komzimba, njengasendabeni yokuzivikela komzimba. Ukusabela ezingxenyeni zomuntu siqu kungaba umphumela wokulingisa ama-molecule.
question1: Iyini indima eyinhloko yesimiso sokuzivikela somzimba esizalwa naso?
answer1: Ukunikeza umzimba umugqa wokuqala wokuzivikela ezifweni ezibangelwa amagciwane ezidlula izithiyo zomzimba nezamakhemikhali
distractor1b: Ukwakha inkumbulo yokuzivikela yomzimba yesikhathi eside
question2: Yini evuselela impendulo yokuzivikela komzimba eguquguqukayo?
answer2: Ulwazi olunikezwa yisimiso somzimba sokuzivikela esingokwemvelo ngamaseli aveza ama-antigen
question3: Iyini indima yamaseli e-T (TH) awusizo?
answer3: Zivuselela amaseli e-B futhi ziqondise impendulo yomzimba eguquguqukayo
question4: Yini ebhujiswa kakhulu ama-T lymphocyte (ama-CTL) abangela ubuthi?
answer4: Amaseli atheleleke ngegciwane kanye nomdlavuza
question5: Uyini umsebenzi wama-antibodies?
answer5: Ukubopha ama-antigen, ukuqeda amagciwane, ukukhuthaza i-phagocytosis, noma ukwenza kusebenze i-complement
question6: Kuyini ukuntuleka kwamasosha omzimba?
answer6: Isimo lapho izimpendulo zomzimba zinganele noma zilibazisekile, okwandisa ukuthambekela kwezifo
question7: Uyini umehluko omkhulu phakathi kokungezwani komzimba kanye nezifo ezibangelwa ukuzivikela komzimba?
answer7: Ukungezwani komzimba kuhlose izinto zangaphandle ezingenangozi, kanti izifo zokuzivikela komzimba zihlose izicubu zomzimba.
distractor7a: Ukungezwani komzimba kuthinta izingane kuphela, kanti izifo ezihlasela amasosha omzimba zithinta abantu abadala kuphela
distractor7b: Izifo ezizenzakalelayo zithinta kuphela isimiso somzimba sokuzivikela esingokwemvelo
question8: Iyiphi indlela isikhumba esisebenzisa ngayo ukuvikela izifo ezibangelwa izinto eziphilayo?
answer8: Ukuncibilikisa
question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 33.29. Lesi sithombe sibonisa izinga lokukhula kwezinye izinhlobo zamabhaktheriya ngamanani ahlukene e-pH. Ngokusekelwe kulesi sithombe, futhi ukhumbula ukuthi isikhumba sakha isithiyo ngokumelene nezinhlobo eziningi zamabhaktheriya, yenza isimangalo ngamanani angenzeka e-pH yesikhumba.
answer9: Ngaphezu kuka-7.5 noma ngaphansi kuka-5.5
question10: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okukhiqiza impendulo yomzimba ngokushesha ngokubona igciwane elihlaselayo bese uligwinya?
answer10: I-Macrophage
distractor10a: I-Cytokine
question11: Ukuvuvukala kwenzeka kanjani?
answer11: Ukuvuvukala kubangelwa ama-molecule afana nama-cytokine kanye ne-histamine akhiqizwa amaseli ahlukahlukene aphethe ukusabela ezifweni ezibangelwa amagciwane endaweni yokulimala noma ukutheleleka.
distractor11a: Ngesikhathi sokuvuvukala, wonke amaseli egazi ayaphuma endaweni yokutheleleka ukuze avikele uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi ekuthelelekeni nge-pathogen
distractor11b: Ukuvuvukala kuyisimo esiqhubekayo emzimbeni womuntu, okuyingxenye yendlela amasosha omzimba azalwa nayo angasabela ngayo ngokushesha ekuthelelekeni.
distractor11c: Uma kwenzeka ukutheleleka, kuvela impendulo yokuvuvukala ngokushesha nje lapho amagciwane engena emzimbeni.
question12: Yisiphi isakhi sangaphakathi sesistimu yomzimba esisebenzisa ama-molecule amakhulu ekilasini lokuhambisana ne-histocompatibility (MHC) I ngqo esu layo lokuzivikela?
answer12: Amaseli okubulala emvelo
question13: Uyini umehluko phakathi kwamaseli okubulala emvelo nama-macrophage?
answer13: Amaseli okubulala emvelo abulala amaseli angaphandle ngezinqubo ze-lysis kanye ne-proteolysis, kanti ama-macrophage abulala amaseli angaphandle nge-phagocytosis.
distractor13a: Amaseli okubulala emvelo awahlali ekhona emzimbeni futhi kumele aqalwe, kanti ama-macrophage ahlala ekhona
distractor13b: Amaseli okubulala emvelo empeleni abulala amaseli angaphandle, kanti ama-macrophage asebenza umsebenzi wokubonisa kuphela
distractor13c: Ama-macrophage kuphela angangena ezicutshini zomsingathi ukuze alwe namaseli angaphandle angena kulezo zicubu.
question14: Iyini ukwakheka kwama-molecule e-major histocompatibility class (MHC) I?
question15: Uyini umsebenzi wama-molecule e-major histocompatibility class (MHC) I?
answer15: Ama-molecule e-MHC I aveza ama-antigen ebusweni beseli
distractor15a: Ama-molecule e-MHC I asiza ekuqiniseni ulwelwesi lweseli
distractor15b: Ama-molecule e-MHC I avumela ukunyakaza kwezinto kulo lonke ulwelwesi lweseli
distractor15c: Ama-molecule e-MHC I ahlinzeka ngezibonakaliso zezinqubo ezihilelekile ekuhlukanisweni kweseli
answer16: Uhlelo lokugcwalisa luqukethe iqembu lamaprotheni angaba ngu-20 egazini ahlasela amagciwane ngendlela yokuwaphawula nokuwabhubhisa.
distractor16a: Uhlelo lokugcwalisa luqukethe ama-macrophage aqeda izifo zangaphandle
distractor16b: Uhlelo lokugcwalisa luqapha ama-molecule e-MHC I emaseli futhi lubhubhise noma yiliphi iseli elibonisa i-antigen engeye-pathogen
distractor16c: Uhlelo lokugcwalisa lwakhiwe ngama-antibodies akhethekile ku-pathogen ngayinye enziwa lapho i-pathogen ingena emzimbeni.
question17: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okwenzeka ngokushesha okukhulu ngenxa yokusebenza kohlelo lokugcwalisa?
question18: Yiliphi elinye igama lokuzivikela komzimba okuguquguqukayo?
answer19: Umuntu akanayo impendulo ethile yomzimba yokulwa negciwane, kodwa usabela ngendlela ethile kulelo gciwane elibuyiselwa ngokushesha kamuva uma ukutheleleka yigciwane elifanayo kuvela futhi.
distractor19a: Umuntu uzalwa enempendulo ethile yomzimba yokulwa nanoma iyiphi igciwane umzimba ochayeke kulo
distractor19b: Umuntu uzalwa enekhono lokuthuthukisa impendulo ethile yomzimba ngokumelene nanoma iyiphi i-pathogen kungakapheli imizuzu embalwa evezwe kuleyo pathogen.
distractor19c: Umuntu akanayo impendulo yomzimba yokulwa negciwane, kodwa uthuthukisa impendulo yesikhashana ethize kulelo gciwane elibe selikhohliwe.
question20: Yisiphi isici sesimiso sokuzivikela somzimba esingokwemvelo esingeyona ingxenye yesimiso sokuzivikela somzimba esizivumelanisa nezimo?
question21: Uyini umehluko phakathi kwezimpendulo zomzimba ezingokwemvelo nezivumelana nezimo?
answer21: Uhlelo lokuzivikela oluguquguqukayo lukhiqiza ukuzivikela okuhlala isikhathi eside kunesistimu yokuzivikela yomzimba engokwemvelo
distractor21a: Uhlelo lokuzivikela oluzivumelanisa nezimo lusebenza ngokushesha kunesistimu yokuzivikela yomzimba ezalwa nayo
distractor21b: Uhlelo lokuzivikela olungokwemvelo lukhiqiza ukuzivikela okuqondile kakhulu kunehlelo lokuzivikela oluzivumelanisa nezimo
distractor21c: Uhlelo lokuzivikela olungokwemvelo lunenkumbulo eyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kunesistimu yokuzivikela eguquguqukayo
question22: Yimaphi amaseli ahlukile empendulweni yomzimba yokuzivikela komzimba e-humoral?
question23: Bheka uMfanekiso 33.30. Lesi sithombe sibonisa indlela isimiso somzimba sokuzivikela esinobuthi esisebenza ngayo. Kwenzekani esinyathelweni sesi-2?

question26: Zingaki futhi yiziphi izinhlobo zama-polypeptide ezakha i-molecule ye-antibody?

question27: Kungani ama-antibodies ahlukaniswe nomuntu ofanayo ebonisa izindawo ezahlukahlukene ezingaguquki?
answer27: Ama-antibodies angaphansi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zama-molecule e-immunoglobulin

distractor27b: Ama-antibodies adluliselwa ngenxa yokungavikeleki komzimba okwenziwa ngaphandle kokusebenzisa amandla.
question28: Yimuphi u-enzyme obangela ukususwa okungahleliwe kwezingxenye zezakhi zofuzo eziguquguqukayo ezakha uchungechunge lokukhanya lwe-antibody ku-DNA?
answer29: Ukuhlelwa kabusha kwe-DNA → ukubhalwa kabusha → ukucutshungulwa kwe-RNA → ukuhumusha → i-antibody evuthiwe

distractor29b: Ukubhalwa phansi → Ukucutshungulwa kwe-RNA → Ukuhlela kabusha i-DNA → ukuhumusha → i-antibody evuthiwe

question31: Ukungezwani komzimba kuye kwachazwa njengokusabela komzimba okungavikeli. Yisiphi isitatimende esinikeza ulwazi olusekela le ncazelo?
answer31: Ukungezwani komzimba kubangelwa impendulo yomzimba kuphrotheni engadali umonakalo futhi umzimba awudingi ukuzivikela kuyo
distractor31a: Impendulo yokungezwani komzimba yenzeka lapho amaseli e-B ekhiqiza ama-molecule e-IgE ngenxa yeprotheni yangaphandle, okubangela ukuthi i-histamine ikhishwe
distractor31b: Abantu abane-allergies baba nezimpawu ezingathandeki ezifana namehlo anamanzi, ukulunywa, izicubu ezivuvukele, kanye nokuthimula
distractor31c: Uma igazi labo lihlolwa, abantu abane-allergies babonisa ukuthi banama-antibodies abopha iphrotheni eyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwamanye amazwe.
question32: Lithini igama lama-antibodies aphawula ngokungafanele izingxenye zawo njengezingaphandle?
question33: Kungani abanye abantu abanesifo sikashukela sohlobo 1 beba nalesi sifo ngenxa yokusabela komzimba okungasebenzi kahle?
answer33: Amaseli abo e-B asabela ku-self protein ukuze akhiqize ama-autoantibodies, okwabangela ukuvuvukala okwabangela ukulimala kwezitho zomzimba.
distractor33a: Amaseli abo e-B akhiqiza ama-molecule e-IgE ngenxa yephrotheni engenangozi, okwabangela ukukhishwa kwe-histamine
distractor33b: Babenempendulo ebambezelekile kuphrotheni eyingozi eyangena emzimbeni futhi yavuselela kokubili amasosha omzimba azalwa nawo kanye navumelana nezimo.
distractor33c: Bathola ama-antibodies e-insulin ngokusebenzisa i-immunity engasebenzi, futhi la ma-antibodies abopha i-insulin noma nini lapho ikhiqizwa emzimbeni.
distractor34a: Ukuntuleka kwe-immune okungokwemvelo, okutholiwe, kanye nokutholakala kwamasosha omzimba
distractor35b: Impendulo yomzimba engathandeki kumaprotheni angaphandle angenangozi
question36: Kungani umzimba womuntu udinga okungaphezu kwesikhumba sawo ukuze usebenze njengesivikelo ekutheleleni amagciwane?
answer36: Amagciwane angangena emzimbeni ngezindawo eziningana ezingamboziwe yisikhumba ezidinga ukuba nesithiyo sokuvimbela ukutheleleka
distractor36a: Isikhumba sisebenza kuphela ngokumelene nezinhlobo ezithile zamagciwane. Ukuze kuvinjelwe ukungena kwezinye izifo, kudingeka ezinye izithiyo zomzimba noma zamakhemikhali.
distractor36b: Isikhumba asinikezi ukuvikelwa okubanzi ekuhlaselweni komzimba yizinhlayiya zangaphandle, ngakho-ke asiyona isithiyo esisebenza kahle kakhulu
distractor36c: Isikhumba sisebenza kuphela njengesivikelo samakhemikhali ngokumelene namagciwane. Umzimba udinga nezithiyo ezibonakalayo ukuze uvimbele izinhlobo ezahlukene zokutheleleka
question37: Ukuqashelwa kobuso beseli kwenzeka ngezinhlobo eziningi zezimpendulo zomzimba, okuhlanganisa nezimpendulo zomzimba ezisheshayo nezishukunyiswayo. Amaseli abulalayo emvelo kanye nama-interferons amelela kanjani uhlobo ngalunye lwempendulo yomzimba (okusheshayo nokushukunyiswayo), futhi ukuqashelwa kobuso beseli kudlala kanjani indima?
answer37: Amaseli abulala angokwemvelo ayisibonelo sokuphendula ngokushesha kwamasosha omzimba njengoba ehlasela amaseli aphethwe yiwo alahlekelwe izimpawu ezijwayelekile zobuso bamangqamuzana. Ama-Interferons ayisibonelo sokuphendula kwamasosha omzimba okubangelwa yiwo njengoba ebangelwa ngemva kokuba izimpawu zobuso bamangqamuzana ezifweni ezihlaselayo zibonwe amaseli aphethwe yiwo.
distractor37a: Amaseli abulala ngokwemvelo ayisibonelo sempendulo yokuzivikela komzimba ebangelwa yilokhu njengoba ehlasela amaseli aphethwe yilesi sifo alahlekelwe izimpawu ezivamile zobuso bamaseli. Ama-Interferons ayisibonelo sempendulo yokuzivikela komzimba ngokushesha njengoba ebangelwa ngemva kokuba izimpawu zobuso bamaseli ezifweni ezihlaselayo zibonwe amaseli aphethwe yilesi sifo.
distractor37b: Amaseli abulala angokwemvelo ayisibonelo sokuphendula ngokushesha kwamasosha omzimba njengoba ebangelwa ngemva kokuba izimpawu zobuso beseli ezifweni ezihlaselayo zibonwe ngamaseli amukelayo. Ama-Interferons ayisibonelo sokuphendula kwamasosha omzimba okubangelwa njengoba ehlasela amaseli amukelayo alahlekelwe izimpawu zobuso beseli ezivamile.
distractor37c: Amaseli abulala ngokwemvelo ayisibonelo sempendulo yokuzivikela komzimba ebangelwa yizifo njengoba ebangelwa yizimpawu zobuso beseli ezifweni ezihlaselayo ezibonwe amaseli amukelayo. Ama-Interferons ayisibonelo sempendulo yokuzivikela komzimba ngokushesha njengoba ehlasela amaseli amukelayo alahlekelwe izimpawu zobuso beseli ezivamile.
question38: Kungani ama-molecule e-MHC I ahlukene phakathi kwamaseli anikelayo nawamukelayo engase aholele ekwenqatshweni kwesitho noma izicubu ezitshaliwe?
answer38: Amaseli abulalayo emvelo kumuntu otholayo azobona ama-molecule e-MHC I esitho esitshaliwe njengamaprotheni angewona awemvelo, okubangela ukuqhekeka kwamaseli atshaliwe. Amanye amaseli azobambisana ukuze aqede amaseli angaphandle.
distractor38a: Ama-neutrophils kumuntu otholayo azokhomba ama-molecule e-MHC I esitho esitshaliwe njengamaprotheni angewona awemvelo, okubangela ukuqhuma kwamaseli atshaliwe. Amanye amaseli azobambisana ukuze aqede amaseli angaphandle.
distractor38b: Ama-lymphocyte e-B kumuntu otholayo azobona ama-molecule e-MHC I esitho esitshaliwe njengamaprotheni angewona awemvelo. Amaseli angaphandle azobe esegwinywa futhi abhujiswe yi-B lymphocyte.
distractor38c: Ama-macrophage kumuntu otholayo azobona ama-molecule e-MHC I esitho esitshaliwe njengamaprotheni angewona awemvelo, okubangela ukuqhuma kwamaseli atshaliwe. Amanye amaseli azobambisana ukuze ahlukanise amaseli angaphandle.
question39: Ake sithi umuntu wazalwa engenalo ikhono lokukhiqiza ama-molecule e-MHC I. Lokho kungadala yiphi inkinga?
answer39: Amasosha omzimba womuntu ngeke akwazi ukuhlukanisa yena kanye nongesiye yena. Lokhu kungenza umuntu abe sengozini enkulu yokutheleleka.
distractor39a: Umuntu ongenalo ikhono lokukhiqiza ama-molecule e-MHC I angafa ngokushesha
distractor39b: Umuntu ongenalo ikhono lokukhiqiza ama-molecule e-MHC I angazibona njengongesiyena uqobo, okuholela ezifweni zokuzivikela komzimba.
distractor39c: Amasosha omzimba womuntu ngeke akwazi ukubhubhisa amagciwane angaphandle ngenxa yokuntuleka kwama-enzyme e-hydrolytic. Lokhu kungenza umuntu abe sengozini enkulu yokutheleleka.
question40: Bheka uMfanekiso 33.7. Isithombe sibonisa ukuthi uhlelo lokugcwalisa lungabopha futhi lubhubhise kanjani i-pathogen. Ake sithi ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuvimbele amaprotheni e-C2 kanye ne-C4 ukuthi akhiwe kahle. Ingabe lonke uhlelo lokugcwalisa luzophazamiseka? Kungani noma kungani kungenjalo?
answer40: Yebo, ngoba uhlelo lokugcwalisa lusebenza njenge-cascade, lapho iphrotheni ngayinye ibangela umsebenzi wephrotheni elandelayo ku-cascade
distractor40a: Cha, ngoba uhlelo lokugcwalisa lusebenza njenge-cascade, lapho iphrotheni ngayinye ibangela umsebenzi wephrotheni elandelayo ku-cascade.
distractor40b: Yebo, ngoba wonke amaprotheni esistimu yokugcwalisa asebenza ngokuzimela

question41: Yisiphi isizathu esingase sichaze ukuthi kungani izilwane ezinezinhlungu zomgogodla zathuthukisa isimiso somzimba sokuzivikela esivumelana nezimo kunokuba kube uhlelo olungokwemvelo oluhilela izimpendulo ezithile kumagciwane athile?
answer41: Njengoba amagciwane amasha eshintsha njalo, kungcono kakhulu ukugcina amandla nolwazi ukuze kube nohlelo lokuzivikela oluzivumelanisa nezimo olungasabela kumagciwane ahlukene ngendlela ethile.
distractor41a: Uhlelo lokuzivikela oluzivumelanisa nezimo ludinga ulwazi oluningi okufanele lugcinwe, okuvumela amangqamuzana ezilwane ezinomgogodla ukuthi akwazi ukufaka izimpendulo ezithile kuzo zonke izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane.
distractor41b: Njengoba amagciwane amasha eshintsha njalo, kungcono kakhulu ukugcina amandla nolwazi ukuze kube nohlelo lokuzivikela oluzivumelanisa nezimo olungasabela kumagciwane afanayo ngezindlela ezahlukene.
distractor41c: Njengoba amagciwane amasha eshintsha njalo, kungcono kakhulu ukugcina amandla nolwazi ukuze kube nohlelo lokuzivikela oluzivumelanisa nezimo olungasabela kumagciwane ahlukene ngendlela engacacile.
question42: Izilwane ezingenamgogodla zinezinhlelo zokuzivikela zomzimba ezingokwemvelo futhi azinazo izinhlelo zokuzivikela ezivumelana nezimo. Izilwane ezinethambo lomgogodla, okuhlanganisa izinhlanzi, izilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini, izilwane ezihuquzelayo, izinyoni nezilwane ezincelisayo zinazo zombili izinhlelo. Ngokusekelwe kulolu lwazi, faka isimangalo ngokuvela kwalezi zinhlelo ezimbili zokuzivikela komzimba.
answer42: Uhlelo lokuzivikela olungokwemvelo lwavela kuqala. Uhlelo lokuzivikela oluguquguqukayo lwavela ngemva kokuba izilwane ezingenamgogodla nezilwane ezinomgogodla zihlukene. Ezilwanyaneni ezinomgogodla, uhlelo lokuzivikela oluguquguqukayo lwavela kusenesikhathi.
distractor42a: Uhlelo lokuzivikela oluzivumelanisa nezimo lwavela kuqala. Uhlelo lokuzivikela oluzalwa nalo lwavela ngemva kokuba izilwane ezingenamgogodla nezilwane ezinomgogodla zihlukene. Ezilwanyaneni ezinomgogodla, uhlelo lokuzivikela oluzivumelanisa nezimo lwavela kusenesikhathi.
distractor42b: Uhlelo lokuzivikela olungokwemvelo lwavela kuqala. Ezilwaneni ezinethambo lomgogodla, uhlelo lokuzivikela oluguquguqukayo lwavela kaningi ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene
distractor42c: Uhlelo lokuzivikela oluzivumelanisa nezimo lwavela kuqala. Ezilwaneni ezinethambo lomgogodla, uhlelo lokuzivikela oluzalwa nalo lwavela kaningi ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene
question43: Ayini amaseli e-B noma e-T angenalwazi futhi asebenza kanjani ezimpendulweni zomzimba eziqhutshwa amaseli kanye nezingajwayelekile?
answer43: Amaseli e-B nama-T angenalwazi angama-lymphocyte ezinhlobo ze-B nama-T avame ukujikeleza emzimbeni ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi awakaze ahlangane nanoma yimaphi ama-antigen abangela izifo. Amaseli e-B asebenzayo akhiqiza ama-antibodies empendulweni yokuzivikela komzimba e-humoral, kuyilapho amaseli e-T asebenzayo evuselela impendulo yokuzivikela yomzimba eqondiswa amaseli.
distractor43a: Amaseli e-B nama-T angenalwazi angama-lymphocyte ezinhlobo ze-B nama-T ahlangane nama-antigen abangela izifo. Amaseli e-T angenalwazi akhiqiza ama-antibodies empendulweni yokuzivikela komzimba e-humoral, kuyilapho amaseli e-B angenalwazi evuselela impendulo yokuzivikela yomzimba eqhutshwa amaseli.

question44: Umuntu onikezwe umuthi wokugomela umkhuhlane ngoNovemba uhlaselwa yisifo esibi somkhuhlane ngoJanuwari. Ungaphetha ngokuthini ngomuthi wokugomela umkhuhlane kanye nokusabela okuphambene?
answer44: Umuthi wokugomela umkhuhlane waveza ama-antibodies emzimbeni womuntu ayeqondene negciwane elithile lomkhuhlane. Ngeshwa, igciwane lomkhuhlane elathelela umuntu kamuva ngoJanuwari lalihlukile ngokwanele ukuthi kwenzeke ukuhlangana phakathi kwama-antigen egciwane abangela ukutheleleka.
distractor44a: Umuthi wokugomela umkhuhlane ucindezela ama-antibodies emzimbeni womuntu ayeqondene negciwane elithile lomkhuhlane. Ngeshwa, igciwane lomkhuhlane elathelela umuntu kamuva ngoJanuwari lalihlukile ngokwanele ukuthi kwenzeke ukusabela okuphambene phakathi kwama-antigen egciwane abangela ukutheleleka.
distractor44b: Umuthi wokugomela umkhuhlane ucindezela ama-antibodies emzimbeni womuntu ayeqondene negciwane elithile lomkhuhlane. Ngeshwa, igciwane lomkhuhlane elathelela umuntu kamuva ngoJanuwari lalifana ngokwanele ukuthi kwenzeke ukusabela okuphambene phakathi kwama-antigen egciwane abangela ukutheleleka.
distractor44c: Umuthi wokugomela umkhuhlane ucindezela ama-antibodies emzimbeni womuntu ayeqondene negciwane elithile lomkhuhlane. Ngeshwa, igciwane lomkhuhlane elathelela umuntu kamuva ngoJanuwari lalifana ngokwanele ukuthi kwenzeke ukusabela okuphambene phakathi kwama-antigen egciwane abangela ukutheleleka.
question45: Yimuphi umsebenzi okwenziwa ukuhlukahluka kwesifunda esiguquguqukayo se-antibody?
answer45: Ivumela ukwenziwa kwama-antibodies amaningi ahlukene anezici ezihlukile zokubopha
distractor45a: Kuyasiza ekuxhumaneni kwama-antibodies nezinye izingxenye zesimiso somzimba sokuzivikela
distractor45b: Kusiza ama-antibodies ukuthi asebenze ngokuqina okuncane kakhulu kanye nokucacile
distractor45c: Ivumela ukwenziwa kwama-antibodies amaningi ahlukene anezici ezifanayo zokubopha
question46: Ungachaza kanjani ukuthi ama-antibodies afanayo atholakala emzimbeni wosana ngemva kokuzalwa akhona nakunina wosana?
answer46: Ama-antibodies akhiqizwa emzimbeni kamama adluliselwa enganeni nge-intravenous immunity nge-placenta.
distractor46a: Ama-antibodies akhiqizwa emzimbeni kamama adluliselwa enganeni ngokuzivikela komzimba ngobisi lwebele.
