distractor46c: Ama-antibodies akhiqizwa emzimbeni wosana adluliselwa kumama nge-placenta
question47: Abacwaningi bebesebenza ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokukhuthaza amasosha omzimba womuntu ukuthi aqaphele amaprotheni angaphandle njengamaprotheni azimele. Kungani lolu cwaningo luzosebenza ekwelapheni ukungezwani komzimba?
answer47: Uma umuntu enokungezwani komzimba, amasosha omzimba womuntu asabela kuphrotheni engenangozi evela endaweni ezungezile, okubangela izimpawu ezingathandeki.
distractor47a: Uma umuntu enokungezwani komzimba, amasosha omzimba womuntu asengozini, okubangela izimpawu ezingathandeki.
distractor47b: Uma umuntu enokungezwani komzimba, amasosha omzimba womuntu asabela kumaprotheni awo, okubangela izimpawu ezingathandeki.
distractor47c: Uma umuntu enokungezwani komzimba, amasosha omzimba womuntu asabela kuphrotheni engenangozi evela endaweni ezungezile, okubangela izimpawu ezinhle
question48: Isiguli sisanda kwaziswa ukuthi sinesifo sokuzivikela komzimba esihlasela izindlala zamathe. Ungasichazela kanjani isiguli ukuthi kwenzekani emzimbeni waso?
answer48: Amasosha omzimba akhiqiza ama-antibodies ngokumelene namaprotheni awo akhona ezindlaleni zawo zamathe, okwenza izindlala zamathe ziqhekeke futhi zingasebenzi.
distractor48a: Amandla ohlelo lokuzivikela omzimba okulwa ne-antigen ekhona ezindlaleni zamathe kungenzeka ukuthi aphazamisekile, okwenza izindlala zamathe ziqhekeke futhi zingasebenzi.
distractor48b: Amasosha omzimba kungenzeka ukuthi asabela ngendlela engavamile ku-antigen okungenzeka ukuthi ingene ezindlaleni zamathe, okwenza izindlala zamathe ziqhekeke futhi zingasebenzi kahle.
distractor48c: Kungenzeka ukuthi ezinye izifo zingene ezindlaleni zamathe, okwenza izindlala zamathe zaphuka futhi zingasebenzi.
question49: Bheka uMfanekiso 33.31. Le grafu ikhombisa ukuthi ukusebenza kahle kwamaphaphu kuphumela kanjani esigulini esinomzimba ongezwani nomzimba ngemva kokuchayeka ku-allergen. Yisiphi isimangalo esingase senziwe ngokusekelwe kule grafu?
answer49: Ukusebenza kwamaphaphu kwehla ngokushesha, kuphinde kubuyele esimweni sawo bese kuba nokwehla kwesibili, okukhulu kakhulu ngemva kwamahora ambalwa.
distractor49a: Ukusebenza kwamaphaphu kwehla ngokushesha bese kubuya kancane kancane
distractor49b: Ukusebenza kwamaphaphu kwehla kancane kancane emahoreni angama-20 alandelayo
distractor49c: Ukusebenza kwamaphaphu kwehla ngokushesha, kuphinde kubuye kube nokwehla kwesibili, okungathí sina kakhulu emahoreni ambalwa kamuva.
question50: Amangqamuzana abulalayo emvelo asabela kanjani kumaseli anempilo uma kuqhathaniswa namangqamuzana atheleleke ngegciwane?
answer50: Amaseli abulala i-MHC I aqaphela iseli eliphilile futhi awayibulali, kuyilapho amaseli athelelekile angenayo i-MHC I ebulawa.
distractor50a: Amaseli abulala ngokwemvelo aqaphela i-MHC I esiseleni esinegciwane bese eyibulala, kuyilapho amaseli aphilile angenayo i-MHC I engabulawa.
distractor50b: Amaseli abulala i-MHC II ayibona eseli eliphilile futhi awayibulali, kuyilapho amaseli athelelekile angenayo i-MHC II ebulawa.
distractor50c: Amaseli abulala ngokwemvelo aqaphela i-MHC II esiseleni esinegciwane futhi ayayibulala, kuyilapho amaseli aphilile angenayo i-MHC II engabulawa.
question51: Bheka uMfanekiso 33.32. Umdwebo olandelayo ongaphelele umelela uchungechunge lwezehlakalo ngesikhathi sokusabela komzimba okungokwemvelo. Amalebula u-A, u-B, no-C kudingeka athathelwe indawo ngamagama amaseli ahilelekile. Yiliphi isethi lamaseli eliqedela kahle lo mdwebo?
answer51: A = i-pathogen, B = iseli le-dendritic, C = iseli eliphilile lomnikazi
distractor51a: A = iseli lomnikazi elinegciwane, B = igciwane, C = iseli lomnikazi elinempilo
distractor51b: A = iseli eliphilile lomnikazi, B = i-pathogen, C = iseli le-dendritic
distractor51c: A = iseli le-dendritic, B = iseli lomnikazi elinegciwane, C = i-pathogen
question52: Umuntu ophilile ukhiqiza ama-antibodies ahlasela amagciwane ahlasela umzimba. Kodwa-ke, uma lo muntu etheleleka nge-HIV, umzimba ulahlekelwa amandla okukhiqiza ama-antibodies. Ucwaningo lukhombisile ukuthi igciwane lihlasela futhi libhubhise amaseli e-CD4+ T. Kungani ukubhujiswa kwamaseli e-CD4+ T kuholela ekulahlekelweni kokwenziwa kwama-antibody ezigulini ezine-HIV?
answer52: Amaseli e-CD4+ T ayisikhungo esidingekayo ochungechungeni lwezehlakalo zokubonisana phakathi kweseli neseli okumele ziqedwe ngaphambi kokuba amaseli e-B avuthwe
distractor52a: Amaseli e-CD4+ T anama-molecule e-CD4 aboshwe ndawonye ezindaweni zawo zamaseli futhi awabangeli i-apoptosis kwamanye amaseli ngesikhathi sokusabela komzimba.
distractor52b: Izibalo zamaseli e-CD4+ T zingaba ngu-1,000 nge-microliter kumuntu ophilile, kodwa zehla ngaphansi kuka-400 nge-microliter kumuntu ongakwazi ukuvikela amasosha omzimba.
distractor52c: Ama-CD4+ T cell precursors akheka emnkantsheni wamathambo bese ethutha aye e-thymus, lapho athuthukisa khona ama-T cell receptors awo.
question53: Bheka uMfanekiso 33.33. Yisiphi kulezi zinombolo ezilandelayo amagremu esibonisa kahle ukuthi i-macrophage isebenza kanjani iseli le-T elisizayo (iseli le-TH)?
question54: Bheka uMfanekiso 33.34. Igrafu ikhombisa izinguquko egazini lomuntu ngemva kokuthola umjovo. Chaza ukuthi ukuxhumana kwamaseli kuhileleke kanjani ekuletheni izinguquko eziboniswe kugrafu.
answer54: Umuthi wokugomela ufaka ama-antigen akhethekile ku-pathogen egazini lomuntu. Lawa ma-antigen athuthelwa ebusweni beseli lamaseli aveza i-antigen akhona egazini. Ama-receptor kumaseli e-T asizayo abopha kuma-antigen akhona kuseli eliveza i-antigen. Lokhu kuxhumana ngqo kweseli neseli kuqala uchungechunge lwezehlakalo eziholela ekukhiqizweni kwama-antibodies yi-B lymphocytes.
distractor54a: Umuthi wokugoma ufaka ama-antigen athile ku-pathogen egazini lomuntu. Lawa ma-antigen abopha kuma-receptor ebusweni bamaseli e-T. Lokhu kuxhumana ngqo kweseli neseli kuqala uchungechunge lwezehlakalo eziholela ekukhiqizweni kwama-antibodies ngama-B lymphocytes.
distractor54b: Umuthi wokugoma ufaka ama-antigen athile ku-pathogen egazini lomuntu. Lawa ma-antigen athuthelwa ebusweni beseli lamaseli aveza i-antigen akhona egazini. Lokhu kuxhumana ngqo kweseli neseli kuqala uchungechunge lwezehlakalo eziholela ekukhiqizweni kwama-antibodies yi-B lymphocytes.
distractor54c: Umuthi wokugomela ufaka ama-antigen akhethekile ku-pathogen egazini lomuntu. Lawa ma-antigen athuthelwa ebusweni beseli lamaseli aveza i-antigen akhona egazini. Ama-receptor kumaseli e-T asizayo abopha kuma-antigen akhona kuseli eliveza i-antigen. Lokhu kuxhumana ngqo kweseli neseli kuqala uchungechunge lwezehlakalo ezisebenzisa uhlelo lokugcwalisa.
question55: Amaseli e-B angamaseli omzimba abalulekile alwa nezifo. Iseli le-B elingazi lutho likhuthazwa kanjani ukuba likhule libe yiseli le-plasma elikhipha amasosha omzimba?
answer55: Amaseli e-T akhipha ama-cytokine, asiza amaseli e-B ukuba ande futhi akhule abe yiseli le-plasma elikhiqiza ama-antibody
distractor55a: Amaseli okubulala emvelo akhipha ama-cytokine, asiza iseli le-B ukuthi likhule futhi likhule libe yiseli le-plasma elikhiqiza ama-antibody
distractor55b: Amaseli e-T akhipha ama-interferons, asiza amaseli e-B ukuba ande futhi akhule abe yiseli le-plasma elikhiqiza ama-antibody
distractor55c: Amaseli okubulala emvelo akhipha ama-interferons, asiza iseli le-B ukuba likhule futhi likhule libe yiseli le-plasma elikhiqiza ama-antibody
question56: Bheka uMfanekiso 33.35. Umdwebo ubonisa inqubo eyenzeka ngesikhathi sokusabela komzimba. Yikuphi okukhethwa kukho okuchaza okwenzekayo kulo mdwebo?
answer56: Ama-antibodies abopha amabhaktheriya, okwenza kube lula ukuwasebenzisa nge-macrophage.
distractor56a: Ama-antibodies abopha amabhaktheriya, awavimbele ukuthi ahlukane
distractor56b: Ama-antibodies abopha kuma-molecule anobuthi akhishwa amabhaktheriya, awavimbele ukungena emangqamuzaneni
distractor56c: Ama-antibodies abopha kuma-molecule anobuthi akhishwa amabhaktheriya, ayeke ukuhamba kwawo emzimbeni
question57: Bheka uMfanekiso 33.36. Ososayensi benze ucwaningo besebenzisa iseli elivela kumbungu wegundane kanye neseli B elivela kugundane omdala. Iseli lembungu legundane alenzi ama-antibodies, kodwa i-DNA yalo iqukethe ukulandelana kwe-nucleotide okuhlanganisa ama-polypeptide e-antibody. Iseli lembungu le-B elidala lenza futhi likhiphe uhlobo olulodwa lwe-antibody. Kulolu cwaningo, ama-probe e-DNA anelebula ye-radio ahlanganiswa ukuze ahambisane ne-DNA ebhala amaketanga okukhanya e-antibody akhiqizwa amaseli embungu e-B adala. Ngemuva kwalokho, i-DNA evela kuseli lembungu legundane kanye neseli le-B elidala yahlukaniswa futhi yahlolwa ukuze kubonwe ukuthi ingabe ihlanganiswe nama-probe e-DNA anelebula ye-radio ahlanganisiwe. Imiphumela iboniswe kumdwebo. Yisiphi isimangalo esisekelwa kangcono yidatha?
answer57: Ukuhlelwa kabusha kwezingxenye zezakhi zofuzo ezifaka ama-polypeptide e-antibody kwenzeka ezingeni le-DNA ukuze kukhiqizwe ukuhlukahluka okukhulu kwama-molecule e-antibody
distractor57a: I-genome yegundane iqukethe inani elikhulu kakhulu lama-antibody genes, okubangela ukuhlukahluka okukhulu kwama-molecule e-antibody angakhiwa.
distractor57b: Ukwehlukahluka okukhulu kwama-molecule e-antibody okungenziwa ngenxa yokuguqulwa kwangemva kokuhumusha kwamaketanga e-antibody polypeptide
distractor57c: I-antibody ngayinye ibhalwe nge-gene yayo eyingqayizivele ku-DNA, okuchaza ukuthi ama-antibodies angaba kanjani nezakhiwo ezihlukene zokubopha i-antigen
question58: I-molecule ye-antibody ibopha kanjani ngqo kwi-antigen eyodwa kodwa hhayi kwezinye?
distractor58a: Ngenxa yokuba khona kwendawo ethile yokubopha i-antigen
question59: I-genome yomuntu iqukethe izakhi zofuzo ezingaphansi kuka-50,000, kodwa umuntu unamandla okukhiqiza ama-molecule e-antibody angaphezu kuka-10^12 ahlukene. Lobu bufakazi bungasetshenziswa kanjani ukusekela isimangalo sokuthi umzimba womuntu unesimiso sokuzivikela somzimba esisebenza kahle futhi esisebenzayo?
answer59: Kunezinhlobo eziningi kakhulu zama-antibody molecules angenziwa, ngalinye lawo elingabhekisa ngqo ku-pathogen ethile ukuze liyibhubhise. Lokhu kucaciswa kwenza isimiso somzimba sokuzivikela sisebenze kangcono. Isimiso somzimba sokuzivikela sisebenza kahle futhi ngoba i-antibody ngayinye ayidingi ukuba ne-gene yayo.
distractor59a: Kunezinhlobo eziningi kakhulu zama-antibody molecules angenziwa, ngalinye lawo elingabhekisa ngqo ku-pathogen ethile ukuze liyibhubhise. Lokhu kucaciswa kwenza isimiso somzimba sokuzivikela sisebenze kangcono. Isimiso somzimba sokuzivikela sisebenza kahle futhi ngoba i-antibody ngayinye kudingeka ibe nesakhi sayo sofuzo.
distractor59b: Kunezinhlobo eziningi zama-antibody molecules angenziwa, ngalinye lawo elingaqondisa igciwane elithile ukuze libhujiswe. Lokhu kungacaci kwenza isimiso somzimba sisebenze kangcono. Isimiso somzimba sisebenza kahle futhi ngoba i-antibody ngayinye ayidingi ukuba nesakhi sayo sofuzo.
distractor59c: Kunezinhlobo eziningi kakhulu zama-antibody molecules angenziwa, ngalinye lawo elingabhekisa ngqo ku-pathogen ethile ukuze liyibhubhise. Lokhu kucaciswa kwenza isimiso somzimba sisebenze kahle kakhulu. Isimiso somzimba sisebenza kahle futhi ngoba i-antibody ngayinye ayidingi ukuba ne-gene yayo.
question60: Bheka uMfanekiso 33.38. Ukungezwani komzimba kubangelwa ukuthi amasosha omzimba asabela kuphrotheni yangaphandle ukuze akhiqize ama-molecule e-IgE aqaphela iphrotheni. Lawa ma-molecule e-IgE ahlotshaniswa namaseli e-mast asabela ekuvezweni kwephrotheni esikhathini esizayo ngokukhulula ama-histamine emzimbeni. Umdwebo ubonisa lokhu kukhululwa futhi ubonisa nokuthi umuthi obizwa ngokuthi i-antihistamine ungasiza kanjani umuntu ohlushwa ukungezwani komzimba ukunciphisa izimpawu zakhe zokungezwani komzimba. Yisiphi kulezi zinkulumo ezilandelayo esichaza ukuthi i-antihistamine isiza kanjani ukubuyisela i-homeostasis ngesikhathi sokusabela kokungezwani komzimba?
answer60: Ama-antihistamine avimbela ama-histamine akhishwe amaseli e-mast ekuvuseleleni ukulunywa nokuvuvukala kwezicubu zomzimba
distractor60a: Ama-antihistamine avimbela amaseli e-mast ukuthi ahlanganiswe nama-molecule e-IgE aqaphela i-allergen yamaprotheni angaphandle
distractor60b: Ama-antihistamine avimbela amaseli e-mast ekukhululeni ama-histamine futhi abangele izimpawu zokungezwani komzimba ezingathandeki
distractor60c: Ama-antihistamine avimbela amaseli e-mast ekukhiqizeni ama-histamine, okuvimbela ukusebenza kwawo emzimbeni.
question61: Bheka uMfanekiso 33.39. Umdwebo ukhombisa i-feedback loop evamile elawula ukukhiqizwa kwama-hormone e-thyroid emzimbeni womuntu. Isifo sikaGraves yisifo esihlasela umzimba lapho umzimba ukhiqiza ama-autoantibodies kwi-TSH receptor. Uma la ma-autoantibodies ebopha kwi-receptor, alingisa isenzo se-TSH hormone. I-feedback loop kanye nokukhiqizwa kwama-hormone e-thyroid okulawulwayo okuboniswe kumdwebo kungathinteka kanjani kumuntu onesifo sikaGraves?
answer61: I-feedback loop izophazamiseka. Ama-autoantibodies azobopha kuma-TSH receptors, avumele ukuthi aqhubeke nokukhiqiza ama-hormone e-thyroid. Ngenxa yalokho, kuzoba nokukhiqizwa ngokweqile kwama-hormone e-thyroid ngoba uhlelo lwe-feedback olungalungile ngeke lukwazi ukusebenza.
distractor61a: I-feedback loop ngeke iphazanyiswe. Ama-autoantibodies azobopha kuma-TSH receptors, avumele ukuthi aqhubeke nokukhiqiza ama-hormone e-thyroid. Ngenxa yalokho, kuzoba nokukhiqizwa ngokweqile kwama-hormone e-thyroid ngoba uhlelo lwe-feedback olungalungile ngeke lukwazi ukusebenza.
distractor61b: I-feedback loop izophazamiseka. Ama-autoantibodies ngeke abophe kuma-TSH receptors, okuwavumela ukuthi aqhubeke nokukhiqiza ama-hormone e-thyroid. Ngenxa yalokho, kuzoba nokukhiqizwa ngokweqile kwama-hormone e-thyroid ngoba uhlelo lwe-feedback olungalungile ngeke lukwazi ukusebenza.
distractor61c: I-feedback loop izophazamiseka. Ama-autoantibodies azobopha kuma-TSH receptors, avumele ukuthi aqhubeke nokukhiqiza ama-hormone e-thyroid. Ngenxa yalokho, kuzoba nokukhiqizwa ngokweqile kwama-hormone e-thyroid ngoba uhlelo lwe-feedback olungalungile belusebenza kahle.
question62: Bheka Umfanekiso 33.40. I-Myasthenia gravis yisifo sokuzivikela komzimba esiqala ngokubonakala kobuthakathaka bemisipha futhi singaqhubekela phambili ekuphazamisekeni okuphelele kokunyakaza kwemisipha. Umdwebo uqhathanisa umuntu ophilile nomuntu ohlushwa yilesi sifo. Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi kwenzekani ukuze kubangele lesi sifo?
answer62: Umzimba ukhiqiza ama-antibodies ngokumelene nama-receptor emisipha, okuvimbela i-acetylcholine ekubopheni nasekuqedeni ukudluliselwa kwesignali yezinzwa
distractor62a: Umzimba ukhiqiza ama-antibodies ngokumelene namaseli ezinzwa, okuvimbela amaseli ezinzwa ukuthi akhulule i-acetylcholine ngesikhathi sokudluliselwa kwesignali emisipheni.
distractor62b: Umzimba ukhiqiza ama-antibodies ngokumelene ne-acetylcholine, okuvimbela i-acetylcholine ekudluliseni izimpawu ezivela emithanjeni ziye emisipheni
distractor62c: Umzimba ukhiqiza ama-antibodies ngokumelene ne-acetylcholine, okuvimbela i-acetylcholine ukuthi iphuke ngemva kokudluliselwa kwesignali kuqediwe.
question63: Bheka uMfanekiso 33.37. Ibhaktheriya elibangela izifo ligubuzelwe yiseli le-phagocytic njengengxenye yempendulo yomzimba yokuzalwa. Yimuphi kule mifanekiso elandelayo omelela kangcono impendulo?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.0 Introduction
chapterContent:
Ukuzala kwezilwane kuyadingeka ukuze kusindiswe uhlobo oluthile. Embusweni wezilwane, kunezindlela eziningi izinhlobo ezizalana ngazo. Ukuzala okungenabo ubulili kukhiqiza izinto eziphilayo ezifanayo ngokofuzo (ama-clone), kanti ekuzaleni ngokocansi, izinto zofuzo zabantu ababili ziyahlangana ukuze kukhiqizwe inzalo ehlukile ngokofuzo kubazali bazo. Ngesikhathi sokuzala ngokocansi i-gamete yesilisa (isidoda) ingafakwa ngaphakathi komzimba wesifazane ukuze kukhuleliswe ngaphakathi, noma isidoda namaqanda kungakhishwa endaweni ukuze kukhuleliswe ngaphandle. Ama-seahorse, njengalawo aboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.1, anikeza isibonelo salokhu okulandelayo. Ngemva komdanso wokuzala, insikazi ibekela amaqanda esikhwameni sesisu se-seahorse yesilisa lapho ikhuliswa khona. Amaqanda ayachachamba futhi inzalo ikhula esikhwameni amasonto amaningana.

 Ezinye izilwane ziyakwazi ukuzala ngaphandle kobulili ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-parthenogenesis. Nakuba le nqubo ivamile ezilwaneni ezingenamgogodla, ayivamile ezilwaneni ezinomgogodla. Ekuqaleni ososayensi babecabanga ukuthi i-parthenogenesis yezilwane ezinomgogodla yenzeka kuphela ezilwaneni ezithunjiwe, njengezinyoni, izinyoka, noshaka; nokho, muva nje kutholakale ukuthi cishe inhlanzi eyodwa kwezinhlanu ezincane ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-sawfish eFlorida iwumphumela we-parthenogenesis. Lolu hlobo lwenhlanzi lusengozini, futhi abacwaningi basola ukuthi lolu hlobo lokuzala lungaba yindlela yokusiza ukugcina lolu hlobo lungashabalali.
question1: Iyini inzuzo eyinhloko yokuzala ngokocansi kunokuzala okungenabo ubulili?
answer1: Ikhiqiza inzalo ehlukahlukene ngokwezakhi zofuzo
question2: Uyini umphumela wokuzala okungenabo ubulili?
answer2: Inzalo efana ncamashi nezakhi zofuzo ebizwa ngokuthi ama-clone
distractor2a: Inzalo enezinto zofuzo ezivela kubazali ababili
question3: Ekuzaleni ngokocansi, inzalo ihlukile ngokofuzo kubazali bayo ngoba:
answer3: Izinto zofuzo ezivela kubantu ababili zihlanganiswa
distractor3a: Izakhi zofuzo zomama kuphela ezizuzwa njengefa
distractor3b: Izakhi zofuzo zobaba kuphela ezizuzwa njengefa
distractor3c: I-DNA ithathelwa indawo ngokuphelele ngemva kokukhulelwa
question4: Kuyini ukukhulelwa kwangaphakathi?
answer4: Ukukhulelwa lapho isidoda sifakwa khona emzimbeni wesifazane
distractor4b: Ukufaka umquba ngaphakathi kweqanda ngemva kokuchamisela
question5: Kuyini i-parthenogenesis?
answer5: Uhlobo lokuzala okungenabo ubulili lapho inzalo ikhula khona ngaphandle kokukhulelwa
question6: Kukuliphi iqembu lezilwane lapho i-parthenogenesis ivame kakhulu khona?
answer6: Izilwane ezingenamgogodla
question7: Kungani abacwaningi becabanga ukuthi i-parthenogenesis yenzeka kuma-sawfish amancane asengozini yokuqothulwa?
answer7: Kungaba yindlela yokuguqula izinto ezisiza ukuvimbela ukuthi lolu hlobo lungashabalali
distractor7a: Kwandisa ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo ngaphezu kokuzala ngokocansi
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 34.1. Yisiphi isitatimende mayelana nokuzalana kwehhashi lasolwandle esinembile?
answer8: Insikazi ibekela amaqanda esikhwameni samaduna, lapho avundiswa khona futhi akhule khona.
distractor8a: Owesilisa ubekela amaqanda esikhwameni sabesifazane sokuzala
distractor8b: Amaqanda avundiswa kuphela ngemva kokuba echanyuselwe
distractor8c: Inzalo ikhula ngaphandle kwabazali ngokushesha ngemva kokukhulelwa

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.1 Izindlela Zokuzala | Ukuxhumana Nezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.1 Reproduction Methods | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluningi mayelana nezinhlelo ezahlukene zokuzala zezilwane alukho ngaphakathi kwe-AP®. Cishe ufunde ukuzala kwabantu enkambweni yezempilo noma enkambweni yebhayoloji yangaphambilini. Ukuzala kuyadingeka ukuze kusindiswe uhlobo oluthile, futhi izilwane ziye zathuthukisa amasu ahlukahlukene okuzala. Esahlukweni esedlule sifunde ukuthi ukuzala okungenabo ubulili nge-mitosis kukhiqiza izinto eziphilayo ezifana nezakhi zofuzo (ama-clone). Siphinde sahlola ngaphambilini ukuthi i-meiosis elandelwa ukuzala ngokocansi ikhiqiza kanjani inzalo ehluke ngezakhi zofuzo kubazali bayo. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi izinto ezikulesi sahluko ziyadingeka noma cha njengengxenye yenkambo yakho ye-AP®, kufanele uthole le mibono ithakazelisa futhi ifanele izimpilo zakho ngaphandle kweklasi.

 Zombili izindlela zokuzala ezingasebenzi ngokocansi kanye nezobulili zinezinzuzo kanye nokungalungi kwazo. Izinto eziphilayo ezizala ngokungasebenzisi ubulili—isibonelo, amabhaktheriya kanye namanye ama-eukaryotes—zingase zibe sengozini endaweni engazinzile noma engabikezeleki ngoba, ngaphandle kokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo, inzalo efanayo ingase ingabi nokwehluka okwanele kwezakhi zofuzo ukuze iphile ezimweni ezintsha noma ezahlukene. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, amazinga asheshayo okuzala okungenabo ubulili angavumela impendulo esheshayo ezimweni zemvelo ezishintshayo. Nakuba ukuzala ngokocansi kuvumela ukwehluka okukhulu kwezakhi zofuzo ebantwaneni, izinto eziphilayo ezizala ngokocansi kumele zigcine abesilisa nabesifazane emphakathini, okunganciphisa ikhono lokuhlala ezindaweni ezintsha zokuhlala.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka Lwekharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi olusekelwe ebholeni lokucwaninga, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 3
Izinhlelo zokuphila zigcina, zithola, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.A
Ulwazi oluzuzwa njengefa luhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kokuphila.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.2 Kuma-eukaryotes, ulwazi oluzuzwa njengefa ludluliselwa esizukulwaneni esilandelayo ngezinqubo ezifaka umjikelezo weseli kanye ne-mitosis noma i-meiosis kanye nokukhulelwa.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezehlakalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obuvezwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.9 Umfundi uyakwazi ukwakha incazelo, esebenzisa izethulo ezibonakalayo noma izindaba, mayelana nendlela i-DNA kuma-chromosome edluliselwa ngayo esizukulwaneni esilandelayo nge-mitosis, noma i-meiosis elandelwa ukukhuliswa.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.2 Kuma-eukaryotes, ulwazi oluzuzwa njengefa ludluliselwa esizukulwaneni esilandelayo ngezinqubo ezifaka umjikelezo weseli kanye ne-mitosis noma i-meiosis kanye nokukhuliswa.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
7.1 Umfundi angaxhumanisa izehlakalo namamodeli kuzo zonke izikali zendawo nezesikhathi.
Inhloso Yokufunda
3.10 Umfundi uyakwazi ukumela ukuxhumana phakathi kwe-meiosis kanye nokwanda kokwehlukahlukana kwezakhi zofuzo okudingekayo ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo
question1: Iyini inzuzo enkulu yokuzala ngaphandle kocansi?
answer1: Ivumela ukuzala okusheshayo nokukhula kwabantu
distractor1a: Ihlala ikhiqiza inzalo ehlukahlukene ngokwezakhi zofuzo
question2: Kungani ukuzala okungenabo ubulili kungaba yingozi ezindaweni ezingazinzile?
answer2: Inzalo efana ngezakhi zofuzo ingase ingabi noshintsho oludingekayo ukuze isinde ezinguqukweni zemvelo
distractor2c: Kuvimbela izinto eziphilayo ukuthi zingazalani ngokushesha
question3: Iyini inzuzo enkulu yokuzala ngokocansi?
answer3: Kwandisa ukwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwenzalo
distractor3c: Kuhlala kuphumela ekukhuleni okusheshayo kwenani labantu
question4: Kungani ukuzala ngokocansi kunganciphisa ukwakheka kwezindawo ezintsha zokuhlala?
answer4: Kudinga ukuthi abesilisa nabesifazane bagcinwe emphakathini
question5: Iyiphi inqubo ekhiqiza inzalo efana nezakhi zofuzo kuma-eukaryotes?
answer5: I-Mitosis
question6: Yikuphi ukuhlanganiswa kwezinqubo okukhiqiza inzalo ehlukene ngokwezakhi zofuzo?
answer6: I-Meiosis ilandelwa ukukhulelwa
question7: Ngokusho kwe-AP® Biology Learning Objective 3.10, i-meiosis inegalelo ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo ngokuyinhloko ngokuthi:
answer7: Ukwanda kokwehlukahlukana kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwenzalo
question8: Ngokusho kwe-AP® Biology Learning Objective 3.9, ulwazi oluzuzwa njengefa ludluliselwa esizukulwaneni esilandelayo ngokusebenzisa:
answer8: I-Mitosis noma i-meiosis elandelwa ukukhulelwa

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.1 Izindlela Zokuzala | Ukuzala Okungenabo Ubulili | Ukuhlukana
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.1 Reproduction Methods | Asexual Reproduction | Fission
chapterContent:
Ukuzala okungenabo ubulili kwenzeka kuma-microorganism e-prokaryotic (amagciwane) nakwezinye izinto eziphilayo ezine-eukaryotic eyodwa kanye nezine-cell eziningi. Kunezindlela eziningana izilwane ezizalana ngazo ngaphandle kobulili.

 Ukuhlukana
Ukuhlukana, okubizwa nangokuthi ukuhlukana kwe-binary, kwenzeka kuma-microorganism e-prokaryotic nakwezinye izinto eziphilayo ezingenamgogodla, ezinama-cell amaningi. Ngemva kwesikhathi sokukhula, into ephilayo ihlukana ibe izinto ezimbili ezihlukene. Ezinye izinto eziphilayo ezine-eukaryotic ezinamangqamuzana ahlukene zihlukana nge-binary by mitosis. Kwezinye izinto eziphilayo, ingxenye yomuntu ngamunye iyahlukana futhi yakhe umuntu wesibili. Le nqubo yenzeka, isibonelo, kuma-echinoderms amaningi e-asteroid ngokuhlukana kwe-central disk. Amanye ama-anemones olwandle kanye nama-polyps athile e-coral (Isithombe 34.2) nawo azala ngokuhlukana
question1: Kuyini ukuhlukana?
answer1: Uhlobo lokuzala okungenabo ubulili lapho into eyodwa ihlukana khona ibe izinto eziphilayo ezimbili ezihlukene
distractor1b: Inqubo lapho inzalo ikhula khona kusukela emaqandeni angavundiswanga
question2: Ukuhlukana kwe-binary kuvame ukwenzeka kuziphi izinto eziphilayo?
answer2: Ama-microorganisms e-Prokaryotic
question3: Amanye ama-eukaryote e-unicellular azala ngokuhlukana kwe-binary esebenzisa yiphi inqubo yeselula?
answer3: I-Mitosis
question4: Kwezinye izinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi, kwenzeka kanjani ukuhlukana?
answer4: Ingxenye yomuntu iyahlukana futhi ikhule ibe umuntu wesibili
distractor4a: Ama-gamete amabili ayahlangana ukuze akhe i-zygote
distractor4b: Ihlumela liyakheka futhi lihlala linamathele unomphela
distractor4c: Amaqanda akhishwa endaweni ezungezile ukuze avundiswe
question5: Yimaphi ama-echinoderms akhiqiza ngokungahambisani nobulili ngokuhlukana kwediski ephakathi?
answer5: Ama-echinoderms amaningi e-asteroid
question6: Yimaphi ama-cnidarians okukhulunywe ngawo endimeni angazala kabusha ngokuhlukana?
answer6: Ama-anemone olwandle kanye nama-polyp e-coral
question7: Uhlobo luni lokuzala kabusha oluyi-fission?
answer7: Ukuzala okungenabo ubulili
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 34.2. Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo eziboniswa zizalana ngokuhlukana?
answer8: Ama-polyp e-coral

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.1 Izindlela Zokuzala | Ukuzala Okungenabo Ubulili | Ukuhluma
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.1 Reproduction Methods | Asexual Reproduction | Budding
chapterContent:
Ukuzala okungenabo ubulili kwenzeka kuma-microorganisms e-prokaryotic (amabhaktheriya) nakwezinye izinto eziphilayo ezine-eukaryotic single cell kanye nama-multi-cell. Kunezindlela eziningana izilwane ezizalana ngazo ngaphandle kobulili.

 Ukuhluma
Ukuhluma kuyindlela yokuzala okungenabo ubulili ebangelwa ukukhula kwengxenye yeseli noma indawo yomzimba okuholela ekuhlukaneni kwezinto eziphilayo zokuqala zibe yizinhlobo ezimbili. Ukuhluma kwenzeka ngokuvamile kwezinye izilwane ezingenamgogodla ezifana nama-corals nama-hydras. Ku-hydras, ihlumela lakhiwa likhule libe ngumuntu omdala futhi lihlukane nomzimba oyinhloko, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.3, kanti ekuhlumeni kwama-coral, ihlumela alihlukani futhi liphindaphindeke njengengxenye yekoloni elisha.
question1: Kuyini ukuhluma?
answer1: Uhlobo lokuzala okungenabo ubulili lapho ukukhula okuphumayo kukhulela kumuntu omusha
distractor1b: Inqubo lapho isidalwa sihlukana khona sibe izingxenye ezimbili ezilinganayo
question2: Imiphumela yokuhluma evela ku:
answer2: Ukukhula kwengxenye yeseli noma isifunda somzimba
question3: Yiziphi izilwane ezivame ukuzala ngokuhluma?
answer3: Amakhorali nama-hydra
question4: Kwenzekani ku-bud eHydra?
answer4: Ikhula ibe umuntu omdala bese ihlukana nomzali
distractor4a: Ihlala inamathele futhi yakha ikoloni ehlala njalo
question5: Ukuhluma kwamakhorali kuhluke kanjani ekuhlumeni kwama-hydras?
answer5: Kumakhorali, ihlumela lihlala linamathele futhi lisiza ekwakheni ikoloni
distractor5a: Amahlumela e-coral ayahlukana ngokushesha ngemva kokwakheka
distractor5b: Amahlumela e-hydra adinga umanyolo ngaphambi kokuba akhule
distractor5c: Ama-Hydra azala ngokocansi, kanti amakhorali azala ngokungahambisani nocansi
question6: Hlobo luni lokuzala oluqhakaza?
answer6: Ukuzala okungenabo ubulili
question7: Iyini inzuzo yokuhluma?
answer7: Ivumela ukukhiqizwa okusheshayo kwenzalo efana nezakhi zofuzo
distractor7a: Kwandisa ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo ngokuhlanganiswa kabusha
distractor7c: Ihlala ikhiqiza inzalo ehlukile ngokwezakhi zofuzo
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 34.3. Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kahle ukuhluma kwe-Hydra?
answer8: Ihlumela likhula kumzali, likhule libe umuntu omdala, bese ekugcineni lihlukana
distractor8a: Umzali uhlukaniswa abe abantu ababili abalinganayo ngobukhulu
distractor8b: Ihlumela lihlala linamathele unomphela ukuze lakhe ikoloni

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.1 Izindlela Zokuzala | Ukuzala Okungenabo Ubulili | Ukuhlukana
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.1 Reproduction Methods | Asexual Reproduction | Fragmentation
chapterContent:
Ukuzala okungenabo ubulili kwenzeka kuma-microorganisms e-prokaryotic (amabhaktheriya) nakwezinye izinto eziphilayo ezine-eukaryotic single cell kanye nama-multi-cell. Kunezindlela eziningi izilwane ezizalana ngazo ngaphandle kobulili.

 Ukuhlukana
Ukuhlukana ukuhlukaniswa komzimba ube izingxenye ezimbili ngokuvuselelwa okulandelayo. Uma isilwane sikwazi ukuhlukana, futhi ingxenye inkulu ngokwanele, umuntu ohlukile uzophinde akhule.

 Isibonelo, ezinkanyezini eziningi zasolwandle, ukuzala okungenabo ubulili kwenziwa ngokuhlukana. Isithombe 34.4 sibonisa inkanyezi yasolwandle lapho ingalo yomuntu ngamunye iphulwa khona bese ivuselela inkanyezi entsha yasolwandle. Izisebenzi zokudoba zaziwa ngokuzama ukubulala izinkanyezi zasolwandle zidla imibhede yazo ye-clam noma ye-oyster ngokuzisika phakathi bese ziphinde ziphonse olwandle. Ngeshwa kubasebenzi, lezi zingxenye ezimbili zingavuselela ingxenye entsha ngayinye, okuholela ezinkanyezini zasolwandle eziphindwe kabili ukuze zibambe ama-oyster nama-clam. Ukuhlukana kwenzeka nasezibungu ze-annelid, ama-turbellarian, kanye nama-poriferans.
Qaphela ukuthi ekuqhekekeni, ngokuvamile kunomehluko obonakalayo ngobukhulu babantu ngabanye, kanti ekuqhekekeni, kwakheka abantu ababili abanobukhulu obufanayo.
question1: Kuyini ukuqhekeka?
answer1: Uhlobo lokuzala okungenabo ucansi lapho umzimba uqhekeka ube yizicucu eziphinde zikhule zibe abantu abasha
distractor1b: Inqubo lapho ihlumela likhula futhi lihlukana khona
distractor1c: Inqubo lapho into ephilayo ihlukana khona ibe abantu ababili abalinganayo ngobukhulu
question2: Ukuze ukuqhekeka kukhiqize umuntu omusha, lesi siqeshana kumele:
answer2: Yiba mkhulu ngokwanele ukuvuselela izingxenye ezingekho
question3: Yisiphi isilwane esivame ukusetshenziswa njengesibonelo sokuqhekeka?
answer3: Inkanyezi yolwandle
question4: Kungani ukunqunywa kwezinkanyezi zasolwandle phakathi kwehlulekile ukunciphisa inani lazo emibhedeni yama-oyster?
answer4: Ingxenye ngayinye yaphinde yazalwa yaba inkanyezi yolwandle ephelele
distractor4b: Ingxenye eyodwa kuphela eyasinda kanti enye yafa
distractor4c: Izinkanyezi zasolwandle zazalana ngokocansi ngemva kokunqunywa
question5: Ngaphandle kwezinkanyezi zasolwandle, ukuqhekeka kwenzeka futhi ku:
answer5: Izimpethu ze-Annelid, ama-turbellarian, nama-poriferans
distractor5b: Izinhlanzi, izilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini, kanye nezinambuzane kuphela
question6: Uyini umehluko omkhulu phakathi kokuqhekeka nokuqhekeka?
answer6: Ukuqhekeka kuvame ukukhiqiza izingcezu ezinobukhulu obungalingani, kanti ukuqhekeka kukhiqiza abantu ababili abanobukhulu obufanayo.
distractor6a: Ukuhlukana kungokobulili, kanti ukuhlukana akusikho ngokobulili
distractor6b: Ukuqhekeka kwenzeka kuphela kumabhaktheriya, kanti ukuqhekeka kwenzeka ezilwaneni kuphela
distractor6c: Ukuhlukana kudinga ukukhulelwa, kanti ukuhlukana akudingi
question7: Iyiphi inqubo yezinto eziphilayo evumela izingcezu ukuba zibe izinto eziphilayo eziphelele?
answer7: Ukuvuselelwa kabusha
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 34.4. Lesi sithombe sibonisani ngokukhiqizwa kwezinkanyezi zasolwandle?
answer8: Ingalo ehlukanisiwe ingaphinde ikhule ibe yinkanyezi entsha yolwandle ngokuqhekeka
distractor8b: Izinkanyezi zasolwandle zizalana kuphela ngomanyolo wangaphandle
distractor8c: Ingalo ehlukanisiwe ayikwazi ukusinda ngaphandle kwediski ephakathi

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.1 Izindlela Zokuzala | Ukuzala Okungenabo Ubulili | I-Parthenogenesis
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.1 Reproduction Methods | Asexual Reproduction | Parthenogenesis
chapterContent:
Ukuzala okungenabo ubulili kwenzeka kuma-microorganisms e-prokaryotic (amagciwane) nakwezinye izinto eziphilayo ezine-eukaryotic single cell kanye nama-multi-cell. Kunezindlela eziningana izilwane ezizalana ngazo ngaphandle kobulili.

 I-Parthenogenesis
I-Parthenogenesis iwuhlobo lokuzala okungenabo ubulili lapho iqanda likhula libe umuntu ophelele ngaphandle kokukhulelwa. Inzalo ephumayo ingaba yi-haploid noma i-diploid, kuye ngenqubo kanye nohlobo. I-Parthenogenesis yenzeka ezilwaneni ezingenamgogodla njengezinambuzane zamanzi, ama-rotifers, ama-aphid, izinambuzane ezinamathelayo, ezinye izintuthwane, ama-wasps, nezinyosi. Izinyosi nama-wasps zisebenzisa i-parthenogenesis ukukhiqiza amaduna e-haploid (abizwa ngokuthi ama-drones). Uma iqanda livundiswa, likhula njengensikazi ye-diploid.

 Ezinye izilwane ezine-vertebrate—njengezinye izilwane ezihuquzelayo, ama-amphibians, nezinhlanzi—nazo zizalana nge-parthenogenesis. Nakuba zivame kakhulu ezitshalweni, i-parthenogenesis iye yabonwa ezinhlotsheni zezilwane ezahlukaniswa ngobulili ezindaweni zoo zasemhlabeni noma zasolwandle. Amadragoni amabili esifazane eKomodo, ushaka we-hammerhead, kanye noshaka we-blacktop akhiqize amathole angenawo amandla lapho abesifazane behlukaniswe nabesilisa.
question1: Kuyini i-parthenogenesis?
answer1: Uhlobo lokuzala okungenabo ubulili lapho iqanda likhula libe umuntu ngaphandle kokukhulelwa
distractor1a: Uhlobo lokuzala ngokocansi oluhilela ukukhulelwa kwangaphandle
distractor1b: Uhlobo lokuhluma lapho isidalwa esisha sikhula khona sisuka kumzali
distractor1c: Inqubo lapho abantu ababili beshintshana khona ngezinto zofuzo
question2: Inzalo ekhiqizwa yi-parthenogenesis ingaba:
answer2: Kungaba yi-haploid noma i-diploid, kuye ngohlobo kanye nenqubo
question3: Yiliphi iqembu elivame ukusebenzisa i-parthenogenesis ukukhiqiza ama-haploid male abizwa ngokuthi ama-drone?
answer3: Izinyosi kanye nezinyovu
question4: Ezinyosini kanye nasezinyokeni, yini ekhula eqandeni elivundisiwe?
answer4: Owesifazane one-diploid
question5: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungafakwanga ohlwini lwezilwane ezingenamgogodla ezizalana nge-parthenogenesis?
answer5: Izimpethu zomhlaba
question6: I-Parthenogenesis nayo ibonwe kumaqembu ezilwane ezinomgogodla?
answer6: Ezinye izilwane ezihuquzelayo, izilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini, kanye nezinhlanzi
question7: Kungani ukubonwa kwe-parthenogenesis ezilwaneni ze-zoo kwakubalulekile?
answer7: Abesifazane babezala abantwana naphezu kokuhlukaniswa kwabesilisa
distractor7c: Abesifazane babedinga isidoda esigcinwe izizukulwane eziningi
question8: Yisiphi kulezi zilwane ezilandelayo okukhulunywe ngazo endimeni esiveze inzalo ye-parthenogenetic?
answer8: Udrako we-Komodo

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.1 Izindlela Zokuzala | Ukuzala Ngocansi
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.1 Reproduction Methods | Sexual Reproduction
chapterContent: Ukuzala ngokocansi kuyinhlanganisela yamaseli okuzala (ngokuvamile ama-haploid) avela kubantu ababili ukuze akhe inzalo yesithathu (ngokuvamile i-diploid) eyingqayizivele. Ukuzala ngokocansi kukhiqiza inzalo enezinhlanganisela ezintsha zezakhi zofuzo. Lokhu kungaba yinzuzo eguquguqukayo ezindaweni ezingazinzile noma ezingalindelekile. Njengabantu, sijwayele ukucabanga ngezilwane njengezinobulili obuhlukene obubili—owesilisa nowesifazane—ezinqunywa ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa. Kodwa-ke, embusweni wezilwane, kunezinhlobo eziningi zalesi sihloko
question1: Kuyini ukuzala ngokocansi?
answer1: Ukuhlanganiswa kwamaseli okuzala avela kubantu ababili ukuze kukhiqizwe inzalo eyingqayizivele ngokwezakhi zofuzo
distractor1a: Ukukhiqizwa kwenzalo efana nezakhi zofuzo nge-mitosis
distractor1c: Ukuhlukaniswa kwesidalwa esisodwa sibe abantu ababili abalinganayo
question2: Amaseli okuzala ahilelekile ekuzaleni ngokocansi ngokuvamile yilawa:
answer2: I-Haploid
question3: Inzalo ekhiqizwa ngokuzala ngokocansi ivame ukuba:
answer3: I-Diploid
question4: Kungani ukuzala ngokocansi kwandisa ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer4: Ikhiqiza inzalo ngenhlanganisela entsha yezakhi zofuzo
distractor4b: Kuvimbela ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ukuthi kungenzeki
question5: Kungani ukuzala ngokocansi kungaba yinzuzo eguquguqukayo?
answer5: Ukwehlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo kwandisa amathuba okuthi ezinye izingane zizosinda ezindaweni ezishintshayo
distractor5c: Ikhiqiza inzalo ngokushesha kakhulu kunokuzala okungenabo ubulili
question6: Kubantu, ubulili buvame ukunqunywa:
answer6: Ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa
question7: Ngokusho kwendima, bangaki ubulili abantu abavame ukuba nabo?
answer7: Okubili: owesilisa nowesifazane
question8: Ithini indima ngokunqunywa kobulili embusweni wezilwane?
answer8: Izilwane eziningi zibonisa ukwehluka okungaphezu kohlelo olujwayelekile lwesilisa nolwesifazane olutholakala kubantu
distractor8b: Zonke izinhlobo zezilwane zinobulili obubodwa kuphela

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.1 Izindlela Zokuzala | Ukuzala Ngocansi | I-Hermaphroditism
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.1 Reproduction Methods | Sexual Reproduction | Hermaphroditism
chapterContent: I-Hermaphroditism yenzeka ezilwaneni lapho umuntu oyedwa enezingxenye zokuzala zesilisa nezesifazane. Izilwane ezingenamgogodla njengemibungu yomhlaba, ama-slugs, ama-tapeworm kanye neminenke, eziboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.5, zivame ukuba yi-hermaphrodites. Ama-Hermaphrodites angazizalela noma angahlangana nolunye uhlobo lwawo, avundiselane futhi zombili zizale inzalo. Ukuzizalela kuvamile ezilwaneni ezinokunyakaza okulinganiselwe noma ezingashukumi, njenge-barnacles kanye ne-clams
question1: Kuyini i-hermaphroditism?
answer1: Isimo lapho umuntu oyedwa enezitho zokuzala zowesilisa nowesifazane
distractor1b: Isu lokuzala elihilela abantu besilisa kuphela
question2: Yisiphi kulezi zilwane ezilandelayo esivame ukuba yi-hermaphroditic?
answer2: Isibungu somhlaba
question3: Yisiphi kulezi zilwane ezilandelayo okukhulunywe ngazo endimeni esingavami ukuba yi-hermaphroditic?
answer3: Ihhashi Lasolwandle
question4: I-hermaphrodites ingazalana kanjani?
answer4: Ngokuzizalela noma ngokuzalana nomunye umuntu
question5: Uma ama-hermaphrodite amabili ehlangana, yini evame ukwenzeka?
answer5: Ziyavundisana futhi zombili zingaveza inzalo
question6: Kungani ukuzivundisa kuvamile kwezinye izilwane eziphila ngendlela ehlukile?
answer6: Ngoba zinokuhamba okulinganiselwe noma azikwazi ukuhamba
question7: Yiziphi izilwane okukhulunywe ngazo endimeni ezivame ukuzivundisa ngoba zinokuhamba okulinganiselwe?
answer7: Ama-Barnacle nama-clams
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 34.5. Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo eziboniswe njengezibonelo zezilwane eziphila ngezinye izilwane?
answer8: Iminenke

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.1 Izindlela Zokuzala | Ukunquma Ubulili
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.1 Reproduction Methods | Sex Determination
chapterContent:
Ukunqunywa kobulili bezilwane ezincelisayo kunqunywa ngokwezakhi zofuzo ngokuba khona kwama-chromosomes ka-X no-Y. Abantu abane-homozygous ku-X (XX) bangabesifazane kanti abantu abane-heterozygous (XY) bangabesilisa. Ukuba khona kwe-chromosome ka-Y kubangela ukuthuthukiswa kwezici zesilisa futhi ukungabikho kwayo kuphumela ezicini zesifazane. Uhlelo lwe-XY lutholakala nakwezinye izinambuzane nezitshalo.

 Ukunqunywa kobulili bezinyoni kuncike ekubeni khona kwama-chromosomes ka-Z no-W. I-Homozygous ku-Z (ZZ) iphumela kowesilisa kanti i-heterozygous (ZW) iphumela kowesifazane. I-W ibonakala ibalulekile ekunqumeni ubulili bomuntu ngamunye, njenge-chromosome ka-Y ezincelisayo. Ezinye izinhlanzi, izilwane ezinamagobolondo, izinambuzane (ezifana nezimvemvane namabhu), kanye nezilwane ezihuquzelayo zisebenzisa lolu hlelo.

 Ubulili bezinye izinhlobo abunqunywa yizakhi zofuzo kodwa bunqunywa yisici esithile sendawo. Ukunqunywa kobulili kwezinye izingwenya nezimfudu, isibonelo, kuvame ukuncika ekushiseni ngezikhathi ezibalulekile zokukhula kwamaqanda. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukunqunywa kobulili bemvelo, noma ikakhulukazi njengokunqunywa kobulili obuxhomeke ekushiseni. Kwamanye ama-turtle, amazinga okushisa apholile ngesikhathi sokufukamela amaqanda akhiqiza abesilisa kanti amazinga okushisa afudumele akhiqiza amantombazane. Kwamanye ama-crocodile, amazinga okushisa aphakathi akhiqiza abesilisa kanti amazinga okushisa afudumele napholile akhiqiza amantombazane. Kwamanye ama-crocodile, ubulili buxhomeke ekuzalweni nasekushiseni.

 Abantu bezinye izinhlobo bashintsha ubulili babo phakathi nokuphila kwabo, beshintshana phakathi kwabesilisa nabesifazane. Uma umuntu engowesifazane kuqala, kuthiwa yi-protogyny noma insikazi yokuqala,” uma kungumuntu wesilisa kuqala, kubizwa ngokuthi yi-protandry noma insikazi yokuqala.” Ama-oyster, isibonelo, azalwa eyisilisa, akhula, abe yinsikazi futhi abeke amaqanda; ezinye izinhlobo zama-oyster zishintsha ubulili izikhathi eziningi.

 Izinga lokushisa ngesikhathi sokufukamela linquma ubulili bama-loggerhead sea turtles ngenkathi ekhula emaqandeni awo. Uma izinga lokushisa lifudumele ngokwanele, wonke azoba ngabesifazane. Uma izinga lokushisa lipholile, wonke azoba ngabesilisa. Uma izinga lokushisa lilungile, elibizwa ngokuthi izinga lokushisa elibalulekile, khona-ke kuzoba cishe abesifazane abayingxenye kanye nabesilisa abayingxenye.
Izinhlobo eziningi zezitshalo, kuhlanganise ne-sunflower eboniswe lapha, ziyakwazi ukuzivundisa. Uma ukuvundisa kungenzeki ngosizo lwezinambuzane ezivundisa impova, ukucwaswa kwembali kuzozimboza ngempova yembali efanayo. Nakuba ukuzivundisa kudala imbewu nge-meiosis, zonke izitshalo eziphumayo zizofana. Ngamanye amazwi, ukuzivundisa kunciphisa ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzaliswa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.2 Ukuvundisa | Ukuxhumana Nezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.2 Fertilization | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ukuzala ngokocansi kuqala ngokuhlanganiswa kwesidoda neqanda enqubweni ebizwa ngokuthi ukukhulelwa. Izindlela zokukhulelwa ezichazwe kulesi sigaba azikho ngaphakathi kwesilinganiso se-AP®. Kodwa-ke, ngokombono wokuziphendukela kwemvelo, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi izilwane zibonisa izindlela zokukhulelwa kwangaphandle kanye nokukhulelwa kwangaphakathi, okungenzeka kunqunywe yindawo ezikuyo. Ezindaweni zasemanzini, amanzi adlulisela isidoda eqandeni (njengasezinhlanzini nasezilwanyaneni), kodwa ezilwaneni eziningi zasemhlabeni (njengezilwane ezihuquzelayo, izinyoni, nezilwane ezincelisayo), ukukhulelwa kwenzeka ngaphakathi. Ukuguqulwa kweqanda elinegobolondo (i-amniote) elinezimbotshana ezingaphandle kwe-embryonic ezilwanyaneni nezinyoni kuvumela inzalo ukuba ikhule ezimweni ezihambisana nomhlaba, ikakhulukazi ukuntuleka kwamanzi. Izilwane ezincelisayo ze-placenta, okuhlanganisa nabantu, zigcina umbungu emzimbeni wowesifazane kuze kube yilapho ezalwa.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe kulesi sigaba azikho ngaphakathi kwesilinganiso se-AP® futhi azihambisani noHlaka Lwezifundo

answer2: Izindawo zasemanzini

distractor3c: Amanzi avumela amaqanda ukuba akhule ngaphandle kwesidoda

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzaliswa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.2 Ukuvundisa | Ukuvundisa Kwangaphandle
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.2 Fertilization | External Fertilization
chapterContent:
Ukukhulelwa kwangaphandle kuvame ukwenzeka ezindaweni zasemanzini lapho amaqanda nesidoda kukhishwa khona emanzini. Ngemva kokuba isidoda sifike eqandeni, ukukhulelwa kwenzeka. Ukukhulelwa kwangaphandle okuningi kwenzeka ngesikhathi senqubo yokuzala lapho owesifazane oyedwa noma abaningi bekhulula amaqanda abo kanye nesilisa (abesilisa) bekhulula isidoda endaweni efanayo, ngesikhathi esifanayo. Ukukhululwa kwezinto zokuzala kungase kubangelwe ukushisa kwamanzi noma ubude bokukhanya kwelanga. Cishe zonke izinhlanzi ziyazala, njengoba kwenza ama-crustacean (njengezinkalankala nama-shrimp), ama-mollusk (njenge-oyster), i-squid, kanye nama-echinoderms (njenge-sea urchins kanye nama-sea cucumber). Isithombe 34.8 sibonisa ukuzala kwe-salmon emfudlaneni ongajulile. Amaxoxo, njengalawo aboniswe ku-Figure 34.9, nawo ayazala.

 Amabhangqa ezinhlanzi angasakazwa angabonisa ukuziphatha kokuthandana. Lokhu kuvumela owesifazane ukuthi akhethe eyeduna ethile. Isiqalo sokukhululwa kweqanda nesidoda (ukuzala) sibangela ukuthi iqanda nesidoda kubekwe endaweni encane, okwandisa amathuba okukhulelwa.

 Ukukhulelwa kwangaphandle endaweni yasemanzini kuvikela amaqanda ekubeni ome. Ukuzala okusakazekile kungabangela ingxube enkulu yezakhi zofuzo eqenjini, okuholela ekuhlukeni okuphezulu kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nethuba elikhulu lokusinda kwezinhlobo endaweni enonya. Eziphilayo zasemanzini ezithambile njengeziponji, ukuzala okusakazekile kuyindlela kuphela yokukhulelwa nokufakwa kwamakoloni ezindaweni ezintsha. Ukuba khona kwamaqanda avundisiwe kanye nokukhula kwamancane emanzini kunikeza amathuba okudliwa okuholela ekulahlekelweni kwenzalo. Ngakho-ke, izigidi zamaqanda kumele zikhiqizwe ngabantu ngabanye, futhi inzalo ekhiqizwa ngale ndlela kumele ivuthwe ngokushesha. Izinga lokusinda kwamaqanda akhiqizwa ngokuzala okusakazekile liphansi.

answer2: Ukukhishwa kwamaqanda kanye nesidoda endaweni efanayo ngesikhathi esisodwa

answer4: Inhlanzi

distractor6c: Amanzi avumela amaqanda ukuthi akhule ngaphandle kokuvundisa

answer7: Ngoba amaqanda amaningi kanye nezinsana ziyalahleka ngenxa yokuzingela, okuholela esilinganisweni esiphansi sokusinda

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzaliswa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.2 Ukuvundisa | Ukuvundisa Kwangaphakathi
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.2 Fertilization | Internal Fertilization
chapterContent:
Ukukhulelwa kwangaphakathi kwenzeka kakhulu ezilwaneni ezisemhlabeni, nakuba ezinye izilwane zasemanzini nazo zisebenzisa le ndlela. Kunezindlela ezintathu inzalo ekhiqizwa ngazo ngemva kokukhulelwa kwangaphakathi. Emaqanda avundisiwe, amaqanda avundisiwe abekwa ngaphandle komzimba wesifazane futhi akhule lapho, ethola ukudla okuvela ebhodweni eliyingxenye yeqanda. Lokhu kwenzeka ezinhlanzini eziningi ezinamathambo, ezihuquzelayo eziningi, kwezinye izinhlanzi ezinezinhlungu, eziningi zezilwane eziphila emanzini, izilwane ezincelisayo ezimbili, kanye nazo zonke izinyoni. Izilwane ezihuquzelayo nezinambuzane zikhiqiza amaqanda anesikhumba, kuyilapho izinyoni nezimfudu zikhiqiza amaqanda ane-calcium carbonate ephezulu egobolondweni, okwenza aqine. Amaqanda enkukhu ayisibonelo salolu hlobo lwesibili.

 Emaqanda avundisiwe, amaqanda avundisiwe agcinwa kwensikazi, kodwa umbungu uthola ukudla kwawo ebhodweni leqanda kanti amaphuphu akhula ngokugcwele lapho echanyuselwa. Lokhu kwenzeka kwezinye izinhlanzi ezinamathambo (njenge-guppy Lebistes reticulatus), ezinye oshaka, ezinye izibankwa, ezinye izinyoka (njengenyoka i-garter Thamnophis sirtalis), ezinye izinyoka, kanye nezinye izilwane ezingenamgogodla (njenge-Madagascar hissing cockroach Gromphadorhina portentosa).

 Ekuphileni, izingane ezincane zikhula ngaphakathi kwensikazi, zithola ukondliwa egazini likamama nge-placenta. Inzalo ikhula kwensikazi futhi izalwe iphila. Lokhu kwenzeka ezincelisayo eziningi, kwezinye izinhlanzi ezinezinhlungu, kanye nezilwane ezimbalwa ezihuquzelayo.

 Ukukhulelwa kwangaphakathi kunenzuzo yokuvikela iqanda elivundisiwe ekuphelelweni amanzi emzimbeni emhlabeni. I-embryo ihlukaniswe ngaphakathi kwensikazi, okunciphisa ukudla kwabantwana. Ukukhulelwa kwangaphakathi kuthuthukisa ukukhulelwa kwamaqanda yindoda ethile. Zimbalwa izingane ezikhiqizwa ngale ndlela, kodwa izinga lokusinda kwazo liphakeme kunelokukhulelwa kwangaphandle.

answer1: Ukukhulelwa okwenzeka emzimbeni wesifazane
question2: Uma iqanda likhula, umbungu osakhula uthola kanjani ukudla okunempilo?
answer2: Kusukela ku-yolk equkethwe ngaphakathi kweqanda

answer3: Ukuqina kwesisu

answer4: Iqanda eliphuzi ngenkathi iqanda ligcinwa ngaphakathi kwensikazi

answer5: Ukuphila kahle

answer6: Izilwane ezincelisayo

answer7: Kuvikela iqanda elivundisiwe ekuphelelweni amanzi emzimbeni futhi kunciphisa ukudla kwe-embryo
distractor7c: Kuhlala kuphumela ezizukulwaneni ezifanayo ngokwezakhi zofuzo
question8: Uma kuqhathaniswa nokukhulelwa kwangaphandle, ukukhulelwa kwangaphakathi ngokuvamile kuphumela ku:
answer8: Inzalo encane enesilinganiso esiphezulu sokusinda
distractor8b: Inani elifanayo lenzalo enesilinganiso esifanayo sokusinda

answer9: Ukuqina kwe-Ovoviparity
question10: Yisiphi isitatimende esiqhathanisa kahle i-oviparity, i-ovoviparity, kanye ne-viviparity?
answer10: Ama-embryo e-oviparous akhula ngaphandle kwensikazi, ama-embryo e-ovoviviparous akhula ngaphakathi kwensikazi esebenzisa i-yolk, kanti ama-embryo e-viviparous athola izakhamzimba kumama nge-placenta.
distractor10a: Zonke izindlela ezintathu zihilela umbungu ukuthola izakhamzimba ezivela ku-placenta
distractor10b: Izilwane ezizala amaqanda kuphela ezivundiswa ngaphakathi
distractor10c: Ama-embryo e-ovoviviparous akhula ngaphandle kwensikazi ngemva kokukhulelwa

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzalela Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.2 Ukuvundisa | Ukuvela Kokuzalela
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.2 Fertilization | The Evolution of Reproduction
chapterContent:
Lapho izinto eziphilayo eziningi sezivele zavela futhi zakha amaseli akhethekile, ezinye zakha nezicubu nezitho ezinemisebenzi ekhethekile. Ukukhula kokuqala kokuzala kwenzeka kuma-Annelids. Lezi zinto eziphilayo zikhiqiza isidoda namaqanda kusuka kumaseli angahlukanisiwe ku-coelom yazo futhi ziwagcine kulowo mgodi. Lapho i-coelom igcwala, amaseli akhishwa ngokuvulwa komchamo noma ngokwahlukana komzimba. Izitho zokuzala zavela ngokuthuthukiswa kwama-gonad akhiqiza isidoda namaqanda. Lawa maseli adlula ku-meiosis, i-adaptation ye-mitosis, eyanciphisa inani lama-chromosome kuseli ngalinye lokuzala ngesigamu, ngenkathi ikhulisa inani lamaseli ngokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli.

 Izinhlelo zokuzala eziphelele zakhiwa ezinambuzaneni, ezinobulili obuhlukile. Isidoda senziwa kuma-testes bese sihamba ngamapayipi ahlanganisiwe siye ku-epididymis ukuze sigcinwe. Amaqanda avuthwa esibelethweni. Lapho ekhishwa esibelethweni, aya emapayipini esibelethweni ukuze akhulelwe. Ezinye izinambuzane zinesikhwama esikhethekile, esibizwa ngokuthi i-spermatheca, esigcina isidoda ukuze sisetshenziswe kamuva, ngezinye izikhathi kuze kube unyaka. Ukuvundisa kunganqunywa ngezimo zemvelo noma zokudla ezifanele kakhulu ukusinda kwenzalo.

 Izilwane ezinethambo lomgogodla zinezakhiwo ezifanayo, kanye nomehluko omncane. Izilwane ezingezona izilwane ezincelisayo, njengezinyoni nezilwane ezihuquzelayo, zinesikhala somzimba esivamile, esibizwa ngokuthi i-cloaca, sezinhlelo zokugaya ukudla, zokukhipha indle kanye nezokuzala. Ukuhlangana phakathi kwezinyoni kuvame ukuhilela ukubeka izikhala ze-cloaca zibhekene ukuze kudluliselwe isidoda. Izilwane ezincelisayo zinezikhala ezihlukene zezinhlelo zesifazane kanye nesibeletho sokusekela inzalo ekhulayo. Isibeletho sinezindawo ezimbili zezinhlobo ezikhiqiza inani elikhulu lenzalo ngesikhathi, kuyilapho izinhlobo ezikhiqiza inzalo eyodwa, njengezilwane ezincane, zinesizalo esisodwa.

 Ukudluliswa kwesidoda kusuka kwesilisa kuya kwesifazane ngesikhathi sokuzala kusukela ekukhipheni isidoda endaweni enamanzi ukuze kuvundiswe ngaphandle, kuya ekuhlanganisweni kwe-cloaca ezinyonini, kuya ekuthuthukisweni kwepenisi ukuze kuthunyelwe ngqo esithweni sangasese sowesifazane ezincelisayo.
question1: Yayiyini intuthuko yokuqala yokuziphendukela kwemvelo ekuzaleni izilwane?

answer7: Indawo evamile yokungena kwezinhlelo zokugaya ukudla, zokukhipha indle, kanye nezokuzala

question10: Yikuphi ukulandelana okumelela ukuqhubeka kokuziphendukela kwemvelo kwezindlela zokudlulisa isidoda ezichazwe endimeni?
answer10: Ukukhulelwa kwangaphandle emanzini → ukuthintana kwezinyoni nge-cloacal → ipenisi yokukhulelwa kwangaphakathi ezincelisayo

chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluningi kulesi sigaba alukho ngaphakathi kwesilinganiso se-AP®. Awudingi ukufanisa uhlu lwezici ezahlukene zomzimba wezinhlelo zokuzala zesilisa nezesifazane nemisebenzi yazo, kodwa cishe uzothola ulwazi olufanele. Izakhiwo zokuzala ezavela ezilwaneni zasemhlabeni, okuhlanganisa nabantu, zivumela abesilisa nabesifazane ukuthi bahlangane, bavundise ngaphakathi, futhi basekele ukukhula nokukhula kwenzalo. Lesi sigaba sinikeza ithuba lokubukeza inqubo ye-meiosis esiyihlole okokuqala esahlukweni esedlule.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka Lwezifundo Zebhayoloji lwe-AP®. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 3
Izinhlelo zokuphila zigcina, zithole, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.A
Ulwazi oluzuzwa njengefa luhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kokuphila.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.2 Kuma-eukaryotes, ulwazi oluzuzwa njengefa ludluliselwa esizukulwaneni esilandelayo ngezinqubo ezifaka umjikelezo weseli kanye ne-mitosis noma i-meiosis kanye nokukhulelwa.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezehlakalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obuvezwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.

3.9 Umfundi uyakwazi ukwakha incazelo, esebenzisa izethulo ezibonakalayo noma izindaba, mayelana nendlela i-DNA kuma-chromosome edluliselwa ngayo esizukulwaneni esilandelayo nge-mitosis, noma i-meiosis elandelwa ukukhulelwa.

chapterContent: Izicubu zokuzala zabantu besilisa nabesifazane zikhula ngendlela efanayo esibelethweni kuze kube yilapho izinga eliphansi le-testosterone ye-hormone likhishwa kuma-gonad wesilisa. I-Testosterone ibangela ukuthi izicubu ezingakakhuli zihlukane zibe izitho zobulili zesilisa. Uma i-testosterone ingekho, izicubu zikhula zibe izicubu zobulili zesilisa. Ama-gonad okuqala aba ama-testes noma ama-ovari. Izicubu ezikhiqiza ipenisi kwabesilisa zikhiqiza i-clitoris kwabesifazane. Izicubu ezizoba yi-scrotum kwabesilisa ziba yi-labia kwabesifazane; okungukuthi, ziyizakhiwo ezifanayo
question1: Ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kombungu ekuqaleni, izicubu zokuzala zabesilisa nabesifazane ziqala kanje:

question3: Kwenzekani uma i-testosterone ingekho ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kombungu?
answer3: Izicubu zikhula zibe izakhiwo zokuzala zabesifazane
distractor3c: Ama-gonad ahlala engahlukanisiwe kukho konke ukuphila

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.3 I-Anatomy Yokuzala Komuntu kanye Nokukhiqizwa Kwe-Gametogenesis | I-Anatomy Yokuzala Komuntu | I-Anatomy Yokuzala Komuntu Yabesilisa
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.3 Human Reproductive Anatomy and Gametogenesis | Human Reproductive Anatomy | Male Reproductive Anatomy
chapterContent:
Esimisweni sokuzala sabesilisa, i-scrotum igcina ama-testicle noma ama-testes (okukodwa: ama-testis), okuhlanganisa nokunikeza indlela yemithambo yegazi, imizwa, kanye nemisipha ehlobene nomsebenzi wama-testicular. Ama-testes ayizitho ezimbili zokuzala zabesilisa ezikhiqiza isidoda kanye nama-hormone athile okuzala. I-testis ngayinye inobukhulu obungaba ngu-2.5 ngo-3.8 cm (1.5 ngo-1 in) futhi ihlukaniswe ngama-lobules anomumo wedge yizicubu ezixhumanisayo ezibizwa ngokuthi i-septa. Ku-wedge ngayinye kukhona ama-tubules aqinile akhiqiza isidoda.

 Isidoda asishukumi ekushiseni komzimba; ngakho-ke, i-scrotum kanye ne-penis kungaphandle komzimba, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.10 ukuze kugcinwe izinga lokushisa elifanele lokunyakaza. Ezilwaneni ezincelisayo zasemhlabeni, ama-testes amabili kumele amiswe ngaphandle komzimba cishe ngo-2° C ngaphansi kokushisa komzimba ukuze akhiqize isidoda esiphilayo. Ukungazali kungenzeka ezincelisayo zasemhlabeni lapho ama-testes engehli ngesisu ngesikhathi sokukhula kwengane.

 Isidoda sivuthwa kuma-seminiferous tubules ahlanganiswe ngaphakathi kwama-testes, njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 34.10. Izindonga zama-seminiferous tubules zakhiwe ngamaseli esidoda asathuthuka, lapho isidoda singakakhuli kahle khona eduze kwe-tubule kanye nesidoda esikhule ngokugcwele ku-lumen. Amaseli esidoda axutshwa namaseli e-nurmaid abizwa ngokuthi amaseli e-Sertoli avikela amaseli egciwane futhi akhuthaze ukukhula kwawo. Amanye amaseli axutshwe odongeni lwama-tubules amaseli angaphakathi kwe-Leydig. Lawa maseli akhiqiza amazinga aphezulu e-testosterone uma owesilisa efika ebusheni.

 Lapho isidoda sesikhule i-flagella futhi sesicishe sivuthiwe, sishiya amasende bese singena kwi-epididymis, eboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.10. Lesi sakhiwo sifana ne-comma futhi silele engxenyeni ephezulu nengemuva yama-testes; yindawo yokuvuthwa kwesidoda. Isidoda sishiya i-epididymis bese singena kuma-vas deferens (noma ama-ductus deferens), athwala isidoda, ngemuva kwesinye, bese sakha i-ejaculatory duct ene-duct evela kuma-seminal vesicles. Ngesikhathi se-vasectomy, ingxenye yama-vas deferens iyasuswa, ivimbela isidoda ukuthi siphume emzimbeni ngesikhathi sokukhipha isisu futhi ivimbele ukukhulelwa.

 Isidoda siyinhlanganisela yesidoda kanye nokuphuma kwe-spermatic duct (cishe amaphesenti ayi-10 (ingqikithi) kanye noketshezi oluvela kuma-gland asekelayo anikela ngenani elikhulu lomthamo wesidoda. Isidoda singamaseli e-haploid, aqukethe i-flagellum njengomsila, intamo equkethe i-mitochondria ekhiqiza amandla yeseli, kanye nekhanda eliqukethe izinto zofuzo. Isithombe 34.11 sibonisa i-micrograph yesidoda somuntu kanye nomdwebo wezingxenye zesidoda. I-acrosome itholakala phezulu kwekhanda lesidoda. Lesi sakhiwo siqukethe ama-enzyme e-lysosomal angagaya izembozo ezivikelayo ezizungeze iqanda ukusiza isidoda singene futhi sivundise iqanda. I-ejaculate izoqukatha ama-milliliters amabili kuya kwayisihlanu oketshezi oluvela ku-50-120 million isidoda nge-milliliter.

 Inqwaba yesidoda ivela kuma-gland asekelayo ahlobene nohlelo lokuzala lwabesilisa. Lawa ama-vesicle esidoda, i-prostate gland, kanye ne-bulbourethral gland, konke okuboniswe ku-Figure 34.10. Ama-vesicle esidoda ayizindlala ezimbili ezilele emngceleni ongemuva wesinyi somchamo. Ama-gland yenza isisombululo esijiyile, esiphuzi, nesi-alkaline. Njengoba isidoda sihamba kuphela endaweni ene-alkaline, i-pH eyisisekelo ibalulekile ukuze kuguqulwe i-acidity yendawo yesitho sangasese sowesifazane. Isixazululo siphinde siqukethe i-mucus, i-fructose (isakhi se-mitochondrial sesidoda), i-enzyme ehlanganisayo, i-ascorbic acid, nama-hormone asebenza endaweni ebizwa ngokuthi ama-prostaglandins. Izindlala ze-seminal vesicle zibanga amaphesenti angama-60 enqwaba yesidoda.

 Ipenisi, eboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.10, iyisitho esikhipha umchamo esinyini sezinso futhi sisebenza njengesitho socansi ngesikhathi socansi. Ipenisi iqukethe amashubhu amathathu ezicubu zobulili ezigijima ubude besitho. Lawa aqukethe amashubhu amabili ohlangothini lwe-dorsal, abizwa ngokuthi i-corpus cavernosum, kanye neshubhu elilodwa lezicubu ohlangothini lwe-ventral, elibizwa ngokuthi i-corpus spongiosum. Lesi sicubu sizogcwala igazi, sibe siqonde futhi siqine, ukulungiselela ucansi. Isitho sifakwa esithweni sangasese sowesifazane siphetha ngokuphuma kocansi. Ngesikhathi socansi, ama-sphincters emisipha ebushelelezi afika ekuvulekeni kwesinyi sezinso ayavalwa futhi vimbela umchamo ukuthi ungangeni endukwini. I-orgasm inqubo enezigaba ezimbili: okokuqala, izindlala kanye nezitho ezihambisanayo ezixhunywe kuma-testes ziyancintisana, bese kuthi isidoda (esine-sperm) sikhishwe nge-urethra ngesikhathi sokukhipha isisu. Ngemva kocansi, igazi liphuma ezicutshini ze-erectile bese i-penis iba buthakathaka.

 I-prostate gland efana ne-walnut izungeze i-urethra, ukuxhumana nesinye somchamo. Inezinqwaba zemigudu emifushane exhuma ngqo kwi-urethra. I-gland iyinhlanganisela yemisipha ebushelelezi kanye nezicubu ze-glandular. Imisipha inikeza amandla amaningi adingekayo ukuze kwenzeke ukukhipha isisu. Izicubu ze-glandular zenza uketshezi oluncane, olufana nobisi oluqukethe i-citrate (isakhamzimba), ama-enzyme, kanye ne-prostate specific antigen (PSA). I-PSA iyi-enzyme ye-proteolytic esiza ukuhlanza i-ejaculate imizuzu embalwa ngemva kokukhululwa kwendoda. Ukukhushulwa kwe-prostate gland kubalelwa cishe kumaphesenti angu-30 enqwaba yesidoda.

 I-bulbourethral gland, noma i-Cowper`s gland, ikhipha ukukhishwa kwayo ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwenqwaba yesidoda. Iyayiqeda amandla noma yikuphi ukusala kwe-asidi ku-urethra okusele emchameni. Lokhu kuvame ukubala amaconsi ambalwa oketshezi ku-ejaculate iyonke futhi kungase kube nesidoda esincane. Ukukhipha ipenis esithweni sangasese sangasese ngaphambi kokukhipha isisu ukuvimbela ukukhulelwa kungase kungasebenzi uma isidoda sikhona ekukhishweni kwe-bulbourethral gland. Indawo kanye nemisebenzi yezitho zokuzala zesilisa kufingqiwe kuthebula elingezansi.

question1: Kungani amasende etholakala ngaphandle komzimba esinqeni sezilwane eziningi ezincelisayo zasemhlabeni?

question2: Ikhiqizwa kuphi isidoda?

question3: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-epididymis?

question4: Uyini umphumela we-vasectomy?

question5: Uyini umsebenzi we-acrosome esicongweni seseli lesidoda?

question6: Yiziphi izindlala ezisekelayo ezikhiqiza cishe amaphesenti angama-60 omthamo wesidoda?
answer6: Ama-vesicles esidoda
question7: Kungani ukukhiqizwa kwe-seminal vesicle ku-alkaline?
answer7: Ukunciphisa indawo ene-asidi yesitho sangasese sowesifazane nokukhuthaza ukuhamba kwesidoda
question8: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wendlala ye-prostate?
answer8: Ukufaka uketshezi esidoda nokusiza ekuncibilikiseni i-ejaculate
question9: Uyini umsebenzi wezindlala ze-bulbourethral (Cowpers)?
answer9: Ziqeda i-acidic umchamo e-urethra ngaphambi kokukhipha isisu
question10: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi kungani indlela yokuhoxa ingaphumeleli ngaso sonke isikhathi ekuvimbeleni ukukhulelwa?
answer10: Ukukhishwa kwe-bulbourethral gland ngaphambi kokukhipha isisu kungase kube nesidoda
distractor10a: Indlala ye-prostate ihlala ikhipha isidoda ngaphambi kokukhipha isisu
distractor10c: Ama-vesicles esidoda akhipha isidoda ngaphambi kocansi
question11: Bheka uMfanekiso 34.10. Yisiphi kulezi zinkulumo ezilandelayo mayelana nohlelo lokuzala lwabesilisa esingamanga?
answer11: Indlala ye-prostate itholakala kuma-testes

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.3 I-Anatomy Yokuzala Komuntu kanye Nokukhiqizwa Kwe-Gametogenesis | I-Anatomy Yokuzala Komuntu | I-Anatomy Yokuzala Kowesifazane
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.3 Human Reproductive Anatomy and Gametogenesis | Human Reproductive Anatomy | Female Reproductive Anatomy
chapterContent:
Izakhiwo eziningana zokuzala zingaphandle komzimba wowesifazane. Lezi zihlanganisa amabele kanye ne-vulva, equkethe i-mons pubis, i-clitoris, i-labia majora, i-labia minora, kanye nezindlala ze-vestibular, konke okuboniswe ku-Figure 34.12. Indawo kanye nemisebenzi yezitho zokuzala zabesifazane kufingqiwe kuthebula elingezansi. I-vulva yindawo ehlotshaniswa ne-vestibule ehlanganisa izakhiwo ezitholakala endaweni ye-inguinal (groin) yabesifazane. I-mons pubis yindawo eyindilinga, enamafutha emboza i-pubic symphysis. I-clitoris isakhiwo esinezicubu zobulili eziqukethe inani elikhulu lemizwa futhi sisebenza njengomthombo wokukhuthaza ngesikhathi socansi. I-labia majora iyizicucu ezimbili ezinde ezigoqekayo ezigijima ngemuva kwe-mons pubis futhi zivale ezinye izingxenye ze-vulva. I-labia majora ivela esicutshini esifanayo esikhiqiza i-scrotum kwendoda. I-labia minora iyizicucu ezincane ezitholakala phakathi kwe-labia majora. Lawa ma-labia avikela izikhala eziya esithweni sangasese sowesifazane kanye ne-urethra. Ama-mons pubis kanye nengxenye engaphambili ye-labia majora zimbozwa izinwele ngesikhathi sobusha; i-labia minora ayinazinwele. Ama-vestibular glands amakhulu atholakala ezinhlangothini zomnyango wesitho sangasese sowesifazane futhi ahlinzeka ngokugcoba ngesikhathi socansi.

 Amabele aqukethe ama-mammary glands namafutha. Ubukhulu besifuba bunqunywa inani lamafutha abekwe ngemuva kwe-gland. I-gland ngayinye iqukethe ama-lobes angu-15 kuya kwangu-25 anemibhobho ethululela engonweni futhi enikeza ingane encelayo ubisi olucebile ngezakhamzimba kanye nama-antibody ukusiza ukukhula nokuvikela ingane.

 Izakhiwo zokuzala zangaphakathi zabesifazane zifaka ama-ovari, ama-oviducts, isibeletho, kanye nesitho sangasese sowesifazane, okuboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.12. Ama-ovari amabili abanjwe endaweni yawo esiswini ngohlelo lwe-ligaments. Ama-ovari aqukethe i-medulla kanye ne-cortex: i-medulla iqukethe imizwa nemithambo yegazi ukuze inikeze i-cortex izakhamzimba futhi isuse imfucuza. Izendlalelo zangaphandle zamaseli e-cortex ziyizingxenye ezisebenzayo zama-ovari. I-cortex yakhiwe ngamaseli e-follicular azungeze amaqanda akhula ngesikhathi sokukhula kwengane esibelethweni. Ngesikhathi sokuya esikhathini, iqembu lamaseli e-follicular liyakhula futhi lilungiselele amaqanda ukukhululwa. Ngesikhathi sokuvuthwa kweqanda, i-follicle eyodwa iyaqhuma bese kukhishwa iqanda elilodwa, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.13a.

 Ama-oviducts, noma amashubhu e-fallopian, asuka esibelethweni esingaphansi kwesisu aye kuma-ovari, kodwa awathintani nama-ovari. Iziphetho ze-oviducts ezisemaceleni ziyaphuma zibe isakhiwo esifana ne-trumpet futhi zinezicucu ze-projections ezifana neminwe ezibizwa ngokuthi i-fimbriae, eziboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.12b. Lapho iqanda likhishwa ngesikhathi sokuvuthwa kweqanda, ama-fimbrae asiza iqanda elingahambi lingene epayipini futhi lidlulele esibelethweni. Izindonga zama-oviducts zi-ciliated futhi zakhiwe kakhulu ngemisipha ebushelelezi. I-cilia ishaya phakathi nendawo, bese imisipha ebushelelezi ifinyela ohlangothini olufanayo, ihambise iqanda liye esibelethweni. Ukukhulelwa kuvame ukwenzeka ngaphakathi kwama-oviducts bese umbungu okhulayo uthuthelwa esibelethweni ukuze ukhule. Ngokuvamile kuthatha iqanda noma umbungu isonto lonke ukuhamba nge-oviduct. Ukuzala kwabesifazane kubizwa ngokuthi i-tubal ligation; kufana ne-vasectomy kwabesilisa ngoba ama-oviducts ayanqunywa futhi avalwe.

 Isibeletho siyisakhiwo esilingana nenqindi yowesifazane. Lokhu kufakwe i-endometrium ecebile ngemithambo yegazi kanye nezindlala ze-mucus. Isibeletho sisekela umbungu okhulayo kanye nombungu ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa. Ingxenye ebanzi kakhulu yodonga lwesibeletho yenziwe ngemisipha ebushelelezi. Ukufinyela kwemisipha ebushelelezi esibelethweni kusiza ekudluliseni umntwana ngesitho sangasese sowesifazane ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Ingxenye yolwelwesi lwesibeletho iyaphuma ngesikhathi sokuya esikhathini, bese iphinda yakheke futhi ukulungiselela ukufakwa. Ingxenye yesibeletho, ebizwa ngokuthi umlomo wesibeletho, iphuma iye phezulu kwesitho sangasese sowesifazane. Umlomo wesibeletho usebenza njengomsele wokuzalwa.

 Isitho sangasese sowesifazane siyipayipi elinemisipha elifeza izinjongo eziningana. Livumela ukugeleza kokuya esikhathini ukuba kuphume emzimbeni. Liyindawo yokugcina ipipi ngesikhathi socansi kanye nesitsha sokubeletha inzalo. Ligcwele amangqamuzana e-epithelial ahlukaniswe ngama-stratified ukuze avikele izicubu ezingaphansi.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Wezilwane | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.3 I-Anatomy Yokuzala Nokukhiqizwa Kwe-Gametogenesis Yabantu | I-Anatomy Yokuzala Yabantu | Impendulo Yocansi Ngesikhathi Socansi
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.3 Human Reproductive Anatomy and Gametogenesis | Human Reproductive Anatomy | Sexual Response during Intercourse
chapterContent:
Impendulo yocansi kubantu ingokwengqondo nangokomzimba. Bobabili ubulili buthola uvuko locansi ngokukhuthazwa ngokwengqondo nangokomzimba. Kunezigaba ezine zokusabela ngokocansi. Ngesikhathi sesigaba sokuqala, esibizwa ngokuthi ukujabula, ukuvaleka kwemithambo yegazi kuholela ekuminyaneni kwemithambo yegazi ezicutshini zobulili kokubili kwabesilisa nabesifazane. Ama-nipples, i-clitoris, i-labia, kanye ne-penis kugcwala igazi futhi kukhule. Ukukhishwa kwe-vaginal kukhishwa ukuze kugcotshwe i-vaginal ukuze kube lula ukuhlangana ngokocansi. Ngesikhathi sesigaba sesibili, esibizwa ngokuthi i-plateau, ukukhuthazwa kuyaqhubeka, ingxenye yesithathu yangaphandle yodonga lwe-vaginal ikhula ngegazi, futhi ukuphefumula nokushaya kwenhliziyo kuyakhuphuka.

 Ngesikhathi sesigaba sesithathu, noma i-orgasm, ukuvaleka kwemisipha okunesigqi, okungazikhetheli kwenzeka kubo bobabili ubulili. Kwabesilisa, izindlala zokuzala kanye nama-tubules anciphayo abeka isidoda ku-urethra, bese i-urethra incipha ikhipha isidoda nge-penis. Kwabesifazane, isibeletho kanye nemisipha ye-vaginal incipha ngamagagasi angase ahlale isikhathi esingaphansi kwesekhondi ngalinye. Ngesikhathi sesigaba sesine, noma ukuxazulula, izinqubo ezichazwe ezigabeni zokuqala ezintathu ziyaziguqula futhi zibuyele esimweni sazo esijwayelekile. Amadoda abhekana nesikhathi sokungavumi ukuhlangana noma ukukhipha isidoda isikhathi esithile kusukela kumaminithi kuya emahoreni

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.3 Human Reproductive Anatomy and Gametogenesis | Gametogenesis
chapterContent: I-Gametogenesis, ukukhiqizwa kwesidoda namaqanda, kwenzeka ngenqubo ye-meiosis. Ngesikhathi se-meiosis, ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli amabili kuhlukanisa ama-chromosome abhangqiwe ku-nucleus bese kuhlukanisa ama-chromatids enziwa ngesikhathi sokuqala komjikelezo wokuphila kweseli. I-Meiosis ikhiqiza amaseli e-haploid anengxenye yama-chromosome amabili avame ukutholakala kumaseli e-diploid. Ukukhiqizwa kwesidoda kubizwa ngokuthi i-spermatogenesis kanti ukukhiqizwa kwamaqanda kubizwa ngokuthi i-oogenesis

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.3 Ukwakheka Nokuzala Komuntu | Ukwakheka Kwezilwane | Ukwakheka Kwezilwane
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.3 Human Reproductive Anatomy and Gametogenesis | Gametogenesis | Spermatogenesis
chapterContent:
I-Spermatogenesis, eboniswe ku-Figure 34.14, yenzeka odongeni lwama-tubules angama-seminiferous (Isithombe 34.10), lapho ama-stem cells eseduze kwe-tube kanye ne-spermatozoa e-lumen ye-tube. Ngaphansi kwe-capsule ye-tubule kukhona ama-diploid, ama-unidiated cells. Lawa ma-stem cell, abizwa ngokuthi i-spermatogonia (eyodwa: i-spermatagonium), adlula ku-mitosis kanti inzalo eyodwa iyaqhubeka nokwahluka ibe yi-sperm cell kanti enye iveza isizukulwane esilandelayo sesidoda.

 I-Meiosis iqala ngeseli elibizwa ngokuthi i-primary spermatocyte. Ekupheleni kwe-meiotic division yokuqala, kukhiqizwa iseli le-haploid elibizwa ngokuthi i-secondary spermatocyte. Leli seli liyi-haploid futhi kumele lidlule kwenye i-meiotic cell division. Iseli elikhiqizwa ekupheleni kwe-meiosis libizwa ngokuthi i-spermatid futhi uma lifika ku-lumen ye-tubule futhi likhula i-flagellum, libizwa ngokuthi i-sperm cell. Ama-sperm amane avela ku-spermatocyte ngayinye eyinhloko edlula ku-meiosis.

 Amaseli e-stem abekwa ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa futhi akhona ekuzalweni kuze kube sekuqaleni kobusha, kodwa esimweni sokungasebenzi. Ngesikhathi sobusha, ama-hormone e-gonadotropic avela ku-anterior pituitary abangela ukusebenza kwala maseli kanye nokukhiqizwa kwesidoda esiphilayo. Lokhu kuyaqhubeka kuze kube yilapho esekhulile.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzaliswa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.3 Ukwakheka Nokukhiqizwa Kwezitho Zokuzala Zomuntu | Ukuzaliswa Kwezitho Zokuzala | Ukuzaliswa Kwezitho Zokuzala
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.3 Human Reproductive Anatomy and Gametogenesis | Gametogenesis | Oogenesis
chapterContent:
I-Oogenesis, eboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.15, yenzeka ezingqimbeni zangaphandle zama-ovari. Njengokukhiqizwa kwesidoda, i-oogenesis iqala ngeseli le-germ, elibizwa ngokuthi i-oogonium (ubuningi: i-oogonia), kodwa leli seli lidlula ku-mitosis ukuze likhule ngenani, ekugcineni liholele kumaseli angaba yisigidi esisodwa kuya kwezimbili ku-embryo.
Iseli eliqala i-meiosis libizwa ngokuthi i-oocyte eyinhloko, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.15. Leli seli lizoqala ukuhlukaniswa kokuqala kwe-meiotic futhi liboshwe ekuqhubekeni kwalo esigabeni sokuqala se-prophase. Ngesikhathi sokuzalwa, wonke amaqanda esikhathi esizayo asesigabeni se-prophase. Ebusheni, ama-hormone e-pituitary angaphambili abangela ukuthuthukiswa kwenqwaba yama-follicle esibelethweni. Lokhu kuphumela ekuqedeni ukuhlukaniswa kokuqala kwe-meiotic. Iseli lihlukana ngokungalingani, lapho iningi lezinto zeseli nama-organelles liya esiseleni esisodwa, esibizwa ngokuthi i-oocyte yesibili, kanye nesethi eyodwa kuphela yama-chromosome kanye nenani elincane le-cytoplasm liya kwelinye iseli. Leli seli lesibili libizwa ngokuthi umzimba we-polar futhi livame ukufa. Kwenzeka ukumiswa kwesibili kwe-meiotic, kulokhu esigabeni se-metaphase II. Ngesikhathi sokuvuthwa kweqanda, leli qanda lesibili le-oocyte lizokhishwa bese lihamba liye esibelethweni nge-oviduct. Uma i-oocyte yesibili ivundiswa, iseli liyaqhubeka nge-meiosis II, likhiqize umzimba wesibili we-polar kanye neqanda elivundisiwe eliqukethe wonke ama-chromosome angu-46 omuntu, ingxenye yawo ivela esidodaneni.

 Ukukhiqizwa kwamaqanda kuqala ngaphambi kokuzalwa, kumiswe ngesikhathi se-meiosis kuze kube yilapho umuntu esethombile, bese kuthi amaseli ngamanye aqhubeke nomjikelezo ngamunye wokuya esikhathini. Iqanda elilodwa likhiqizwa kusukela enkambisweni ngayinye ye-meiotic, lapho ama-chromosome engeziwe nama-chromatids engena emizimbeni ye-polar ewohloka futhi aphinde amuncwe umzimba.

chapterContent:
Ulwazi olukulesi sigaba luwukusetshenziswa kwemiqondo esiyifundile lapho sihlola uhlelo lwe-endocrine esahlukweni esedlule. Imijikelezo yokuzala yabantu besilisa nabesifazane ilawulwa ukusebenzisana kwama-hormone avela ku-hypothalamus kanye ne-anterior pituitary nama-hormone avela ezicutshini nasezithweni zokuzala. Ulwazi oluningiliziwe mayelana nokukhiqizwa kwesidoda kanye nemijikelezo yama-ovari kanye nokuya esikhathini alukho ngaphakathi kwesilinganiso se-AP®, futhi kungenzeka ukuthi ufunde lolu lwazi ekilasini lezempilo. Njengoba izinto ezikulesi sigaba ziwusizo futhi zifanelekile, ukubuyekezwa okufushane kuyasiza.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 kanye no-Big Idea 3 wohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nenye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo wokwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zigcine i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.C
Izinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa izindlela zokuphendula ukuze zilawule ukukhula nokuzala, kanye nokugcina i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.C.1 Izinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa izindlela zokuphendula ukuze zilondoloze izindawo zazo zangaphakathi futhi ziphendule ezinguqukweni zemvelo zangaphandle.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.4 Ukulawulwa Kwamahomoni Kokuzala Kwabantu | Amahomoni Abesilisa
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.4 Hormonal Control of Human Reproduction | Male Hormones
chapterContent:
Ekuqaleni kokuthomba, i-hypothalamus ibangela ukukhishwa kwe-follicle stimulating hormone (FSH) kanye ne-luteinizing hormone (LH) ohlelweni lwabesilisa okokuqala. I-FSH ingena kuma-testes futhi ivuselela amangqamuzana e-Sertoli ukuthi aqale ukusiza i-spermatogenesis ngokusebenzisa impendulo engemihle, njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 34.16. I-LH ingena kuma-testes futhi ivuselela amangqamuzana angaphakathi kwe-Leydig ukwenza nokukhulula i-testosterone kuma-testes nasegazini.

 I-Testosterone, i-hormone ephethe izici zocansi zesibili ezikhula kubesilisa ngesikhathi sokuthomba, ivuselela i-spermatogenesis. Lezi zici zocansi zesibili zifaka phakathi ukujula kwezwi, ukukhula kwezinwele zobuso, ze-axillary, neze-pubic, kanye nokuqala kwesifiso socansi.
Uhlelo lwempendulo engemihle lwenzeka kubesilisa kanye namazinga aphezulu e-testosterone asebenza ku-hypothalamus kanye ne-anterior pituitary ukuvimbela ukukhishwa kwe-gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH), FSH, kanye ne-LH. Amaseli e-Sertoli akhiqiza i-hormone i-inhibin, ekhishwa egazini uma inani lesidoda liphezulu kakhulu. Lokhu kuvimbela ukukhishwa kwe-GnRH ne-FSH, okuzobangela ukuthi i-spermatogenesis yehle. Uma inani lesidoda lifinyelela ku-20 million/ml, amaseli e-Sertoli ayayeka ukukhishwa kwe-inhibin, futhi inani lesidoda liyakhula.

answer1: I-hormone evuselela i-follicle (i-FSH) kanye ne-hormone ye-luteinizing (i-LH)
