chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.4 Ukulawulwa Kwamahomoni Kokuzala Kwabantu | Amahomoni Abesifazane
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.4 Hormonal Control of Human Reproductive Anatomy | Female Hormones
chapterContent:
Ukulawula ukuzala kwabesifazane kuyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu. Njengakwabesilisa, ama-hormone e-pituitary angaphambili abangela ukukhishwa kwama-hormone i-FSH ne-LH. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-estrogen ne-progesterone akhishwa kuma-follicle akhulayo. I-Estradiol yi-hormone yokuzala kwabesifazane esiza ekukhuleni kabusha kwe-endometrial, ukuvuthwa kweqanda, kanye nokumuncwa kwe-calcium; futhi inesibopho sezici zobulili zesibili zabesifazane. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukukhula kwamabele, ukuvuleka kwezinqe, kanye nesikhathi esifushane esidingekayo ekuvuthweni kwamathambo. I-Progesterone isiza ekukhuleni kabusha kwe-endometrial kanye nokuvinjelwa kokukhishwa kwe-FSH ne-LH.

 Kwabesifazane, i-FSH ivuselela ukukhula kwamaseli amaqanda, abizwa ngokuthi ama-ova, akhula ezakhiweni ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-follicle. Amaseli e-follicle akhiqiza i-hormone i-inhibin, evimbela ukukhiqizwa kwe-FSH. I-LH idlala indima ekuthuthukisweni kwe-ova, ekuqalisweni kokuvuthwa kweqanda, kanye nasekukhuthazweni kwe-estradiol, uhlobo olunamandla kakhulu noluvame kakhulu lwe-estrogen, kanye nokukhiqizwa kwe-progesterone ngama-ovari. I-Estradiol ne-progesterone ama-hormone e-steroid alungiselela umzimba ukukhulelwa. I-Estradiol ikhiqiza izici zobulili zesibili kwabesifazane, kuyilapho i-estradiol ne-progesterone zombili zilawula umjikelezo wokuya esikhathini.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.4 Ukulawulwa Kwamahomoni Kokuzala Kwabantu | Amahomoni Abesifazane | Umjikelezo Wesibeletho Nomjikelezo Wokuya Esikhathini
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.4 Hormonal Control of Human Reproduction | Female Hormones | The Ovarian Cycle and the Menstrual Cycle
chapterContent:
Umjikelezo we-ovarian ulawula ukulungiswa kwezicubu ze-endocrine kanye nokukhululwa kwamaqanda, kuyilapho umjikelezo wokuya esikhathini ulawula ukulungiswa nokugcinwa kolwelwesi lwesibeletho. Le mijikelezo yenzeka ngesikhathi esisodwa futhi ihlanganiswa emjikelezweni wezinsuku ezingu-22-32, ubude obumaphakathi bezinsuku ezingu-28.

 Ingxenye yokuqala yomjikelezo we-ovarian yisigaba se-follicular esiboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.17. Amazinga akhuphuka kancane kancane e-FSH kanye ne-LH abangela ukukhula kwama-follicle ebusweni be-ovary. Le nqubo ilungiselela iqanda ukuvuthwa. Njengoba ama-follicle ekhula, aqala ukukhulula ama-estrogen kanye nezinga eliphansi le-progesterone. Kulesi sigaba, i-progesterone isiza ukuqina kwe-endometrium ukuze ikwazi ukwamukela ukufakwa kweqanda elivundisiwe. Uma ukukhulelwa kweqanda kwenzeka, kwenzeka epayipini le-fallopian. Uhambo lweqanda elivundisiwe ngepayipi le-fallopian luthatha cishe izinsuku eziyisikhombisa. Kulesi sigaba sokukhula, esibizwa ngokuthi i-morula, kunamaseli angu-30-60. Uma ukukhulelwa kungenzeki, ulwelwesi luyasuswa. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezingaba zinhlanu, amazinga e-estrogen ayakhuphuka bese umjikelezo wokuya esikhathini ungena esigabeni sokwanda. I-endometrium iqala ukukhula kabusha, ithathe indawo yemithambo yegazi kanye nezindlala ezawohloka ekupheleni komjikelezo wokugcina.

 Ngaphambi nje kokuba phakathi nomjikelezo (cishe ngosuku lwe-14), izinga eliphezulu le-estrogen libangela i-FSH ikakhulukazi i-LH ukuba ikhuphuke ngokushesha, bese yehla. Ukwanda kwe-LH kubangela ukuvuthwa kweqanda: i-follicle evuthiwe kakhulu, njengaleyo eboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.18, iyaqhuma futhi ikhiphe iqanda layo. Ama-follicle angaqhumanga ayawohloka futhi amaqanda awo ayalahleka. Izinga le-estrogen liyancipha lapho ama-follicle engeziwe ewohloka.

 Ngemva kokuvuthwa kweqanda, umjikelezo we-ovarian ungena esigabeni sawo se-luteal, esiboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.17 kanti umjikelezo wokuya esikhathini ungena esigabeni sawo se-secretory, zombili eziqala cishe ngosuku lwe-15 kuya ku-28. Izigaba ze-luteal neze-secretory zibhekisela ezinguqukweni ku-follicle eqhumayo. Amaseli ku-follicle enza izinguquko zomzimba futhi akhiqize isakhiwo esibizwa ngokuthi i-corpus luteum. I-corpus luteum ikhiqiza i-estrogen ne-progesterone. I-progesterone yenza kube lula ukukhula kabusha kolwelwesi lwesibeletho futhi ivimbele ukukhishwa kwe-FSH ne-LH eyengeziwe. Isibeletho silungiselelwa ukwamukela iqanda elivundisiwe, uma kwenzeka phakathi nalo mjikelezo. Ukuvinjelwa kwe-FSH ne-LH kuvimbela noma yimaphi amaqanda nama-follicle engeziwe ekukhuleni, kuyilapho i-progesterone iphakanyisiwe. Izinga le-estrogen elikhiqizwa yi-corpus luteum liyanda liye ezingeni elizinzile ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ezizayo.

 Uma kungekho qanda elivundisiwe elifakwe esibelethweni, i-corpus luteum iyawohloka futhi amazinga e-estrogen ne-progesterone ayancipha. I-endometrium iqala ukuwohloka njengoba amazinga e-progesterone ehla, okuqalisa umjikelezo olandelayo wokuya esikhathini. Ukwehla kwe-progesterone kuvumela ne-hypothalamus ukuthi ithumele i-GnRH ku-anterior pituitary, ikhulule i-FSH ne-LH futhi iqale imijikelezo futhi. Isithombe 34.19 siqhathanisa ngokubonakalayo imijikelezo ye-ovarian kanye ne-uterine kanye namazinga e-hormone ahambisanayo.

chapterContent:
Njengoba abesifazane besondela eminyakeni yabo ephakathi kwama-40 kuya kwengama-50, ama-ovari abo aqala ukulahlekelwa ukuzwela kwabo ku-FSH kanye ne-LH. Izikhathi zokuya esikhathini ziya ngokuya zincipha futhi ekugcineni ziyaphela; lokhu kuyi-menopause. Kusekhona amaqanda kanye nama-follicle angaba khona kuma-ovari, kodwa ngaphandle kokukhuthazwa kwe-FSH kanye ne-LH, ngeke akhiqize iqanda elisebenzayo elizokhishwa. Umphumela walokhu ukungakwazi ukuba nezingane.

 Imiphumela emibi yokuya esikhathini ihlanganisa ukushisa okukhulu, ukujuluka okukhulu (ikakhulukazi ebusuku), ikhanda elibuhlungu, ukulahlekelwa izinwele, ubuhlungu bemisipha, ukoma kwesitho sangasese sowesifazane, ukuqwasha, ukucindezeleka, ukukhuluphala, kanye nokushintshashintsha kwemizwelo. I-estrogen ihilelekile ekugayweni kwe-calcium futhi, ngaphandle kwayo, amazinga e-calcium egazini ayancipha. Ukuze kugcwaliswe igazi, i-calcium ilahleka emathanjeni okungase kunciphise ubuningi bamathambo futhi kuholele ekuwohlokeni kwamathambo. Ukwengezwa kwe-estrogen ngendlela yokwelashwa kokushintsha kwama-hormone (HRT) kungavimbela ukulahlekelwa kwamathambo, kodwa ukwelashwa kungaba nemiphumela emibi emibi. Nakuba kucatshangwa ukuthi i-HRT inikeza isivikelo esithile kumdlavuza wamathumbu amakhulu, i-osteoporosis, isifo senhliziyo, ukuwohloka kwe-macular, kanye nokucindezeleka, imiphumela yayo emibi ihlanganisa ingozi eyengeziwe ye: isifo sohlangothi noma ukuhlaselwa yinhliziyo, amahlule egazi, umdlavuza webele, umdlavuza wesibeletho, umdlavuza we-endometrial, isifo se-gallbladder, kanye nesifo sengqondo esibi.
question1: Kuyini ukunqamuka kokuya esikhathini?
answer1: Ukuphela unomphela kokuya esikhathini ngenxa yokuncipha kokuzwela kwama-ovari ku-FSH kanye ne-LH
distractor1c: Ukungabikho kwesikhashana kokuya esikhathini ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa
question2: Kungani abesifazane beyeka ukuvuthwa ngesikhathi sokunqamuka kokuya esikhathini?
answer2: Ama-ovari alahlekelwa ukuzwela ku-FSH kanye ne-LH, ngakho-ke amaqanda aphilayo awasakhiqizwa futhi awasakhululwa.
distractor2b: I-pituitary gland iyayeka ukukhiqiza wonke ama-hormone
question3: Iyini imiphumela eyinhloko yokuzala yokunqamuka kokuya esikhathini?
answer3: Ukungakwazi ukuba nezingane ngokwemvelo
question4: Yisiphi kulezi ezilandelayo esiwuphawu oluvamile lokunqamuka kokuya esikhathini?
answer4: Ukushisa okukhulu
question5: Kungani ukunqamuka kokuya esikhathini kwandisa ingozi ye-osteoporosis?
answer5: Ukwehla kwe-estrogen kunciphisa amazinga e-calcium egazini, okubangela ukuba i-calcium isuswe emathanjeni
distractor5a: I-estrogen ephezulu ibangela ukuwohloka kwamathambo ngokweqile
question6: Kuyini ukwelashwa kokufaka esikhundleni sama-hormone (HRT)?
answer6: Ukwelashwa okwengeza i-estrogen ukunciphisa imiphumela ethile yokunqamuka kokuya esikhathini
question7: Yisiphi isimo esingasiza ekuvimbeleni ukwelashwa esikhundleni sama-hormone?
answer7: Ukulahlekelwa amathambo okuhambisana ne-osteoporosis
question8: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungaba yingozi ehlobene nokwelashwa kokushintsha ama-hormone (HRT)?
answer8: Ingozi eyengeziwe yomdlavuza webele
distractor8a: Ukulahlekelwa yizo zonke izitho zokuzala zama-ovari
question9: Yisiphi isitatimende esifingqa kangcono ukuhwebelana kokwelashwa kokushintsha ama-hormone?
answer9: Kunganciphisa ukulahleka kwamathambo kanye nezinye izifo kodwa futhi kwandisa ingozi yezinkinga eziningana zempilo ezimbi
distractor9a: Iqeda zonke izimpawu zokunqamuka kokuya esikhathini ngaphandle kwezingozi
distractor9b: Kukhulisa kuphela ukuzala ngemva kokunqamuka kokuya esikhathini

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.4 Ukulawulwa Kwamahomoni Kokuzala Kwabantu | Amahomoni Abesifazane | Ukuxhumana Kwabasebenzi | Isazi Se-Endocrinologist Sokuzala
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.4 Hormonal Control of Human Reproduction | Female Hormones | Career Connection | Reproductive Endocrinologist
chapterContent:
I-endocrinologist yokuzala ingudokotela ophatha izifo ezahlukahlukene zamahomoni ezihlobene nokuzala kanye nokungabi nabantwana kokubili kwabesilisa nabesifazane. Lezi zinkinga zifaka phakathi izinkinga zokuya esikhathini, ukungabi nabantwana, ukulahlekelwa ukukhulelwa, ukungasebenzi kahle kocansi, kanye nokunqamuka kokuya esikhathini. Odokotela bangasebenzisa imithi yokuzala, ukuhlinzwa, noma amasu okusiza ekuzaleni (ART) ekwelashweni kwabo. I-ART ihilela ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubo zokulawula iqanda noma isidoda ukuze kube lula ukuzala, njengokukhulelwa kwe-in vitro.

 Odokotela be-endocrinologist bokuzala baqeqeshwa kakhulu kwezokwelapha, okokuqala endaweni yokuhlala iminyaka emine kwezokwelapha zokubelethisa kanye nezifo zabesifazane, bese kuba sebudlelwaneni beminyaka emithathu kwezokwelapha ze-endocrinology zokuzala. Ukuze aqinisekiswe yibhodi kule ndawo, udokotela kumele aphumelele ukuhlolwa okubhaliwe nokomlomo kuzo zombili lezi zindawo.
question1: Iyini indima eyinhloko yodokotela we-endocrinologist wokuzala?
answer1: Ukuthola nokwelapha izinkinga zama-hormone ezihlobene nokuzala kanye nokungabi nabantwana kokubili kwabesilisa nabesifazane
distractor1a: Ukwenza ukunakekelwa kwabesifazane abakhulelwe kuphela ngaphambi kokubeletha
distractor1b: Ukwelapha izifo ze-endocrine kuphela ezingahlobene nokuzala
question2: Yiziphi izimo ezilandelayo ezingaphathwa yi-endocrinologist yokuzala?
answer2: Ukungazali
question3: Isho ukuthini i-ART?
answer3: Amasu okusiza ekuzaleni
question4: Iyini inhloso yamasu okusiza ekuzaleni (ART)?
answer4: Ukuphatha amaqanda noma isidoda ukuze kube lula ukuzala
question5: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sendlela yokusiza ekuzaleni (ART)?
answer5: Ukukhulelwa kwe-in vitro (IVF)
question6: Ngaphambi kokugxila kwi-endocrinology yokuzala, odokotela baqala ngokuqedela indawo yokuhlala kuyiphi insimu?
answer6: Ukwelashwa kokubelethisa kanye nezifo zabesifazane
question7: Isikhathi esingakanani sobudlelwano kwi-endocrinology yokuzala ngemva kokuhlala emtholampilo?
answer7: Iminyaka emithathu
question8: Yini odokotela okufanele bayenze ukuze bathole isitifiketi sebhodi kwi-endocrinology yokuzala?
answer8: Phumelela ukuhlolwa okubhaliwe nomlomo kokubili kwezokwelapha zabesifazane kanye ne-endocrinology yokuzala

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.5 Ukuvundisa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwesibeletho Sasekuqaleni | Ukuxhumana Nezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.5 Fertilization and Early Embryonic Development | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ulwazi olukulesi sigaba alukho ngaphakathi kwesilinganiso se-AP® ngaphandle kokuphawula ukuthi inqubo lapho into ephilayo ikhula khona isuka ku-zygote eneseli elilodwa iye kwinto ephilayo enamangqamuzana amaningi enamaseli akhethekile, izicubu, nezitho zomzimba iyinkimbinkimbi futhi ilawulwa kahle. Ukuhleleka ibe yinto ephilayo enamangqamuzana amaningi kulawulwa yizakhi zofuzo zento ephilayo. Ukwehlukaniswa kwamaseli kuwumphumela wokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ezithile, futhi izakhi zofuzo ze-homeotic (HOX) kanye nama-morphogens kulawula iphethini nesikhathi sezigaba zokukhula.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe kulesi sigaba azikho ngaphakathi kwesilinganiso se-AP® futhi azihambisani noHlaka Lwezifundo
question1: Iyini i-zygote?
answer1: Iseli elilodwa elakhiwe ukuhlangana kwesidoda neqanda elikhula libe yinto ephilayo enamangqamuzana amaningi
question2: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono intuthuko yombungu?
answer2: Kuyinqubo eyinkimbinkimbi futhi elawulwa kahle lapho i-zygote eneseli elilodwa ikhula ibe yinto ephilayo enamangqamuzana amaningi enamaseli akhethekile, izicubu, kanye nezitho zomzimba.
distractor2a: Kuyinqubo engalawulwa lapho amaseli ehlukana khona ngokungahleliwe
distractor2b: Kulawulwa kuphela yizimo zemvelo hhayi izakhi zofuzo
question3: Yini elawula ukuhlelwa kwesidalwa esinamangqamuzana amaningi ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa?
answer3: Izakhi zofuzo zezinto eziphilayo
question4: Ukwehlukaniswa kwamaseli kwenzeka ngokuyinhloko ngenxa yalokhu:
answer4: Ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ezithile
distractor4b: Ukubonakaliswa okufanayo kwezakhi zofuzo kuzo zonke iseli
question5: Iyini indima eyinhloko yezakhi zofuzo ze-homeotic (HOX) kanye nama-morphogen ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa?
answer5: Balawula iphethini kanye nesikhathi sezigaba zokukhula

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.5 Ukuvundisa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwesibeletho Sasekuqaleni | Ukuvundisa
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.5 Fertilization and Early Embryonic Development | Fertilization
chapterContent:
Ukuvundisa, okufanekiswe kuMfanekiso 34.20a inqubo lapho ama-gametes (iqanda nesidoda) kuhlangana khona ukuze kwakheke i-zygote. Iqanda nesidoda ngasinye siqukethe isethi eyodwa yama-chromosome. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi inzalo inesethi eyodwa ephelele yama-chromosome, isidoda esisodwa kuphela okumele sihlangane neqanda elilodwa. Ezincelisayo, iqanda livikelwe ungqimba lwe-extracellular matrix oluqukethe ikakhulukazi ama-glycoprotein abizwa ngokuthi i-zona pellucida. Lapho isidoda sibopha ku-zona pellucida, kwenzeka uchungechunge lwezehlakalo ze-biochemical, ezibizwa ngokuthi ukusabela kwe-acrosomal. Ezincelisayo ze-placental, i-acrosome iqukethe ama-enzyme okugaya aqala ukuwohloka kwe-glycoprotein matrix evikela iqanda futhi ivumele i-sperm plasma membrane ukuthi ihlangane ne-plasma membrane yeqanda, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.20b. Ukuhlanganiswa kwalezi zindwangu ezimbili kudala ithuba lapho i-nucleus yesidoda idluliselwa khona esibelethweni. Izindwangu ze-nuclear zeqanda nesidoda ziyaqhekeka futhi ama-genome amabili e-haploid ahlangana ukuze akhe i-genome ye-diploid.

 Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akukho ngaphezu kwesidoda esisodwa esivundisa iqanda, uma kwenzeka ukusabela kwe-acrosomal endaweni eyodwa ye-membrane yeqanda, iqanda likhipha amaprotheni kwezinye izindawo ukuvimbela esinye isidoda ukuthi singahlangani neqanda. Uma le ndlela yehluleka, isidoda esiningi singahlangana neqanda, okuholela ku-polyspermy. Umbungu ophumelayo awunazo izakhi zofuzo futhi uyafa zingakapheli izinsuku ezimbalwa.
question1: Kuyini ukukhulelwa?
answer1: Ukuhlanganiswa kwesidoda neqanda ukuze kwakheke i-zygote
question2: Kungani isidoda esisodwa kuphela kufanele sivundise iqanda?
answer2: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi inzalo inenani elifanele lama-chromosome e-diploid
question3: Iyini i-zona pellucida?
answer3: Ingqimba yangaphandle ecebile nge-glycoprotein ezungeze futhi ivikele iqanda
question4: Kwenzekani ngesikhathi sokusabela kwe-acrosomal?
answer4: Ama-enzyme akhishwa ku-sperm acrosome agaya i-zona pellucida, okuvumela isidoda ukuthi sifinyelele ulwelwesi lweqanda.
distractor4c: Iqanda likhipha ama-hormone akhuthaza ukuvuthwa kwamaqanda
question5: Uyini umsebenzi wama-enzyme ku-acrosome yesidoda?
answer5: Ukugaya i-glycoprotein matrix evikelayo ezungeze iqanda
question6: Kwenzekani ngemva kokuba ulwelwesi lwe-plasma lwesidoda neqanda luhlangene?
answer6: I-nucleus yesidoda ingena eqandeni
question7: I-genome ye-diploid ye-zygote yakheka kanjani?
answer7: Ama-genome e-haploid esidoda neqanda ayahlangana ngemva kokuba ulwelwesi lwawo lwenuzi luqhekeke
distractor7a: Isidoda siphinda ama-chromosome aso ngaphambi kokungena eqandeni
distractor7b: Iqanda liphinda kabili ama-chromosome alo ngaphambi kokukhulelwa
distractor7c: Isidoda neqanda kuhlala kuyi-haploid kulo lonke intuthuko
question8: Iqanda livimbela kanjani i-polyspermy?
answer8: Ikhipha amaprotheni avimbela isidoda esengeziwe ukuthi singahlangani neqanda ngemva kokungena kwesidoda sokuqala
distractor8a: Ibhubhisa yonke imbewu eseduze ngaphambi kokukhulelwa
question9: Kuyini i-polyspermy?
answer9: Ukukhulelwa kweqanda yizidoda ezingaphezu kwesisodwa
distractor9b: Ukukhiqizwa kwamaqanda amaningi ngesikhathi sokuvuthwa kweqanda
question10: Iyini imiphumela ye-polyspermy?
answer10: I-embryo ayisebenzi ngokwezakhi zofuzo futhi iyafa zingakapheli izinsuku ezimbalwa.
distractor10a: I-embryo ikhula ibe amawele afanayo

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.5 Ukuvundisa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwesibeletho Sasekuqaleni | Isigaba Sokuqhekeka Nokuqhekeka
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.5 Fertilization and Early Embryonic Development | Cleavage and Blastula Stage
chapterContent:
Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi kuqala ku-zygote eneseli elilodwa, ehlukana ngokushesha ukuze yakhe i-blastula. Izindilinga ezisheshayo neziningi zokuhlukana kwamaseli zibizwa ngokuthi ukuhlukana. Ukuhlukana kuboniswe ku-Figure 34.21a. Ngemva kokuba ukuhlukana sekukhiqize amaseli angaphezu kwe-100, umbungu ubizwa ngokuthi i-blastula. I-blastula ivame ukuba ungqimba oluyindilinga lwamaseli (i-blastoderm) oluzungeze umgodi ogcwele uketshezi noma ogcwele i-yolk (i-blastocoel) (Figure 34.21b). Izilwane ezincelisayo kulesi sigaba zakha isakhiwo esibizwa ngokuthi i-blastocyst, esibonakala ngesisindo sangaphakathi samaseli esihlukile ku-blastula ezungezile, esiboniswe ku-Figure 34.22. Ngesikhathi sokuhlukana, amaseli ahlukana ngaphandle kokwanda kwesisindo; okungukuthi, i-zygote eyodwa enkulu eneseli elilodwa ihlukana ibe amaseli amaningi amancane. Iseli ngalinye ngaphakathi kwe-blastula libizwa ngokuthi i-blastomere.

 Ukuhlukana kungenzeka ngezindlela ezimbili: ukuhlukana kwe-holoblastic (ingqikithi) noma ukuhlukana kwe-meroblastic (ingxenye). Uhlobo lokuhlukana luncike enanini le-yolk emaqandeni. Ezincelisayo ezincelisayo ze-placenta (kufaka phakathi abantu) lapho ukondliwa kunikezwa khona umzimba kamama, amaqanda anenani elincane kakhulu le-yolk futhi ahlukana ne-holoblastic. Ezinye izinhlobo, njengezinyoni, ezine-yolk eningi eqandeni ukuze zondle umbungu ngesikhathi sokukhula, zihlukana ne-meroblastic.

 Ezincelisayo, i-blastula yakha i-blastocyst esigabeni esilandelayo sokukhula. Lapha amaseli aku-blastula azihlela ngezendlalelo ezimbili: i-inner cell mass, kanye ne-outer latter ebizwa ngokuthi i-trophoblast. I-inner cell mass ibizwa nangokuthi i-embryoblast futhi le nqwaba yamaseli izoqhubeka yakhe umbungu. Kulesi sigaba sokukhula, okuboniswe ku-Figure 34.22 i-inner cell mass iqukethe ama-embryonic stem cells azohluka ngezinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli ezidingwa yizinto eziphilayo. I-trophoblast izofaka isandla ku-placenta futhi yondle umbungu
question1: Kuyini ukuhlukana?
answer1: Ukuhlukana kwamaseli okusheshayo, okuphindaphindiwe kwe-zygote okukhiqiza amaseli amaningi amancane ngaphandle kokwandisa isisindo semibungu iyonke
question2: Yisiphi isakhiwo esakhiwa ngemva kokuba i-zygote idlule ezigabeni eziningi zokuqhekeka?
answer2: I-Blastula
question3: Cishe zingaki izinhlayiya ezinazo ngaphambi kokuba zibizwe ngokuthi i-blastula?
answer3: Amaseli angaphezu kwe-100
question4: Iyini i-blastoderm?
answer4: Ingqimba eyindilinga yamaseli azungeze i-blastocoel ku-blastula
question5: Iyini i-blastocoel?
answer5: Umgodi ogcwele uketshezi noma ogcwele i-yolk ngaphakathi kwe-blastula
question6: Libizwa ngokuthini iseli ngalinye ngaphakathi kwe-blastula?
answer6: I-Blastomere
question7: Kwenzekani ngesisindo sonke se-embryo ngesikhathi sokuhlukana?
answer7: Kuhlala kufana ngenkathi amaseli eba mancane kancane kancane
question8: Yiluphi uhlobo lokuqhekeka okwenzeka ezincelisayo ezitholakala endaweni yokubeletha, kuhlanganise nabantu?
answer8: Ukuqhekeka kwe-Holoblastic (okuphelele)
question9: Kungani izilwane ezincelisayo ze-placenta zihlukaniswa yi-holoblastic?
answer9: Amaqanda azo aqukethe i-yolk encane kakhulu ngoba umama unikeza ukudla
distractor9a: Amaqanda abo aqukethe inani elikhulu le-yolk
distractor9b: Ama-embryo abo akhula ngaphandle komzimba kamama
question10: Yiluphi uhlobo lokuqhekeka olujwayelekile ezinyonini?
answer10: Ukuqhekeka kwe-Meroblastic (okuyingxenye)
distractor10a: Ukuqhekeka kwe-Holoblastic (okuphelele)
question11: Kungani izinyoni zihlukana phakathi kwezinyoni?
answer11: Amaqanda abo aqukethe inani elikhulu le-yolk elondla umbungu osakhula
distractor11c: Ama-embryo abo ahlukana nge-mitosis kuphela ngemva kokuchamisela
question12: I-blastula yezilwane ezincelisayo iba yisiphi isakhiwo ngesikhathi sesigaba esilandelayo sokuthuthukiswa?
answer12: I-Blastocyst
question13: Iyiphi ingxenye ye-blastocyst ekhula ibe yi-embryo?
question14: Liyini elinye igama lesisindo sangaphakathi seseli?
question15: Hlobo luni lwamaseli atholakala enqwabeni yangaphakathi yeseli ye-blastocyst?
answer16: Ifaka isandla ku-placenta futhi isiza ukondla umbungu

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.5 Ukuvundisa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwesibeletho Sasekuqaleni | Ukususwa Kwesisu
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.5 Fertilization and Early Embryonic Development | Gastrulation
chapterContent:
I-blastula evamile ibhola lamaseli. Isigaba esilandelayo ekukhuleni kombungu ukwakheka kohlelo lomzimba. Amaseli aku-blastula azihlela kabusha ngokwendawo ukuze akhe izingqimba ezintathu zamaseli. Le nqubo ibizwa ngokuthi i-gastrulation. Ngesikhathi se-gastrulation, i-blastula iyazigoqa ukuze yakhe izingqimba ezintathu zamaseli. Ngayinye yalezi zingqimba ibizwa ngokuthi ungqimba lwegciwane futhi ungqimba ngalunye lwegciwane luhluka ngezinhlelo zezitho ezahlukene.

 Izingqimba ezintathu zamagciwane, eziboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.23, yi-endoderm, i-ectoderm, kanye ne-mesoderm. I-ectoderm iveza uhlelo lwezinzwa kanye ne-epidermis. I-mesoderm iveza amaseli emisipha kanye nezicubu ezixhumene emzimbeni. I-endoderm iveza amaseli ekholomu atholakala ohlelweni lokugaya ukudla kanye nezitho eziningi zangaphakathi.
question1: Kuyini i-gastrulation?
answer1: Inqubo lapho i-blastula ihlela kabusha khona ukuze yakhe izingqimba ezintathu eziyinhloko zamagciwane futhi isungule uhlelo lomzimba
distractor1a: Inqubo lapho isidoda sivundisa khona iqanda
question2: Iyini injongo eyinhloko yokugaya ukudla?
answer2: Ukusungula uhlelo lomzimba ngokwenza izingqimba ezintathu zegciwane
distractor2b: Ukwandisa usayizi we-embryo ngaphandle kokuhlukaniswa kweseli
question3: I-blastula ishintsha kanjani ngesikhathi sokugaya ukudla?
answer3: Iyazigoqa ukuze yakhe izendlalelo ezintathu zamaseli
question4: Iyini ungqimba lwegciwane?
answer4: Ungqimba lwamaseli olwakhiwe ngesikhathi sokugaya ukudla olukhula lube yizicubu nezitho ezithile
question5: Zingaki izingqimba zamagciwane eziyinhloko ezakhiwa ngesikhathi sokugaya ukudla?
answer5: Okuthathu
question6: Yiziphi izingqimba ezintathu eziyinhloko zamagciwane?
answer6: I-Ectoderm, i-mesoderm, kanye ne-endoderm
question7: Yiluphi ungqimba lwamagciwane oludala isimiso sezinzwa kanye nesikhumba?
answer7: I-Ectoderm
question8: Yiluphi ungqimba lwegciwane olukhula lube amaseli emisipha kanye nezicubu ezixhumeneyo?
answer8: I-Mesoderm

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.5 Ukuvundisa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwesibeletho Sasekuqaleni | Ingabe Izingane Eziklanyiwe Zisesikhathini Sethu Esizayo?
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.5 Fertilization and Early Embryonic Development | Are Designer Babies in Our Future?
chapterContent:
Bheka uMfanekiso 34.24. Uma ubungavimbela ingane yakho ekutholeni isifo sofuzo esibhubhisayo, ubungakwenza? Ubungakhetha ubulili bengane yakho noma uyikhethe ngenxa yokukhanga kwayo, amandla, noma ukuhlakanipha? Ubungaya kude kangakanani ukuze wandise amathuba okumelana nezifo? Ubunjiniyela bezakhi zofuzo bengane yomuntu, ukukhiqizwa kwezingane eziklanyiwe ezinezimpawu ze-phenotypic ezifiselekayo, kwakuyisihloko esinqunyelwe ezinganekwaneni zesayensi. Lokhu akusenjalo: inganekwane yesayensi manje isihlangana neqiniso lesayensi. Izinqumo eziningi ze-phenotypic zenzalo sezivele zitholakala, kanti eziningi kungenzeka ukuthi zingenzeka esikhathini esizayo esingekude kakhulu. Yiziphi izici okufanele zikhethwe nokuthi kufanele zikhethwe kanjani yizihloko zempikiswano enkulu emphakathini wezokwelapha womhlaba wonke. Umugqa wokuziphatha nowokuziphatha awucaci noma uvunyelwene ngaso sonke isikhathi, futhi abanye besaba ukuthi ubuchwepheshe besimanje bokuzala bungaholela ohlotsheni olusha lwe-eugenics.

 I-Eugenics ukusetshenziswa kolwazi nobuchwepheshe obuvela emithonjeni eyahlukahlukene ukuthuthukisa ukwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo zohlanga lwesintu. Umgomo wokudala abantu abangcono ngokwezakhi zofuzo wawuvamile kakhulu (nakuba wawuphikisana) emazweni amaningana ekuqaleni kwekhulu lama-20, kodwa wadumazeka lapho iJalimane lamaNazi lisungula uhlelo olubanzi lwe-eugenics ngawo-1930 nawo-1940. Njengengxenye yohlelo lwabo, amaNazi abulala ngenkani amakhulu ezinkulungwane zalabo okuthiwa abafanelekile futhi abulala amashumi ezinkulungwane zabantu abakhubazekile ezikhungweni njengengxenye yohlelo oluhlelekile lokuthuthukisa uhlanga lwamaJalimane olungcono ngokwezakhi zofuzo olwaziwa ngokuthi ama-Aryan. Kusukela ngaleso sikhathi, imibono ye-eugenics ayizange ivezwe esidlangalaleni, kodwa kusekhona labo abayikhuthazayo.

 Kwenziwe imizamo esikhathini esidlule yokulawula izici ezinganeni zabantu kusetshenziswa isidoda esinikelwe emadodeni anezakhi ezifiselekayo. Eqinisweni, isazi se-eugenics uRobert Klark Graham sasungula ibhange lesidoda ngo-1980 elalihlanganisa amasampula avela kubanikeli kuphela abane-IQ ephezulu. Ibhange lesidoda elihlakaniphile lehlulekile ukubamba umcabango womphakathi futhi umsebenzi wavalwa ngo-1999.

 Ezikhathini zamuva nje, inqubo eyaziwa ngokuthi i-prenatal genetic diagnosis (PGD) iye yathuthukiswa. I-PGD ihilela ukuhlolwa kwama-embryo abantu njengengxenye yenqubo yokukhulelwa kwe-in vitro, lapho ama-embryo ekhulelwa khona futhi akhule ngaphandle komzimba kamama isikhathi esithile ngaphambi kokuba afakwe. Igama elithi PGD livame ukubhekisela kokubili ekuxilongweni, ekukhethweni, kanye nasekufakweni kwama-embryo akhethiwe.

 Ekusetshenzisweni kwe-PGD okungenakuphikiswana, ama-embryo ahlolwa ukuba khona kwama-allele abangela izifo zofuzo ezifana nesifo se-sickle cell, i-muscular dystrophy, kanye ne-hemophilia, lapho kutholakale khona i-allele eyodwa noma ama-allele amabili abangela isifo. Ngokukhipha ama-embryo aqukethe la ma-allele ekufakweni kumama, lesi sifo siyavinjelwa, futhi ama-embryo angasetshenziswanga anikelwa kwisayensi noma alahlwe. Bambalwa kakhulu emphakathini wezokwelapha womhlaba wonke abangabaza ukuziphatha kwalolu hlobo lwenqubo, okuvumela abantu abesaba ukuba nezingane ngenxa yama-allele abawathwalayo ukwenza kanjalo ngempumelelo. Umkhawulo omkhulu kule nqubo izindleko zayo. Ngokuvamile akumbozwa umshwalense wezokwelapha futhi ngenxa yalokho kungenakufinyeleleka ngokwezimali kubantu abaningi abashadile, amaphesenti amancane kakhulu abo bonke abazalwa bephila asebenzisa izindlela eziyinkimbinkimbi kangaka. Noma kunjalo, ngisho nasezimweni ezinjengalezi lapho izinkinga zokuziphatha zingase zibonakale zicacile, akuwona wonke umuntu ovumelana nokuziphatha kwalezi zinhlobo zezinqubo. Isibonelo, kulabo abathatha isimo sokuthi impilo yomuntu iqala ekukhulelweni, ukulahla ama-embryo angasetshenziswanga, umphumela odingekayo we-PGD, akwamukeleki ngaphansi kwanoma yiziphi izimo.

 Isimo sokuziphatha esibi kakhulu sitholakala ekukhetheni ubulili bengane, okwenziwa kalula yi-PGD. Njengamanje, amazwe afana neGreat Britain avimbele ukukhethwa kobulili bengane ngezizathu ezingezona ukuvimbela izifo ezihlobene nobulili. Amanye amazwe avumela inqubo yokulinganisela umndeni, ngokusekelwe esifisweni sabazali abathile sokuba nomntwana okungenani oyedwa wobulili ngabunye. Kanti amanye, kuhlanganise ne-United States, athathe indlela ehlakazekile yokulawula le mikhuba, ngokuyisisekelo eshiya kudokotela osebenzayo ngamunye ukuthi anqume ukuthi yimiphi imikhuba eyamukelekayo nengamukeleki.

 Ngisho nabantu abakhubazekile, njengalabo abangezwa noma abancane, bavame ukukhetha ama-embryo nge-PGD ukuqinisekisa ukuthi babelana ngokukhubazeka kwabo. Laba bazali bavame ukubhekisela ezicini eziningi ezinhle zokukhubazeka kwabo kanye namasiko ahlobene njengezizathu zokukhetha kwabo, abakubona njengelungelo labo lokuziphatha. Kwabanye, ukubangela ngamabomu ukukhubazeka enganeni kwephula isimiso sezokwelapha esiyisisekelo se-Primum non nocere, okokuqala, akulimazi. Le nqubo, nakuba ingekho emthethweni emazweni amaningi, ikhombisa ubunzima bezinkinga zokuziphatha ezihlobene nokukhetha izici zofuzo ezinganeni.

 Le nqubo ingaholelaphi? Ingabe lobu buchwepheshe buzoba buthengeka kakhulu futhi kufanele busetshenziswe kanjani? Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buzothuthuka ngokushesha nangokungalindelekile, ukuntuleka kweziqondiso eziqondile zokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuzala ngaphambi kokuba buvele kungenza kube nzima ngabameli ukuba bahambisane nesivinini uma sebeqashelwe, becabanga ukuthi inqubo idinga noma yimuphi umthetho kahulumeni nhlobo. Abanye ochwepheshe be-bioethic bathi kufanele sibhekane nobuchwepheshe obukhona manje kuphela, hhayi esikhathini esizayo esingaqinisekile. Baphikisana ngokuthi lezi zinhlobo zezinqubo zizohlala zibiza kakhulu futhi zingavamile, ngakho-ke ukwesaba kwe-eugenics kanye ne-master`izinhlanga akunasisekelo futhi kukhulunywe ngokweqile. Impikiswano iyaqhubeka.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukukhiqizwa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.6 Ukwakheka Kwe-Organogenesis Nokwakheka Kwe-Vertebrate Axis | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.6 Organogenesis and Vertebrate Axis Formation | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ulwazi olukulesi sigaba alukho ngaphakathi kobubanzi be-AP®. Ukwakheka kwezitho ezivela ezingqimbeni ze-germ embryonic kubangelwa ukuvezwa kwamaqoqo athile ezakhi zofuzo ezinquma uhlobo lweseli. I-organogenesis ifundwe elabhorethri kusetshenziswa i-fruit fly (Drosophila) kanye ne-nematode Caenorhabditis elegans. Ezilwaneni ezinomgogodla, esinye sezinyathelo eziyinhloko ngesikhathi se-organogenesis ukwakheka kwesistimu yezinzwa kusuka ku-ectoderm ye-embryonic. Ukwakheka kwama-axes omzimba (lateral-medial, dorsal-ventral, kanye ne-anterior-posterior) kuyisigaba esibalulekile sokuthuthukiswa ngaphansi kokulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe kulesi sigaba azikho ngaphakathi kobubanzi be-AP® futhi azihambisani noHlaka Lwezifundo.

 Ukugaya kuholela ekwakhekeni kwezingqimba ezintathu zamagciwane ezibangela, ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo, ezithweni ezahlukene emzimbeni wesilwane. Le nqubo ibizwa ngokuthi i-organogenesis. I-organogenesis ibonakala ngokunyakaza okusheshayo nokunembile kwamaseli ngaphakathi kombungu.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukukhiqizwa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.6 Ukukhiqizwa Kwe-Organogenesis Nokwakheka Kwe-Axis Yethambo | Ukukhiqizwa Kwe-Organogenesis
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.6 Organogenesis and Vertebrate Axis Formation | Organogenesis
chapterContent:
Izitho zomzimba zakha kusukela ezingqimbeni zegciwane ngenqubo yokuhlukanisa. Ngesikhathi sokuhlukanisa, amaseli okuqala e-embryonic aveza amasethi athile ezakhi zofuzo azonquma uhlobo lwawo lokugcina lweseli. Isibonelo, amanye amaseli ku-ectoderm azoveza izakhi zofuzo eziqondene namaseli esikhumba. Ngenxa yalokho, lawa maseli azohluka abe amaseli e-epidermal. Inqubo yokuhlukanisa ilawulwa yizinhlayiya zesignali zamaseli.

 Ososayensi bafunda kabanzi nge-organogenesis elebhu yezimpukane zezithelo (i-Drosophila) kanye ne-nematode Caenorhabditis elegans. I-Drosophila inezingxenye emizimbeni yazo, futhi ukwakheka kwezingxenye kuvumele ososayensi ukuthi batadishe ukuthi yiziphi izakhi zofuzo ezidlala indima ebalulekile ku-organogenesis ngobude be-embryo ngezikhathi ezahlukene. I-nematode C.elegans inamaseli angama-somatic angaba yi-1000 futhi ososayensi bafunde isiphetho seseli ngalinye ngesikhathi sokukhula kwalo emjikelezweni wokuphila kwe-nematode. Kunokwehluka okuncane emaphethini ohlu lweseli phakathi kwabantu, ngokungafani nezilwane ezincelisayo lapho ukuthuthukiswa kwamaseli kusuka ku-embryo kuncike ezinkombeni zamaseli.

 Ezilwaneni ezinomgogodla, esinye sezinyathelo eziyinhloko ngesikhathi se-organogenesis ukwakheka kwesistimu ye-neural. I-ectoderm yakha amaseli nezicubu ze-epithelial, kanye nezicubu ze-neuronal. Ngesikhathi sokwakhiwa kwesistimu ye-neural, ama-molecule akhethekile okubonisa abizwa ngokuthi izinto zokukhula abonisa amanye amaseli emaphethelweni e-ectoderm ukuthi abe amaseli e-epidermis. Amaseli asele maphakathi akha ipuleti le-neural. Uma ukubonakaliswa yizinto zokukhula kuphazanyiswa, khona-ke yonke i-ectoderm izohluka ibe yizicubu ze-neural.

 Ipuleti le-neural lidlula ochungechungeni lokunyakaza kwamaseli lapho ligoqa khona bese lenza ithubhu ebizwa ngokuthi ithubhu le-neural, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.25. Ekuthuthukisweni okuqhubekayo, ithubhu le-neural lizoveza ubuchopho kanye nomgogodla.

 I-mesoderm elele ohlangothini ngalunye lwethubhu le-neural le-vertebrate izokhula ibe yizicubu ezahlukahlukene zomzimba wesilwane. Iphethini yendawo yokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ihlela kabusha i-mesoderm ibe amaqembu amaseli abizwa ngokuthi ama-somite anezikhala phakathi kwawo. Ama-somite aboniswe ku-Figure 34.26 azokhula abe amaseli akha amathambo nezimbambo, i-dermis yesikhumba sangemuva, imisipha yamathambo emhlane, kanye nemisipha yamathambo odongeni lomzimba kanye nemilenze. I-mesoderm iphinde yakha isakhiwo esibizwa ngokuthi i-notochord, esimise okwenduku futhi sakha i-axis ephakathi yomzimba wesilwane.

chapterContent:
Ngisho noma izingqimba zegciwane zakha, ibhola lamaseli lisaqhubeka nokuba nesimo salo esiyindilinga. Kodwa-ke, imizimba yezilwane inezingqimba ezisemaceleni (kwesobunxele-kwesokudla), ezisemaceleni ezingemuva (esiswini sangemuva), kanye nezingaphambili-ngemuva (ikhanda- izinyawo), okuboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.27.

 Lokhu kusungulwa kanjani? Kokunye kokuhlolwa okubaluleke kakhulu okwake kwenziwa ku-biology yokuthuthukiswa, uSpemann noMangold bathatha amaseli omgogodla komunye umbungu bawafaka esifundeni sesisu somunye umbungu. Bathole ukuthi umbungu otshaliwe manje wawunezingqimba ezimbili: eyodwa endaweni yomgogodla kusukela kumaseli okuqala kanye nenye endaweni yokufakelwa. Lokhu kusikisela ukuthi amaseli omgogodla ahlelwe ngokwezakhi zofuzo ukuze akhe ingqimba futhi achaze i-axis. Kusukela ngaleso sikhathi, abacwaningi bathole izakhi zofuzo eziningi ezibangela ukwakheka kwe-axis. Ukuguquka kwalezi zakhi zofuzo kuholela ekulahlekelweni kokulingana okudingekayo ekuthuthukisweni kwezinto eziphilayo.

 Imizimba yezilwane inokulingana okubonakalayo kwangaphandle. Kodwa-ke, izitho zangaphakathi azilingani. Isibonelo, inhliziyo ingakwesobunxele kanti isibindi singakwesokudla. Ukwakheka kwe-axis ephakathi kwesobunxele nesokudla kuyinqubo ebalulekile ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kungalingani kwangaphakathi kusungulwa kusenesikhathi ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa futhi kuhilela izakhi zofuzo eziningi. Ucwaningo lusaqhubeka ukuze kuqondwe ngokugcwele imiphumela yokuthuthukiswa kwalezi zakhi zofuzo.

answer8: Kusenesikhathi kakhulu ngesikhathi sokukhula kombungu

answer10: Ososayensi basasebenza ukuze baqonde ngokugcwele ukuthi izakhi zofuzo ezilawula ukungalingani komzimba zisebenza kanjani ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa

Ulwazi olukulesi sigaba alukho ngaphakathi kwesilinganiso se-AP®, futhi kungenzeka ukuthi walufunda lolu lwazi ekilasini lezempilo langaphambilini. Kodwa-ke, uma ungajwayelene nolwazi, manje sekuyisikhathi sokulufunda. Akukhona nje kuphela ukuthi ulwazi luyinto ethakazelisayo nenolwazi, luyasebenza futhi lufanele noma yimuphi umuntu osemdala wokuzala, okuhlanganisa nabafundi besikole samabanga aphezulu esifundweni se-AP®.

 Ukukhulelwa kuqala ngokukhulelwa kweqanda futhi kuqhubeke kuze kube yilapho umuntu ezalwa. Ubude besikhathi sokukhulelwa ezilwaneni buyahlukahluka, kusukela ezinsukwini ezingu-60 ezinjeni nasemakatini kuya ezinsukwini ezingu-266 kubantu. Ukuvimbela ukukhulelwa kwenzeka ngaphansi kwemigomo yokuvimbela inzalo noma yokulawula inzalo. Ngoba ulwazi lwezinhlelo ze-endocrine nokuthi ama-hormone asebenza kanjani luyadingeka ku-AP®, ulwazi olukulesi sigaba mayelana nezindlela zama-hormone zokuvimbela inzalo, njengokulawula inzalo, lusebenza ikakhulukazi.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yoHlaka Lwezifundo Ze-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlelo Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis eguquguqukayo.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.C
Izinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa izindlela zokuphendula ukulawula ukukhula nokuzala, kanye nokugcina i-homeostasis eguquguqukayo.

2.C.1 Izinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa izindlela zokuphendula ukuze zilondoloze izindawo zazo zangaphakathi futhi ziphendule ezinguqukweni zemvelo zangaphandle.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.7 Ukukhulelwa Nokuzalwa Kwabantu | Ukukhulelwa Kwabantu
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.7 Human Pregnancy and Birth | Human Gestation
chapterContent:
Amahora angamashumi amabili nane ngaphambi kokukhulelwa, iqanda seliqedile i-meiosis futhi liba yi-oocyte evuthiwe. Lapho livundiswa (ekukhulelweni) iqanda liyaziwa ngokuthi yi-zygote. I-zygote ihamba nge-oviduct iye esibelethweni (Isithombe 34.28). Umbungu osakhula kumele ufakwe odongeni lwesibeletho zingakapheli izinsuku eziyisikhombisa, noma uzowohloka bese ushona. Izendlalelo zangaphandle ze-zygote (blastocyst) zikhula zibe yi-endometrium ngokugaya amaseli e-endometrial, futhi ukuphulukiswa kwamanxeba kwe-endometrium kuvala i-blastocyst ezicutshini. Olunye ungqimba lwe-blastocyst, i-chorion, luqala ukukhulula i-hormone ebizwa ngokuthi i-human beta chorionic gonadotropin (β-HCG) efika ku-corpus luteum futhi igcine leso sakhiwo sisebenza. Lokhu kuqinisekisa amazinga anele e-progesterone azogcina i-endometrium yesibeletho ukusekela umbungu osakhula. Ukuhlolwa kokukhulelwa kunquma izinga le-β-HCG emchameni noma egazini. Uma i-hormone ikhona, ukuhlolwa kuyatholakala.

 Isikhathi sokukhulelwa sihlukaniswe ngezigaba ezintathu ezilinganayo noma ama-trimester. Phakathi namasonto amabili kuya kwamane okuqala e-trimester yokuqala, ukudla okunomsoco kanye nokungcola kuphathwa yi-endometrial lining ngokusebenzisa ukusabalala. Njengoba i-trimester iqhubeka, ungqimba lwangaphandle lwe-embryo luqala ukuhlangana ne-endometrium, bese kwakheka i-placenta. Lesi sitho sithatha izidingo zezakhamzimba kanye nokungcola kwe-embryo kanye ne-fetus, lapho igazi likamama lidlulisela izakhamzimba kwi-placenta futhi lisusa ukungcola kuyo. Amakhemikhali avela ku-fetus, njenge-bilirubin, acutshungulwa yisibindi sikamama ukuze asuswe. Amanye ama-immunoglobulins kamama azodlula kwi-placenta, anikeze ukuzivikela okungasebenzi ngokumelene nokutheleleka okungenzeka.

 Izitho zangaphakathi kanye nezakhiwo zomzimba ziqala ukukhula phakathi ne-trimester yokuqala. Emasontweni amahlanu, amahlumela emilenze, amehlo, inhliziyo, nesibindi sekuvele kwakhiwe. Emasontweni ayisishiyagalombili, igama elithi fetus liyasebenza, futhi umzimba usuvele wakhiwe, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.29. Umuntu cishe unobude obuyisihlanu amasentimitha (amasentimitha amabili) futhi izitho eziningi, njengamaphaphu nesibindi, azikasebenzi. Ukuchayeka kunoma yibuphi ubuthi kuyingozi kakhulu phakathi nekota yokuqala, njengoba zonke izitho zomzimba nezakhiwo ziqala ukukhula. Noma yini ethinta lokho kukhula ingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekusindeni kombungu.

 Ngesikhathi sekota yesibili, umbungu ukhula ube cishe ngamasentimitha angu-30 amasentimitha (amasentimitha angu-12), njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.30. Uba matasa futhi umama uvame ukuzwa ukunyakaza kokuqala. Zonke izitho nezakhiwo ziyaqhubeka nokukhula. I-placenta isithathe imisebenzi yokudla okunempilo kanye nokungcola kanye nokukhiqizwa kwe-estrogen ne-progesterone kusuka ku-corpus luteum, eye yawohloka. I-placenta izoqhubeka nokusebenza kuze kube yilapho umntwana ezalwa.

 Ngesikhathi sekota yesithathu, ingane ikhula ibe ngu-3 kuya ku-4 kg (6 1⁄2 -8 1⁄2 lbs.) kanye nobude obungaba ngu-50 cm (19-20 inches), njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.31. Lesi yisikhathi sokukhula okusheshayo ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa. Ukukhula kwezitho zomzimba kuyaqhubeka kuze kube sekuzalweni (futhi ezinye izinhlelo, njengesimiso sezinzwa nesibindi, ziyaqhubeka nokukhula ngemva kokuzalwa). Umama uzoba sesimweni esinzima kakhulu phakathi nale trimester. Angase achame njalo ngenxa yokucindezela kwesinye okuvela kumntwana. Kungase kube nokuvaleka kwamathumbu nezinkinga zokujikeleza kwegazi, ikakhulukazi emilenzeni yakhe. Amahlule angase akheke emilenzeni yakhe ngenxa yokucindezela okuvela kumntwana emithanjeni ebuyayo njengoba ingena emgodini wesisu.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.7 Ukukhulelwa Nokuzalwa Kwabantu | Ukubeletha Nokuzalwa
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.7 Human Pregnancy and Birth | Labor and Birth
chapterContent:
Ukubeletha kuyimizamo yomzimba yokukhipha umbungu kanye ne-placenta esibelethweni ngesikhathi sokuzalwa (ukubeletha). Ngasekupheleni kwe-trimester yesithathu, i-estrogen ibangela ama-receptor odongeni lwesibeletho ukuba akhe futhi abophe i-hormone i-oxytocin. Ngalesi sikhathi, umntwana uyashintsha, ebheke phambili naphansi ngemuva noma umqhele wekhanda uhilela umlomo wesibeletho (ukuvulwa kwesibeletho). Lokhu kubangela ukuthi umlomo wesibeletho weluleke futhi kuthunyelwe imizwa yemizwa ku-hypothalamus, okubonisa ukukhishwa kwe-oxytocin kusuka ku-posterior pituitary. I-oxytocin ibangela ukuthi imisipha ebushelelezi odongeni lwesibeletho inciphe. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, i-placenta ikhipha ama-prostaglandin esibelethweni, okwandisa ukuncipha. Ukudluliselwa kwempendulo enhle kwenzeka phakathi kwesibeletho, i-hypothalamus, kanye ne-posterior pituitary ukuqinisekisa ukutholakala okwanele kwe-oxytocin. Njengoba kuhlanganiswa amangqamuzana emisipha abushelelezi, ukuncipha kwanda ngamandla.

 Kunezigaba ezintathu zokubeletha. Ngesikhathi sesigaba sokuqala, umlomo wesibeletho uyancipha futhi unwebeke. Lokhu kuyadingeka ukuze umntwana kanye ne-placenta kukhishwe ngesikhathi sokuzalwa. Umlomo wesibeletho ekugcineni uzokhula ube cishe yi-10 cm . Ngesikhathi sesigaba sesibili, umntwana uyakhishwa esibelethweni. Isibeletho siyafinyela futhi umama uyasunduza njengoba ecindezela imisipha yesisu sakhe ukusiza ukubeletha. Isigaba sokugcina ukudlula kwe-placenta ngemva kokuba umntwana ezelwe futhi isitho sesiphumile ngokuphelele odongeni lwesibeletho. Uma ukubeletha kufanele kume ngaphambi kokuba kufinyelelwe esigabeni sesibili, i-oxytocin yokwenziwa inganikezwa ukuze kuqalwe kabusha futhi kugcinwe ukubeletha.

 Enye indlela esikhundleni sokubeletha nokubeletha ukubeletha ngokuhlinzwa komntwana ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-Caesarian section. Lokhu ukuhlinzwa okukhulu kwesisu futhi kungaholela ezinkingeni zangemva kokuhlinzwa kumama, kodwa kwezinye izimo kungaba yindlela kuphela yokubeletha umntwana ngokuphephile.

 Izindlala zebele zikamama zidlula ezinguqukweni phakathi nekota yesithathu ukulungiselela ukuncelisa nokuncelisa. Lapho umntwana eqala ukuncela ebeleni, izimpawu zithunyelwa ku-hypothalamus okubangela ukukhululwa kwe-prolactin kusuka ku-anterior pituitary. I-Prolactin ibangela ukuthi izindlala zebele zikhiqize ubisi. I-Oxytocin nayo iyakhishwa, ikhuthaza ukukhishwa kobisi. Ubisi luqukethe izakhamzimba zokukhula nokukhula komntwana kanye nama-immunoglobulins ukuvikela ingane ezifweni ezibangelwa amagciwane kanye namagciwane.

Ukuvimbela ukukhulelwa kuhambisana namagama athi ukuvimbela ukukhulelwa noma ukuvimbela ukukhulelwa. Empeleni, ukuvimbela ukukhulelwa kubhekisela ekuvimbeleni isidoda neqanda ukuthi lingahlangani. Nokho, womabili la magama avame ukusetshenziswa ngokushintshana.

 Ithebula Lezindlela Zokuvimbela Ukukhulelwa libala izindlela ezivamile zokuvimbela ukukhulelwa. Amazinga okuhluleka abhalwe phansi akuzona amazinga afanele angatholakala, kodwa amazinga ajwayelekile ayenzeka. Izinga lokuhluleka inani lokukhulelwa elivela ekusetshenzisweni kwale ndlela esikhathini sezinyanga eziyishumi nambili. Izindlela zokuvimbela, njengekhondomu, izigqoko zomlomo wesibeletho, kanye nama-diaphragm, zivimba isidoda ukuthi singangeni esibelethweni, zivimbele ukukhulelwa. Ama-spermicides amakhemikhali afakwa esithweni sangasese sangasese abulala isidoda. Ama-sponge, agcwele ama-spermicides, afakwa esithweni sangasese sangasese somlomo wesibeletho. Inhlanganisela yamakhemikhali okubulala isidoda kanye nezindlela zokuvimbela inzalo ifinyelela amazinga okuhluleka aphansi kunezindlela lapho zisetshenziswa ngokwehlukana.

 Cishe ingxenye yesine yemibhangqwana esebenzisa izindlela zokuvimbela inzalo, ukuhlela umndeni ngokwemvelo, noma ukuhoxa ingalindela ukwehluleka kwale ndlela. Ukuhlela umndeni ngokwemvelo kusekelwe ekuqapheni umjikelezo wokuya esikhathini kanye nokuba nobulili kuphela ngezikhathi lapho iqanda lingatholakali. Izinga lokushisa lomzimba wowesifazane lingakhuphuka nge-degree Celsius lapho kuvuthwa futhi uketshezi lomlomo wesibeletho lunganda ngobuningi futhi lube lula ukugoba. Lezi zinguquko zinikeza inkomba ejwayelekile yokuthi kunini lapho ucansi lungase lubangele ukukhulelwa. Ukukhipha i-penis esithweni sangasese sowesifazane ngesikhathi socansi, ngaphambi kokuba kwenzeke ukukhishwa kwe-ejaculation. Lena indlela eyingozi enezinga eliphezulu lokwehluleka ngenxa yokuba khona kwesidoda ekukhishweni kwe-bulbourethral gland, okungase kungene esithweni sangasese sowesifazane ngaphambi kokukhipha i-penis.

 Izindlela zama-hormone zisebenzisa i-progesterone yokwenziwa (ngezinye izikhathi ihlanganiswe ne-estrogen), ukuvimbela i-hypothalamus ekukhipheni i-FSH noma i-LH, ngaleyo ndlela kuvimbe iqanda ukuthi lingatholakali ukuze likhulelwe. Indlela yokunikeza i-hormone ithinta izinga lokwehluleka. Indlela ethembeke kakhulu, enezinga lokwehluleka elingaphansi kwe-1%, ukufakwa kwe-hormone ngaphansi kwesikhumba. Izinga elifanayo lingatholakala ngezinqubo zokubulala inzalo ze-vasectomy endodeni noma ze-tubal ligation kowesifazane, noma ngokusebenzisa idivayisi ye-intrauterine (IUD). Ama-IUD afakwa esibelethweni futhi asungula isimo sokuvuvukala esivimbela amaqanda avundisiwe ukuthi angatshali odongeni lwesibeletho.

 Ukuhambisana nendlela yokuvimbela inzalo kunegalelo elikhulu empumelelweni noma ekuhlulekeni kwanoma iyiphi indlela ethile. Indlela kuphela esebenza ngokuphelele ekuvimbeleni ukukhulelwa ukuzithiba. Ukukhetha indlela yokuvimbela inzalo kuncike emigomweni yowesifazane noma umbhangqwana. Ukubopha i-Tubal kanye ne-vasectomy kubhekwa njengokuvimbela okuhlala njalo, kanti ezinye izindlela ziyakwazi ukuguqulwa futhi zinikeza ukuvimbela inzalo kwesikhashana.

 Ukuqeda ukukhulelwa okukhona kungaba okuzenzakalelayo noma ngokuzithandela. Ukuqeda inzalo ngokuzenzakalelayo kuyisisu futhi kuvame ukwenzeka ekuqaleni kokukhulelwa, ngokuvamile phakathi namasonto ambalwa okuqala. Lokhu kwenzeka lapho ingane ingakwazi ukukhula kahle futhi ukukhulelwa kuqedwa ngokwemvelo. Ukuqeda inzalo ngokuzithandela kuyisisu. Imithetho elawula ukukhipha isisu iyahlukahluka phakathi kwezimo futhi ivame ukubuka ukuphila kwengane njengezindlela zokuvumela noma ukuvimbela inqubo.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 34. Ukuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.7 Ukukhulelwa Nokuzalwa Kwabantu | Ukungazali
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.7 Human Pregnancy and Birth | Infertility
chapterContent:
Ukungazali ukungakwazi ukukhulelwa umntwana noma ukuzala umntwana. Cishe amaphesenti angama-75 ezimbangela zokungazali zingatholakala; lezi zifaka phakathi izifo, njengezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi ezingabangela izibazi zamapayipi okuzala kwabesilisa noma kwabesifazane, noma izinkinga zokukhula ezivame ukuhlotshaniswa namazinga ama-hormone angajwayelekile komunye wabantu. Ukondleka okwanele, ikakhulukazi indlala, kungalibazisa ukuya esikhathini. Ukucindezeleka kungaphinde kuholele ekungazali. Ukucindezeleka kwesikhathi esifushane kungathinta amazinga ama-hormone, kanti ukucindezeleka kwesikhathi eside kungalibazisa ukuthomba futhi kubangele imijikelezo yokuya esikhathini engavamile. Ezinye izici ezithinta ukuzala zifaka ubuthi (njenge-cadmium), ukubhema ugwayi, ukusebenzisa insangu, ukulimala kwe-gonadal, nokuguga.

 Uma kutholakala ukungabi namntwana, ubuchwepheshe obuningana bokusiza ekuzaleni (ART) buyatholakala ukusiza ekukhulelweni. Uhlobo oluvamile lwe-ART ukuvundiswa kwe-in vitro (IVF) lapho iqanda nesidoda kuhlanganiswa khona ngaphandle komzimba bese kufakwa esibelethweni. Amaqanda atholakala kowesifazane ngemuva kokwelashwa okubanzi kwama-hormone okulungiselela amaqanda avuthiwe ukuvundiswa futhi alungiselele isibeletho ukufakwa kweqanda elivundisiwe. Isidoda sitholakala endodeni futhi sihlanganiswa namaqanda futhi sisekelwe ngokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli amaningana ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ama-zygote ayakwazi ukuphila. Lapho ama-embryo esefinyelele esigabeni samaseli ayisishiyagalombili, elilodwa noma ngaphezulu lifakwa esibelethweni sowesifazane. Uma ukukhulelwa kungenziwa nge-IVF elula, inqubo yokufaka isidoda eqandeni ingasetshenziswa. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) futhi kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 34.32. Izinqubo ze-IVF zikhiqiza amaqanda amaningi avundisiwe kanye nama-embryo angaqandiswa futhi agcinwe ukuze asetshenziswe esikhathini esizayo. Lezi zinqubo zingaphinde ziholele ekuzalweni okuningi.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 34. Ukuzaliswa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane | 34.9 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Animal Structure and Function | 34. Animal Reproduction and Development | 34.9 Chapter Summary
chapterContent:
34.1 Izindlela Zokuzala
Ukuzala kungaba okungaxutshwanga ngokobulili lapho umuntu oyedwa ekhiqiza inzalo efana ngokofuzo, noma ngokobulili lapho izinto zofuzo ezivela kubantu ababili zihlanganiswa ukukhiqiza inzalo ehlukahlukene ngokofuzo. Ukuzala okungaxutshwanga ngokobulili kwenzeka ngokuhlukana, ukuhluma, nokuqhekeka. Ukuzala ngokocansi kungasho ukuhlangana kwesidoda namaqanda emizimbeni yezilwane noma kungasho ukukhululwa kwesidoda namaqanda endaweni ezungezile. Umuntu angaba ubulili obubodwa, noma kokubili; kungaqala njengobulili obubodwa futhi kushintshe ngesikhathi sokuphila kwakhe, noma kungahlala kungowesilisa noma owesifazane.

 34.2 Ukuvundisa
Ukuzala ngokocansi kuqala ngokuhlanganiswa kwesidoda neqanda enqubweni ebizwa ngokuthi ukuvundisa. Lokhu kungenzeka ngaphandle kwemizimba noma ngaphakathi kowesifazane. Zombili izindlela zinezinzuzo kanye nokungalungi. Uma sekuvundisiwe, amaqanda angakhula ngaphakathi kowesifazane noma ngaphandle. Uma iqanda likhula ngaphandle komzimba, ngokuvamile linesivikelo esivikelayo phezu kwalo. Ukwakheka kwesilwane kwavela izindlela ezahlukene zokuvundisa, ukubamba, noma ukukhipha iqanda. Indlela yokuvundisa iyahlukahluka phakathi kwezilwane. Ezinye izinhlobo zikhulula iqanda nesidoda endaweni ezungezile, ezinye izinhlobo zigcina iqanda bese zithola isidoda emzimbeni wesifazane bese zikhipha umbungu osakhula umbozwe yigobolondo, kanti ezinye izinhlobo zigcina inzalo ekhulayo ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa.

 34.3 I-Anatomy Yokuzala Komuntu kanye ne-Gametogenesis
Njengoba izilwane ziba nzima kakhulu, izitho ezithile kanye nezinhlelo zezitho zakhiwe ukusekela imisebenzi ethile yezinto eziphilayo. Izakhiwo zokuzala ezavela ezilwaneni zasezweni zivumela abesilisa nabesifazane ukuba bahlangane, bavundise ngaphakathi, futhi basekele ukukhula nokukhula kwenzalo. Izinqubo zakhiwe ukukhiqiza amangqamuzana okuzala ayenengxenye yenombolo yama-chromosome omzali ngamunye ukuze inhlanganisela entsha ibe nenani elifanele lezinto zofuzo. I-Gametogenesis, ukukhiqizwa kwesidoda (i-spermatogenesis) namaqanda (i-oogenesis), kwenzeka ngenqubo ye-meiosis.

 34.4 Ukulawulwa Kwama-Hormonal Kokuzala Komuntu
Imijikelezo yokuzala yowesilisa nowesifazane ilawulwa ama-hormone akhishwa kwi-hypothalamus kanye ne-anterior pituitary kanye nama-hormone avela ezicutshini zokuzala kanye nezitho. I-hypothalamus iqapha isidingo sama-hormone e-FSH ne-LH enziwa futhi akhishwe ku-anterior pituitary. I-FSH ne-LH zithinta izakhiwo zokuzala ukuze zibangele ukwakheka kwesidoda kanye nokulungiselela amaqanda okukhululwa kanye nokukhulelwa okungenzeka. Kwabesilisa, i-FSH ne-LH zivuselela amangqamuzana e-Sertoli kanye namaseli angaphakathi kwe-Leydig kuma-testes ukuze kube lula ukukhiqizwa kwesidoda. Amangqamuzana e-Leydig akhiqiza i-testosterone, ephinde ibe nesibopho sezici zobulili zesibili zabesilisa. Kwabesifazane, i-FSH ne-LH zibangela ukuthi kukhiqizwe i-estrogen ne-progesterone. Zilawula uhlelo lokuzala lwabesifazane oluhlukaniswe umjikelezo we-ovarian kanye nomjikelezo wokuya esikhathini. Ukunqamuka kokuya esikhathini kwenzeka lapho ama-ovari elahlekelwa ukuzwela kwawo ku-FSH ne-LH futhi imijikelezo yokuzala yabesifazane yehla iyeke.

 34.5 Ukuqunjelwa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwasekuqaleni Kwe-Embryonic
Izigaba zokuqala zokukhula kwe-embryonic ziqala ngokuqunjelwa. Inqubo yokuqunjelwa ilawulwa ngokuqinile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isidoda esisodwa kuphela esihlangana neqanda elilodwa. Ngemva kokuqunjelwa, i-zygote iyaqhekeka ukuze yakhe i-blastula. I-blastula, kwezinye izinhlobo iyibhola elingenalutho lamaseli, idlula enkambisweni ebizwa ngokuthi i-gastrulation, lapho kwakheka khona izingqimba ezintathu zamagciwane. I-ectoderm iveza uhlelo lwezinzwa kanye namaseli esikhumba e-epidermal, i-mesoderm iveza amaseli emisipha kanye nezicubu ezixhumene emzimbeni, kanti i-endoderm iveza amaseli e-columnar kanye nezitho zangaphakathi.

 34.6 I-Organogenesis kanye ne-Vertebrate Axis Formation
I-Organogenesis ukwakheka kwezitho ezivela ezingqimbeni zamagciwane. Izingqimba ngayinye zamagciwane iveza izinhlobo ezithile zezicubu. Isigaba sokuqala ukwakheka kohlelo lwezinzwa ku-ectoderm. I-mesoderm iveza ama-somite kanye ne-notochord. Ukwakheka kwe-vertebrate axis esinye isigaba esibalulekile sokuthuthukiswa.

 34.7 Ukukhulelwa Nokuzalwa Komuntu
Ukukhulelwa komuntu kuqala ngokukhulelwa kweqanda futhi kuqhubekela ezinyangeni ezintathu zokukhulelwa. Inqubo yokubeletha inezigaba ezintathu (ukufinyela, ukubeletha kwengane, ukukhishwa kwe-placenta), ngasinye siqhutshwa ama-hormone. I-trimester yokuqala ibeka izakhiwo eziyisisekelo zomzimba, okuhlanganisa ama-limb buds, inhliziyo, amehlo, nesibindi. I-trimester yesibili iyaqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa kwazo zonke izitho nezinhlelo. I-trimester yesithathu ibonisa ukukhula okukhulu kwengane futhi iphetha ngokubeletha nokubeletha. Ukuvimbela ukukhulelwa kungenziwa ngezindlela ezahlukene okuhlanganisa izithiyo, ama-hormone, noma ezinye izindlela. Ubuchwepheshe bokuzala obusizayo bungasiza abantu abanezinkinga zokuzala

question68: Chaza ukufana nokwehluka kwempendulo yocansi kwabesilisa nabesifazane
answer68: Kokubili abesilisa nabesifazane babonisa ukwanda kwesilinganiso senhliziyo, izinga lokuphefumula, kanye nomfutho wegazi phakathi nesigaba sokuqala nesesibili. Kodwa-ke, impendulo yocansi iyahluka ngobukhulu kanye nobude besikhathi kwabesilisa nabesifazane. Futhi, abesilisa babonisa ukuvuka okuthile, kuyilapho abesifazane bebonisa ukuvuka okungaqondile.
distractor68a: Kokubili abesilisa nabesifazane babonisa ukuvuka okuthile, kodwa impendulo yocansi iyahluka ngamandla nangobude besikhathi
distractor68b: Kokubili abesilisa nabesifazane babonisa ukuvuka okuthile. Kwabesilisa, izinga lokuphefumula kanye nezinga lokushaya kwenhliziyo liyakhuphuka. Kwabesifazane, kukhona ukwehla kwezinga lokuphefumula kanye nezinga lokushaya kwenhliziyo
distractor68c: Ukwanda kwe-vasodilation kwenzeka kokubili kwabesilisa nabesifazane, okuvumela igazi ukuthi lifake izicubu zobulili emabeleni, e-clitoris, e-labia, esithweni sangasese sowesifazane, kanye nasepenis. Kwabesilisa, izinga lokuphefumula kanye nezinga lokushaya kwenhliziyo liyakhuphuka. Kwabesifazane, kukhona ukwehla kwesilinganiso sokuphefumula kanye nezinga lokushaya kwenhliziyo.
question69: Qhathanisa futhi uqhathanise i-spermatogenesis kanye ne-oogenesis
answer69: Zombili ziyisimo se-gametogenesis esenzeka nge-meiosis. I-Spermatogenesis yinqubo yokwakheka kwesidoda esine emasendeni kwabesilisa. Inqubo yokwakheka kweqanda elilodwa ema-ovari kwabesifazane ibizwa ngokuthi i-oogenesis.
distractor69a: Zombili ziyisimo se-gametogenesis esenzeka nge-mitosis. I-Spermatogenesis yinqubo yokwakheka kwesidoda esine emasendeni kwabesilisa. Inqubo yokwakheka kweqanda elilodwa ema-ovari kwabesifazane ibizwa ngokuthi i-oogenesis.
distractor69b: Zombili ziyisimo se-gametogenesis esenzeka nge-meiosis. I-Spermatogenesis yinqubo yokwakheka kwesidoda esine emasendeni kwabesilisa. Inqubo yokwakheka kwamaqanda amane emaqanda kwabesifazane ibizwa ngokuthi i-oogenesis.
distractor69c: Zombili ziyisimo se-gametogenesis esenzeka nge-meiosis. I-Spermatogenesis inqubo yokwakheka kwesidoda esisodwa kuma-testes kwabesilisa, kanti inqubo yokwakheka kweqanda elilodwa kuma-ovari kwabesifazane ibizwa ngokuthi i-oogenesis.
question70: Ngokusekelwe ekuqondeni kwakho ukulawula ama-hormone okuzala kwabantu, chaza ukuthi i-hypothalamus ilawula kanjani ukukhiqizwa kwama-hormone okuzala kwabesilisa
answer70: I-hypothalamus ivuselela ukukhishwa kwe-FSH ne-LH ngesikhathi sokuthomba ngokukhipha i-GnRH. I-FSH ivuselela amangqamuzana e-Sertoli kuma-testes, kanti i-LH ivuselela amangqamuzana e-Leydig ukuze akhiqize futhi akhiphe i-testosterone.
distractor70a: I-hypothalamus ikhipha i-FSH kanye ne-LH ngesikhathi sokuthomba ngokukhipha i-GnRH. I-FSH ivuselela amaseli e-Leydig kuma-testes, kanti i-LH ivuselela amaseli e-Sertoli ukuze akhiqize futhi akhiphe i-testosterone.
distractor70b: I-hypothalamus ikhipha i-FSH ne-LH ngesikhathi sokuthomba ngokukhipha i-GHRH. I-FSH ivuselela amangqamuzana e-Sertoli kuma-testes, kanti i-LH ivuselela amangqamuzana e-Leydig ukuze akhiqize futhi akhiphe i-testosterone.
distractor70c: I-hypothalamus ikhipha i-TSH ne-LH ngesikhathi sokuthomba ngokukhipha i-GnRH. I-TSH ivuselela amangqamuzana e-Sertoli kuma-testes, kanti i-LH ivuselela amangqamuzana e-Leydig ukuze akhiqize futhi akhiphe i-testosterone.

distractor76b: Izici zokukhula zikhomba ukuthi amanye amangqamuzana e-ectodermal akha amangqamuzana e-epidermal, kanti amanye amangqamuzana akha amangqamuzana e-neural crest.
distractor76c: Amaprotheni ahilelekile endleleni yokubonisana ye-Wnt abonisa amangqamuzana e-ectodermal ukwakha amangqamuzana e-epidermal kanye ne-neural plate
question77: Bheka uMfanekiso 34.27 kanye noMfanekiso 34.38. Isithombe sibonisa isimo esibizwa ngokuthi i-spina bifida. Lesi simo senzeka lapho ithubhu yemizwa ingavali kahle engxenyeni engezansi yomzimba emgogodleni. Yini engenzeka uma ithubhu yemizwa ingavali kahle engxenyeni engenhla yomzimba?
question78: Bheka uMfanekiso 34.38. Isithombe sibonisa isimo esibizwa ngokuthi i-spina bifida. Lesi simo senzeka lapho ithubhu yemizwa ingavali kahle engxenyeni engezansi yomzimba emgogodleni. Isimo esingezansi kwesokudla, esibizwa ngokuthi i-meningomyelocele, yinguqulo embi kakhulu ye-spina bifida. Sibangela ukukhubazeka okukhulu, kanti ezinye izinhlobo zalesi simo zingase zingabangeli ukukhubazeka okukhulu. Yenza isimangalo mayelana nokuthi kungani i-meningomyelocele ibangela ukukhubazeka okukhulu.
answer78: Ku-meningomyelocele, intambo yomgogodla ayikho endaweni yayo evamile
distractor78a: Ku-meningomyelocele, isikhwama esigcwele uketshezi lwe-cerebrospinal sikhulu
question79: Yikuphi okuchaza kahle izigaba ezintathu zokubeletha?
answer79: Ngesikhathi sesigaba sokuqala, umlomo wesibeletho uyancipha futhi unwebeka ube cishe yi-10 cm. Ngesikhathi sesigaba sesibili, umntwana uyakhishwa esibelethweni. Isigaba sokugcina ukudlula kwe-placenta ngemva kokuzalwa komntwana.
distractor79a: Ngesikhathi sesigaba sokuqala, umlomo wesibeletho uyancipha. Ngesikhathi sesigaba sesibili, umlomo wesibeletho uyanwebeka ube cishe yi-10 cm bese umntwana ekhishwa esibelethweni. Isigaba sokugcina ukudlula kwe-placenta ngemva kokuzalwa komntwana.
distractor79b: Ngesikhathi sesigaba sokuqala, umlomo wesibeletho uyancipha. Ngesikhathi sesigaba sesibili, umlomo wesibeletho uyanwebeka ube cishe yi-10 cm. Ngesikhathi sesigaba sokugcina, umntwana uyakhishwa esibelethweni, kulandele i-placenta
distractor79c: Ngesikhathi sesigaba sokuqala, umlomo wesibeletho uyancipha futhi ungase uvuleke noma ungavuleki. Ngesikhathi sesigaba sesibili, umntwana uyakhishwa esibelethweni. Isigaba sokugcina ukudlula kwe-placenta ngemva kokuzalwa komntwana
question80: Bheka uMfanekiso 34.39. Uhlobo lwezilwane ezincane kakhulu (i-Brachionus calyciflorus) lungazala kokubili ngokocansi nangokungazali. Ucwaningo luhlole ukuthi ukufaneleka kwenzalo ekhiqizwe ngokocansi kanye nenzalo ekhiqizwe ngaphandle kocansi kwashintsha kanjani lapho into ephilayo ijwayela indawo entsha. Igrafu ikhombisa idatha yocwaningo. Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kulolu cwaningo
answer80: Inzalo ezalwa kabusha ngokocansi inenzuzo enkulu uma ijwayela izindawo ezintsha
distractor80a: Ukuzala ngokocansi kwavela ngokuzivumelanisa nezimo ezintsha
distractor80b: Inzalo ekhiqizwa ngokocansi ikhiqiza inzalo eningi kunenzalo ekhiqizwa ngaphandle kocansi ezimweni eziningi
distractor80c: Ukuzala ngokocansi kunenzuzo kakhulu kunokuzala okungenabo ubulili ngaphansi kwezimo eziningi
question81: Qhathanisa futhi uqhathanise ukunqunywa kobulili ezinyonini nasezincelisayo
answer81: Ezincelisayo, ubulili bunqunywa ukuba khona kwe-XX (homozygous) kwabesifazane kanye ne-XY (heterozygous) kwabesilisa, kanti ezinyonini, ubulili bunqunywa ukuba khona kwe-ZW (heterozygous) kwabesifazane kanye ne-ZZ (homozygous) kwabesilisa.
distractor81a: Ezincelisayo, ubulili bunqunywa ukuba khona kwe-XX (homozygous) kwabesilisa kanye ne-XY (heterozygous) kwabesifazane, kanti ezinyonini, ubulili bunqunywa ukuba khona kwe-ZZ (homozygous) kwabesifazane kanye ne-ZW (heterozygous) kwabesilisa.
distractor81b: Ezincelisayo, ubulili bunqunywa ukuba khona kwe-XX (homozygous) kwabesilisa kanye ne-XY (heterozygous) kwabesifazane, kanti ezinyonini, ubulili bunqunywa ukuba khona kwe-ZW (heterozygous) kwabesifazane kanye ne-ZZ (homozygous) kwabesilisa.
distractor81c: Ezincelisayo, ubulili bunqunywa ukuba khona kwe-XX (homozygous) kwabesifazane kanye ne-XY (heterozygous) kwabesilisa, kanti ezinyonini, ubulili bunqunywa ukuba khona kwe-ZZ (homozygous) kwabesifazane kanye ne-ZW (heterozygous) kwabesilisa.
question82: Bheka uMfanekiso 34.39. Uhlobo lwezilwane ezincane kakhulu (i-Brachionus calyciflorus) lungazala kokubili ngokocansi nangokungazali. Ucwaningo luhlole ukuthi ukufaneleka kwenzalo ekhiqizwe ngokocansi kanye nenzalo ekhiqizwe ngaphandle kocansi kwashintsha kanjani lapho into ephilayo izivumelanisa nendawo entsha. Igrafu ikhombisa idatha yocwaningo. Yikuphi ukukhetha okuchaza idatha eboniswe kule grafu?
answer82: Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukufaneleka kwenzalo ekhiqizwe ngaphandle kocansi kwehla
distractor82a: Inzalo ekhiqizwe ngocansi yayilungele kakhulu kulo lonke ukubukwa
distractor82b: Inzalo ekhiqizwe ngaphandle kocansi yayifaneleka kakhulu kulo lonke ukubukwa
distractor82c: Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukufaneleka kwenzalo ekhiqizwe ngocansi kwehle
question83: Ekuzaleni ngokocansi, amaseli amabili ohlobo oluthile ayahlangana akhe elinye iseli. Kungani lokhu kuwusizo?
answer83: Ikhiqiza inhlanganisela entsha yezakhi zofuzo, evumela inzalo ukuba iphile ngesikhathi sokushintsha kwemvelo
distractor83a: Kuphumela ekukhiqizweni kwenzalo eningi ngesikhathi esifushane
distractor83b: Akubandakanyi ukwakheka kwe-gamete futhi kudinga amandla amancane
distractor83c: Ivumela izinto eziphilayo ezinganyakazi ukuthi zizalane uma kungekho umngane wazo
question84: Ukuzala kuvame ukubangelwa isignali efana nokushisa kwamanzi noma ubude bosuku. Iyini inzuzo yokusebenzisa lolu hlobo lwesignali uma kuqhathaniswa nokusebenzisa izindlela zokuthandana zomuntu ngamunye?
answer84: Ivumela abantu abaningi ukuba bazale ngesikhathi esisodwa ngaphandle kokuba abesilisa nabesifazane bakhethe abalingani ngabanye.
distractor84a: Yindlela kuphela abesilisa nabesifazane abangachitha ngayo isikhathi sokukhululwa kwe-gametes ngasikhathi sinye
question85: Bheka uMfanekiso 34.40. Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo mayelana nokulawulwa kwamahomoni omjikelezo wokuzala kwabesifazane esiyiqiniso?
distractor85a: I-LH ne-FSH kukhiqizwa kuma-ovari, kanti i-estradiol ne-progesterone kukhiqizwa ku-pituitary.
distractor85b: I-Estradiol ne-progesterone ezikhishwa yi-corpus luteum zibangela ukuthi i-myometrium iqine
distractor85c: Ukukhiqizwa kwe-GnRH yi-hypothalamus kuvinjelwa amazinga aphezulu e-estradiol, kodwa kukhuthazwa amazinga aphansi e-estradiol.
question86: Bheka Umfanekiso 34.41. Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo mayelana nomjikelezo wokuya esikhathini esiyiqiniso?
answer86: Ukuya esikhathini kwenzeka ngaphambi kokuba amazinga e-LH ne-FSH afinyelele phezulu.
distractor86a: Amazinga e-estrogen akhuphuka ngesikhathi sesigaba se-luteal somjikelezo we-ovarian kanye nesigaba sokukhipha isisu somjikelezo wesibeletho.
distractor86b: Ukuya esikhathini kwenzeka ngemva kokwenyuka kwamazinga e-progesterone
distractor86c: Amazinga e-progesterone akhuphuka ngaphambi kokuvuthwa kwamaqanda, kanti amazinga e-estrogen akhuphuka ngemva kokukhulelwa.
question87: Yini ekhuthaza amangqamuzana e-Leydig kuma-testes ukuthi akhiqize i-testosterone?
question88: Iyini i-oogonium kanye ne-oocyte yesibili? Yimuphi inqubo eholela ekwakhekeni kwe-oocyte yesibili?
answer88: I-oogonium ye-diploid yakha i-haploid oocyte ngenqubo ye-meiosis
distractor88a: I-oogonium ye-diploid yakha i-haploid oocyte ngenqubo ye-mitosis
distractor88b: I-haploid oogonium yakha i-diploid oocyte ngenqubo ye-meiosis
distractor88c: I-haploid oogonium yakha i-haploid oocyte ngenqubo ye-meiosis
question89: Kungani ama-zygote e-diploid akhiqizwa ngemva kokukhulelwa kwamangqamuzana esidoda akhiqizwa yi-spermatogenesis engafani?
distractor89c: Esinye isidoda singaba nomsila, kanti esinye singase singabi nawo
question90: Uhlelo lwe-endocrine luhlanganisa izindlela zokuphendula ezigcina i-homeostasis. Qhathanisa izindlela ezilandelayo ukuze uthole ukuthi iyiphi ebonisa impendulo engemihle ngohlelo lokuzala ezincelisayo.
answer90: Amazinga akhulayo e-testosterone avimbela ukukhiqizwa kwe-GnRH, i-LH, ne-FSH yi-hypothalamus kanye ne-pituitary
distractor90a: I-LH ne-FSH zivuselela amaseli angaphakathi e-Leydig ukuze akhiphe i-testosterone kwabesilisa
distractor90b: Kwabesifazane, i-follicle ekhulayo iqala ukukhulula i-estrogen ngobuningi obandayo.
distractor90c: I-corpus luteum ikhipha i-progesterone ngemva kokuvuthwa
question91: Bheka uMfanekiso 34.42. Igrafu ikhombisa indawo yokugcina amaqanda kanye namazinga ashintshayo ama-hormone ngesikhathi sokunqamuka kokuya esikhathini. Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kule grafu
answer91: Ama-ovari aqukethe inqolobane elinganiselwe yama-follicles ama-ovari emzimbeni.
distractor91a: Ngesikhathi sokuya esikhathini, ukukhiqizwa kwe-progesterone kuyanda.
distractor91b: Ama-follicle amasha esibelethweni akhiqizwa njalo nge-meiosis
distractor91c: Ngesikhathi sokunqamuka kokuya esikhathini, ukukhishwa kwe-follicle stimulating hormone (FSH) kuyancishiswa.
question92: Chaza isenzakalo esingaba khona uma i-corpus luteum ingakhiqizi inani elikhulayo le-progesterone
answer92: Ngisho noma ukukhulelwa kuphumelele, i-zygote ingase ingakwazi ukutshala ngempumelelo. Uma ikwazi ukutshala, ngeke ikwazi ukuthola ukudla okwanele ku-endometrium.
distractor92a: I-zygote efakiwe ngeke ikwazi ukuthola ukudla okwanele kusuka ku-endometrium
distractor92b: Ngisho noma ukukhulelwa kuphumelele, i-zygote ingase ingakwazi ukutshala ngempumelelo. Uma ikwazi ukutshala, ngeke ikwazi ukuthola ukudla okwanele ku-myometrium.
distractor92c: Ukufinyela kwesibeletho ngesikhathi sokubeletha kanye nokuncelisa ngeke kwenzeke, okubangela izinkinga nezinkinga kumama.
question93: Yini eyenziwa yiphilisi lokuvimbela inzalo labesifazane elivimbela ukukhishwa kwe-GnRH kusuka ku-hypothalamus?
answer93: Ukunciphisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-FSH ne-LH kusuka ku-anterior pituitary gland
distractor93b: Ukwandisa isigaba sokugeleza komjikelezo wokuya esikhathini
question94: Yini ebangela ukwenyuka kwamazinga e-FSH ne-LH esigabeni se-follicular?
answer94: Ama-follicle ebusweni besibeletho aqala ukukhula ukulungiselela ukuvuthwa kweqanda
distractor94c: Enye yama-follicle avuthiwe iyaqhuma, ikhulule iqanda
question95: Umbhangqwana ubelokhu uzama ukukhulelwa isikhathi esithile futhi uya kudokotela we-endocrinologist ukuze athole iseluleko. Uma udokotela we-endocrinologist ethola ukuthi kukhona ukuvaleka kwamaqanda kowesifazane, yiluphi uhlobo lokwelashwa angaluncoma?
answer95: Ukukhetha ukukhulelwa ngaphandle kokusebenzisa i-in vitro noma ukususa ukuvinjelwa ngokuhlinzwa bese kuhlanganiswa kabusha iziphetho zamapayipi e-fallopian
distractor95a: Ukukhetha ukukhulelwa emzimbeni noma ukubopha amashubhu e-fallopian ngokuhlinzwa ukuze amashubhu avalwe
distractor95b: Ukukhetha ukukhulelwa noma ukususwa kokuvinjelwa ngokuhlinzwa bese kuhlanganiswa kabusha iziphetho zamapayipi e-fallopian
distractor95c: Ukukhetha ukukhulelwa kwe-in vitro noma ukubopha amashubhu e-fallopian ngokuhlinzwa ukuze amashubhu avalwe
question96: Bheka uMfanekiso 34.43. Izithombe namagrafu abonisa amazinga ama-hormone kanye nesakhiwo solwelwesi lwesibeletho ngesikhathi somjikelezo wokuya esikhathini. Yiliphi i-hormone noma ama-hormone adlala indima enkulu ekuqhekekeni kwe-follicle?
answer96: I-follicle stimulating hormone (FSH) kanye ne-luteinizing hormone (LH)
question97: Bheka uMfanekiso 34.43. Izithombe namagrafu abonisa amazinga ama-hormone kanye nesakhiwo solwelwesi lwesibeletho ngesikhathi somjikelezo wokuya esikhathini. Yiliphi i-hormone elidlala indima enkulu ekuthuthukisweni kolwelwesi lwesibeletho?
question98: Bheka uMfanekiso 34.44. Igrafu ikhombisa amazinga e-oxytocin (i-hormone) ngesikhathi sokubeletha kanye nokwanda komlomo wesibeletho. Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kule grafu
answer98: Umzimba ukhipha inani elikhulayo le-oxytocin, okuholela ekwandeni kokukhula kwesibeletho.
distractor98a: Amazinga e-oxytocin angaphezu komkhawulo anele ukubangela ukwanda okukhulu komlomo wesibeletho
distractor98b: Amazinga e-Oxytocin awahlobene nokukhula komlomo wesibeletho
distractor98c: Amazinga e-oxytocin angaphansi komkhawulo abangela ukwanda okukhulu kokukhula komlomo wesibeletho
question99: Yiliphi i-hormone ekhishwa yi-anterior pituitary njengengxenye ye-positive feedback loop phakathi kwayo ne-ovary?
question100: Bheka uMfanekiso 34.45. Igrafu ikhombisa idatha kahulumeni wase-US yemiphumela yezinqubo zobuchwepheshe bokusiza ekuzaleni ngo-2016. Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kulolu lwazi
answer100: Iningi lokukhulelwa liphela ngempumelelo ekuzalweni okuphilayo
distractor100b: Kukhona ukungafani kwedatha lapho inani lezinsana likhulu kunenani lokuzalwa okuphilayo
distractor100c: Cishe ama-50% emizamo ayahluleka ekudluliseni umbungu
question101: Bheka uMfanekiso 34.46. Igrafu ikhombisa amazinga e-oxytocin ngesikhathi sokubeletha. I-Oxytocin iyi-hormone ebangela ukufinyela kwemisipha ezungeze isibeletho. Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kule grafu
answer101: Ukufinyela kwenzeka ngezikhathi ezithile. Imisipha iyafinyela imizuzu embalwa bese iphumula. Ukufinyela ngakunye kunamandla kunokwangaphambilini
distractor101a: Imisipha iyafinyela ekuqaleni kokubeletha futhi ayiphumuli. Ukufinyela okukodwa kuyaqina kancane kancane
distractor101b: Imisipha iyafinyela ekuqaleni kokubeletha futhi ayilokothi iphumule. Ukufinyela okukodwa kuya ngokuya kuba buthakathaka
distractor101c: Ukufinyela kwenzeka ngezikhathi ezithile. Imisipha iyafinyela imizuzu embalwa bese iphumula. Ukufinyela kuyashintsha ngobukhulu
